* [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) — журнал версий и список всех изменений.

### Практические исправления редактора (0.4.257)
Кнопка ⋮ в верхней панели открывает выбор папки, язык OCR и восстановление экспорта. В меню можно вернуться к Download/DocScan. Рамка автообрезки фиксируется в момент нажатия затвора. Ручная обрезка и сохранение настроек используют изображение с разрешением до 3000 px по длинной стороне; уменьшенный предпросмотр не заменяет источник при сохранении. Полный исходный JPEG сохраняется отдельно от производной страницы и доступен через «Вернуть исходный снимок» в течение жизни страницы и предусмотренной истории Undo.

### Надёжное сохранение PDF
PDF и выбранные JPG получают общее свободное имя без замены существующих файлов. Публичная запись проверяется чтением размера и SHA-256; при ошибке публикация не считается успешной. Успешные сохранения доступны в «Недавних» независимо от SAF. После полного подтверждения неизменённые сохранённые страницы убираются из рабочей ленты; отредактированные в процессе страницы сохраняются.

При сохранении PDF ограничения поискового слоя показываются в диалоге результата; видимый снимок сохраняется. В режиме OCR без JPG требуется непустой результат распознавания каждой страницы и проверяется полнота поддерживаемого текста. Ошибка или таймаут OCR прекращает сохранение. Текст импортированных PDF без координат переносится и масштабируется целиком в пределах страницы; длинный текст может печататься меньшим шрифтом.

## Проверка качества OCR

[План, бэкап, измерения и ограничения OCR](docs/OCR_QUALITY_RESULTS.md) описывают сохранение оригиналов камеры, метрики и сравнительные проверки. `OcrQualityRegressionInstrumentedTest` проверяет надёжность без дополнительных моделей. Для сравнительного `OcrQualityBenchmarkInstrumentedTest` сначала выполнить `python3 tools/prepare_ocr_benchmark_assets.py --project /путь/к/проверочной/копии --with-real-scans`, затем собрать AndroidTest APK в этой копии. Модели best занимают около 44 МБ, закреплены commit/SHA и используются только тестовым APK; production содержит прежние fast-модели.

### Уточнение режима «Документ» (0.4.269)
После переключения режима и смены положения листа рамка подтверждается заново свежими кадрами. Обработка готового JPEG использует собственный контур: отсутствие живой рамки само по себе не запрещает обрезку, а её достоверное противоречие сохраняет полный кадр. Устаревшие кадры не подтверждают рамку после паузы.

### Обработка обрезки и память (0.4.270)
Рабочее разрешение обрезки выбирается по размерам исходных и выходных буферов; полный исходный JPEG остаётся неизменным. Детекция сохранённого кадра и warp согласованы с OCR через общий допуск тяжёлой работы. В редакторе применяется утверждённый план, а устаревшая версия страницы или другой артефакт отклоняются.

В 0.4.271 дополнительно восстановлена полнота объявлений адаптера для сборки чистого Git checkout. Результаты проверки режима и ограничения перечислены в [протоколе](docs/archive/document-mode/DOCUMENT_MODE_VALIDATION.md).

В 0.4.272 редактор автообрезки сообщает о нехватке памяти при предпросмотре или применении; текущая страница остаётся без изменений.

В 0.4.273 детектор сохраняет исходные границы для листа у края кадра, учитывает бумагу внутри кандидата при выборе между листом и внешним фоном и допускает погрешность перспективы для чеков 1:12. Эти изменения проверяются настоящим OpenCV на фиксированном наборе изображений.

### Сохранение PDF · 0.4.307

Первое окно сохранения содержит закреплённые заголовок и имя файла, OCR/jpg справа сверху и кнопки снизу. DB необязательна: без категории работают личные префиксы. При выборе категории каждый вложенный уровень появляется отдельным пустым полем. В DB доступны контекстные префиксы, владелец, Private, даты и несколько назначений. Локальный PDF фиксируется до облачной очереди; повтор отправки сохраняет идентификаторы документа и выбранных связей. Подробнее: [FamilyTodoList Docs](docs/FAMILY_DOCS.md).

В 0.4.308 карточка сохранения компактна без DB и увеличивается по мере появления полей категории, разделов и дополнительных сведений. После достижения доступной высоты включается прокрутка тела формы.

В 0.4.309 базовые категории Docs доступны без предварительного подключения. Кнопка подключения видна в карточке; после ввода кода форма сохраняет заполненные поля и загружает реальный каталог семьи. Сохранение в семейную DB требует авторизации; локальный PDF без DB остаётся доступен без неё.

package app.docscan.android;

import android.content.ContentProvider;
import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;

import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Instrumentation-only provider for deterministic PDF source failure and grant-revocation tests. */
public final class PdfSourceFaultTestProvider extends ContentProvider {
    public static final String AUTHORITY = "app.docscan.scanner.test.pdfsource";
    public static final String MODE_COMPLETE = "COMPLETE";
    public static final String MODE_FAIL_AFTER_PREFIX = "FAIL_AFTER_PREFIX";
    public static final String MODE_BLOCK_THEN_COMPLETE = "BLOCK_THEN_COMPLETE";

    private static final String PREFS = "pdf_source_fault_provider";
    private static final String KEY_BYTES = "bytes";
    private static final String KEY_MIME_TYPE = "mime_type";
    private static final String KEY_MODE = "mode";
    private static final String KEY_SPLIT = "split";
    private static final String KEY_OPENS = "opens";
    private static final String KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN = "bytes_written";
    private static final String KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN = "prefix_written";
    private static final String KEY_RELEASED = "released";
    private static final String KEY_OUTCOME = "outcome";
    private static final String KEY_OK = "ok";
    private static final long STREAM_RELEASE_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000L;
    private static final ExecutorService WRITERS = Executors.newCachedThreadPool(runnable -> {
        Thread thread = new Thread(runnable, "pdf-source-fault-provider");
        thread.setDaemon(true);
        return thread;
    });

    @Override public boolean onCreate() { return true; }

    @Override public String getType(Uri uri) {
        String fixtureId = uri.getLastPathSegment();
        if (fixtureId == null) return "application/pdf";
        return getContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, 0)
                .getString(fixtureId + "." + KEY_MIME_TYPE, "application/pdf");
    }

    @Override public Cursor query(Uri uri, String[] projection, String selection,
                                  String[] selectionArgs, String sortOrder) { return null; }

    @Override public Uri insert(Uri uri, ContentValues values) {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Read-only PDF source fixture");
    }

    @Override public int delete(Uri uri, String selection, String[] selectionArgs) {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Read-only PDF source fixture");
    }

    @Override public int update(Uri uri, ContentValues values, String selection, String[] selectionArgs) {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Read-only PDF source fixture");
    }

    @Override public Bundle call(String method, String arg, Bundle extras) {
        if (arg == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Fixture ID is required");
        android.content.SharedPreferences prefs = getContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, 0);
        String key = arg + ".";
        switch (method) {
            case "configure": {
                if (extras == null || extras.getByteArray(KEY_BYTES) == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source bytes are required");
                }
                byte[] data = extras.getByteArray(KEY_BYTES);
                String mode = extras.getString(KEY_MODE);
                if (!MODE_COMPLETE.equals(mode) && !MODE_FAIL_AFTER_PREFIX.equals(mode)
                        && !MODE_BLOCK_THEN_COMPLETE.equals(mode)) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown provider stream mode: " + mode);
                }
                int split = Math.max(1, Math.min(data.length - 1, extras.getInt(KEY_SPLIT, 64)));
                boolean saved = prefs.edit()
                        .putString(key + KEY_BYTES, android.util.Base64.encodeToString(data, android.util.Base64.NO_WRAP))
                        .putString(key + KEY_MIME_TYPE, extras.getString(KEY_MIME_TYPE, "application/pdf"))
                        .putString(key + KEY_MODE, mode)
                        .putInt(key + KEY_SPLIT, split)
                        .putInt(key + KEY_OPENS, 0)
                        .putInt(key + KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN, 0)
                        .putBoolean(key + KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN, false)
                        .putBoolean(key + KEY_RELEASED, false)
                        .putString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "NOT_OPENED")
                        .commit();
                if (!saved) throw new IllegalStateException("Could not persist provider fixture configuration");
                Bundle configured = new Bundle();
                configured.putBoolean(KEY_OK, true);
                return configured;
            }
            case "release": {
                if (!prefs.edit().putBoolean(key + KEY_RELEASED, true).commit()) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Could not release provider stream");
                }
                Bundle released = new Bundle();
                released.putBoolean(KEY_OK, true);
                return released;
            }
            case "grant": {
                String[] targetPackages = extras == null ? new String[0] : extras.getStringArray("target_packages");
                if (targetPackages == null || targetPackages.length == 0) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Target package names are required");
                }
                Uri fixtureUri = Uri.parse("content://" + AUTHORITY + "/pdf/" + arg);
                for (String targetPackage : targetPackages) {
                    getContext().grantUriPermission(targetPackage, fixtureUri,
                            android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
                }
                Bundle granted = new Bundle();
                granted.putBoolean(KEY_OK, true);
                return granted;
            }
            case "revoke": {
                Uri fixtureUri = Uri.parse("content://" + AUTHORITY + "/pdf/" + arg);
                getContext().revokeUriPermission(fixtureUri, android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
                Bundle revoked = new Bundle();
                revoked.putBoolean(KEY_OK, true);
                return revoked;
            }
            case "state": {
                Bundle state = new Bundle();
                state.putInt(KEY_OPENS, prefs.getInt(key + KEY_OPENS, 0));
                state.putInt(KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN, prefs.getInt(key + KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN, 0));
                state.putBoolean(KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN, prefs.getBoolean(key + KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN, false));
                state.putString(KEY_OUTCOME, prefs.getString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "NOT_OPENED"));
                return state;
            }
            case "clear": {
                android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor edit = prefs.edit();
                String[] keys = {KEY_BYTES, KEY_MIME_TYPE, KEY_MODE, KEY_SPLIT, KEY_OPENS, KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN,
                        KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN, KEY_RELEASED, KEY_OUTCOME};
                for (String item : keys) edit.remove(key + item);
                if (!edit.commit()) throw new IllegalStateException("Could not clear provider fixture");
                Bundle cleared = new Bundle();
                cleared.putBoolean(KEY_OK, true);
                return cleared;
            }
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown provider fixture command: " + method);
        }
    }

    @Override public ParcelFileDescriptor openFile(Uri uri, String mode) throws FileNotFoundException {
        if (!"r".equals(mode)) throw new FileNotFoundException("PDF source fixture is read-only");
        String fixtureId = uri.getLastPathSegment();
        if (fixtureId == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("Fixture ID is missing");
        android.content.SharedPreferences prefs = getContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, 0);
        String key = fixtureId + ".";
        String encoded = prefs.getString(key + KEY_BYTES, null);
        String streamMode = prefs.getString(key + KEY_MODE, null);
        if (encoded == null || streamMode == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("Fixture is not configured");
        final byte[] bytes;
        try {
            bytes = android.util.Base64.decode(encoded, android.util.Base64.NO_WRAP);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException failure) {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Fixture bytes are malformed");
        }
        int split = Math.max(1, Math.min(bytes.length - 1, prefs.getInt(key + KEY_SPLIT, 64)));
        if (!prefs.edit().putInt(key + KEY_OPENS, prefs.getInt(key + KEY_OPENS, 0) + 1)
                .putString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "OPENED").commit()) {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Could not record provider open");
        }

        final ParcelFileDescriptor[] pipe;
        try {
            pipe = ParcelFileDescriptor.createReliablePipe();
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Could not create reliable PDF source pipe: " + failure.getMessage());
        }
        WRITERS.execute(() -> writeStream(pipe, prefs, key, bytes, streamMode, split));
        return pipe[0];
    }

    private static void writeStream(ParcelFileDescriptor[] pipe, android.content.SharedPreferences prefs,
                                    String key, byte[] bytes, String mode, int split) {
        ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseOutputStream output = new ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseOutputStream(pipe[1]);
        try {
            if (MODE_COMPLETE.equals(mode)) {
                output.write(bytes);
                output.flush();
                prefs.edit().putInt(key + KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN, bytes.length)
                        .putString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "COMPLETE").commit();
                output.close();
                return;
            }
            output.write(bytes, 0, split);
            output.flush();
            prefs.edit().putInt(key + KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN, split)
                    .putBoolean(key + KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN, true)
                    .putString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "WAITING_AFTER_PREFIX").commit();
            awaitRelease(prefs, key);
            if (MODE_BLOCK_THEN_COMPLETE.equals(mode)) {
                output.write(bytes, split, bytes.length - split);
                output.flush();
                prefs.edit().putInt(key + KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN, bytes.length)
                        .putString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "COMPLETE_AFTER_RELEASE").commit();
                output.close();
            } else {
                prefs.edit().putString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "FAILED_AFTER_PREFIX").commit();
                pipe[1].closeWithError("Injected provider failure after " + split + " bytes");
            }
        } catch (Exception failure) {
            String outcome = prefs.getString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "");
            if (!"FAILED_AFTER_PREFIX".equals(outcome)) {
                prefs.edit().putString(key + KEY_OUTCOME, "WRITER_ERROR:" + failure.getClass().getSimpleName()).commit();
            }
            try { output.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) { }
        }
    }

    private static void awaitRelease(android.content.SharedPreferences prefs, String key) throws IOException {
        long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + STREAM_RELEASE_TIMEOUT_MS;
        while (!prefs.getBoolean(key + KEY_RELEASED, false)) {
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() >= deadline) throw new IOException("Test did not release the provider stream");
            try {
                Thread.sleep(10);
            } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                throw new IOException("Provider writer was interrupted", interrupted);
            }
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.FileAlreadyExistsException
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class AndroidAtomicArtifactPublisherInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun atomicallyRenamesWithinPrivateStorageAndRefusesToReplaceExistingTarget() {
        val root = File(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext.cacheDir, "publisher-${System.nanoTime()}")
        val source = File(root, "staging/source.tmp")
        val target = File(root, "objects/result.bin")
        source.parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        target.parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        val publisher = AndroidAtomicArtifactPublisher()
        try {
            val first = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4)
            source.writeBytes(first)
            publisher.publish(source.toPath(), target.toPath())
            assertFalse(source.exists())
            assertArrayEquals(first, target.readBytes())

            val duplicate = File(source.parentFile, "duplicate.tmp")
            val originalTargetBytes = target.readBytes()
            duplicate.writeBytes(byteArrayOf(9, 8, 7))
            assertThrows(FileAlreadyExistsException::class.java) {
                publisher.publish(duplicate.toPath(), target.toPath())
            }
            assertTrue(duplicate.exists())
            assertArrayEquals(originalTargetBytes, target.readBytes())
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.os.OperationCanceledException
import android.os.CancellationSignal
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType1Font
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.encryption.AccessPermission
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.encryption.StandardProtectionPolicy
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.security.MessageDigest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class AndroidPdfImportReaderInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun cancellationAfterRasterizerReturnsRecyclesBitmapAndStopsBeforeOutputOrCallback() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val pdf = threePagePdf(context, "pdf-import-cancel-after-raster.pdf")
        val scratch = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-cancel-after-raster-scratch").apply { mkdirs() }
        val signal = CancellationSignal()
        val scheduler = app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler()
        val rendered = mutableListOf<Bitmap>()
        var callbacks = 0
        val outputOpens = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
        val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader.withPngOutputForTest(
            context,
            PdfPageBitmapRenderer { renderer, pageIndex, scale ->
                assertEquals("Cancellation must stop before a later page rasterizes", 0, pageIndex)
                renderer.renderImage(pageIndex, scale).also {
                    rendered += it
                    signal.cancel()
                }
            },
            PdfPagePngOutputFactory {
                outputOpens.incrementAndGet()
                throw AssertionError("Cancellation after rasterization must be checked before opening PNG output")
            },
            Bitmap::recycle,
        )
        val sourceDigest = sha256(pdf)
        try {
            val failure = org.junit.Assert.assertThrows(OperationCanceledException::class.java) {
                reader.renderPages(
                    source = pdf,
                    expectedPageCount = 3,
                    skipPageIndices = emptySet(),
                    scratchDirectory = scratch,
                    scheduler = scheduler,
                    cancellationSignal = signal,
                ) { _, _, _ -> callbacks++ }
            }
            assertTrue(failure.message.orEmpty().isNotBlank())
            assertEquals(1, rendered.size)
            assertTrue("Bitmap returned by the rasterizer is recycled exactly through the real recycler", rendered.single().isRecycled)
            assertEquals("Output stream was not opened", 0, outputOpens.get())
            assertEquals("Canceled page was not delivered", 0, callbacks)
            assertTrue("Canceled page temp output is removed", scratch.listFiles().isNullOrEmpty())
            assertEquals("Cancellation releases scheduler admission", "available",
                scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) { "available" })
            assertEquals(sourceDigest, sha256(pdf))
        } finally {
            rendered.filterNot(Bitmap::isRecycled).forEach(Bitmap::recycle)
            pdf.delete()
            scratch.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsEmptyMalformedAndEncryptedPdfs() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader(context)
        val fixtures = mutableListOf<File>()
        try {
            val empty = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-empty.pdf").also(fixtures::add)
            PDDocument().use { it.save(empty) }
            assertRejectedWithoutMutation(reader, empty, IllegalArgumentException::class.java)

            val malformed = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-malformed.pdf").also(fixtures::add)
            malformed.writeBytes("%PDF-1.7\nnot-a-pdf".toByteArray())
            assertRejectedWithoutMutation(reader, malformed, Exception::class.java)

            val truncated = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-truncated.pdf").also(fixtures::add)
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.save(truncated)
            }
            val original = truncated.readBytes()
            val eofMarker = "%%EOF".toByteArray()
            val markerStart = original.indices.lastOrNull { start ->
                start + eofMarker.size <= original.size
                    && eofMarker.indices.all { offset -> original[start + offset] == eofMarker[offset] }
            } ?: throw AssertionError("Generated PDF fixture has no EOF marker")
            truncated.writeBytes(original.copyOf(markerStart))
            assertRejectedWithoutMutation(reader, truncated, IllegalArgumentException::class.java)

            val encrypted = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-encrypted.pdf").also(fixtures::add)
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.protect(StandardProtectionPolicy("owner-secret", "user-secret", AccessPermission()))
                document.save(encrypted)
            }
            assertRejectedWithoutMutation(reader, encrypted, Exception::class.java)
        } finally {
            fixtures.forEach(File::delete)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsMalformedPdfCorpusWithoutSideEffectsAndReopensValidSource() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(context)
        val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader(context)
        data class InvalidFixture(
            val name: String,
            val file: File,
            val inspectionMessage: String,
            val renderFailureType: Class<out Throwable>,
            val renderMessageFragment: String?,
        )

        val fixtureFiles = mutableListOf<File>()
        val scratchDirectories = mutableListOf<File>()
        val valid = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-corpus-valid.pdf").also(fixtureFiles::add)
        try {
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                val page = PDPage(PDRectangle.A4)
                document.addPage(page)
                PDPageContentStream(document, page).use { stream ->
                    stream.beginText()
                    stream.setFont(PDType1Font.HELVETICA, 12f)
                    stream.newLineAtOffset(72f, PDRectangle.A4.height - 72f)
                    stream.showText("Valid parser recovery control 48372615")
                    stream.endText()
                }
                document.save(valid)
            }
            val validDigest = sha256(valid)
            assertEquals(1, reader.inspect(valid).pageCount)

            val empty = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-corpus-zero-page.pdf").also(fixtureFiles::add)
            PDDocument().use { it.save(empty) }

            val malformed = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-corpus-malformed-bytes.pdf").also(fixtureFiles::add)
            malformed.writeBytes("%PDF-1.7\nnot-a-pdf\n%%EOF\n".toByteArray())

            val truncated = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-corpus-truncated.pdf").also(fixtureFiles::add)
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.save(truncated)
            }
            val truncatedBytes = truncated.readBytes()
            val eofMarker = "%%EOF".toByteArray()
            val markerStart = lastIndexOf(truncatedBytes, eofMarker)
            assertTrue("Generated truncation fixture must contain terminal EOF", markerStart >= 0)
            truncated.writeBytes(truncatedBytes.copyOf(markerStart))

            val encryptedWithUserPassword = File(context.cacheDir,
                "pdf-import-corpus-encrypted-user-password.pdf").also(fixtureFiles::add)
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.protect(StandardProtectionPolicy("owner-secret", "user-secret", AccessPermission()))
                document.save(encryptedWithUserPassword)
            }

            val encryptedWithEmptyUserPassword = File(context.cacheDir,
                "pdf-import-corpus-encrypted-empty-user-password.pdf").also(fixtureFiles::add)
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.protect(StandardProtectionPolicy("owner-secret", "", AccessPermission()))
                document.save(encryptedWithEmptyUserPassword)
            }

            val brokenRoot = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-corpus-broken-root.pdf").also(fixtureFiles::add)
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.save(brokenRoot)
            }
            val brokenRootBytes = brokenRoot.readBytes()
            val serialized = String(brokenRootBytes, Charsets.ISO_8859_1)
            val rootReference = Regex("/Root\\s+\\d+\\s+\\d+\\s+R")
                .findAll(serialized)
                .lastOrNull()
            assertNotNull("Generated PDF fixture must expose its trailer Root reference", rootReference)
            val corruptRoot = serialized.replaceRange(rootReference!!.range, "/Root 987654 0 R")
            assertTrue("Corrupt fixture must retain its terminal EOF marker", lastIndexOf(
                corruptRoot.toByteArray(Charsets.ISO_8859_1), eofMarker,
            ) >= 0)
            brokenRoot.writeBytes(corruptRoot.toByteArray(Charsets.ISO_8859_1))

            val invalid = listOf(
                InvalidFixture(
                    "zero-page", empty,
                    "PDF must contain between 1 and 500 pages (found 0)",
                    IllegalStateException::class.java,
                    "page count changed after source snapshot",
                ),
                InvalidFixture(
                    "malformed-bytes", malformed,
                    "Private PDF source is malformed or unreadable",
                    IOException::class.java,
                    null,
                ),
                InvalidFixture(
                    "truncated-before-eof", truncated,
                    "PDF is truncated: terminal %%EOF marker is missing",
                    IllegalArgumentException::class.java,
                    "terminal %%EOF marker is missing",
                ),
                InvalidFixture(
                    "unresolvable-trailer-root", brokenRoot,
                    "Private PDF source is malformed or unreadable",
                    IOException::class.java,
                    null,
                ),
                InvalidFixture(
                    "encrypted-user-password-required", encryptedWithUserPassword,
                    "Encrypted PDFs are not supported for import",
                    PdfImportInvalidSourceException::class.java,
                    "Encrypted PDFs are not supported for import",
                ),
                InvalidFixture(
                    "encrypted-empty-user-password", encryptedWithEmptyUserPassword,
                    "Encrypted PDFs are not supported for import",
                    PdfImportInvalidSourceException::class.java,
                    "Encrypted PDFs are not supported for import",
                ),
            )

            invalid.forEachIndexed { fixtureIndex, fixture ->
                val sourceDigest = sha256(fixture.file)
                var firstRenderFailure: Pair<Class<out Throwable>, String?>? = null
                repeat(2) { attempt ->
                    val inspectionFailure = assertThrows(PdfImportInvalidSourceException::class.java) {
                        reader.inspect(fixture.file)
                    }
                    assertEquals("${fixture.name}: inspection error classification", fixture.inspectionMessage,
                        inspectionFailure.message)
                    assertEquals("${fixture.name}: inspection must preserve source bytes", sourceDigest,
                        sha256(fixture.file))

                    val scratch = File(context.cacheDir,
                        "pdf-import-corpus-scratch-$fixtureIndex-$attempt").apply { mkdirs() }
                    scratchDirectories += scratch
                    val callbacks = mutableListOf<Int>()
                    val renderFailure = assertThrows(fixture.renderFailureType) {
                        reader.renderPages(
                            source = fixture.file,
                            expectedPageCount = 1,
                            skipPageIndices = emptySet(),
                            scratchDirectory = scratch,
                            scheduler = app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler(),
                        ) { index, _, _ -> callbacks += index }
                    }
                    val actualRenderFailure = renderFailure.javaClass to renderFailure.message
                    if (firstRenderFailure == null) {
                        firstRenderFailure = actualRenderFailure
                    } else {
                        assertEquals("${fixture.name}: repeated render failure must be stable",
                            firstRenderFailure, actualRenderFailure)
                    }
                    assertTrue("${fixture.name}: render failure must be explicit",
                        !renderFailure.message.isNullOrBlank())
                    fixture.renderMessageFragment?.let { fragment ->
                        assertTrue("${fixture.name}: unexpected render diagnostic '${renderFailure.message}'",
                            renderFailure.message.orEmpty().contains(fragment))
                    }
                    assertTrue("${fixture.name}: invalid PDF must not publish a page", callbacks.isEmpty())
                    assertTrue("${fixture.name}: parser failure must leave scratch empty",
                        scratch.listFiles().isNullOrEmpty())
                    assertEquals("${fixture.name}: render failure must preserve source bytes", sourceDigest,
                        sha256(fixture.file))
                    assertEquals("${fixture.name}: a later valid parser open must succeed", 1,
                        reader.inspect(valid).pageCount)
                    assertEquals("${fixture.name}: valid control bytes must remain unchanged", validDigest,
                        sha256(valid))
                }
            }

            val rendered = mutableListOf<Int>()
            val validScratch = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-corpus-valid-scratch").apply { mkdirs() }
            scratchDirectories += validScratch
            reader.renderPages(valid, 1, emptySet(), validScratch,
                app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler()) { index, png, _ ->
                assertTrue("Valid control PNG exists during publication", png.isFile)
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(png.absolutePath)
                assertNotNull(bitmap)
                try {
                    assertTrue(bitmap!!.width > 0 && bitmap.height > 0)
                    rendered += index
                } finally {
                    bitmap?.recycle()
                }
            }
            assertEquals(listOf(0), rendered)
            assertTrue("Valid control scratch output is removed after publication", validScratch.listFiles().isNullOrEmpty())
            assertEquals(validDigest, sha256(valid))
        } finally {
            scratchDirectories.forEach(File::deleteRecursively)
            fixtureFiles.forEach(File::delete)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun terminalEofAllowsOnlyPdfWhitespaceAndPreservesSourceBytes() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader(context)
        val source = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-eof-boundary-source.pdf")
        val fixture = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-eof-boundary-fixture.pdf")
        try {
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.save(source)
            }
            val sourceDigest = sha256(source)
            val valid = source.readBytes()
            assertEquals(1, reader.inspect(source).pageCount)

            val eofEnd = lastIndexOf(valid, "%%EOF".toByteArray()) + "%%EOF".length
            assertTrue("Generated fixture must contain a terminal EOF marker", eofEnd >= "%%EOF".length)
            val permittedWhitespace = byteArrayOf(0, 9, 10, 12, 13, 32)
            permittedWhitespace.forEach { whitespace ->
                fixture.writeBytes(valid + byteArrayOf(whitespace))
                val digest = sha256(fixture)
                repeat(2) {
                    assertEquals("PDF whitespace 0x${whitespace.toUByte().toString(16)} is permitted after EOF",
                        1, reader.inspect(fixture).pageCount)
                }
                assertEquals(digest, sha256(fixture))
            }

            // The prior reader examined only a 64 KiB tail. Keep each PDF whitespace byte
            // valid when the suffix spans beyond that implementation window.
            permittedWhitespace.forEach { whitespace ->
                val longSuffix = ByteArray(64 * 1024 + 1) { whitespace }
                fixture.writeBytes(valid + longSuffix)
                val digest = sha256(fixture)
                repeat(2) {
                    assertEquals("Long PDF whitespace 0x${whitespace.toUByte().toString(16)} is permitted after EOF",
                        1, reader.inspect(fixture).pageCount)
                }
                assertEquals(digest, sha256(fixture))
            }

            val forbiddenTail = ByteArray(64 * 1024 + 1) { permittedWhitespace.last() }
            fixture.writeBytes(valid.copyOf(eofEnd) + forbiddenTail + byteArrayOf('X'.code.toByte()))
            assertRejectedWithoutMutation(reader, fixture, IllegalArgumentException::class.java)
            assertEquals(sourceDigest, sha256(source))
        } finally {
            source.delete()
            fixture.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun lastIndexOf(bytes: ByteArray, needle: ByteArray): Int {
        for (start in bytes.size - needle.size downTo 0) {
            if (needle.indices.all { bytes[start + it] == needle[it] }) return start
        }
        return -1
    }

    @Test
    fun inspectsAndRendersPagesInSourceOrderAndReusesUsableTextLayer() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val pdf = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-reader-fixture.pdf")
        val singlePage = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-single-page.pdf")
        try {
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                listOf(PDRectangle.A4, PDRectangle.LETTER).forEachIndexed { index, bounds ->
                    val page = PDPage(bounds)
                    if (index == 1) page.rotation = 90
                    document.addPage(page)
                    if (index == 0) {
                        PDPageContentStream(document, page).use { stream ->
                            stream.beginText()
                            stream.setFont(PDType1Font.HELVETICA, 12f)
                            stream.newLineAtOffset(72f, bounds.height - 72f)
                            stream.showText("Invoice page ${index + 1} reference 84726190")
                            stream.endText()
                        }
                    }
                }
                document.documentInformation.title = "PDF import fixture"
                document.save(pdf)
            }
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.save(singlePage)
            }

            val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader(context)
            val multiHash = sha256(pdf)
            val inspection = reader.inspect(pdf)
            assertEquals(2, inspection.pageCount)
            assertEquals("PDF import fixture", inspection.title)
            assertEquals(listOf(0, 1), inspection.pages.map { it.pageIndex })
            assertEquals(PDRectangle.A4.width, inspection.pages[0].widthPoints, 0.01f)
            assertEquals(PDRectangle.A4.height, inspection.pages[0].heightPoints, 0.01f)
            assertEquals(0, inspection.pages[0].rotationDegrees)
            assertTrue(inspection.pages[0].hasReusableTextLayer)
            assertEquals(PDRectangle.LETTER.width, inspection.pages[1].widthPoints, 0.01f)
            assertEquals(PDRectangle.LETTER.height, inspection.pages[1].heightPoints, 0.01f)
            assertEquals(90, inspection.pages[1].rotationDegrees)
            assertTrue(!inspection.pages[1].hasReusableTextLayer)
            assertEquals(multiHash, sha256(pdf))

            val singleInspection = reader.inspect(singlePage)
            assertEquals(1, singleInspection.pageCount)
            assertEquals(listOf(0), singleInspection.pages.map { it.pageIndex })
            assertTrue(!singleInspection.pages.single().hasReusableTextLayer)

            val rendered = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, String?>>()
            reader.renderPages(
                source = pdf,
                expectedPageCount = 2,
                skipPageIndices = emptySet(),
                scratchDirectory = context.cacheDir,
                scheduler = app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler(),
            ) { index, file, text ->
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath)
                try {
                    assertNotNull(bitmap)
                    assertTrue(maxOf(bitmap!!.width, bitmap.height) <= 3000)
                    rendered += index to text
                } finally {
                    bitmap?.recycle()
                }
            }
            assertEquals(listOf(0, 1), rendered.map { it.first })
            assertTrue(rendered[0].second?.contains("reference 84726190") == true)
            assertTrue(rendered[1].second.isNullOrBlank())
            assertEquals(multiHash, sha256(pdf))
        } finally {
            pdf.delete()
            singlePage.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun renderPagesKeepsOnlyOneBitmapAndPreservesRotatedAndOversizedPageGeometry() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val pdf = threePagePdf(context, "pdf-import-render-lifetime-positive.pdf")
        val scratch = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-render-lifetime-positive-scratch").apply { mkdirs() }
        val returnedBitmaps = mutableListOf<Bitmap>()
        var peakLiveBitmaps = 0
        val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader.withRasterizerForTest(
            context,
            PdfPageBitmapRenderer { renderer, pageIndex, scale ->
                assertTrue(
                    "Previous PDF page bitmap must be recycled before rasterizing the next page",
                    returnedBitmaps.all(Bitmap::isRecycled),
                )
                val bitmap = renderer.renderImage(pageIndex, scale)
                returnedBitmaps += bitmap
                peakLiveBitmaps = maxOf(peakLiveBitmaps, returnedBitmaps.count { !it.isRecycled })
                bitmap
            },
        )
        val sourceDigest = sha256(pdf)
        val observed = mutableListOf<Triple<Int, Int, Int>>()
        try {
            reader.renderPages(pdf, 3, emptySet(), scratch, app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler()) {
                    index, pngFile, _ ->
                assertTrue("Rendered PNG exists only while the page consumer runs", pngFile.isFile)
                assertTrue("Page bitmap is recycled before consumer publication", returnedBitmaps[index].isRecycled)
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(pngFile.absolutePath)
                assertNotNull(bitmap)
                try {
                    observed += Triple(index, bitmap!!.width, bitmap.height)
                } finally {
                    bitmap?.recycle()
                }
            }
            assertEquals(listOf(0, 1, 2), observed.map { it.first })
            assertEquals(1, peakLiveBitmaps)
            assertTrue(returnedBitmaps.all(Bitmap::isRecycled))
            assertTrue("90-degree PDF page renders in landscape orientation", observed[1].second > observed[1].third)
            val expectedRotatedRatio = PDRectangle.LETTER.height / PDRectangle.LETTER.width
            val actualRotatedRatio = observed[1].second.toFloat() / observed[1].third
            assertTrue("Rotated page aspect ratio is preserved", kotlin.math.abs(actualRotatedRatio - expectedRotatedRatio) < 0.02f)
            assertTrue("Oversized source page stays within the existing 3000 px render envelope",
                observed.all { maxOf(it.second, it.third) <= 3000 })
            assertTrue("Oversized source page uses the existing cap", maxOf(observed[2].second, observed[2].third) >= 2999)
            assertTrue(scratch.listFiles().isNullOrEmpty())
            assertEquals(sourceDigest, sha256(pdf))
        } finally {
            pdf.delete()
            scratch.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rendererFailureAtEveryPageClosesResourcesDeletesScratchAndReleasesAdmission() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val pdf = threePagePdf(context, "pdf-import-render-failure.pdf")
        val sourceDigest = sha256(pdf)
        try {
            for (failedIndex in 0..2) {
                val scratch = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-render-failure-$failedIndex").apply { mkdirs() }
                val scheduler = app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler()
                val returnedBitmaps = mutableListOf<Bitmap>()
                val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader.withRasterizerForTest(
                    context,
                    PdfPageBitmapRenderer { renderer, pageIndex, scale ->
                        assertTrue("Prior rendered page bitmap was not recycled", returnedBitmaps.all(Bitmap::isRecycled))
                        if (pageIndex == failedIndex) throw IOException("injected renderer failure at page $pageIndex")
                        renderer.renderImage(pageIndex, scale).also(returnedBitmaps::add)
                    },
                )
                val callbacks = mutableListOf<Int>()
                try {
                    val failure = assertThrows(IOException::class.java) {
                        reader.renderPages(pdf, 3, emptySet(), scratch, scheduler) { index, pngFile, _ ->
                            assertTrue(pngFile.isFile)
                            callbacks += index
                        }
                    }
                    assertEquals("injected renderer failure at page $failedIndex", failure.message)
                    assertEquals((0 until failedIndex).toList(), callbacks)
                    assertTrue(returnedBitmaps.all(Bitmap::isRecycled))
                    assertTrue("No page temporary survives renderer failure", scratch.listFiles().isNullOrEmpty())
                    assertEquals(sourceDigest, sha256(pdf))
                    assertEquals(3, reader.inspect(pdf).pageCount)
                    assertEquals("admission released", scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) { "admission released" })
                } finally {
                    scratch.deleteRecursively()
                }
            }
        } finally {
            pdf.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun consumerFailureAtEveryPageDeletesCurrentPngClosesResourcesAndReleasesAdmission() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val pdf = threePagePdf(context, "pdf-import-consumer-failure.pdf")
        val sourceDigest = sha256(pdf)
        try {
            for (failedIndex in 0..2) {
                val scratch = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-consumer-failure-$failedIndex").apply { mkdirs() }
                val scheduler = app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler()
                val returnedBitmaps = mutableListOf<Bitmap>()
                val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader.withRasterizerForTest(
                    context,
                    PdfPageBitmapRenderer { renderer, pageIndex, scale ->
                        assertTrue("Prior rendered page bitmap was not recycled", returnedBitmaps.all(Bitmap::isRecycled))
                        renderer.renderImage(pageIndex, scale).also(returnedBitmaps::add)
                    },
                )
                val callbacks = mutableListOf<Int>()
                var failedFile: File? = null
                try {
                    val failure = assertThrows(IOException::class.java) {
                        reader.renderPages(pdf, 3, emptySet(), scratch, scheduler) { index, pngFile, _ ->
                            assertTrue(pngFile.isFile)
                            assertTrue(returnedBitmaps[index].isRecycled)
                            callbacks += index
                            if (index == failedIndex) {
                                failedFile = pngFile
                                throw IOException("injected consumer failure at page $index")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    assertEquals("injected consumer failure at page $failedIndex", failure.message)
                    assertEquals((0..failedIndex).toList(), callbacks)
                    assertTrue(returnedBitmaps.all(Bitmap::isRecycled))
                    assertTrue("No page temporary survives consumer failure", scratch.listFiles().isNullOrEmpty())
                    assertTrue("Callback's temporary PNG is deleted after it fails", failedFile?.exists() == false)
                    assertEquals(sourceDigest, sha256(pdf))
                    assertEquals(3, reader.inspect(pdf).pageCount)
                    assertEquals("admission released", scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) { "admission released" })
                } finally {
                    scratch.deleteRecursively()
                }
            }
        } finally {
            pdf.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun pngScratchOutputFailureAtEveryIoPhaseIncludingCloseCleansResourcesReleasesAdmissionAndPreservesPrefix() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val pdf = threePagePdf(context, "pdf-import-png-output-failure.pdf")
        val sourceDigest = sha256(pdf)
        try {
            for (phase in listOf("open", "partial-write", "sync", "close")) {
                val scratch = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-import-png-output-$phase").apply {
                    deleteRecursively()
                    mkdirs()
                }
                val scheduler = app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler()
                val renderedBitmaps = mutableListOf<Bitmap>()
                val renderCalls = mutableListOf<Int>()
                val recycleCalls = java.util.IdentityHashMap<Bitmap, Int>()
                val callbacks = mutableListOf<Int>()
                var outputOpenCount = 0
                var failedOutput: File? = null
                var partialBytesWritten = false
                var syncFailureInjected = false
                var delegateCloseCompleted = false
                var closeFailureInjected = false
                val outputFactory = PdfPagePngOutputFactory { output ->
                    val pageIndex = outputOpenCount++
                    if (pageIndex == 0) {
                        FilePdfPagePngOutputFactory.open(output)
                    } else {
                        assertEquals("Failure must be injected while writing page 2", 1, pageIndex)
                        failedOutput = output
                        when (phase) {
                            "open" -> throw IOException("injected PNG output open failure")
                            "partial-write" -> object : PdfPagePngOutput {
                                override fun compress(bitmap: Bitmap): Boolean {
                                    FileOutputStream(output).use { stream ->
                                        stream.write(byteArrayOf(0x89.toByte(), 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47))
                                        stream.fd.sync()
                                    }
                                    partialBytesWritten = output.length() > 0L
                                    throw IOException("injected partial PNG write failure")
                                }

                                override fun sync() = Unit
                                override fun close() = Unit
                            }
                            "sync" -> {
                                val delegate = FilePdfPagePngOutputFactory.open(output)
                                object : PdfPagePngOutput {
                                    override fun compress(bitmap: Bitmap): Boolean = delegate.compress(bitmap)
                                    override fun sync() {
                                        syncFailureInjected = true
                                        throw IOException("injected PNG sync failure")
                                    }

                                    override fun close() = delegate.close()
                                }
                            }
                            "close" -> {
                                val delegate = FilePdfPagePngOutputFactory.open(output)
                                object : PdfPagePngOutput {
                                    override fun compress(bitmap: Bitmap): Boolean = delegate.compress(bitmap)
                                    override fun sync() = delegate.sync()
                                    override fun close() {
                                        delegate.close()
                                        delegateCloseCompleted = true
                                        closeFailureInjected = true
                                        throw IOException("injected PNG close failure")
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            else -> error("Unexpected output failure phase: $phase")
                        }
                    }
                }
                val faultingReader = AndroidPdfImportReader.withPngOutputForTest(
                    context,
                    PdfPageBitmapRenderer { renderer, pageIndex, scale ->
                        renderCalls += pageIndex
                        renderer.renderImage(pageIndex, scale).also(renderedBitmaps::add)
                    },
                    outputFactory,
                ) { bitmap ->
                    recycleCalls[bitmap] = (recycleCalls[bitmap] ?: 0) + 1
                    bitmap.recycle()
                }
                var pageOneBytes = 0L
                try {
                    val failure = assertThrows(IOException::class.java) {
                        faultingReader.renderPages(pdf, 3, emptySet(), scratch, scheduler) { index, pngFile, _ ->
                            assertTrue("Successful page scratch PNG exists during callback", pngFile.isFile)
                            assertTrue("Rendered bitmap is recycled before consumer callback", renderedBitmaps[index].isRecycled)
                            callbacks += index
                            if (index == 0) pageOneBytes = pngFile.length()
                        }
                    }
                    assertEquals(
                        when (phase) {
                            "open" -> "injected PNG output open failure"
                            "partial-write" -> "injected partial PNG write failure"
                            "sync" -> "injected PNG sync failure"
                            else -> "injected PNG close failure"
                        },
                        failure.message,
                    )
                    assertEquals("Only the completed page-1 prefix reaches the consumer", listOf(0), callbacks)
                    assertEquals("No page after the failed page is rasterized", listOf(0, 1), renderCalls)
                    assertEquals("Exactly two page outputs are opened", 2, outputOpenCount)
                    assertTrue("Page 1 produced complete PNG bytes", pageOneBytes > 8L)
                    assertTrue("Each rendered bitmap is recycled", renderedBitmaps.all(Bitmap::isRecycled))
                    assertTrue("Each rendered bitmap is recycled exactly once", renderedBitmaps.all { recycleCalls[it] == 1 })
                    assertTrue("Failed-page scratch output is removed", failedOutput?.exists() == false)
                    assertTrue("No scratch output survives the I/O failure", scratch.listFiles().isNullOrEmpty())
                    if (phase == "partial-write") assertTrue("Failure followed persisted partial bytes", partialBytesWritten)
                    if (phase == "sync") assertTrue("Injected failure occurred at sync", syncFailureInjected)
                    if (phase == "close") {
                        assertTrue("Underlying output was closed before the injected failure", delegateCloseCompleted)
                        assertTrue("Injected failure occurred at close", closeFailureInjected)
                    }
                    assertEquals("Source PDF bytes remain unchanged", sourceDigest, sha256(pdf))
                    assertEquals("Source PDF can be reopened after output failure", 3, faultingReader.inspect(pdf).pageCount)
                    assertEquals(
                        "Scheduler admission is released after output failure",
                        "admission released",
                        scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) { "admission released" },
                    )
                } finally {
                    scratch.deleteRecursively()
                }
            }
        } finally {
            pdf.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun importedPdfRetainsAuthoritativeTranscriptAndPositionedWordGeometry() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(context)
        val pdf = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-layout-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        val scratch = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-layout-scratch-${System.nanoTime()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        val scheduler = app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler()
        val expected = "Invoice 6421\nTotal 127.45 USD"
        try {
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                val page = PDPage(PDRectangle(600f, 800f))
                document.addPage(page)
                PDPageContentStream(document, page).use { stream ->
                    stream.beginText()
                    stream.setFont(PDType1Font.HELVETICA, 20f)
                    stream.newLineAtOffset(60f, 700f)
                    stream.showText("Invoice 6421")
                    stream.newLineAtOffset(0f, -34f)
                    stream.showText("Total 127.45 USD")
                    stream.endText()
                }
                document.save(pdf)
            }

            val reader = AndroidPdfImportReader(context)
            val inspection = reader.inspect(pdf)
            assertTrue("generated page has a reusable text layer", inspection.pages.single().hasReusableTextLayer)
            var deliveredText: String? = null
            var deliveredLayout: app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout? = null
            var rasterWidth = 0
            var rasterHeight = 0
            reader.renderPagesDetailed(
                source = pdf,
                expectedPageCount = 1,
                skipPageIndices = emptySet(),
                scratchDirectory = scratch,
                scheduler = scheduler,
            ) { index, png, text, layout ->
                assertEquals(0, index)
                assertTrue(png.isFile)
                val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
                BitmapFactory.decodeFile(png.absolutePath, bounds)
                rasterWidth = bounds.outWidth
                rasterHeight = bounds.outHeight
                deliveredText = text
                deliveredLayout = layout
            }

            val layout = deliveredLayout ?: throw AssertionError("PDF import did not return the reusable text layout")
            assertEquals(expected, deliveredText?.trim())
            assertEquals(expected, layout.toPlainText().trim())
            assertTrue("layout reports positioned structure", layout.quality?.structureAvailable == true)
            assertEquals(rasterWidth, layout.sourceWidthPx)
            assertEquals(rasterHeight, layout.sourceHeightPx)
            val words = layout.blocks.flatMap { it.lines }.flatMap { it.words }
            assertEquals(listOf("Invoice", "6421", "Total", "127.45", "USD"), words.map { it.text })
            assertTrue("all glyph boxes stay inside the rendered page", words.all { word ->
                word.box.left >= 0f && word.box.top >= 0f && word.box.right <= 1f && word.box.bottom <= 1f
            })
            assertTrue("first line is positioned near the PDF's upper-left text origin", words.first().box.left in 0.08f..0.14f
                && words.first().box.top in 0.09f..0.17f)
            assertTrue("line baselines are preserved", layout.blocks.flatMap { it.lines }.all { it.baseline != null })
        } finally {
            pdf.delete()
            scratch.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun threePagePdf(context: android.content.Context, name: String): File {
        val pdf = File(context.cacheDir, name)
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
            document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.LETTER).apply { rotation = 90 })
            document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle(30_000f, 21_000f)))
            document.save(pdf)
        }
        return pdf
    }

    private fun assertRejectedWithoutMutation(
        reader: AndroidPdfImportReader,
        source: File,
        expected: Class<out Throwable>,
    ) {
        val digestBefore = sha256(source)
        assertThrows(expected) { reader.inspect(source) }
        assertEquals(digestBefore, sha256(source))
        // A second open after each parser failure detects retained parser state/handles.
        assertThrows(expected) { reader.inspect(source) }
        assertEquals(digestBefore, sha256(source))
    }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(file.readBytes())
        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
}

        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

        sourceArtifact.parentFile?.mkdirs()

            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
        var storage: ProductStorage? = null

                            17, 'COMMITTED', 'android-epoch-v1', NULL)""",
                        arrayOf<Any>("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004", sourceImageBytes.size, sourceChecksum),

    @Test
    fun androidDriverMigratesVersionEightWithoutChangingWorkspaceOrPageState() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "schema-migration-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "schema-migration-artifacts-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        var migratedStorage: ProductStorage? = null

        try {
            createPage(storage, "legacy-unselected.jpg", Color.rgb(192, 32, 32))
            val selectedPage = createPage(storage, "legacy-selected.jpg", Color.rgb(32, 32, 192))
            storage.setSelected(selectedPage.pageId, true)
            val unselectedPage = storage.visiblePages().first { it.pageId != selectedPage.pageId }
            storage.setSelected(unselectedPage.pageId, false)
            storage.setActivePage(unselectedPage.pageId)

            val beforeProjection = storage.workspaceProjection()
            val beforePages = beforeProjection.pages.map(::snapshot)
            val beforeBytes = beforeProjection.pages.associate { page ->
                page.pageId to storage.artifactPath(page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes()
            }
            val workspaceId = storage.workspaceId
            storage.close()

            val databaseFile = context.getDatabasePath(databaseName)
            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READWRITE).use { database ->
                database.execSQL("PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF")
                database.execSQL("DROP TABLE SaveOutputPublicationIntent")
                database.execSQL("DROP TABLE PdfImportPublicationIntent")
                database.execSQL("DROP TABLE ImageImportPublicationIntent")
                database.execSQL("DROP TABLE PublicExportPublication")
                database.execSQL("DROP TABLE ExternalExportPackageOutput")
                database.execSQL("DROP TABLE ExternalExportPackage")
                database.execSQL(
                    """CREATE TABLE ExternalExportPackage (
                        export_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES ExportArtifact(export_artifact_id),
                        destination_tree_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
                        common_basename TEXT NOT NULL,
                        provider_qualification_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ProviderQualification(qualification_id),
                        adapter_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                        provider_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                        os_version TEXT NOT NULL,
                        destination_access_class TEXT NOT NULL,
                        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('READY', 'WRITING_EXTERNAL', 'UNKNOWN_OUTCOME', 'PARTIAL', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED_KNOWN')),
                        last_error TEXT,
                        ocr_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE'
                    )""",
                )
                database.execSQL(
                    """CREATE TABLE ExternalExportPackageOutput (
                        export_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ExternalExportPackage(export_artifact_id),
                        output_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ArtifactRecord(artifact_id),
                        display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
                        PRIMARY KEY (export_artifact_id, output_artifact_id),
                        UNIQUE (export_artifact_id, display_name),
                        UNIQUE (export_artifact_id, ordinal)
                    )""",
                )
                database.execSQL("ALTER TABLE Page DROP COLUMN select_when_ready")
                database.version = 8
                assertEquals("Fixture must represent schema v8", 8, database.version)
                val columns = database.rawQuery("PRAGMA table_info(Page)", null).use { cursor ->
                    buildSet {
                        val nameIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow("name")
                        while (cursor.moveToNext()) add(cursor.getString(nameIndex))
                    }
                }
                assertFalse("v8 Page must not contain the v9 selection-intent column", "select_when_ready" in columns)
                val laterMigrationTableCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='SaveOutputPublicationIntent'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v8 fixture must omit the v10 publication-intent table", 0, laterMigrationTableCount)
                val pdfIntentCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='PdfImportPublicationIntent'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v8 fixture must omit the v11 PDF publication-intent table", 0, pdfIntentCount)
                val imageIntentCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='ImageImportPublicationIntent'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v8 fixture must omit the v12 image publication-intent table", 0, imageIntentCount)
                val publicExportPublicationCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='PublicExportPublication'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v8 fixture must omit the v13 public export publication table", 0, publicExportPublicationCount)
                val externalPackageColumns = database.rawQuery("PRAGMA table_info(ExternalExportPackage)", null).use { cursor ->
                    buildSet {
                        val nameIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow("name")
                        while (cursor.moveToNext()) add(cursor.getString(nameIndex))
                    }
                }
                assertFalse("v8 fixture must omit the v13 JPG inclusion column", "include_jpg" in externalPackageColumns)
            }

            migratedStorage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
            assertFalse("A valid v8 database must open without the startup integrity lock", migratedStorage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertTrue(migratedStorage.workspaceIntegrityFindingsAtStartup.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(workspaceId, migratedStorage.workspaceId)

            val afterProjection = migratedStorage.workspaceProjection()
            assertEquals(beforeProjection.activePageId, afterProjection.activePageId)
            assertEquals(beforePages, afterProjection.pages.map(::snapshot))
            afterProjection.pages.forEach { page ->
                assertEquals(beforeBytes.getValue(page.pageId).toList(), migratedStorage.artifactPath(page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes().toList())
            }

            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { database ->
                assertEquals(
                    "ProductStorage must migrate Android user_version to the current schema",
                    DocScanDatabase.Schema.version.toInt(),
                    database.version,
                )
                val publicationIntentTableCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='SaveOutputPublicationIntent'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v9→v10 migration must create the publication-intent table once", 1, publicationIntentTableCount)
                val pdfIntentCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='PdfImportPublicationIntent'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v10→v11 migration must create the PDF publication-intent table once", 1, pdfIntentCount)
                val imageIntentCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='ImageImportPublicationIntent'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v11→v12 migration must create the image publication-intent table once", 1, imageIntentCount)
                val publicExportPublicationCount = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='PublicExportPublication'",
                    null,
                ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
                assertEquals("v12→v13 migration must create the public export publication table once", 1, publicExportPublicationCount)
                database.rawQuery("SELECT page_id, select_when_ready FROM Page ORDER BY order_index", null).use { cursor ->
                    var rows = 0
                    while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                        assertEquals("Legacy selection intent must default off", 0, cursor.getInt(1))
                        rows++
                    }
                    assertEquals(2, rows)
                }
            }
        } finally {
            migratedStorage?.close()
            runCatching { storage.close() }
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun createPage(storage: ProductStorage, displayName: String, color: Int): StoredPage {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(80, 120, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(color) }
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
            check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 94, output))
            output.toByteArray()
        }
        bitmap.recycle()
        val imported = storage.importImage(bytes.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", displayName)
        return storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == imported.pageId }
    }

    private fun legacyFixtureImageBytes(): ByteArray {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(80, 120, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(Color.rgb(37, 121, 203)) }
        return try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
                check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 94, output))
                output.toByteArray()
            }
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun assertTable(database: SQLiteDatabase, table: String) {
        val count = database.rawQuery(
            "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?",
            arrayOf(table),
        ).use { cursor -> cursor.moveToFirst(); cursor.getInt(0) }
        assertEquals("$table exists after migration", 1, count)
    }

    private fun assertColumns(database: SQLiteDatabase, table: String, vararg expected: String) {
        val columns = database.rawQuery("PRAGMA table_info(`$table`)", null).use { cursor ->
            buildSet {
                val nameIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow("name")
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) add(cursor.getString(nameIndex))
            }
        }
        expected.forEach { column -> assertTrue("$table.$column exists after migration", column in columns) }
    }

    private fun assertColumnDefault(database: SQLiteDatabase, table: String, column: String, expected: String) {
        val defaultValue = database.rawQuery("PRAGMA table_info(`$table`)", null).use { cursor ->
            val nameIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow("name")
            val defaultIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow("dflt_value")
            var value: String? = null
            while (cursor.moveToNext()) if (cursor.getString(nameIndex) == column) value = cursor.getString(defaultIndex)
            value
        }
        assertNotNull("$table.$column has a migrated default", defaultValue)
        assertEquals("$table.$column default", expected, defaultValue)
    }

    private fun snapshot(page: StoredPage): PageState = PageState(
        pageId = page.pageId,
        imageVersionId = page.imageVersionId,
        orderIndex = page.orderIndex,
        selected = page.selected,
        contentRevision = page.contentRevision,
        artifactRelativePath = page.artifactRelativePath,
        artifactState = page.artifactState,
    )

    private data class PageState(
        val pageId: PageId,
        val imageVersionId: ImageVersionId,
        val orderIndex: Long,
        val selected: Boolean,
        val contentRevision: Long,
        val artifactRelativePath: String,
        val artifactState: String,
    )
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.CheckBox
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import androidx.test.uiautomator.UiDevice
import app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import app.docscan.core.model.RecognitionId
import app.docscan.core.store.CaptureCommand
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionCandidate
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CameraFirstLayoutInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test fun fixedBottomRailInsetViewerAndBothNavigationMethodsPreserveSelection() = fixture { scenario, storage, device ->
        val pages = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
        waitUntil { var ready = false; scenario.onActivity { ready = it.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-home-page:" + pages[0].pageId.value)?.isLaidOut == true }; ready }
        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
            val decor = activity.window.decorView
            val rail = bounds(decor.findViewWithTag("docscan-home-thumbnail-scroll"))
            val actions = bounds(decor.findViewWithTag("docscan-home-actions"))
            val camera = bounds(decor.findViewWithTag("docscan-camera-area"))
            val shutter = bounds(decor.findViewWithTag("docscan-capture-button"))
            val save = bounds(decor.findViewWithTag("docscan-save-button"))
            val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density
            assertTrue("Compact lower block <=175dp", rail.height() + actions.height() <= 175 * density)
            assertTrue(shutter.bottom <= rail.top)
            assertTrue("Shutter stays centered when side actions are hidden", kotlin.math.abs(shutter.centerX() - camera.centerX()) <= density)
            assertTrue(save.centerX() > camera.centerX())
            assertTrue(save.top < shutter.top)
            assertTrue(rail.bottom <= actions.top)
            decor.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-home-page:" + pages[0].pageId.value).performClick()
        }
        waitUntil { topHost(scenario)?.isLaidOut == true }
        var host: View? = null
        scenario.onActivity { activity -> host = host(activity); assertHost(host!!, activity.resources.displayMetrics.density, true) }
        screenshot(device, "viewer")
        scenario.onActivity {
            host!!.findViewWithTag<View>(ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + pages[2].pageId.value).performClick()
        }
        waitUntil { storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == pages[2].pageId }
        fun renderedBounds(): Rect {
            var result = Rect()
            waitUntil {
                var ready = false
                scenario.onActivity {
                    val image = host!!.findViewWithTag<android.widget.ImageView>(ProductActivity.VIEWER_MAIN_IMAGE_TAG)
                    ready = image.drawable != null && image.isLaidOut
                    if (ready) result = bounds(image)
                }
                ready
            }
            return result
        }
        fun swipeTo(delta: Int, expected: PageId) {
            val r = renderedBounds()
            android.util.Log.i("DocScanNativeGestureTest", "before=${storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId} delta=$delta bounds=$r expected=$expected")
            val direction = if (delta > 0) 1 else -1
            assertTrue(device.swipe(r.centerX() + direction*r.width()/3, r.centerY(), r.centerX()-direction*r.width()/3, r.centerY(), 18))
            waitUntil { storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == expected }
        }
        swipeTo(-1, pages[1].pageId)
        swipeTo(1, pages[2].pageId)
        swipeTo(1, pages[2].pageId)
        assertEquals("Last page must not wrap", pages[2].pageId, storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId)
        val imageBounds = renderedBounds()
        device.swipe(imageBounds.centerX(), imageBounds.centerY() - imageBounds.height()/4, imageBounds.centerX(), imageBounds.centerY()+imageBounds.height()/4, 18)
        SystemClock.sleep(200)

    @Test fun retakeFromMenuReturnsToCameraAndPreservesPageIdentityOrderAndSelection() = fixture { scenario, storage, device ->
        val before = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
        openWorkspaceMenuForTest(scenario)
