            val row = host(activity)!!.findViewWithTag<ViewGroup>(ProductActivity.PAGE_ROW_TAG_PREFIX + before.first().pageId.value)
            fun retake(view: View): android.widget.Button? {
                if (view is android.widget.Button && view.text.toString() == activity.getString(R.string.retake_page)) return view
                if (view is ViewGroup) for (index in 0 until view.childCount) retake(view.getChildAt(index))?.let { return it }
                return null
            }
            val button = requireNotNull(retake(row))
            var parent = button.parent
            while (parent is View && parent !is android.widget.HorizontalScrollView) parent = parent.parent
            (parent as android.widget.HorizontalScrollView).scrollTo(button.left, 0)
            button.performClick()
        }
        waitUntil { hostCount(scenario) == 0 }
        waitUntil {
            var ready = false
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val shutter = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-capture-button")
                ready = shutter.isEnabled && shutter.isShown
                if (ready) actionBounds = bounds(shutter)
            }
            ready
        }
        assertTrue(device.click(actionBounds.centerX(), actionBounds.centerY()))
        waitUntil { storage.workspaceProjection().pages.first().imageVersionId != before.first().imageVersionId }
        val end = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 60000
        while (storage.workspaceProjection().pages.first().recognizedText == null && SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < end) SystemClock.sleep(100)
        val after = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
        assertNotNull("Retake OCR completes", after.first().recognizedText)
        assertEquals(before.map { it.pageId }, after.map { it.pageId })
        assertEquals(before.map { it.orderIndex }, after.map { it.orderIndex })
        assertEquals(before.map { it.selected }, after.map { it.selected })
        assertEquals(before.drop(1), after.drop(1))
        screenshot(device, "retake-complete")
    }

    private fun restoreLocaleAndRetainFailure(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>, locales: androidx.core.os.LocaleListCompat, primary: Throwable?) {
        try { switchLocaleAndAwaitActivity(scenario, locales) }
        catch (restore: Throwable) {
            if (primary == null) throw restore
            primary.addSuppressed(restore)
        }
    }

    private fun switchLocaleAndAwaitActivity(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>, locales: androidx.core.os.LocaleListCompat) {
        var previous: ProductActivity? = null
        var changed = false
        var language = ""
        val requested = locales.toLanguageTags()
        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
            previous = activity
            val current = androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate.getApplicationLocales().toLanguageTags()
            changed = current != requested
            // Process Resources can still contain ru while an empty app locale list restores en-US.
            // LocaleManager supplies device locales independently of per-app configuration timing.
            val system = if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
                activity.getSystemService(android.app.LocaleManager::class.java).systemLocales[0].language
            } else android.content.res.Resources.getSystem().configuration.locales[0].language
            language = locales.get(0)?.language ?: system
            android.util.Log.i("DocScanNativeLocale", "before=$current requested=$requested target=$language device=$system processResources=${android.content.res.Resources.getSystem().configuration.locales.toLanguageTags()} instance=${System.identityHashCode(activity)} replace=$changed")
            androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales(locales)
        }
        var observation = "not observed"
        try {
            waitUntil {
                var ready = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    val actual = androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate.getApplicationLocales().toLanguageTags()
                    val effective = activity.resources.configuration.locales[0].language
                    val laidOut = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-home-actions")?.isLaidOut == true
                    val replaced = activity !== previous
                    observation = "requested=$requested actual=$actual target=$language effective=$effective replaced=$replaced layout=$laidOut"
                    ready = actual == requested && (!changed || replaced) && effective == language && laidOut
                }
                ready
            }
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            throw AssertionError("Locale transition: $observation", failure)
        }
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync()
        android.util.Log.i("DocScanNativeLocale", "ready $observation")
    }

    private fun assertTextFits(view: android.widget.TextView, description: String) {
        val text = view.transformationMethod?.getTransformation(view.text, view) ?: view.text
        if (view is android.widget.Button && view !is CheckBox) assertTrue("Visible button caption: $description", text.isNotBlank())
        if (text.isEmpty()) return
        val layout = requireNotNull(view.layout)
        assertTrue("No hidden final line: $description $text", layout.lineCount > 0 && layout.getLineEnd(layout.lineCount-1) == text.length)
        assertTrue("No vertical clipping: $description $text", layout.height <= view.height-view.compoundPaddingTop-view.compoundPaddingBottom)
        for (line in 0 until layout.lineCount) {
            assertEquals("No ellipsis: $description $text", 0, layout.getEllipsisCount(line))
            assertTrue("No horizontal clipping: $description $text", layout.getLineWidth(line) <= view.width-view.compoundPaddingLeft-view.compoundPaddingRight)
        }
    }
    private fun assertFooterCaptions(host: View, density: Float, description: String) {
        fun visit(view: View) {
            if (!view.isShown) return
            if (view is android.widget.TextView) assertTextFits(view, description)
            if (view is android.widget.Button) {
                assertTrue("Footer target >=48dp: $description", view.width >= 48*density && view.height >= 48*density)
                assertTrue("Footer accessible name retained: $description", !(view.contentDescription ?: view.text).isNullOrBlank())
            }
            if (view is ViewGroup) for (index in 0 until view.childCount) visit(view.getChildAt(index))
        }
        visit(host.findViewWithTag(InsetDialogHost.RAIL_TAG))
    }

    private fun assertHost(host: View, density: Float, hasRail: Boolean) {
        val outer = bounds(host)
        val panel = bounds(host.findViewWithTag(InsetDialogHost.PANEL_TAG))
        assertTrue("Left margin >=20dp: $outer / $panel", panel.left - outer.left >= 19 * density)
        assertTrue("Right margin >=20dp: $outer / $panel", outer.right - panel.right >= 19 * density)
        assertTrue("Top margin >=24dp: $outer / $panel", panel.top - outer.top >= 23 * density)
        assertTrue("Bottom margin >=24dp", outer.bottom - panel.bottom >= 23 * density)
        if (hasRail) {
            val rail = bounds(host.findViewWithTag(InsetDialogHost.RAIL_TAG))
            assertTrue("Rail remains below page window", rail.top >= panel.bottom + 19 * density)
            assertTrue("Rail is in the bottom 175dp", rail.top >= outer.bottom - 175 * density)
        }
        android.util.Log.i("DocScanNativeLayout", "density=$density host=$outer panel=$panel bottomRail=$hasRail")
    }

    private fun bounds(view: View): Rect = Rect().also { rect ->
        view.getLocalVisibleRect(rect)
        val origin = IntArray(2); view.getLocationOnScreen(origin); rect.offset(origin[0], origin[1])
    }
    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST") private fun hosts(activity: ProductActivity): List<View> {
        val controller = ProductActivity::class.java.getDeclaredField("dialogHost").apply { isAccessible = true }.get(activity)
        return InsetDialogHost::class.java.getDeclaredField("hosts").apply { isAccessible = true }.get(controller) as List<View>
    }
    private fun host(activity: ProductActivity) = hosts(activity).lastOrNull()
    private fun topHost(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>): View? { var host: View? = null; scenario.onActivity { host = host(it) }; return host }
    private fun hostCount(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>): Int { var count = 0; scenario.onActivity { count = hosts(it).size }; return count }
    private fun waitUntil(condition: () -> Boolean) { val end = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 15000; while (!condition()) { if (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() > end) throw AssertionError("UI condition timed out"); SystemClock.sleep(50) } }
    private fun screenshot(device: UiDevice, name: String) {
        val output = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("additionalTestOutputDir")
        val dir = (output?.let { java.io.File(it, "native-ui-evidence") }
            ?: InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext.getExternalFilesDir("native-ui-evidence")!!).apply { mkdirs() }
        assertTrue(device.takeScreenshot(dir.resolve("$name.png")))
    }
    private fun fixture(test: (ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>, ProductStorage, UiDevice) -> Unit) {
        val inst = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation(); val context = inst.targetContext
        val app = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val old = app.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString(); val db = "native-layout-$suffix.db"; val artifacts = "native-layout-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, db, artifacts)
        repeat(3) { index ->
            val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(320, 440, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(if (index == 0) 0xfff5f0df.toInt() else 0xffeeeeff.toInt()) }
            val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().apply { bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, this) }.toByteArray(); bitmap.recycle()
            val pageId = PageId.new()
            storage.commitCapture(CaptureCommand(workspaceId = storage.workspaceId, pageId = pageId, imageVersionId = ImageVersionId.new(), artifact = storage.stageCapturedJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)), selected = index == 0, makeActive = false, coordinateSpace = "JPEG_PIXEL_EDGE_ORIGIN_TOP_LEFT", processingDesiredState = ProductActivity.OCR_OPERATION_KEY, sourceProvenance = "INSTRUMENTATION_TEST"))
            val page = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.last()
            storage.commitRecognition(RecognitionCandidate(RecognitionId.new(), storage.workspaceId, page.pageId, page.imageVersionId, page.contentRevision, ProductActivity.OCR_OPERATION_KEY, "Native UI fixture ${index + 1}"))
        }
        app.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
        try { test(scenario, storage, UiDevice.getInstance(inst)) } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            runCatching { screenshot(UiDevice.getInstance(inst), "failure") }
            throw failure
        } finally {
            scenario.close(); app.productStorageOverrideForTest = old; storage.close(); context.deleteDatabase(db); context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifacts).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.cash.sqldelight.driver.android.AndroidSqliteDriver
import app.docscan.core.artifact.FileArtifactRepository
import app.docscan.core.cleanup.CleanupArbiter
import app.docscan.core.db.DocScanDatabase
import app.docscan.core.model.WorkspaceId
import app.docscan.core.model.WorkspaceSessionId
import app.docscan.core.store.DurableImageArtifact
import app.docscan.core.store.StateStore
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.util.Comparator
import java.util.UUID
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CleanupCorruptionQuarantineInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun quarantinesCorruptAndroidArtifactsWithoutDeletingTheirBytes() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "cleanup-corrupt-$suffix.db"
        val root = Files.createTempDirectory(context.noBackupFilesDir.toPath(), "cleanup-corrupt-$suffix-")
        val driver = AndroidSqliteDriver(
            schema = DocScanDatabase.Schema,
            context = context,
            name = databaseName,
            callback = object : AndroidSqliteDriver.Callback(DocScanDatabase.Schema) {
                override fun onConfigure(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                    db.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true)
                    check(db.enableWriteAheadLogging()) { "SQLite WAL mode is required for cleanup fixture" }
                }

                override fun onOpen(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                    db.execSQL("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
                    db.query("PRAGMA synchronous").use { cursor ->
                        check(cursor.moveToFirst() && cursor.getInt(0) == 2) {
                            "SQLite synchronous=FULL is required for cleanup fixture"
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
        )
        val database = DocScanDatabase(driver)
        val store = StateStore(database, AndroidClock())
        val repository = FileArtifactRepository(
            privateRoot = root,
            directorySync = AndroidDirectorySync(),
            producerEpoch = "cleanup-corrupt-$suffix",
            atomicPublisher = AndroidAtomicArtifactPublisher(),
        )
        val arbiter = CleanupArbiter(store, repository)

        try {
            store.createInitialWorkspace(WorkspaceId.new(), WorkspaceSessionId.new())

            val corruptBeforeClaim = publishCommittedOrphan(database, repository, store, byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4))
            val firstCorruption = byteArrayOf(91, 92, 93)
            Files.write(root.resolve(corruptBeforeClaim.relativePath), firstCorruption)
            val firstResult = arbiter.runBatch(1L)
            assertEquals(1, firstResult.claimedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(0, firstResult.deletedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(1, firstResult.quarantinedArtifacts)
            assertQuarantinedBytesPreserved(database, root, corruptBeforeClaim, firstCorruption)

            val corruptDuringRecovery = publishCommittedOrphan(database, repository, store, byteArrayOf(5, 6, 7, 8))
            val activeClaim = store.claimUnreferencedArtifacts(1L).single()
            assertEquals(corruptDuringRecovery.artifactId, activeClaim.artifactId)
            val secondCorruption = byteArrayOf(81, 82)
            Files.write(root.resolve(corruptDuringRecovery.relativePath), secondCorruption)
            assertEquals(1, arbiter.recoverInterruptedDeletions(1L))
            assertQuarantinedBytesPreserved(database, root, corruptDuringRecovery, secondCorruption)

            val validOrphan = publishCommittedOrphan(database, repository, store, byteArrayOf(21, 22, 23, 24))
            val positiveResult = arbiter.runBatch(1L)
            assertEquals(1, positiveResult.claimedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(1, positiveResult.deletedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(0, positiveResult.quarantinedArtifacts)
            val deleted = database.schemaQueries.artifactById(validOrphan.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", deleted.state)
            assertEquals("DELETED", deleted.storage_state)
            assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve(validOrphan.relativePath)))

            val noRetry = arbiter.runBatch(1L)
            assertEquals(0, noRetry.claimedArtifacts)
            assertQuarantinedBytesPreserved(database, root, corruptBeforeClaim, firstCorruption)
            assertQuarantinedBytesPreserved(database, root, corruptDuringRecovery, secondCorruption)
        } finally {
            driver.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            Files.walk(root).use { paths -> paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(Files::deleteIfExists) }
        }
    }

    private fun publishCommittedOrphan(
        database: DocScanDatabase,
        repository: FileArtifactRepository,
        store: StateStore,
        bytes: ByteArray,
    ): DurableImageArtifact {
        val artifact = repository.publishJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(artifact)
        assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.commitArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).value)
        assertTrue(repository.verifyPublished(artifact.relativePath, artifact.sizeBytes, artifact.sha256))
        return artifact
    }

    private fun assertQuarantinedBytesPreserved(
        database: DocScanDatabase,
        root: java.nio.file.Path,
        artifact: DurableImageArtifact,
        expectedBytes: ByteArray,
    ) {
        val row = database.schemaQueries.artifactById(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
        assertEquals("QUARANTINED", row.state)
        assertEquals("PRESENT", row.storage_state)
        assertNull(row.gc_claim_token)
        assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())
        val path = root.resolve(artifact.relativePath)
        assertTrue("Quarantined bytes must stay present", Files.exists(path))
        assertArrayEquals(expectedBytes, Files.readAllBytes(path))
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/CleanupDirectorySyncFailureInstrumentedTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.cash.sqldelight.driver.android.AndroidSqliteDriver
import app.docscan.core.artifact.DirectorySync
import app.docscan.core.artifact.FileArtifactRepository
import app.docscan.core.cleanup.CleanupArbiter
import app.docscan.core.db.DocScanDatabase
import app.docscan.core.model.WorkspaceId
import app.docscan.core.model.WorkspaceSessionId
import app.docscan.core.store.StateStore
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CleanupDirectorySyncFailureInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun postUnlinkDirectorySyncFailurePropagatesAndRecoveryConverges() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "cleanup-sync-$suffix.db"
        val root = Files.createTempDirectory(context.noBackupFilesDir.toPath(), "cleanup-sync-$suffix-")
        val armed = AtomicBoolean(false)
        val injected = AtomicBoolean(false)
        val sync = DirectorySync { directory ->
            if (armed.get() && injected.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                throw IOException("injected Android post-unlink directory fsync failure")
            }
            AndroidDirectorySync().sync(directory)
        }
        val repository = FileArtifactRepository(
            privateRoot = root,
            directorySync = sync,
            producerEpoch = "cleanup-sync-$suffix",
            atomicPublisher = AndroidAtomicArtifactPublisher(),
        )
        val driver = AndroidSqliteDriver(
            schema = DocScanDatabase.Schema,
            context = context,
            name = databaseName,
            callback = object : AndroidSqliteDriver.Callback(DocScanDatabase.Schema) {
                override fun onConfigure(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                    db.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true)
                    check(db.enableWriteAheadLogging()) { "SQLite WAL mode is required" }
                }

                override fun onOpen(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                    db.execSQL("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
                    db.query("PRAGMA synchronous").use { cursor ->
                        check(cursor.moveToFirst() && cursor.getInt(0) == 2) {
                            "SQLite synchronous=FULL is required for cleanup recovery fixture"
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
        )
        val database = DocScanDatabase(driver)
        val store = StateStore(database, AndroidClock())
        try {
            store.createInitialWorkspace(WorkspaceId.new(), WorkspaceSessionId.new())
            val failedArtifact = repository.publishJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(byteArrayOf(11, 22, 33, 44)))
            store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(failedArtifact)
            assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.commitArtifact(failedArtifact.artifactId.value).value)
            assertTrue(repository.verifyPublished(failedArtifact.relativePath, failedArtifact.sizeBytes, failedArtifact.sha256))

            armed.set(true)
            val failure = runCatching { CleanupArbiter(store, repository).runBatch(1L) }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue("Injected directory sync failure must escape CleanupArbiter", failure is IOException)
            assertTrue("The adapter must record that its post-unlink failure ran", injected.get())
            assertTrue("Failure diagnostic must identify the injected sync boundary",
                failure?.message.orEmpty().contains("post-unlink directory fsync"))
            assertFalse("Unlink happened before the injected directory sync", Files.exists(root.resolve(failedArtifact.relativePath)))
            val claimedAfterFailure = database.schemaQueries.artifactById(failedArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
            assertEquals("GC_CLAIMED", claimedAfterFailure.state)
            assertEquals("PRESENT", claimedAfterFailure.storage_state)
            assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(failedArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())

            armed.set(false)
            assertEquals(1, CleanupArbiter(store, repository).recoverInterruptedDeletions(1L))
            val recovered = database.schemaQueries.artifactById(failedArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
            assertEquals("DELETED", recovered.storage_state)
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", recovered.state)
            assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve(failedArtifact.relativePath)))
            assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(failedArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())

            val positiveControl = repository.publishJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(byteArrayOf(55, 66, 77, 88)))
            store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(positiveControl)
            assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.commitArtifact(positiveControl.artifactId.value).value)
            val normalResult = CleanupArbiter(store, repository).runBatch(1L)
            assertEquals(1, normalResult.claimedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(1, normalResult.deletedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(0, normalResult.quarantinedArtifacts)
            assertEquals("DELETED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(positiveControl.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().storage_state)
            assertFalse(Files.exists(root.resolve(positiveControl.relativePath)))
        } finally {
            driver.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            Files.walk(root).use { paths -> paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(Files::deleteIfExists) }
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/CleanupLockProcessDeathInstrumentedTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Process
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.artifact.DirectorySync
import app.docscan.core.artifact.FileArtifactRepository
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CleanupLockProcessDeathInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun androidProcessDeathReleasesCleanupLockForWaitingWorker() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val targetContext: Context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val testCache = targetContext.cacheDir.toPath()
        Files.createDirectories(testCache)
        val root = Files.createTempDirectory(testCache, "cleanup-lock-death-")
        val helperIntent = Intent(targetContext, CleanupLockHolderService::class.java)
            .putExtra(CleanupLockHolderService.EXTRA_ROOT, root.toString())
        val helperComponent = targetContext.startService(helperIntent)
        assertTrue("Test lock-holder service did not start", helperComponent != null)

        val ready = root.resolve(CleanupLockHolderService.OWNER_READY_FILE)
        val helperPidFile = root.resolve(CleanupLockHolderService.OWNER_PID_FILE)
        val error = root.resolve(CleanupLockHolderService.OWNER_ERROR_FILE)
        var helperPid = -1
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        try {
            val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 8_000L
            while (!Files.exists(ready) && !Files.exists(error) && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
                SystemClock.sleep(25L)
            }
            assertFalse("Lock-holder process failed: ${if (Files.exists(error)) error.toFile().readText() else "no ready marker"}", Files.exists(error))
            assertTrue("Lock-holder process never recorded its lock", Files.exists(ready))
            helperPid = helperPidFile.toFile().readText().toInt()
            assertNotEquals("Lock-holder must run in a separate Android process", Process.myPid(), helperPid)
            Log.i(TAG, "helper_pid=$helperPid instrumentation_pid=${Process.myPid()} lock_ready=true")

            val waitingStarted = CountDownLatch(1)
            val secondRoot = FileArtifactRepository(root, DirectorySync {}, "android-cleanup-waiter")
            val waitingWorker = executor.submit {
                waitingStarted.countDown()
                secondRoot.withExclusiveCleanupLock { root.resolve("waiter.acquired").toFile().writeText("acquired") }
            }
            assertTrue("Waiting worker did not start", waitingStarted.await(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            Thread.sleep(250L)
            assertFalse("Second Android process acquired the live lock", waitingWorker.isDone)
            assertFalse("Acquisition marker appeared while helper held lock", Files.exists(root.resolve("waiter.acquired")))

            Process.killProcess(helperPid)
            assertTrue(
                "Waiting worker did not acquire lock after helper process death",
                Files.exists(root.resolve("waiter.acquired")) || runCatching {
                    waitingWorker.get(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    true
                }.getOrDefault(false),
            )
            waitingWorker.get(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            secondRoot.withExclusiveCleanupLock { root.resolve("reacquired").toFile().writeText("yes") }
            assertTrue("Lock could not be acquired after process death", Files.exists(root.resolve("reacquired")))
            Log.i(TAG, "helper_killed=true waiting_worker_acquired=true lock_reacquired=true")
        } finally {
            if (helperPid > 0) Process.killProcess(helperPid)
            targetContext.stopService(helperIntent)
            executor.shutdownNow()
            runCatching {
                Files.list(root).use { children -> children.forEach(Files::deleteIfExists) }
                Files.deleteIfExists(root)
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "CleanupLockProcessDeathTest"
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.cash.sqldelight.driver.android.AndroidSqliteDriver
import app.docscan.core.artifact.FileArtifactRepository

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CleanupProducerReferenceMatrixInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun realProducerReferencesProtectAllSixClassesFromAndroidCleanup() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "cleanup-producers-$suffix.db"
        val artifactRoot = Files.createTempDirectory(context.noBackupFilesDir.toPath(), "cleanup-producers-$suffix-")
        val driver = AndroidSqliteDriver(
            schema = DocScanDatabase.Schema,
            context = context,
            name = databaseName,
            callback = object : AndroidSqliteDriver.Callback(DocScanDatabase.Schema) {
                override fun onConfigure(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                    db.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true)
                    check(db.enableWriteAheadLogging()) { "SQLite WAL mode is required" }
                }

                override fun onOpen(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                    db.execSQL("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
                    db.query("PRAGMA synchronous").use { cursor ->
                        check(cursor.moveToFirst() && cursor.getInt(0) == 2) {
                            "SQLite synchronous=FULL is required for cleanup producer fixture"
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
        )
        val database = DocScanDatabase(driver)
        val store = StateStore(database, AndroidClock())
        val repository = FileArtifactRepository(
            privateRoot = artifactRoot,
            directorySync = AndroidDirectorySync(),
            producerEpoch = "cleanup-producers-$suffix",
            atomicPublisher = AndroidAtomicArtifactPublisher(),
        )

        try {
            val workspaceId = WorkspaceId.new()
            store.createInitialWorkspace(workspaceId, WorkspaceSessionId.new())

            val original = publishImage(repository, store, byteArrayOf(1, 3, 5, 7))
            val page = store.commitCapture(
                CaptureCommand(
                    workspaceId = workspaceId,
                    pageId = PageId.new(),
                    imageVersionId = ImageVersionId.new(),
                    artifact = original,
                    selected = true,
                    makeActive = true,
                    coordinateSpace = "source-pixel-v1",
                    processingDesiredState = "OCR_LATIN_V1",
                    sourceProvenance = "{\"kind\":\"cleanup-producer-fixture\"}",
                ),
            )

            val replacement = publishImage(repository, store, byteArrayOf(2, 4, 6, 8))
            val replacementVersion = ImageVersionId.new()
            val nextContentRevision = store.replacePageImage(
                ReplacePageImageCommand(
                    workspaceId = workspaceId,
                    pageId = page.pageId,
                    expectedImageVersionId = page.imageVersionId,
                    expectedContentRevision = 1L,
                    newImageVersionId = replacementVersion,
                    artifact = replacement,
                    coordinateSpace = "edited-pixel-v1",
                    transformProvenance = "producer-reference-matrix",
                    processingDesiredState = "OCR_LATIN_V1",
                ),
            )
            assertEquals(2L, nextContentRevision)

            val importSnapshot = publishImage(repository, store, byteArrayOf(9, 11, 13, 15))
            val importSessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
            store.beginImageImport(
                ImportImageCommand(
                    importSessionId = importSessionId,
                    workspaceId = workspaceId,
                    pageId = PageId.new(),
                    imageVersionId = ImageVersionId.new(),
                    sourceArtifact = importSnapshot,
                    mimeType = "image/jpeg",
                    displayName = "unfinished-import.jpg",
                    desiredOperationKey = "OCR_LATIN_V1",
                ),
            )

            val saveManifest = store.freezeSelectedPagesForSave(workspaceId)
            store.beginLocalOutputComposition(saveManifest)
            val pdf = repository.publishExportFile(ByteArrayInputStream(byteArrayOf(21, 22, 23, 24)), "pdf")
            val jpeg = repository.publishExportFile(ByteArrayInputStream(byteArrayOf(31, 32, 33, 34)), "jpg")
            store.recordStagedExportFile(saveManifest.saveManifestId, pdf)
            store.recordStagedExportFile(saveManifest.saveManifestId, jpeg)

            val provider = ProviderQualificationCommand(
                qualificationId = "cleanup-qualification-$suffix",
                adapterId = "cleanup-test-saf-v1",
                providerVersion = "provider-fixture-v1",
                osVersion = "api36.1-avd",
                destinationAccessClass = "PERSISTED_TREE_READ_WRITE",
                validationSuiteVersion = "cleanup-producer-matrix-v1",
                qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload = "{\"create\":true,\"write\":true,\"observe\":true}",
            )
            store.recordProviderQualification(provider)
            val destination = "content://cleanup-test.provider/tree/$suffix"
            store.recordDestinationGrant(destination, 100L)
            val exportId = ExportArtifactId.new()
            store.commitLocalExportArtifact(
                CommitLocalExportCommand(
                    exportArtifactId = exportId,
                    saveManifestId = saveManifest.saveManifestId,
                    files = listOf(
                        LocalExportFileCommand(pdf, "PDF", null),
                        LocalExportFileCommand(jpeg, "JPG_PAGE", replacementVersion),
                    ),
                    externalPackage = ExternalExportPackageCommand(
                        destinationTreeUri = destination,
                        commonBasename = "Scan",
                        providerQualificationId = provider.qualificationId,
                        adapterId = provider.adapterId,
                        providerVersion = provider.providerVersion,
                        osVersion = provider.osVersion,
                        destinationAccessClass = provider.destinationAccessClass,
                        outputs = listOf(
                            ExternalExportPackageOutputCommand(pdf.artifactId, "Scan.pdf", 0L),
                            ExternalExportPackageOutputCommand(jpeg.artifactId, "Scan-001.jpg", 1L),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )

            val saveProtection = store.freezeSelectedPagesForSave(workspaceId)
            val attemptId = ExportAttemptId.new()
            store.beginExportAttempt(
                BeginExportAttemptCommand(
                    exportAttemptId = attemptId,
                    exportArtifactId = exportId,
                    outputArtifactId = pdf.artifactId,
                    destinationTreeUri = destination,
                    plannedDisplayName = "Scan.pdf",
                    mimeType = "application/pdf",
                    providerQualificationId = provider.qualificationId,
                    adapterId = provider.adapterId,
                    providerVersion = provider.providerVersion,
                    osVersion = provider.osVersion,
                    destinationAccessClass = provider.destinationAccessClass,
                ),
            )

            val orphan = publishImage(repository, store, byteArrayOf(41, 42, 43, 44))
            assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.commitArtifact(orphan.artifactId.value).value)

            data class ProtectedFile(
                val artifactId: ArtifactId,
                val relativePath: String,
                val sizeBytes: Long,
                val sha256: String,
                val expectedBytes: ByteArray,
                val references: List<Triple<String, String, String>>,
            )
            fun imageFile(artifact: DurableImageArtifact, bytes: ByteArray, vararg refs: Triple<String, String, String>) =
                ProtectedFile(artifact.artifactId, artifact.relativePath, artifact.sizeBytes, artifact.sha256, bytes, refs.toList())
            fun exportFile(file: DurableExportFile, bytes: ByteArray, vararg refs: Triple<String, String, String>) =
                ProtectedFile(file.artifactId, file.relativePath, file.sizeBytes, file.sha256, bytes, refs.toList())

            val protectedArtifacts = listOf(
                imageFile(original, byteArrayOf(1, 3, 5, 7), Triple("IMAGE_VERSION", "UNDO", page.imageVersionId.value)),
                imageFile(replacement, byteArrayOf(2, 4, 6, 8),
                    Triple("IMAGE_VERSION", "AUTHORITATIVE", replacementVersion.value),
                    Triple("SAVE_MANIFEST", "SAVE", saveProtection.saveManifestId.value)),
                imageFile(importSnapshot, byteArrayOf(9, 11, 13, 15),
                    Triple("IMPORT_SESSION", "RECOVERY", importSessionId.value)),
                exportFile(pdf, byteArrayOf(21, 22, 23, 24),
                    Triple("EXPORT_ARTIFACT", "EXPORT", exportId.value),
                    Triple("EXPORT_ATTEMPT", "RECOVERY", attemptId.value)),
                exportFile(jpeg, byteArrayOf(31, 32, 33, 34),
                    Triple("EXPORT_ARTIFACT", "EXPORT", exportId.value)),
            )
            val observedPairs = protectedArtifacts.flatMap { artifact ->
                val references = database.schemaQueries.artifactReferences(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsList()
                artifact.references.forEach { (kind, protection, ownerId) ->
                    assertTrue("Producer did not persist $kind/$protection owner $ownerId for ${artifact.artifactId.value}",
                        references.any {
                            it.ref_kind == kind && it.protection_class == protection && it.ref_owner_id == ownerId
                        })
                }
                references.map { it.ref_kind to it.protection_class }
            }.toSet()
            assertEquals(
                setOf(
                    "IMAGE_VERSION" to "AUTHORITATIVE",
                    "IMAGE_VERSION" to "UNDO",
                    "IMPORT_SESSION" to "RECOVERY",
                    "SAVE_MANIFEST" to "SAVE",
                    "EXPORT_ARTIFACT" to "EXPORT",
                    "EXPORT_ATTEMPT" to "RECOVERY",
                ),
                observedPairs,
            )
            val result = CleanupArbiter(store, repository).runBatch(20L)

            assertEquals(1, result.claimedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(1, result.deletedArtifacts)
            assertEquals(0, result.quarantinedArtifacts)
            protectedArtifacts.forEach { artifact ->
                val row = database.schemaQueries.artifactById(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
                assertEquals("COMMITTED", row.state)
                assertEquals("PRESENT", row.storage_state)
                assertTrue("Producer-protected bytes changed for ${artifact.artifactId.value}",
                    repository.verifyPublished(artifact.relativePath, artifact.sizeBytes, artifact.sha256))
                assertTrue("Producer-protected bytes differ for ${artifact.artifactId.value}",
                    Files.readAllBytes(artifactRoot.resolve(artifact.relativePath)).contentEquals(artifact.expectedBytes))
            }
            val deletedOrphan = database.schemaQueries.artifactById(orphan.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", deletedOrphan.state)
            assertEquals("DELETED", deletedOrphan.storage_state)
            assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(orphan.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())
            assertFalse(Files.exists(artifactRoot.resolve(orphan.relativePath)))
        } finally {
            driver.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            Files.walk(artifactRoot).use { paths -> paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(Files::deleteIfExists) }
        }
    }

    private fun publishImage(
        repository: FileArtifactRepository,
        store: StateStore,
        bytes: ByteArray,
    ): DurableImageArtifact = repository.publishJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)).also(store::recordStagedDurableArtifact)

}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/CropSelectionViewInstrumentedTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CropSelectionViewInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun draggingCornerMovesItsNormalizedPointAndRejectsCrossingGeometry() {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
            val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(200, 200, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val canvas = Bitmap.createBitmap(400, 400, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val view = CropSelectionView(context).apply {
                measure(
                    View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(400, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                    View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(400, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                )
                layout(0, 0, 400, 400)
                bitmap = source
            }
            try {
                view.draw(android.graphics.Canvas(canvas))
                val before = view.quadrilateral.topLeft
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 20f, 20f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 60f, 60f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 60f, 60f)
                assertTrue(view.quadrilateral.topLeft.x > before.x)
                assertTrue(view.quadrilateral.topLeft.y > before.y)

                val afterValidMove = view.quadrilateral
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 60f, 60f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 380f, 380f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 380f, 380f)
                assertTrue(view.quadrilateral == afterValidMove)
            } finally {
                view.bitmap = null
                source.recycle()
                canvas.recycle()
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun draggingEdgeTranslatesBothEndpointsOfEdge() {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
            val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(200, 200, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val canvas = Bitmap.createBitmap(400, 400, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val view = CropSelectionView(context).apply {
                measure(
                    View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(400, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                    View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(400, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                )
                layout(0, 0, 400, 400)
                bitmap = source
            }
            try {
                view.draw(android.graphics.Canvas(canvas))
                val before = view.quadrilateral

                // Drag top edge (midpoint is at 200, 20) downwards to (200, 60)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 200f, 20f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 200f, 60f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 200f, 60f)

                assertTrue("Top-left y should move down", view.quadrilateral.topLeft.y > before.topLeft.y)
                assertTrue("Top-right y should move down", view.quadrilateral.topRight.y > before.topRight.y)
                // Bottom corners must stay unchanged
                org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(before.bottomLeft, view.quadrilateral.bottomLeft)
                org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(before.bottomRight, view.quadrilateral.bottomRight)

                // Drag right edge (midpoint is around 380, 200) inwards to (340, 200)
                val beforeRightDrag = view.quadrilateral
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 380f, 200f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 340f, 200f)
                dispatch(view, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 340f, 200f)

                assertTrue("Top-right x should move left", view.quadrilateral.topRight.x < beforeRightDrag.topRight.x)
                assertTrue("Bottom-right x should move left", view.quadrilateral.bottomRight.x < beforeRightDrag.bottomRight.x)
                // Left corners must stay unchanged
                org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(beforeRightDrag.topLeft, view.quadrilateral.topLeft)
                org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(beforeRightDrag.bottomLeft, view.quadrilateral.bottomLeft)
            } finally {
                view.bitmap = null
                source.recycle()
                canvas.recycle()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun dispatch(view: CropSelectionView, action: Int, x: Float, y: Float) {
        val event = MotionEvent.obtain(0L, 0L, action, x, y, 0)
        try {
            view.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
        } finally {
            event.recycle()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.os.Build
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.ImageButton
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CurvedEdgesUiInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun toggleStaysBesideDocumentWithoutOverlapAt320And360DpAndSurvivesRecreation() {
        assumeTrue(
            "Screen size changes are only allowed on an emulator",
            Build.FINGERPRINT.contains("generic") || Build.FINGERPRINT.contains("emulator") ||
                Build.HARDWARE in setOf("ranchu", "goldfish") || Build.PRODUCT.contains("sdk_gphone", ignoreCase = true),
        )
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val originalSize = shell("wm size")
        val originalDensity = shell("wm density")
        val dimensions = Regex("Physical size: (\\d+)x(\\d+)").find(originalSize)
            ?: throw AssertionError("Cannot read physical emulator dimensions: $originalSize")
        val widthPx = dimensions.groupValues[1].toInt()
        val heightPx = dimensions.groupValues[2].toInt()
        val density = Regex("(?:Override|Physical) density: (\\d+)").find(originalDensity)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toInt()
            ?: throw AssertionError("Cannot read emulator density: $originalDensity")
        val priorOverride = Regex("Override size: (\\d+x\\d+)").find(originalSize)?.groupValues?.get(1)
        try {
            for (targetDp in listOf(320, 360)) {
                val targetPx = (targetDp * density / 160.0).toInt()
                shell("wm size ${targetPx}x$heightPx")
                instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
                val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
                try {
                    awaitCaptureReady(scenario)
                    instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
                    scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                        val actualWidthDp = activity.resources.configuration.screenWidthDp
                        assertTrue("Expected compact width near ${targetDp}dp, got ${actualWidthDp}dp",
                            kotlin.math.abs(actualWidthDp - targetDp) <= 1)
                        val curved = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<ImageButton>("docscan-curved-edges-toggle")
                        val document = findDocumentButton(activity.window.decorView, activity.getString(R.string.document_mode_name))
                        val shutter = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<Button>("docscan-capture-button")
                        assertNotNull("Curved-edge icon is present", curved)
                        assertNotNull("Camera shutter is present", shutter)
                        assertTrue("Curved icon and Document label share a row", curved.parent === document.parent)
                        assertTrue("Curved icon appears immediately after Document", bounds(document).right <= bounds(curved).left)
                        assertTrue("Controls share a vertical center", kotlin.math.abs(bounds(curved).centerY() - bounds(document).centerY()) <= 1)
                        val group = Rect(bounds(curved)).apply { union(bounds(document)) }
                        assertFalse("Curved/Documents controls must not overlap the shutter at ${targetDp}dp",
                            Rect.intersects(group, bounds(shutter)))
                        assertTrue("Controls fit inside the visible display width", group.left >= 0 && group.right <= activity.resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels)
                        assertFalse("Curved processing starts off", curved.isSelected)
                        assertFalse("Curved processing is disabled outside Document mode", curved.isEnabled)
                        assertCurvedCheckState(curved, checked = false)

                        document.performClick()
                        assertTrue("Document mode becomes active", document.isSelected)
                        assertTrue("Curved option is enabled in Document mode", curved.isEnabled)
                        curved.performClick()
                        assertTrue("Icon reflects checked state", curved.isSelected)
                        assertCurvedCheckState(curved, checked = true)
                        curved.performClick()
                        assertFalse("Second tap restores unchecked state", curved.isSelected)
                        assertCurvedCheckState(curved, checked = false)
                        curved.performClick()
                        assertCurvedCheckState(curved, checked = true)
                    }

                    if (targetDp == 360) {
                        scenario.recreate()
                        awaitCaptureReady(scenario)
                        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                            val curved = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<ImageButton>("docscan-curved-edges-toggle")
                            val document = findDocumentButton(activity.window.decorView, activity.getString(R.string.document_mode_name))
                            assertTrue("Document mode restores across recreation", document.isSelected)
                            assertTrue("Checked curved-edge mode restores across recreation", curved.isSelected)
                            assertCurvedCheckState(curved, checked = true)
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    scenario.close()
                }
            }
        } finally {
            shell(if (priorOverride == null) "wm size reset" else "wm size $priorOverride")
            instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
        }
    }

    private fun awaitCaptureReady(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>) {
        val timeout = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 30_000L
        while (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < timeout) {
            var ready = false
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                ready = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-capture-button")?.isEnabled == true
            }
            if (ready) return
            SystemClock.sleep(100L)
        }
        throw AssertionError("Camera capture button did not become ready")
    }

    private fun findButton(root: View, text: String): Button? {
        if (root is Button && root.text.toString() == text) return root
        if (root is ViewGroup) for (index in 0 until root.childCount) findButton(root.getChildAt(index), text)?.let { return it }
        return null
    }

    private fun findDocumentButton(root: View, text: String): Button =
        findButton(root, text) ?: throw AssertionError("Document mode button '$text' is missing")

    private fun bounds(view: View): Rect {
        val location = IntArray(2)
        view.getLocationOnScreen(location)
        return Rect(location[0], location[1], location[0] + view.width, location[1] + view.height)
    }

    private fun assertCurvedCheckState(view: ImageButton, checked: Boolean) {
        val info = view.createAccessibilityNodeInfo()
        try {
            assertTrue("Curved-edge control is exposed as checkable", info.isCheckable)
            assertEquals("Accessibility check state tracks the visual state", checked, info.isChecked)
            assertEquals("Accessibility class is checkbox-like", android.widget.CheckBox::class.java.name, info.className.toString())
        } finally {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            info.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun shell(command: String): String {
        val descriptor = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(command)
        return ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(descriptor).bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }.trim()
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/CurvedPageEdgesInstrumentedTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.sin

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CurvedPageEdgesInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun repairsBothConcaveAndConvexPageEdgesAndPreservesCentralPrint() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        for (bend in listOf(-1, 1)) {
            val source = gradientBitmap()
            val probs = pageMask(bend)
            val originalCenter = source.getPixel(128, 128)
            val nearEdgePrint = source.getPixel(32, 128)
            try {
                val repaired = CurvedPageEdges.repair(source, identityQuad(), probs)
                assertNotNull("Bend $bend should produce a bounded repair", repaired)
                repaired!!.useBitmap {
                    assertEquals("Repair must preserve unmasked central page pixels", originalCenter, it.getPixel(128, 128))
                    assertEquals("Print near the recovered edge must remain untouched", nearEdgePrint, it.getPixel(32, 128))
                    assertTrue("Output dimensions should match rectified page", it.width == source.width && it.height == source.height)
                }
            } finally {
                source.recycle()
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun expandsAnUnclippedQuadAndDeclinesExpansionWhenItWouldLeaveTheFrame() {
        val expanded = CurvedPageEdges.expanded(quad(.10, .10, .90, .90))
        assertNotNull("An inset page quad has room for modest outward bends", expanded)
        val expandedPoints = requireNotNull(expanded).asList()
        assertTrue(expandedPoints.first().x < .10 && expandedPoints.first().y < .10)
        assertTrue(expandedPoints[2].x > .90 && expandedPoints[2].y > .90)
        assertNull("A page already clipped at the frame cannot be expanded safely",
            CurvedPageEdges.expanded(quad(.01, .10, .90, .90)))
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsUnreliableAndClippedMasksWithoutReturningAnImage() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val source = gradientBitmap()
        try {
            val uncertainCenter = FloatArray(SIZE * SIZE) { 0.10f }
            assertNull("A low-confidence center is not safe to repair",
                CurvedPageEdges.repair(source, identityQuad(), uncertainCenter))

            val clipped = pageMask(0).also { values ->
                // Connect the outside to the central safe area, as happens when the
                // segmentation confidently labels an incomplete crop as background.
                for (y in SIZE / 3 until SIZE * 2 / 3) for (x in 0 until SIZE / 2) {
                    values[y * SIZE + x] = 0.05f
                }
            }
            assertNull("A background leak into the central page area must be rejected",
                CurvedPageEdges.repair(source, identityQuad(), clipped))
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun inpaintingDoesNotCreateASharpSeamOnSmoothGradient() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val source = gradientBitmap()
        try {
            val output = CurvedPageEdges.repair(source, identityQuad(), pageMask(1))
            assertNotNull("Smooth gradient with a bounded border mask should be repaired", output)
            output!!.useBitmap { repaired ->
                // Outside the confident page mask the source has a contrasting
                // dark background. Repair should replace it with plausible paper
                // continuation, without introducing a large luminance step.
                val y = SIZE / 2
                val repairedOutside = luminance(repaired.getPixel(8, y))
                val paperAtEdge = luminance(repaired.getPixel(14, y))
                val originalOutside = luminance(source.getPixel(8, y))
                assertTrue("Masked background should be replaced by the page continuation: before=$originalOutside after=$repairedOutside paper=$paperAtEdge",
                    abs(repairedOutside - paperAtEdge) < abs(originalOutside - paperAtEdge))
                val seamSlope = abs(luminance(repaired.getPixel(14, y)) - luminance(repaired.getPixel(13, y)))
                val interiorSlope = abs(luminance(repaired.getPixel(40, y)) - luminance(repaired.getPixel(39, y)))
                assertTrue("Mask seam slope=$seamSlope, interior slope=$interiorSlope",
                    seamSlope <= interiorSlope + 8)
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun pageMask(bend: Int): FloatArray = FloatArray(SIZE * SIZE).also { values ->
        for (y in 0 until SIZE) {
            val wave = sin(Math.PI * y / (SIZE - 1)).toFloat()
            // At mid-height, positive bend extends the right edge out; negative
            // bend pushes the left edge inward. Endpoints stay close to the corners.
            val left = 14 + if (bend < 0) (7 * wave).toInt() else 0
            val right = SIZE - 15 + if (bend > 0) (7 * wave).toInt() else 0
            for (x in left..right) values[y * SIZE + x] = 0.96f
        }
    }

    private fun gradientBitmap(): Bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(SIZE, SIZE, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).also { bitmap ->
        bitmap.eraseColor(Color.rgb(32, 49, 60))
        for (y in 0 until SIZE) for (x in 14 until SIZE - 14) {
            val shade = (150 + x / 2 + y / 5).coerceAtMost(245)
            bitmap.setPixel(x, y, Color.rgb(shade, shade, shade))
        }
        // Central print-like strokes confirm repair doesn't touch page content.
        for (y in 90..166 step 12) for (x in 80..176) bitmap.setPixel(x, y, Color.rgb(50, 55, 60))
        // A short text-like stroke sits just inside the most inward-bending edge.
        for (x in 30..38) bitmap.setPixel(x, 128, Color.rgb(42, 47, 52))
    }

    private fun identityQuad() = CropQuadrilateral(
        NormalizedCropPoint(0.0, 0.0), NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 0.0),
        NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 1.0), NormalizedCropPoint(0.0, 1.0),
    )

    private fun quad(left: Double, top: Double, right: Double, bottom: Double) = CropQuadrilateral(
        NormalizedCropPoint(left, top), NormalizedCropPoint(right, top),
        NormalizedCropPoint(right, bottom), NormalizedCropPoint(left, bottom),
    )

    private fun luminance(color: Int) = (Color.red(color) * 299 + Color.green(color) * 587 + Color.blue(color) * 114) / 1000

    private inline fun Bitmap.useBitmap(block: (Bitmap) -> Unit) {
        try { block(this) } finally { recycle() }
    }

    private companion object { const val SIZE = 256 }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.opencv.android.OpenCVLoader
import org.opencv.android.Utils
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import java.io.Closeable

/** Instrumentation parity against host FP32 CPU run; never a camera quality gate. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocAlignerAndroidReferenceInstrumentedTest {

    @Before
    fun requireOptionalReferenceAssets() {
        val required = listOf(
            "models/lc100.onnx", "models/t8.onnx",
            "docaligner_run_test_card.png", "negative_white.png", "negative_black.png",
            "negative_uniform_gray.png", "negative_low_contrast_noise.png",
            "negative_checker_clutter.png", "negative_graphic_panel.png", "synthetic_document.png",
        )
        val assets = instrumentationContext().assets
        val missing = required.filter { name ->
            runCatching { assets.open(name).use { } }.isFailure
        }
        assumeTrue("Fetch optional DocAligner reference assets first; missing: $missing", missing.isEmpty())
    }

    private data class LoadedMat(val mat: Mat, val width: Int, val height: Int) : Closeable {
        override fun close() = mat.release()
    }

    private data class Run(val raw: DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.RawReference,
                           val result: DocumentBoundaryResult)

    @Test
    fun upstreamCardMatchesPinnedHostCornersAndCannotClaimFound() {
        assertTrue("OpenCV Android native library must load", OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val expected = mapOf(
            DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.LC100 to listOf(
                47.1987608889 to 223.2925990884,
                387.1165100209 to 198.0532896779,
                423.4226855013 to 345.6081579118,
                40.4768732285 to 361.3888288091,
            ),
            DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.T8 to listOf(
                49.9575748014 to 223.6944135816,
                387.1555049372 to 198.4516612004,
                423.5801911235 to 345.8444163450,
                40.3199731446 to 361.2965064588,
            ),
        )
        for ((model, points) in expected) {
            val run = runModel(model, "docaligner_run_test_card.png")
            assertEquals("output names must pin absence of classification", setOf("heatmap"), run.raw.outputNames)
            assertEquals(listOf(1L, 3L, 256L, 256L), run.raw.inputShape.toList())
            assertEquals(listOf(1L, 4L, 128L, 128L), run.raw.heatmapShape.toList())
            assertCorners(points, run.raw.channelCornersXY, tolerancePx = 3.0)
            assertEquals(BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS, run.result.outcome)
            assertEquals("no model presence score", null, run.result.candidates.single().documentPresence)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun featurelessNegativesDoNotCreateHeatmapCentroidsButRemainAmbiguous() {
        assertTrue(OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val names = listOf(
            "negative_white.png", "negative_black.png", "negative_uniform_gray.png",
            "negative_low_contrast_noise.png", "negative_checker_clutter.png",
        )
        for (model in DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.entries) {
            for (name in names) {
                val run = runModel(model, name)
                assertTrue("$model $name: ${run.raw.channelCornersXY}", run.raw.channelCornersXY.all { it == null })
                assertTrue("heatmap-only graph cannot prove NO_DOCUMENT", run.result.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS)
                assertTrue(run.result.candidates.isEmpty())
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun graphicPanelDemonstratesFalseLockRiskWithoutPresenceGate() {
        assertTrue(OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val expected = listOf(
            120.9677579876 to 37.2225953929,
            531.2148502946 to 86.4328728669,
            496.9694637464 to 423.6012031309,
            97.3560715914 to 386.5349353322,
        )
        val lc100 = runModel(DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.LC100, "negative_graphic_panel.png")
        assertCorners(expected, lc100.raw.channelCornersXY, tolerancePx = 4.0)
        assertEquals(BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS, lc100.result.outcome)
        assertEquals(1, lc100.result.candidates.size)
        assertNull(lc100.result.candidates.single().documentPresence)

        val t8 = runModel(DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.T8, "negative_graphic_panel.png")
        assertEquals(4, t8.raw.channelCornersXY.count { it != null })
        assertEquals(BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS, t8.result.outcome)
    }

    @Test
    fun simpleSyntheticPaperSeparatesTheTwoPinnedCandidates() {
        assertTrue(OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val lc100 = runModel(DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.LC100, "synthetic_document.png")
        assertEquals(4, lc100.raw.channelCornersXY.count { it != null })
        assertEquals(BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS, lc100.result.outcome)
        val t8 = runModel(DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.T8, "synthetic_document.png")
        assertTrue(t8.raw.channelCornersXY.all { it == null })
        assertEquals(BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS, t8.result.outcome)
    }

    @Test
    fun viewportCropIsResizedAndCornersReturnInFullBufferCoordinates() {
        assertTrue(OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val crop = BufferRect(20, 15, 620, 465)
        val expected = mapOf(
            DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.LC100 to listOf(
                124.9344243181 to 40.3163322650,
                531.0639795417 to 87.0995741672,
                496.9672394802 to 423.7144093900,
                97.6457513968 to 386.2705848532,
            ),
            DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.T8 to listOf(
                123.2424222021 to 42.4137016980,
                527.7433331238 to 90.9300836465,
                492.4548638677 to 416.5868717045,
                96.8197644644 to 381.6175568494,
            ),
        )
        for ((model, points) in expected) {
            val run = runModel(model, "negative_graphic_panel.png", crop)
            assertCorners(points, run.raw.channelCornersXY, tolerancePx = 4.0)
            assertEquals(BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS, run.result.outcome)
        }
    }

    private fun runModel(
        model: DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model,
        assetName: String,
        viewport: BufferRect? = null,
    ): Run {
        val image = loadRgba(assetName)
        image.use {
            val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
                bufferWidth = image.width,
                bufferHeight = image.height,
                cropRect = viewport ?: BufferRect(0, 0, image.width, image.height),
                rotationDegrees = 0,
            )
            val identity = BoundaryFrameId(1, 1, 1)
            val input = DocumentBoundaryInput(
                identity = identity,
                spec = spec,
                timing = DocumentFrameTiming(null, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()),
                rgba = image.mat,
            )
            DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter(model, instrumentationContext().assets).use { adapter ->
                val raw = adapter.inferRaw(input)
                android.util.Log.i(
                    "DBQ_MODEL_RAW",
                    "model=${model.name} asset=$assetName crop=${input.spec.cropRect} " +
                        "input=${raw.inputShape.contentToString()} heatmap=${raw.heatmapShape.contentToString()} " +
                        "outputs=${raw.outputNames.sorted()} corners=${raw.channelCornersXY}",
                )
                val result = adapter.detect(input)
                assertEquals(identity, result.identity)
                assertTrue(result.reason.orEmpty().contains("no document-presence head"))
                return Run(raw, result)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadRgba(name: String): LoadedMat {
        val options = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888 }
        val bitmap = instrumentationContext().assets.open(name).use { stream ->
            BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream, null, options)
        } ?: error("Unable to decode androidTest asset $name")
        val mat = Mat()
        try {
            Utils.bitmapToMat(bitmap, mat) // Android OpenCV produces RGBA CV_8UC4.
            assertEquals(4, mat.channels())
            return LoadedMat(mat, bitmap.width, bitmap.height)
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            mat.release()
            throw t
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun assertCorners(expected: List<Pair<Double, Double>>,
                              actual: List<Pair<Double, Double>?>,
                              tolerancePx: Double) {
        assertEquals("one centroid slot per heatmap channel", 4, actual.size)
        for (i in expected.indices) {
            val got = actual[i]
            assertNotNull("corner $i missing", got)
            assertEquals("corner $i x", expected[i].first, got!!.first, tolerancePx)
            assertEquals("corner $i y", expected[i].second, got.second, tolerancePx)
        }
    }

    private fun instrumentationContext() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().context
}
