package app.docscan.android

import ai.onnxruntime.OnnxTensor
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtSession
import ai.onnxruntime.TensorInfo
import org.opencv.core.CvType
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.core.MatOfPoint
import org.opencv.core.Point
import org.opencv.core.Rect
import org.opencv.core.Size
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder
import java.nio.FloatBuffer
import java.security.MessageDigest

/**
 * Test-only FP32 CPU adapter for the two pinned DocAligner heatmap ONNX models.
 * It mirrors DocAligner heatmap_reg/infer.py and deliberately never reports
 * FOUND: these model graphs expose no document-presence output.
 */
internal class DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter(
    private val model: Model,
    assets: android.content.res.AssetManager,
) : DocumentBoundaryDetector {

    enum class Model(val asset: String, val sha256: String) {
        LC100(
            "models/lc100.onnx",
            "f4117b786e3a18470f3865c93f3c2bd69d9b998edd60f385574a5c665e79594e",
        ),
        T8(
            "models/t8.onnx",
            "950070fd4a46e25d46db7c35d0ed77612d9063f70d4543c7c504f0da6a943a89",
        ),
    }

    data class RawReference(
        val channelCornersXY: List<Pair<Double, Double>?>,
        val inputShape: LongArray,
        val heatmapShape: LongArray,
        val outputNames: Set<String>,
    )

    override val detectorId: String = "docaligner-${model.name.lowercase()}-android-reference"
    override val configVersion: String = "onnx-opset16-fp32-${model.sha256}"

    private val environment = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment()
    private val session: OrtSession
    var lastRawReference: RawReference? = null
        private set

    init {
        val bytes = assets.open(model.asset).use { it.readBytes() }
        check(sha256(bytes) == model.sha256) { "Unexpected ${model.name} model asset SHA-256" }
        val options = OrtSession.SessionOptions()
        options.setIntraOpNumThreads(2)
        session = options.use { environment.createSession(bytes, it) }
        check(session.inputNames == setOf("img")) { "Expected one img input: ${session.inputNames}" }
        check(session.outputNames == setOf("heatmap")) {
            "Expected heatmap-only graph without a document-presence output: ${session.outputNames}"
        }
    }

    /**
     * Raw model candidate evidence independent of the production presence/edge
     * policy. Returned coordinates are pixel-index centroids plus cropRect origin.
     * The later CameraX boundary transform owns the +0.5 pixel-center conversion.
     */
    fun inferRaw(input: DocumentBoundaryInput): RawReference {
        val rgba = input.rgba
        require(!rgba.empty() && rgba.type() == CvType.CV_8UC4) { "Expected non-empty CV_8UC4 RGBA input" }
        require(rgba.cols() == input.spec.bufferWidth && rgba.rows() == input.spec.bufferHeight) {
            "RGBA Mat does not match AnalysisBufferSpec"
        }

        val cropRect = input.spec.cropRect
        val cropView = Mat(rgba, Rect(cropRect.left, cropRect.top, cropRect.width, cropRect.height))
        val bgr = Mat()
        val resized = Mat()
        try {
            Imgproc.cvtColor(cropView, bgr, Imgproc.COLOR_RGBA2BGR)
            Imgproc.resize(bgr, resized, Size(INPUT_SIZE.toDouble(), INPUT_SIZE.toDouble()),
                0.0, 0.0, Imgproc.INTER_LINEAR)
            val pixels = ByteArray(INPUT_SIZE * INPUT_SIZE * 3)
            resized.get(0, 0, pixels)
            val inputBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(INPUT_SIZE * INPUT_SIZE * 3 * Float.SIZE_BYTES)
                .order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder()).asFloatBuffer()
            val planeSize = INPUT_SIZE * INPUT_SIZE
            // Upstream does HWC BGR -> CHW float32 / 255 with no mean/std normalization.
            for (channel in 0..2) {
                for (pixel in 0 until planeSize) {
                    inputBuffer.put(((pixels[pixel * 3 + channel].toInt() and 0xff).toFloat()) / 255.0f)
                }
            }
            inputBuffer.rewind()
            val tensorShape = longArrayOf(1, 3, INPUT_SIZE.toLong(), INPUT_SIZE.toLong())
            OnnxTensor.createTensor(environment, inputBuffer, tensorShape).use { tensor ->
                session.run(mapOf("img" to tensor)).use { result ->
                    val heatmap = result.get("heatmap").orElseThrow() as OnnxTensor
                    val info = heatmap.info as TensorInfo
                    val heatmapShape = info.shape
                    check(heatmapShape.size == 4 && heatmapShape[0] == 1L && heatmapShape[1] == 4L) {
                        "Expected [1,4,H,W] heatmap, got ${heatmapShape.contentToString()}"
                    }
                    val heatmapValues = FloatArray(heatmapShape.fold(1L) { acc, d -> acc * d }.toInt())
                    heatmap.floatBuffer.get(heatmapValues)
                    val corners = postprocess(
                        heatmapValues = heatmapValues,
                        heatmapHeight = heatmapShape[2].toInt(),
                        heatmapWidth = heatmapShape[3].toInt(),
                        outputHeight = cropRect.height,
                        outputWidth = cropRect.width,
                    ).map { it?.let { p -> (p.x + cropRect.left) to (p.y + cropRect.top) } }
                    return RawReference(
                        channelCornersXY = corners,
                        inputShape = tensorShape,
                        heatmapShape = heatmapShape,
                        outputNames = session.outputNames,
                    )
                }
            }
        } finally {
            resized.release()
            bgr.release()
            cropView.release()
        }
    }

    override fun detect(input: DocumentBoundaryInput): DocumentBoundaryResult {
        val started = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        val raw = inferRaw(input).also { lastRawReference = it }
        val corners = raw.channelCornersXY
        val candidates = if (corners.size == 4 && corners.all { it != null }) {
            val points = corners.map { point ->
                val nonNull = requireNotNull(point)
                BoundaryPoint(nonNull.first, nonNull.second)
            }
            val quad = runCatching { BoundaryQuad(points[0], points[1], points[2], points[3]) }.getOrNull()
            if (quad == null) emptyList() else listOf(
                DocumentHypothesis(
                    candidateId = 0,
                    quad = quad,
                    rawScore = 0.0,
                    documentPresence = null,
                    visibility = BoundaryVisibility.UNKNOWN,
                    source = detectorId,
                ),
            )
        } else emptyList()
        val finished = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        return DocumentBoundaryResult(
            identity = input.identity,
            detectorId = detectorId,
            configVersion = configVersion,
            outcome = BoundaryOutcome.AMBIGUOUS,
            candidates = candidates,
            detectorStartedNs = started,
            detectorFinishedNs = finished,
            reason = "Reference heatmap has no document-presence head; raw corners do not authorize FOUND or NO_DOCUMENT",
        )
    }

    override fun close() = session.close()

    private fun postprocess(
        heatmapValues: FloatArray,
        heatmapHeight: Int,
        heatmapWidth: Int,
        outputHeight: Int,
        outputWidth: Int,
    ): List<Point?> {
        val corners = ArrayList<Point?>(4)
        val planeSize = heatmapHeight * heatmapWidth
        for (channel in 0 until 4) {
            val source = Mat(heatmapHeight, heatmapWidth, CvType.CV_32FC1)
            val resized = Mat()
            val byteHeatmap = Mat(outputHeight, outputWidth, CvType.CV_8UC1)
            val binary = Mat()
            val hierarchy = Mat()
            val contours = ArrayList<MatOfPoint>()
            try {
                source.put(0, 0, heatmapValues.copyOfRange(channel * planeSize, (channel + 1) * planeSize))
                Imgproc.resize(source, resized, Size(outputWidth.toDouble(), outputHeight.toDouble()),
                    0.0, 0.0, Imgproc.INTER_LINEAR)
                val floats = FloatArray(outputHeight * outputWidth)
                resized.get(0, 0, floats)
                val bytes = ByteArray(floats.size)
                for (i in floats.indices) {
                    val value = if (floats[i] < HEATMAP_THRESHOLD) 0.0f else floats[i]
                    // NumPy uint8(float32 * 255) truncates; Mat.convertTo would round.
                    bytes[i] = (value * 255.0f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 255).toByte()
                }
                byteHeatmap.put(0, 0, bytes)
                Imgproc.threshold(byteHeatmap, binary, 0.0, 255.0,
                    Imgproc.THRESH_BINARY or Imgproc.THRESH_OTSU)
                Imgproc.findContours(binary, contours, hierarchy,
                    Imgproc.RETR_EXTERNAL, Imgproc.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
                val polygons = contours.filter { it.total() >= 3L }
                val contourAreas = polygons.map { Imgproc.moments(it).m00 }
                val maxArea = contourAreas.maxOrNull()
                val maxAreaIndices = if (maxArea == null) emptyList() else
                    contourAreas.indices.filter { contourAreas[it] == maxArea }
                // Upstream selects all tied maximum polygons, flattens all
                // centroids, then rejects that channel because len(point) != 2.
                if (maxAreaIndices.size != 1) {
                    corners.add(null)
                } else {
                    val moments = Imgproc.moments(polygons[maxAreaIndices.single()])
                    corners.add(Point(
                        moments.m10 / (moments.m00 + 1e-5),
                        moments.m01 / (moments.m00 + 1e-5),
                    ))
                }
            } finally {
                contours.forEach { it.release() }
                hierarchy.release()
                binary.release()
                byteHeatmap.release()
                resized.release()
                source.release()
            }
        }
        return corners
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private companion object {
        const val INPUT_SIZE = 256
        const val HEATMAP_THRESHOLD = 0.3f
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.ContentProvider
import android.content.ContentResolver
import android.content.ContentValues
import android.content.Context
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import android.content.pm.ProviderInfo
import android.database.Cursor
import android.database.MatrixCursor
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.provider.MediaStore
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileNotFoundException
import java.util.UUID
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocScanPublisherRollbackInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun realDownloadsProviderUsesFreeSuffixAndPreservesFirstPdf() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val source = File(context.cacheDir, "publisher-real-source-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        val basename = "docscan-publisher-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val createdUris = mutableListOf<Uri>()
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            document.addPage(PDPage())
            document.save(source)
        }

        try {
            val first = DocScanPublisher.publish(
                context = context,
                pdfSource = source,
                pdfFileName = "$basename.pdf",
                jpegSources = emptyList(),
                jpegFileNames = emptyList(),
                saveJpg = false,
            )
            createdUris += first.pdfUri
            val firstExpectedBytes = source.readBytes()
            assertArrayEquals(firstExpectedBytes, requireNotNull(context.contentResolver.openInputStream(first.pdfUri)).use { it.readBytes() })

            val second = DocScanPublisher.publish(
                context = context,
                pdfSource = source,
                pdfFileName = "$basename.pdf",
                jpegSources = emptyList(),
                jpegFileNames = emptyList(),
                saveJpg = false,
            )
            createdUris += second.pdfUri

            assertEquals("$basename.pdf", first.pdfDisplayName)
            assertEquals("$basename (1).pdf", second.pdfDisplayName)
            assertNotEquals("Each publication must have its own MediaStore URI", first.pdfUri, second.pdfUri)
            assertArrayEquals(
                "The second publication must not replace the first file",
                firstExpectedBytes,
                requireNotNull(context.contentResolver.openInputStream(first.pdfUri)).use { it.readBytes() },
            )
            assertArrayEquals(
                "The newly published PDF must read back byte-for-byte",
                firstExpectedBytes,
                requireNotNull(context.contentResolver.openInputStream(second.pdfUri)).use { it.readBytes() },
            )
        } finally {
            createdUris.forEach { uri -> runCatching { context.contentResolver.delete(uri, null, null) } }
            source.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun failedReadBackRemovesEveryRowCreatedForPublication() {
        val targetContext = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val root = File(targetContext.cacheDir, "publisher-rollback-${System.nanoTime()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        val pdf = File(root, "source.pdf").apply { writeBytes(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4)) }
        val jpeg = File(root, "page.jpg").apply { writeBytes(byteArrayOf(5, 6, 7, 8)) }
        val provider = FakeMediaStoreProvider(root, failReadBackAtIndex = 1)
        provider.attachInfo(targetContext, ProviderInfo().apply {
            authority = "media"
            packageName = targetContext.packageName
            applicationInfo = targetContext.applicationInfo
            name = FakeMediaStoreProvider::class.java.name
        })
        val resolver = ContentResolver.wrap(provider)
        val context = object : ContextWrapper(targetContext) {
            override fun getContentResolver(): ContentResolver = resolver
        }

        try {
            assertThrows(FileNotFoundException::class.java) {
                DocScanPublisher.publish(
                    context = context,
                    pdfSource = pdf,
                    pdfFileName = "rollback.pdf",
                    jpegSources = listOf(jpeg),
                    jpegFileNames = listOf("rollback.jpg"),
                    saveJpg = true,
                )
            }
            assertEquals("Both inserted MediaStore rows must be rolled back", 2, provider.deletedIds.size)
            assertTrue("The fake provider must have no published rows after rollback", provider.items.isEmpty())
            assertTrue("Rollback removes each inserted row exactly once", provider.insertedIds.toSet() == provider.deletedIds.toSet())
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private class FakeMediaStoreProvider(
        private val root: File,
        private val failReadBackAtIndex: Int,
    ) : ContentProvider() {
        data class Item(val id: String, val uri: Uri, val file: File, val values: ContentValues)

        val items = linkedMapOf<String, Item>()
        val insertedIds = mutableListOf<String>()
        val deletedIds = mutableListOf<String>()
        private var nextId = 1

        override fun onCreate(): Boolean = true

        override fun query(
            uri: Uri,
            projection: Array<out String>?,
            selection: String?,
            selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
            sortOrder: String?,
        ): Cursor {
            val columns = projection?.toList() ?: listOf(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
            val cursor = MatrixCursor(columns.toTypedArray())
            val item = uri.lastPathSegment?.let(items::get)
            val rows = if (item != null) listOf(item) else items.values.toList()
            rows.forEach { row ->
                cursor.addRow(columns.map { column -> row.values.getAsString(column) })
            }
            return cursor
        }

        override fun getType(uri: Uri): String = "application/octet-stream"

        override fun insert(uri: Uri, values: ContentValues?): Uri {
            val id = (nextId++).toString()
            val itemUri = Uri.withAppendedPath(uri, id)
            val itemFile = File(root, "media-$id").apply { createNewFile() }
            val item = Item(id, itemUri, itemFile, ContentValues(values ?: ContentValues()))
            items[id] = item
            insertedIds += id
            return itemUri
        }

        override fun delete(uri: Uri, selection: String?, selectionArgs: Array<out String>?): Int {
            val id = uri.lastPathSegment ?: return 0
            val item = items.remove(id) ?: return 0
            item.file.delete()
            deletedIds += id
            return 1
        }

        override fun update(uri: Uri, values: ContentValues?, selection: String?, selectionArgs: Array<out String>?): Int {
            val item = uri.lastPathSegment?.let(items::get) ?: return 0
            if (values != null) item.values.putAll(values)
            return 1
        }

        override fun openFile(uri: Uri, mode: String): ParcelFileDescriptor {
            val item = uri.lastPathSegment?.let(items::get) ?: throw FileNotFoundException(uri.toString())
            if (mode.startsWith("r") && insertedIds.indexOf(item.id) == failReadBackAtIndex) {
                throw FileNotFoundException("Injected read-back failure")
            }
            val flags = if (mode.startsWith("r")) ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_ONLY else {
                ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_WRITE_ONLY or ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_CREATE or ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_TRUNCATE
            }
            return ParcelFileDescriptor.open(item.file, flags)
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.opencv.core.CvType
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.core.Rect
import org.opencv.core.Scalar
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import java.util.Random

/** Regression coverage for detector exceptions. These tests exercise software policy only. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentBoundaryFaultInstrumentedTest {
    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(480, 360, BufferRect(0, 0, 480, 360), 0)

    @Test
    fun detectorExceptionPublishesErrorClearsQuadResetsTrackerAndNextValidFramesReconfirm() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        var processingMs = 1_002L
        var shouldThrow = false
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { processingMs })
        val page = quad(52.0, 42.0, 428.0, 318.0)
        var detectorCalls = 0
        val detector = detector { input ->
            detectorCalls++
            if (shouldThrow) throw IllegalStateException("injected detector failure")
            found(input, page)
        }
        val pipeline = DocumentBoundaryPipeline(coordinator, detector, trackingEnabled = true,
            clockMs = { processingMs })
        val rgba = texturedRgba()
        try {
            processingMs = 1_002L
            val first = pipeline.process(frame(1L, 1L, 1_000L, rgba))
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, first.status)

            processingMs = 1_102L
            val confirmed = pipeline.process(frame(2L, 1L, 1_100L, rgba))
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmed.status)
            assertNotNull(confirmed.quadInBufferPixels)

            // Detector cadence is 100 ms. The throwing call must become an explicit ERROR
            // result and reset both coordinator confirmation and the optical-flow seed.
            shouldThrow = true
            processingMs = 1_202L
            val failure = pipeline.process(frame(3L, 1L, 1_200L, rgba))
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR, failure.status)
            assertNull("An error must not retain an apparently usable old quad", failure.quadInBufferPixels)
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR, coordinator.getPublishedState().status)

            // This frame is below detector cadence. If the failed path left the old tracker
            // seed alive, same-image optical flow would turn ERROR into an expired/missing state.
            processingMs = 1_252L
            val betweenDetections = pipeline.process(frame(4L, 1L, 1_250L, rgba))
            assertEquals("Failure must clear the optical-flow seed", LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR,
                betweenDetections.status)

            shouldThrow = false
            processingMs = 1_302L
            val recoveredOnce = pipeline.process(frame(5L, 1L, 1_300L, rgba))
            assertEquals("A new detector observation must start confirmation again",
                LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, recoveredOnce.status)
            processingMs = 1_402L
            val recoveredTwice = pipeline.process(frame(6L, 1L, 1_400L, rgba))
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, recoveredTwice.status)
            assertTrue("The detector must run for both recovery observations", detectorCalls >= 5)

            // Input Mat is borrowed: neither process nor pipeline.close may release caller memory.
            assertFalse("Pipeline must not release its borrowed Mat", rgba.empty())
            assertNotNull(rgba.get(100, 100))
        } finally {
            pipeline.close()
            assertFalse("close() releases owned resources only", rgba.empty())
            rgba.release()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun staleGenerationExceptionCannotClearNewerConfirmedGeometry() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        var processingMs = 2_002L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { processingMs })
        val currentGeneration = coordinator.newGeneration()
        val page = quad(50.0, 44.0, 430.0, 316.0)
        val detector = detector { input ->
            if (input.identity.generationId != currentGeneration) {
                throw IllegalStateException("late old-generation failure")
            }
            found(input, page)
        }
        val pipeline = DocumentBoundaryPipeline(coordinator, detector, clockMs = { processingMs })
        val rgba = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(90.0, 110.0, 130.0, 255.0))
        try {
            processingMs = 2_002L
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL,
                pipeline.process(frame(1L, currentGeneration, 2_000L, rgba)).status)
            processingMs = 2_102L
            val current = pipeline.process(frame(2L, currentGeneration, 2_100L, rgba))
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, current.status)
            val beforeLateError = coordinator.getPublishedState()

            processingMs = 2_202L
            val returned = pipeline.process(frame(3L, currentGeneration - 1L, 2_200L, rgba))
            assertEquals("Stale errors are rejected by generation", beforeLateError, returned)
            assertEquals(beforeLateError, coordinator.getPublishedState())
            assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(coordinator.getPublishedState(), nowMonotonicMs = 2_202L))
        } finally {
            pipeline.close()
            rgba.release()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun staleGenerationExceptionCannotPublishErrorIntoNewGeneration() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        var processingMs = 3_002L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { processingMs })
        val currentGeneration = coordinator.newGeneration()
        val detector = detector { throw IllegalStateException("stale frame failure") }
        val pipeline = DocumentBoundaryPipeline(coordinator, detector, clockMs = { processingMs })
        val rgba = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(24.0, 24.0, 24.0, 255.0))
        try {
            processingMs = 3_002L
            val state = pipeline.process(frame(1L, currentGeneration - 1L, 3_000L, rgba))
            assertEquals("A stale exception must not revive its old generation as ERROR",
                currentGeneration, state.generationId)
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.IDLE, state.status)
            assertEquals(state, coordinator.getPublishedState())
        } finally {
            pipeline.close()
            rgba.release()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun stillOnlyCropRemainsAvailableWhenLiveBoundaryIsError() {
        val stillQuad = app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral(
            app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1),
            app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.1),
            app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.9),
            app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.9),
        )
        val errorLive = LiveDetectionState.empty(9L).copy(status = LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR)
        val decision = DocumentCapturePolicy.decide(
            stillQuad = stillQuad,
            live = errorLive,
            jpeg = JpegGeometrySpec(1200, 1600),
            generationAtShutter = 9L,
            shutterTimestampMs = 4_000L,
        )
        assertEquals("An unavailable live result does not veto a valid still boundary",
            DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, decision)
    }

    private fun frame(id: Long, generationId: Long, timestampMs: Long, rgba: Mat) =
        DocumentBoundaryInput(
            identity = BoundaryFrameId(id, generationId, generationId),
            spec = spec,
            timing = DocumentFrameTiming(sensorTimestampNs = null,
                receivedTimestampNs = timestampMs * 1_000_000L),
            rgba = rgba,
        )

    private fun found(input: DocumentBoundaryInput, page: BoundaryQuad): DocumentBoundaryResult =
        DocumentBoundaryResult(
            identity = input.identity,
            detectorId = "fault-injection-test",
            configVersion = "test-v1",
            outcome = BoundaryOutcome.FOUND,
            candidates = listOf(DocumentHypothesis(
                candidateId = 1,
                quad = page,
                rawScore = 0.95,
                visibility = BoundaryVisibility.FULL,
                source = "fault-test",
            )),
            detectorStartedNs = input.timing.receivedTimestampNs,
            detectorFinishedNs = input.timing.receivedTimestampNs + 1L,
        )

    private fun detector(block: (DocumentBoundaryInput) -> DocumentBoundaryResult) =
        object : DocumentBoundaryDetector {
            override val detectorId = "fault-injection-test"
            override val configVersion = "test-v1"
            override fun detect(input: DocumentBoundaryInput): DocumentBoundaryResult = block.invoke(input)
            override fun close() = Unit
        }

    private fun texturedRgba(): Mat {
        val rgba = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(18.0, 18.0, 18.0, 255.0))
        val random = Random(442_901L)
        for (top in 48 until 315 step 15) {
            for (left in 58 until 430 step 16) {
                val shade = (45 + random.nextInt(205)).toDouble()
                Imgproc.rectangle(rgba, Rect(left, top, 6, 7), Scalar(shade, shade, shade, 255.0), Imgproc.FILLED)
            }
        }
        return rgba
    }

    private fun quad(left: Double, top: Double, right: Double, bottom: Double) = BoundaryQuad(
        BoundaryPoint(left, top), BoundaryPoint(right, top), BoundaryPoint(right, bottom), BoundaryPoint(left, bottom),
    )
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import java.io.File
import java.lang.reflect.Field
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService
import java.util.concurrent.AbstractExecutorService
import java.util.concurrent.FutureTask
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Exercises the real Activity destroy path while its serialized pipeline lazy initializer is in flight. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentBoundaryLifecycleInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun delayedStartupUiCallbackDoesNotSubmitDestinationWorkAfterDestroy() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val app = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val hadCameraPermission = context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.CAMERA) ==
            PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val suffix = System.nanoTime().toString()
        val databaseName = "dbq-startup-lifecycle-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "dbq-startup-lifecycle-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        val previousOverride = app.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val previousProvider = app.productStorageProviderForTest
        val providerEntered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val releaseProvider = CountDownLatch(1)
        val postDestroyIo = RecordingExecutorService()
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        var originalIo: ExecutorService? = null

        try {
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = null
            app.productStorageProviderForTest = {
                providerEntered.countDown()
                check(releaseProvider.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) { "Test did not release startup storage provider" }
                storage
            }
            if (hadCameraPermission) {
                instrumentation.uiAutomation.revokeRuntimePermission(context.packageName, Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
            }

            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            assertTrue("Startup reaches the controlled storage provider", providerEntered.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            val activeScenario = requireNotNull(scenario)
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                originalIo = reflectedField(activity, "io") as ExecutorService
                // The startup provider is holding the original executor's only task. Replace the
                // Activity's destination-work executor with a recorder before destroying it.
                ProductActivity::class.java.getDeclaredField("io").apply { isAccessible = true }
                    .set(activity, postDestroyIo)
            }

            activeScenario.close()
            scenario = null
            assertTrue("onDestroy shuts down the Activity-owned replacement executor", postDestroyIo.isShutdown)
            requireNotNull(originalIo).shutdown()
            releaseProvider.countDown()
            assertTrue("The held startup I/O task drains after provider release",
                requireNotNull(originalIo).awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()

            assertEquals("A destroyed Activity must not submit SAF grant work from delayed startup UI", 0,
                postDestroyIo.executeCount.get())
            assertTrue("Camera permission remains revoked; delayed startup did not launch the permission flow",
                context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.CAMERA) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        } finally {
            releaseProvider.countDown()
            runCatching { scenario?.close() }
            originalIo?.shutdownNow()
            app.productStorageProviderForTest = previousProvider
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousOverride
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            if (hadCameraPermission) {
                runCatching {
                    instrumentation.uiAutomation.grantRuntimePermission(context.packageName, Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun destroyQueuesPipelineCloseBehindAnInFlightLazyInitialization() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val hadCameraPermission = context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.CAMERA) ==
            PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val suffix = System.nanoTime().toString()
        val trace = File(context.cacheDir, "dbq-lifecycle-$suffix/trace.jsonl")
        val archiveDirectory = File(context.cacheDir, "dbq-lifecycle-$suffix/frames")
        val initializerEntered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val releaseInitializer = CountDownLatch(1)
        val pipelineRef = AtomicReference<DocumentBoundaryPipeline?>()
        val diagnosticsRef = AtomicReference<DocumentBoundaryDiagnostics?>()
        val archiveRef = AtomicReference<DocumentFrameArchive?>()
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        var executor: ExecutorService? = null
        var blockedDelegateRef: Lazy<DocumentBoundaryPipeline>? = null
        var initFuture: FutureTask<DocumentBoundaryPipeline>? = null
        var closeFuture: FutureTask<Unit>? = null

        try {
            if (hadCameraPermission) {
                instrumentation.uiAutomation.revokeRuntimePermission(context.packageName, Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
            }
            val launched = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            scenario = launched
            launched.onActivity { activity ->
                executor = reflectedField(activity, "cameraAnalysisExecutor") as ExecutorService
                val blockedDelegate = lazy {
                    initializerEntered.countDown()
                    check(releaseInitializer.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                        "Test did not release the blocked pipeline initializer"
                    }
                    val diagnostics = DocumentBoundaryDiagnostics(trace).also(diagnosticsRef::set)
                    val archive = DocumentFrameArchive(archiveDirectory).also(archiveRef::set)
                    DocumentBoundaryPipeline(
                        coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(),
                        detector = ClassicalDocumentBoundaryDetector(),
                        trackingEnabled = false,
                        diagnostics = diagnostics,
                        frameArchive = archive,
                    ).also(pipelineRef::set)
                }
                blockedDelegateRef = blockedDelegate
                // The test owns this Activity instance and replaces only its private lazy delegate.
                val delegateField = ProductActivity::class.java
                    .getDeclaredField("documentBoundaryPipelineDelegate").apply { isAccessible = true }
                delegateField.set(activity, blockedDelegate)
            }

            // Let ProductActivity's startup I/O callback enqueue and finish its destination-status
            // refresh before destroy shuts down the same executor. Otherwise the lifecycle test
            // can race an unrelated onCreate callback and crash before reaching cleanup assertions.
            instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
            awaitActivityStartup(launched)

            launched.onActivity {
                val blockedDelegate = requireNotNull(blockedDelegateRef)
                initFuture = FutureTask { blockedDelegate.value }
                requireNotNull(executor).execute(requireNotNull(initFuture))
            }

            assertTrue("Initializer should be blocked on cameraAnalysisExecutor",
                initializerEntered.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue("Delegate must remain uninitialized while initializer is blocked",
                scenarioDelegate(launched).isInitialized().not())

            // Run the real destroy path independently so the test can release the initializer
            // after onDestroy has made its cleanup decision and shut down the analysis executor.
            // ActivityScenario.close itself waits for lifecycle completion, so calling it inline
            // would prevent the test thread from releasing the latch.
            val closing = FutureTask { launched.close() }
            closeFuture = closing
            Thread(closing, "dbq-lifecycle-activity-close").start()
            val analysisExecutor = requireNotNull(executor)
            awaitShutdownDecision(analysisExecutor)
            releaseInitializer.countDown()
            closing.get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            scenario = null

            val pipeline = requireNotNull(initFuture).get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertNotNull(pipelineRef.get())
            assertTrue("Analysis executor should drain the queued cleanup after initialization",
                analysisExecutor.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))

            val diagnostics = requireNotNull(diagnosticsRef.get())
            val archive = requireNotNull(archiveRef.get())
            assertTrue("Diagnostics writer must terminate after pipeline close",
                writerOf(diagnostics).awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue("Frame archive writer must terminate after pipeline close",
                writerOf(archive).awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue("Diagnostics must emit its close/end marker", trace.isFile &&
                trace.readLines().any { it.contains("\"event\":\"end\"") })
            assertTrue("Archive must publish its final summary after close",
                File(archiveDirectory, "recording-summary.json").isFile)
            assertFalse("The test does not create a camera stream", archiveDirectory.listFiles()
                ?.any { it.extension == "jpg" } == true)
        } finally {
            releaseInitializer.countDown()
            closeFuture?.let { runCatching { it.get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) } }
            runCatching { scenario?.close() }
            initFuture?.let { runCatching { it.get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) } }
            pipelineRef.get()?.let { runCatching { it.close() } }
            diagnosticsRef.get()?.let { runCatching { it.close() } }
            archiveRef.get()?.let { runCatching { it.close() } }
            diagnosticsRef.get()?.let { runCatching { writerOf(it).awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) } }
            archiveRef.get()?.let { runCatching { writerOf(it).awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) } }
            executor?.let {
                it.shutdown()
                runCatching { it.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }
            }
            if (hadCameraPermission) {
                runCatching {
                    instrumentation.uiAutomation.grantRuntimePermission(context.packageName, Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
                }
            }
            trace.parentFile?.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun scenarioDelegate(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>): Lazy<*> {
        var delegate: Lazy<*>? = null
        scenario.onActivity { activity -> delegate = reflectedField(activity, "documentBoundaryPipelineDelegate") as Lazy<*> }
        return requireNotNull(delegate)
    }

    private fun reflectedField(instance: Any, name: String): Any? {
        val field: Field = instance.javaClass.getDeclaredField(name).apply { isAccessible = true }
        return field.get(instance)
    }

    private fun writerOf(owner: Any): ExecutorService = reflectedField(owner, "writer") as ExecutorService

    private class RecordingExecutorService : AbstractExecutorService() {
        val executeCount = AtomicInteger()
        @Volatile private var stopped = false

        override fun execute(command: Runnable) {
            executeCount.incrementAndGet()
            command.run()
        }

        override fun shutdown() { stopped = true }
        override fun shutdownNow(): MutableList<Runnable> { stopped = true; return mutableListOf() }
        override fun isShutdown(): Boolean = stopped
        override fun isTerminated(): Boolean = stopped
        override fun awaitTermination(timeout: Long, unit: TimeUnit): Boolean = stopped
    }

    private fun awaitShutdownDecision(executor: ExecutorService) {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(10)
        while (!executor.isShutdown && System.nanoTime() < deadline) Thread.sleep(10)
        assertTrue("Activity onDestroy should reach analysis executor shutdown", executor.isShutdown)
    }

    private fun awaitActivityStartup(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>) {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(10)
        var startupComplete = false
        while (!startupComplete && System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                startupComplete = reflectedField(activity, "destinationButton")
                    ?.let { (it as android.widget.Button).isEnabled } == true &&
                    !activity.isFinishing && !activity.isDestroyed
            }
            if (!startupComplete) Thread.sleep(20)
        }
        assertTrue("Activity startup destination status should finish before the lifecycle race", startupComplete)
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint

/** Geometry regression fixtures with known outer-paper corners; synthetic only, not quality evidence. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentBoundaryLocalizationInstrumentedTest {
    private data class Variant(val name: String, val enhanced: Boolean)
    private data class Fixture(
        val name: String,
        val width: Int,
        val height: Int,
        /** Explicit outer-paper TL, TR, BR, BL pixel-centre ground truth. */
        val outerPaper: List<Point>,
        val externalFrame: Boolean = false,
        val innerPrintedBorder: Boolean = false,
        val receipt: Boolean = false,
    )
    private data class Result(val outcome: BoundaryOutcome, val points: List<BoundaryPoint>?, val score: Double?, val details: String)

    private val variants = listOf(Variant("original", false), Variant("A", true))

    @Test
    fun whitePaperOnTexturedTableUsesTheKnownOuterPaperBoundary() {
        assertLocalizes(Fixture(
            name = "white-paper-on-table",
            width = 800,
            height = 600,
            outerPaper = q(800, 600, 176.0 to 91.0, 630.0 to 126.0, 587.0 to 510.0, 207.0 to 475.0),
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun strongPrintedInnerFrameDoesNotReplaceTheOuterPaperBoundary() {
        assertLocalizes(Fixture(
            name = "printed-inner-border",
            width = 800,
            height = 600,
            outerPaper = q(800, 600, 176.0 to 91.0, 630.0 to 126.0, 587.0 to 510.0, 207.0 to 475.0),
            innerPrintedBorder = true,
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun strongExternalTableFrameDoesNotReplaceTheOuterPaperBoundary() {
        assertLocalizes(Fixture(
            name = "external-table-frame",
            width = 800,
            height = 600,
            outerPaper = q(800, 600, 176.0 to 91.0, 630.0 to 126.0, 587.0 to 510.0, 207.0 to 475.0),
            externalFrame = true,
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun narrowReceiptUsesItsExternalLongEdges() {
        assertLocalizes(Fixture(
            name = "narrow-receipt",
            width = 640,
            height = 900,
            outerPaper = q(640, 900, 292.0 to 126.0, 352.0 to 122.0, 360.0 to 770.0, 282.0 to 778.0),
            receipt = true,
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun rotatedAndPerspectivePagesMatchTheSuppliedExternalCorners() {
        assertLocalizesAll(listOf(
            Fixture(
                name = "rotated-page-30deg",
                width = 800,
                height = 600,
                outerPaper = q(800, 600, 282.0 to 66.0, 690.0 to 302.0, 518.0 to 538.0, 110.0 to 302.0),
            ),
            Fixture(
                name = "perspective-page",
                width = 800,
                height = 600,
                outerPaper = q(800, 600, 183.0 to 63.0, 650.0 to 112.0, 610.0 to 533.0, 220.0 to 486.0),
            ),
        ))
    }

    @Test
    fun unsupportedSideAndClippedBorderDoNotBecomeInventedFullQuads() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (variant in variants) {
            val weakSide = createScene(Fixture(
                name = "one-unsupported-side",
                width = 800,
                height = 600,
                outerPaper = q(800, 600, 170.0 to 90.0, 630.0 to 126.0, 590.0 to 510.0, 205.0 to 475.0),
            ), unsupportedSide = 2)
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, weakSide, 100L)
                val row = "fixture=one-unsupported-side variant=${variant.name} outcome=${result.outcome} " +
                    "actualPixels=${result.points?.joinToString(";") { "${it.x},${it.y}" } ?: "null"} ${result.details}"
                android.util.Log.i("DocBoundaryLocalization", "LOCALIZATION_CASE $row")
                if (result.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.FOUND) failures += "$row; unsupported side must not publish FOUND"
            } finally { weakSide.release() }

            val clipped = createScene(Fixture(
                name = "clipped-left-boundary",
                width = 800,
                height = 600,
                outerPaper = q(800, 600, -24.0 to 84.0, 624.0 to 118.0, 585.0 to 514.0, -20.0 to 482.0),
            ))
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, clipped, 101L)
                val row = "fixture=clipped-left-boundary variant=${variant.name} outcome=${result.outcome} " +
                    "actualPixels=${result.points?.joinToString(";") { "${it.x},${it.y}" } ?: "null"} ${result.details}"
                android.util.Log.i("DocBoundaryLocalization", "LOCALIZATION_CASE $row")
                if (result.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.FOUND) failures += "$row; clipped boundary must not publish FOUND"
            } finally { clipped.release() }
        }
        assertTrue("Synthetic unsupported/clipped boundary cases failed:\n${failures.joinToString("\n")}", failures.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun uniformNegativeImageProducesNoCandidate() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        for (variant in variants) {
            val uniform = Mat(600, 800, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(112.0, 112.0, 112.0, 255.0))
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, uniform, 102L)
                assertFalse("Uniform background is not a page: $result", result.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.FOUND)
                assertTrue("Uniform background should not expose crop candidates: $result", result.points == null)
            } finally { uniform.release() }
        }
    }

    private fun assertLocalizes(fixture: Fixture) {
        assertLocalizesAll(listOf(fixture))
    }

    private fun assertLocalizesAll(fixtures: List<Fixture>) {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (fixture in fixtures) for (variant in variants) {
            val image = createScene(fixture)
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, image, 1L)
                val actual = result.points
                val expectedQuad = normalizedGroundTruth(fixture.outerPaper, fixture.width, fixture.height)
                val actualQuad = actual?.let { normalizedDetected(it, fixture.width, fixture.height) }
                val iou = actualQuad?.let { QuadGeometryUtils.polygonIoU(expectedQuad, it) }
                val cornerError = actual?.let {
                    normalizedMaxCyclicCornerError(fixture.outerPaper, it, fixture.width, fixture.height)
                }
                val expectedPixels = fixture.outerPaper.joinToString(";") { "${it.x},${it.y}" }
                val actualPixels = actual?.joinToString(";") { "${it.x},${it.y}" } ?: "null"
                val row = "fixture=${fixture.name} variant=${variant.name} outcome=${result.outcome} " +
                    "iou=${iou ?: "null"} maxCornerError=${cornerError ?: "null"} " +
                    "expectedPixels=$expectedPixels actualPixels=$actualPixels ${result.details}"
                android.util.Log.i("DocBoundaryLocalization", "LOCALIZATION_CASE $row")
                if (result.outcome != BoundaryOutcome.FOUND || actual == null || iou == null || cornerError == null) {
                    failures += "$row; expected FOUND"
                } else {
                    if (iou < 0.97) failures += "$row; IoU < 0.97"
                    if (cornerError > 0.01) failures += "$row; normalized max corner error > 0.01"
                }
            } finally {
                image.release()
            }
        }
        assertTrue("Synthetic outer-paper localization cases failed:\n${failures.joinToString("\n")}", failures.isEmpty())
    }

    private fun detect(variant: Variant, image: Mat, frameId: Long): Result {
        val input = DocumentBoundaryInput(
            identity = BoundaryFrameId(frameId, generationId = 1L, geometryId = 1L),
            spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(image.cols(), image.rows(), BufferRect(0, 0, image.cols(), image.rows()), 0),
            timing = DocumentFrameTiming(sensorTimestampNs = null, receivedTimestampNs = frameId * 1_000_000L),
            rgba = image,
        )
        val detector = ClassicalDocumentBoundaryDetector(enhanced = variant.enhanced)
        try {
            val result = detector.detect(input)
            val candidate = result.candidates.firstOrNull()
            return Result(result.outcome, candidate?.quad?.points, candidate?.rawScore,
                "detector=${result.detectorId} reason=${result.reason} candidates=" +
                    result.candidates.joinToString { "score=${it.rawScore} raw=${it.rawQuad.points} refined=${it.quad.points}" })
        } finally {
            detector.close()
        }
    }

    private fun createScene(fixture: Fixture, unsupportedSide: Int? = null): Mat {
        val image = Mat(fixture.height, fixture.width, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(66.0, 79.0, 91.0, 255.0))
        // Textured tabletop: parallel grain lines deliberately create non-document edges.
        for (x in 0 until fixture.width step 37) {
            Imgproc.line(image, Point(x.toDouble(), 0.0), Point((x + 150).toDouble(), fixture.height.toDouble()),
                Scalar(102.0, 111.0, 116.0, 255.0), 2)
        }
        if (fixture.externalFrame) {
            Imgproc.rectangle(image, org.opencv.core.Rect(94, 48, 612, 510),
                Scalar(18.0, 20.0, 22.0, 255.0), 11)
        }

        val paperColor = Scalar(247.0, 245.0, 238.0, 255.0)
        if (unsupportedSide != null) {
            // Remove the paper/table transition just outside one GT side. Ground-truth corners
            // remain unchanged but that side is no longer supported by pixels.
            val side = fixture.outerPaper[unsupportedSide]
            val next = fixture.outerPaper[(unsupportedSide + 1) % 4]
            val center = Point(fixture.outerPaper.sumOf { it.x } / 4.0, fixture.outerPaper.sumOf { it.y } / 4.0)
            val mid = Point((side.x + next.x) / 2.0, (side.y + next.y) / 2.0)
            val dx = mid.x - center.x
            val dy = mid.y - center.y
            val length = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(1.0)
            val ux = dx / length
            val uy = dy / length
            fillPoly(image, fixture.outerPaper, paperColor)
            // Continue the page-colored region all the way to the image boundary. This erases
            // the selected side without creating a parallel, fully observable replacement edge.
            val extent = hypot(fixture.width.toDouble(), fixture.height.toDouble()) * 2.0
            val band = listOf(side, next,
                Point(next.x + ux * extent, next.y + uy * extent),
                Point(side.x + ux * extent, side.y + uy * extent))
            fillPoly(image, band, paperColor)
        } else {
            fillPoly(image, fixture.outerPaper, paperColor)
        }

        drawInteriorPrint(image, fixture.outerPaper)
        if (fixture.innerPrintedBorder) {
            val center = Point(fixture.outerPaper.sumOf { it.x } / 4.0, fixture.outerPaper.sumOf { it.y } / 4.0)
            val inner = fixture.outerPaper.map { Point(center.x + (it.x - center.x) * 0.82,
                center.y + (it.y - center.y) * 0.82) }
            val outline = MatOfPoint(*inner.toTypedArray())
            try { Imgproc.polylines(image, listOf(outline), true, Scalar(18.0, 18.0, 18.0, 255.0), 9) }
            finally { outline.release() }
        }
        if (fixture.receipt) {
            // Receipt print is dense but remains inside the known narrow sheet.
            for (i in 0 until 18) {
                val y = 170 + i * 28
                Imgproc.line(image, Point(300.0, y.toDouble()), Point((332 + (i % 3) * 5).toDouble(), y.toDouble()),
                    Scalar(45.0, 45.0, 45.0, 255.0), 2)
            }
        }
        return image
    }

    private fun drawInteriorPrint(image: Mat, quad: List<Point>) {
        val ink = Scalar(208.0, 205.0, 196.0, 255.0)
        for (row in 1..8) {
            val t = 0.12 + row * 0.085
            val left = interpolate(quad[0], quad[3], t)
            val right = interpolate(quad[1], quad[2], t)
            val start = interpolate(left, right, 0.12)
            val end = interpolate(left, right, if (row % 3 == 0) 0.70 else 0.88)
            Imgproc.line(image, start, end, ink, 2)
        }
    }

    private fun interpolate(a: Point, b: Point, t: Double) = Point(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t)

    private fun fillPoly(image: Mat, points: List<Point>, color: Scalar) {
        val polygon = MatOfPoint(*points.toTypedArray())
        try { Imgproc.fillConvexPoly(image, polygon, color) }
        finally { polygon.release() }
    }

    private fun normalizedGroundTruth(points: List<Point>, width: Int, height: Int) = CropQuadrilateral(
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[0].x / (width - 1), points[0].y / (height - 1)),
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[1].x / (width - 1), points[1].y / (height - 1)),
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[2].x / (width - 1), points[2].y / (height - 1)),
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[3].x / (width - 1), points[3].y / (height - 1)),
    )

    private fun normalizedDetected(points: List<BoundaryPoint>, width: Int, height: Int) = CropQuadrilateral(
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[0].x / (width - 1), points[0].y / (height - 1)),
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[1].x / (width - 1), points[1].y / (height - 1)),
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[2].x / (width - 1), points[2].y / (height - 1)),
        NormalizedCropPoint(points[3].x / (width - 1), points[3].y / (height - 1)),
    )

    private fun normalizedMaxCyclicCornerError(expected: List<Point>, actual: List<BoundaryPoint>,
                                                width: Int, height: Int): Double {
        val diagonal = maxOf(
            hypot(expected[0].x - expected[2].x, expected[0].y - expected[2].y),
            hypot(expected[1].x - expected[3].x, expected[1].y - expected[3].y),
        )
        return (0 until 4).minOf { shift ->
            (0 until 4).maxOf { i ->
                val a = expected[i]
                val b = actual[(i + shift) % 4]
                hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) / diagonal
            }
        }
    }

    private fun q(width: Int, height: Int, vararg xy: Pair<Double, Double>): List<Point> {
        require(width > 0 && height > 0 && xy.size == 4)
        return xy.map { Point(it.first, it.second) }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Paint

import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull

import org.opencv.core.Core

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentBoundaryNativeInstrumentedTest {
    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(480, 360, BufferRect(0, 0, 480, 360), 0)

    @Test
    fun supportedEdgesRefineWithinBoundAndBlankImageRollsBackExactly() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val gray = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC1, Scalar(28.0))
        val blank = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC1, Scalar(28.0))
        val original = quad(84.0, 74.0, 396.0, 286.0)
        try {
            Imgproc.rectangle(gray, Rect(80, 70, 321, 221), Scalar(242.0), Imgproc.FILLED)
            val refined = DocumentBoundaryRefiner.refine(gray, original, radius = 8)
            assertEquals(BoundaryRefinement.REFINED, refined.status)
            assertTrue(refined.edges.all { (it.coverage ?: 0.0) >= 0.60 })
            assertTrue(refined.edges.all { (it.occupiedBins ?: 0) >= 6 && it.residualPx != null })
            refined.quad.points.zip(quad(80.0, 70.0, 400.0, 290.0).points).forEach { (actual, expected) ->
                assertTrue("Refined edge should follow supported pixels: actual=$actual expected=$expected",
                    hypot(actual.x - expected.x, actual.y - expected.y) <= 2.5)
            }

            val rollback = DocumentBoundaryRefiner.refine(blank, original, radius = 8)
            assertEquals(BoundaryRefinement.ORIGINAL, rollback.status)
            assertEquals("Without enough edge support, return the exact coarse quad", original, rollback.quad)
        } finally {
            blank.release()
            gray.release()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun opticalFlowAcceptsTexturedTranslationAndDropsBlankLowCoverageOrStaleFrames() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val source = texturedPage()
        val translated = Mat()
        val affine = Mat(2, 3, CvType.CV_64F)
        val tracker = DocumentBoundaryTracker()
        val q = quad(50.0, 40.0, 430.0, 320.0)
        try {
            affine.put(0, 0, 1.0, 0.0, 5.0, 0.0, 1.0, 4.0)
            Imgproc.warpAffine(source, translated, affine, source.size(), Imgproc.INTER_LINEAR,
                Core.BORDER_CONSTANT, Scalar(18.0))
            tracker.seed(source, q, spec, 1_000L)
            val tracked = tracker.track(translated, spec, 1_050L)
            assertNotNull("Feature-supported translation should produce a track", tracked)
            val result = requireNotNull(tracked)
            assertTrue("Enough LK inliers are required", result.inliers >= 12)
            assertTrue("Features must cover a meaningful portion of the page", result.coverage >= 0.15)
            result.quad.points.zip(q.points).forEach { (actual, expected) ->
                assertTrue("Tracked x should include the synthetic translation", abs(actual.x - expected.x - 5.0) <= 1.5)
                assertTrue("Tracked y should include the synthetic translation", abs(actual.y - expected.y - 4.0) <= 1.5)
            }

            tracker.seed(source, q, spec, 2_000L)
            val blank = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC1, Scalar(18.0))
            try {
                assertEquals("Blank frames provide no stable feature field", null, tracker.track(blank, spec, 2_050L))
            } finally { blank.release() }

            tracker.seed(source, q, spec, 3_000L)
            assertEquals("A gap outside the 199ms tracking budget drops the old frame", null,
                tracker.track(translated, spec, 3_200L))

            val featureless = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC1, Scalar(18.0))
            try {
                tracker.seed(featureless, q, spec, 4_000L)
                assertEquals("Seed rejects insufficient feature coverage", null, tracker.track(source, spec, 4_020L))
            } finally { featureless.release() }
        } finally {
            tracker.close()
            affine.release()
            translated.release()
            source.release()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun firstConfirmedCandidateSeedsFlowAndProvisionalReplacementCannotSwitchToAnotherPage() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        var processingMs = 1_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { processingMs })
        val pageA = quad(34.0, 28.0, 220.0, 330.0)
        val pageB = quad(260.0, 28.0, 450.0, 330.0)
        var nextCandidate = pageA
        val detector = object : DocumentBoundaryDetector {
            override val detectorId = "seed-switch-regression"
            override val configVersion = "test-v1"
            override fun detect(input: DocumentBoundaryInput): DocumentBoundaryResult {
                val hypothesis = DocumentHypothesis(
                    candidateId = 1,
                    quad = nextCandidate,
                    rawScore = 0.95,
                    visibility = BoundaryVisibility.FULL,
                    source = detectorId,
                )
                return DocumentBoundaryResult(
                    identity = input.identity,
                    detectorId = detectorId,
                    configVersion = configVersion,
                    outcome = BoundaryOutcome.FOUND,
                    candidates = listOf(hypothesis),
                    detectorStartedNs = input.timing.receivedTimestampNs,
                    detectorFinishedNs = input.timing.receivedTimestampNs + 1L,
                )
            }
            override fun close() = Unit
        }
        val pipeline = DocumentBoundaryPipeline(coordinator, detector, trackingEnabled = true,
            clockMs = { processingMs })
        val rgba = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(18.0, 18.0, 18.0, 255.0))
        val random = Random(782_151L)
        for (top in 42 until 315 step 15) for (left in 42 until 440 step 15) {
            val shade = (45 + random.nextInt(205)).toDouble()
            Imgproc.rectangle(rgba, Rect(left, top, 6, 7), Scalar(shade, shade, shade, 255.0), Imgproc.FILLED)
        }
        fun frame(id: Long, timestampMs: Long): DocumentBoundaryInput = DocumentBoundaryInput(
            identity = BoundaryFrameId(id, generationId = 1L, geometryId = 1L),
            spec = spec,
            timing = DocumentFrameTiming(sensorTimestampNs = null, receivedTimestampNs = timestampMs * 1_000_000L),
            rgba = rgba,
        )
        fun assertNearPageA(state: LiveDetectionState, label: String) {
            val points = requireNotNull(state.quadInBufferPixels)
            val a = pageA.toFloatArray()
            val b = pageB.toFloatArray()
            val errorA = points.indices.sumOf { abs(points[it] - (a[it] + 0.5f)).toDouble() } / points.size
            val errorB = points.indices.sumOf { abs(points[it] - (b[it] + 0.5f)).toDouble() } / points.size
            assertTrue("$label must retain confirmed page A (errorA=$errorA errorB=$errorB)", errorA < 8.0 && errorB > 80.0)
        }
        try {
            processingMs = 1_002L
            val first = pipeline.process(frame(1L, 1_000L))
            assertEquals("Flow cannot confirm its first detector observation", LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, first.status)

            processingMs = 1_102L
            val confirmedA = pipeline.process(frame(2L, 1_100L))
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmedA.status)
            assertNearPageA(confirmedA, "Confirmed detector result")

            nextCandidate = pageB
            processingMs = 1_202L
            val provisionalB = pipeline.process(frame(3L, 1_200L))
            assertEquals("A disagreeing first B observation is held behind A", LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, provisionalB.status)
            assertNearPageA(provisionalB, "Provisional B result")

            processingMs = 1_252L
            val flowOnly = pipeline.process(frame(4L, 1_250L))
            assertEquals("The next flow-only frame cannot switch to provisional B", LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, flowOnly.status)
            assertNearPageA(flowOnly, "Flow-only result")
        } finally {
            pipeline.close()
            rgba.release()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun stillRefinementUsesExifOrientedCoordinatesAndLeavesOriginalJpegUntouched() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val file = File(context.cacheDir, "dbq-still-exif-${System.nanoTime()}.jpg")
        val raw = Bitmap.createBitmap(600, 400, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        try {
            Canvas(raw).apply {
                drawColor(Color.rgb(30, 35, 40))
                drawRect(50f, 40f, 550f, 360f, Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.WHITE })
            }
            file.outputStream().use { output -> assertTrue(raw.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 98, output)) }
            ExifInterface(file).apply {
                setAttribute(ExifInterface.TAG_ORIENTATION, ExifInterface.ORIENTATION_ROTATE_90.toString())
                saveAttributes()
            }
            val sourceBytes = file.readBytes()
            val oriented = ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(file, 2L * 1024 * 1024, maxSide = 1600)
            try {
                assertEquals("EXIF 90 rotates width into height", 400, oriented.width)
                assertEquals("EXIF 90 rotates height into width", 600, oriented.height)
            } finally { oriented.recycle() }

            val coarse = CropQuadrilateral(
                NormalizedCropPoint(40.0 / 399.0, 50.0 / 599.0),
                NormalizedCropPoint(360.0 / 399.0, 50.0 / 599.0),
                NormalizedCropPoint(360.0 / 399.0, 550.0 / 599.0),
                NormalizedCropPoint(40.0 / 399.0, 550.0 / 599.0),
            )
            val refined = StillBoundaryProcessor.refine(file, coarse)
            assertEquals("Still processing must not rewrite the captured JPEG", sourceBytes.toList(), file.readBytes().toList())
            refined.asList().zip(coarse.asList()).forEach { (actual, expected) ->
                assertTrue("EXIF-oriented still quad remains in the expected portrait space",
                    abs(actual.x - expected.x) <= 0.025 && abs(actual.y - expected.y) <= 0.025)
            }
            assertEquals(32L * 1024 * 1024, StillBoundaryProcessor.WORKING_SET_BYTES)
        } finally {
            raw.recycle()
            file.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun texturedPage(): Mat {
        val image = Mat(360, 480, CvType.CV_8UC1, Scalar(18.0))
        val random = Random(713_031L)
        for (top in 52 until 310 step 16) {
            for (left in 62 until 420 step 17) {
                val color = (45 + random.nextInt(205)).toDouble()
                val width = 5 + random.nextInt(7)
                val height = 5 + random.nextInt(7)
                Imgproc.rectangle(image, Rect(left, top, width, height), Scalar(color), Imgproc.FILLED)
            }
        }
        return image
    }

    private fun quad(left: Double, top: Double, right: Double, bottom: Double) = BoundaryQuad(
        BoundaryPoint(left, top), BoundaryPoint(right, top), BoundaryPoint(right, bottom), BoundaryPoint(left, bottom),
    )
}

    @Test
    fun frameArchiveOwnsItsCopyBoundsImageSizeAndLabelsDataAsDebugAnalysis() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val directory = File(context.cacheDir, "dbq-frame-archive-${System.nanoTime()}")
        val source = Mat(800, 1200, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(10.0, 40.0, 200.0, 255.0))
        val archive = DocumentFrameArchive(directory)
        try {
            archive.record(input(7L, source, 1200, 800))
            // record() must finish copying/resizing before borrowing returns to CameraX.
            source.setTo(Scalar(0.0, 255.0, 0.0, 255.0))
        } finally {
            source.release()
            archive.close()
        }

        val summaryFile = awaitFile(File(directory, "recording-summary.json"))
        val summary = JSONObject(summaryFile.readText())
        assertEquals(1, summary.getInt("acceptedFrames"))
        assertEquals(450, summary.getInt("limitFrames"))
        assertEquals("DEBUG_ANALYSIS", summary.getString("source"))
        assertFalse(summary.getBoolean("presentationTimeAvailable"))

        val metadata = JSONObject(File(directory, "frame-7.json").readText())
        assertEquals(1200, metadata.getInt("originalWidth"))
        assertEquals(800, metadata.getInt("originalHeight"))
        assertEquals(9, metadata.getJSONArray("originalCentresToImageCentres").length())

        val image = Imgcodecs.imread(File(directory, "frame-7.jpg").absolutePath)
        try {
            assertEquals(720, image.cols())
            assertEquals(480, image.rows())
            val bgr = image.get(240, 360)
            assertNotNull(bgr)
            assertTrue("Archive should preserve the pre-mutation blue channel", bgr[0] > 180.0)
            assertTrue("Archive should not contain the post-record green mutation", bgr[1] < 80.0)

    @Test
    fun frameArchiveEnforces450FrameCapAndRejectsCallsAfterClose() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val directory = File(context.cacheDir, "dbq-frame-cap-${System.nanoTime()}")
        val source = Mat(24, 32, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(40.0, 80.0, 160.0, 255.0))
        val archive = DocumentFrameArchive(directory)
        for (frame in 0L..451L) archive.record(input(frame, source, 32, 24))
        archive.close()
        archive.record(input(999L, source, 32, 24))
        source.release()

        val summary = JSONObject(awaitFile(File(directory, "recording-summary.json")).readText())
        assertTrue("Accepted frame count cannot exceed the hard cap", summary.getInt("acceptedFrames") in 0..450)
        val writtenImages = directory.listFiles { file -> file.extension == "jpg" }?.size ?: 0
        assertTrue("No more than the configured frame cap may reach disk", writtenImages <= 450)
        assertEquals(summary.getInt("acceptedFrames"), writtenImages)
    }

    @Test
    fun diagnosticsCopiesBorrowedGeometryAndCloseDrainsBoundedEventWriter() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val directory = File(context.cacheDir, "dbq-diagnostics-${System.nanoTime()}")
        val output = File(directory, "trace.jsonl")
        val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(32, 24, BufferRect(0, 0, 32, 24), 0)
        val borrowedPoints = floatArrayOf(2f, 3f, 29f, 3f, 29f, 20f, 2f, 20f)
        val inputMat = Mat()
        val diagnostics = DocumentBoundaryDiagnostics(output)
        try {
            val input = DocumentBoundaryInput(
                BoundaryFrameId(41L, 8L, 3L), spec,
                DocumentFrameTiming(
                    sensorTimestampNs = null,
                    receivedTimestampNs = 41_000_000L,
                    preparedTimestampNs = 41_000_010L,
                ), inputMat,
            )
            val result = DocumentBoundaryResult(
                identity = input.identity,
                detectorId = "recorder-test",
                configVersion = "v1",
                outcome = BoundaryOutcome.FOUND,
                candidates = emptyList(),
                detectorStartedNs = 41_000_011L,
                detectorFinishedNs = 41_000_012L,
            )
            val state = LiveDetectionState(
                generationId = 8L,
                status = LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED,
                analysisSpec = spec,
                quadInBufferPixels = borrowedPoints,
                quadInNormalizedViewPort = null,
                rawScore = 0.9,
                frameTimestampMonotonicMs = 41L,
                processedTimestampMonotonicMs = 42L,
                publicationId = 9L,
                visualDeadlineMonotonicMs = 241L,
                lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs = 41L,
            )
            diagnostics.record(input, result, state)
            borrowedPoints[0] = 999f
        } finally {
            inputMat.release()
            diagnostics.close()
        }

        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 15_000L
        var lines: List<String> = emptyList()
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (output.isFile) {
                lines = output.readLines()
                if (lines.any { it.contains("\"event\":\"end\"") }) break
            }
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(25L)
        }
        assertTrue("close() must drain accepted snapshots and write its end marker", lines.size >= 3)
        val start = JSONObject(lines.first())
        val event = JSONObject(lines.first { it.contains("\"event\":\"result\"") })
        val end = JSONObject(lines.last())
        assertEquals("start", start.getString("event"))
        assertEquals(41L, event.getLong("frameId"))
        assertEquals(8L, event.getLong("generationId"))
        assertEquals(41_000_010L, event.getLong("preparedNs"))
        assertEquals(2.0, event.getJSONArray("displayBufferQuad").getDouble(0), 0.0)
        assertTrue("Unknown presentation timing remains explicit", start.isNull("presentTimestampNs"))
        assertFalse("Trace never includes image pixels", event.has("pixels"))
        assertEquals("end", end.getString("event"))
        assertFalse(end.getBoolean("writeFailed"))
        assertFalse("Diagnostics creates only its structured trace", directory.listFiles().orEmpty()
            .any { it.extension == "jpg" || it.name.startsWith("frame-") })
    }

    @Test
    fun uiApplyAndDrawMarkersKeepMainEventTimesOrderAndOwnedScreenGeometry() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val directory = File(context.cacheDir, "dbq-ui-markers-${System.nanoTime()}")
        val output = File(directory, "trace.jsonl")
        val diagnostics = DocumentBoundaryDiagnostics(output)
        val applyPoints = floatArrayOf(10f, 11f, 91f, 12f, 89f, 90f, 9f, 88f)
        val drawPoints = floatArrayOf(12f, 13f, 92f, 14f, 90f, 91f, 11f, 89f)
        var applyTimestampNs = 0L
        var drawTimestampNs = 0L
        try {
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
                assertEquals(Looper.getMainLooper(), Looper.myLooper())
                applyTimestampNs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                diagnostics.recordMarker("UI_APPLY", 55L, 12L, applyTimestampNs, applyPoints)
            }
            applyPoints[0] = 999f

            instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
                assertEquals(Looper.getMainLooper(), Looper.myLooper())
                drawTimestampNs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                diagnostics.recordMarker("DRAW", 55L, 12L, drawTimestampNs, drawPoints)
            }
            drawPoints[0] = 999f
        } finally {
            diagnostics.close()
        }

        val lines = awaitTraceEnd(output)
        val events = lines.map(::JSONObject)
        val markers = events.filter { it.optString("event") in setOf("UI_APPLY", "DRAW") }
        assertEquals(listOf("UI_APPLY", "DRAW"), markers.map { it.getString("event") })
        assertEquals(listOf(55L, 55L), markers.map { it.getLong("publicationId") })
        assertEquals(listOf(12L, 12L), markers.map { it.getLong("generationId") })
        assertEquals(applyTimestampNs, markers[0].getLong("timestampNs"))
        assertEquals(drawTimestampNs, markers[1].getLong("timestampNs"))
        assertTrue("The queued draw marker follows the UI apply event", drawTimestampNs >= applyTimestampNs)
        assertEquals(10.0, markers[0].getJSONArray("screenQuad").getDouble(0), 0.0)
        assertEquals(12.0, markers[1].getJSONArray("screenQuad").getDouble(0), 0.0)
        assertTrue(markers.all { it.isNull("presentTimestampNs") })
        assertFalse("A UI draw marker is not a display presentation event",
            events.any { it.optString("event") == "PRESENT" })
    }

    @Test
    fun traceAndFrameArchiveAreDisabledByDefaultAndRequireExplicitDebugIntent() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        assertTrue("This debug instrumentation target must be debuggable",
            context.applicationInfo.flags and android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_DEBUGGABLE != 0)

        ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val pipeline = forcePipeline(activity)
                assertNull(field(pipeline, "frameArchive"))
                assertNull(field(pipeline, "diagnostics"))
                assertFalse(field(pipeline, "trackingEnabled") as Boolean)
                val detector = requireNotNull(field(pipeline, "detector"))
                assertFalse(field(detector, "enhanced") as Boolean)
            }
        }

        val intent = Intent(context, ProductActivity::class.java)
            .putExtra("docscan.dbq.backend", "A")
            .putExtra("docscan.dbq.tracker", true)
            .putExtra("docscan.dbq.frames", true)
            .putExtra("docscan.dbq.trace", true)
        ActivityScenario.launch<ProductActivity>(intent).use { scenario ->
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val pipeline = forcePipeline(activity)
                assertNotNull(field(pipeline, "frameArchive"))
                assertNotNull(field(pipeline, "diagnostics"))
                assertTrue(field(pipeline, "trackingEnabled") as Boolean)
                val detector = requireNotNull(field(pipeline, "detector"))
                assertTrue(field(detector, "enhanced") as Boolean)
            }
        }
