    private fun input(frameId: Long, rgba: Mat, width: Int, height: Int) = DocumentBoundaryInput(
        identity = BoundaryFrameId(frameId, generationId = 1L, geometryId = 1L),
        spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(width, height, BufferRect(0, 0, width, height), 0),
        timing = DocumentFrameTiming(sensorTimestampNs = null, receivedTimestampNs = frameId + 1L),
        rgba = rgba,
    )

    private fun awaitFile(file: File): File {
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 15_000L
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (file.isFile) return file
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(25L)
        }
        throw AssertionError("Timed out waiting for recorder output ${file.name}")
    }

    private fun awaitTraceEnd(file: File): List<String> {
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 15_000L
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (file.isFile) {
                val lines = file.readLines()
                if (lines.any { it.contains("\"event\":\"end\"") }) return lines
            }
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(25L)
        }
        throw AssertionError("Timed out waiting for diagnostics writer to close ${file.name}")
    }

    private fun forcePipeline(activity: ProductActivity): DocumentBoundaryPipeline {
        val delegate = ProductActivity::class.java.getDeclaredField("documentBoundaryPipelineDelegate")
            .apply { isAccessible = true }.get(activity) as Lazy<*>
        return requireNotNull(delegate.value) as DocumentBoundaryPipeline
    }

    private fun field(instance: Any, name: String): Any? = instance.javaClass.getDeclaredField(name)
        .apply { isAccessible = true }.get(instance)
}

package app.docscan.android

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.opencv.android.OpenCVLoader
import org.opencv.core.CvType
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.core.Point
import org.opencv.core.Scalar
import org.opencv.imgcodecs.Imgcodecs
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import java.io.File
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentBoundaryReplayInstrumentedTest {

    @Test
    fun realCorpusReplayOrExplicitNotRunSkip() {
        assertTrue("OpenCV Android native library must load", OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val app = instrumentation.targetContext
        val pathArgument = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("dbq.replay.manifest")
        val manifestFile = if (pathArgument.isNullOrBlank()) {
            File(app.filesDir, "dbq-replay/manifest.json")
        } else File(pathArgument)
        val replay = DocumentBoundaryReplaySupport(app, instrumentation.context)
        if (!manifestFile.isFile) {
            replay.writeNotRunReport("CORPUS_MANIFEST_MISSING", manifestFile)
            assumeTrue("No real replay corpus; expected ${manifestFile.canonicalPath}", false)
        }

        val manifest = replay.parseManifest(manifestFile)
        val missingModels = replay.missingModelAssets(manifest.variants)
        if (missingModels.isNotEmpty()) {
            replay.writeNotRunReport("OPTIONAL_MODEL_ASSETS_MISSING:$missingModels", manifestFile)
            assumeTrue("Optional model assets missing; replay not run: $missingModels", false)
        }

        val sourceBytes = manifestFile.readBytes()
        val sourceSha = sha256(sourceBytes)
        val output = replay.run(manifestFile, manifest)
        assertEquals("one output JSONL row for every variant/frame", manifest.variants.size * manifest.clips.sumOf { it.frames.size }, output.rowCount)
        assertEquals(sourceSha, output.sourceManifestSha256)
        assertTrue("summary must live in app-private output", output.directory.canonicalPath.startsWith(
            File(app.filesDir, "dbq-replay-results").canonicalPath + File.separator,
        ))
        assertTrue(sourceBytes.contentEquals(manifestFile.readBytes()))
        assertManifestOrderAndIdentity(output.directory, manifest, sourceSha)
    }

    @Test
    fun syntheticFiveFrameReplayWritesAlignedRowsWithoutGeometryThresholds() {
        assertTrue("OpenCV Android native library must load", OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val app = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val inputDir = File(app.cacheDir, "dbq-replay-synthetic-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
        assertTrue(inputDir.mkdirs())
        val frameJson = JSONArray()
        val frameIds = listOf(101L, 102L, 103L, 104L, 105L)
        val timestamps = listOf(0L, 110L, 220L, 330L, 440L)
        val sourceHashes = ArrayList<String>()

        for (index in frameIds.indices) {
            val name = "synthetic-${index + 1}.png"
            val path = File(inputDir, name)
            writeSyntheticFrame(path, index)
            sourceHashes += sha256(path.readBytes())
            frameJson.put(JSONObject()
                .put("frameId", frameIds[index])
                .put("timestampMs", timestamps[index])
                .put("file", name)
                .put("rotationDegrees", 0)
                .put("eligible", true))
        }
        val manifest = JSONObject()
            .put("schemaVersion", 1)
            .put("variants", JSONArray()
                .put(JSONObject().put("id", "original").put("backend", "original").put("tracking", false))
                .put(JSONObject().put("id", "A_tracking").put("backend", "A").put("tracking", true)))
            .put("clips", JSONArray().put(JSONObject()
                .put("clipId", "synthetic-five-frame")
                .put("group", "SYNTHETIC")
                .put("frames", frameJson)))
        val manifestFile = File(inputDir, "manifest.json").apply { writeText(manifest.toString(2)) }
        val manifestShaBefore = sha256(manifestFile.readBytes())
        val originalFramesBefore = frameIds.indices.map { sha256(File(inputDir, "synthetic-${it + 1}.png").readBytes()) }
        val parsed = DocumentBoundaryReplaySupport(app).parseManifest(manifestFile)
        val output = DocumentBoundaryReplaySupport(app).run(manifestFile, parsed)

        assertEquals(10, output.rowCount)
        assertEquals(manifestShaBefore, output.sourceManifestSha256)
        assertEquals(manifestShaBefore, sha256(manifestFile.readBytes()))
        assertEquals(sourceHashes, originalFramesBefore)
        assertEquals(sourceHashes, frameIds.indices.map { sha256(File(inputDir, "synthetic-${it + 1}.png").readBytes()) })
        assertManifestOrderAndIdentity(output.directory, parsed, manifestShaBefore)

        val summary = JSONObject(File(output.directory, "run.json").readText())
        assertEquals("COMPLETED", summary.getString("status"))
        assertEquals("VIRTUAL_REPLAY_MS", summary.getString("clockDomain"))
        assertFalse(summary.getBoolean("captureOrPresentTimestampsAvailable"))
        assertTrue(summary.getJSONObject("apk").getString("versionName").isNotBlank())
        assertEquals(2, summary.getJSONArray("variants").length())
    }

    @Test
    fun manifestRejectsNonIncreasingFrameIdentityOrTimestamp() {
        assertTrue("OpenCV Android native library must load", OpenCVLoader.initLocal())
        val app = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val inputDir = File(app.cacheDir, "dbq-replay-invalid-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
        assertTrue(inputDir.mkdirs())
        val frame = File(inputDir, "frame.png")
        writeSyntheticFrame(frame, 0)
        val replay = DocumentBoundaryReplaySupport(app)
        val invalidSequences = listOf(
            "duplicate-frame-id" to listOf(frameRecord(2, 10, frame.name), frameRecord(2, 20, frame.name)),
            "duplicate-timestamp" to listOf(frameRecord(2, 10, frame.name), frameRecord(3, 10, frame.name)),
        )
        for ((clipId, frames) in invalidSequences) {
            val manifest = JSONObject()
                .put("schemaVersion", 1)
                .put("variants", JSONArray().put(JSONObject()
                    .put("id", "original").put("backend", "original").put("tracking", false)))
                .put("clips", JSONArray().put(JSONObject()
                    .put("clipId", clipId).put("group", "SYNTHETIC")
                    .put("frames", JSONArray().put(frames[0]).put(frames[1]))))
            val manifestFile = File(inputDir, "$clipId.json").apply { writeText(manifest.toString()) }
            val failure = runCatching { replay.parseManifest(manifestFile) }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue("$clipId must fail validation", failure is IllegalArgumentException)
        }
    }

    private fun assertManifestOrderAndIdentity(outputDir: File, manifest: ReplayManifest, manifestSha: String) {
        for (variant in manifest.variants) {
            for (clip in manifest.clips) {
                val file = File(outputDir, "${safeName(variant.id)}--${safeName(clip.clipId)}.jsonl")
                assertTrue("missing variant/clip output: $file", file.isFile)
                val rows = file.readLines().filter { it.isNotBlank() }.map { JSONObject(it) }
                assertEquals(clip.frames.size, rows.size)
                assertEquals(clip.frames.map { it.frameId }, rows.map { it.getLong("frameId") })
                assertEquals(clip.frames.map { it.timestampMs }, rows.map { it.getLong("virtualReceiptMs") })
                rows.forEachIndexed { index, row ->
                    assertEquals(manifestSha, row.getString("sourceManifestSha256"))
                    assertEquals(variant.id, row.getString("variantId"))
                    assertEquals(clip.clipId, row.getString("clipId"))
                    assertEquals(clip.frames[index].eligible, row.getBoolean("eligible"))
                    assertTrue(row.has("inferenceScheduled"))
                    assertTrue(row.has("status"))
                    if (row.getBoolean("inferenceScheduled")) {
                        assertTrue("real detector runtime must be positive", row.getLong("detectorRuntimeNs") > 0L)
                        assertTrue(row.has("rawCandidates") && row.has("refinedCandidates"))
                    } else {
                        assertFalse("unscheduled frame must not invent runtime", row.has("detectorRuntimeNs"))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun writeSyntheticFrame(path: File, index: Int) {
        val image = Mat(240, 320, CvType.CV_8UC3, Scalar(92.0, 92.0, 92.0))
        val paper = org.opencv.core.MatOfPoint(
            Point(30.0 + index, 25.0), Point(286.0 + index, 32.0),
            Point(278.0 + index, 215.0), Point(35.0 + index, 208.0),
        )
        try {
            Imgproc.fillConvexPoly(image, paper, Scalar(235.0, 235.0, 235.0))
            Imgproc.polylines(image, listOf(paper), true, Scalar(30.0, 30.0, 30.0), 3)
            for (line in 0..4) {
                Imgproc.line(image, Point(58.0 + index, 68.0 + line * 24),
                    Point(245.0 + index, 68.0 + line * 24), Scalar(75.0, 75.0, 75.0), 2)
            }
            check(Imgcodecs.imwrite(path.absolutePath, image)) { "Unable to write synthetic input $path" }
        } finally {
            paper.release()
            image.release()
        }
    }

    private fun frameRecord(frameId: Long, timestampMs: Long, file: String) = JSONObject()
        .put("frameId", frameId).put("timestampMs", timestampMs).put("file", file)
        .put("rotationDegrees", 0).put("eligible", true)

    private fun safeName(value: String) = value.replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]"), "_")

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.os.Build
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.opencv.android.Utils
import org.opencv.core.CvType
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

internal data class ReplayVariant(val id: String, val backend: String, val tracking: Boolean)
internal data class ReplayFrame(
    val frameId: Long,
    val timestampMs: Long,
    val file: File,
    val rotationDegrees: Int,
    val cropRect: BufferRect?,
    val eligible: Boolean,
    val referenceQuad: List<Pair<Double, Double>>?,
)
internal data class ReplayClip(val clipId: String, val group: String, val frames: List<ReplayFrame>)
internal data class ReplayManifest(val variants: List<ReplayVariant>, val clips: List<ReplayClip>)

/** Forwards production detector results unchanged and exposes only the latest synchronous call. */
internal class RecordingDocumentBoundaryDetector(
    private val delegate: DocumentBoundaryDetector,
) : DocumentBoundaryDetector {
    override val detectorId get() = delegate.detectorId
    override val configVersion get() = delegate.configVersion
    var callCount: Long = 0
        private set
    var lastResult: DocumentBoundaryResult? = null
        private set
    val lastHeatmapCorners: List<Pair<Double, Double>?>?
        get() = (delegate as? DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter)?.lastRawReference?.channelCornersXY

    override fun detect(input: DocumentBoundaryInput): DocumentBoundaryResult {
        val result = delegate.detect(input)
        lastResult = result
        callCount++
        return result
    }

    override fun close() = delegate.close()
}

internal data class ReplayRun(val directory: File, val rowCount: Int, val sourceManifestSha256: String)

/** Schema-1 replay engine. All generated files are written below app-private filesDir/dbq-replay-results. */
internal class DocumentBoundaryReplaySupport(
    private val appContext: Context,
    private val assetContext: Context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().context,
) {
    private val outputRoot = File(appContext.filesDir, "dbq-replay-results")

    fun parseManifest(manifestFile: File): ReplayManifest {
        val canonicalManifest = manifestFile.canonicalFile
        require(canonicalManifest.isFile) { "Replay manifest does not exist: $canonicalManifest" }
        val parent = canonicalManifest.parentFile.canonicalFile
        val root = JSONObject(canonicalManifest.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
        require(root.getInt("schemaVersion") == 1) { "Only replay schemaVersion 1 is supported" }
        val variantsJson = root.getJSONArray("variants")
        val variants = (0 until variantsJson.length()).map { index ->
            val value = variantsJson.getJSONObject(index)
            val variant = ReplayVariant(
                id = value.getString("id"),
                backend = value.getString("backend"),
                tracking = value.getBoolean("tracking"),
            )
            require(isSafeId(variant.id)) { "Variant id must use only letters, digits, dot, underscore, and dash" }
            require(variant.backend in BACKENDS) { "Unsupported backend '${variant.backend}'" }
            variant
        }
        require(variants.isNotEmpty() && variants.map { it.id }.toSet().size == variants.size) {
            "Manifest needs unique, non-empty variants"
        }

        val clipsJson = root.getJSONArray("clips")
        val clips = (0 until clipsJson.length()).map { clipIndex ->
            val clipJson = clipsJson.getJSONObject(clipIndex)
            val clipId = clipJson.getString("clipId")
            require(isSafeId(clipId)) { "clipId must use only letters, digits, dot, underscore, and dash" }
            val group = clipJson.getString("group")
            val framesJson = clipJson.getJSONArray("frames")
            require(framesJson.length() > 0) { "Clip '$clipId' must contain frames" }
            var previousFrameId: Long? = null
            var previousTimestamp: Long? = null
            val frames = (0 until framesJson.length()).map { frameIndex ->
                val frameJson = framesJson.getJSONObject(frameIndex)
                val frameId = frameJson.getLong("frameId")
                val timestampMs = frameJson.getLong("timestampMs")
                require(frameId >= 0 && (previousFrameId == null || frameId > previousFrameId!!)) {
                    "frameId must be unique and strictly increasing in clip '$clipId'"
                }
                require(timestampMs >= 0 && timestampMs <= Long.MAX_VALUE / 1_000_000L &&
                    (previousTimestamp == null || timestampMs > previousTimestamp!!)) {
                    "timestampMs must be non-negative, representable as ns, and strictly increasing in '$clipId'"
                }
                previousFrameId = frameId
                previousTimestamp = timestampMs

                val relative = File(frameJson.getString("file"))
                require(!relative.isAbsolute) { "Frame file must be relative to the manifest parent" }
                val canonical = File(parent, relative.path).canonicalFile
                require(canonical.path.startsWith(parent.path + File.separator)) {
                    "Frame file escapes manifest parent: ${relative.path}"
                }
                require(canonical.isFile) { "Frame file does not exist: $canonical" }
                val rotation = frameJson.getInt("rotationDegrees")
                require(rotation in ROTATIONS) { "Unsupported rotationDegrees=$rotation" }
                val crop = if (frameJson.has("cropRect") && !frameJson.isNull("cropRect")) {
                    val rect = frameJson.getJSONObject("cropRect")
                    BufferRect(rect.getInt("left"), rect.getInt("top"), rect.getInt("right"), rect.getInt("bottom"))
                } else null
                val reference = if (frameJson.has("quad") && !frameJson.isNull("quad")) {
                    val array = frameJson.getJSONArray("quad")
                    require(array.length() == 8) { "quad must be 8 flat pixel-centre numbers" }
                    (0 until 4).map { i ->
                        val x = array.getDouble(i * 2)
                        val y = array.getDouble(i * 2 + 1)
                        require(x.isFinite() && y.isFinite()) { "quad coordinates must be finite" }
                        x to y
                    }
                } else null
                ReplayFrame(frameId, timestampMs, canonical, rotation, crop,
                    frameJson.getBoolean("eligible"), reference)
            }
            ReplayClip(clipId, group, frames)
        }
        require(clips.isNotEmpty() && clips.map { it.clipId }.toSet().size == clips.size) {
            "Manifest needs unique clips"
        }
        return ReplayManifest(variants, clips)
    }

    fun missingModelAssets(variants: List<ReplayVariant>): List<String> {
        val required = variants.mapNotNull { variant -> when (variant.backend) {
            "B_LC100" -> "models/lc100.onnx"
            "B_T8" -> "models/t8.onnx"
            else -> null
        } }.toSet()
        return required.filter { asset ->
            runCatching { assetContext.assets.open(asset).use { } }.isFailure
        }
    }

    fun writeNotRunReport(reason: String, manifestFile: File?): File {
        outputRoot.mkdirs()
        val directory = newRunDirectory()
        val record = JSONObject()
            .put("schemaVersion", 1)
            .put("status", "NOT_RUN")
            .put("reason", reason)
            .put("sourceManifest", manifestFile?.canonicalPath ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("sourceManifestSha256", manifestFile?.takeIf { it.isFile }?.let { sha256(it.readBytes()) } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("clockDomain", "VIRTUAL_REPLAY_MS")
            .put("createdAtElapsedRealtimeNs", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
        atomicWrite(File(directory, "run.json"), record.toString(2))
        return directory
    }

    fun run(manifestFile: File, manifest: ReplayManifest): ReplayRun {
        val manifestBytes = manifestFile.canonicalFile.readBytes()
        val manifestSha = sha256(manifestBytes)
        val originalFrameHashes = manifest.clips.flatMap { it.frames }.associate { frame ->
            frame.file.canonicalPath to sha256(frame.file.readBytes())
        }
        val directory = newRunDirectory()
        var rowCount = 0
        val variantConfigs = JSONArray()

        for (variant in manifest.variants) {
            variantConfigs.put(JSONObject()
                .put("variantId", variant.id)
                .put("backend", variant.backend)
                .put("tracking", variant.tracking)
                .put("detectorId", detectorId(variant.backend))
                .put("configVersion", configVersion(variant.backend))
                .put("rawModelSha256", modelSha(variant.backend).let { it ?: JSONObject.NULL }))

            for (clip in manifest.clips) {
                var virtualNowMs = 0L
                val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { virtualNowMs })
                val recording = RecordingDocumentBoundaryDetector(createBackend(variant))
                val filters = DocumentQuadFilterMode.entries.associateWith(::DocumentQuadFilter)
                val pipeline = DocumentBoundaryPipeline(
                    coordinator = coordinator,
                    detector = recording,
                    trackingEnabled = variant.tracking,
                    clockMs = { virtualNowMs },
                )
                try {
                    val rows = JSONArray()
                    var previousSpec: AnalysisBufferSpec? = null
                    var geometryId = 0L
                    for (frame in clip.frames) {
                        val sourceBytes = frame.file.readBytes()
                        val sourceSha = sha256(sourceBytes)
                        val decoded = decodeFullResolution(frame.file)
                        val rgba = decoded.second
                        try {
                            val imageWidth = rgba.cols()
                            val imageHeight = rgba.rows()
                            val crop = frame.cropRect ?: BufferRect(0, 0, imageWidth, imageHeight)
                            val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(imageWidth, imageHeight, crop, frame.rotationDegrees)
                            if (previousSpec != spec) geometryId++
                            previousSpec = spec

                            val generation = coordinator.generationForFrame(spec, coordinator.currentGeneration())
                                ?: error("Coordinator rejected replay frame generation")
                            val input = DocumentBoundaryInput(
                                identity = BoundaryFrameId(frame.frameId, generation, geometryId),
                                spec = spec,
                                timing = DocumentFrameTiming(
                                    sensorTimestampNs = null,
                                    receivedTimestampNs = frame.timestampMs * 1_000_000L,
                                ),
                                rgba = rgba,
                            )
                            // The virtual process clock is deterministic and separate from measured detector runtime.
                            virtualNowMs = frame.timestampMs + 1L
                            val callsBefore = recording.callCount
                            val state = pipeline.process(input)
                            val inferred = recording.callCount > callsBefore
                            val detectorResult = if (inferred) recording.lastResult
                                ?: error("Detector scheduled without a captured result") else null
                            val filterOutputs = if (detectorResult?.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.FOUND) {
                                val visible = DocumentBoundarySelection.visible(detectorResult, spec.cropRect)
                                visible.firstOrNull()?.let { candidate ->
                                    DocumentQuadFilterMode.entries.associateWith { mode ->
                                        filters.getValue(mode).update(candidate.rawQuad, frame.timestampMs)
                                    }
                                }
                            } else null
                            rows.put(serializeFrame(
                                manifestSha, variant, clip, frame, sourceSha, input, state,
                                    inferred, detectorResult, filterOutputs,
                                    if (inferred) recording.lastHeatmapCorners else null,
                            ))
                            rowCount++
                        } finally {
                            rgba.release()
                            decoded.first.recycle()
                        }
                        check(sha256(frame.file.readBytes()) == sourceSha) {
                            "Replay changed an input frame: ${frame.file}"
                        }
                    }
                    val filename = "${safeName(variant.id)}--${safeName(clip.clipId)}.jsonl"
                    val file = File(directory, filename)
                    atomicWrite(file, buildString {
                        for (i in 0 until rows.length()) append(rows.getJSONObject(i).toString()).append('\n')
                    })
                } finally {
                    pipeline.close()
                }
            }
        }

        check(sha256(manifestFile.canonicalFile.readBytes()) == manifestSha) { "Replay modified the source manifest" }
        originalFrameHashes.forEach { (path, hash) ->
            check(sha256(File(path).readBytes()) == hash) { "Replay modified input frame $path" }
        }
        val summary = JSONObject()
            .put("schemaVersion", 1)
            .put("status", "COMPLETED")
            .put("sourceManifestSha256", manifestSha)
            .put("sourceManifestCanonicalPath", manifestFile.canonicalPath)
            .put("clockDomain", "VIRTUAL_REPLAY_MS")
            .put("captureOrPresentTimestampsAvailable", false)
            .put("apk", apkMetadata())
            .put("android", androidMetadata())
            .put("variants", variantConfigs)
            .put("clipIds", JSONArray(manifest.clips.map { it.clipId }))
            .put("rowCount", rowCount)
            .put("rawLegacyModelLicenseScopeResolved", false)
            .put("qualityClaim", JSONObject.NULL)
        atomicWrite(File(directory, "run.json"), summary.toString(2))
        return ReplayRun(directory, rowCount, manifestSha)
    }

    private fun createBackend(variant: ReplayVariant): DocumentBoundaryDetector = when (variant.backend) {
        "original" -> ClassicalDocumentBoundaryDetector(enhanced = false)
        "A" -> ClassicalDocumentBoundaryDetector(enhanced = true)
        "B_LC100" -> DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter(DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.LC100, assetContext.assets)
        "B_T8" -> DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter(DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.T8, assetContext.assets)
        else -> error("Unsupported backend ${variant.backend}")
    }

    private fun serializeFrame(
        manifestSha: String,
        variant: ReplayVariant,
        clip: ReplayClip,
        frame: ReplayFrame,
        sourceSha: String,
        input: DocumentBoundaryInput,
        state: LiveDetectionState,
        inferenceScheduled: Boolean,
        detectorResult: DocumentBoundaryResult?,
        filterOutputs: Map<DocumentQuadFilterMode, BoundaryQuad>?,
        heatmapCorners: List<Pair<Double, Double>?>?,
    ): JSONObject {
        val published = state.quadInBufferPixels?.let { points ->
            require(points.size == 8) { "Published buffer quad must have 8 coordinates" }
            JSONArray().apply {
                for (i in 0 until 4) put(JSONArray().put(points[2 * i].toDouble() - 0.5)
                    .put(points[2 * i + 1].toDouble() - 0.5))
            }
        } ?: JSONObject.NULL
        val row = JSONObject()
            .put("schemaVersion", 1)
            .put("sourceManifestSha256", manifestSha)
            .put("variantId", variant.id)
            .put("backend", variant.backend)
            .put("tracking", variant.tracking)
            .put("clipId", clip.clipId)
            .put("group", clip.group)
            .put("frameId", frame.frameId)
            .put("generationId", input.identity.generationId)
            .put("geometryId", input.identity.geometryId)
            .put("virtualReceiptMs", frame.timestampMs)
            .put("clockDomain", "VIRTUAL_REPLAY_MS")
            .put("inputFile", frame.file.name)
            .put("inputSha256", sourceSha)
            .put("rotationDegrees", frame.rotationDegrees)
            .put("cropRect", rectJson(input.spec.cropRect))
            .put("eligible", frame.eligible)
            .put("referenceQuadPixelCentres", frame.referenceQuad?.let(::pairListJson) ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("inferenceScheduled", inferenceScheduled)
            .put("status", state.status.name)
            .put("confirmed", state.status == LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED)
            .put("held", state.status == LiveDetectionStatus.HELD)
            .put("trackedGeometry", state.isTrackedGeometry)
            .put("publishedQuadPixelCentres", published)
            .put("trackId", state.trackId ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("frameTimestampMonotonicMs", state.quadInBufferPixels?.let { state.frameTimestampMonotonicMs } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs", state.quadInBufferPixels?.let { state.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("visualDeadlineMonotonicMs", state.quadInBufferPixels?.let { state.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("processedTimestampMonotonicMs", state.quadInBufferPixels?.let { state.processedTimestampMonotonicMs } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
        if (inferenceScheduled) {
            val result = requireNotNull(detectorResult)
            val runtimeNs = result.detectorFinishedNs - result.detectorStartedNs
            require(result.identity == input.identity) { "Detector returned a result for a different frame identity" }
            require(result.detectorStartedNs > 0 && runtimeNs >= 0) { "Detector runtime clock was invalid" }
            row.put("detectorId", result.detectorId)
                .put("detectorConfigVersion", result.configVersion)
                .put("detectorOutcome", result.outcome.name)
                .put("detectorReason", result.reason ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                .put("detectorRuntimeNs", runtimeNs)
                .put("rawCandidates", candidatesJson(result.candidates, raw = true))
                .put("refinedCandidates", candidatesJson(result.candidates, raw = false))
            if (heatmapCorners != null) row.put("rawHeatmapCornersPixelCentres", nullablePointListJson(heatmapCorners))
        }
        if (filterOutputs != null) {
            val geometryOnly = JSONObject()
            filterOutputs.forEach { (mode, quad) -> geometryOnly.put(mode.name, quadJson(quad)) }
            row.put("filterGeometryOnly", geometryOnly)
        }
        return row
    }

    private fun candidatesJson(candidates: List<DocumentHypothesis>, raw: Boolean): JSONArray = JSONArray().apply {
        candidates.forEach { candidate ->
            val quad = if (raw) candidate.rawQuad else candidate.quad
            put(JSONObject()
                .put("candidateId", candidate.candidateId)
                .put("quadPixelCentres", quadJson(quad))
                .put("rawScore", candidate.rawScore)
                .put("documentPresence", candidate.documentPresence ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                .put("visibility", candidate.visibility.name)
                .put("refinement", candidate.refinement.name)
                .put("rankMargin", candidate.rankMargin ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                .put("cornerUncertaintyPx", JSONArray(candidate.cornerUncertaintyPx.map { it ?: JSONObject.NULL })))
        }
    }

    private fun decodeFullResolution(file: File): Pair<Bitmap, Mat> {
        val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
        BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath, bounds)
        val width = bounds.outWidth
        val height = bounds.outHeight
        require(width > 0 && height > 0) { "Unreadable frame: $file" }
        require(width.toLong() * height.toLong() <= MAX_FRAME_PIXELS) {
            "Frame exceeds $MAX_FRAME_PIXELS pixels: $width x $height"
        }
        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath,
            BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888 })
            ?: error("Unable to decode full-resolution frame: $file")
        if (bitmap.width != width || bitmap.height != height) {
            bitmap.recycle()
            error("Decoded dimensions differ from bounds; replay never resizes inputs")
        }
        val rgba = Mat()
        try {
            Utils.bitmapToMat(bitmap, rgba)
            require(rgba.type() == CvType.CV_8UC4 && rgba.cols() == width && rgba.rows() == height) {
                "Expected full-resolution RGBA CV_8UC4 input"
            }
            return bitmap to rgba
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            rgba.release()
            bitmap.recycle()
            throw failure
        }
    }

    private fun apkMetadata(): JSONObject {
        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
        val info = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            appContext.packageManager.getPackageInfo(appContext.packageName, PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(0))
        } else {
            appContext.packageManager.getPackageInfo(appContext.packageName, 0)
        }
        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
        val legacyVersionCode = info.versionCode.toLong()
        return JSONObject()
            .put("packageName", appContext.packageName)
            .put("versionName", info.versionName ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            .put("versionCode", if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 28) info.longVersionCode else legacyVersionCode)
    }

    private fun androidMetadata() = JSONObject()
        .put("sdkInt", Build.VERSION.SDK_INT)
        .put("release", Build.VERSION.RELEASE)
        .put("manufacturer", Build.MANUFACTURER)
        .put("model", Build.MODEL)
        .put("device", Build.DEVICE)
        .put("abis", JSONArray(Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.toList()))

    private fun newRunDirectory(): File {
        outputRoot.mkdirs()
        val directory = File(outputRoot, "run-${System.currentTimeMillis()}-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
        check(directory.mkdir()) { "Unable to create replay output directory $directory" }
        return directory
    }

    private fun atomicWrite(destination: File, text: String) {
        val temporary = File(destination.parentFile, ".${destination.name}.${UUID.randomUUID()}.tmp")
        FileOutputStream(temporary).bufferedWriter(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.write(text) }
        check(temporary.renameTo(destination)) { "Unable to atomically publish replay output $destination" }
    }

    private fun safeName(value: String): String {
        require(isSafeId(value)) { "Unsafe replay id: $value" }
        return value
    }

    private fun isSafeId(value: String): Boolean =
        value.length in 1..80 && value != "." && value != ".." && value.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"))

    private fun modelSha(backend: String): String? = when (backend) {
        "B_LC100" -> DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.LC100.sha256
        "B_T8" -> DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.T8.sha256
        else -> null
    }

    private fun detectorId(backend: String): String = when (backend) {
        "original" -> "opencv-original"
        "A" -> "opencv-A"
        "B_LC100" -> "docaligner-lc100-android-reference"
        "B_T8" -> "docaligner-t8-android-reference"
        else -> error("Unsupported backend $backend")
    }

    private fun configVersion(backend: String): String = when (backend) {
        "original" -> "production-boundary-selection-0.4.288"
        "A" -> "A-boundary-color-evidence-4"
        "B_LC100" -> "onnx-opset16-fp32-${DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.LC100.sha256}"
        "B_T8" -> "onnx-opset16-fp32-${DocAlignerAndroidTestAdapter.Model.T8.sha256}"
        else -> error("Unsupported backend $backend")
    }

    private fun rectJson(rect: BufferRect) = JSONObject()
        .put("left", rect.left).put("top", rect.top).put("right", rect.right).put("bottom", rect.bottom)

    private fun quadJson(quad: BoundaryQuad) = JSONArray().apply {
        quad.points.forEach { put(JSONArray().put(it.x).put(it.y)) }
    }

    private fun pairListJson(points: List<Pair<Double, Double>>) = JSONArray().apply {
        points.forEach { put(JSONArray().put(it.first).put(it.second)) }
    }

    private fun nullablePointListJson(points: List<Pair<Double, Double>?>) = JSONArray().apply {
        points.forEach { point ->
            put(point?.let { JSONArray().put(it.first).put(it.second) } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
        }
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_FRAME_PIXELS = 4_000_000L
        val BACKENDS = setOf("original", "A", "B_LC100", "B_T8")
        val ROTATIONS = setOf(0, 90, 180, 270)
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import app.docscan.core.model.RecognitionId
import app.docscan.core.store.CaptureCommand
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionCandidate
import app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.util.UUID
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentCropPlanInstrumentedTest {
    private data class StorageFixture(val suffix: String, val storage: ProductStorage)

    @Test
    fun pixelCentreLastCornerNormalizesToOneAndWarpSamplesLastSourcePixel() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val width = 101
        val height = 81
        val right = (width - 1).toFloat()
        val bottom = (height - 1).toFloat()
        val detection = DocumentCropProcessor.Detection(
            bufferPoints = floatArrayOf(0f, 0f, right, 0f, right, bottom, 0f, bottom),
            imageWidth = width,
            imageHeight = height,
            score = 0.9,
        )
        val quad = detection.toNormalized()
        assertEquals(1.0, quad.topRight.x, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1.0, quad.bottomRight.x, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1.0, quad.bottomRight.y, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1.0, quad.bottomLeft.y, 0.0)

        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
            eraseColor(Color.BLACK)
            setPixel(width - 1, height - 1, Color.MAGENTA)
        }
        try {
            val warped = DocumentCropProcessor.rectifyManual(source, quad)
            try {
                assertEquals(width - 1, warped.width)
                assertEquals(height - 1, warped.height)
                assertEquals("Normalized 1.0 must warp from the final source pixel centre",
                    Color.MAGENTA, warped.getPixel(width - 2, height - 2))
            } finally {
                warped.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun previewThenApplyUsesOneDetectionAndInvalidatesRecognitionForNewImageVersion() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val calls = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, Int>>()
        val fixture = newStorage(context, detector = { bitmap ->
            calls += bitmap.width to bitmap.height
            detection(bitmap.width, bitmap.height)
        })
        val storage = fixture.storage
        val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler()
        try {
            val page = capture(storage)
            storage.commitRecognition(
                RecognitionCandidate(
                    recognitionId = RecognitionId.new(),
                    workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                    pageId = page.pageId,
                    imageVersionId = page.imageVersionId,
                    contentRevision = page.contentRevision,
                    desiredOperationKey = "TEST_OCR_V1",
                    recognizedText = "recognized before crop",
                ),
            )
            val recognized = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
            assertEquals("recognized before crop", recognized.recognizedText)
            val originalVersion = recognized.imageVersionId
            val originalRevision = recognized.contentRevision

            val preview = requireNotNull(storage.createDocumentCropPreview(recognized, scheduler))
            try {
                assertEquals("Preview must run corner detection once", 1, calls.size)
                assertTrue(preview.previewBitmap.width > 0 && preview.previewBitmap.height > 0)
                assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
                    storage.applyDocumentCrop(preview.plan.copy(artifactRelativePath = "other-page.jpg"), scheduler)
                }
                assertEquals("A plan cannot be redirected to another artifact", recognized,
                    storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single())
                val cropped = storage.applyDocumentCrop(preview.plan, scheduler).pages.single()

                assertEquals("Apply must reuse the preview plan", 1, calls.size)
                assertEquals(recognized.pageId, cropped.pageId)
                assertNotEquals(originalVersion, cropped.imageVersionId)
                assertTrue(cropped.contentRevision > originalRevision)
                assertNull("New pixels cannot retain text from the prior image version", cropped.recognizedText)
                assertTrue(cropped.canUndoImage)
            } finally {
                preview.previewBitmap.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            closeStorage(context, fixture)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun stalePlanAfterEditAndDeleteIsRejectedWithoutChangingCurrentProjection() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val detector = { bitmap: Bitmap -> detection(bitmap.width, bitmap.height) }
        val fixture = newStorage(context, detector)
        val storage = fixture.storage
        val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler()
        try {
            val editedPage = capture(storage)
            val editPlan = requireNotNull(storage.createDocumentCropPreview(editedPage, scheduler)).also {
                it.previewBitmap.recycle()
            }.plan

            val rotated = storage.rotatePageImage(editedPage, 1, scheduler).pages.single()
            val beforeRejectedEditPlan = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
            assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
                storage.applyDocumentCrop(editPlan, scheduler)
            }
            assertEquals("A stale plan must not publish or revise the edited page", beforeRejectedEditPlan,
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single())

            val deletedPage = capture(storage)
            val deletePlanResult = requireNotNull(storage.createDocumentCropPreview(deletedPage, scheduler))
            val deletePlan = deletePlanResult.plan
            deletePlanResult.previewBitmap.recycle()
            val unaffectedBeforeDelete = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == rotated.pageId }
            storage.deletePage(deletedPage)
            val projectionAfterDelete = storage.workspaceProjection()
            val unaffectedAfterDelete = projectionAfterDelete.pages.single()
            assertEquals(unaffectedBeforeDelete, unaffectedAfterDelete)

            assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
                storage.applyDocumentCrop(deletePlan, scheduler)
            }
            val projectionAfterRejectedDeletePlan = storage.workspaceProjection()
            assertNull(projectionAfterRejectedDeletePlan.pages.find { it.pageId == deletedPage.pageId })
            assertEquals("Rejecting a deleted-page plan must leave other pages untouched", unaffectedAfterDelete,
                projectionAfterRejectedDeletePlan.pages.single())
            assertEquals("No page rows remain after both checks except the unchanged page", 1,
                projectionAfterRejectedDeletePlan.pages.size)
        } finally {
            closeStorage(context, fixture)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun previewAndApplyOutOfMemoryFailuresRecycleBitmapsAndPreservePageAndScheduler() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val previewInput = arrayOfNulls<Bitmap>(1)
        val previewFixture = newStorage(
            context,
            detector = { bitmap -> detection(bitmap.width, bitmap.height) },
            rectifier = { bitmap, _ ->
                previewInput[0] = bitmap
                throw OutOfMemoryError("injected preview allocation failure")
            },
        )
        try {
            val storage = previewFixture.storage
            val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler()
            val page = capture(storage)
            commitRecognition(storage, page)
            val before = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
            assertThrows(OutOfMemoryError::class.java) {
                storage.createDocumentCropPreview(before, scheduler)
            }
            assertTrue("Preview source is always recycled", requireNotNull(previewInput[0]).isRecycled)
            assertEquals("Preview OOM cannot mutate page state", before, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single())
            assertTrue("Scheduler admission is released after preview OOM", scheduler.withAdmission(1L) { true })
        } finally {
            closeStorage(context, previewFixture)
        }

        var rectifierCalls = 0
        val applyInput = arrayOfNulls<Bitmap>(1)
        val applyFixture = newStorage(
            context,
            detector = { bitmap -> detection(bitmap.width, bitmap.height) },
            rectifier = { bitmap, quad ->
                rectifierCalls++
                if (rectifierCalls == 1) {
                    DocumentCropProcessor.rectifyManual(bitmap, quad)
                } else {
                    applyInput[0] = bitmap
                    throw OutOfMemoryError("injected apply allocation failure")
                }
            },
        )
        try {
            val storage = applyFixture.storage
            val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler()
            val page = capture(storage)
            commitRecognition(storage, page)
            val before = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
            val preview = requireNotNull(storage.createDocumentCropPreview(before, scheduler))
            try {
                assertThrows(OutOfMemoryError::class.java) {
                    storage.applyDocumentCrop(preview.plan, scheduler)
                }
            } finally {
                preview.previewBitmap.recycle()
            }
            assertTrue("Apply source is always recycled", requireNotNull(applyInput[0]).isRecycled)
            assertEquals("Apply OOM cannot publish or revise the page", before, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single())
            assertTrue("Scheduler admission is released after apply OOM", scheduler.withAdmission(1L) { true })
        } finally {
            closeStorage(context, applyFixture)
        }
    }

    private fun newStorage(
        context: Context,
        detector: (Bitmap) -> DocumentCropProcessor.Detection?,
        rectifier: (Bitmap, app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral) -> Bitmap = DocumentCropProcessor::rectifyManual,
    ): StorageFixture {
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        return StorageFixture(
            suffix,
            ProductStorage(
                context = context,
                databaseName = "document-crop-$suffix.db",
                artifactDirectoryName = "document-crop-artifacts-$suffix",
                documentCornerDetector = detector,
                documentRectifier = rectifier,
            ),
        )
    }

    private fun capture(storage: ProductStorage): app.docscan.core.store.StoredPage {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(640, 900, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        Canvas(bitmap).apply {
            drawColor(Color.rgb(48, 52, 56))
            drawRect(45f, 40f, 595f, 865f, Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.WHITE })
        }
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { stream ->
            check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, stream))
            stream.toByteArray()
        }
        bitmap.recycle()
        val pageId = PageId.new()
        storage.commitCapture(
            CaptureCommand(
                workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                pageId = pageId,
                imageVersionId = ImageVersionId.new(),
                artifact = storage.stageCapturedJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)),
                selected = true,
                makeActive = true,
                coordinateSpace = "JPEG_PIXEL_EDGE_ORIGIN_TOP_LEFT",
                processingDesiredState = "TEST_OCR_V1",
                sourceProvenance = "DOCUMENT_CROP_PLAN_TEST",
            ),
        )
        return storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == pageId }
    }

    private fun commitRecognition(storage: ProductStorage, page: app.docscan.core.store.StoredPage) {
        storage.commitRecognition(
            RecognitionCandidate(
                recognitionId = RecognitionId.new(),
                workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                pageId = page.pageId,
                imageVersionId = page.imageVersionId,
                contentRevision = page.contentRevision,
                desiredOperationKey = "TEST_OCR_V1",
                recognizedText = "recognized before crop",
            ),
        )
    }

    private fun detection(width: Int, height: Int): DocumentCropProcessor.Detection {
        require(width > 1 && height > 1)
        val right = (width - 1).toFloat()
        val bottom = (height - 1).toFloat()
        return DocumentCropProcessor.Detection(
        // Keep the old perspective/skew intent, expressed in the detector's current pixel-centre space.
        bufferPoints = floatArrayOf(
            right * 0.07f, bottom * 0.045f,
            right * 0.93f, bottom * 0.06f,
            right * 0.95f, bottom * 0.945f,
            right * 0.045f, bottom * 0.96f,
        ),
        imageWidth = width,
        imageHeight = height,
        score = 0.90,
        )
    }

    private fun closeStorage(context: Context, fixture: StorageFixture) {
        fixture.storage.close()
        context.deleteDatabase("document-crop-${fixture.suffix}.db")
        context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve("document-crop-artifacts-${fixture.suffix}").deleteRecursively()
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Path
import android.util.Log
import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlin.math.sqrt

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentCropProcessorInstrumentedTest {
    private data class Fixture(
        val name: String,
        val width: Int,
        val height: Int,
        val corners: List<Pair<Float, Float>>,
    )

    @Test
    fun rectifiesStrongPageBoundaryWithoutChangingSource() {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(1000, 1400, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val canvas = Canvas(source)
        canvas.drawColor(Color.rgb(30, 30, 30))
        val page = Path().apply {
            moveTo(130f, 100f)
            lineTo(850f, 155f)
            lineTo(790f, 1280f)
            lineTo(190f, 1320f)
            close()
        }
        canvas.drawPath(page, Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.WHITE })
        val originalCorner = source.getPixel(0, 0)

        val result = DocumentCropProcessor.rectify(source)

        assertNotNull(result)
        assertEquals(originalCorner, source.getPixel(0, 0))
        assertTrue(requireNotNull(result).width >= 500)
        assertTrue(result.height >= 900)
        result.recycle()
        source.recycle()
    }

    @Test
    fun returnsNoCandidateForUniformImage() {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(800, 1100, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        source.eraseColor(Color.GRAY)

        val result = DocumentCropProcessor.rectify(source)

        assertNull(result)
        source.recycle()
    }

    @Test
    fun opencvDetectsNearFullFramePagesAndLongReceiptsInBothOrientations() {
        val fixtures = buildList {
            listOf(0.90, 0.95, 0.98).forEach { occupancy ->
                add(pageFixture("page-${(occupancy * 100).toInt()}pct", 1000, 1400, occupancy))
            }
            listOf(4, 8, 12).forEach { ratio ->
                add(receiptFixture("receipt-1to${ratio}-portrait", ratio, portrait = true))
                add(receiptFixture("receipt-1to${ratio}-landscape", ratio, portrait = false))
            }
            add(skewedFixture())
            add(nestedFixture())
        }

        val measurements = fixtures.map(::measureWithOpenCv)
        measurements.forEach { measurement ->
            Log.i(
                "DocScanCropNative",
                "fixture=${measurement.name} detected=${measurement.detected} score=${measurement.score} " +
                    "iou=${measurement.iou} areaRatio=${measurement.actualAreaRatio} " +
                    "maxCornerErrorPx=${measurement.maxCornerErrorPixels} " +
                    "relativeCornerError=${measurement.relativeCornerError} " +
                    "output=${measurement.outputWidth}x${measurement.outputHeight}",
            )
        }

        val misses = measurements.filterNot { it.detected }
        assertTrue("OpenCV missed fixtures: ${misses.map { it.name }}", misses.isEmpty())
        measurements.forEach { measurement ->
            assertTrue("${measurement.name}: IoU=${measurement.iou}", measurement.iou >= 0.72)
            assertTrue("${measurement.name}: relative corner error=${measurement.relativeCornerError}", measurement.relativeCornerError <= 0.10)
            if (measurement.name.matches(Regex("page-(90|95|98)pct"))) {
                val requested = measurement.name.removePrefix("page-").removeSuffix("pct").toDouble() / 100.0
                assertTrue("${measurement.name}: generated page area=${measurement.actualAreaRatio}",
                    kotlin.math.abs(measurement.actualAreaRatio - requested) <= 0.002)
            }
        }
    }

    private data class Measurement(
        val name: String,
        val detected: Boolean,
        val score: Double,
        val iou: Double,
        val actualAreaRatio: Double,
        val maxCornerErrorPixels: Double,
        val relativeCornerError: Double,
        val outputWidth: Int,
        val outputHeight: Int,
    )

    private fun measureWithOpenCv(fixture: Fixture): Measurement {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(fixture.width, fixture.height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        drawFixture(source, fixture.corners)
        try {
            val detected = DocumentCropProcessor.detectCorners(source)
            if (detected == null) {
                return Measurement(fixture.name, false, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
                    Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, 0, 0)
            }
            val actual = detected.toNormalized()
            val expected = quad(fixture.corners, fixture.width, fixture.height)
            val iou = QuadGeometryUtils.polygonIoU(expected, actual)
            val areaRatio = QuadGeometryUtils.polygonArea(expected.asList())
            val expectedCorners = QuadGeometryUtils.canonicalizeCorners(expected.asList())
            val actualCorners = QuadGeometryUtils.canonicalizeCorners(actual.asList())
            var maxCornerErrorPixels = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY
            var minCornerErrorPixels = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY
            for (shift in 0 until 4) {
                val cornerErrors = (0 until 4).map { index ->
                    val a = expectedCorners[index]
                    val b = actualCorners[(index + shift) % 4]
                    hypot((a.x - b.x) * fixture.width, (a.y - b.y) * fixture.height)
                }
                val total = cornerErrors.sum()
                if (total < minCornerErrorPixels) {
                    minCornerErrorPixels = total
                    maxCornerErrorPixels = cornerErrors.maxOrNull() ?: Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY
                }
            }
            val docDiagonal = maxOf(
                hypot((expectedCorners[2].x - expectedCorners[0].x) * fixture.width,
                    (expectedCorners[2].y - expectedCorners[0].y) * fixture.height),
                hypot((expectedCorners[3].x - expectedCorners[1].x) * fixture.width,
                    (expectedCorners[3].y - expectedCorners[1].y) * fixture.height),
            )
            val rectified = DocumentCropProcessor.rectifyManual(source, actual)
            try {
                return Measurement(
                    name = fixture.name,
                    detected = true,
                    score = detected.score,
                    iou = iou,
                    actualAreaRatio = areaRatio,
                    maxCornerErrorPixels = maxCornerErrorPixels,
                    relativeCornerError = maxCornerErrorPixels / docDiagonal,
                    outputWidth = rectified.width,
                    outputHeight = rectified.height,
                )
            } finally {
                rectified.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun pageFixture(name: String, width: Int, height: Int, occupancy: Double): Fixture {
        val scale = sqrt(occupancy)
        val centerX = width / 2.0
        val centerY = height / 2.0
        val halfWidth = width * scale / 2.0
        val halfHeight = height * scale / 2.0
        return Fixture(name, width, height, listOf(
            (centerX - halfWidth).toFloat() to (centerY - halfHeight).toFloat(),
            (centerX + halfWidth).toFloat() to (centerY - halfHeight).toFloat(),
            (centerX + halfWidth).toFloat() to (centerY + halfHeight).toFloat(),
            (centerX - halfWidth).toFloat() to (centerY + halfHeight).toFloat(),
        ))
    }

    private fun receiptFixture(name: String, ratio: Int, portrait: Boolean): Fixture {
        val width = if (portrait) 900 else 2000
        val height = if (portrait) 2000 else 900
        val shortSide = minOf(minOf(width, height) * 0.66f, maxOf(width, height) * 0.72f / ratio)
        val longSide = shortSide * ratio
        val pageWidth = if (portrait) shortSide else longSide
        val pageHeight = if (portrait) longSide else shortSide
        val left = (width - pageWidth) / 2f
        val top = (height - pageHeight) / 2f
        val perspective = minOf(pageWidth, pageHeight) * 0.035f
        return Fixture(name, width, height, listOf(
            left + perspective to top,
            left + pageWidth - perspective * 0.6f to top + perspective * 0.4f,
            left + pageWidth to top + pageHeight,
            left to top + pageHeight - perspective * 0.6f,
        ))
    }

    private fun skewedFixture(): Fixture {
        val width = 1200
        val height = 1200
        return Fixture("page-skewed-45deg", width, height, listOf(
            420f to 80f, 1120f to 780f, 780f to 1120f, 80f to 420f,
        ))
    }

    private fun nestedFixture(): Fixture = Fixture(
        "page-on-nested-background", 1200, 1600,
        listOf(270f to 180f, 960f to 230f, 900f to 1430f, 310f to 1380f),
    )

    private fun drawFixture(bitmap: Bitmap, corners: List<Pair<Float, Float>>) {
        val canvas = Canvas(bitmap)
        canvas.drawColor(Color.rgb(55, 63, 69))
        val background = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.rgb(92, 105, 111); strokeWidth = 3f }
        for (x in 0 until bitmap.width step 47) canvas.drawLine(x.toFloat(), 0f, (x + 120).toFloat(), bitmap.height.toFloat(), background)
        // Nested colored panels exercise cases where a strong background contour surrounds the true sheet.
        if (bitmap.width >= 1200 && bitmap.height >= 1500) {
            canvas.drawRoundRect(100f, 100f, bitmap.width - 100f, bitmap.height - 100f, 18f, 18f,
                Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.rgb(142, 106, 72) })
        }
        val page = Path().apply {
            moveTo(corners[0].first, corners[0].second)
            for (index in 1..3) lineTo(corners[index].first, corners[index].second)
            close()
        }
        canvas.drawPath(page, Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.rgb(248, 246, 238) })
        // Low-contrast print texture helps distinguish paper from a featureless white screen.
        val print = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.rgb(214, 211, 202); strokeWidth = 2f }
        val centerX = bitmap.width / 2f
        val centerY = bitmap.height / 2f
        for (line in -6..6) {
            val y = centerY + line * 28f
            canvas.drawLine(centerX - bitmap.width * 0.18f, y, centerX + bitmap.width * 0.18f, y, print)
        }
    }

    private fun quad(corners: List<Pair<Float, Float>>, width: Int, height: Int) = CropQuadrilateral(
        NormalizedCropPoint((corners[0].first / width).toDouble(), (corners[0].second / height).toDouble()),
        NormalizedCropPoint((corners[1].first / width).toDouble(), (corners[1].second / height).toDouble()),
        NormalizedCropPoint((corners[2].first / width).toDouble(), (corners[2].second / height).toDouble()),
        NormalizedCropPoint((corners[3].first / width).toDouble(), (corners[3].second / height).toDouble()),
    )
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Uses the production Activity window, so no test-only Activity/process is needed. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentOverlayViewInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    private val polygon = floatArrayOf(10f, 10f, 90f, 10f, 90f, 90f, 10f, 90f)
    private val replacementPolygon = floatArrayOf(20f, 20f, 80f, 20f, 80f, 80f, 20f, 80f)

    @Test
    fun polygonPersistsWithoutFurtherAnalyzerFrames() {
        ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            lateinit var overlay: DocumentOverlayView
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                overlay = attachOverlay(activity)
                overlay.setPolygonPixels(polygon)
                assertTrue(drawPixel(overlay, 50, 10) != Color.TRANSPARENT)
            }

            // Advancing the main looper alone does not remove an applied contour.
            val looperAdvanced = CountDownLatch(1)
            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({ looperAdvanced.countDown() }, 400L)
            assertTrue("Main looper did not reach the persistence check", looperAdvanced.await(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS))

            scenario.onActivity {
                assertTrue(drawPixel(overlay, 50, 10) != Color.TRANSPARENT)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun clearRemovesPolygonAndNextPolygonReplacesItsGeometry() {
        ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            lateinit var overlay: DocumentOverlayView
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                overlay = attachOverlay(activity)
                overlay.setPolygonPixels(polygon)
                assertTrue(drawPixel(overlay, 50, 10) != Color.TRANSPARENT)

                overlay.setPolygonPixels(replacementPolygon)
                assertEquals("The previous top edge is replaced", Color.TRANSPARENT, drawPixel(overlay, 50, 10))
                assertTrue("The new top edge is drawn", drawPixel(overlay, 50, 20) != Color.TRANSPARENT)

                overlay.clear()
                assertEquals(Color.TRANSPARENT, drawPixel(overlay, 50, 20))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun attachOverlay(activity: ProductActivity): DocumentOverlayView =
        DocumentOverlayView(activity).also { view ->
            activity.addContentView(view, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(100, 100))
            view.measure(
                android.view.View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(100, android.view.View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                android.view.View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(100, android.view.View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
            )
            view.layout(0, 0, 100, 100)
        }

    private fun drawPixel(view: DocumentOverlayView, x: Int, y: Int): Int {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(100, 100, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        try {
            view.draw(Canvas(bitmap))
            return bitmap.getPixel(x, y)
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.opencv.core.CvType
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.core.MatOfPoint
import org.opencv.core.Point
import org.opencv.core.Scalar
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

/** Synthetic regression suite for conservative partial-frame evidence; not an accuracy gate. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentPartialVisibilityInstrumentedTest {
    private data class Variant(val name: String, val enhanced: Boolean)
    private data class Bounds(val left: Double, val top: Double, val right: Double, val bottom: Double)

    private val variants = listOf(Variant("original", false), Variant("A", true))
    private val width = 480
    private val height = 360
    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(width, height, BufferRect(0, 0, width, height), 0)

    @Test
    fun clippedAtEverySideAndCornerProducesPartialWithoutInventedFullQuad() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val clipped = linkedMapOf(
            "left" to Bounds(-34.0, 38.0, 420.0, 324.0),
            "right" to Bounds(60.0, 38.0, 514.0, 324.0),
            "top" to Bounds(55.0, -32.0, 425.0, 326.0),
            "bottom" to Bounds(55.0, 34.0, 425.0, 392.0),
            "top-left" to Bounds(-34.0, -32.0, 420.0, 326.0),
            "top-right" to Bounds(60.0, -32.0, 514.0, 326.0),
            "bottom-right" to Bounds(60.0, 34.0, 514.0, 392.0),
            "bottom-left" to Bounds(-34.0, 34.0, 420.0, 392.0),
        )

        for (variant in variants) for ((case, bounds) in clipped) {
            val image = pageScene(bounds, patterned = true)
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, image, nextFrameId.getAndIncrement())
                assertEquals("${variant.name}/$case must be classified as partial evidence",
                    BoundaryOutcome.PARTIAL, result.outcome)
                assertTrue("PARTIAL must not expose an inferred crop quad (${variant.name}/$case)",
                    result.candidates.isEmpty())
            } finally {
                image.release()
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun fullyVisiblePaperFourPixelsFromEachEdgeIsNeverPartial() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val nearEdge = linkedMapOf(
            "left" to Bounds(4.0, 38.0, 420.0, 324.0),
            "right" to Bounds(60.0, 38.0, 475.0, 324.0),
            "top" to Bounds(55.0, 4.0, 425.0, 326.0),
            "bottom" to Bounds(55.0, 34.0, 425.0, 355.0),
        )
        for (variant in variants) for ((case, bounds) in nearEdge) {
            val image = pageScene(bounds, patterned = true)
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, image, nextFrameId.getAndIncrement())
                assertNotEquals("A visible 4px edge gap is not clipping (${variant.name}/$case)",
                    BoundaryOutcome.PARTIAL, result.outcome)
                assertNotEquals("Valid synthetic input should not produce detector ERROR (${variant.name}/$case)",
                    BoundaryOutcome.ERROR, result.outcome)
                if (result.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.FOUND) {
                    assertFalse("Fully visible candidates must remain inside the image",
                        result.candidates.isEmpty() || result.candidates.any {
                            it.visibility != BoundaryVisibility.FULL || !it.quad.inside(spec.cropRect)
                        })
                }
                // A miss is recorded but is not a failure: this is not a detector-quality claim.
            } finally {
                image.release()
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun weakOrPanelLikeEvidenceDoesNotCreatePartialAndOneSupportedSideCannotStandInForDocument() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val cases: List<Pair<String, () -> Mat>> = listOf(
            "uniform-saturated-panel" to { pageScene(Bounds(-28.0, 50.0, 430.0, 310.0), patterned = false,
                background = Scalar(50.0, 70.0, 90.0, 255.0), paper = Scalar(255.0, 0.0, 0.0, 255.0)) },
            "opposite-frame-background" to { pageScene(Bounds(90.0, -34.0, 390.0, 394.0), patterned = false) },
            "low-contrast-clipped-paper" to { pageScene(Bounds(-28.0, 48.0, 430.0, 312.0), patterned = false,
                background = Scalar(232.0, 232.0, 232.0, 255.0), paper = Scalar(238.0, 238.0, 238.0, 255.0)) },
            "insufficient-side-support" to { insufficientSupportScene() },
            "empty-dark-scene" to { Mat(height, width, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(18.0, 22.0, 26.0, 255.0)) },
        )

        for (variant in variants) for ((case, createImage) in cases) {
            val image = createImage()
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, image, nextFrameId.getAndIncrement())
                assertNotEquals("Insufficient evidence must not be promoted to PARTIAL (${variant.name}/$case)",
                    BoundaryOutcome.PARTIAL, result.outcome)
                if (case == "insufficient-side-support" || case == "empty-dark-scene" ||
                    case == "low-contrast-clipped-paper") {
                    assertNotEquals("This low-evidence scene must not become a full crop (${variant.name}/$case)",
                        BoundaryOutcome.FOUND, result.outcome)
                }
                if (result.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.FOUND) {
                    // These panel-like scenes may expose legacy classical false positives. Log the
                    // source and raw corners so validation can compare against the pre-change baseline.
                    Log.w("DBQPartialBaseline", "legacy full result ${variant.name}/$case " +
                        result.candidates.joinToString { "${it.source}:${it.rawQuad.points}" })
                }
                assertNotEquals("Synthetic test frame should not crash the detector (${variant.name}/$case)",
                    BoundaryOutcome.ERROR, result.outcome)
            } finally {
                image.release()
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun blankWhiteClippedPaperRemainsUnresolvedWithoutCropCandidate() {
        DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        for (variant in variants) {
            val image = pageScene(Bounds(-28.0, 48.0, 430.0, 312.0), patterned = false)
            try {
                val result = detect(variant, image, nextFrameId.getAndIncrement())
                assertNotEquals("Blank white clipping is not evidence for a complete crop (${variant.name})",
                    BoundaryOutcome.FOUND, result.outcome)
                if (result.outcome == BoundaryOutcome.PARTIAL) {
                    assertTrue("Geometric PARTIAL carries no inferred full crop quad (${variant.name})",
                        result.candidates.isEmpty())
                }
            } finally {
                image.release()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun detect(variant: Variant, image: Mat, id: Long): DocumentBoundaryResult {
        val detector = ClassicalDocumentBoundaryDetector(enhanced = variant.enhanced)
        return try {
            detector.detect(DocumentBoundaryInput(
                identity = BoundaryFrameId(id, generationId = 1L, geometryId = 1L),
                spec = spec,
                timing = DocumentFrameTiming(sensorTimestampNs = null,
                    receivedTimestampNs = id * 1_000_000L),
                rgba = image,
            ))
        } finally {
            detector.close()
        }
    }

    private fun pageScene(
        bounds: Bounds,
        patterned: Boolean,
        background: Scalar = Scalar(48.0, 72.0, 92.0, 255.0),
        paper: Scalar = Scalar(245.0, 243.0, 232.0, 255.0),
    ): Mat {
        val image = Mat(height, width, CvType.CV_8UC4, background)
        val polygon = MatOfPoint(
            Point(bounds.left, bounds.top), Point(bounds.right, bounds.top),
            Point(bounds.right, bounds.bottom), Point(bounds.left, bounds.bottom),
        )
        try {
            Imgproc.fillConvexPoly(image, polygon, paper)
        } finally {
            polygon.release()
        }
        if (patterned) {
            val ink = Scalar(32.0, 35.0, 38.0, 255.0)
            for (y in 96 until 290 step 34) {
                Imgproc.line(image, Point(112.0, y.toDouble()), Point(350.0, y.toDouble()), ink, 2)
            }
            for (y in listOf(112.0, 180.0, 248.0)) {
                Imgproc.rectangle(image, org.opencv.core.Rect(370, y.toInt(), 22, 12), ink, Imgproc.FILLED)
            }
        }
        return image
    }

    private fun insufficientSupportScene(): Mat {
        val image = pageScene(Bounds(-28.0, 45.0, 430.0, 315.0), patterned = false,
            background = Scalar(232.0, 232.0, 232.0, 255.0), paper = Scalar(235.0, 235.0, 235.0, 255.0))
        // One isolated observed edge cannot establish three-sided document presence.
        Imgproc.line(image, Point(110.0, 312.0), Point(420.0, 312.0), Scalar(12.0, 12.0, 12.0, 255.0), 2)
        return image
    }

    private companion object {
        val nextFrameId = AtomicLong(1L)
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.opencv.core.CvType
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.core.MatOfPoint
import org.opencv.core.Point
import org.opencv.core.Scalar
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import kotlin.math.hypot

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DocumentSegmenterInstrumentedTest {
    private val context get() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext

    private fun frame(quad: List<Point>?): Mat {
        val m = Mat(960, 1280, CvType.CV_8UC4, Scalar(90.0, 80.0, 70.0, 255.0))
        if (quad != null) {
            Imgproc.fillPoly(m, listOf(MatOfPoint(*quad.toTypedArray())), Scalar(235.0, 235.0, 230.0, 255.0))
            repeat(14) { i ->
                Imgproc.line(m, Point(quad[0].x + 60, quad[0].y + 50 + i * 35.0), Point(quad[1].x - 60, quad[1].y + 50 + i * 35.0),
                    Scalar(40.0, 40.0, 40.0, 255.0), 3)
            }
        }
        return m
    }

    @Test
    fun findsSheetCornersAndRejectsEmptyTable() {
        val segmenter = DocumentSegmenter.load(context)
        assertNotNull("model must load through OpenCV dnn", segmenter)
        val quad = listOf(Point(300.0, 150.0), Point(980.0, 190.0), Point(930.0, 800.0), Point(260.0, 760.0))
        val sheet = frame(quad)
        val empty = frame(null)
        try {
            segmenter!!.segment(sheet, 0) // warm-up
            val started = System.nanoTime()
            val found = segmenter.segment(sheet, 0)
            val ms = (System.nanoTime() - started) / 1e6
            Log.i("DocScanSeg", "segment ms=$ms confidence=${found?.confidence}")
            assertNotNull(found)
            val diag = hypot(1280.0, 960.0)
            val worst = quad.indices.maxOf { i ->
                hypot(found!!.bufferPoints[i * 2] - quad[i].x, found.bufferPoints[i * 2 + 1] - quad[i].y) / diag
            }
            Log.i("DocScanSeg", "worst corner error ${worst * 100}% of diagonal")
            assertTrue("corner error ${worst * 100}%", worst < 0.04)
            val none = segmenter.segment(empty, 0)
            assertTrue("empty table must not look like a document", none == null || none.confidence < ProductActivity.MODEL_APPEAR_CONFIDENCE)
        } finally {
            sheet.release(); empty.release()
        }
    }
}
