package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.view.View
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import androidx.test.uiautomator.By
import androidx.test.uiautomator.UiDevice
import androidx.test.uiautomator.Until
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assert.fail
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class FamilyDocsInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    private fun fixture(): Pair<Context, File> {
        val target = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val root = File(target.cacheDir, "family-docs-test-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
        check(root.mkdirs())
        val context = object : ContextWrapper(target) {
            override fun getNoBackupFilesDir(): File = root
            override fun getApplicationContext(): Context = this
        }
        return context to root
    }

    private fun identity(familyId: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(), memberId: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()) =
        FamilyDocsIdentity("ds_${"x".repeat(43)}", System.currentTimeMillis() + 86_400_000, familyId, memberId, "Synthetic", JSONArray())

    private fun metadata() = JSONObject()
        .put("title", "Synthetic receipt")
        .put("original_filename", "synthetic.pdf")
        .put("node_ids", JSONArray().put("synthetic:leaf"))
        .put("visibility", "family")
        .put("owner_member_id", JSONObject.NULL)
        .put("doc_date", JSONObject.NULL)
        .put("expires_at", JSONObject.NULL)
        .put("note", "synthetic test only")

    @Test
    fun credentialsAreEncryptedDurableAndClearedWithoutPlaintextToken() {
        val (context, root) = fixture()
        try {
            val secret = identity()
            val credentials = FamilyDocsCredentials(context)
            credentials.save(secret)
            val encrypted = File(root, "family-docs/connection.enc")
            assertTrue(encrypted.isFile)
            val bytes = encrypted.readBytes()
            assertFalse(String(bytes, Charsets.ISO_8859_1).contains(secret.token))
            assertEquals(secret.token, FamilyDocsCredentials(context).read()?.token)
            assertEquals(secret.familyId, FamilyDocsCredentials(context).read()?.familyId)
            assertEquals(secret.memberId, FamilyDocsCredentials(context).read()?.memberId)
            credentials.clear()
            assertNull(FamilyDocsCredentials(context).read())
            assertFalse(encrypted.exists())
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun outboxSnapshotAndDocumentIdSurviveRestartAndTransientFailure() {
        val (context, root) = fixture()
        try {
            val identity = identity()
            val credentials = FamilyDocsCredentials(context).also { it.save(identity) }
            val pdf = File(root, "source.pdf").apply { writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\nsynthetic".toByteArray()) }
            val hash = FamilyDocsFiles.hash(pdf)
            val clientState = FakeState()
            val firstClient = FamilyDocsClient(credentials, FakeTransport(clientState))
            val firstOutbox = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, firstClient)
            val queued = firstOutbox.enqueue("export-${UUID.randomUUID()}", pdf, pdf.length(), hash, metadata(), identity)
            assertEquals(queued.id, queued.metadata.getString("idempotency_key"))

            // Re-entering the same committed export/account returns its prior stable operation.
            val repeated = firstOutbox.enqueue(queued.sourceExportId, pdf, pdf.length(), hash, metadata(), identity)
            assertEquals(queued.id, repeated.id)
            assertEquals(1, firstOutbox.entries().size)
            val snapshot = File(root, "family-docs/outbox/${queued.id}/document.pdf")
            assertEquals(hash, FamilyDocsFiles.hash(snapshot))

            // Mutating the original source after queueing cannot change the immutable upload snapshot.
            pdf.writeBytes("mutated source".toByteArray())
            assertEquals(hash, FamilyDocsFiles.hash(snapshot))

            clientState.failFirstPrepare = true
            val firstAttempt = runCatching { firstOutbox.send(queued.id) }
            assertTrue(firstAttempt.isFailure)
            val registeredId = firstOutbox.entries().single().documentId
            assertEquals(clientState.canonicalDocumentId, registeredId)

            // A newly constructed credentials/client/outbox object models process restart.
            val afterRestart = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, FamilyDocsClient(FamilyDocsCredentials(context), FakeTransport(clientState)))
            val recovered = afterRestart.entries().single()
            assertEquals(queued.id, recovered.id)
            assertEquals(registeredId, recovered.documentId)
            assertFalse(recovered.ready)
            val ready = afterRestart.send(queued.id)
            assertTrue(ready.ready)
            assertEquals(registeredId, ready.documentId)
            assertFalse(snapshot.exists()) // Ready was durably journaled before the owned snapshot was cleaned.
            assertEquals(1, clientState.registerCount)
            assertEquals(listOf(registeredId, registeredId), clientState.prepareDocumentIds)
            assertEquals(listOf(registeredId), clientState.contentDocumentIds)
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun changedAccountCannotSendOrReassignAnExistingQueueEntry() {
        val (context, root) = fixture()
        try {
            val original = identity()
            val credentials = FamilyDocsCredentials(context).also { it.save(original) }
            val pdf = File(root, "source.pdf").apply { writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\nsynthetic".toByteArray()) }
            val state = FakeState()
            val client = FamilyDocsClient(credentials, FakeTransport(state))
            val outbox = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, client)
            val queued = outbox.enqueue("account-bound-export", pdf, pdf.length(), FamilyDocsFiles.hash(pdf), metadata(), original)

            credentials.save(identity())
            assertTrue(runCatching { outbox.send(queued.id) }.isFailure)
            assertEquals(original.familyId, outbox.entries().single().familyId)
            assertEquals(original.memberId, outbox.entries().single().memberId)
            assertNull(outbox.entries().single().documentId)
            assertTrue(state.paths.isEmpty())
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun sourceHashMismatchFailsClosedBeforeQueuePublication() {
        val (context, root) = fixture()
        try {
            val identity = identity()
            val client = FamilyDocsClient(FamilyDocsCredentials(context)) { _, _, _, _ -> error("network forbidden") }
            val outbox = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, client)
            val pdf = File(root, "source.pdf").apply { writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\nfirst".toByteArray()) }
            val expected = FamilyDocsFiles.hash(pdf)
            pdf.writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\nother".toByteArray())
            assertTrue(runCatching { outbox.enqueue("changed-export", pdf, pdf.length(), expected, metadata(), identity) }.isFailure)
            assertTrue(outbox.entries().isEmpty())
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun corruptQueuedSnapshotFailsBeforeAnyTransportCall() {
        val (context, root) = fixture()
        try {
            val identity = identity()
            val credentials = FamilyDocsCredentials(context).also { it.save(identity) }
            val pdf = File(root, "source.pdf").apply { writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\nsynthetic".toByteArray()) }
            val state = FakeState()
            val outbox = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, FamilyDocsClient(credentials, FakeTransport(state)))
            val queued = outbox.enqueue("corrupt-export", pdf, pdf.length(), FamilyDocsFiles.hash(pdf), metadata(), identity)
            val snapshot = File(root, "family-docs/outbox/${queued.id}/document.pdf")
            snapshot.writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\ncorrupted".toByteArray())

            assertTrue(runCatching { outbox.send(queued.id) }.isFailure)
            assertTrue("Checksum failure must happen before registration or upload", state.paths.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(null, outbox.entries().single().documentId)
            assertFalse(outbox.entries().single().ready)
            assertTrue("The failed snapshot remains available for diagnosis/recovery", snapshot.exists())
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun metadataRequiresOneToFiveDestinationsAndPrivateOwnerToBeCurrentMember() {
        val (context, root) = fixture()
        try {
            val identity = identity()
            val client = FamilyDocsClient(FamilyDocsCredentials(context)) { _, _, _, _ -> error("network forbidden") }
            val outbox = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, client)
            val pdf = File(root, "source.pdf").apply { writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\nsynthetic".toByteArray()) }
            val size = pdf.length()
            val hash = FamilyDocsFiles.hash(pdf)

            listOf(0, 6).forEach { count ->
                val destinations = JSONArray()
                repeat(count) { destinations.put("synthetic:leaf:$it") }
                assertTrue(
                    "Destination count $count must fail before queue publication",
                    runCatching {
                        outbox.enqueue("invalid-destinations-$count", pdf, size, hash, metadata().put("node_ids", destinations), identity)
                    }.isFailure,
                )
                assertTrue(outbox.entries().isEmpty())
            }

            val privateForAnotherMember = metadata()
                .put("visibility", "private")
                .put("owner_member_id", UUID.randomUUID().toString())
            assertTrue(
                "Private documents cannot be assigned to a different member",
                runCatching { outbox.enqueue("invalid-private-owner", pdf, size, hash, privateForAnotherMember, identity) }.isFailure,
            )
            assertTrue(outbox.entries().isEmpty())

            val privateForSelf = metadata()
                .put("visibility", "private")
                .put("owner_member_id", identity.memberId)
            val queued = outbox.enqueue("private-self", pdf, size, hash, privateForSelf, identity)
            assertEquals("private", queued.metadata.getString("visibility"))
            assertEquals(identity.memberId, queued.metadata.getString("owner_member_id"))
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun backendReconnectAndPairFailuresHaveActionableDeviceMessages() {
        listOf("DEVICE_RECONNECT_REQUIRED", "SESSION_EXPIRED", "DEVICE_REVOKED").forEach { code ->
            val message = FamilyDocsFailure(code).message.orEmpty()
            assertTrue("$code should tell the user to reconnect", message.contains("Подключите сканер заново"))
            assertTrue("$code should state the queued PDF is retained", message.contains("PDF остаётся в очереди"))
        }
        listOf("PAIR_CODE_EXPIRED", "OAUTH_FLOW_INVALID").forEach { code ->
            val message = FamilyDocsFailure(code).message.orEmpty()
            assertTrue("$code should explain that pairing failed", message.contains("код подключения", ignoreCase = true) || message.contains("подключить", ignoreCase = true))
            assertFalse("$code should not claim a cloud upload happened", message.contains("отправить PDF"))
        }
        assertTrue(FamilyDocsFailure("DEVICE_LIMIT").message.orEmpty().contains("10 сканеров"))
        listOf("DRIVE_RECONNECT_REQUIRED", "DRIVE_NOT_CONNECTED", "DRIVE_FOLDER_NOT_READY").forEach { code ->
            assertTrue("$code should point to FamilyTodoList Drive setup", FamilyDocsFailure(code).message.orEmpty().contains("FamilyTodoList"))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun expiredConnectionIsNotReportedConnectedAndOldResponseCannotClearReplacement() {
        val (context, root) = fixture()
        try {
            val credentials = FamilyDocsCredentials(context)
            val old = identity()
            val replacement = identity()
            credentials.save(old)
            credentials.save(replacement)
            credentials.clearIf(old)
            assertEquals("A stale response must not erase a newer account", replacement.token, credentials.read()?.token)

            val expired = replacement.copy(expiresAt = System.currentTimeMillis() - 1)
            credentials.save(expired)
            val client = FamilyDocsClient(credentials)
            assertNull("Expired device identity must not appear connected", client.connected())
            val result = runCatching { client.json("/docs/catalog", JSONObject(), expired) }
            assertTrue(result.exceptionOrNull() is FamilyDocsFailure)
            assertNull("Known expiry clears only the expired connection", credentials.read())
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private class FakeState {
        val canonicalDocumentId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val paths = mutableListOf<String>()
        val prepareDocumentIds = mutableListOf<String>()
        val contentDocumentIds = mutableListOf<String>()
        var registerCount = 0
        var failFirstPrepare = false
    }

    private class FakeTransport(private val state: FakeState) : FamilyDocsTransport {
        override fun request(path: String, payload: JSONObject?, pdf: File?, identity: FamilyDocsIdentity?): JSONObject {
            state.paths += path
            return when {
                path == "/docs/documents" -> {
                    state.registerCount++
                    JSONObject().put("document", JSONObject().put("id", state.canonicalDocumentId))
                }
                path.endsWith("/prepare") -> {
                    val id = path.substringAfter("/docs/documents/").substringBefore("/")
                    state.prepareDocumentIds += id
                    if (state.failFirstPrepare) {
                        state.failFirstPrepare = false
                        throw FamilyDocsFailure("NETWORK")
                    }
                    JSONObject().put("prepared", true)
                }
                path.endsWith("/content") -> {
                    val id = path.substringAfter("/docs/documents/").substringBefore("/")
                    state.contentDocumentIds += id
                    assertNotEquals(null, pdf)
                    JSONObject().put("document", JSONObject().put("upload_state", "ready"))
                }
                else -> error("Unexpected synthetic request: $path")
            }
        }
    }
}

    }

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class FamilyDocsWorkflowRetryInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun lostWorkflowResponseRetriesSameOperationAndSkipsAcknowledgedOperationAfterRestart() {
        val target = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val root = File(target.cacheDir, "family-docs-workflow-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
        check(root.mkdirs())
        val context = object : ContextWrapper(target) {
            override fun getNoBackupFilesDir(): File = root
            override fun getApplicationContext(): Context = this
        }
        try {
            val identity = FamilyDocsIdentity(
                "ds_${"x".repeat(43)}", System.currentTimeMillis() + 86_400_000,
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(), UUID.randomUUID().toString(), "Synthetic", JSONArray(),
            )
            val credentials = FamilyDocsCredentials(context).also { it.save(identity) }
            val pdf = File(root, "source.pdf").apply { writeBytes("%PDF-1.4\nsynthetic workflow fixture".toByteArray()) }
            val operations = JSONArray()
                .put(JSONObject().put("operation_id", UUID.randomUUID().toString()).put("task_id", UUID.randomUUID().toString()).put("action", "link_task"))
                .put(JSONObject().put("operation_id", UUID.randomUUID().toString()).put("event_id", UUID.randomUUID().toString()).put("action", "link_event"))
            val workflow = JSONObject().put("operations", operations)
            val metadata = JSONObject()
                .put("title", "Synthetic workflow receipt")
                .put("original_filename", "synthetic.pdf")
                .put("node_ids", JSONArray().put("synthetic:leaf"))
                .put("visibility", "family")
                .put("owner_member_id", JSONObject.NULL)
                .put("doc_date", JSONObject.NULL)
                .put("expires_at", JSONObject.NULL)
                .put("note", "synthetic test only")
            val state = WorkflowTransportState()
            val firstOutbox = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, FamilyDocsClient(credentials, WorkflowTransport(state)))
            val queued = firstOutbox.enqueue(
                "export-${UUID.randomUUID()}", pdf, pdf.length(), FamilyDocsFiles.hash(pdf), metadata, identity, workflow,
            )

            val firstAttempt = runCatching { firstOutbox.send(queued.id) }
            assertTrue("The synthetic server applies operation two and then loses its response", firstAttempt.isFailure)
            assertEquals(listOf(operations.getJSONObject(0).getString("operation_id"), operations.getJSONObject(1).getString("operation_id")), state.operationAttempts)
            assertEquals("Both intended operations reached the server once", 2, state.appliedOperationIds.size)
            assertFalse(firstOutbox.entries().single().ready)

            // A new outbox/client models process restart; operation one was durably acknowledged,
            // while operation two must be retried with its original idempotency and entity IDs.
            val recovered = FamilyDocsOutbox(context, FamilyDocsClient(FamilyDocsCredentials(context), WorkflowTransport(state)))
            val ready = recovered.send(queued.id)
            assertTrue(ready.ready)
            assertEquals(queued.id, ready.id)
            assertEquals(1, state.registrationCount)
            assertEquals(listOf(state.documentId, state.documentId), state.uploadDocumentIds)
            assertEquals(
                listOf(
                    operations.getJSONObject(0).getString("operation_id"),
                    operations.getJSONObject(1).getString("operation_id"),
                    operations.getJSONObject(1).getString("operation_id"),
                ),
                state.operationAttempts,
            )
            assertEquals("Server-side idempotency leaves one logical application per operation", 2, state.appliedOperationIds.size)
            assertTrue("The durable queue snapshot is removed only after all workflow operations finish", File(root, "family-docs/outbox/${queued.id}/document.pdf").let { !it.exists() })
        } finally {
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private class WorkflowTransportState {
        val documentId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val operationAttempts = mutableListOf<String>()
        val appliedOperationIds = linkedSetOf<String>()
        val uploadDocumentIds = mutableListOf<String>()
        var registrationCount = 0
        var loseFirstEventResponse = true
    }

    private class WorkflowTransport(private val state: WorkflowTransportState) : FamilyDocsTransport {
        override fun request(path: String, payload: JSONObject?, pdf: File?, identity: FamilyDocsIdentity?): JSONObject = when {
            path == "/docs/documents" -> {
                state.registrationCount++
                JSONObject().put("document", JSONObject().put("id", state.documentId))
            }
            path.endsWith("/prepare") -> JSONObject().put("prepared", true)
            path.endsWith("/content") -> {
                state.uploadDocumentIds += path.substringAfter("/docs/documents/").substringBefore("/")
                assertTrue("Only an immutable PDF snapshot is uploaded", pdf?.isFile == true)
                JSONObject().put("document", JSONObject().put("upload_state", "ready"))
            }
            path.endsWith("/workflow") -> {
                val operation = requireNotNull(payload)
                val operationId = operation.getString("operation_id")
                state.operationAttempts += operationId
                state.appliedOperationIds += operationId // Model the server committing before response loss.
                if (operation.has("event_id") && state.loseFirstEventResponse) {
                    state.loseFirstEventResponse = false
                    throw FamilyDocsFailure("NETWORK")
                }
                JSONObject().put("ok", true)
            }
            else -> error("Unexpected synthetic request: $path")
        }
    }
}

        try {
            val output = fixture.storage.composeFrozenSaveOutputSet(
                fixture.snapshot,
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.8f, 150),
                companionJpegQuality = 82,
            )
            assertEquals(1, output.pages.size)
            assertEquals(fixture.snapshot.pages.single().imageVersionId.value, output.pages.single().imageVersionId)
            assertTrue(output.pdfFile.isFile && output.pdfFile.length() > 0L)
            assertTrue(output.pages.single().jpegFile.isFile && output.pages.single().jpegSha256.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}")))
            assertTrue(maxOf(output.pages.single().widthPx, output.pages.single().heightPx) <= 3000)
            assertTrue(File(output.pdfFile.parentFile, "page-1.jpg").isFile)
        } finally {
            close(fixture)
        }
    }

    @Test

    @Test

    @Test
    fun startupRecoveryRemovesOnlyCandidatesForInterruptedLocalSave() {
        val fixture = fixture("startup-recovery")
        try {
            val saveManifestId = fixture.snapshot.saveManifestId.value
            val sourceHash = sha256(fixture.source)
            fixture.storage.close()

            val candidateRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "docscan-save-candidates")
            assertTrue(candidateRoot.mkdirs() || candidateRoot.isDirectory)
            val finalCandidate = File(candidateRoot, saveManifestId).apply {
                assertTrue(mkdirs())
                File(this, "orphan.marker").writeText("incomplete final candidate")
            }
            val stagingCandidate = File(candidateRoot, ".$saveManifestId.${UUID.randomUUID()}.building").apply {
                assertTrue(mkdirs())
                File(this, "orphan.marker").writeText("incomplete staging candidate")
            }
            val unrelatedCandidate = File(candidateRoot, ".${UUID.randomUUID()}.${UUID.randomUUID()}.building").apply {
                assertTrue(mkdirs())
            }

            val databaseFile = context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName)
            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READWRITE).use { db ->
                db.execSQL("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
                val dependency = ContentValues().apply {
                    put("save_dependency_result_id", UUID.randomUUID().toString())
                    put("save_manifest_id", saveManifestId)
                    put("image_version_id", fixture.snapshot.pages.single().imageVersionId.value)
                    put("dependency_kind", "LOCAL_OUTPUT_COMPOSITION")
                    put("dependency_spec", "frozen-image-version:${fixture.snapshot.pages.single().imageVersionId.value}")
                    putNull("payload")
                    putNull("artifact_id")
                }
                db.insertOrThrow("SaveDependencyResult", null, dependency)
            }

            fixture.storage = ProductStorage(context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectory)

            assertEquals(1, fixture.storage.abandonedLocalOutputCompositionsAtStartup)
            assertFalse(finalCandidate.exists())
            assertFalse(stagingCandidate.exists())
            assertTrue(unrelatedCandidate.isDirectory)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(fixture.source))
            assertEquals(1L, fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size.toLong())
            val replacement = fixture.storage.freezeSelectedPagesForSave()
            fixture.storage.cancelUnstartedSaveManifest(replacement.saveManifestId)
        } finally {
            close(fixture)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun committedSaveCandidateIsRemovedAtStartupWhileDurableOutputsRemain() {

    @Test
    fun startupAbandonsInterruptedSaveAfterObjectRenameBeforeArtifactRow() {
        var failObjectSync = false
        val syncFactory: () -> DirectorySync = {
            object : DirectorySync {
                override fun sync(directory: java.nio.file.Path) {
                    val isObjectShard = directory.parent?.fileName?.toString() == "objects"
                        && directory.fileName.toString().matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{2}"))
                    if (failObjectSync && isObjectShard) {
                        failObjectSync = false
                        throw IOException("injected sync failure after export object rename")
                    }
                    AndroidDirectorySync().sync(directory)
                }
            }
        }
        val fixture = fixture("staged-output-recovery", directorySyncFactory = syncFactory)
        try {
            val output = fixture.storage.composeFrozenSaveOutputSet(
                fixture.snapshot,
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.8f, 150),
                companionJpegQuality = 82,
            )
            val candidateDirectory = requireNotNull(output.pdfFile.parentFile)
            val outputObjectCountBefore = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, fixture.artifactDirectory)
                .resolve("objects").walkTopDown().count { it.isFile }
            val sourceHash = sha256(fixture.source)
            val pdfId = app.docscan.core.model.ArtifactId.forSaveOutput(fixture.snapshot.saveManifestId, 0)
            val unregisteredPdf = File(
                context.noBackupFilesDir,
                "${fixture.artifactDirectory}/objects/${pdfId.value.take(2)}/${pdfId.value}.pdf",
            )

            // The publication intent is durable; fail after the PDF rename and before its DB row.
            failObjectSync = true
            assertTrue(runCatching {
                fixture.storage.commitLocalExportOutputSet(fixture.snapshot, output)
            }.isFailure)
            assertTrue(unregisteredPdf.isFile)
            assertTrue(candidateDirectory.isDirectory)

            fixture.storage.close()
            fixture.storage = ProductStorage(context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectory)

            assertEquals(1, fixture.storage.abandonedLocalOutputCompositionsAtStartup)
            assertFalse(candidateDirectory.exists())
            assertFalse(unregisteredPdf.exists())
            assertEquals(outputObjectCountBefore, File(context.noBackupFilesDir, fixture.artifactDirectory)
                .resolve("objects").walkTopDown().count { it.isFile })
            assertEquals(1, fixture.storage.visiblePages().size)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(fixture.source))
        } finally {
            close(fixture)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun candidateCleanupFailureKeepsCommittedExportAndRetriesAtStartup() {
        val fixture = fixture("candidate-cleanup-retry", directorySyncFactory = failCandidateCleanupSyncFactory())
        try {
            val output = fixture.storage.composeFrozenSaveOutputSet(
                fixture.snapshot,
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.8f, 150),
                companionJpegQuality = 82,
            )
            val candidateDirectory = requireNotNull(output.pdfFile.parentFile)
            val exportId = fixture.storage.commitLocalExportOutputSet(fixture.snapshot, output)
            val cleanup = fixture.storage.cleanupCommittedLocalOutputCandidate(fixture.snapshot.saveManifestId)

            assertTrue(cleanup.isFailure)
            assertFalse(candidateDirectory.exists())
            val committedOutputs = fixture.storage.committedExportOutputs(exportId)
            assertEquals(2, committedOutputs.size)
            committedOutputs.forEach { output ->
                val file = fixture.storage.artifactPath(output.relativePath).toFile()
                assertTrue(file.isFile)
                assertEquals(output.sizeBytes, file.length())
                assertEquals(output.sha256, sha256(file))
            }

            fixture.storage.close()
            fixture.storage = ProductStorage(context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectory)

            assertEquals(0, fixture.storage.failedCommittedSaveCandidateCleanupsAtStartup)
            assertFalse(candidateDirectory.exists())
            assertEquals(committedOutputs, fixture.storage.committedExportOutputs(exportId))
        } finally {
            close(fixture)
        }
    }

    private fun failCandidateCleanupSyncFactory(): () -> DirectorySync {
        var factoryCalls = 0
        return {
            factoryCalls++
            if (factoryCalls == 3) {
                object : DirectorySync {
                    override fun sync(directory: java.nio.file.Path) {
                        throw IOException("injected committed candidate cleanup sync failure")
                    }
                }
            } else AndroidDirectorySync()
        }
    }

    private fun parentSyncFailureOnceFactory(): () -> DirectorySync {
        var factoryCalls = 0
        var composerSyncCalls = 0
        return {
            factoryCalls++
            if (factoryCalls == 1) {
                // ProductStorage constructs its artifact repository before the composer.
                AndroidDirectorySync()
            } else {
                object : DirectorySync {
                    override fun sync(directory: java.nio.file.Path) {
                        composerSyncCalls++
                        if (composerSyncCalls == 2) {
                            throw IOException("injected output-root sync failure")
                        }
                        AndroidDirectorySync().sync(directory)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun fixture(
        label: String,
        width: Int = 240,
        height: Int = 320,
        addOcr: Boolean = true,
        directorySyncFactory: () -> DirectorySync = { AndroidDirectorySync() },
    ): Fixture {
        val id = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "test-save-$id.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "test-save-artifacts-$id"
        val storage = ProductStorage(
            context,
            databaseName,
            artifactDirectory,
            directorySyncFactory = directorySyncFactory,
        )
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
            eraseColor(Color.WHITE)
            Canvas(this).drawText("DOCSCAN", 20f, 80f, Paint().apply {
                color = Color.BLACK
                textSize = 24f
            })
        }
        val encoded = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { stream ->
            check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, stream))
            stream.toByteArray()
        }
        bitmap.recycle()
        val imported = storage.importImage(encoded.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "fixture.jpg")
        storage.setSelected(imported.pageId, true)
        val page = storage.visiblePages().single()
        if (addOcr) storage.commitRecognition(
            RecognitionCandidate(
                recognitionId = RecognitionId.new(),
                workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                pageId = page.pageId,
                imageVersionId = page.imageVersionId,
                contentRevision = page.contentRevision,
                desiredOperationKey = ProductActivity.OCR_OPERATION_KEY,
                recognizedText = "DOCSCAN Привет",
                geometry = RecognitionGeometry(
                    sourceWidthPx = width.toLong(),
                    sourceHeightPx = height.toLong(),
                    coordinateSpace = OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE,
                    words = listOf(
                        RecognizedWord("DOCSCAN", 20, 50, 150, 82, 99.0),
                        RecognizedWord("Привет", 25, 100, 160, 135, 96.0),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        val snapshot = storage.freezeSelectedPagesForSave()
        val source = storage.artifactPath(snapshot.pages.single().artifactRelativePath).toFile()
        val outputRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "docscan-save-candidates")
        return Fixture(storage, databaseName, artifactDirectory, snapshot, source, outputRoot)
    }

    private fun close(fixture: Fixture) {
        fixture.storage.close()
        context.deleteDatabase(fixture.databaseName)
        File(context.noBackupFilesDir, fixture.artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "docscan-save-candidates").deleteRecursively()
    }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(file.readBytes()).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

    private data class Fixture(
        var storage: ProductStorage,
        val databaseName: String,
        val artifactDirectory: String,
        val snapshot: app.docscan.core.store.SaveManifestSnapshot,
        val source: File,
        val outputRoot: File,
    )
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/ImageImportPublicationDeathInstrumentedTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Host-driven process termination after durable image bytes but before SQL registration. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class ImageImportPublicationDeathInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun sourcePublicationDeathResumeProbe() {
        val args = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments()
        val fixtureId = args.getString("fixtureId") ?: return
        val phase = args.getString("phase") ?: return
        val boundary = args.getString("boundary") ?: "SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED"
        require(boundary in setOf("SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED", "SQL_TRANSACTION_OPEN"))
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val names = fixture(context, fixtureId)
        when (phase) {
            "checkpoint" -> checkpoint(context, application, names, fixtureId, boundary)
            "resume" -> resume(context, application, names, fixtureId, boundary)
            else -> throw AssertionError("Unknown image-import phase: $phase")
        }
    }

    private fun checkpoint(
        context: android.content.Context,
        application: DocScanApplication,
        names: Fixture,
        fixtureId: String,
        boundary: String,
    ) {
        check(!context.getDatabasePath(names.database).exists())
        check(!names.artifacts.exists())
        names.root.mkdirs()
        val bytes = createJpeg()
        val source = names.root.resolve("source.jpg")
        source.writeBytes(bytes)
        val originalOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val originalProvider = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        storage.imageImportSourcePublicationBoundaryObserverForTest = { intent, artifact ->
            if (boundary == "SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED") {
                check(intent.importSessionId.value == fixtureId)
                writeCheckpoint(context, names, fixtureId, boundary, source, artifact.artifactId.value,
                    artifact.relativePath, artifact.sizeBytes, artifact.sha256)
                awaitHostKill("image source publication")
            }
        }
        storage.imageImportTransactionBoundaryObserverForTest = { command ->
            if (boundary == "SQL_TRANSACTION_OPEN") {
                writeCheckpoint(context, names, fixtureId, boundary, source, command.sourceArtifact.artifactId.value,
                    command.sourceArtifact.relativePath, command.sourceArtifact.sizeBytes, command.sourceArtifact.sha256)
                awaitHostKill("image SQL transaction")
            }
        }
        try {
            storage.importImage(source.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", source.name, ImportSessionId.parse(fixtureId))
            throw AssertionError("Host should force-stop the process before import returns")
        } finally {
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = originalProvider
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = originalOverride
        }
    }

    private fun resume(
        context: android.content.Context,
        application: DocScanApplication,
        names: Fixture,
        fixtureId: String,
        boundary: String,
    ) {
        val checkpoint = names.checkpoint.readLines().associate { it.substringBefore('=') to it.substringAfter('=') }
        assertEquals(fixtureId, checkpoint["fixture"])
        assertEquals(boundary, checkpoint["boundary"])
        val published = names.artifacts.resolve(checkpoint.getValue("artifactRelativePath"))
        assertTrue(published.isFile)
        assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("artifactSize").toLong(), published.length())
        assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("artifactSha256"), sha256(published))
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(names.database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            assertEquals(1L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", checkpoint.getValue("artifactId")))
            assertEquals(0L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
        }

        val originalOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val originalProvider = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        try {
            assertFalse("Source intent recovery must preserve app startup", storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertEquals(1, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
            assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("sourceSha256"), sha256(names.root.resolve("source.jpg")))
            assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("artifactSha256"), sha256(published))
            assertEquals(1L, imageStateCount(context, names.database, fixtureId, "COMPLETED"))
            assertEquals(1L, imagePageCount(context, names.database, fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, imageIntentCount(context, names.database, fixtureId))

            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            SystemClock.sleep(500)
            storage.close()
            val secondStartup = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
            try {
                assertFalse(secondStartup.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                assertEquals(1, secondStartup.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
                assertEquals(1L, imagePageCount(context, names.database, fixtureId))
                assertEquals(0L, imageIntentCount(context, names.database, fixtureId))
            } finally {
                secondStartup.close()
            }
            Log.i(TAG, "SOURCE_RESUME_PASS fixture=$fixtureId boundary=$boundary pages=1 artifactSha256=${checkpoint.getValue("artifactSha256")}")
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = originalProvider
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = originalOverride
            runCatching { storage.close() }
            context.deleteDatabase(names.database)
            names.artifacts.deleteRecursively()
            names.root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun writeCheckpoint(
        context: android.content.Context,
        names: Fixture,
        fixtureId: String,
        boundary: String,
        source: File,
        artifactId: String,
        relativePath: String,
        size: Long,
        hash: String,
    ) {
        val privateFile = names.artifacts.resolve(relativePath)
        assertTrue(privateFile.isFile)
        assertEquals(size, privateFile.length())
        assertEquals(hash, sha256(privateFile))
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(names.database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            assertEquals(1L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", artifactId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalar(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
        }
        names.checkpoint.writeText(listOf(
            "fixture=$fixtureId",
            "boundary=$boundary",
            "sourceSha256=${sha256(source)}",
            "artifactId=$artifactId",
            "artifactRelativePath=$relativePath",
            "artifactSize=$size",
            "artifactSha256=$hash",
        ).joinToString("\n") + "\n")
        Log.i(TAG, "SOURCE_CHECKPOINT fixture=$fixtureId boundary=$boundary artifact=$artifactId")
    }

    private fun awaitHostKill(boundary: String) {
        check(CountDownLatch(1).await(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)) { "Host did not terminate app at $boundary checkpoint" }
    }

    private fun createJpeg(): ByteArray {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(160, 120, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        return try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
                check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 94, output))
                output.toByteArray()
            }
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun fixture(context: android.content.Context, id: String): Fixture {
        require(id.matches(Regex("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}")))
        val root = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "image-import-death-$id")
        return Fixture("image-import-$id.db", File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "image-artifacts-$id"), root, File(root, "checkpoint.txt"))
    }

    private fun scalar(db: SQLiteDatabase, sql: String, arg: String): Long =
        db.rawQuery(sql, arrayOf(arg)).use { cursor -> check(cursor.moveToFirst()); cursor.getLong(0) }

    private fun imageStateCount(context: android.content.Context, database: String, id: String, state: String): Long =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use {
            scalar(it, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ? AND state = '$state'", id)
        }

    private fun imagePageCount(context: android.content.Context, database: String, id: String): Long =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use {
            scalar(it, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", id)
        }

    private fun imageIntentCount(context: android.content.Context, database: String, id: String): Long =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use {
            scalar(it, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", id)
        }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(file.readBytes())
        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private data class Fixture(val database: String, val artifacts: File, val root: File, val checkpoint: File)

    private companion object { const val TAG = "ImageImportPublicationDeath" }
}

    @Test
    fun jpegAndPngImportsRegisterExactBytesAndMimeProvenance() {
        withFixture("image-positive") { fixture ->
            listOf("image/jpeg" to "jpg", "image/png" to "png").forEach { (mime, extension) ->
                val bytes = imageBytes(if (extension == "jpg") Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG else Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG)
                val session = ImportSessionId.new()
                val page = fixture.storage.importImage(bytes.inputStream(), mime, "source.$extension", session)
                val storedPath = scalarString(fixture.context, fixture.database, """
                    SELECT ArtifactRecord.relative_storage_path FROM ArtifactRecord
                    JOIN ImageVersion ON ImageVersion.artifact_id = ArtifactRecord.artifact_id
                    WHERE ImageVersion.image_version_id = ?
                """.trimIndent(), page.imageVersionId.value)
                assertEquals(bytes.size.toLong(), fixture.artifactRoot.resolve(storedPath).length())
                assertEquals(sha256(bytes), sha256(fixture.artifactRoot.resolve(storedPath).readBytes()))
                assertEquals("$mime:source.$extension", scalarString(fixture.context, fixture.database,
                    "SELECT source_provenance FROM Page WHERE page_id = ?", page.pageId.value))
                assertEquals("COMPLETED", scalarString(fixture.context, fixture.database,
                    "SELECT state FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
                assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
            }
            assertEquals(2, fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun grantedProviderFailureDuringImageCopyLeavesNoOwnedPartialState() {
        repeat(2) { repetition ->
            withFixture("image-provider-failure-$repetition") { fixture ->
                val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                val providerContext = instrumentation.context
                val providerId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                val uri = Uri.parse("content://${PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY}/pdf/$providerId")
                val inputBytes = imageBytes(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG)
                val configure = Bundle().apply {
                    putByteArray("bytes", inputBytes)
                    putString("mime_type", "image/jpeg")
                    putString("mode", PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.MODE_FAIL_AFTER_PREFIX)
                    putInt("split", 64)
                }
                val configured = providerContext.contentResolver.call(
                    PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "configure", providerId, configure,
                )
                assertTrue(configured?.getBoolean("ok") == true)
                val grant = Bundle().apply {
                    putStringArray("target_packages", arrayOf(fixture.context.packageName, providerContext.packageName))
                }
                val granted = providerContext.contentResolver.call(
                    PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "grant", providerId, grant,
                )
                assertTrue(granted?.getBoolean("ok") == true)
                assertEquals(PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED,
                    fixture.context.checkUriPermission(uri, android.os.Process.myPid(), android.os.Process.myUid(),
                        android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION))

                val session = ImportSessionId.new()
                var ownedArtifactId: String? = null
                val sentinel = File(fixture.artifactRoot, "unrelated-sentinel.bin").apply {
                    parentFile?.mkdirs()
                    writeBytes(byteArrayOf(0x42, 0x17, 0x6a))
                }
                val sentinelBytes = sentinel.readBytes()
                try {
                    val importResult = CompletableFuture<Exception?>()
                    Thread({
                        try {
                            fixture.storage.importImageFromProvider({
                            ownedArtifactId = scalarString(fixture.context, fixture.database,
                                "SELECT artifact_id FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value)
                            fixture.context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
                            }, "image/jpeg", "provider-failure.jpg", session)
                            importResult.complete(null)
                        } catch (failure: Exception) {
                            importResult.complete(failure)
                        }
                    }, "image-provider-copy-failure-$repetition").start()
                    awaitProviderState(providerContext, providerId) { it.getBoolean("prefix_written") }
                    assertTrue("Intent must exist before the real provider stream is opened", ownedArtifactId != null)
                    var state = providerState(providerContext, providerId)
                    assertEquals(1, state?.getInt("opens"))
                    assertEquals(64, state?.getInt("bytes_written"))
                    assertEquals("WAITING_AFTER_PREFIX", state?.getString("outcome"))
                    providerContext.contentResolver.call(PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "release", providerId, null)
                    assertTrue("Provider mid-copy error must fail the import",
                        importResult.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) is Exception)
                    awaitProviderState(providerContext, providerId) { it.getString("outcome") == "FAILED_AFTER_PREFIX" }
                    state = providerState(providerContext, providerId)
                    assertEquals("FAILED_AFTER_PREFIX", state?.getString("outcome"))
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
                    val sourceId = requireNotNull(ownedArtifactId)
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", sourceId))
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
                    assertFalse(fixture.artifactRoot.resolve("objects/${sourceId.take(2)}/$sourceId.jpg").exists())
                    assertTrue(File(fixture.artifactRoot, "staging").listFiles().orEmpty().none { it.name.startsWith("$sourceId-") })
                    assertTrue(sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(sentinelBytes))

                    fixture.storage.close()
                    fixture.storage = ProductStorage(fixture.context, fixture.database, fixture.artifactDirectory)
                    assertFalse(fixture.storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", sourceId))
                    assertTrue(sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(sentinelBytes))
                } finally {
                    providerContext.contentResolver.call(PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "release", providerId, null)
                    providerContext.contentResolver.call(PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "revoke", providerId, null)
                    providerContext.contentResolver.call(PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "clear", providerId, null)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidSourceAndChangedRetryPreserveOnlyOriginalCommittedImage() {
        withFixture("image-source-failure") { fixture ->
            val session = ImportSessionId.new()

            val committed = fixture.storage.importImage(original.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "same.jpg", session)

    }

    @Test
    fun oldOpenImageSessionRecoversWithDeterministicPageOnRepeatedStartup() {
        withFixture("image-legacy-recovery") { fixture ->
            val session = ImportSessionId.new()
            val bytes = imageBytes(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG)
            val captured = fixture.storage.importImage(bytes.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "legacy.jpg", session)
            val pageId = deterministicPageId(session.value)
            val versionId = deterministicVersionId(session.value)
            val artifactPath = scalarString(fixture.context, fixture.database, """
                SELECT ArtifactRecord.relative_storage_path FROM ArtifactRecord
                JOIN ImageVersion ON ImageVersion.artifact_id = ArtifactRecord.artifact_id
                WHERE ImageVersion.image_version_id = ?
            """.trimIndent(), captured.imageVersionId.value)
            fixture.sql { db ->
                db.delete("Page", "import_session_id = ?", arrayOf(session.value))
                db.delete("ImageVersion", "image_version_id = ?", arrayOf(captured.imageVersionId.value))
                db.delete("ArtifactReference", "artifact_id = ? AND ref_kind = 'IMAGE_VERSION'", arrayOf(captured.artifactId.value))
                db.execSQL("UPDATE Workspace SET active_page_id = NULL")
                db.execSQL("UPDATE ImportSession SET state = 'OPEN' WHERE import_session_id = ?", arrayOf(session.value))
                db.execSQL("INSERT INTO ArtifactReference(artifact_id, ref_kind, ref_owner_id, protection_class) VALUES (?, 'IMPORT_SESSION', ?, 'RECOVERY')",
                    arrayOf(captured.artifactId.value, session.value))
            }
            assertEquals(1L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ? AND state = 'OPEN'", session.value))
            fixture.storage.close()
            fixture.storage = ProductStorage(fixture.context, fixture.database, fixture.artifactDirectory)
            assertFalse(fixture.storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertEquals(1L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE page_id = ?", pageId))
            assertEquals(1L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageVersion WHERE image_version_id = ?", versionId))
            assertEquals(sha256(bytes), sha256(fixture.artifactRoot.resolve(artifactPath).readBytes()))
            assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
            fixture.storage.close()
            fixture.storage = ProductStorage(fixture.context, fixture.database, fixture.artifactDirectory)
            assertFalse(fixture.storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertEquals(1L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", session.value))
            assertEquals(1L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ? AND state = 'COMPLETED'", session.value))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidLegacyOpenSessionsFailClosedWithoutDeletingDiagnosticState() {
        listOf(
            "missing-file", "corrupt-file", "malformed-context", "missing-mime",
            "mismatched-display-name", "foreign-reference", "extra-reference",
        ).forEach { scenario ->
            withFixture("image-legacy-$scenario") { fixture ->
                val snapshot = seedLegacyOpenImageSession(fixture)
                val privateFile = fixture.artifactRoot.resolve(snapshot.relativePath)
                when (scenario) {
                    "missing-file" -> assertTrue(privateFile.delete())
                    "corrupt-file" -> privateFile.writeBytes("corrupt-source-preserved".toByteArray())
                    "malformed-context" -> fixture.sql { db ->
                        db.execSQL("UPDATE ImportSession SET frozen_operation_parameters = ? WHERE import_session_id = ?",
                            arrayOf("{\"displayName\":\"legacy.jpg\",\"mimeType\":\"image/jpeg\"", snapshot.sessionId.value))
                    }
                    "missing-mime" -> fixture.sql { db ->
                        db.execSQL("UPDATE ImportSession SET frozen_operation_parameters = ? WHERE import_session_id = ?",
                            arrayOf("{\"displayName\":\"legacy.jpg\"}", snapshot.sessionId.value))
                    }
                    "mismatched-display-name" -> fixture.sql { db ->
                        db.execSQL("UPDATE ImportSession SET frozen_operation_parameters = ? WHERE import_session_id = ?",
                            arrayOf("{\"displayName\":\"different.jpg\",\"mimeType\":\"image/jpeg\"}", snapshot.sessionId.value))
                    }
                    "foreign-reference" -> fixture.sql { db ->
                        db.delete("ArtifactReference", "artifact_id = ? AND ref_kind = 'IMPORT_SESSION'", arrayOf(snapshot.artifactId))
                        db.execSQL("INSERT INTO ArtifactReference(artifact_id, ref_kind, ref_owner_id, protection_class) VALUES (?, 'IMPORT_SESSION', ?, 'RECOVERY')",
                            arrayOf(snapshot.artifactId, "foreign-owner"))
                    }
                    "extra-reference" -> fixture.sql { db ->
                        db.execSQL("INSERT INTO ArtifactReference(artifact_id, ref_kind, ref_owner_id, protection_class) VALUES (?, 'UNKNOWN_CONTEXT', ?, 'RECOVERY')",
                            arrayOf(snapshot.artifactId, "extra-owner"))
                    }
                }
                val bytesBeforeRestart = if (privateFile.exists()) privateFile.readBytes() else null
                fixture.storage.close()
                val startup = runCatching { ProductStorage(fixture.context, fixture.database, fixture.artifactDirectory) }
                val blockedStorage = startup.getOrNull()
                val diagnosedByStartupGate = scenario == "foreign-reference" || scenario == "extra-reference"
                if (diagnosedByStartupGate && blockedStorage != null) {
                    val expectedFinding = if (scenario == "foreign-reference") {
                        "IMPORT_SESSION_OWNER_MISSING"
                    } else {
                        "UNKNOWN_REFERENCE_KIND"
                    }
                    assertTrue("$scenario owner-integrity finding must block recovery", blockedStorage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                    val actualFindings = blockedStorage.artifactReferenceIntegrityFindingsAtStartup.map { it.code }
                    assertTrue(
                        "$scenario must be retained as a startup diagnostic; findings=$actualFindings",
                        expectedFinding in actualFindings,
                    )
                } else {
                    assertTrue("$scenario legacy state must block recovery", startup.isFailure)
                }
                try {
                    assertEquals(1L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ? AND state = 'OPEN'", snapshot.sessionId.value))
                    assertEquals(1L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ? AND state = 'COMMITTED'", snapshot.artifactId))
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", snapshot.sessionId.value))
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageVersion WHERE page_id = ?", deterministicPageId(snapshot.sessionId.value)))
                    assertEquals(0L, fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", snapshot.sessionId.value))
                    val refOwner = scalarStringOrNull(
                        fixture.context,
                        fixture.database,
                        "SELECT ref_owner_id FROM ArtifactReference WHERE artifact_id = ? AND ref_kind = 'IMPORT_SESSION'",
                        snapshot.artifactId,
                    )
                    assertEquals(if (scenario == "foreign-reference") "foreign-owner" else snapshot.sessionId.value, refOwner)
                    assertEquals(
                        if (scenario == "extra-reference") 2L else 1L,
                        fixture.scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactReference WHERE artifact_id = ?", snapshot.artifactId),
                    )
                    if (bytesBeforeRestart == null) assertFalse(privateFile.exists())
                    else assertTrue("$scenario source bytes must be preserved", bytesBeforeRestart.contentEquals(privateFile.readBytes()))
                } finally {
                    blockedStorage?.close()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun seedLegacyOpenImageSession(fixture: Fixture): LegacySnapshot {
        val session = ImportSessionId.new()
        val bytes = imageBytes(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG)
        val captured = fixture.storage.importImage(bytes.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "legacy.jpg", session)
        val relativePath = scalarString(fixture.context, fixture.database, """
            SELECT ArtifactRecord.relative_storage_path FROM ArtifactRecord
            JOIN ImageVersion ON ImageVersion.artifact_id = ArtifactRecord.artifact_id
            WHERE ImageVersion.image_version_id = ?
        """.trimIndent(), captured.imageVersionId.value)
        fixture.sql { db ->
            db.delete("Page", "import_session_id = ?", arrayOf(session.value))
            db.delete("ImageVersion", "image_version_id = ?", arrayOf(captured.imageVersionId.value))
            db.delete("ArtifactReference", "artifact_id = ? AND ref_kind = 'IMAGE_VERSION'", arrayOf(captured.artifactId.value))
            db.execSQL("UPDATE Workspace SET active_page_id = NULL")
            db.execSQL("UPDATE ImportSession SET state = 'OPEN' WHERE import_session_id = ?", arrayOf(session.value))
            db.execSQL("INSERT INTO ArtifactReference(artifact_id, ref_kind, ref_owner_id, protection_class) VALUES (?, 'IMPORT_SESSION', ?, 'RECOVERY')",
                arrayOf(captured.artifactId.value, session.value))
        }
        return LegacySnapshot(session, captured.artifactId.value, relativePath)
    }

    private fun withFixture(label: String, action: (Fixture) -> Unit) {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val database = "$label-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "$label-artifacts-$suffix"
        val fixture = Fixture(context, database, artifactDirectory, File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectory))
        fixture.storage = ProductStorage(context, database, artifactDirectory)
        try { action(fixture) } finally {
            runCatching { fixture.storage.close() }
            context.deleteDatabase(database)
            fixture.artifactRoot.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun imageBytes(format: Bitmap.CompressFormat, color: Int = 0xff225588.toInt()): ByteArray {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(96, 72, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(color) }
        return try { ByteArrayOutputStream().use { out -> check(bitmap.compress(format, 92, out)); out.toByteArray() } }
        finally { bitmap.recycle() }
    }

    private fun deterministicPageId(sessionId: String) = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("$sessionId:0:page".toByteArray()).toString()
    private fun deterministicVersionId(sessionId: String) = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("$sessionId:0:image-version".toByteArray()).toString()

    private fun scalarString(context: Context, database: String, query: String, arg: String): String =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            db.rawQuery(query, arrayOf(arg)).use { cursor -> check(cursor.moveToFirst()); cursor.getString(0) }
        }

    private fun scalarStringOrNull(context: Context, database: String, query: String, arg: String): String? =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            db.rawQuery(query, arrayOf(arg)).use { cursor -> if (!cursor.moveToFirst()) null else cursor.getString(0) }
        }

    private fun providerState(context: Context, fixtureId: String): Bundle? = context.contentResolver.call(
        PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "state", fixtureId, null,
    )

    private fun awaitProviderState(context: Context, fixtureId: String, predicate: (Bundle) -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(15)
        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
            val state = requireNotNull(providerState(context, fixtureId))
            if (predicate(state)) return
            Thread.sleep(10)
        }
        throw AssertionError("Provider did not reach expected state: ${providerState(context, fixtureId)?.getString("outcome")}")
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray) = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private data class Fixture(val context: Context, val database: String, val artifactDirectory: String, val artifactRoot: File) {
        lateinit var storage: ProductStorage
        fun scalar(query: String, arg: String? = null): Long = sql { db ->
            db.rawQuery(query, arg?.let { arrayOf(it) }).use { cursor -> check(cursor.moveToFirst()); cursor.getLong(0) }
        }
        fun <T> sql(action: (SQLiteDatabase) -> T): T {
            return SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(database).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READWRITE).use(action)
        }
    }

    private data class LegacySnapshot(val sessionId: ImportSessionId, val artifactId: String, val relativePath: String)
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class ManualDocumentCropInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun perspectiveCropProducesSeparateBoundedBitmapAndLeavesSourceDimensionsUnchanged() {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(300, 200, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
            eraseColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE)
        }
        try {
            val result = DocumentCropProcessor.rectifyManual(
                source,
                CropQuadrilateral(
                    NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1),
                    NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.1),
                    NormalizedCropPoint(0.8, 0.9),
                    NormalizedCropPoint(0.2, 0.9),
                ),
            )
            try {
                assertTrue(result !== source)
                assertTrue(result.width < source.width)
                assertTrue(result.height < source.height)
                assertEquals(300, source.width)
                assertEquals(200, source.height)
            } finally {
                result.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }
}

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class MultiImageImportPickerInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun realPdfImportCanBeSavedAsVerifiedSafPackageInSameActivity() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val app = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val fixtureFolder = "DocScanImportSave-$suffix"
        val displayName = "ordered-source-$suffix.pdf"
        val databaseName = "import-save-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "import-save-artifacts-$suffix"
        val candidateDirectory = "import-save-candidates-$suffix"
        val basename = "docscan-import-save-$suffix"
        val expectedOutputNames = setOf("$basename.pdf", "$basename — 01.jpg", "$basename — 02.jpg")
        val permissionsBefore = persistedPermissionUris(context)
        val source = createFixturePdf(context, fixtureFolder, displayName, EXPECTED_PDF_PAGE_COLORS.take(2))
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory, candidateDirectory)
        val priorOverride = app.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val priorProvider = app.productStorageProviderForTest
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        var tree: Uri? = null
        var namespaceWasAbsent = false
        var primaryFailure: Throwable? = null
        var cleanupFailure: Throwable? = null
        val activityIdentity = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()

        try {
            assertTrue("The isolated workspace must start empty", storage.workspaceProjection().pages.isEmpty())
            assertSourceBytesUnchanged(context, source)
            app.productStorageProviderForTest = null
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            awaitActivityReady(scenario)
            scenario.onActivity { activity -> activityIdentity.set(System.identityHashCode(activity)) }
            val device = UiDevice.getInstance(instrumentation)

            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val chooseDestination = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-destination-button")
                assertNotNull("ProductActivity destination chooser must be visible", chooseDestination)
                assertTrue("Destination chooser must be enabled", requireNotNull(chooseDestination).isEnabled)
                chooseDestination.performClick()
            }
            selectDocumentsDestination(device)
            awaitActivityResumed(scenario)
            val grant = awaitValue("real SAF destination grant") { storage.destinationGrant() }
            val selectedTree = Uri.parse(grant.treeUri)
            tree = selectedTree
            assertEquals("primary:Documents", DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(selectedTree))
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertEquals("The same live ProductActivity returns from destination selection",
                    activityIdentity.get(), System.identityHashCode(activity))
            }

            val runtimeReady = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(context, storage).ensureReady(selectedTree.toString())
            val qualificationId = runtimeReady.qualificationId
            assertEquals("Runtime readiness is tied to this exact destination", selectedTree.toString(),
                org.json.JSONObject(runtimeReady.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload).getString("treeUri"))
            assertTrue("No pre-existing output uses this unique basename",
                providerChildren(context, selectedTree).none { it.second in expectedOutputNames })
            namespaceWasAbsent = true

            clickImport(scenario)
            chooseFixtureDocuments(device, fixtureFolder, listOf(displayName))
            awaitActivityResumed(scenario)
            awaitCondition("Both source PDF pages must import into the isolated workspace") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size == 2
            }
            val importedPages = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
            assertTrue("Real picker import selects both new Pages", importedPages.all { it.selected })
            val pageRecords = pageRecords(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName), importedPages)
            assertEquals(listOf(0L, 1L), pageRecords.map { it.sourcePageIndex })
            assertEquals("PDF pages share one source session", 1, pageRecords.map { it.importSessionId }.distinct().size)
            assertEquals(listOf("application/pdf:$displayName"), pageRecords.map { it.sourceProvenance }.distinct())
            val importSession = importSessionRecords(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName)).single()
            assertEquals("COMPLETED", importSession.state)
            assertEquals(displayName, importSession.displayName)
            assertEquals(sha256(source.bytes), privateSourceSha256(
                context.getDatabasePath(databaseName), artifactDirectory, importSession.sourceSnapshotArtifactId,
            ))
            importedPages.zip(EXPECTED_PDF_PAGE_COLORS.take(2)).forEachIndexed { index, (page, expectedColor) ->
                val image = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(storage.artifactPath(page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().absolutePath)
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Imported Page $index must decode")
                try { assertColorNear("Imported Page $index", image.getPixel(image.width / 2, image.height / 2), expectedColor) }
                finally { image.recycle() }
            }
            assertSourceBytesUnchanged(context, source)
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertEquals("The same live ProductActivity must continue through both system pickers",
                    activityIdentity.get(), System.identityHashCode(activity))
            }

            awaitCondition("Imported selected Pages must enable Activity Save") {
                var enabled = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    enabled = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled == true
                }
                enabled
            }
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                requireNotNull(activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")).performClick()
            }
            assertTrue("Save name dialog appears", device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.clazz("android.widget.EditText")), TIMEOUT_MILLIS))
            device.findObject(By.clazz("android.widget.EditText")).text = basename
            val saveAction = By.text("Save selected pages")
            assertTrue("Save confirmation is available", device.wait(Until.hasObject(saveAction), TIMEOUT_MILLIS))
            device.findObject(saveAction).click()

            val recent = awaitValue("Complete SAF package is confirmed") { storage.recentDocuments().singleOrNull() }
            val exportPackage = requireNotNull(storage.externalExportPackage(recent.exportArtifactId))
            assertEquals("SUCCEEDED", exportPackage.state)
            assertEquals("The exported package must reference the actual runtime readiness record",
                qualificationId, exportPackage.providerQualificationId)
            val packageOutputs = exportPackage.outputs.sortedBy { it.ordinal }
            assertEquals(3, packageOutputs.size)
            assertEquals(listOf(0L, 1L, 2L), packageOutputs.map { it.ordinal })
            assertEquals(listOf("$basename.pdf", "$basename — 01.jpg", "$basename — 02.jpg"),
                packageOutputs.map { it.displayName })
            val committedOutputs = storage.committedExportOutputs(recent.exportArtifactId).associateBy { it.artifactId }
            val attempts = storage.exportAttempts(recent.exportArtifactId).associateBy { it.outputArtifactId }
            assertEquals(3, committedOutputs.size)
            assertEquals(3, attempts.size)
            assertTrue("Every package output is confirmed", attempts.values.all { it.state == "SUCCEEDED" })
            val providerBytesByName = packageOutputs.associate { packageOutput ->
                val attempt = requireNotNull(attempts[packageOutput.outputArtifactId])
                val output = requireNotNull(committedOutputs[packageOutput.outputArtifactId])
                val bytes = requireNotNull(context.contentResolver.openInputStream(Uri.parse(attempt.externalIdentity))).use { it.readBytes() }
                assertEquals("Read-back size matches private committed artifact", output.sizeBytes, bytes.size.toLong())
                assertEquals("Read-back checksum matches private committed artifact", output.sha256, sha256(bytes))
                packageOutput.displayName to bytes
            }
            val pdfBytes = requireNotNull(providerBytesByName[packageOutputs.first().displayName])
            PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(context)
            PDDocument.load(ByteArrayInputStream(pdfBytes)).use { document ->
                assertEquals("Saved PDF retains the two imported source pages", 2, document.numberOfPages)
                val renderer = PDFRenderer(document)
                EXPECTED_PDF_PAGE_COLORS.take(2).forEachIndexed { index, expectedColor ->
                    val image = renderer.renderImage(index, 0.25f)
                    try { assertColorNear("Saved PDF page $index", image.getPixel(image.width / 2, image.height / 2), expectedColor) }
                    finally { image.recycle() }
                }
            }
            packageOutputs.drop(1).zip(EXPECTED_PDF_PAGE_COLORS.take(2)).forEach { (packageOutput, expectedColor) ->
                val bytes = requireNotNull(providerBytesByName[packageOutput.displayName])
