package app.docscan.android

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLangMode
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toPlainText
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Typeface
import com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI
import java.io.File
import java.util.Locale
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Synthetic, reproducible benchmark; results are diagnostics, not claims about real camera scans. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class OcrQualityBenchmarkInstrumentedTest {
    private val context get() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext

    @Test
    fun benchmarkSyntheticPagesAcrossProfilesSegmentationModesAndModelSets() {
        val bestAssets = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().context.assets
            .list("tessdata-best").orEmpty().toSet()
        assumeTrue(
            "Prepare the pinned validation models with tools/prepare_ocr_benchmark_assets.py",
            setOf("eng.traineddata", "rus.traineddata", "spa.traineddata").all(bestAssets::contains),
        )
        val report = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-quality-benchmark.csv")
        val bestRoot = OcrQualityTestSupport.installBestModels(context)
        val lines = mutableListOf(
            "fixture,model,profile,psm,cer,order_ok,elapsed_ms,peak_pss_kb,truth,recognized",
        )
        val fixtures = OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures

        TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { fast ->
            fixtures.forEach { fixture ->
                record(lines, fixture, "fast", OcrRunSettings(), fast)
            }
            listOf("shadow", "small", "en").forEach { id ->
                val fixture = fixtures.first { it.id == id }
                OcrImageProfile.entries.forEach { profile ->
                    record(lines, fixture, "fast", OcrRunSettings(TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_AUTO, profile), fast)
                }
            }
            listOf("columns", "receipt").forEach { id ->
                val fixture = fixtures.first { it.id == id }
                listOf(
                    TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_AUTO,
                    TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_SINGLE_COLUMN,
                    TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_SINGLE_BLOCK,
                    TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_SPARSE_TEXT,
                ).forEach { psm ->
                    record(lines, fixture, "fast", OcrRunSettings(psm, OcrImageProfile.ORIGINAL), fast)
                }
            }
        }

        listOf("ru", "en", "es").forEach { id ->
            val fixture = fixtures.first { it.id == id }
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context, modelDataRootOverride = bestRoot).use { best ->
                record(lines, fixture, "best", OcrRunSettings(), best)
            }
        }

        TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { fast -> runLargePageCropProbe(lines, fast) }

        report.writeText(lines.joinToString("\n", postfix = "\n"))
        android.util.Log.i("DocScanOcrBenchmark", "CSV=${report.absolutePath}\n${lines.joinToString("\n")}")
        assertEquals("twelve synthetic fixture pages are present", 12, fixtures.size)
        assertEquals("all 12 fixture baselines were measured", 12, fixtures.count { fixture ->
            lines.any { it.startsWith("${fixture.id},fast,ORIGINAL,${TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_AUTO},") }
        })
    }

    private fun record(
        output: MutableList<String>,
        fixture: OcrFixture,
        model: String,
        settings: OcrRunSettings,
        adapter: TesseractOcrAdapter,
    ) {
        val image = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context, fixture)
        try {
            lateinit var result: TesseractOcrAdapter.OcrResult
            val measurement = OcrQualityTestSupport.measure {
                result = adapter.recognizeDetailed(
                    image,
                    mode = when (fixture.id) {
                        "es" -> OcrLangMode.ES_EN
                        "mixed" -> OcrLangMode.RU_ES_EN
                        "ru" -> OcrLangMode.RU_EN
                        else -> OcrLangMode.RU_EN
                    },
                    settings = settings,
                )
            }
            val expectedTokens = words(fixture.truth)
            val actualTokens = words(result.text)
            val orderOk = isSubsequence(expectedTokens, actualTokens)
            val cer = OcrQualityTestSupport.cer(fixture.truth, result.text)
            output += listOf(
                fixture.id, model, settings.imageProfile.name, settings.pageSegMode.toString(),
                "%.5f".format(Locale.ROOT, cer), orderOk.toString(), measurement.elapsedMs.toString(),
                measurement.peakPssKb.toString(), csv(fixture.truth), csv(result.text.replace('\n', ' ')),
            ).joinToString(",")
            android.util.Log.i(
                "DocScanOcrBenchmark",
                "${fixture.id},$model,${settings.imageProfile},psm=${settings.pageSegMode}," +
                    "CER=${"%.3f".format(Locale.ROOT, cer)},order=$orderOk," +
                    "elapsed=${measurement.elapsedMs}ms,peakPSS=${measurement.peakPssKb}KB",
            )
        } finally { image.delete() }
    }

    /** Compares the former 4MP power-of-two decode with the current precise 6MP OCR decode. */
    private fun runLargePageCropProbe(output: MutableList<String>, adapter: TesseractOcrAdapter) {
        val rows = (0 until 22).map { row -> "ID%02d TOTAL %06d REF %04d".format(Locale.ROOT, row + 1, 125000 + row, 8000 + row) }
        val truth = rows.joinToString("\n")
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(4000, 3000, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val image = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-quality-12mp-${System.nanoTime()}.jpg")
        try {
            val canvas = Canvas(source)
            canvas.drawColor(Color.WHITE)
            val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
                color = Color.BLACK
                typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.NORMAL)
                textSize = 32f
            }
            rows.forEachIndexed { index, row -> canvas.drawText(row, 150f, 140f + index * 125f, paint) }
            image.outputStream().use { outputStream ->
                check(source.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 96, outputStream))
                outputStream.fd.sync()
            }
        } finally { source.recycle() }

        try {
            val oldBitmap = ProductImageDecoder.decode(image, 4L * 1024L * 1024L, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                ?: error("legacy 4MP decoder returned no bitmap")
            try {
                lateinit var oldText: String
                val measurement = OcrQualityTestSupport.measure {
                    oldText = adapter.recognize(oldBitmap, OcrLangMode.RU_EN).toPlainText()
                }
                appendCropRow(output, "crop-legacy-4mp", oldBitmap.width, oldBitmap.height, truth, oldText, measurement)
            } finally { oldBitmap.recycle() }

            val preciseBitmap = ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(image, 6L * 1024L * 1024L)
            try {
                lateinit var preciseText: String
                val measurement = OcrQualityTestSupport.measure {
                    preciseText = adapter.recognize(preciseBitmap, OcrLangMode.RU_EN).toPlainText()
                }
                appendCropRow(output, "crop-current-6mp", preciseBitmap.width, preciseBitmap.height, truth, preciseText, measurement)
                assertTrue("precise decode retains more pixels than the former 4MP path",
                    preciseBitmap.width.toLong() * preciseBitmap.height > 2_000L * 1_500L)
            } finally { preciseBitmap.recycle() }
        } finally { image.delete() }
    }

    private fun appendCropRow(
        output: MutableList<String>,
        id: String,
        width: Int,
        height: Int,
        truth: String,
        recognized: String,
        measurement: OcrMeasurement,
    ) {
        val orderOk = isSubsequence(words(truth), words(recognized))
        val cer = OcrQualityTestSupport.cer(truth, recognized)
        output += listOf(id, "fast", "ORIGINAL", TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_AUTO.toString(),
            "%.5f".format(Locale.ROOT, cer), orderOk.toString(), measurement.elapsedMs.toString(),
            measurement.peakPssKb.toString(), csv("${width}x$height; $truth"), csv(recognized.replace('\n', ' ')))
            .joinToString(",")
        android.util.Log.i("DocScanOcrBenchmark", "$id ${width}x$height CER=$cer order=$orderOk " +
            "elapsed=${measurement.elapsedMs}ms peakPSS=${measurement.peakPssKb}KB")
    }

    private fun words(text: String): List<String> = Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}]+")
        .findAll(text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)).map { it.value }.toList()

    private fun isSubsequence(expected: List<String>, actual: List<String>): Boolean {
        if (expected.isEmpty()) return actual.isEmpty()
        var next = 0
        actual.forEach { if (it == expected[next]) next++ else Unit
            if (next == expected.size) return true
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun csv(value: String): String = "\"${value.replace("\"", "\"\"")}\""

}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.exifinterface.media.ExifInterface
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLangMode
import com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class OcrQualityRegressionInstrumentedTest {
    private val context get() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext

    @Test
    fun blankAndCorruptInputsStayDistinctAndNeverInventWordGeometry() {
        val blank = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context, OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "blank" })
        val corrupt = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-corrupt-${System.nanoTime()}.png").apply { writeText("not an image") }
        try {
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { adapter ->
                val result = adapter.recognizeDetailed(blank, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_ES_EN)
                assertTrue("blank page should return blank text", result.text.isBlank())
                assertTrue("blank page should not contain invented geometry", result.geometry.words.isEmpty())
                assertTrue(result.layout.blocks.isEmpty())

                try {
                    adapter.recognizeDetailed(corrupt, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN)
                    throw AssertionError("corrupt image should be reported as an error")
                } catch (failure: Exception) {
                    assertFalse("decode errors must not be reported as cancellation", failure is CancellationException)
                }
            }
        } finally { blank.delete(); corrupt.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelledBeforeDecodePropagatesWithoutStartingNativeRecognition() {
        val file = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context, OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "en" })
        val progress = AtomicReference(false)
        try {
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context, { progress.set(true) }).use { adapter ->
                try {
                    adapter.recognizeDetailed(file, isCancelled = { true }, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN)
                    throw AssertionError("cancellation should propagate")
                } catch (_: CancellationException) { }
                assertFalse("pre-cancelled request must not enter native recognition", progress.get())
            }
        } finally { file.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelCurrentRecognitionStopsAnActiveNativePass() {
        val file = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context, OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "dense" })
        val recoveryFile = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context,
            OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "en" })
        val nativeProgress = CountDownLatch(1)
        val outcome = AtomicReference<Throwable?>(null)
        val finished = CountDownLatch(1)
        val adapter = TesseractOcrAdapter(context, { nativeProgress.countDown() })
        val worker = Thread {
            try { adapter.recognizeDetailed(file, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN) }
            catch (failure: Throwable) { outcome.set(failure) }
            finally { finished.countDown() }
        }
        try {
            worker.start()
            assertTrue("Tesseract progress callback did not arrive", nativeProgress.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            adapter.cancelCurrentRecognition()
            assertTrue("recognition did not stop after cancellation", finished.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue("active cancellation should propagate, got ${outcome.get()}", outcome.get() is CancellationException)
            val recovered = adapter.recognizeDetailed(recoveryFile, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN)
            assertTrue("adapter should process the next request after cancellation: ${recovered.text}",
                recovered.text.contains("Invoice") && recovered.text.contains("504821"))
        } finally {
            adapter.close(); worker.interrupt(); file.delete(); recoveryFile.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun twelveMegapixelSourceRemainsFullResolutionWhenAllowed() {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(4000, 3000, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val file = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-12mp-${System.nanoTime()}.jpg")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(file).use { output ->
                assertTrue(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output))
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            val decoded = ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(file, 12L * 1024L * 1024L)
            try {
                assertEquals(4000, decoded.width)
                assertEquals(3000, decoded.height)
            } finally { decoded.recycle() }
        } finally { bitmap.recycle(); file.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun preciseDecoderMatchesLegacyExifOrientationForRotateAndFlip() {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(120, 80, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val canvas = android.graphics.Canvas(source)
        canvas.drawColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE)
        val paint = android.graphics.Paint().apply { color = android.graphics.Color.RED }
        canvas.drawRect(0f, 0f, 58f, 38f, paint)
        paint.color = android.graphics.Color.BLUE
        canvas.drawRect(62f, 42f, 120f, 80f, paint)
        val file = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-exif-${System.nanoTime()}.jpg")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(file).use { output ->
                assertTrue(source.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 100, output))
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            listOf(
                ExifInterface.ORIENTATION_ROTATE_90,
                ExifInterface.ORIENTATION_ROTATE_270,
                ExifInterface.ORIENTATION_FLIP_HORIZONTAL,
            ).forEach { orientation ->
                ExifInterface(file).apply {
                    setAttribute(ExifInterface.TAG_ORIENTATION, orientation.toString())
                    saveAttributes()
                }
                val precise = ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(file, 1_000_000)
                val legacy = ProductImageDecoder.decode(file, 1_000_000, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                    ?: error("legacy decoder returned no image")
                try {
                    assertEquals("EXIF orientation $orientation width", legacy.width, precise.width)
                    assertEquals("EXIF orientation $orientation height", legacy.height, precise.height)
                    listOf(0.15f to 0.15f, 0.85f to 0.85f, 0.15f to 0.85f, 0.85f to 0.15f).forEach { (x, y) ->
                        val px = (precise.width * x).toInt().coerceAtMost(precise.width - 1)
                        val py = (precise.height * y).toInt().coerceAtMost(precise.height - 1)
                        val a = precise.getPixel(px, py)
                        val b = legacy.getPixel(px, py)
                        val delta = listOf(
                            kotlin.math.abs(android.graphics.Color.red(a) - android.graphics.Color.red(b)),
                            kotlin.math.abs(android.graphics.Color.green(a) - android.graphics.Color.green(b)),
                            kotlin.math.abs(android.graphics.Color.blue(a) - android.graphics.Color.blue(b)),
                        ).maxOrNull() ?: 0
                        assertTrue("EXIF orientation $orientation changed corner pixels", delta < 40)
                    }
                } finally { precise.recycle(); legacy.recycle() }
            }
        } finally { source.recycle(); file.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun invoiceNumberAndAmountSurviveRecognition() {
        val file = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context, OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "en" })
        try {
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { adapter ->
                val text = adapter.recognizeDetailed(file, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN).text
                assertTrue("invoice identifier missing: $text", text.contains("504821"))
                assertTrue("invoice amount missing: $text", text.contains("127.45"))
            }
        } finally { file.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun pageSegmentationAndPhotometricProfilesPreserveSourceCoordinates() {
        val file = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context, OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "shadow" })
        try {
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { adapter ->
                val result = adapter.recognizeDetailed(
                    file,
                    mode = OcrLangMode.RU_ES_EN,
                    settings = OcrRunSettings(TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_AUTO, OcrImageProfile.LIGHTING),
                )
                assertEquals(OcrQualityTestSupport.WIDTH.toLong(), result.geometry.sourceWidthPx)
                assertEquals(OcrQualityTestSupport.HEIGHT.toLong(), result.geometry.sourceHeightPx)
                assertFalse("nonblank page should have real recognized words", result.geometry.words.isEmpty())
                assertTrue(result.geometry.words.all { word ->
                    word.leftPx >= 0 && word.topPx >= 0 &&
                        word.rightPx <= OcrQualityTestSupport.WIDTH && word.bottomPx <= OcrQualityTestSupport.HEIGHT
                })
            }
        } finally { file.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun automaticLightingOnlyPreprocessesUnevenBackgroundAndKeepsItsText() {
        val clearFile = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context,
            OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "en" })
        val shadowFile = OcrQualityTestSupport.savePng(context,
            OcrQualityTestSupport.fixtures.first { it.id == "shadow" })
        try {
            val clear = ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(clearFile, 6L * 1024L * 1024L)
            val shadow = ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(shadowFile, 6L * 1024L * 1024L)
            try {
                assertEquals(OcrImageProfile.ORIGINAL, OcrImagePreparation.suggestProfile(clear))
                assertEquals(OcrImageProfile.LIGHTING, OcrImagePreparation.suggestProfile(shadow))
            } finally { clear.recycle(); shadow.recycle() }

            TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { adapter ->
                val result = adapter.recognizeDetailed(shadowFile, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN)
                assertTrue("adaptive OCR should preserve the synthetic receipt truth: ${result.text}",
                    result.text.contains("RECEIPT 8831") && result.text.contains("Coffee 2.50") &&
                        result.text.contains("TOTAL 2.50 EUR"))
                assertTrue("quality metadata should identify applied lighting correction",
                    result.layout.quality?.preprocessingProfile?.startsWith("LIGHTING:") == true)
            }
        } finally { clearFile.delete(); shadowFile.delete() }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.LinearGradient
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Shader
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.os.Debug
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

internal data class OcrFixture(val id: String, val truth: String, val draw: (Canvas, Paint) -> Unit)

internal data class OcrMeasurement(val elapsedMs: Long, val peakPssKb: Long)

internal object OcrQualityTestSupport {
    const val WIDTH = 1600
    const val HEIGHT = 2100

    val fixtures = listOf(
        OcrFixture("ru", "Документ № 8472\nПроверка качества текста\nСумма 1250,50 руб.") { c, p ->
            lines(c, p, listOf("Документ № 8472", "Проверка качества текста", "Сумма 1250,50 руб."), 105)
        },
        OcrFixture("en", "Invoice 504821\nCustomer: Anna Smith\nTotal: 127.45 USD") { c, p ->
            lines(c, p, listOf("Invoice 504821", "Customer: Anna Smith", "Total: 127.45 USD"), 105)
        },
        OcrFixture("es", "Mañana acción\nNiña café pingüino\nNúmero 4821 ¿Sí? ¡Claro!") { c, p ->
            lines(c, p, listOf("Mañana acción", "Niña café pingüino", "Número 4821 ¿Sí? ¡Claro!"), 105)
        },
        OcrFixture("numbers", "INV-2026/10\n+34 612 345 678\n€ 1.234,56  98.7%") { c, p ->
            lines(c, p, listOf("INV-2026/10", "+34 612 345 678", "€ 1.234,56  98.7%"), 105)
        },
        OcrFixture("shadow", "RECEIPT 8831\nCoffee 2.50\nTOTAL 2.50 EUR") { c, p ->
            c.drawRect(0f, 0f, WIDTH.toFloat(), HEIGHT.toFloat(), Paint().apply {
                shader = LinearGradient(0f, 0f, WIDTH.toFloat(), 0f, Color.rgb(122, 122, 122), Color.WHITE, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP)
            })
            lines(c, p, listOf("RECEIPT 8831", "Coffee 2.50", "TOTAL 2.50 EUR"), 100)
        },
        OcrFixture("small", "Small print 2026\nKeep this receipt\nReference 008412") { c, p ->
            lines(c, p, listOf("Small print 2026", "Keep this receipt", "Reference 008412"), 28)
        },
        OcrFixture("skew", "DOCUMENT ANGLE\nRotate five degrees\nNumber 7319") { c, p ->
            c.save(); c.rotate(-5f, WIDTH / 2f, HEIGHT / 2f)
            lines(c, p, listOf("DOCUMENT ANGLE", "Rotate five degrees", "Number 7319"), 100)
            c.restore()
        },
        OcrFixture("columns", "LEFT ALPHA 101\nLEFT BETA 202\nRIGHT GAMMA 303\nRIGHT DELTA 404") { c, p ->
            p.textSize = 54f
            listOf("LEFT ALPHA 101", "LEFT BETA 202", "RIGHT GAMMA 303", "RIGHT DELTA 404").forEachIndexed { i, s ->
                c.drawText(s, if (i < 2) 80f else 850f, if (i % 2 == 0) 420f else 540f, p)
            }
        },
        OcrFixture("receipt", "STORE MARKET\nMilk 2.49\nBread 1.25\nTOTAL 3.74\nTHANK YOU") { c, p ->
            lines(c, p, listOf("STORE MARKET", "Milk 2.49", "Bread 1.25", "TOTAL 3.74", "THANK YOU"), 82)
        },
        OcrFixture("blank", "") { _, _ -> },
        OcrFixture("dense", (0 until 50).joinToString("\n") { "Row $it INV ${10000 + it} TOTAL 98.76" }) { c, p ->
            p.textSize = 24f
            (0 until 50).forEach { row -> c.drawText("Row $row INV ${10000 + row} TOTAL 98.76", 70f, 300f + row * 34f, p) }
        },
        OcrFixture("mixed", "Документ Invoice 2718\nEspaña: acción, pingüino\nИтого / Total 99,95") { c, p ->
            lines(c, p, listOf("Документ Invoice 2718", "España: acción, pingüino", "Итого / Total 99,95"), 90)
        },
    )

    fun bitmap(fixture: OcrFixture): Bitmap {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(WIDTH, HEIGHT, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val canvas = Canvas(bitmap)
        canvas.drawColor(Color.WHITE)
        val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            color = Color.BLACK
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.NORMAL)
            textSize = 92f
        }
        fixture.draw(canvas, paint)
        return bitmap
    }

    fun savePng(context: Context, fixture: OcrFixture): File {
        val bitmap = bitmap(fixture)
        val file = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-quality-${fixture.id}-${System.nanoTime()}.png")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(file).use { output ->
                check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, output))
                output.fd.sync()
            }
        } finally { bitmap.recycle() }
        return file
    }

    fun measure(block: () -> Unit): OcrMeasurement {
        val running = AtomicBoolean(true)
        val peak = AtomicLong(Debug.getPss().toLong())
        val sampler = Thread {
            while (running.get()) {
                peak.accumulateAndGet(Debug.getPss().toLong(), ::maxOf)
                try { Thread.sleep(40) } catch (_: InterruptedException) { return@Thread }
            }
        }.apply { name = "ocr-pss-sampler"; isDaemon = true; start() }
        val started = System.nanoTime()
        try { block() } finally {
            val elapsed = (System.nanoTime() - started) / 1_000_000
            running.set(false); sampler.join(1_000)
            peak.accumulateAndGet(Debug.getPss().toLong(), ::maxOf)
            lastMeasurement = OcrMeasurement(elapsed, peak.get())
        }
        return lastMeasurement
    }

    @Volatile private var lastMeasurement = OcrMeasurement(0, 0)

    fun cer(expected: String, actual: String): Double {
        val a = expected.filterNot(Char::isWhitespace).lowercase().toList()
        val b = actual.filterNot(Char::isWhitespace).lowercase().toList()
        if (a.isEmpty()) return if (b.isEmpty()) 0.0 else 1.0
        var previous = IntArray(b.size + 1) { it }
        for (i in a.indices) {
            val current = IntArray(b.size + 1); current[0] = i + 1
            for (j in b.indices) current[j + 1] = minOf(
                current[j] + 1, previous[j + 1] + 1,
                previous[j] + if (a[i] == b[j]) 0 else 1,
            )
            previous = current
        }
        return previous.last().toDouble() / a.size
    }

    fun installBestModels(context: Context): File {
        val root = File(context.cacheDir, "tessdata-best-validation")
        val tessdata = File(root, "tessdata")
        check(tessdata.isDirectory || tessdata.mkdirs())
        val testAssets = androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().context.assets
        listOf("eng", "rus", "spa").forEach { lang ->
            val output = File(tessdata, "$lang.traineddata")
            testAssets.open("tessdata-best/$lang.traineddata").use { input ->
                FileOutputStream(output).use { it.write(input.readBytes()); it.fd.sync() }
            }
        }
        return root
    }

    private fun lines(canvas: Canvas, paint: Paint, values: List<String>, size: Int) {
        paint.textSize = size.toFloat()
        values.forEachIndexed { index, line -> canvas.drawText(line, 100f, 360f + index * (size + 80f), paint) }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLangMode
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.text.Normalizer
import java.util.Locale
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Public FUNSD testing scans; metrics are word-set recall, not annotated reading order. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class OcrRealScanBenchmarkInstrumentedTest {
    private val instrumentation get() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private val context get() = instrumentation.targetContext

    @Test
    fun benchmarkTenPublicScansWithAdaptiveOriginalAndBestModels() {
        val assets = instrumentation.context.assets
        val corpusFiles = assets.list("funsd").orEmpty().toSet()
        val bestFiles = assets.list("tessdata-best").orEmpty().toSet()
        assumeTrue(
            "Prepare FUNSD and pinned best models with tools/prepare_ocr_benchmark_assets.py",
            corpusFiles.contains("manifest.json") &&
                listOf("eng.traineddata", "rus.traineddata", "spa.traineddata").all(bestFiles::contains),
        )
        val manifest = JSONObject(assets.open("funsd/manifest.json").bufferedReader().use { it.readText() })
        val pages = manifest.getJSONArray("pages")
        assertEquals("the public corpus snapshot contains ten pages", 10, pages.length())
        val report = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-funsd-benchmark.csv")
        val rows = mutableListOf("fixture,model,profile,annotated_words,word_recall,numeric_recall,elapsed_ms,peak_pss_kb")
        val preparedImages = mutableListOf<File>()
        val bestRoot = OcrQualityTestSupport.installBestModels(context)
        try {
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { fast ->
                TesseractOcrAdapter(context, modelDataRootOverride = bestRoot).use { best ->
                    for (index in 0 until pages.length()) {
                        val id = pages.getJSONObject(index).getString("id")
                        val image = copyAsset("funsd/$id.png", "funsd-$id.png")
                        val annotation = JSONObject(assets.open("funsd/$id.json").bufferedReader().use { it.readText() })
                        preparedImages += image
                        val truth = annotationTokens(annotation)
                        record(rows, id, truth, "fast", "ADAPTIVE", fast) {
                            it.recognizeDetailed(image, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN)
                        }
                        record(rows, id, truth, "fast", "ORIGINAL", fast) {
                            it.recognizeDetailed(image, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN,
                                settings = OcrRunSettings(autoLighting = false))
                        }
                        if (index < 3) {
                            record(rows, id, truth, "best", "ORIGINAL", best) {
                                it.recognizeDetailed(image, mode = OcrLangMode.RU_EN,
                                    settings = OcrRunSettings(autoLighting = false))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally { preparedImages.forEach(File::delete) }
        report.writeText(rows.joinToString("\n", postfix = "\n"))
        android.util.Log.i("DocScanRealOcrBenchmark", "CSV=${report.absolutePath}\n${rows.joinToString("\n")}")
        assertTrue("all 10 pages have adaptive and ORIGINAL rows", rows.size >= 1 + 10 * 2)
    }

    private fun record(
        output: MutableList<String>,
        id: String,
        truth: List<String>,
        model: String,
        profile: String,
        adapter: TesseractOcrAdapter,
        recognize: (TesseractOcrAdapter) -> TesseractOcrAdapter.OcrResult,
    ) {
        lateinit var result: TesseractOcrAdapter.OcrResult
        val measure = OcrQualityTestSupport.measure { result = recognize(adapter) }
        val prediction = tokens(result.text)
        val all = multisetRecall(truth, prediction)
        val numeric = multisetRecall(truth.filter(::isNumeric), prediction.filter(::isNumeric))
        val row = listOf(
            id, model, profile, truth.size.toString(), "%.5f".format(Locale.ROOT, all),
            "%.5f".format(Locale.ROOT, numeric), measure.elapsedMs.toString(), measure.peakPssKb.toString(),
        ).joinToString(",")
        output += row
        android.util.Log.i("DocScanRealOcrBenchmark", row)
    }

    private fun copyAsset(assetPath: String, name: String): File = File(context.cacheDir, name).also { target ->
        instrumentation.context.assets.open(assetPath).use { input ->
            target.outputStream().use { output -> input.copyTo(output) }
        }
    }

    private fun annotationTokens(annotation: JSONObject): List<String> {
        val result = mutableListOf<String>()
        val form = annotation.getJSONArray("form")
        for (i in 0 until form.length()) {
            val words = form.getJSONObject(i).optJSONArray("words") ?: continue
            for (j in 0 until words.length()) result += tokens(words.getJSONObject(j).optString("text"))
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun tokens(text: String): List<String> = Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}]+")
        .findAll(Normalizer.normalize(text, Normalizer.Form.NFKC).lowercase(Locale.ROOT))
        .map { it.value }.toList()

    private fun isNumeric(token: String): Boolean = token.any(Char::isDigit)

    private fun multisetRecall(truth: List<String>, prediction: List<String>): Double {
        if (truth.isEmpty()) return 1.0
        val available = prediction.groupingBy { it }.eachCount().toMutableMap()
        val matched = truth.count { token ->
            val count = available[token] ?: 0
            if (count > 0) available[token] = count - 1
            count > 0
        }
        return matched.toDouble() / truth.size
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.edit.PageImageEditState
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PageImageAdjustmentProcessorInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun brightnessAndContrastCreateEditedPixelsWithoutMutatingSource() {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(4, 3, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(Color.GRAY) }
        try {
            val original = source.getPixel(1, 1)
            val edited = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.render(
                source,
                PageImageEditState(brightness = 25, contrastPercent = 150),
            )
            try {
                assertNotEquals(original, edited.getPixel(1, 1))
                assertEquals(original, source.getPixel(1, 1))
            } finally {
                edited.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rotationChangesDimensionsAndSharpnessStaysWithinPixelRange() {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(3, 2, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        source.setPixel(1, 1, Color.WHITE)
        try {
            val edited = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.render(
                source,
                PageImageEditState(clockwiseTurns = 1, sharpnessPercent = 150),
            )
            try {
                assertEquals(2, edited.width)
                assertEquals(3, edited.height)
                val pixel = edited.getPixel(0, 0)
                assertTrue(Color.alpha(pixel) in 0..255)
                assertTrue(Color.red(pixel) in 0..255)
            } finally {
                edited.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/PageImageAdjustmentRowsRegressionInstrumentedTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Matrix
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.edit.PageImageEditState
import java.util.Random
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PageImageAdjustmentRowsRegressionInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun rowRendererMatchesPreviousFullArrayAlgorithmForSmallAndSeededImages() {
        val random = Random(0xD0C5CAFL)
        val dimensions = listOf(1 to 1, 1 to 9, 11 to 1, 2 to 2, 17 to 13, 29 to 7)
        val states = listOf(
            PageImageEditState(),
            PageImageEditState(brightness = -100, contrastPercent = 0),
            PageImageEditState(brightness = 100, contrastPercent = 200),
            PageImageEditState(brightness = -37, contrastPercent = 175, sharpnessPercent = 100),
            PageImageEditState(brightness = 42, contrastPercent = 0, sharpnessPercent = 200),
            PageImageEditState(brightness = 0, contrastPercent = 200, sharpnessPercent = 1),
        )

        dimensions.forEach { (width, height) ->
            val pixels = IntArray(width * height) {
                (random.nextInt(256) shl 24) or
                    (random.nextInt(256) shl 16) or
                    (random.nextInt(256) shl 8) or
                    random.nextInt(256)
            }
            val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
                setPixels(pixels, 0, width, 0, 0, width, height)
            }
            try {
                for (turns in 0..3) for (parameters in states) {
                    val state = parameters.copy(clockwiseTurns = turns)
                    val expected = renderWithPreviousFullArrayAlgorithm(source, state)
                    val actual = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.render(source, state)
                    try {
                        assertEquals("width for ${width}x$height, $state", expected.width, actual.width)
                        assertEquals("height for ${width}x$height, $state", expected.height, actual.height)
                        assertArrayEquals(
                            "pixels for seeded ${width}x$height, $state",
                            pixelsOf(expected),
                            pixelsOf(actual),
                        )
                    } finally {
                        expected.recycle()
                        actual.recycle()
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                source.recycle()
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun noOpRenderReturnsIndependentBitmap() {
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(2, 2, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(0xff3185c7.toInt()) }
        try {
            val sourcePixel = source.getPixel(0, 0)
            val output = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.render(source, PageImageEditState())
            try {
                assertNotSame("The caller must own a separate output bitmap", source, output)
                assertTrue("Rendering must keep the source available", !source.isRecycled)
                output.setPixel(0, 0, 0xffabcdef.toInt())
                assertEquals("Changing output must not mutate the source", sourcePixel, source.getPixel(0, 0))
            } finally {
                output.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rowRendererHandlesImageAboveFourMegapixelsWithinTwelveMegapixelBound() {
        val width = 2048
        val height = 2304
        val pixelCount = width.toLong() * height
        assertTrue(pixelCount > 4L * 1024L * 1024L)
        assertTrue(pixelCount <= PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.MAX_SOURCE_PIXELS)
        val sourceColor = 0xff808080.toInt()
        val source = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(sourceColor) }
        try {
            val output = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.render(
                source,
                PageImageEditState(brightness = 0, contrastPercent = 100, sharpnessPercent = 200),
            )
            try {
                assertEquals(width, output.width)
                assertEquals(height, output.height)
                assertEquals(sourceColor, output.getPixel(0, 0))
                assertEquals(sourceColor, output.getPixel(width / 2, height / 2))
                assertEquals(sourceColor, output.getPixel(width - 1, height - 1))
                assertTrue("Large-image output must be independent", source !== output)
            } finally {
                output.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            source.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun renderWithPreviousFullArrayAlgorithm(source: Bitmap, state: PageImageEditState): Bitmap {
        val rotated = if (state.clockwiseTurns == 0) source else Bitmap.createBitmap(
            source,
            0,
            0,
            source.width,
            source.height,
            Matrix().apply { postRotate(state.clockwiseTurns * 90f) },
            true,
        )
        try {
            val width = rotated.width
            val height = rotated.height
            val original = IntArray(width * height)
            val adjusted = IntArray(width * height)
            rotated.getPixels(original, 0, width, 0, 0, width, height)
            val contrast = state.contrastPercent / 100f
            for (index in original.indices) {
                val pixel = original[index]
                val alpha = pixel ushr 24 and 0xff
                val red = adjust(pixel ushr 16 and 0xff, contrast, state.brightness)
                val green = adjust(pixel ushr 8 and 0xff, contrast, state.brightness)
                val blue = adjust(pixel and 0xff, contrast, state.brightness)
                adjusted[index] = (alpha shl 24) or (red shl 16) or (green shl 8) or blue
            }
            val outputPixels = if (state.sharpnessPercent == 0) adjusted else {
                val sharpened = original.copyOf()
                val amount = state.sharpnessPercent / 100f
                for (y in 0 until height) for (x in 0 until width) {
                    val index = y * width + x
                    val center = adjusted[index]
                    var red = 0
                    var green = 0
                    var blue = 0
                    var samples = 0
                    for (dy in -1..1) for (dx in -1..1) {
                        val nx = x + dx
                        val ny = y + dy
                        if (nx !in 0 until width || ny !in 0 until height) continue
                        val neighbor = adjusted[ny * width + nx]
                        red += neighbor ushr 16 and 0xff
                        green += neighbor ushr 8 and 0xff
                        blue += neighbor and 0xff
                        samples++
                    }
                    val centerRed = center ushr 16 and 0xff
                    val centerGreen = center ushr 8 and 0xff
                    val centerBlue = center and 0xff
                    val outRed = (centerRed + (centerRed - red / samples) * amount).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
                    val outGreen = (centerGreen + (centerGreen - green / samples) * amount).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
                    val outBlue = (centerBlue + (centerBlue - blue / samples) * amount).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
                    sharpened[index] = (center ushr 24 shl 24) or (outRed shl 16) or (outGreen shl 8) or outBlue
                }
                sharpened
            }
            return Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).also {
                it.setPixels(outputPixels, 0, width, 0, 0, width, height)
            }
        } finally {
            if (rotated !== source) rotated.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun adjust(channel: Int, contrast: Float, brightness: Int): Int =
        (((channel - 127.5f) * contrast) + 127.5f + brightness).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)

    private fun pixelsOf(bitmap: Bitmap): IntArray = IntArray(bitmap.width * bitmap.height).also {
        bitmap.getPixels(it, 0, bitmap.width, 0, 0, bitmap.width, bitmap.height)
    }
}

    @Test
    fun visiblePageImageEditorControlsHaveAccessibleNamesAndAtLeast48DpBounds() {
        val fixture = createFixture()
        val device = UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
        val scenario = fixture.launch()
        try {
            openWorkspaceMenuForTest(scenario)
            scrollWorkspaceListToPositionForTest(scenario, 0)
            awaitCondition("Workspace Page is rendered") {
                var present = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    present = nativeWorkspaceRoot(activity).findViewWithTag<View>(
                        ProductActivity.PAGE_IMAGE_EDIT_BUTTON_TAG_PREFIX + fixture.page.pageId.value,
                    ) != null
                }
                present
            }
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                nativeWorkspaceRoot(activity).findViewWithTag<View>(
                    ProductActivity.PAGE_IMAGE_EDIT_BUTTON_TAG_PREFIX + fixture.page.pageId.value,
                )?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Page image edit action is missing")
            }
            assertTrue("Image editor opens", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_image_title)))
            val rotate = device.findObject(By.text(buttonText(fixture.context, R.string.edit_rotate_clockwise)))
            awaitCondition("Image editor source becomes ready") {
                runCatching { rotate.isEnabled }.getOrDefault(false)
            }

            val targets = linkedMapOf<String, EditorActionTarget>()
            for (viewport in 0..2) {
                val root = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Editor accessibility window is unavailable at viewport $viewport")
                collectEditorActionTargets(root, targets)
                android.util.Log.i(
                    "DocScanA11y",
                    "Page image editor inventory: viewport=$viewport density=${fixture.context.resources.displayMetrics.density} targets=${targets.values}",
                )
                if (viewport == 2) break
                val scrollBounds = findScrollableBounds(root) ?: break
                val startY = (scrollBounds.bottom - fixture.context.resources.displayMetrics.density * 24).toInt()
                val endY = (scrollBounds.top + fixture.context.resources.displayMetrics.density * 24).toInt()
                device.swipe(scrollBounds.centerX(), startY, scrollBounds.centerX(), endY, 18)
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(250)
            }

            val minimumSizePx = kotlin.math.ceil(48f * fixture.context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
            val inventory = targets.values.joinToString("\n") { target ->
                "${target.className} label=${target.label ?: "<missing>"} size=${target.widthPx}x${target.heightPx} enabled=${target.enabled}"
            }
            assertEquals("The editor inventory must contain its eight required controls:\n$inventory", 8, targets.size)
            val unnamed = targets.values.filter { it.label.isNullOrBlank() }
            assertTrue("Every interactive editor control needs a spoken name:\n$inventory", unnamed.isEmpty())
            val labelsByNormalizedName = targets.values.mapNotNull { it.label?.trim()?.lowercase() }
            assertEquals("Every editor control needs a distinct spoken name:\n$inventory", targets.size, labelsByNormalizedName.toSet().size)
            val undersized = targets.values.filter { it.widthPx < minimumSizePx || it.heightPx < minimumSizePx }
            assertTrue(
                "Every editor touch target must meet 48dp (${minimumSizePx}px at this density):\n$inventory",
                undersized.isEmpty(),
            )
            val labels = targets.values.mapNotNull { it.label }.map { it.lowercase() }
            listOf(
                R.string.edit_rotate_clockwise,
                R.string.edit_crop_four_points,
                R.string.edit_undo,
                R.string.edit_brightness,
                R.string.edit_contrast,
                R.string.edit_sharpness,
                R.string.edit_save,
                R.string.edit_cancel,
            ).map { fixture.context.getString(it).lowercase() }.forEach { expected ->
                assertTrue("Editor inventory is missing '$expected':\n$inventory", labels.any { expected in it })
            }
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            fixture.restore()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun manualCropCornersAreSeparatelyAccessibleAndTheirActionCanBeSaved() {
        val fixture = createFixture()
        val device = UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
        val scenario = fixture.launch()
        try {
            awaitCondition("Workspace page is rendered") {
                var present = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    present = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>(
                        ProductActivity.PAGE_IMAGE_EDIT_BUTTON_TAG_PREFIX + fixture.page.pageId.value,
                    ) != null
                }
                present
            }
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>(
                    ProductActivity.PAGE_IMAGE_EDIT_BUTTON_TAG_PREFIX + fixture.page.pageId.value,
                )?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Page image edit action is missing")
            }
            assertTrue("Image editor opens", awaitText(device, buttonText(fixture.context, R.string.edit_crop_four_points)))
            device.findObject(By.text(buttonText(fixture.context, R.string.edit_crop_four_points))).click()
            assertTrue("Manual crop preview becomes available", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.manual_crop_instruction)))

            val cornerDescriptions = listOf(
                R.string.manual_crop_corner_top_left,
                R.string.manual_crop_corner_top_right,
                R.string.manual_crop_corner_bottom_right,
                R.string.manual_crop_corner_bottom_left,
            ).map(fixture.context::getString)
            cornerDescriptions.forEach { description ->
                assertNotNull("Activity exposes accessible crop corner: $description", device.wait(Until.findObject(By.desc(description)), 2_000))
            }

            val root = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow
                ?: throw AssertionError("Manual crop accessibility window is unavailable")
            val directionalActions = listOf(
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_LEFT,
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_RIGHT,
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_UP,
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_DOWN,
            )
            val directionalChanges = listOf(
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_LEFT to (-1 to 0),
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_RIGHT to (1 to 0),
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_UP to (0 to -1),
                CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_DOWN to (0 to 1),
            )
            val minimumTargetSizePx = kotlin.math.ceil(48f * fixture.context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
            cornerDescriptions.forEach { description ->
                val node = findNodeByDescription(root, description)
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Crop corner is missing from the accessibility tree: $description")
                assertTrue(
                    "$description exposes all directional actions",
                    directionalActions.all { action -> node.actionList.any { it.id == action } },
                )
                val bounds = android.graphics.Rect().also(node::getBoundsInScreen)
                assertTrue(
                    "$description meets the 48dp width target (${bounds.width()}px < ${minimumTargetSizePx}px; density=${fixture.context.resources.displayMetrics.density})",
                    bounds.width() >= minimumTargetSizePx,
                )
                assertTrue(
                    "$description meets the 48dp height target (${bounds.height()}px < ${minimumTargetSizePx}px; density=${fixture.context.resources.displayMetrics.density})",
                    bounds.height() >= minimumTargetSizePx,
                )
            }

            val centerApproach = listOf(
                cornerDescriptions[0] to listOf(CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_RIGHT, CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_DOWN),
                cornerDescriptions[1] to listOf(CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_LEFT, CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_DOWN),
                cornerDescriptions[2] to listOf(CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_LEFT, CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_UP),
                cornerDescriptions[3] to listOf(CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_RIGHT, CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_UP),
            )
            repeat(20) {
                centerApproach.forEach { (description, inwardActions) ->
                    inwardActions.forEach { action ->
                        assertTrue(
                            "$description accepts an inward action before direction coverage",
                            performCornerAction(description, action),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            cornerDescriptions.forEach { targetDescription ->
                directionalChanges.forEach { (action, direction) ->
                    val before = cornerDescriptions.associateWith(::accessibleCornerBounds)
                    val targetBefore = before.getValue(targetDescription)
                    val currentRoot = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow
                        ?: throw AssertionError("Manual crop accessibility window is unavailable")
                    val target = findNodeByDescription(currentRoot, targetDescription)
                        ?: throw AssertionError("Crop corner disappeared before action: $targetDescription")
                    assertTrue(
                        "$targetDescription responds to action $action",
                        target.performAction(action),
                    )
                    awaitCondition("$targetDescription action $action updates its accessible bounds") {
                        val current = accessibleCornerBounds(targetDescription)
                        when {
                            direction.first < 0 -> current.centerX() < targetBefore.centerX()
                            direction.first > 0 -> current.centerX() > targetBefore.centerX()
                            direction.second < 0 -> current.centerY() < targetBefore.centerY()
                            else -> current.centerY() > targetBefore.centerY()
                        }
                    }
                    val after = cornerDescriptions.associateWith(::accessibleCornerBounds)
                    val targetAfter = after.getValue(targetDescription)
                    when {
                        direction.first < 0 -> assertTrue(
                            "$targetDescription moves left: $targetBefore -> $targetAfter",
                            targetAfter.centerX() < targetBefore.centerX(),
                        )
                        direction.first > 0 -> assertTrue(
                            "$targetDescription moves right: $targetBefore -> $targetAfter",
                            targetAfter.centerX() > targetBefore.centerX(),
                        )
                        direction.second < 0 -> assertTrue(
                            "$targetDescription moves up: $targetBefore -> $targetAfter",
                            targetAfter.centerY() < targetBefore.centerY(),
                        )
                        direction.second > 0 -> assertTrue(
                            "$targetDescription moves down: $targetBefore -> $targetAfter",
                            targetAfter.centerY() > targetBefore.centerY(),
                        )
                    }
                    cornerDescriptions.filterNot { it == targetDescription }.forEach { otherDescription ->
                        assertEquals(
                            "$targetDescription action $action leaves $otherDescription fixed",
                            before.getValue(otherDescription),
                            after.getValue(otherDescription),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            val beforeBounds = accessibleCornerBounds(cornerDescriptions.first())
            var validMoves = 1
            while (performCornerAction(cornerDescriptions.first(), CropSelectionView.ACTION_MOVE_RIGHT)) validMoves++
            assertTrue("Valid corner nudges work before the adjacent edge", validMoves > 1)
            val afterBounds = accessibleCornerBounds(cornerDescriptions.first())
            assertTrue("The action updates the control bounds to the moved corner", afterBounds.centerX() > beforeBounds.centerX())
            val topRightBounds = accessibleCornerBounds(cornerDescriptions[1])
            assertTrue("Rejected crossing leaves corners ordered", afterBounds.centerX() < topRightBounds.centerX())
            assertEquals(
                "Rejected crossing does not change the last valid top-left bounds",
                afterBounds,
                accessibleCornerBounds(cornerDescriptions.first()),
            )

            device.findObject(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.manual_crop_apply))).click()
            assertTrue("Applying the crop returns to the editor", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_save)))
            device.findObject(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_save))).click()
            awaitCondition("Saving the accessible crop commits a new image version") {
                fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.singleOrNull { it.pageId == fixture.page.pageId }
                    ?.imageVersionId != fixture.page.imageVersionId
            }
            val saved = fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == fixture.page.pageId }
            assertEquals(fixture.page.pageId, saved.pageId)
            assertNotEquals(fixture.page.imageVersionId, saved.imageVersionId)
            assertTrue("Saved crop leaves Undo available", saved.canUndoImage)
            assertTrue("Crop Save preserves the old immutable bytes", fixture.sourceBytes.contentEquals(
                fixture.storage.artifactPath(fixture.page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes(),
            ))
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            fixture.restore()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun keepEditingThenDiscardPreservesCommittedPageAndArtifact() {
        val fixture = createFixture()
        val device = UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
        collapseNotificationShadeIfOpen(device)
        val scenario = fixture.launch()
        try {
            openDirtyPrompt(fixture, scenario, device)
            device.click(30, device.displayHeight / 2)
            assertTrue("Dirty prompt must remain open after an outside tap", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_discard)))
            device.findObject(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_keep_editing))).click()
            assertTrue("Keep editing returns to the image editor", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_image_title)))
            device.pressBack()
            assertTrue("Back from the dirty editor opens the discard prompt", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_discard)))
            device.findObject(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_discard))).click()
            assertTrue("Discard closes the editor", device.wait(Until.gone(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_image_title))), 5_000))

            val after = fixture.storage.workspaceProjection()
            val page = after.pages.single { it.pageId == fixture.page.pageId }
            assertEquals(fixture.page, page)
            assertEquals(fixture.projection.activePageId, after.activePageId)
            assertEquals(fixture.referenceCount, referenceCount(fixture.context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.page.imageVersionId.value))
            assertEquals(fixture.sourceHash, sha256(fixture.storage.artifactPath(fixture.page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes()))
            assertTrue(fixture.sourceBytes.contentEquals(fixture.storage.artifactPath(fixture.page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes()))
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            fixture.restore()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun saveFromDirtyPromptCreatesUndoableVersionAndPreservesPriorArtifact() {
        val fixture = createFixture()
        val device = UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
        collapseNotificationShadeIfOpen(device)
        val scenario = fixture.launch()
        try {
            openDirtyPrompt(fixture, scenario, device)
            device.findObject(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_save))).click()
            assertTrue("Save closes the editor after the immutable edit commits", device.wait(Until.gone(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_image_title))), 15_000))
            awaitCondition("Save from the prompt commits a new image version") {
                fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == fixture.page.pageId }.imageVersionId != fixture.page.imageVersionId
            }

            val after = fixture.storage.workspaceProjection()
            val saved = after.pages.single { it.pageId == fixture.page.pageId }
            assertEquals(fixture.page.pageId, saved.pageId)
            assertNotEquals(fixture.page.imageVersionId, saved.imageVersionId)
            assertTrue("The previous image version is available to Undo", saved.canUndoImage)
            assertEquals(fixture.page.selected, saved.selected)
            assertEquals(fixture.projection.activePageId, after.activePageId)
            assertEquals(fixture.referenceCount, referenceCount(fixture.context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.page.imageVersionId.value))
            assertEquals(fixture.sourceHash, sha256(fixture.storage.artifactPath(fixture.page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes()))
            assertTrue(fixture.sourceBytes.contentEquals(fixture.storage.artifactPath(fixture.page.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes()))
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            fixture.restore()
        }
    }

    private fun openDirtyPrompt(fixture: Fixture, scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>, device: UiDevice) {
        awaitCondition("Workspace page is rendered") {
            var rendered = false
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                rendered = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>(
                    ProductActivity.PAGE_IMAGE_EDIT_BUTTON_TAG_PREFIX + fixture.page.pageId.value,
                ) != null
            }
            rendered
        }
        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
            activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>(
                ProductActivity.PAGE_IMAGE_EDIT_BUTTON_TAG_PREFIX + fixture.page.pageId.value,
            )?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Page image edit action is missing")
        }
        assertTrue("Image editor opens", awaitText(device, buttonText(fixture.context, R.string.edit_rotate_clockwise)))
        device.findObject(By.text(buttonText(fixture.context, R.string.edit_rotate_clockwise))).click()
        assertTrue("Rotate makes the draft dirty", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_adjustment_summary, 90, 0, 100, 0)))
        device.pressBack()
        assertTrue("Back opens the dirty-exit prompt", awaitText(device, fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_discard)))
        assertNotNull("Prompt explains that the saved page is unchanged", device.findObject(By.text(fixture.context.getString(R.string.edit_discard_confirmation))))
    }

    private fun createFixture(): Fixture {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "dirty-guard-$suffix.db"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, "dirty-guard-artifacts-$suffix")
        val previousOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val previousProvider = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage

        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(96, 64, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, it)) }.toByteArray()
        bitmap.recycle()
        val artifact = storage.stageCapturedJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))
        val pageId = PageId.new()
        storage.commitCapture(
            CaptureCommand(
                workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                pageId = pageId,
                imageVersionId = ImageVersionId.new(),
                artifact = artifact,
                selected = true,
                makeActive = true,
                coordinateSpace = "JPEG_PIXEL_EDGE_ORIGIN_TOP_LEFT",
                processingDesiredState = ProductActivity.OCR_OPERATION_KEY,
                sourceProvenance = "TEST",
            ),
        )
        var page = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
        storage.commitRecognition(
            RecognitionCandidate(
                recognitionId = RecognitionId.new(),
                workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                pageId = page.pageId,
                imageVersionId = page.imageVersionId,
                contentRevision = page.contentRevision,
                desiredOperationKey = ProductActivity.OCR_OPERATION_KEY,
                recognizedText = "dirty guard fixture",
            ),
        )
        page = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
        val projection = storage.workspaceProjection()
        return Fixture(
            context = context,
            application = application,
            storage = storage,
            databaseName = databaseName,
            page = page,
            projection = projection,
            sourceBytes = bytes,
            sourceHash = sha256(bytes),
            referenceCount = referenceCount(context, databaseName, page.imageVersionId.value),
            previousOverride = previousOverride,
            previousProvider = previousProvider,
        )
    }

    private data class Fixture(
        val context: Context,
        val application: DocScanApplication,
        val storage: ProductStorage,
        val databaseName: String,
        val page: app.docscan.core.store.StoredPage,
        val projection: app.docscan.core.store.WorkspaceProjection,
        val sourceBytes: ByteArray,
        val sourceHash: String,
        val referenceCount: Long,
        val previousOverride: ProductStorage?,
        val previousProvider: (() -> ProductStorage)?,
    ) {
        fun launch(): ActivityScenario<ProductActivity> {
            val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            scenario.onActivity { it.renderPages(storage.workspaceProjection()) }
            return scenario
        }

        fun restore() {
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = previousProvider
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousOverride
        }
    }

    private fun referenceCount(context: Context, databaseName: String, imageVersionId: String): Long {
        val database = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
        )
        return database.use {
            it.rawQuery(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactReference WHERE artifact_id = (SELECT artifact_id FROM ImageVersion WHERE image_version_id = ?)",
                arrayOf(imageVersionId),
            ).use { cursor ->
                check(cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getLong(0)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun awaitText(device: UiDevice, text: String): Boolean {
        val found = device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.text(text)), 5_000)
        if (!found) {
            val hierarchy = File(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext.cacheDir, "dirty-guard-window.xml")
            device.dumpWindowHierarchy(hierarchy)
            android.util.Log.e("DirtyGuardUI", "Expected text: $text\n${hierarchy.readText()}")
        }
        return found
    }

    private fun buttonText(context: Context, resourceId: Int): String = context.getString(resourceId).uppercase()

    private fun collapseNotificationShadeIfOpen(device: UiDevice) {
        repeat(2) {
            if (device.hasObject(By.res("com.android.systemui:id/notification_stack_scroller"))) {
                device.pressBack()
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(300)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun awaitCondition(message: String, condition: () -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 10_000
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (condition()) return
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(100)
        }
        throw AssertionError(message)
    }

    private fun findNodeByDescription(
        node: AccessibilityNodeInfo,
        description: String,
    ): AccessibilityNodeInfo? {
        if (node.contentDescription?.toString() == description) return node
        for (index in 0 until node.childCount) {
            val child = node.getChild(index) ?: continue
            findNodeByDescription(child, description)?.let { return it }
        }
        return null
    }

    private data class EditorActionTarget(
        val className: String,
        val label: String?,
        val widthPx: Int,
        val heightPx: Int,
        val enabled: Boolean,
    )

    private fun collectEditorActionTargets(node: AccessibilityNodeInfo, targets: MutableMap<String, EditorActionTarget>) {
        val className = node.className?.toString().orEmpty()
        val isSeekBar = className.endsWith("SeekBar")
        val isButton = className.endsWith("Button")
        val rect = Rect().also(node::getBoundsInScreen)
        if (node.isVisibleToUser && rect.width() > 0 && rect.height() > 0 &&
            (node.isClickable || node.isLongClickable || isSeekBar || isButton)
        ) {
            val label = node.contentDescription?.toString()?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)
                ?: node.text?.toString()?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)
            val target = EditorActionTarget(className, label, rect.width(), rect.height(), node.isEnabled)
            val key = "$className|$label"
            val previous = targets[key]
            if (previous == null || (target.widthPx >= previous.widthPx && target.heightPx >= previous.heightPx)) {
                targets[key] = target
            }
        }
        for (index in 0 until node.childCount) {
            val child = node.getChild(index) ?: continue
            collectEditorActionTargets(child, targets)
        }
    }

    private fun findScrollableBounds(node: AccessibilityNodeInfo): Rect? {
        if (node.isVisibleToUser && node.isScrollable) return Rect().also(node::getBoundsInScreen)
        for (index in 0 until node.childCount) {
            val child = node.getChild(index) ?: continue
            findScrollableBounds(child)?.let { return it }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun accessibleCornerBounds(description: String): android.graphics.Rect {
        val root = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: throw AssertionError("Accessibility window is unavailable while reading $description")
        val node = findNodeByDescription(root, description)
            ?: throw AssertionError("Accessible crop corner is missing: $description")
        return android.graphics.Rect().also(node::getBoundsInScreen)
    }

    private fun performCornerAction(description: String, action: Int): Boolean {
        val root = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: throw AssertionError("Accessibility window is unavailable before action $action")
        val node = findNodeByDescription(root, description)
            ?: throw AssertionError("Accessible crop corner is missing before action $action: $description")
        return node.performAction(action)
    }

    private data class WorkspaceActionTarget(
        val tag: String?,
        val className: String,
        val label: String?,
        val widthPx: Int,
        val heightPx: Int,
    )

    private fun collectWorkspaceActionTargets(view: View, targets: MutableList<WorkspaceActionTarget>) {
        if (view.visibility != View.VISIBLE) return
        val visibleBounds = Rect()
        if ((view.isClickable || view.isLongClickable) && view.getGlobalVisibleRect(visibleBounds)) {
            val label = view.contentDescription?.toString()?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)
                ?: (view as? TextView)?.text?.toString()?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)
            targets += WorkspaceActionTarget(
                tag = view.tag?.toString(),
                className = view.javaClass.simpleName,
                label = label,
                widthPx = view.width,
                heightPx = view.height,
            )
        }
        if (view is ViewGroup) {
            for (index in 0 until view.childCount) collectWorkspaceActionTargets(view.getChildAt(index), targets)
        }
    }

    private inline fun <reified T : View> findAncestor(view: View): T? {
        var parent = view.parent
        while (parent is View) {
            if (parent is T) return parent
            parent = parent.parent
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes)
        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.edit.PageImageEditState
import app.docscan.core.whiten.WhiteningMode
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import kotlin.math.abs

/** Editor whitening through the real Bitmap path: uneven page becomes even; slider 0 keeps the image; no mode = untouched. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PageImageWhiteningInstrumentedTest {
    private fun shadedPage(): Bitmap {
        val w = 320; val h = 400
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(w, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val row = IntArray(w)
        for (y in 0 until h) {
            for (x in 0 until w) {
                val light = 0.45f + 0.55f * x / w
                val ink = y % 24 in 8..11 && x in 20..300
                val base = if (ink) 40 else 240
                val v = (base * light).toInt()
                row[x] = Color.rgb(v, v, (v * 0.96f).toInt())
            }
            bitmap.setPixels(row, 0, w, 0, y, w, 1)
        }
        return bitmap
    }

    private fun paperSpread(bitmap: Bitmap): Pair<Int, Int> {
        val values = (0 until bitmap.height).filter { it % 24 in 14..20 }
            .flatMap { y -> (30 until bitmap.width - 30 step 5).map { x -> Color.green(bitmap.getPixel(x, y)) } }.sorted()
        return values.first() to values.last()
    }

    @Test
    fun whiteningEvensTheBackgroundAndReportsWhatItDid() {
        val source = shadedPage()
        try {
            val (spreadLow, spreadHigh) = paperSpread(source)
            val rendered = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.renderWithReport(source, PageImageEditState(whitening = WhiteningMode.NATURAL))
            try {
                val (low, high) = paperSpread(rendered.bitmap)
                assertTrue("paper range $low..$high must be tighter than $spreadLow..$spreadHigh", high - low < (spreadHigh - spreadLow) / 3)
                assertTrue("paper near 248: $low..$high", low >= 238 && high <= 255)
                assertNotNull(rendered.whitening)
                assertEquals("whiten-1:natural", rendered.whitening?.provenance)
            } finally { rendered.bitmap.recycle() }
        } finally { source.recycle() }
    }

    @Test
    fun whitenessZeroKeepsTheImageAndNoModeDoesNotWhiten() {
        val source = shadedPage()
        try {
            val kept = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.renderWithReport(
                source, PageImageEditState(whitening = WhiteningMode.NATURAL, whitenessPercent = 0))
            try {
                assertEquals(source.getPixel(100, 14), kept.bitmap.getPixel(100, 14))
            } finally { kept.bitmap.recycle() }
            val plain = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.renderWithReport(source, PageImageEditState())
            try {
                assertNull(plain.whitening)
                assertTrue(abs(Color.green(source.getPixel(60, 14)) - Color.green(plain.bitmap.getPixel(60, 14))) <= 1)
            } finally { plain.bitmap.recycle() }
        } finally { source.recycle() }
    }

    @Test
    fun halfwayWhitenessLandsBetweenOriginalAndFull() {
        val source = shadedPage()
        try {
            val full = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.render(source, PageImageEditState(whitening = WhiteningMode.NATURAL))
            val half = PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.render(source, PageImageEditState(whitening = WhiteningMode.NATURAL, whitenessPercent = 50))
            try {
                val o = Color.green(source.getPixel(40, 14)); val f = Color.green(full.getPixel(40, 14)); val h = Color.green(half.getPixel(40, 14))
                assertTrue("half $h between $o and $f", h > minOf(o, f) && h < maxOf(o, f))
            } finally { full.recycle(); half.recycle() }
        } finally { source.recycle() }
    }
}
