package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import app.docscan.core.store.CaptureCommand
import app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.util.UUID
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PageRotationEditorInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun applyingRotationCreatesNewVersionAndUndoRestoresOriginalArtifact() {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, "rotation-$suffix.db", "rotation-artifacts-$suffix")
        val fixture = Bitmap.createBitmap(120, 80, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().also {
            assertTrue(fixture.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, it))
        }.toByteArray()
        fixture.recycle()

        val source = storage.stageCapturedJpeg(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))
        val pageId = PageId.new()
        storage.commitCapture(
            CaptureCommand(
                workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                pageId = pageId,
                imageVersionId = ImageVersionId.new(),
                artifact = source,
                selected = true,
                makeActive = true,
                coordinateSpace = "JPEG_PIXEL_EDGE_ORIGIN_TOP_LEFT",
                processingDesiredState = "OCR_RUS_ENG_TESSERACT_V1",
                sourceProvenance = "TEST",
            ),
        )
        val before = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
        val originalBytes = storage.artifactPath(source.relativePath).toFile().readBytes()

        val rotatedProjection = storage.rotatePageImage(before, 1, HeavyWorkScheduler())
        val rotated = rotatedProjection.pages.single()
        assertNotEquals(before.imageVersionId, rotated.imageVersionId)
        assertEquals(before.pageId, rotated.pageId)
        assertTrue(rotated.canUndoImage)
        val rotatedBitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(storage.artifactPath(rotated.artifactRelativePath).toString())
        assertEquals(80, rotatedBitmap.width)
        assertEquals(120, rotatedBitmap.height)
        rotatedBitmap.recycle()
        assertTrue(storage.artifactPath(source.relativePath).toFile().readBytes().contentEquals(originalBytes))

        storage.undoPageImage(rotated)
        val restored = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
        assertEquals(before.imageVersionId, restored.imageVersionId)
        assertEquals(source.relativePath, restored.artifactRelativePath)
        assertTrue(storage.artifactPath(source.relativePath).toFile().readBytes().contentEquals(originalBytes))
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.os.CancellationSignal
import android.os.OperationCanceledException
import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PdfImportCancellationInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun cancellationAfterCommittedPrefixLeavesImportResumableAndDoesNotDuplicatePages() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(context)
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-cancel-$suffix.db"
        val artifactsDirectory = "pdf-cancel-$suffix"
        val source = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-cancel-$suffix.pdf")
        val sourceBytes = threePagePdf()
        source.writeBytes(sourceBytes)
        val expectedSourceSha = sha256(source)
        val sourceScratchBefore = renderScratchSnapshot(context.cacheDir)
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        val pageIds = (0..2).map { index ->
            val identity = "${sessionId.value}:$index"
            PageId.parse(stableId("$identity:page"))
        }
        val signal = CancellationSignal()
        val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler()
        val progressBeforeCancel = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, Int>>()
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactsDirectory)
        storage.pdfImportPageCommittedObserverForTest = { observedSession, committed, total ->
            assertEquals(sessionId.value, observedSession)
            assertEquals(3, total)
            if (committed == 1) signal.cancel()
        }
        try {
            val failure = org.junit.Assert.assertThrows(OperationCanceledException::class.java) {
                FileInputStream(source).use { input ->
                    storage.importPdf(
                        source = input,
                        displayName = "cancel-resume.pdf",
                        importSessionId = sessionId,
                        scheduler = scheduler,
                        cancellationSignal = signal,
                        onProgress = { completed, total -> progressBeforeCancel += completed to total },
                    )
                }
            }
            val failedState = importState(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            val prefix = storage.importedPdfPageIds(sessionId)
            val indices = sourcePageIndices(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            val scratchAfterCancel = renderScratchSnapshot(context.cacheDir)
            val schedulerReleased = scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) { "available" }
            val unchangedSourceSha = sha256(source)
            assertTrue(failure.message.orEmpty().contains("cancel", ignoreCase = true))
            assertEquals(listOf(1 to 3), progressBeforeCancel)
            assertEquals(pageIds.take(1), prefix)
            assertEquals(listOf(0L), indices)
            assertEquals("OPEN", failedState.first)
            assertTrue(failedState.second.orEmpty().contains("cancel", ignoreCase = true))
            assertEquals(sourceScratchBefore, scratchAfterCancel)
            assertEquals("available", schedulerReleased)
            assertEquals(expectedSourceSha, unchangedSourceSha)
            Log.i(TAG, "CANCELLED_STATE session=${sessionId.value} state=${failedState.first} " +
                "error=${failedState.second?.replace(' ', '_')} progress=${progressBeforeCancel.joinToString()} " +
                "pageIds=${prefix.joinToString { it.value }} sourcePageIndices=${indices.joinToString()} " +
                "scratch=${scratchAfterCancel.joinToString { it.first }} scheduler=$schedulerReleased " +
                "sourceSha256=$unchangedSourceSha")

            storage.pdfImportPageCommittedObserverForTest = null
            val resumedProgress = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, Int>>()
            val resumed = storage.resumeIncompletePdfImports(scheduler) { _, completed, total ->
                resumedProgress += completed to total
            }
            val recoveredState = importState(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            val recoveredPageIds = storage.importedPdfPageIds(sessionId)
            val recoveredIndices = sourcePageIndices(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            val scratchAfterResume = renderScratchSnapshot(context.cacheDir)
            val schedulerReusable = scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) { "available" }
            val finalSourceSha = sha256(source)
            assertEquals(pageIds, resumed)
            assertEquals(pageIds, recoveredPageIds)
            assertEquals(listOf(0L, 1L, 2L), recoveredIndices)
            assertEquals(listOf(2 to 3, 3 to 3), resumedProgress)
            assertEquals("COMPLETED", recoveredState.first)
            assertNull(recoveredState.second)
            assertEquals(sourceScratchBefore, scratchAfterResume)
            assertEquals("available", schedulerReusable)
            assertEquals(expectedSourceSha, finalSourceSha)
            Log.i(TAG, "RECOVERED_STATE session=${sessionId.value} state=${recoveredState.first} " +
                "error=null progress=${resumedProgress.joinToString()} " +
                "pageIds=${recoveredPageIds.joinToString { it.value }} sourcePageIndices=${recoveredIndices.joinToString()} " +
                "scratch=${scratchAfterResume.joinToString { it.first }} scheduler=$schedulerReusable " +
                "sourceSha256=$finalSourceSha")
        } finally {
            storage.pdfImportPageCommittedObserverForTest = null
            storage.close()
            source.delete()
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactsDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
        }
    }

    private fun threePagePdf(): ByteArray = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            repeat(3) { document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4)) }
            document.save(output)
        }
        output.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun sourcePageIndices(context: android.content.Context, databaseName: String, sessionId: String): List<Long> =
        readDatabase(context, databaseName) { database ->
            database.rawQuery(
                "SELECT source_page_index FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ? ORDER BY source_page_index ASC",
                arrayOf(sessionId),
            ).use { cursor -> buildList { while (cursor.moveToNext()) add(cursor.getLong(0)) } }
        }

    private fun importState(context: android.content.Context, databaseName: String, sessionId: String): Pair<String, String?> =
        readDatabase(context, databaseName) { database ->
            database.rawQuery(
                "SELECT state, last_error FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?",
                arrayOf(sessionId),
            ).use { cursor ->
                assertTrue("ImportSession row must exist", cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getString(0) to if (cursor.isNull(1)) null else cursor.getString(1)
            }
        }

    private fun <T> readDatabase(
        context: android.content.Context,
        databaseName: String,
        block: (SQLiteDatabase) -> T,
    ): T {
        val database = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).path,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
        )
        return try { block(database) } finally { database.close() }
    }

    private fun renderScratchSnapshot(cache: File): List<Pair<String, String>> =
        cache.listFiles().orEmpty()
            .filter { it.name.startsWith("pdf-page-") }
            .map { it.name to sha256(it) }
            .sortedBy { it.first }

    private fun stableId(value: String): String = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(value.toByteArray()).toString()

    private fun sha256(file: File): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(file.readBytes())
        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "PdfImportCancellation"
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.artifact.DirectorySync
import app.docscan.core.model.ArtifactId
import app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PdfImportPagePublicationSyncFailureInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun postPublicationSyncFailurePreservesPrefixAndResumesDeterministicPageOnce() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(context)
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-page-sync-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "pdf-page-sync-$suffix"
        val artifactsRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName)
        val sourceFile = File(context.cacheDir, "pdf-page-sync-source-$suffix.pdf")
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        val sourceBytes = threePagePdf()
        sourceFile.writeBytes(sourceBytes)
        val sourceSha = sha256(sourceFile)
        val failingIndex = 1
        val pageIdentity = "${sessionId.value}:$failingIndex"
        val failedPageId = ArtifactId.parse(stableId("$pageIdentity:artifact"))
        val failedPageFile = File(
            artifactsRoot,
            "objects/${failedPageId.value.take(2)}/${failedPageId.value}.png",
        )
        val expectedShardFile = requireNotNull(failedPageFile.parentFile)
        val expectedShardRaw = expectedShardFile.toPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize()
        val expectedShardCanonical = expectedShardFile.canonicalFile.toPath()
        val expectedPageIds = (0..2).map { index ->
            val identity = "${sessionId.value}:$index"
            PageId.parse(stableId("$identity:page"))
        }
        val injected = AtomicBoolean(false)
        val injectionCount = AtomicInteger(0)
        val syncCallCount = AtomicInteger(0)
        val syncFactory: () -> DirectorySync = {
            object : DirectorySync {
                override fun sync(directory: Path) {
                    val observedDirectoryRaw = directory.toAbsolutePath().normalize()
                    val observedDirectoryCanonical = directory.toFile().canonicalFile.toPath()
                    val targetExists = failedPageFile.isFile
                    Log.i(
                        TAG,
                        "DIRECTORY_SYNC_TRACE call=${syncCallCount.incrementAndGet()} " +
                            "pathRaw=$observedDirectoryRaw expectedShardRaw=$expectedShardRaw " +
                            "pathCanonical=$observedDirectoryCanonical expectedShardCanonical=$expectedShardCanonical " +
                            "targetExists=$targetExists injected=${injected.get()}",
                    )
                    if (observedDirectoryCanonical == expectedShardCanonical
                        && targetExists
                        && injected.compareAndSet(false, true)
                    ) {
                        injectionCount.incrementAndGet()
                        Log.i(TAG, "DIRECTORY_SYNC_INJECTION pageIndex=$failingIndex target=$failedPageFile")
                        throw IOException(FAILURE_MESSAGE)
                    }
                    AndroidDirectorySync().sync(directory)
                }
            }
        }
        val storage = ProductStorage(
            context = context,
            databaseName = databaseName,
            artifactDirectoryName = artifactDirectoryName,
            directorySyncFactory = syncFactory,
        )
        val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler()
        val renderScratchBefore = renderScratchSnapshot(context.cacheDir)
        val firstProgress = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, Int>>()
        try {
            val failure = org.junit.Assert.assertThrows(IOException::class.java) {
                storage.importPdf(
                    source = ByteArrayInputStream(sourceBytes),
                    displayName = "sync-failure.pdf",
                    importSessionId = sessionId,
                    scheduler = scheduler,
                ) { completed, total -> firstProgress += completed to total }
            }

            assertEquals(FAILURE_MESSAGE, failure.message)
            assertTrue("Injected failure must occur once after the deterministic image exists", injected.get())
            assertEquals("The registered directory-sync fault must fire exactly once", 1, injectionCount.get())
            assertTrue("Directory sync trace must include observed callbacks", syncCallCount.get() > 0)
            val failedSessionState = importState(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            val failedPageIds = storage.importedPdfPageIds(sessionId)
            val failedPageIndices = pageIndices(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            assertTrue("The post-rename failure leaves the deterministic page object for retry", failedPageFile.isFile)
            assertValidPng(failedPageFile)
            val orphanSha = sha256(failedPageFile)
            val orphanSize = failedPageFile.length()
            val failedArtifactRecordCount = artifactRecordCount(context, databaseName, failedPageId.value)
            val failedStagingTemps = artifactStagingTempSnapshot(artifactsRoot)
            val failedRenderScratch = renderScratchSnapshot(context.cacheDir)
            val failedSourceSha = sha256(sourceFile)
            val failedSchedulerAdmission = scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) {
                "scheduler admission released"
            }
            assertEquals(listOf(1 to 3), firstProgress)
            assertEquals(expectedPageIds.take(1), failedPageIds)
            assertEquals(listOf(0L), failedPageIndices)
            assertEquals("OPEN", failedSessionState.first)
            assertEquals(FAILURE_MESSAGE, failedSessionState.second)
            assertEquals(0L, failedArtifactRecordCount)
            assertTrue("Artifact staging temp files must be removed", failedStagingTemps.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(renderScratchBefore, failedRenderScratch)
            assertEquals(sourceSha, failedSourceSha)
            assertEquals("scheduler admission released", failedSchedulerAdmission)
            Log.i(
                TAG,
                "POST_FAILURE_STATE injectionCount=${injectionCount.get()} " +
                    "progress=${progressSnapshot(firstProgress)} sessionState=${failedSessionState.first} " +
                    "sessionError=${logValue(failedSessionState.second)} " +
                    "pageIds=${failedPageIds.joinToString(",") { it.value }} " +
                    "sourcePageIndices=${failedPageIndices.joinToString(",")} " +
                    "artifactRecordCount=$failedArtifactRecordCount orphanPath=${failedPageFile.absolutePath} " +
                    "orphanPngValid=true orphanBytes=$orphanSize orphanSha256=$orphanSha " +
                    "stagingTemps=${failedStagingTemps.joinToString(",")} " +
                    "renderScratch=${renderScratchSnapshotString(failedRenderScratch)} " +
                    "sourceSha256=$failedSourceSha scheduler=$failedSchedulerAdmission",
            )

            val resumedProgress = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, Int>>()
            val resumedPageIds = storage.resumeIncompletePdfImports(scheduler) { _, completed, total ->
                resumedProgress += completed to total
            }
            val recoveredSessionState = importState(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            val recoveredPageIds = storage.importedPdfPageIds(sessionId)
            val recoveredPageIndices = pageIndices(context, databaseName, sessionId.value)
            val committedRecord = requireNotNull(artifactRecord(context, databaseName, failedPageId.value)) {
                "Retry must register the previously published deterministic image"
            }
            val recoveredArtifactRecordCount = artifactRecordCount(context, databaseName, failedPageId.value)
            val recoveredStagingTemps = artifactStagingTempSnapshot(artifactsRoot)
            val recoveredRenderScratch = renderScratchSnapshot(context.cacheDir)
            val recoveredSourceSha = sha256(sourceFile)
            val recoveredSchedulerAdmission = scheduler.withAdmission(80L * 1024L * 1024L) {
                "scheduler remains reusable"
            }
            assertEquals(expectedPageIds, resumedPageIds)
            assertEquals(expectedPageIds, recoveredPageIds)
            assertEquals(listOf(0L, 1L, 2L), recoveredPageIndices)
            assertEquals(listOf(2 to 3, 3 to 3), resumedProgress)
            assertEquals("COMPLETED", recoveredSessionState.first)
            assertNull(recoveredSessionState.second)
            assertEquals("objects/${failedPageId.value.take(2)}/${failedPageId.value}.png", committedRecord.relativePath)
            assertEquals(orphanSize, committedRecord.sizeBytes)
            assertEquals(orphanSha, committedRecord.sha256)
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", committedRecord.state)
            assertEquals(1L, recoveredArtifactRecordCount)
            assertTrue("Artifact staging temp files must be removed", recoveredStagingTemps.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(renderScratchBefore, recoveredRenderScratch)
            assertEquals(sourceSha, recoveredSourceSha)
            assertEquals("scheduler remains reusable", recoveredSchedulerAdmission)
            Log.i(
                TAG,
                "POST_RESUME_STATE injectionCount=${injectionCount.get()} " +
                    "progress=${progressSnapshot(resumedProgress)} sessionState=${recoveredSessionState.first} " +
                    "sessionError=${logValue(recoveredSessionState.second)} " +
                    "pageIds=${recoveredPageIds.joinToString(",") { it.value }} " +
                    "sourcePageIndices=${recoveredPageIndices.joinToString(",")} " +
                    "artifactRecordCount=$recoveredArtifactRecordCount artifactPath=${committedRecord.relativePath} " +
                    "artifactState=${committedRecord.state} artifactBytes=${committedRecord.sizeBytes} " +
                    "artifactSha256=${committedRecord.sha256} reusedOrphanMatch=${committedRecord.sizeBytes == orphanSize && committedRecord.sha256 == orphanSha} " +
                    "stagingTemps=${recoveredStagingTemps.joinToString(",")} " +
                    "renderScratch=${renderScratchSnapshotString(recoveredRenderScratch)} " +
                    "sourceSha256=$recoveredSourceSha scheduler=$recoveredSchedulerAdmission",
            )
        } finally {
            storage.close()
            sourceFile.delete()
            artifactsRoot.deleteRecursively()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).path + "-wal").delete()
            File(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).path + "-shm").delete()
        }
    }

    private data class ArtifactRecord(
        val relativePath: String,
        val sizeBytes: Long,
        val sha256: String,
        val state: String,
    )

    private fun threePagePdf(): ByteArray = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            repeat(3) { document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4)) }
            document.save(output)
        }
        output.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun pageIndices(context: android.content.Context, databaseName: String, sessionId: String): List<Long> =
        readDatabase(context, databaseName) { database ->
            database.rawQuery(
                "SELECT source_page_index FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ? ORDER BY source_page_index ASC",
                arrayOf(sessionId),
            ).use { cursor ->
                buildList { while (cursor.moveToNext()) add(cursor.getLong(0)) }
            }
        }

    private fun importState(
        context: android.content.Context,
        databaseName: String,
        sessionId: String,
    ): Pair<String, String?> = readDatabase(context, databaseName) { database ->
        database.rawQuery(
            "SELECT state, last_error FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?",
            arrayOf(sessionId),
        ).use { cursor ->
            assertTrue("ImportSession row must exist", cursor.moveToFirst())
            cursor.getString(0) to if (cursor.isNull(1)) null else cursor.getString(1)
        }
    }

    private fun artifactRecordCount(
        context: android.content.Context,
        databaseName: String,
        artifactId: String,
    ): Long = readDatabase(context, databaseName) { database ->
        database.rawQuery(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?",
            arrayOf(artifactId),
        ).use { cursor ->
            assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
            cursor.getLong(0)
        }
    }

    private fun artifactRecord(
        context: android.content.Context,
        databaseName: String,
        artifactId: String,
    ): ArtifactRecord? = readDatabase(context, databaseName) { database ->
        database.rawQuery(
            "SELECT relative_storage_path, size_bytes, checksum, state FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?",
            arrayOf(artifactId),
        ).use { cursor ->
            if (!cursor.moveToFirst()) null else ArtifactRecord(
                relativePath = cursor.getString(0),
                sizeBytes = cursor.getLong(1),
                sha256 = cursor.getString(2),
                state = cursor.getString(3),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun <T> readDatabase(
        context: android.content.Context,
        databaseName: String,
        block: (SQLiteDatabase) -> T,
    ): T {
        val database = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).path,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
        )
        return try { block(database) } finally { database.close() }
    }

    private fun assertValidPng(file: File) {
        val bytes = file.readBytes()
        assertTrue("PNG signature must be present", bytes.size > 8)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x89.toByte(), 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a), bytes.copyOfRange(0, 8))
        val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
        BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath, bounds)
        assertTrue("Orphan PNG must decode to bounded dimensions", bounds.outWidth > 0 && bounds.outHeight > 0)
        assertTrue(maxOf(bounds.outWidth, bounds.outHeight) <= 3000)
    }

    private fun artifactStagingTempSnapshot(root: File): List<String> {
        val staging = File(root, "staging")
        return staging.listFiles().orEmpty().filter { it.name.endsWith(".tmp") }.map { it.name }.sorted()
    }

    private fun progressSnapshot(progress: List<Pair<Int, Int>>): String =
        progress.joinToString(",") { "${it.first}/${it.second}" }

    private fun renderScratchSnapshotString(snapshot: List<Pair<String, String>>): String =
        snapshot.joinToString(",") { "${it.first}:${it.second}" }.ifEmpty { "none" }

    private fun logValue(value: String?): String = value?.replace(" ", "_") ?: "null"

    private fun renderScratchSnapshot(cache: File): List<Pair<String, String>> =
        cache.listFiles().orEmpty()
            .filter { it.name.startsWith("pdf-page-") }
            .map { it.name to sha256(it) }
            .sortedBy { it.first }

    private fun stableId(value: String): String = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(value.toByteArray()).toString()

    private fun sha256(file: File): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(file.readBytes())
        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "PdfImportPagePublicationSyncFailure"
        const val FAILURE_MESSAGE = "injected no-space directory sync after page image publish"
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Explicitly driven in two phases by execution/tools/run_pdf_import_process_death.sh. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PdfImportProcessDeathInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun processDeathResumeProbe() {
        val arguments = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments()
        val fixtureId = arguments.getString("fixtureId") ?: return
        val phase = arguments.getString("phase") ?: return
        val pageCount = arguments.getString("pageCount")?.toIntOrNull() ?: 2
        val pauseAfterPage = arguments.getString("pauseAfterPage")?.toIntOrNull() ?: 1
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        when (phase) {
            "checkpoint" -> pauseAfterCommittedPrefix(context, application, fixtureId, pageCount, pauseAfterPage)
            "resume" -> resumeAfterProcessDeath(context, application, fixtureId, pageCount, pauseAfterPage)
            else -> throw AssertionError("Unknown process-death probe phase: $phase")
        }
    }

    private fun pauseAfterCommittedPrefix(
        context: android.content.Context,
        application: DocScanApplication,
        fixtureId: String,
        pageCount: Int,
        pauseAfterPage: Int,
    ) {
        val names = fixtureNames(context, fixtureId)
        check(!context.getDatabasePath(names.database).exists()) { "Fixture database already exists" }
        check(!names.artifacts.exists()) { "Fixture artifact root already exists" }
        check(!names.fixture.exists()) { "Fixture directory already exists" }
        names.fixture.mkdirs()
        val sourcePdf = names.fixture.resolve("source.pdf")
        createSourcePdf(sourcePdf, pageCount)
        val sourceHash = sha256(sourcePdf)
        val previousOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val previousProvider = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        try {
            val importId = ImportSessionId.parse(fixtureId)
            storage.importPdf(
                source = sourcePdf.inputStream(),
                displayName = "process-death-fixture.pdf",
                importSessionId = importId,
                scheduler = application.heavyWorkScheduler,
            ) { completed, total ->
                if (completed == pauseAfterPage) {
                    check(total == pageCount)
                    val committedPages = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
                    check(committedPages.size == pauseAfterPage)
                    val checkpoint = buildList {
                        add(pageCount.toString())
                        add(pauseAfterPage.toString())
                        add(sourceHash)
                        committedPages.forEach { page ->
                            add("${page.pageId.value}|${page.imageVersionId.value}")
                        }
                    }.joinToString("\n") + "\n"
                    val checkpointFile = names.fixture.resolve("checkpoint.txt")
                    FileOutputStream(checkpointFile).use { stream ->
                        stream.write(checkpoint.toByteArray())
                        stream.fd.sync()
                    }
                    Log.i(TAG, "CHECKPOINT fixture=$fixtureId committed_pages=$pauseAfterPage/$pageCount source_sha256=$sourceHash")
                    check(CountDownLatch(1).await(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)) {
                        "Host did not terminate the app at the first-page checkpoint"
                    }
                }
            }
            throw AssertionError("Process-death checkpoint returned without a host kill")
        } finally {
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = previousProvider
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousOverride
            // On the intended path Android kills this process at the checkpoint. This runs only
            // if the harness failed to kill it, allowing the harness to report a normal failure.
            runCatching { storage.close() }
            context.deleteDatabase(names.database)
            names.artifacts.deleteRecursively()
            names.fixture.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun resumeAfterProcessDeath(
        context: android.content.Context,
        application: DocScanApplication,
        fixtureId: String,
        pageCount: Int,
        pauseAfterPage: Int,
    ) {
        val names = fixtureNames(context, fixtureId)
        val fixtureLines = names.fixture.resolve("checkpoint.txt").readLines()
        require(fixtureLines.size == 3 + pauseAfterPage)
        assertEquals(pageCount.toString(), fixtureLines[0])
        assertEquals(pauseAfterPage.toString(), fixtureLines[1])
        val sourceHash = fixtureLines[2]
        val expectedCommitted = fixtureLines.drop(3).map { line ->
            line.split('|').also { assertEquals(2, it.size) }
        }
        val previousOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val previousProvider = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        try {
            assertFalse("Session fixture must exist after process death", storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            val before = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
            assertEquals("Only the recorded source prefix was committed before the kill", pauseAfterPage, before.size)
            before.forEachIndexed { index, page ->
                assertEquals(expectedCommitted[index][0], page.pageId.value)
                assertEquals(expectedCommitted[index][1], page.imageVersionId.value)
            }

            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            awaitPageCount(scenario, storage, pageCount)

            val after = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
            val importedIds = storage.importedPdfPageIds(ImportSessionId.parse(fixtureId))
            assertEquals(pageCount, after.size)
            assertEquals(pageCount, after.map { it.pageId }.distinct().size)
            assertEquals(pageCount, after.map { it.imageVersionId }.distinct().size)
            assertEquals(importedIds, after.map { it.pageId })
            expectedCommitted.forEachIndexed { index, identity ->
                assertEquals(identity[0], after[index].pageId.value)
                assertEquals(identity[1], after[index].imageVersionId.value)
            }

            val sourceArtifacts = names.artifacts.walkTopDown().filter { it.isFile && it.extension == "pdf" }.toList()
            assertEquals("One private source PDF remains in the isolated artifact root", 1, sourceArtifacts.size)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(sourceArtifacts.single()))
            assertTrue(names.fixture.resolve("source.pdf").isFile)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(names.fixture.resolve("source.pdf")))

            assertTrue(
                "Completed import is not returned as new work on a repeated resume",
                storage.resumeIncompletePdfImports(application.heavyWorkScheduler).isEmpty(),
            )
            assertEquals("Repeated resume must not duplicate Pages", pageCount, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
            Log.i(TAG, "RESUME_PASS fixture=$fixtureId page_ids=${importedIds.joinToString(",")} source_sha256=$sourceHash")
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = previousProvider
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousOverride
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(names.database)
            names.artifacts.deleteRecursively()
            names.fixture.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun awaitPageCount(
        scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>,
        storage: ProductStorage,
        expected: Int,
    ) {
        val deadline = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 60_000L
        while (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size == expected) return
            SystemClock.sleep(50L)
        }
        throw AssertionError("ProductActivity startup did not resume PDF import to $expected pages")
    }

    private fun fixtureNames(
        context: android.content.Context,
        fixtureId: String,
    ): FixtureNames {
        val database = "pdf-death-$fixtureId.db"
        val artifactsName = "pdf-death-artifacts-$fixtureId"
        val fixtureName = "pdf-death-fixture-$fixtureId"
        val names = FixtureNames(
            database = database,
            artifacts = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactsName),
            fixture = File(context.filesDir, fixtureName),
        )
        return names
    }

    private fun createSourcePdf(file: File, pageCount: Int) {
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            repeat(pageCount) {
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
            }
            document.save(file)
        }
    }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(file.readBytes())
        .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

    private data class FixtureNames(val database: String, val artifacts: File, val fixture: File)

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "PdfImportProcessDeath"
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PdfImportProviderRevocationInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun providerFailureAfterPrefixLeavesNoPrivateOrRegisteredPartialSource() {
        repeat(2) { repetition ->
            withFixture("provider-failure-$repetition") { fixture ->
                val source = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 2)
                configureProvider(fixture, source, PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.MODE_FAIL_AFTER_PREFIX, split = 64)
                fixture.grant()
                try {
                    val result = java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<ImportResult>()
                    val input = fixture.openSource()
                    Thread({
                        try {
                            result.complete(ImportResult.Success(fixture.storage.importPdf(
                                input,
                                "provider-failure.pdf",
                                fixture.sessionId,
                                fixture.application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                            )))
                        } catch (failure: Exception) {
                            result.complete(ImportResult.Failure(failure))
                        } finally {
                            runCatching { input.close() }
                        }
                    }, "pdf-import-provider-failure-$repetition").start()
                    awaitProviderState(fixture) { it.getBoolean(KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN) }
                    assertEquals(64, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN))
                    releaseProvider(fixture)
                    val importResult = result.get(30, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    assertTrue("A reliable-pipe provider failure during source copy must fail import",
                        importResult is ImportResult.Failure)
                    awaitProviderState(fixture) { it.getString(KEY_OUTCOME) == "FAILED_AFTER_PREFIX" }
                    assertNoOwnedSourceState(fixture)
                    android.util.Log.i(TAG, "SOURCE_FAILURE_PASS fixture=${fixture.uri.lastPathSegment} session=${fixture.sessionId.value} " +
                        "bytesWritten=${providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN)} " +
                        "providerOutcome=${providerState(fixture).getString(KEY_OUTCOME)} sourceSha256=${sha256(source)} phase=pre-startup")

                    fixture.storage.close()
                    fixture.storage = ProductStorage(fixture.targetContext, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectoryName)
                    assertFalse("A fresh startup must not be integrity-blocked", fixture.storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                    assertNoOwnedSourceState(fixture)
                    android.util.Log.i(TAG, "SOURCE_FAILURE_RECOVERY_PASS fixture=${fixture.uri.lastPathSegment} " +
                        "session=${fixture.sessionId.value} startupIntegrityBlocked=false phase=post-startup")
                    assertTrue(fixture.sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(fixture.sentinelBefore))
                    assertEquals("Provider must serve exactly one source stream", 1, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_OPENS))
                } finally {
                    fixture.revoke()
                    clearProvider(fixture)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun revokingGrantDuringActiveCopyCannotProducePartialPrivateSource() {
        repeat(2) { repetition ->
            withFixture("provider-revoke-copy-$repetition") { fixture ->
                val source = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 2)
                configureProvider(fixture, source, PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.MODE_BLOCK_THEN_COMPLETE, split = 96)
                fixture.grant()
                val result = java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<ImportResult>()
                val input = fixture.openSource()
                Thread({
                    try {
                        result.complete(ImportResult.Success(fixture.storage.importPdf(
                            input,
                            "revoked-during-copy.pdf",
                            fixture.sessionId,
                            fixture.application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                        )))
                    } catch (failure: Exception) {
                        result.complete(ImportResult.Failure(failure))
                    } finally {
                        runCatching { input.close() }
                    }
                }, "pdf-import-provider-revoke-$repetition").start()

                try {
                    awaitProviderState(fixture) { it.getBoolean(KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN) }
                    assertEquals(96, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN))
                    fixture.revoke()
                    assertFreshOpenDenied(fixture)
                    assertEquals("Revocation must not open the source a second time", 1, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_OPENS))
                    releaseProvider(fixture)

                    val importResult = result.get(30, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    when (importResult) {
                        is ImportResult.Success -> {
                            assertEquals(source.size, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN))
                            assertEquals(sha256(source), sha256(fixture.sourceFile().readBytes()))
                            assertEquals(2, importResult.pageIds.size)
                            assertEquals(importResult.pageIds, fixture.storage.importedPdfPageIds(fixture.sessionId))
                        }
                        is ImportResult.Failure -> {
                            assertNoOwnedSourceState(fixture)
                            fixture.storage.close()
                            fixture.storage = ProductStorage(fixture.targetContext, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectoryName)
                            assertFalse("Fresh startup after revoked-copy failure must remain available", fixture.storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                            assertNoOwnedSourceState(fixture)
                        }
                    }
                    assertEquals("The importer may use only the single stream opened before revocation", 1,
                        providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_OPENS))
                    assertTrue(fixture.sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(fixture.sentinelBefore))
                    android.util.Log.i(TAG, "ACTIVE_REVOKE_RESULT repetition=$repetition result=${importResult.javaClass.simpleName} " +
                        "providerOutcome=${providerState(fixture).getString(KEY_OUTCOME)} sourceSha256=${
                            if (importResult is ImportResult.Success) sha256(fixture.sourceFile().readBytes()) else "none"
                        }")
                } finally {
                    releaseProvider(fixture)
                    fixture.revoke()
                    clearProvider(fixture)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun revokingGrantAfterPrivatePublicationDoesNotAffectImport() {
        repeat(2) { repetition ->
            withFixture("provider-revoke-published-$repetition") { fixture ->
                val source = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 2)
                configureProvider(fixture, source, PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.MODE_COMPLETE)
                fixture.grant()
                var revokedAtPublication = false
                fixture.storage.pdfImportSourcePublicationBoundaryObserverForTest = { _, artifact ->
                    val privateFile = fixture.targetContext.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(
                        "${fixture.artifactDirectoryName}/${artifact.relativePath}",
                    )
                    assertTrue("Private PDF must be published before the revoke checkpoint", privateFile.isFile)
                    assertEquals(sha256(source), sha256(privateFile.readBytes()))
                    fixture.revoke()
                    assertFreshOpenDenied(fixture)
                    assertEquals("Provider must not be reopened after private publication", 1,
                        providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_OPENS))
                    revokedAtPublication = true
                }

                try {
                    val pages = fixture.storage.importPdf(
                        fixture.openSource(),
                        "revoked-after-publication.pdf",
                        fixture.sessionId,
                        fixture.application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                    )
                    assertTrue("Test must revoke the URI at the durable private publication boundary", revokedAtPublication)
                    assertEquals(sha256(source), sha256(fixture.sourceFile().readBytes()))
                    assertEquals(2, pages.size)
                    assertEquals(pages, fixture.storage.importedPdfPageIds(fixture.sessionId))
                    assertEquals(1, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_OPENS))
                    assertEquals(source.size, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN))
                    assertTrue(fixture.sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(fixture.sentinelBefore))
                    android.util.Log.i(TAG, "POST_PUBLICATION_REVOKE_PASS repetition=$repetition sourceSha256=${sha256(source)} pages=${pages.size}")
                } finally {
                    fixture.revoke()
                    clearProvider(fixture)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun completeProviderSourcePositiveControlImportsExactSnapshot() {
        repeat(2) { repetition ->
            withFixture("provider-source-positive-$repetition") { fixture ->
                val source = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 3)
                configureProvider(fixture, source, PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.MODE_COMPLETE)
                fixture.grant()
                try {
                    val pages = fixture.storage.importPdf(
                        fixture.openSource(),
                        "positive-provider.pdf",
                        fixture.sessionId,
                        fixture.application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                    )
                    assertEquals(sha256(source), sha256(fixture.sourceFile().readBytes()))
                    assertEquals(3, pages.size)
                    assertEquals(pages, fixture.storage.importedPdfPageIds(fixture.sessionId))
                    assertEquals(1, providerState(fixture).getInt(KEY_OPENS))
                    assertTrue(fixture.sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(fixture.sentinelBefore))
                    android.util.Log.i(TAG, "SOURCE_POSITIVE_PASS fixture=${fixture.uri.lastPathSegment} " +
                        "session=${fixture.sessionId.value} sourceSha256=${sha256(source)} pages=${pages.size} providerOpens=1")
                } finally {
                    fixture.revoke()
                    clearProvider(fixture)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun withFixture(label: String, block: (Fixture) -> Unit) {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val targetContext = instrumentation.targetContext
        val providerContext = instrumentation.context
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "${label.take(24)}-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "${label.take(20)}-$suffix"
        val root = File(targetContext.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName).apply { mkdirs() }
        val sentinel = File(root, "unrelated-sentinel.bin").apply { writeBytes(byteArrayOf(0x51, 0x22, 0x73)) }
        val fixture = Fixture(
            targetContext = targetContext,
            providerContext = providerContext,
            application = targetContext.applicationContext as DocScanApplication,
            databaseName = databaseName,
            artifactDirectoryName = artifactDirectoryName,
            uri = Uri.parse("content://${PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY}/pdf/$suffix"),
            sessionId = ImportSessionId.new(),
            sentinel = sentinel,
            sentinelBefore = sentinel.readBytes(),
            storage = ProductStorage(targetContext, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName),
        )
        try {
            block(fixture)
        } finally {
            fixture.revoke()
            runCatching { fixture.storage.close() }
            targetContext.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            root.deleteRecursively()
            runCatching { fixture.providerContext.deleteSharedPreferences("pdf_source_fault_provider") }
        }
    }

    private fun configureProvider(fixture: Fixture, bytes: ByteArray, mode: String, split: Int = 64) {
        val extras = Bundle().apply {
            putByteArray(KEY_BYTES, bytes)
            putString(KEY_MODE, mode)
            putInt(KEY_SPLIT, split)
        }
        val response = fixture.providerContext.contentResolver.call(
            PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY,
            "configure",
            fixture.uri.lastPathSegment,
            extras,
        )
        assertTrue("Provider fixture must configure", response?.getBoolean(KEY_OK) == true)
    }

    private fun providerState(fixture: Fixture): Bundle = requireNotNull(
        fixture.providerContext.contentResolver.call(
            PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "state", fixture.uri.lastPathSegment, null,
        ),
    )

    private fun awaitProviderState(fixture: Fixture, predicate: (Bundle) -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + 15_000_000_000L
        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
            val state = providerState(fixture)
            if (predicate(state)) return
            Thread.sleep(10)
        }
        throw AssertionError("Provider did not reach expected state; observed=${providerState(fixture).getString(KEY_OUTCOME)}")
    }

    private fun releaseProvider(fixture: Fixture) {
        fixture.providerContext.contentResolver.call(
            PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "release", fixture.uri.lastPathSegment, null,
        )
    }

    private fun clearProvider(fixture: Fixture) {
        fixture.providerContext.contentResolver.call(
            PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "clear", fixture.uri.lastPathSegment, null,
        )
    }

    private fun assertFreshOpenDenied(fixture: Fixture) {
        var denied = false
        try {
            fixture.targetContext.contentResolver.openInputStream(fixture.uri)?.use { it.read() }
        } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            denied = true
        } catch (_: java.io.FileNotFoundException) {
            denied = true
        }
        assertTrue("Revoked target URI grant must deny a new provider open", denied)
    }

    private fun assertNoOwnedSourceState(fixture: Fixture) {
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            fixture.targetContext.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName).absolutePath,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
        ).use { db ->
            assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PdfImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixture.sessionId.value))
            assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", fixture.sessionId.value))
            assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixture.sessionId.value))
            assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page"))
            android.util.Log.i(TAG, "NO_OWNED_SOURCE_STATE session=${fixture.sessionId.value} intents=0 artifacts=0 sessions=0 pages=0 " +
                "finalExists=${fixture.sourceFile().exists()} stagingOwned=${File(fixture.targetContext.noBackupFilesDir, "${fixture.artifactDirectoryName}/staging")
                    .listFiles().orEmpty().count { it.name.startsWith(fixture.sessionId.value) }}")
        }
        assertFalse("No final source object may remain", fixture.sourceFile().exists())
        val staging = File(fixture.targetContext.noBackupFilesDir, "${fixture.artifactDirectoryName}/staging")
        assertTrue("No ID-prefixed partial staging object may remain", staging.listFiles().orEmpty().none {
            it.name.startsWith(fixture.sessionId.value)
        })
    }

    private fun scalarLong(db: SQLiteDatabase, sql: String, vararg args: String): Long =
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { cursor -> check(cursor.moveToFirst()); cursor.getLong(0) }

    private fun createPdfBytes(pageCount: Int): ByteArray = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            repeat(pageCount) { document.addPage(PDPage()) }
            document.save(output)
        }
        output.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

    private data class Fixture(
        val targetContext: Context,
        val providerContext: Context,
        val application: DocScanApplication,
        val databaseName: String,
        val artifactDirectoryName: String,
        val uri: Uri,
        val sessionId: ImportSessionId,
        val sentinel: File,
        val sentinelBefore: ByteArray,
        var storage: ProductStorage,
    ) {
        fun grant() {
            val targets = Bundle().apply {
                putStringArray("target_packages", arrayOf(targetContext.packageName, providerContext.packageName))
            }
            val grant = providerContext.contentResolver.call(
                PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "grant", uri.lastPathSegment, targets,
            )
            assertTrue("Provider must grant this randomized URI to the app/test package", grant?.getBoolean(KEY_OK) == true)
            assertEquals(PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED,
                targetContext.checkUriPermission(uri, android.os.Process.myPid(), android.os.Process.myUid(),
                    android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION))
        }

        fun revoke() {
            providerContext.contentResolver.call(
                PdfSourceFaultTestProvider.AUTHORITY, "revoke", uri.lastPathSegment, null,
            )
        }

        fun openSource() = targetContext.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
            ?: throw java.io.FileNotFoundException("Test provider returned no source stream")

        fun sourceFile() = File(targetContext.noBackupFilesDir,
            "$artifactDirectoryName/objects/${sessionId.value.take(2)}/${sessionId.value}.pdf")
    }

    private sealed interface ImportResult {
        data class Success(val pageIds: List<app.docscan.core.model.PageId>) : ImportResult
        data class Failure(val cause: Exception) : ImportResult
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PdfImportProviderRevoke"
        private const val KEY_BYTES = "bytes"
        private const val KEY_MODE = "mode"
        private const val KEY_SPLIT = "split"
        private const val KEY_OK = "ok"
        private const val KEY_OPENS = "opens"
        private const val KEY_BYTES_WRITTEN = "bytes_written"
        private const val KEY_PREFIX_WRITTEN = "prefix_written"
        private const val KEY_OUTCOME = "outcome"
    }
}


================================================================================
