package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId
import app.docscan.core.store.DurableImageArtifact
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Host-driven process termination at PDF image publication boundaries. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PdfImportPublicationDeathInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun publicationBoundaryResumeProbe() {
        val args = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments()
        val fixtureId = args.getString("fixtureId") ?: return
        val phase = args.getString("phase") ?: return
        val boundary = args.getString("boundary") ?: "BYTES_PUBLISHED"
        require(boundary in setOf(
            "BYTES_PUBLISHED", "METADATA_STAGED", "TRANSACTION_OPEN",
            "SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED", "SOURCE_INVALID_BYTES_PUBLISHED",
        ))
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        when (phase) {
            "checkpoint" -> checkpoint(context, application, fixtureId, boundary)
            "resume" -> resume(context, application, fixtureId, boundary)
            else -> throw AssertionError("Unknown publication-death phase: $phase")
        }
    }

    private fun checkpoint(
        context: android.content.Context,
        application: DocScanApplication,
        fixtureId: String,
        boundary: String,
    ) {
        val names = fixtureNames(context, fixtureId)
        check(!context.getDatabasePath(names.database).exists()) { "Fixture database already exists" }
        check(!names.artifacts.exists()) { "Fixture artifact root already exists" }
        check(!names.fixture.exists()) { "Fixture directory already exists" }
        names.fixture.mkdirs()
        val sourcePdf = names.fixture.resolve("source.pdf")
        if (boundary == "SOURCE_INVALID_BYTES_PUBLISHED") {
            sourcePdf.writeBytes("not a PDF document".toByteArray())
        } else {
            createSourcePdf(sourcePdf)
        }
        val sourceHash = sha256(sourcePdf)
        val appOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val providerOverride = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        storage.pdfImportSourcePublicationBoundaryObserverForTest = { intent, artifact ->
            if (boundary == "SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED" || boundary == "SOURCE_INVALID_BYTES_PUBLISHED") {
                val artifactFile = names.artifacts.resolve(artifact.relativePath)
                assertTrue("The source PDF must be durably published before the checkpoint", artifactFile.isFile)
                assertEquals(artifact.sizeBytes, artifactFile.length())
                assertEquals(artifact.sha256, sha256(artifactFile))
                assertEquals(1L, scalarLong(context, names.database,
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PdfImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?",
                    fixtureId,
                ))
                assertEquals(null, artifactState(context, names.database, artifact.artifactId.value))
                assertEquals(null, scalarString(context, names.database,
                    "SELECT state FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?",
                    fixtureId,
                ))
                val checkpoint = listOf(
                    "fixture=$fixtureId",
                    "boundary=$boundary",
                    "sourceSha256=$sourceHash",
                    "artifactId=${artifact.artifactId.value}",
                    "artifactRelativePath=${artifact.relativePath}",
                    "artifactSize=${artifact.sizeBytes}",
                    "artifactSha256=${artifact.sha256}",
                    "displayName=${intent.displayName}",
                ).joinToString("\n") + "\n"
                writeCheckpoint(names.fixture, checkpoint)
                Log.i(TAG, "SOURCE_CHECKPOINT fixture=$fixtureId boundary=$boundary artifact=${artifact.artifactId.value}")
                check(CountDownLatch(1).await(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)) { "Host did not terminate app at source-PDF publication checkpoint" }
            }
        }
        storage.pdfImportPublicationBoundaryObserverForTest = { observedBoundary, sourcePageIndex, artifact ->
            if (boundary != "TRANSACTION_OPEN"
                && observedBoundary == boundary
                && sourcePageIndex == PAUSE_BEFORE_PAGE_INDEX
            ) {
                assertEquals("Only the earlier source prefix may be committed at the checkpoint", 1,
                    storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
                assertDurablePageArtifact(context, names, artifact, boundary)
                val committed = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
                val checkpoint = buildList {
                    add("fixture=$fixtureId")
                    add("boundary=$boundary")
                    add("sourcePageIndex=$sourcePageIndex")
                    add("sourceSha256=$sourceHash")
                    add("artifactId=${artifact.artifactId.value}")
                    add("artifactRelativePath=${artifact.relativePath}")
                    add("artifactSize=${artifact.sizeBytes}")
                    add("artifactSha256=${artifact.sha256}")
                    add("committedPageCount=${committed.size}")
                    committed.forEach { page -> add("page=${page.pageId.value}|${page.imageVersionId.value}") }
                }.joinToString("\n") + "\n"
                writeCheckpoint(names.fixture, checkpoint)
                Log.i(TAG, "CHECKPOINT fixture=$fixtureId boundary=$boundary source_page=$sourcePageIndex artifact=${artifact.artifactId.value}")
                check(CountDownLatch(1).await(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)) { "Host did not terminate app at the publication checkpoint" }
            }
        }
        storage.pdfImportPageTransactionBoundaryObserverForTest = { command ->
            if (boundary == "TRANSACTION_OPEN" && command.sourcePageIndex == PAUSE_BEFORE_PAGE_INDEX.toLong()) {
                val artifact = command.imageArtifact
                assertDurablePageArtifact(context, names, artifact, boundary)
                val prefix = deterministicPageIds(fixtureId, 0)
                val checkpoint = listOf(
                    "fixture=$fixtureId",
                    "boundary=$boundary",
                    "sourcePageIndex=${command.sourcePageIndex}",
                    "sourceSha256=$sourceHash",
                    "artifactId=${artifact.artifactId.value}",
                    "artifactRelativePath=${artifact.relativePath}",
                    "artifactSize=${artifact.sizeBytes}",
                    "artifactSha256=${artifact.sha256}",
                    "committedPageCount=1",
                    "page=${prefix.first}|${prefix.second}",
                    "transactionPageId=${command.pageId.value}",
                    "transactionImageVersionId=${command.imageVersionId.value}",
                ).joinToString("\n") + "\n"
                writeCheckpoint(names.fixture, checkpoint)
                Log.i(TAG, "CHECKPOINT fixture=$fixtureId boundary=$boundary source_page=${command.sourcePageIndex} artifact=${artifact.artifactId.value}")
                check(CountDownLatch(1).await(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)) { "Host did not terminate app inside the PDF page transaction" }
            }
        }
        try {
            storage.importPdf(
                source = sourcePdf.inputStream(),
                displayName = "publication-death-fixture.pdf",
                importSessionId = ImportSessionId.parse(fixtureId),
                scheduler = application.heavyWorkScheduler,
            )
            throw AssertionError("Publication checkpoint returned without a host process kill")
        } finally {
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = providerOverride
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = appOverride
            runCatching { storage.close() }
            context.deleteDatabase(names.database)
            names.artifacts.deleteRecursively()
            names.fixture.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun assertDurablePageArtifact(
        context: android.content.Context,
        names: FixtureNames,
        artifact: DurableImageArtifact,
        boundary: String,
    ) {
        val file = names.artifacts.resolve(artifact.relativePath)
        assertTrue("Published page bytes must exist before the checkpoint", file.isFile)
        assertEquals(artifact.sizeBytes, file.length())
        assertEquals(artifact.sha256, sha256(file))
        artifactState(context, names.database, artifact.artifactId.value).let { state ->
            when (boundary) {
                "BYTES_PUBLISHED" -> assertNull("Metadata must not yet be registered", state)
                "METADATA_STAGED", "TRANSACTION_OPEN" -> assertEquals("STAGED_DURABLE", state)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun resume(
        context: android.content.Context,
        application: DocScanApplication,
        fixtureId: String,
        boundary: String,
    ) {
        val names = fixtureNames(context, fixtureId)
        if (boundary == "SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED" || boundary == "SOURCE_INVALID_BYTES_PUBLISHED") {
            resumeSourcePublication(context, application, fixtureId, boundary, names)
            return
        }
        val checkpoint = names.fixture.resolve("checkpoint.txt").readLines()
            .map { it.substringBefore('=') to it.substringAfter('=') }.toMap()
        assertEquals(fixtureId, checkpoint["fixture"])
        assertEquals(boundary, checkpoint["boundary"])
        assertEquals(PAUSE_BEFORE_PAGE_INDEX.toString(), checkpoint["sourcePageIndex"])
        assertEquals("1", checkpoint["committedPageCount"])
        val expectedPage = checkpoint.getValue("page").split('|')
        assertEquals(2, expectedPage.size)
        val sourceHash = checkpoint.getValue("sourceSha256")

        if (boundary == "TRANSACTION_OPEN") {
            assertTransactionRollback(context, names.database, fixtureId, checkpoint)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(names.fixture.resolve("source.pdf")))
            val stagedImage = names.artifacts.resolve(checkpoint.getValue("artifactRelativePath"))
            assertTrue("Published transaction image must survive the process kill", stagedImage.isFile)
            assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("artifactSize").toLong(), stagedImage.length())
            assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("artifactSha256"), sha256(stagedImage))
        }

        val appOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val providerOverride = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        try {
            assertFalse("Import fixture must pass startup integrity checks", storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertEquals("The previously committed prefix must survive process death", 1,
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
            val prefix = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
            assertEquals(expectedPage[0], prefix.pageId.value)
            assertEquals(expectedPage[1], prefix.imageVersionId.value)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(names.fixture.resolve("source.pdf")))

            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            awaitPageCount(scenario, storage, SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT)

            val pages = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
            assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, pages.size)
            assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, pages.map { it.pageId }.distinct().size)
            assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, pages.map { it.imageVersionId }.distinct().size)
            assertEquals(expectedPage[0], pages.first().pageId.value)
            assertEquals(expectedPage[1], pages.first().imageVersionId.value)
            val ids = storage.importedPdfPageIds(ImportSessionId.parse(fixtureId))
            assertEquals(pages.map { it.pageId }, ids)
            assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, ids.distinct().size)
            val rows = importedArtifactRows(context, names.database, fixtureId)
            assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, rows.size)
            assertTrue("Every visible imported page must point at a committed artifact", rows.all { it.second == "COMMITTED" })
            val sourceSnapshots = names.artifacts.walkTopDown().filter { it.isFile && it.extension == "pdf" }.toList()
            assertEquals("One private source PDF remains", 1, sourceSnapshots.size)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(sourceSnapshots.single()))
            assertTrue(storage.resumeIncompletePdfImports(application.heavyWorkScheduler).isEmpty())
            assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
            assertEquals("No materialized page artifact may be quarantined", 0, storage.quarantinedArtifactsAtStartup)
            Log.i(TAG, "RESUME_PASS fixture=$fixtureId boundary=$boundary page_ids=${ids.joinToString(",")}")
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = providerOverride
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = appOverride
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(names.database)
            names.artifacts.deleteRecursively()
            names.fixture.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun resumeSourcePublication(
        context: android.content.Context,
        application: DocScanApplication,
        fixtureId: String,
        boundary: String,
        names: FixtureNames,
    ) {
        val checkpoint = names.fixture.resolve("checkpoint.txt").readLines()
            .map { it.substringBefore('=') to it.substringAfter('=') }.toMap()
        assertEquals(fixtureId, checkpoint["fixture"])
        assertEquals(boundary, checkpoint["boundary"])
        val sourceHash = checkpoint.getValue("sourceSha256")
        assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(names.fixture.resolve("source.pdf")))
        val published = names.artifacts.resolve(checkpoint.getValue("artifactRelativePath"))
        assertTrue("Published source bytes must survive until startup recovery", published.isFile)
        assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("artifactSize").toLong(), published.length())
        assertEquals(checkpoint.getValue("artifactSha256"), sha256(published))
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            context.getDatabasePath(names.database).absolutePath,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
        ).use { db ->
            assertEquals(1L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PdfImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
            assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
        }

        val appOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val providerOverride = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, names.database, names.artifacts.name)
        application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        try {
            assertFalse(storage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
                context.getDatabasePath(names.database).absolutePath,
                null,
                SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
            ).use { db ->
                assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PdfImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
                if (boundary == "SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED") {
                    assertEquals(1L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ? AND state='COMMITTED'", fixtureId))
                    assertEquals(1L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ? AND state='OPEN'", fixtureId))
                    assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(published))
                } else {
                    assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", fixtureId))
                    assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
                    assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", fixtureId))
                    assertFalse("Invalid unregistered source must be removed", published.exists())
                }
            }
            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            if (boundary == "SOURCE_BYTES_PUBLISHED") {
                awaitPageCount(scenario, storage, SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT)
                val pages = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
                assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, pages.size)
                assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, pages.map { it.pageId }.distinct().size)
                assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, pages.map { it.imageVersionId }.distinct().size)
                assertEquals(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT, storage.importedPdfPageIds(ImportSessionId.parse(fixtureId)).size)
                assertTrue(storage.resumeIncompletePdfImports(application.heavyWorkScheduler).isEmpty())
                assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(published))
            } else {
                assertTrue(storage.workspaceProjection().pages.isEmpty())
                assertFalse(published.exists())
            }
            assertEquals("No interrupted source intent may be quarantined as an artifact", 0, storage.quarantinedArtifactsAtStartup)
            Log.i(TAG, "SOURCE_RESUME_PASS fixture=$fixtureId boundary=$boundary")
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = providerOverride
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = appOverride
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(names.database)
            names.artifacts.deleteRecursively()
            names.fixture.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun artifactState(context: android.content.Context, databaseName: String, artifactId: String): String? {
        val db = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY)
        return db.use {
            it.rawQuery("SELECT state FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", arrayOf(artifactId)).use { cursor ->
                if (!cursor.moveToFirst()) null else cursor.getString(0)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun assertTransactionRollback(
        context: android.content.Context,
        databaseName: String,
        importSessionId: String,
        checkpoint: Map<String, String>,
    ) {
        val db = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
        )
        db.use {
            assertEquals(
                "Only the committed prefix is visible after process death",
                1L,
                scalarLong(it, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ?", importSessionId),
            )
            assertEquals(
                "The uncommitted source page must roll back",
                0L,
                scalarLong(
                    it,
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ? AND source_page_index = ?",
                    importSessionId,
                    PAUSE_BEFORE_PAGE_INDEX.toString(),
                ),
            )
            assertEquals(
                0L,
                scalarLong(it, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageVersion WHERE image_version_id = ?", checkpoint.getValue("transactionImageVersionId")),
            )
            assertEquals(
                0L,
                scalarLong(it, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE page_id = ?", checkpoint.getValue("transactionPageId")),
            )
            assertEquals(
                0L,
                scalarLong(it, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactReference WHERE artifact_id = ?", checkpoint.getValue("artifactId")),
            )
            assertEquals("STAGED_DURABLE", scalarString(it, "SELECT state FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", checkpoint.getValue("artifactId")))
            assertEquals("OPEN", scalarString(it, "SELECT state FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", importSessionId))
            assertEquals(
                checkpoint.getValue("page").split('|').first(),
                scalarString(it, "SELECT page_id FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ? ORDER BY source_page_index LIMIT 1", importSessionId),
            )
            assertEquals(
                checkpoint.getValue("page").split('|')[1],
                scalarString(it, "SELECT current_image_version_id FROM Page WHERE import_session_id = ? ORDER BY source_page_index LIMIT 1", importSessionId),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun scalarLong(db: SQLiteDatabase, sql: String, vararg args: String): Long =
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { cursor -> check(cursor.moveToFirst()); cursor.getLong(0) }

    private fun scalarLong(context: android.content.Context, databaseName: String, sql: String, vararg args: String): Long =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use {
            scalarLong(it, sql, *args)
        }

    private fun scalarString(db: SQLiteDatabase, sql: String, vararg args: String): String? =
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { cursor -> if (cursor.moveToFirst()) cursor.getString(0) else null }

    private fun scalarString(context: android.content.Context, databaseName: String, sql: String, vararg args: String): String? =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use {
            scalarString(it, sql, *args)
        }

    private fun deterministicPageIds(importSessionId: String, sourcePageIndex: Int): Pair<String, String> {
        val pageIdentity = "$importSessionId:$sourcePageIndex"
        val pageId = java.util.UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("$pageIdentity:page".toByteArray()).toString()
        val imageVersionId = java.util.UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("$pageIdentity:image-version".toByteArray()).toString()
        return pageId to imageVersionId
    }

    private fun writeCheckpoint(directory: File, contents: String) {
        FileOutputStream(directory.resolve("checkpoint.txt")).use { out ->
            out.write(contents.toByteArray())
            out.fd.sync()
        }
    }

    private fun importedArtifactRows(
        context: android.content.Context,
        databaseName: String,
        importSessionId: String,
    ): List<Pair<String, String>> {
        val db = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY)
        return db.use {
            it.rawQuery(
                "SELECT a.artifact_id, a.state FROM Page p JOIN ImageVersion v ON v.image_version_id = p.current_image_version_id " +
                    "JOIN ArtifactRecord a ON a.artifact_id = v.artifact_id WHERE p.import_session_id = ? " +
                    "ORDER BY p.source_page_index",
                arrayOf(importSessionId),
            ).use { cursor ->
                buildList {
                    while (cursor.moveToNext()) add(cursor.getString(0) to cursor.getString(1))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun awaitPageCount(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>, storage: ProductStorage, expected: Int) {
        val deadline = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 60_000L
        while (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size == expected) return
            SystemClock.sleep(50L)
        }
        throw AssertionError("ProductActivity startup did not resume the import to $expected pages")
    }

    private fun fixtureNames(context: android.content.Context, fixtureId: String): FixtureNames = FixtureNames(
        database = "pdf-publish-death-$fixtureId.db",
        artifacts = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "pdf-publish-artifacts-$fixtureId"),
        fixture = File(context.filesDir, "pdf-publish-fixture-$fixtureId"),
    )

    private fun createSourcePdf(file: File) {
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            repeat(SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT) { document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4)) }
            document.save(file)
        }
    }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(file.readBytes()).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

    private data class FixtureNames(val database: String, val artifacts: File, val fixture: File)

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "PdfImportPublicationDeath"
        const val SOURCE_PAGE_COUNT = 3
        const val PAUSE_BEFORE_PAGE_INDEX = 1
    }
}

    @Test
    fun synchronousInvalidPdfRemovesOnlyItsPrivateSnapshotAndIntent() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-source-invalid-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "pdf-source-invalid-artifacts-$suffix"
        val artifactRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName)
        artifactRoot.mkdirs()
        val sentinel = File(artifactRoot, "unrelated-sentinel.bin").apply { writeBytes(byteArrayOf(3, 1, 4)) }
        val sentinelBefore = sentinel.readBytes()
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val priorStorage = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName)
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        try {
            var failure: Exception? = null
            try {
                storage.importPdf(
                    ByteArrayInputStream("not a PDF".toByteArray()),
                    "invalid.pdf",
                    sessionId,
                    application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                )
            } catch (caught: Exception) {
                failure = caught
            }
            assertTrue("Invalid PDF must fail inspection", failure != null)
            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
                context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath,
                null,
                SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
            ).use { db ->
                assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PdfImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", sessionId.value))
                assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", sessionId.value))
                assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", sessionId.value))
            }
            assertFalse(File(artifactRoot, "objects/${sessionId.value.take(2)}/${sessionId.value}.pdf").exists())
            assertTrue(sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(sentinelBefore))
        } finally {
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            artifactRoot.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun enospcAtPdfSourceAtomicPublicationLeavesNoPrivateOrDatabaseOwnership() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-source-enospc-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "pdf-source-enospc-artifacts-$suffix"
        val artifactRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName)
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val priorStorage = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val publisherCalls = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
        val injectedPublisher = AtomicArtifactPublisher { temporary, target ->
            publisherCalls.incrementAndGet()
            assertTrue("PDF bytes must reach the private staging file before destination ENOSPC", Files.isRegularFile(temporary))
            assertTrue("Staged PDF must contain the valid source", Files.size(temporary) > 0)
            throw FileSystemException(temporary.toString(), target.toString(), "No space left on device")
        }
        val storage = ProductStorage(
            context,
            databaseName,
            artifactDirectoryName,
            artifactAtomicPublisher = injectedPublisher,
        )
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        val sourceBytes = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 2)
        val sourceHash = sha256(sourceBytes)
        val projectionBefore = storage.workspaceProjection()
        var storageClosed = false
        try {
            var failure: Exception? = null
            try {
                storage.importPdf(
                    ByteArrayInputStream(sourceBytes),
                    "low-space.pdf",
                    sessionId,
                    application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                )
            } catch (caught: Exception) {
                failure = caught
            }
            assertTrue("ENOSPC must propagate to the import caller", failure is FileSystemException)
            assertEquals("No space left on device", (failure as FileSystemException).reason)
            assertEquals(1, publisherCalls.get())
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(sourceBytes))
            assertEquals("A failed import must not change workspace", projectionBefore, storage.workspaceProjection())
            val countsAfterFailure = readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId)
            assertEquals(mapOf(
                "PdfImportPublicationIntent" to 0L,
                "ImportSession" to 0L,
                "Page" to 0L,
                "ImageVersion" to 0L,
                "ArtifactRecord" to 0L,
                "ArtifactReference" to 0L,
            ), countsAfterFailure)
            assertNoPrivatePdfOrStagingFiles(artifactRoot)
            Log.i("PdfImportNoSpace", "phase=atomic-publish-enospc sourceSize=${sourceBytes.size} sourceSha256=$sourceHash publisherCalls=${publisherCalls.get()} counts=$countsAfterFailure workspaceUnchanged=true privateFiles=0 exception=${failure.javaClass.simpleName}:${failure.message}")

            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            storage.close()
            storageClosed = true
            val reopened = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName)
            try {
                assertFalse("Restart must not report startup integrity failure", reopened.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                assertTrue("Failed source publication must not create a resumable session",
                    reopened.resumeIncompletePdfImports(application.heavyWorkScheduler).isEmpty())
                assertEquals(projectionBefore, reopened.workspaceProjection())
                assertEquals(countsAfterFailure, readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId))
                assertNoPrivatePdfOrStagingFiles(artifactRoot)
                Log.i("PdfImportNoSpace", "phase=restart-reconciled counts=${readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId)} workspaceUnchanged=true privateFiles=0")
            } finally {
                reopened.close()
            }
        } finally {
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            if (!storageClosed) storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            artifactRoot.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun enospcBeforeSecondPdfSourceStagingWriteCleansPartialPrefixAndOwnership() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-source-write-enospc-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "pdf-source-write-enospc-artifacts-$suffix"
        val artifactRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName)
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val priorStorage = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val sourceBytes = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 2)
        val sourceHash = sha256(sourceBytes)
        val writeCheckpoints = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
        val forceCalls = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
        val publisherCalls = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
        val injectedCheckpoint = ArtifactStagingWriteCheckpoint { channel, bytesAlreadyWritten ->
            val call = writeCheckpoints.incrementAndGet()
            if (call == 2) {
                assertEquals("Exactly one 64-byte prefix must have reached staging", 64L, bytesAlreadyWritten)
                assertEquals("The staging file must contain only the committed prefix", 64L, channel.size())
                throw FileSystemException("private-pdf-staging", null, "No space left on device")
            }
            assertEquals("First staging write must start at offset zero", 0L, bytesAlreadyWritten)
            assertEquals("Staging file must initially be empty", 0L, channel.size())
        }
        val injectedSync = ArtifactStagingSync {
            forceCalls.incrementAndGet()
            it.force(true)
        }
        val injectedPublisher = AtomicArtifactPublisher { _, _ ->
            publisherCalls.incrementAndGet()
            throw AssertionError("Sync and publish must not run after staging write ENOSPC")
        }
        val storage = ProductStorage(
            context,
            databaseName,
            artifactDirectoryName,
            artifactAtomicPublisher = injectedPublisher,
            artifactStagingSync = injectedSync,
            artifactStagingWriteCheckpoint = injectedCheckpoint,
        )
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        val projectionBefore = storage.workspaceProjection()
        var storageClosed = false
        try {
            val shortReadSource = object : FilterInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(sourceBytes)) {
                override fun read(buffer: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int =
                    super.read(buffer, offset, minOf(length, 64))
            }
            var failure: Exception? = null
            try {
                storage.importPdf(
                    shortReadSource,
                    "staging-write-enospc.pdf",
                    sessionId,
                    application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                )
            } catch (caught: Exception) {
                failure = caught
            }
            assertTrue("ENOSPC before second staging write must propagate", failure is FileSystemException)
            assertEquals("No space left on device", (failure as FileSystemException).reason)
            assertEquals(2, writeCheckpoints.get())
            assertEquals(0, forceCalls.get())
            assertEquals(0, publisherCalls.get())
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(sourceBytes))
            assertEquals("A partial staging write must not change workspace", projectionBefore, storage.workspaceProjection())
            val countsAfterFailure = readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId)
            assertEquals(mapOf(
                "PdfImportPublicationIntent" to 0L,
                "ImportSession" to 0L,
                "Page" to 0L,
                "ImageVersion" to 0L,
                "ArtifactRecord" to 0L,
                "ArtifactReference" to 0L,
            ), countsAfterFailure)
            assertNoPrivatePdfOrStagingFiles(artifactRoot)
            Log.i("PdfImportNoSpace", "phase=staging-write-enospc sourceSize=${sourceBytes.size} sourceSha256=$sourceHash stagedPrefixBytes=64 writeCheckpoints=${writeCheckpoints.get()} forceCalls=${forceCalls.get()} publisherCalls=${publisherCalls.get()} counts=$countsAfterFailure workspaceUnchanged=true privateFiles=0 exception=${failure.javaClass.simpleName}:${failure.message}")

            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            storage.close()
            storageClosed = true
            val reopened = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName)
            try {
                assertFalse("Restart must not report startup integrity failure", reopened.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                assertTrue("Failed staging write must not create a resumable session",
                    reopened.resumeIncompletePdfImports(application.heavyWorkScheduler).isEmpty())
                assertEquals(projectionBefore, reopened.workspaceProjection())
                assertEquals(countsAfterFailure, readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId))
                assertNoPrivatePdfOrStagingFiles(artifactRoot)
                Log.i("PdfImportNoSpace", "phase=staging-write-restart-reconciled counts=${readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId)} workspaceUnchanged=true privateFiles=0")
            } finally {
                reopened.close()
            }
        } finally {
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            if (!storageClosed) storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            artifactRoot.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun enospcAtPdfSourceStagingDirectorySyncCleansAtomicallyPublishedTarget() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-source-dirsync-enospc-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "pdf-source-dirsync-enospc-artifacts-$suffix"
        val artifactRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName)
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val priorStorage = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val sourceBytes = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 2)
        val sourceHash = sha256(sourceBytes)
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        val expectedTarget = File(artifactRoot, "objects/${sessionId.value.take(2)}/${sessionId.value}.pdf")
        val syncFailures = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
        val targetPresentAtInjectedFailure = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean()
        val syncDirectories = java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList<String>()
        val injectedDirectorySync = DirectorySync { directory ->
            syncDirectories += directory.fileName.toString()
            if (directory.fileName.toString() == "staging" && syncFailures.compareAndSet(0, 1)) {
                targetPresentAtInjectedFailure.set(expectedTarget.isFile && expectedTarget.length() == sourceBytes.size.toLong())
                throw FileSystemException(directory.toString(), null, "No space left on device")
            }
            AndroidDirectorySync().sync(directory)
        }
        val storage = ProductStorage(
            context,
            databaseName,
            artifactDirectoryName,
            directorySyncFactory = { injectedDirectorySync },
        )
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val projectionBefore = storage.workspaceProjection()
        var storageClosed = false
        try {
            var failure: Exception? = null
            try {
                storage.importPdf(
                    ByteArrayInputStream(sourceBytes),
                    "directory-sync-enospc.pdf",
                    sessionId,
                    application.heavyWorkScheduler,
                )
            } catch (caught: Exception) {
                failure = caught
            }
            assertTrue("Directory sync ENOSPC must propagate to the import caller", failure is FileSystemException)
            assertEquals("No space left on device", (failure as FileSystemException).reason)
            assertEquals(1, syncFailures.get())
            assertTrue("Atomic target must exist with complete bytes when staging directory sync fails", targetPresentAtInjectedFailure.get())
            assertEquals("Cleanup must continue with later directory syncs", true, syncDirectories.size > 1)
            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(sourceBytes))
            assertEquals("Failed publication must not change workspace", projectionBefore, storage.workspaceProjection())
            val countsAfterFailure = readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId)
            assertEquals(mapOf(
                "PdfImportPublicationIntent" to 0L,
                "ImportSession" to 0L,
                "Page" to 0L,
                "ImageVersion" to 0L,
                "ArtifactRecord" to 0L,
                "ArtifactReference" to 0L,
            ), countsAfterFailure)
            assertNoPrivatePdfOrStagingFiles(artifactRoot)
            assertTrue("Only the first staging sync may be injected", syncDirectories.first() == "staging")
            Log.i("PdfImportNoSpace", "phase=directory-sync-enospc sourceSize=${sourceBytes.size} sourceSha256=$sourceHash targetPresentAtFailure=${targetPresentAtInjectedFailure.get()} syncCalls=${syncDirectories.size} syncFailures=${syncFailures.get()} counts=$countsAfterFailure workspaceUnchanged=true privateFiles=0 exception=${failure.javaClass.simpleName}:${failure.message}")

            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            storage.close()
            storageClosed = true
            val reopened = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName)
            try {
                assertFalse("Restart must not report startup integrity failure", reopened.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                assertTrue("Failed directory sync must not create a resumable session",
                    reopened.resumeIncompletePdfImports(application.heavyWorkScheduler).isEmpty())
                assertEquals(projectionBefore, reopened.workspaceProjection())
                assertEquals(countsAfterFailure, readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId))
                assertNoPrivatePdfOrStagingFiles(artifactRoot)
                Log.i("PdfImportNoSpace", "phase=directory-sync-restart-reconciled counts=${readPublicationCounts(context, databaseName, sessionId)} workspaceUnchanged=true privateFiles=0")
            } finally {
                reopened.close()
            }
        } finally {
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            if (!storageClosed) storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            artifactRoot.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun startupAbandonsOnlyAnAbsentSourceIntentAndItsIdPrefixedPartialFile() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-source-partial-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "pdf-source-partial-artifacts-$suffix"
        val artifactRoot = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName)
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val first = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName)
        val workspaceId = first.workspaceId.value
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        first.close()
        val staging = File(artifactRoot, "staging").apply { mkdirs() }
        val ownedTemp = File(staging, "${sessionId.value}-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.tmp").apply {
            writeBytes(byteArrayOf(8, 6, 7, 5))
        }
        val unrelated = File(staging, "${UUID.randomUUID()}-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002.tmp").apply {
            writeBytes(byteArrayOf(9, 7, 9, 3))
        }
        val unrelatedBefore = unrelated.readBytes()
        val sentinel = File(artifactRoot, "keep.bin").apply { writeBytes(byteArrayOf(2, 7, 1, 8)) }
        val sentinelBefore = sentinel.readBytes()
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READWRITE,
        ).use { db ->
            db.execSQL(
                "INSERT INTO PdfImportPublicationIntent(import_session_id, workspace_id, source_display_name) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                arrayOf(sessionId.value, workspaceId, "interrupted.pdf"),
            )
        }

        val recovered = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName)
        try {
            assertFalse(recovered.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
                context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath,
                null,
                SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
            ).use { db ->
                assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PdfImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", sessionId.value))
                assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", sessionId.value))
                assertEquals(0L, scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", sessionId.value))
            }
            assertFalse(ownedTemp.exists())
            assertTrue(unrelated.exists())
            assertTrue(unrelated.readBytes().contentEquals(unrelatedBefore))
            assertTrue(sentinel.readBytes().contentEquals(sentinelBefore))
        } finally {
            recovered.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            artifactRoot.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun changedBytesForRegisteredSessionCannotDeleteOrReplaceThePrivateSource() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "pdf-source-mismatch-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectoryName = "pdf-source-mismatch-artifacts-$suffix"
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val priorStorage = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectoryName)
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val sessionId = ImportSessionId.new()
        val originalBytes = createPdfBytes()
        val changedBytes = createPdfBytes(pageCount = 2)
        try {
            storage.importPdf(ByteArrayInputStream(originalBytes), "same.pdf", sessionId, application.heavyWorkScheduler)
            val sourceFile = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "$artifactDirectoryName/objects/${sessionId.value.take(2)}/${sessionId.value}.pdf")
            val originalHash = sha256(originalBytes)
            assertEquals(originalHash, sha256(sourceFile.readBytes()))
            val originalPages = storage.importedPdfPageIds(sessionId)
            var failure: Exception? = null
            try {
                storage.importPdf(ByteArrayInputStream(changedBytes), "same.pdf", sessionId, application.heavyWorkScheduler)
            } catch (caught: Exception) {
                failure = caught
            }
            assertTrue("Different bytes under the same ImportSessionId must fail", failure != null)
            assertEquals(originalHash, sha256(sourceFile.readBytes()))
            assertEquals(originalPages, storage.importedPdfPageIds(sessionId))
            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
                context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath,
                null,
                SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
            ).use { db ->
                assertEquals("COMPLETED", db.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT state FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?",
                    arrayOf(sessionId.value),
                ).use { cursor -> check(cursor.moveToFirst()); cursor.getString(0) })
            }
            assertFalse(File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "$artifactDirectoryName/objects/${sessionId.value.take(2)}/${sessionId.value}.pdf.tmp").exists())
        } finally {
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorStorage
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectoryName).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun readPublicationCounts(context: android.content.Context, databaseName: String, sessionId: ImportSessionId): Map<String, Long> =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(
            context.getDatabasePath(databaseName).absolutePath,
            null,
            SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY,
        ).use { db ->
            linkedMapOf(
                "PdfImportPublicationIntent" to scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PdfImportPublicationIntent WHERE import_session_id = ?", sessionId.value),
                "ImportSession" to scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImportSession WHERE import_session_id = ?", sessionId.value),
                "Page" to scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page"),
                "ImageVersion" to scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ImageVersion"),
                "ArtifactRecord" to scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactRecord"),
                "ArtifactReference" to scalarLong(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactReference"),
            )
        }

    private fun assertNoPrivatePdfOrStagingFiles(artifactRoot: File) {
        val objects = File(artifactRoot, "objects")
        val staging = File(artifactRoot, "staging")
        assertTrue("No private artifact object may survive ENOSPC", objects.walkTopDown().none { it.isFile })
        assertTrue("No partial staging file may survive ENOSPC", staging.walkTopDown().none { it.isFile })
    }

    private fun createPdfBytes(pageCount: Int = 1): ByteArray = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            repeat(pageCount) { document.addPage(PDPage()) }
            document.save(output)
        }
        output.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun scalarLong(db: SQLiteDatabase, sql: String, vararg args: String): Long =
        db.rawQuery(sql, args).use { cursor -> check(cursor.moveToFirst()); cursor.getLong(0) }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

}

    @Test
    fun emptyWorkspaceHomeActionsHaveDistinctNamesAndFortyEightDpTargets() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val previousOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "a11y-home-$suffix.db"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, "a11y-home-artifacts-$suffix")
        application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
        try {
            awaitCaptureReady(scenario)
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync()
            val root = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow
                ?: throw AssertionError("Empty-workspace Home accessibility window is unavailable")
            val targets = mutableListOf<ViewerAccessibilityTarget>()
            collectViewerAccessibilityTargets(root, targets)
            val inventory = targets.joinToString("\n") { target ->
                "${target.className} label=${target.label ?: "<missing>"} bounds=${target.widthPx}x${target.heightPx}"
            }
            val density = context.resources.displayMetrics.density
            android.util.Log.i("DocScanA11y", "Empty-workspace Home inventory: density=$density\n$inventory")
            assertTrue("Home exposes visible actionable controls:\n$inventory", targets.isNotEmpty())
            assertTrue(
                "Every visible Home action needs a nonblank accessible name:\n$inventory",
                targets.none { it.label.isNullOrBlank() },
            )
            val labels = targets.map { it.label!!.trim().lowercase() }
            assertEquals("Visible Home action names are distinct:\n$inventory", labels.size, labels.toSet().size)
            val version = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(context.packageName, 0).versionName.orEmpty()
            val expected = listOf(
                context.getString(R.string.capture_page),
                context.getString(R.string.import_images_or_pdf),
                context.getString(R.string.export_selected_pages),
                context.getString(R.string.select_all_pages),
                context.getString(R.string.delete_selected_pages),
            ).map { it.trim().lowercase() }
            expected.forEach { label ->
                assertTrue("Home action '$label' is missing from the accessibility tree:\n$inventory", label in labels)
            }
            val minimumSizePx = kotlin.math.ceil(48f * density).toInt()
            val undersized = targets.filter { it.widthPx < minimumSizePx || it.heightPx < minimumSizePx }
            assertTrue(
                "Every visible Home target must meet 48dp (${minimumSizePx}px):\n$inventory",
                undersized.isEmpty(),
            )
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousOverride
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun pageSelectionCheckboxesExposeDistinctAccessibleLabelsAndUpdateOnlyTheirPage() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val storage = (context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication).productStorage
        val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
        val fixtures = mutableListOf<PageId>()
        try {
            awaitCaptureReady(scenario)
            val first = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = true)
            val second = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = false)
            fixtures += first.pageId
            fixtures += second.pageId
            scenario.onActivity { it.renderPages(storage.workspaceProjection()) }

            scrollHomeRailToPositionForTest(scenario, 0)

            val firstLabel = context.getString(R.string.include_page_in_save, 1)
            val secondLabel = context.getString(R.string.include_page_in_save, 2)
            assertTrue("Page labels identify different ordinals", firstLabel != secondLabel)
            val device = UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
            val firstAppeared = device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.desc(firstLabel)), 5_000)
            assertTrue("Page 1 selection checkbox appears after the workspace row scrolls into view", firstAppeared)
            val firstCheckbox = requireNotNull(device.findObject(By.desc(firstLabel))) {
                "Page 1 selection checkbox is not exposed in the accessibility tree"
            }
            assertTrue("Page 1 accessibility node retains the checkbox role", firstCheckbox.isCheckable)
            assertTrue("Page 1 starts selected", firstCheckbox.isChecked)

            scrollHomeRailToPositionForTest(scenario, 1)
            assertTrue(
                "Page 2 selection checkbox appears after its workspace row scrolls into view",
                device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.desc(secondLabel)), 5_000),
            )
            val secondCheckbox = requireNotNull(device.findObject(androidx.test.uiautomator.By.desc(secondLabel))) {
                "Page 2 selection checkbox is not exposed in the accessibility tree after scrolling to it"
            }
            assertTrue("Page 2 accessibility node retains the checkbox role", secondCheckbox.isCheckable)
            assertTrue("Page 2 starts unselected", !secondCheckbox.isChecked)

            secondCheckbox.click()
            awaitCondition("Accessible Page 2 activation must persist only Page 2 selection") {
                val pages = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
                pages.singleOrNull { it.pageId == first.pageId }?.selected == true &&
                    pages.singleOrNull { it.pageId == second.pageId }?.selected == true
            }
            awaitCondition("Page 2 remains checked in the current accessibility tree") { device.findObject(By.desc(secondLabel))?.isChecked == true }
            assertEquals(true, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == first.pageId }.selected)
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            fixtures.forEach { id ->
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.singleOrNull { it.pageId == id }?.let(storage::deletePage)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun workspaceViewerSynchronizesActiveAndSelectedAcrossThumbnailsButtonsAndSwipes() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val storage = (context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication).productStorage
        val priorActive = storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId
        val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
        var reopened: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        var scenarioClosed = false
        val fixtures = mutableListOf<PageId>()
        try {
            awaitCaptureReady(scenario)
            val first = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = true)
            val second = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = false)
            val third = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = true)
            fixtures += listOf(first.pageId, second.pageId, third.pageId)
            storage.setActivePage(first.pageId)
            scenario.onActivity { it.renderPages(storage.workspaceProjection()) }

            scrollHomeRailToPositionForTest(scenario, 0)
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val thumb = findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView,
                    ProductActivity.WORKSPACE_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + first.pageId.value) as? View
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Active Page 1 thumbnail is missing")
                val frame = thumb.background as? GradientDrawable
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Workspace thumbnail has no active frame")
                assertEquals(context.getString(R.string.active_page, 1), thumb.contentDescription)
                thumb.performClick()
            }
            awaitCondition("Opening a workspace thumbnail must persist Active before image rendering") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == first.pageId
            }
            awaitCondition("Viewer strip must be rendered") {
                var present = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    present = findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_THUMBNAIL_STRIP_TAG) != null
                }
                present
            }
            assertWorkspaceViewerAccessibility(context)

            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val secondThumb = findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + second.pageId.value)
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Page 2 thumbnail is missing")
                secondThumb.performClick()
            }
            awaitCondition("Tapping the Viewer strip makes only its Page Active") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == second.pageId &&
                    storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == second.pageId }.selected.not()
            }
            assertTrue(storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == first.pageId }.selected)
            assertTrue(storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == third.pageId }.selected)
            assertEquals(false, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == second.pageId }.selected)

            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val pageTwoSelection = findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_SELECTION_TAG_PREFIX + second.pageId.value) as? CheckBox
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Page 2 Selected checkbox is missing")
                val minimumHitTargetPx = kotlin.math.ceil(
                    48f * activity.resources.displayMetrics.density,
                ).toInt()
                assertTrue(
                    "Viewer selection checkbox meets the 48dp minimum hit target (actual=${pageTwoSelection.height}px, minimum=${minimumHitTargetPx}px, minimumHeight=${pageTwoSelection.minimumHeight}px)",
                    pageTwoSelection.height >= minimumHitTargetPx,
                )
                assertFalse("Viewer checkbox mirrors persisted selection", pageTwoSelection.isChecked)
                pageTwoSelection.performClick()
            }
            awaitCondition("Viewer selection persists without changing Active") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == second.pageId }.selected &&
                    storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == second.pageId
            }

            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                (findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_NEXT_TAG) as? View)
                    ?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Next control is missing")
            }
            awaitCondition("Next updates the displayed and durable Active Page") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == third.pageId
            }

            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val title = findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_TITLE_TAG) as? android.widget.TextView
                val ordinal = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.indexOfFirst { it.pageId == third.pageId } + 1
                assertEquals(context.getString(R.string.page_number, ordinal), title?.text)
                val selectedPageTwo = findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_SELECTION_TAG_PREFIX + second.pageId.value) as? CheckBox
                assertTrue("Viewer strip retains Selected state while Active moves",
                    selectedPageTwo?.isChecked == true)
                val activeThumbnail = findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + third.pageId.value) as? View
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Active thumbnail is missing")
                val activeFrame = activeThumbnail.background as? GradientDrawable
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Active thumbnail has no frame")
                val activeOrdinal = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.indexOfFirst { it.pageId == third.pageId } + 1
                assertEquals(context.getString(R.string.active_page, activeOrdinal), activeThumbnail.contentDescription)
                assertFalse("Next is disabled at the last Page", findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_NEXT_TAG)?.isEnabled ?: true)
                (findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_NEXT_TAG) as View).performClick()
            }
            SystemClock.sleep(150L)
            assertEquals("Next at the end does not wrap", third.pageId, storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId)

            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                (findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + second.pageId.value) as? View)
                    ?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Page 2 thumbnail is missing")
            }
            awaitCondition("Selecting Page 2 prepares backward and forward swipe checks") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == second.pageId
            }
            swipeViewer(scenario, directionLeft = false)
            awaitCondition("Right swipe navigates to the previous Page") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == first.pageId
            }
            swipeViewer(scenario, directionLeft = true)
            awaitCondition("Left swipe navigates to the next Page") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == second.pageId
            }
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                (findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_PREVIOUS_TAG) as? View)
                    ?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Previous control is missing")
            }
            awaitCondition("Previous control shares the swipe navigation state") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == first.pageId
            }
            val actualFirst = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.first()
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                (findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + actualFirst.pageId.value) as? View)
                    ?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Workspace first Page thumbnail is missing")
            }
            awaitCondition("Viewer can navigate to the true first workspace Page") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == actualFirst.pageId
            }
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertFalse("Previous is disabled at the first Page", findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PREVIOUS_TAG)?.isEnabled ?: true)
            }
            swipeViewer(scenario, directionLeft = false)
            SystemClock.sleep(150L)
            assertEquals("Right swipe at the first Page does not wrap", actualFirst.pageId, storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId)
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                (findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + first.pageId.value) as? View)
                    ?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Fixture Page 1 thumbnail is missing")
            }
            awaitCondition("Fixture Active state is restored before closing Viewer") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == first.pageId
            }

            UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()).pressBack()
            awaitCondition("Viewer closes before checking persisted reopen state") {
                var closed = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    closed = findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_THUMBNAIL_STRIP_TAG) == null
                }
                closed
            }
            scrollHomeRailToPositionForTest(scenario, 0)
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val active = findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView,
                    ProductActivity.WORKSPACE_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + first.pageId.value) as? View
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Workspace thumbnail missing after Viewer close")
                assertTrue("Workspace active frame is synchronized after Viewer close",
                    active.background is GradientDrawable && active.contentDescription == context.getString(
                        R.string.active_page,
                        storage.workspaceProjection().pages.indexOfFirst { it.pageId == first.pageId } + 1,
                    ))
            }
            scenario.close()
            scenarioClosed = true
            reopened = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            scrollHomeRailToPositionForTest(reopened!!, 0)
            awaitCondition("Reopened workspace restores durable Active Page") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == first.pageId
            }
            reopened!!.onActivity { activity ->
                val active = findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView,
                    ProductActivity.WORKSPACE_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + first.pageId.value) as? View
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Workspace Active thumbnail missing after Activity recreation")
                assertTrue("Reopened workspace shows the durable Active frame",
                    active.background is GradientDrawable && active.contentDescription == context.getString(
                        R.string.active_page,
                        storage.workspaceProjection().pages.indexOfFirst { it.pageId == first.pageId } + 1,
                    ))
            }
        } finally {
            if (!scenarioClosed) scenario.close()
            reopened?.close()
            fixtures.asReversed().forEach { id ->
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.singleOrNull { it.pageId == id }?.let(storage::deletePage)
            }
            priorActive?.let { id ->
                if (storage.workspaceProjection().pages.any { it.pageId == id }) storage.setActivePage(id)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rapidViewerThumbnailNavigationDisplaysTheLastRequestedImage() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val storage = (context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication).productStorage
        val priorActive = storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId
        val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
        val fixtures = mutableListOf<PageId>()
        try {
            awaitCaptureReady(scenario)
            val first = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = true)
            val second = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = false)
            val third = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = true)
            fixtures += listOf(first.pageId, second.pageId, third.pageId)
            storage.setActivePage(first.pageId)
            scrollHomeRailToPositionForTest(scenario, 0)
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                activity.renderPages(storage.workspaceProjection())
                (findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView,
                    ProductActivity.WORKSPACE_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + first.pageId.value) as? View)
                    ?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Workspace Page 1 thumbnail is missing")
            }
            awaitCondition("Viewer strip opens for the fixture workspace") {
                var present = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    present = findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_THUMBNAIL_STRIP_TAG) != null
                }
                present
            }

            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val secondThumbnail = findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + second.pageId.value)
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Page 2 thumbnail is missing")
                val thirdThumbnail = findViewerView(activity,
                    ProductActivity.VIEWER_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + third.pageId.value)
                    ?: throw AssertionError("Viewer Page 3 thumbnail is missing")
                // Queue both requests in the same UI turn so the first decode cannot settle first.
                secondThumbnail.performClick()
                thirdThumbnail.performClick()
            }
            awaitCondition("The final thumbnail request becomes durable Active and displays its red image") {
                var finalImageShown = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    val viewerImage = findViewerView(activity,
                        ProductActivity.VIEWER_MAIN_IMAGE_TAG) as? android.widget.ImageView
                    val bitmap = (viewerImage?.drawable as? android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable)?.bitmap
                    if (bitmap != null) {
                        val pixel = bitmap.getPixel(bitmap.width / 2, bitmap.height / 2)
                        finalImageShown = android.graphics.Color.red(pixel) > android.graphics.Color.blue(pixel)
                    }
                }
                finalImageShown && storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == third.pageId
            }
            assertFalse("Rapid navigation does not change Page 2 Selected state",
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single { it.pageId == second.pageId }.selected)
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            fixtures.asReversed().forEach { id ->
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.singleOrNull { it.pageId == id }?.let(storage::deletePage)
            }
            priorActive?.let { id ->
                if (storage.workspaceProjection().pages.any { it.pageId == id }) storage.setActivePage(id)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun viewerSelectionPersistsActiveEvenWhenPageImageCannotBeDecoded() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val storage = (context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication).productStorage
        val priorActive = storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId
        val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
        var fixtureId: PageId? = null
        var imagePath: java.nio.file.Path? = null
        var originalImage: ByteArray? = null
        try {
            awaitCaptureReady(scenario)
            val fixture = createFixturePage(context, storage, selected = false)
            fixtureId = fixture.pageId
            imagePath = storage.artifactPath(fixture.artifactRelativePath)
            originalImage = java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(imagePath)
            java.nio.file.Files.write(imagePath, byteArrayOf(0, 1, 2, 3, 4))
            scrollHomeRailToPositionForTest(scenario, 0)
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                activity.renderPages(storage.workspaceProjection())
                (findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView,
                    ProductActivity.WORKSPACE_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + fixture.pageId.value) as? View)
                    ?.performClick() ?: throw AssertionError("Corrupt-image fixture thumbnail is missing")
            }
            awaitCondition("Active is persisted even when selected Page image decoding fails") {
                storage.workspaceProjection().activePageId == fixture.pageId
            }
            awaitCondition("Viewer reports the image decode error") {
                var failed = false
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    failed = (findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_TITLE_TAG)
                        as? android.widget.TextView)?.text != context.getString(
                        R.string.page_number,
                        storage.workspaceProjection().pages.indexOfFirst { it.pageId == fixture.pageId } + 1,
                    )
                }
                failed
            }
            assertFalse("Decode failure does not change Selected", storage.workspaceProjection().pages
                .single { it.pageId == fixture.pageId }.selected)
        } finally {
            scenario.close()
            if (imagePath != null && originalImage != null) java.nio.file.Files.write(imagePath, originalImage)
            fixtureId?.let { id ->
                storage.workspaceProjection().pages.singleOrNull { it.pageId == id }?.let(storage::deletePage)
            }
            priorActive?.let { id ->
                if (storage.workspaceProjection().pages.any { it.pageId == id }) storage.setActivePage(id)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun swipeViewer(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>, directionLeft: Boolean) {
        val rect = android.graphics.Rect()
        awaitCondition("Viewer main image becomes visible before swiping") {
            var visible = false
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val image = findViewerView(activity, ProductActivity.VIEWER_MAIN_IMAGE_TAG) as? android.widget.ImageView
                visible = image != null && image.drawable != null && image.getGlobalVisibleRect(rect) &&
                    rect.width() > 0 && rect.height() > 0
            }
            visible
        }
        val centerY = rect.centerY()
        val startX = if (directionLeft) rect.left + rect.width() * 3 / 4 else rect.left + rect.width() / 4
        val endX = if (directionLeft) rect.left + rect.width() / 4 else rect.left + rect.width() * 3 / 4
        UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
            .swipe(startX, centerY, endX, centerY, 12)
    }

    @Test
    fun validShutterProvidesOneLightFeedbackAndCommitsPage() {

        val storage = (context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication).productStorage
