package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import androidx.test.uiautomator.By
import androidx.test.uiautomator.UiDevice
import androidx.test.uiautomator.Until
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.regex.Pattern

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SafProviderCapabilityProbeInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun primaryDocumentsProviderEnumeratesWritesReadsBackAndDoesNotOverwriteOnDuplicateCreate() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val app = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "saf-probe-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "saf-probe-artifacts-$suffix"
        val preexistingPermissions = context.contentResolver.persistedUriPermissions.map { it.uri }.toSet()
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        var tree: Uri? = null
        var firstDocument: Uri? = null
        var duplicateDocument: Uri? = null
        var primaryFailure: Throwable? = null
        var cleanupFailure: Throwable? = null
        val requestedName = "docscan-provider-probe-$suffix.txt"
        val payload = ByteArray(256 * 1024) { index -> ((index * 31 + index / 251 + 17) and 0xff).toByte() }
        val expectedHash = sha256(payload)

        try {
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            awaitActivityReady(scenario)
            clickDestinationButton(scenario)
            selectDocumentsFolder(UiDevice.getInstance(instrumentation))

            val grant = awaitDestinationGrant(storage)
            tree = Uri.parse(grant.treeUri)
            assertEquals("The selected SAF tree must be the delegated existing primary Documents folder",
                "primary:Documents", DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree))
            assertTrue("The real picker must leave persistent read/write permission",
                context.contentResolver.persistedUriPermissions.any {
                    it.uri == tree && it.isReadPermission && it.isWritePermission
                })
            assertTrue("Production grant manager must revalidate the selected tree",
                SafDestinationGrantManager(context).revalidate(grant, storage))
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertFalse(
                    "Save must stay disabled while this probe has not recorded a qualification",
                    activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled ?: true,
                )
            }

            val authority = requireNotNull(tree.authority)
            val provider = context.packageManager.resolveContentProvider(authority, 0)
            assertNotNull("Selected tree authority must resolve to a provider", provider)
            val providerPackage = requireNotNull(provider).packageName
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            val providerInfo = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(providerPackage, 0)
            val providerVersion = "${providerInfo.versionName.orEmpty()}#${providerInfo.longVersionCode}"
            val adapterId = "${ProductActivity.SAF_ADAPTER_ID}/$providerPackage/$authority"
            val accessClass = ProductActivity.SAF_ACCESS_CLASS
            assertNull("This probe must not provision a provider qualification", storage.providerQualificationFor(
                adapterId, providerVersion, Build.FINGERPRINT, accessClass,
            ))
            android.util.Log.i(
                LOG_TAG,
                "PROVIDER_TUPLE authority=$authority package=$providerPackage version=$providerVersion " +
                    "os=${Build.FINGERPRINT} access=$accessClass tree=$tree",
            )

            val resolver = context.contentResolver
            val treeId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
            val parent = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, treeId)
            val before = listChildren(resolver, tree, treeId)
            assertFalse("Random probe name must not exist before this run", before.any { it.name == requestedName })
            android.util.Log.i(LOG_TAG, "CHILD_ENUMERATION before_count=${before.size} requested_absent=true")

            firstDocument = DocumentsContract.createDocument(resolver, parent, "text/plain", requestedName)
            assertNotNull("Positive control: provider must create a unique new document", firstDocument)
            writeFully(resolver, requireNotNull(firstDocument), payload)
            val firstReadBack = readFully(resolver, firstDocument!!)
            assertEquals("Provider must return every byte written", payload.size, firstReadBack.size)
            assertEquals("Full read-back SHA-256 must match", expectedHash, sha256(firstReadBack))

            var duplicateException: Exception? = null
            try {
                duplicateDocument = DocumentsContract.createDocument(resolver, parent, "text/plain", requestedName)
            } catch (failure: Exception) {
                duplicateException = failure
            }
            if (duplicateDocument == null) {
                assertNotNull("Duplicate rejection must be explicit; unrelated create errors do not qualify", duplicateException)
                val errorText = "${duplicateException!!::class.java.simpleName} ${duplicateException.message.orEmpty()}"
                    .lowercase()
                assertTrue("Duplicate rejection must identify an existing/conflicting name: $errorText",
                    listOf("exist", "duplicate", "already", "conflict").any(errorText::contains))
                android.util.Log.i(LOG_TAG, "DUPLICATE_CREATE outcome=rejected error=$errorText")
            } else {
                assertNotEquals("Duplicate create must return a distinct document identity", firstDocument, duplicateDocument)
                assertTrue("Provider enumeration must expose the newly created second identity",
                    listChildren(resolver, tree, treeId).any { it.id == DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(duplicateDocument) })
                android.util.Log.i(LOG_TAG, "DUPLICATE_CREATE outcome=separate_uri uri=$duplicateDocument")
            }

            val preserved = readFully(resolver, firstDocument!!)
            assertEquals("The original document must retain its full byte count", payload.size, preserved.size)
            assertEquals("The original document must not be overwritten by a same-name create", expectedHash, sha256(preserved))
            val after = listChildren(resolver, tree, treeId)
            assertTrue("Child enumeration must retain the original provider document ID",
                after.any { it.id == DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(firstDocument) })
            assertNull("No qualification row may be written by this probe", storage.providerQualificationFor(
                adapterId, providerVersion, Build.FINGERPRINT, accessClass,
            ))
            android.util.Log.i(
                LOG_TAG,
                "PROBE_PASS bytes=${payload.size} sha256=$expectedHash children_before=${before.size} " +
                    "children_after=${after.size} original_id=${DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(firstDocument)}",
            )
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            primaryFailure = failure
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = null
            val resolver = context.contentResolver
            listOfNotNull(duplicateDocument, firstDocument).distinct().forEach { uri ->
                if (runCatching { DocumentsContract.deleteDocument(resolver, uri) }.getOrDefault(false).not()) {
                    cleanupFailure = IllegalStateException("Provider did not delete test-owned document $uri", cleanupFailure)
                }
            }
            tree?.let { selectedTree ->
                var grantReleasedByTest = false
                runCatching {
                    val id = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(selectedTree)
                    val ownedIds = listOfNotNull(firstDocument, duplicateDocument).map(DocumentsContract::getDocumentId).toSet()
                    val leftovers = listChildren(resolver, selectedTree, id).filter { it.id in ownedIds }
                    if (leftovers.isNotEmpty()) throw IllegalStateException("Test-owned provider children remain after cleanup: $leftovers")
                }.onFailure { cleanupFailure = it }
                if (selectedTree !in preexistingPermissions) {
                    runCatching { SafDestinationGrantManager(context).releasePersistedGrant(selectedTree.toString()) }
                        .onSuccess { grantReleasedByTest = true }
                        .onFailure { cleanupFailure = it }
                }
                if (cleanupFailure == null) {
                    android.util.Log.i(
                        LOG_TAG,
                        "CLEANUP_PASS created_ids_removed=true grant_released_by_test=$grantReleasedByTest",
                    )
                }
            }
            runCatching { storage.close() }.onFailure { cleanupFailure = it }
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            cleanupFailure?.let { if (primaryFailure == null) primaryFailure = it else primaryFailure!!.addSuppressed(it) }
        }
        primaryFailure?.let { throw AssertionError("AOSP provider probe failed or cleanup was incomplete", it) }
    }

    private fun selectDocumentsFolder(device: UiDevice) {
        val timeout = 15_000L
        assertTrue("System DocumentsUI must launch", device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.pkg("com.google.android.documentsui")), timeout))
        val useFolder = By.text(Pattern.compile("(?i)^use this folder$"))
        val allow = By.text(Pattern.compile("(?i)^allow$"))
        SafPickerTestActions.openPrimaryDirectory(device, listOf("Documents"))
        SafPickerTestActions.clickFresh(
            device,
            useFolder,
            "Use shared-storage Documents folder",
            timeoutMs = timeout,
            completed = { device.hasObject(allow) || device.hasObject(By.pkg("app.docscan.scanner")) },
        )
        if (device.wait(Until.hasObject(allow), 3_000L)) {
            SafPickerTestActions.clickFresh(
                device,
                allow,
                "Allow shared-storage Documents access",
                timeoutMs = 3_000L,
                completed = { device.hasObject(By.pkg("app.docscan.scanner")) },
            )
        }
        assertTrue("DocumentsUI must return to the app", device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.pkg("app.docscan.scanner")), timeout))
    }

    private fun listChildren(
        resolver: android.content.ContentResolver,
        tree: Uri,
        treeId: String,
    ): List<Child> {
        val childUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree, treeId)
        val children = mutableListOf<Child>()
        resolver.query(
            childUri,
            arrayOf(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID, DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME),
            null,
            null,
            null,
        )?.use { cursor ->
            val idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
            val nameColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
            while (cursor.moveToNext()) children += Child(cursor.getString(idColumn), cursor.getString(nameColumn))
        } ?: throw IllegalStateException("Provider returned no child listing")
        return children
    }

    private fun writeFully(resolver: android.content.ContentResolver, uri: Uri, bytes: ByteArray) {
        val output = resolver.openOutputStream(uri, "w") ?: throw IllegalStateException("Provider returned no output stream")
        output.use { stream -> stream.write(bytes); stream.flush() }
    }

    private fun readFully(resolver: android.content.ContentResolver, uri: Uri): ByteArray =
        resolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { it.readBytes() }
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Provider returned no read-back stream")

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

    private fun clickDestinationButton(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>) {
        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
            val button = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>("docscan-destination-button")
            assertNotNull("Destination picker button must exist", button)
            assertTrue("Destination picker must be enabled after startup", button.isEnabled)
            button.performClick()
        }
    }

    private fun awaitActivityReady(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>) {
        awaitCondition("ProductActivity must initialize storage") {
            var ready = false
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                ready = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>("docscan-destination-button")?.isEnabled == true
            }
            ready
        }
    }

    private fun awaitDestinationGrant(storage: ProductStorage): app.docscan.core.store.DestinationGrantSnapshot {
        var result: app.docscan.core.store.DestinationGrantSnapshot? = null
        awaitCondition("Picker result must create a destination grant") {
            result = storage.destinationGrant()
            result != null
        }
        return requireNotNull(result)
    }

    private fun awaitCondition(message: String, timeoutMillis: Long = 15_000L, condition: () -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeoutMillis
        while (System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (condition()) return
            Thread.sleep(50)
        }
        throw AssertionError(message)
    }

    private data class Child(val id: String, val name: String)

    private companion object {
        const val LOG_TAG = "SafProviderProbe"
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/SafRuntimeDestinationCheckInstrumentedTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import androidx.test.uiautomator.UiDevice
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SafRuntimeDestinationCheckInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun actualProviderCheckPersistsTypedTreeBoundEvidenceAndCleansItsOwnedDocuments() {
        val fixture = fixture("positive")
        try {
            val tree = chooseTree(fixture, "Documents")
            val initialChildren = listChildren(fixture.context, tree).associateBy { it.documentId }
            val evidenceDirectory = runtimeEvidenceDirectory(fixture.context)
            val beforeEvidence = evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().map { it.name }.toSet()

            val checker = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(fixture.context, fixture.storage)
            val result = checker.ensureReady(tree.toString())

            val payload = JSONObject(result.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload)
            assertTrue("The record must use runtime-check provenance",
                payload.getString("provenance") == "RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_CHECK")
            assertFalse("Runtime evidence is not a formal qualification", payload.getBoolean("formalQualification"))
            assertEquals("Runtime readiness is scoped to the exact selected tree", tree.toString(), payload.getString("treeUri"))
            assertEquals(SafProviderIdentity.resolve(fixture.context, tree.toString()).adapterId, result.adapterId)
            assertEquals(Build.FINGERPRINT, result.osVersion)
            assertTrue("The typed capability set is complete", payload.getJSONObject("capabilities").let {
                it.getBoolean("createDoesNotOverwriteExistingDocument") &&
                    it.getBoolean("enumerateChildren") && it.getBoolean("readBackSha256")
            })
            val evidenceFile = File(payload.getString("evidencePath"))
            assertTrue("Raw runtime evidence is present", evidenceFile.isFile)
            assertEquals("Evidence bytes match the stored digest", payload.getString("evidenceSha256"), sha256(evidenceFile.readBytes()))
            val rawEvidence = JSONObject(evidenceFile.readText())
            assertTrue("No-overwrite is proved by a definite name conflict or distinct identity",
                rawEvidence.getString("duplicateOutcome") in setOf("DEFINITE_NAME_CONFLICT", "DISTINCT_IDENTITY"))
            assertEquals("The original probe bytes survive the duplicate-create attempt",
                rawEvidence.getString("payloadSha256"), rawEvidence.getString("originalHashAfterDuplicate"))
            assertTrue("The final provider listing is independently checked", rawEvidence.getBoolean("finalListingVerified"))
            assertTrue("Cleanup of checker-owned documents is independently checked", rawEvidence.getBoolean("ownedCleanupVerified"))
            assertEquals("Evidence sidecar repeats the evidence digest", payload.getString("evidenceSha256"),
                File(evidenceDirectory, evidenceFile.nameWithoutExtension + ".sha256").readText().trim())
            assertEquals("The capability checker leaves no owned provider documents", initialChildren.keys,
                listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())
            assertTrue("The successful check adds no pending operation journal",
                runtimeEvidenceDirectory(fixture.context).listFiles().orEmpty()
                    .filter { it.name !in beforeEvidence }.none { it.name.startsWith("pending-") })

            val events = mutableListOf<SafRuntimeCheckBoundary>()
            val reused = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(
                fixture.context,
                fixture.storage,
                RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(fixture.context),
                SafRuntimeCheckObserver { boundary, _ -> events += boundary },
            ).ensureReady(tree.toString())
            assertEquals("An exact-tree ready record is reused", result.qualificationId, reused.qualificationId)
            assertTrue("Reusing readiness performs no provider operation", events.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(initialChildren.keys, listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())

            val otherTree = chooseAnotherTree(fixture, "Download")
            assertFalse("The second test destination must be a distinct exact tree", otherTree == tree)
            assertNull("Readiness for the first folder cannot authorize a different folder",
                checker.findReady(otherTree.toString()))
            val otherBaseline = listChildren(fixture.context, otherTree).map { it.documentId }.toSet()
            val otherReady = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(fixture.context, fixture.storage).ensureReady(otherTree.toString())
            assertEquals(otherTree.toString(), JSONObject(otherReady.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload).getString("treeUri"))
            assertFalse("A separate tree receives its own runtime record", result.qualificationId == otherReady.qualificationId)
            assertEquals("The second provider check also cleans its own documents", otherBaseline,
                listChildren(fixture.context, otherTree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())

            val oldDatabase = fixture.storage
            oldDatabase.close()
            fixture.storage = ProductStorage(fixture.context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectory)
            val reopened = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(fixture.context, fixture.storage)
            val restored = reopened.findReady(tree.toString())
            assertNotNull("Readiness survives database reopen only with intact evidence", restored)
            assertEquals(result.qualificationId, restored?.qualificationId)
            assertEquals("The second tree's separate readiness also survives database reopen", otherReady.qualificationId,
                reopened.findReady(otherTree.toString())?.qualificationId)

            val createdFiles = runtimeEvidenceDirectory(fixture.context).listFiles().orEmpty()
                .filter { it.name !in beforeEvidence }
            assertTrue("At least one evidence packet was written", createdFiles.any { it.name.startsWith("evidence-") })
            android.util.Log.i(TAG, "RUNTIME_CHECK_PASS tree=$tree qualification=${result.qualificationId} " +
                "formal=false owned_cleanup=true evidence_sha256=${payload.getString("evidenceSha256")}")
        } finally {
            fixture.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun providerBoundaryFailuresNeverCreateReadinessAndOwnedDocumentsAreRecovered() {
        val permissionFixture = fixture("boundaries")
        var selectedTree: Uri? = null
        val createdEvidenceNames = mutableSetOf<String>()
        try {
            selectedTree = chooseTree(permissionFixture, "Documents")
            val tree = requireNotNull(selectedTree)
            val baselineIds = listChildren(permissionFixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet()
            val evidenceDirectory = runtimeEvidenceDirectory(permissionFixture.context)
            val evidenceBefore = evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().map { it.name }.toSet()
            val applicable = SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.entries
            val reached = mutableSetOf<SafRuntimeCheckBoundary>()

            applicable.forEach { target ->
                val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "")
                val databaseName = "saf-runtime-failure-$suffix.db"
                val artifactDirectory = "saf-runtime-failure-artifacts-$suffix"
                val evidenceBeforeAttempt = evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().map { it.name }.toSet()
                var storage = ProductStorage(permissionFixture.context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
                storage.recordDestinationGrant(tree.toString())
                val events = mutableListOf<SafRuntimeCheckBoundary>()
                val checker = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(
                    permissionFixture.context,
                    storage,
                    RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(permissionFixture.context, DuplicateCreateMode.RENAME_DISTINCT),
                    SafRuntimeCheckObserver { boundary, _ ->
                        events += boundary
                        if (boundary == target) throw IOException("injected failure at $target")
                    },
                )
                val failure = runCatching { checker.ensureReady(tree.toString()) }.exceptionOrNull()
                assertNotNull("Injected provider-boundary failure must propagate at $target", failure)
                reached += events
                assertNull("Failure at $target must not record runtime readiness", checker.findReady(tree.toString()))
                val evidenceAfterFailure = evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().map { it.name }.toSet()
                val newFailureEvidence = evidenceAfterFailure - evidenceBeforeAttempt
                assertTrue("Failure evidence must be retained for $target",
                    newFailureEvidence.any { it.startsWith("evidence-failed-") })
                createdEvidenceNames += newFailureEvidence

                val pending = evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().filter {
                    it.name !in evidenceBeforeAttempt && it.name.startsWith("pending-") && it.name.endsWith(".json")
                }
                if (pending.isNotEmpty()) {
                    // Reopen through the real provider path: it must resolve only the journaled owned URI,
                    // clean it, and then run a new check before it can persist readiness.
                    storage.close()
                    storage = ProductStorage(permissionFixture.context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
                    val recovered = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(permissionFixture.context, storage).ensureReady(tree.toString())
                    assertEquals("Recovery must remain tied to the selected tree", tree.toString(),
                        JSONObject(recovered.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload).getString("treeUri"))
                    assertTrue("Recovery removes this failed run's pending journal",
                        evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().none { it.name in pending.map(File::getName) })
                }
                assertEquals("Boundary failure/recovery leaves the original provider child identities unchanged at $target",
                    baselineIds, listChildren(permissionFixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())
                assertEquals("The isolated database has at most the recovery record created after the failed attempt",
                    if (pending.isEmpty()) 0 else 1,
                    storage.providerQualificationsFor(
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).adapterId,
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).providerVersion,
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).osVersion,
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).accessClass,
                    ).size,
                )
                storage.close()
                permissionFixture.context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
                permissionFixture.context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            }

            assertTrue("Every applicable injected operation boundary was observed", applicable.all { it in reached })
            assertTrue("The real SAF tree decorator created and journaled a second distinct provider document",
                SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_DUPLICATE_CREATE_JOURNALED in reached)
            evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().filter { it.name !in evidenceBefore }
                .forEach { it.delete() }
            assertEquals("Test-only runtime evidence files are cleaned by exact owned filename", evidenceBefore,
                evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().map { it.name }.toSet())
            android.util.Log.i(TAG, "RUNTIME_FAILURE_MATRIX_PASS boundaries=${reached.joinToString()} " +
                "duplicate=distinct-identity original_children=${baselineIds.size}")
        } finally {
            createdEvidenceNames.forEach { name -> File(runtimeEvidenceDirectory(permissionFixture.context), name).delete() }
            permissionFixture.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun abruptInterruptionLeavesOwnedIdentityForNextCheckerToCleanBeforeRetry() {
        val fixture = fixture("interruption")
        try {
            val tree = chooseTree(fixture, "Documents")
            val before = listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet()
            val evidenceDirectory = runtimeEvidenceDirectory(fixture.context)
            val observer = SafRuntimeCheckObserver { boundary, _ ->
                if (boundary == SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_FIRST_CREATE_JOURNALED) {
                    throw SafRuntimeCheckInterruption("simulated process interruption after created URI was journaled")
                }
            }
            val interrupted = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(
                fixture.context,
                fixture.storage,
                RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(fixture.context),
                observer,
            )
            val interruption = runCatching { interrupted.ensureReady(tree.toString()) }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue("The interruption must escape as the designated abrupt-process surrogate",
                interruption is SafRuntimeCheckInterruption)
            val pendingBefore = evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().filter {
                it.name !in fixture.priorEvidenceNames && it.name.startsWith("pending-") && it.name.endsWith(".json")
            }
            assertEquals("Created-URI interruption leaves exactly one pending journal", 1, pendingBefore.size)
            val journal = JSONObject(pendingBefore.single().readText())
            assertEquals(tree.toString(), journal.getString("treeUri"))
            assertEquals("PENDING_UNKNOWN", journal.getString("phase"))
            assertEquals("The owned URI is durably present before provider bytes are written", 1,
                journal.getJSONArray("ownedUris").length())
            assertNull("Interrupted checks never become ready", interrupted.findReady(tree.toString()))

            val reopenedStorage = ProductStorage(fixture.context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectory)
            fixture.storage = reopenedStorage
            val ready = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(fixture.context, reopenedStorage).ensureReady(tree.toString())
            assertTrue("The next checker cleans the old owned document before recording new readiness",
                JSONObject(ready.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload).getBoolean("formalQualification").not())
            assertTrue("The interrupted journal is resolved", evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().none {
                it.name.startsWith("pending-")
            })
            assertEquals("No owned probe output survives recovery and the new successful check", before,
                listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())
        } finally {
            fixture.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun providerPortFailuresAtCreateStreamsReadBackAndCleanupNeverBecomeReady() {
        val permissionFixture = fixture("provider-port-faults")
        try {
            val tree = chooseTree(permissionFixture, "Documents")
            val baselineIds = listChildren(permissionFixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet()
            val modes = listOf(
                ProviderPortFault.ENUMERATE_THROW,
                ProviderPortFault.CREATE_THROW,
                ProviderPortFault.CREATE_NULL,
                ProviderPortFault.CREATE_EFFECT_THEN_THROW,
                ProviderPortFault.WRITE_THROW,
                ProviderPortFault.FLUSH_THROW,
                ProviderPortFault.CLOSE_THROW,
                ProviderPortFault.READ_THROW,
                ProviderPortFault.READ_TRUNCATED,
                ProviderPortFault.READ_HASH_MISMATCH,
                ProviderPortFault.DELETE_FALSE,
            )
            modes.forEach { mode ->
                val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "")
                val databaseName = "saf-runtime-port-fault-$suffix.db"
                val artifactDirectory = "saf-runtime-port-fault-artifacts-$suffix"
                var storage = ProductStorage(permissionFixture.context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
                storage.recordDestinationGrant(tree.toString())
                val providerIo = RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(permissionFixture.context, portFault = mode)
                val checker = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(
                    permissionFixture.context,
                    storage,
                    providerIo,
                    SafRuntimeCheckObserver.NONE,
                )
                val failure = runCatching { checker.ensureReady(tree.toString()) }.exceptionOrNull()
                assertNotNull("Provider port fault must fail closed at $mode", failure)
                assertNull("Provider port fault at $mode must not persist readiness", checker.findReady(tree.toString()))

                if (mode == ProviderPortFault.CREATE_EFFECT_THEN_THROW) {
                    // The provider created a random child but withheld its URI. The production checker must
                    // leave that unresolved identity alone; the test adapter knows this exact test child.
                    val created = requireNotNull(providerIo.lastCreatedUri)
                    assertTrue("Lost create identity leaves a durable pending journal", runtimeEvidenceDirectory(permissionFixture.context)
                        .listFiles().orEmpty().any { it.name.startsWith("pending-") && it.readText().contains(tree.toString()) })
                    assertTrue("Test removes only the URI it directly observed creating", providerIo.deleteDocument(created))
                }

                storage.close()
                storage = ProductStorage(permissionFixture.context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
                val recovered = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(permissionFixture.context, storage).ensureReady(tree.toString())
                assertEquals("Recovery qualification remains exact-tree scoped", tree.toString(),
                    JSONObject(recovered.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload).getString("treeUri"))
                assertEquals("Every injected fault and recovery restores the original provider child IDs at $mode",
                    baselineIds, listChildren(permissionFixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())
                assertEquals("Only recovery, after the failed operation is resolved, can record readiness", 1,
                    storage.providerQualificationsFor(
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).adapterId,
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).providerVersion,
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).osVersion,
                        SafProviderIdentity.resolve(permissionFixture.context, tree.toString()).accessClass,
                    ).size)
                storage.close()
                permissionFixture.context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
                permissionFixture.context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            }
            android.util.Log.i(TAG, "RUNTIME_PROVIDER_IO_FAILURE_MATRIX_PASS cases=${modes.joinToString()} baseline_ids=${baselineIds.size}")
        } finally {
            permissionFixture.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun definiteExistingNameConflictIsProvedWithoutChangingTheOriginalProbe() {
        val fixture = fixture("definite-conflict")
        try {
            val tree = chooseTree(fixture, "Documents")
            val baselineIds = listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet()
            val checker = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(
                fixture.context,
                fixture.storage,
                RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(fixture.context, duplicateCreateMode = DuplicateCreateMode.DEFINITE_CONFLICT),
                SafRuntimeCheckObserver.NONE,
            )
            val ready = checker.ensureReady(tree.toString())
            val payload = JSONObject(ready.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload)
            val evidence = JSONObject(File(payload.getString("evidencePath")).readText())
            assertEquals("Provider proves duplicate creation did not replace the existing document",
                "DEFINITE_NAME_CONFLICT", evidence.getString("duplicateOutcome"))
            assertEquals(evidence.getString("payloadSha256"), evidence.getString("originalHashAfterDuplicate"))
            assertEquals("A rejected duplicate does not create an additional child", baselineIds,
                listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())
        } finally {
            fixture.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun distinctDuplicateIdentityIsJournaledReadBackCheckedAndRemoved() {
        val fixture = fixture("distinct-duplicate")
        try {
            val tree = chooseTree(fixture, "Documents")
            val baselineIds = listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet()
            val checker = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(
                fixture.context,
                fixture.storage,
                RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(fixture.context, duplicateCreateMode = DuplicateCreateMode.RENAME_DISTINCT),
                SafRuntimeCheckObserver.NONE,
            )
            val ready = checker.ensureReady(tree.toString())
            val payload = JSONObject(ready.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload)
            val evidence = JSONObject(File(payload.getString("evidencePath")).readText())
            assertEquals("A distinct returned identity is accepted only after being independently listed",
                "DISTINCT_IDENTITY", evidence.getString("duplicateOutcome"))
            assertEquals(evidence.getString("payloadSha256"), evidence.getString("originalHashAfterDuplicate"))
            assertTrue(evidence.getBoolean("finalListingVerified"))
            assertTrue(evidence.getBoolean("ownedCleanupVerified"))
            assertEquals("Both the original and auto-renamed owned URI are cleaned after evidence capture", baselineIds,
                listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())
        } finally {
            fixture.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun providerAutoRenameIsDetectedBeforeAnyWriteAndOnlyOwnedUriIsCleaned() {
        val fixture = fixture("first-name-rename")
        try {
            val tree = chooseTree(fixture, "Documents")
            val baselineIds = listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet()
            val evidenceBefore = runtimeEvidenceDirectory(fixture.context).listFiles().orEmpty().map { it.name }.toSet()
            val events = mutableListOf<SafRuntimeCheckBoundary>()
            val checker = SafRuntimeDestinationCheck(
                fixture.context,
                fixture.storage,
                RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(fixture.context, firstCreateMode = FirstCreateMode.RENAME_NAME),
                SafRuntimeCheckObserver { boundary, _ -> events += boundary },
            )
            val failure = runCatching { checker.ensureReady(tree.toString()) }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertNotNull("Provider auto-rename must fail exact-name validation", failure)
            val failureEvidence = runtimeEvidenceDirectory(fixture.context).listFiles().orEmpty()
                .first { it.name !in evidenceBefore && it.name.startsWith("evidence-failed-") && it.name.endsWith(".json") }
            val failurePayload = JSONObject(failureEvidence.readText())
            val ownedUris = failurePayload.getJSONArray("ownedUris")
            assertEquals("Provider returned URI was journaled as owned before its name was rejected", 1, ownedUris.length())
            assertTrue("The returned document identity was absent from the baseline", DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(
                Uri.parse(ownedUris.getString(0))) !in baselineIds)
            assertTrue("No output stream was opened after the provider changed the requested name",
                SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_FIRST_WRITE !in events)
            assertNull("Renamed provider child cannot become readiness", checker.findReady(tree.toString()))
            assertEquals("Cleanup uses the returned owned URI and restores the baseline listing", baselineIds,
                listChildren(fixture.context, tree).map { it.documentId }.toSet())
        } finally {
            fixture.close()
        }
    }

    private fun chooseTree(fixture: Fixture, folder: String): Uri {
        val scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
        fixture.scenario = scenario
        awaitActivityReady(scenario)
        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
            val button = requireNotNull(activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>("docscan-destination-button"))
            check(button.isEnabled)
            button.performClick()
        }
        SafPickerTestActions.chooseTreeDirectory(
            UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()),
            scenario,
            listOf(folder),
        )
        return Uri.parse(requireNotNull(fixture.storage.destinationGrant()).treeUri).also {
            fixture.selectedTrees += it.toString()
        }
    }

    private fun chooseAnotherTree(fixture: Fixture, folder: String): Uri {
        val scenario = requireNotNull(fixture.scenario)
        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
            val button = requireNotNull(activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>("docscan-destination-button"))
            check(button.isEnabled)
            button.performClick()
        }
        SafPickerTestActions.chooseTreeDirectory(
            UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()),
            scenario,
            listOf(folder),
        )
        return Uri.parse(requireNotNull(fixture.storage.destinationGrant()).treeUri).also {
            fixture.selectedTrees += it.toString()
        }
    }

    private fun awaitActivityReady(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>) {
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 20_000L
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            var ready = false
            scenario.onActivity { ready = it.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>("docscan-destination-button")?.isEnabled == true }
            if (ready) return
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(50)
        }
        throw AssertionError("ProductActivity destination action did not initialize")
    }

    private fun listChildren(context: Context, tree: Uri): List<SafRuntimeChild> = RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(context).listChildren(tree)

    private fun runtimeEvidenceDirectory(context: Context) = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "saf-runtime-destination-checks")

    private fun fixture(label: String): Fixture {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val app = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "")
        val databaseName = "saf-runtime-$label-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "saf-runtime-$label-artifacts-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        val previousOverride = app.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val priorPermissionUris = context.contentResolver.persistedUriPermissions.map { it.uri.toString() }.toSet()
        app.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        val evidenceDirectory = runtimeEvidenceDirectory(context)
        return Fixture(
            context, app, databaseName, artifactDirectory, storage, previousOverride,
            priorPermissionUris, evidenceDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().map { it.name }.toSet(),
        )
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private enum class DuplicateCreateMode { PROVIDER_DEFAULT, RENAME_DISTINCT, DEFINITE_CONFLICT }
    private enum class FirstCreateMode { PROVIDER_DEFAULT, RENAME_NAME }

    private enum class ProviderPortFault {
        NONE, ENUMERATE_THROW, CREATE_THROW, CREATE_NULL, CREATE_EFFECT_THEN_THROW,
        WRITE_THROW, FLUSH_THROW, CLOSE_THROW, READ_THROW, READ_TRUNCATED, READ_HASH_MISMATCH, DELETE_FALSE,
    }

    private class RealSafRuntimeProviderIo(
        context: Context,
        private val duplicateCreateMode: DuplicateCreateMode = DuplicateCreateMode.PROVIDER_DEFAULT,
        private val portFault: ProviderPortFault = ProviderPortFault.NONE,
        private val firstCreateMode: FirstCreateMode = FirstCreateMode.PROVIDER_DEFAULT,
    ) : SafRuntimeProviderIo {
        private val resolver = context.contentResolver
        private var createOrdinal = 0
        private var inputOrdinal = 0
        private var deleteOrdinal = 0
        var lastCreatedUri: Uri? = null
            private set

        override fun listChildren(treeUri: Uri): List<SafRuntimeChild> {
            if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.ENUMERATE_THROW) {
                throw IOException("injected provider child enumeration failure")
            }
            val treeId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(treeUri)
            val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(treeUri, treeId)
            val children = mutableListOf<SafRuntimeChild>()
            resolver.query(childrenUri, arrayOf(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
                DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME), null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
                val idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
                val nameColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    val documentId = cursor.getString(idColumn) ?: continue
                    val documentUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(treeUri, documentId)
                    children += SafRuntimeChild(documentUri, documentId, cursor.getString(nameColumn).orEmpty())
                }
            } ?: throw IOException("Provider returned no child listing")
            return children
        }

        override fun createDocument(treeUri: Uri, mimeType: String, displayName: String): Uri? {
            createOrdinal += 1
            if (createOrdinal == 1 && portFault == ProviderPortFault.CREATE_THROW) {
                throw IOException("injected provider create failure before side effect")
            }
            if (createOrdinal == 1 && portFault == ProviderPortFault.CREATE_NULL) return null
            if (createOrdinal == 1 && portFault == ProviderPortFault.CREATE_EFFECT_THEN_THROW) {
                lastCreatedUri = createDocumentActual(treeUri, mimeType, displayName)
                throw IOException("injected lost create response after actual provider side effect")
            }
            if (createOrdinal == 1 && firstCreateMode == FirstCreateMode.RENAME_NAME) {
                return createDocumentActual(treeUri, mimeType, "$displayName (1)").also { lastCreatedUri = it }
            }
            if (createOrdinal == 2 && duplicateCreateMode == DuplicateCreateMode.RENAME_DISTINCT) {
                return createDocumentActual(treeUri, mimeType, "$displayName (1)")
            }
            if (createOrdinal == 2 && duplicateCreateMode == DuplicateCreateMode.DEFINITE_CONFLICT) {
                throw IOException("EEXIST: file already exists")
            }
            return createDocumentActual(treeUri, mimeType, displayName).also { if (createOrdinal == 1) lastCreatedUri = it }
        }

        private fun createDocumentActual(treeUri: Uri, mimeType: String, displayName: String): Uri? {
            val parent = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(treeUri, DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(treeUri))
            return DocumentsContract.createDocument(resolver, parent, mimeType, displayName)
        }

        override fun openOutputStream(documentUri: Uri): OutputStream? {
            val delegate = resolver.openOutputStream(documentUri, "w") ?: return null
            if (portFault !in setOf(ProviderPortFault.WRITE_THROW, ProviderPortFault.FLUSH_THROW, ProviderPortFault.CLOSE_THROW)) return delegate
            return object : OutputStream() {
                override fun write(value: Int) = delegate.write(value)
                override fun write(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int) {
                    if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.WRITE_THROW) {
                        if (length > 1) delegate.write(bytes, offset, length / 2)
                        throw IOException("injected output write failure after partial bytes")
                    }
                    delegate.write(bytes, offset, length)
                }
                override fun flush() {
                    delegate.flush()
                    if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.FLUSH_THROW) throw IOException("injected output flush failure")
                }
                override fun close() {
                    delegate.close()
                    if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.CLOSE_THROW) throw IOException("injected output close failure")
                }
            }
        }

        override fun openInputStream(documentUri: Uri): InputStream? {
            inputOrdinal += 1
            if (inputOrdinal == 1 && portFault == ProviderPortFault.READ_THROW) throw IOException("injected provider read failure")
            val delegate = resolver.openInputStream(documentUri) ?: return null
            if (inputOrdinal != 1 || portFault !in setOf(ProviderPortFault.READ_TRUNCATED, ProviderPortFault.READ_HASH_MISMATCH)) return delegate
            return object : InputStream() {
                private val limit = 64
                private var readCount = 0
                private var changedByte = false
                override fun read(): Int {
                    if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.READ_TRUNCATED && readCount >= limit) return -1
                    val value = delegate.read()
                    if (value < 0) return -1
                    readCount += 1
                    return if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.READ_HASH_MISMATCH && !changedByte) {
                        changedByte = true
                        value xor 0x01
                    } else value
                }
                override fun read(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int {
                    if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.READ_TRUNCATED && readCount >= limit) return -1
                    val bounded = if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.READ_TRUNCATED) minOf(length, limit - readCount) else length
                    val count = delegate.read(bytes, offset, bounded)
                    if (count > 0) {
                        if (portFault == ProviderPortFault.READ_HASH_MISMATCH && !changedByte) {
                            bytes[offset] = (bytes[offset].toInt() xor 0x01).toByte()
                            changedByte = true
                        }
                        readCount += count
                    }
                    return count
                }
                override fun close() = delegate.close()
            }
        }

        override fun deleteDocument(documentUri: Uri): Boolean {
            deleteOrdinal += 1
            if (deleteOrdinal == 1 && portFault == ProviderPortFault.DELETE_FALSE) return false
            return DocumentsContract.deleteDocument(resolver, documentUri)
        }
    }

    private class Fixture(
        val context: Context,
        private val app: DocScanApplication,
        val databaseName: String,
        val artifactDirectory: String,
        var storage: ProductStorage,
        private val previousOverride: ProductStorage?,
        private val priorPermissionUris: Set<String>,
        val priorEvidenceNames: Set<String>,
    ) {
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        val selectedTrees = mutableSetOf<String>()

        fun close() {
            scenario?.close()
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousOverride
            runCatching { storage.close() }
            selectedTrees.filterNot { it in priorPermissionUris }.forEach { treeUri ->
                runCatching { SafDestinationGrantManager(context).releasePersistedGrant(treeUri) }
            }
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, SafRuntimeDestinationCheck.CHECK_DIRECTORY).listFiles().orEmpty()
                .filter { it.name !in priorEvidenceNames }
                .forEach { it.delete() }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "SafRuntimeDestinationCheck"
    }
}

    @Test
    fun firstSavePublishesVerifiedPublicPdfAndCompanionImageWithoutSafSetup() {
        val fixture = fixture("first-save")
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        var recentPdfUri: Uri? = null
        var savedPdfName: String? = null
        var primaryFailure: Throwable? = null
        var cleanupFailure: Throwable? = null
        val basename = "docscan-first-save-${fixture.suffix}"
        try {
            assertTrue("The isolated workspace starts with one real source Page", fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.isEmpty())
            val source = jpegFixture()
            val page = fixture.storage.importImage(source.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "first-save-source.jpg")
            fixture.storage.setSelected(page.pageId, true)
            val sourceRecord = fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
            val sourcePath = fixture.storage.artifactPath(sourceRecord.artifactRelativePath).toFile()
            val sourceSha = sha256(sourcePath.readBytes())
            assertEquals("Only the source Page is selected", 1, fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.count { it.selected })
            assertNull("A fresh Save path has no destination grant", fixture.storage.destinationGrant())
            assertEquals("The fresh isolated database has no provider qualification rows", 0,
                countProviderQualifications(fixture.context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName)))

            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            val activeScenario = requireNotNull(scenario)
            await("fresh Activity and selected Page are ready") {
                var ready = false
                activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    ready = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled == true
                }
                ready
            }
            clickSave(activeScenario)
            val device = UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
            assertTrue("First Save opens the public save-name dialog without launching the SAF picker",
                device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.clazz("android.widget.EditText")), TIMEOUT_MILLIS))
            assertFalse("A fresh default-folder Save does not launch DocumentsUI", device.hasObject(By.pkg(DOCUMENTS_UI)))
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertFalse("Public Save does not leave a pending SAF picker", activityBoolean(activity, "destinationPickerPending"))
                assertFalse("Public Save does not wait for folder setup", activityBoolean(activity, "pendingMainSave"))
            }
            val prompt = device.findObject(By.clazz("android.widget.EditText"))
            prompt.text = basename
            val ocrCheckbox = device.findObject(By.text("OCR"))
            assertTrue("The save dialog exposes the OCR choice", ocrCheckbox != null)
            if (ocrCheckbox.isChecked) ocrCheckbox.click()
            assertFalse("The test disables OCR to avoid native recognition work", ocrCheckbox.isChecked)
            val saveAction = By.res("android", "button1")
            assertTrue("The Android positive action is Save", device.wait(Until.hasObject(saveAction), TIMEOUT_MILLIS))
            assertEquals("Save", device.findObject(saveAction).text)
            device.findObject(saveAction).click()

            val recent = awaitValue("The public MediaStore Save is confirmed in Recent") {
                fixture.storage.recentDocuments().singleOrNull()
            }
            recentPdfUri = Uri.parse(recent.documentUri)
            savedPdfName = recent.displayName
            assertTrue("Recent points to the actual public MediaStore Download", recent.documentUri.startsWith("content://media/"))
            assertEquals("The unique requested basename is retained", "$basename.pdf", recent.displayName)
            assertNull("Public Save does not create a SAF ExternalExportPackage",
                fixture.storage.externalExportPackage(recent.exportArtifactId))
            assertNull("Public Save does not persist a SAF destination grant", fixture.storage.destinationGrant())
            assertEquals("Public Save does not create provider qualification rows", 0,
                countProviderQualifications(fixture.context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName)))
            val committed = fixture.storage.committedExportOutputs(recent.exportArtifactId).associateBy { it.artifactId }
            assertEquals(2, committed.size)
            val pdfOutput = committed.values.single { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
            val imageOutput = committed.values.single { it.mimeType == "image/jpeg" }
            assertTrue("The local PDF is committed and checksum-valid", fixture.storage.verifyExportOutput(pdfOutput))
            assertTrue("The local companion JPG is committed and checksum-valid", fixture.storage.verifyExportOutput(imageOutput))
            PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(fixture.context)
            PDDocument.load(fixture.storage.exportOutputFile(pdfOutput)).use { document ->
                assertEquals("Image-only input remains a one-page PDF", 1, document.numberOfPages)
            }
            val downloadedPdfBytes = requireNotNull(fixture.context.contentResolver.openInputStream(recentPdfUri!!)).use { it.readBytes() }
            assertEquals("Public PDF bytes match the verified local artifact", pdfOutput.sha256, sha256(downloadedPdfBytes))
            val jpgBytes = fixture.storage.exportOutputFile(imageOutput).readBytes()
            val decoded = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(jpgBytes, 0, jpgBytes.size)
            assertNotNull("The local companion JPG is a valid image", decoded)
            decoded?.recycle()
            val expectedJpgName = "${recent.displayName.removeSuffix(".pdf")}.jpg"
            val downloadNames = listOf(recent.displayName, expectedJpgName)
            val downloadUris = listDownloadUris(fixture.context, downloadNames)
            assertEquals("PDF and companion JPG are present in public Downloads", 2, downloadUris.size)
            val downloadedJpg = downloadUris.single { it.second == expectedJpgName }.first
            val downloadedJpgBytes = requireNotNull(fixture.context.contentResolver.openInputStream(downloadedJpg)).use { it.readBytes() }
            assertEquals("Public companion JPG matches the verified local artifact", imageOutput.sha256, sha256(downloadedJpgBytes))
            assertEquals("Successful Save consumes its selected source Page", 0, fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
            assertTrue("The source artifact remains unchanged in the isolated workspace evidence",
                sourcePath.isFile && sha256(sourcePath.readBytes()) == sourceSha)
            assertEquals("Recent contains the one successful PDF result", 1, fixture.storage.recentDocuments().size)
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertFalse("Save disables when the only Page has been consumed",
                    activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled ?: true)
                assertTrue("Home rail exits the external-workflow busy state after Save",
                    activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView>("docscan-home-thumbnail-scroll")?.isEnabled == true)
            }
            activeScenario.close()
            scenario = null
            fixture.storage.close()
            val reopened = ProductStorage(fixture.context, fixture.databaseName, fixture.artifactDirectory, fixture.candidateDirectory)
            try {
                assertFalse("Reopening public Recent does not trigger startup integrity blocking", reopened.startupIntegrityBlocked)
                assertEquals("Public Recent survives a fresh ProductStorage open", recent,
                    reopened.recentDocuments().single())
            } finally {
                reopened.close()
            }
            android.util.Log.i(TAG, "FIRST_PUBLIC_SAVE_PASS uri=${recent.documentUri} outputs=2 page_consumed=true")
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            primaryFailure = failure
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            val names = savedPdfName?.let { listOf(it, "${it.removeSuffix(".pdf")}.jpg") }
                ?: listOf("$basename.pdf", "$basename.jpg")
            val discoveredUris = runCatching { listDownloadUris(fixture.context, names).map { it.first } }
                .onFailure { cleanupFailure = it }
                .getOrDefault(emptyList())
            val exactUris = (listOfNotNull(recentPdfUri) + discoveredUris).distinct()
            exactUris.forEach { uri ->
                runCatching {
                    check(fixture.context.contentResolver.delete(uri, null, null) == 1) {
                        "MediaStore did not remove test output $uri"
                    }
                }
                    .onFailure { cleanupFailure = it }
            }
            fixture.close()
            cleanupFailure?.let { if (primaryFailure == null) primaryFailure = it else primaryFailure!!.addSuppressed(it) }
        }
        primaryFailure?.let { throw AssertionError("First Save setup or cleanup failed", it) }
    }

    @Test
    fun saveAvailabilityIsDisabledForZeroAndMoreThanOneHundredSelectedPages() {
        val fixture = fixture("save-limits")
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        try {
            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            val activeScenario = requireNotNull(scenario)
            await("empty Activity is initialized") {
                var ready = false
                activeScenario.onActivity { ready = it.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button") != null }

            }

            assertEquals("The empty fixture starts with no output or readiness", 0,
                countProviderQualifications(fixture.context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName)))

            val jpeg = jpegFixture()
            repeat(101) { index ->
                val imported = fixture.storage.importImage(jpeg.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "limit-${index + 1}.jpg")
                fixture.storage.setSelected(imported.pageId, true)
            }
            assertEquals("The fixture reaches the >100 selected boundary", 101,
                fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.count { it.selected })
            // Refresh through the production Activity lifecycle so its Save availability reflects all Pages.
            activeScenario.recreate()
            await("The 101 selected Pages keep Save disabled after Activity refresh") {
                var disabled = false
                activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    disabled = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled == false
                }
                disabled
            }
            assertSaveDisabled(activeScenario, "More than 100 selected Pages cannot enter Save setup")
            assertNull("Availability checks do not launch the picker or create a grant", fixture.storage.destinationGrant())
            assertEquals("Availability checks do not create provider readiness", 0,
                countProviderQualifications(fixture.context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName)))
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            fixture.close()
        }
    }

        val fixture = fixture("cancel-save-picker")

            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)

                activeScenario.onActivity { enabled = it.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled == true }
                enabled
            }
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                requireNotNull(activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-workspace-menu-button")).performClick()
            }
            val chooseFolder = By.text("CHOOSE SAVE FOLDER")
            val device = UiDevice.getInstance(InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation())
            assertTrue("The real workspace menu exposes Choose save folder",
                device.wait(Until.hasObject(chooseFolder), TIMEOUT_MILLIS))
            device.findObject(chooseFolder).click()
            assertTrue("Choose save folder launches the real picker", device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.pkg(DOCUMENTS_UI)), TIMEOUT_MILLIS))
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertTrue("Folder selection marks only the picker as pending", activityBoolean(activity, "destinationPickerPending"))
                assertFalse("Folder selection does not create a pending Save", activityBoolean(activity, "pendingMainSave"))
            }
            cancelPickerWithBoundedBack(device, activeScenario)
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertFalse("Cancellation clears the picker-pending state", activityBoolean(activity, "destinationPickerPending"))
                assertFalse("Folder cancellation leaves no pending main Save", activityBoolean(activity, "pendingMainSave"))
            }
            await("Cancelled folder selection leaves the workspace interactive") {
                var enabled = false
                activeScenario.onActivity { enabled = it.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled == true }
                enabled
            }
            assertNull("Cancelling folder selection stores no destination", fixture.storage.destinationGrant())
            assertEquals("Cancelling folder selection stores no runtime readiness", 0,
                countProviderQualifications(fixture.context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName)))
            assertEquals("Cancellation retains the selected Page", 1, fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.count { it.selected })
            val retained = fixture.storage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
            assertEquals("Cancellation retains identical source bytes", sourceSha,
                sha256(fixture.storage.artifactPath(retained.artifactRelativePath).toFile().readBytes()))
            assertEquals("Cancellation publishes no Recent result", 0, fixture.storage.recentDocuments().size)
            assertEquals("Cancellation creates no external package", 0,
                countTableRows(fixture.context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName), "ExternalExportPackage"))
            assertEquals("Cancellation creates no export artifact", 0,
                countTableRows(fixture.context.getDatabasePath(fixture.databaseName), "ExportArtifact"))
            assertTrue("Cancelled folder selection publishes no Download outputs",
                listDownloadUris(fixture.context, noOutputNames).isEmpty())
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                assertTrue("After cancellation the selected Page can enter setup again",
                    activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-save-button")?.isEnabled == true)
                val rail = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView>("docscan-home-thumbnail-scroll")
                val checkbox = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<View>("docscan-home-selection:${page.pageId.value}")
                assertTrue("Home rail is enabled after picker cancellation", rail?.isEnabled == true)
                assertTrue("Retained Page selection remains enabled after picker cancellation", checkbox?.isEnabled == true)
            }
            android.util.Log.i(TAG, "SAVE_FOLDER_PICKER_CANCEL_PASS page_retained=true readiness=0 exports=0")
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            primaryFailure = failure
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            fixture.close()
            cleanupFailure?.let { if (primaryFailure == null) primaryFailure = it else primaryFailure!!.addSuppressed(it) }
        }
        primaryFailure?.let { throw AssertionError("Pending Save picker cancel or cleanup failed", it) }
    }

    private fun activityBoolean(activity: ProductActivity, fieldName: String): Boolean =
        ProductActivity::class.java.getDeclaredField(fieldName).run {
            isAccessible = true
            getBoolean(activity)
        }

    private fun fixture(label: String): Fixture {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val app = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "")
        val databaseName = "save-setup-$label-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "save-setup-$label-artifacts-$suffix"
        val candidateDirectory = "save-setup-$label-candidates-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory, candidateDirectory)
        val priorOverride = app.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val priorProvider = app.productStorageProviderForTest
        app.productStorageProviderForTest = null
        app.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
        return Fixture(context, app, storage, databaseName, artifactDirectory, candidateDirectory,
            priorOverride, priorProvider, suffix)
    }

    private fun jpegFixture(): ByteArray {
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(80, 60, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(0xff3979a5.toInt()) }
        return try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
                check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 92, output))
                output.toByteArray()
            }
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun listDownloadUris(context: Context, displayNames: List<String>): List<Pair<Uri, String>> {
        require(displayNames.isNotEmpty())
        val result = mutableListOf<Pair<Uri, String>>()
        val relativePath = "${Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS}/DocScan/"
        displayNames.forEach { displayName ->
            context.contentResolver.query(
                MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
                arrayOf(MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID, MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME),
                "${MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH} = ? AND ${MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME} = ?",
                arrayOf(relativePath, displayName),
                null,
            )?.use { cursor ->
                val idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID)
                val nameColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    result += ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                        MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
                        cursor.getLong(idColumn),
                    ) to cursor.getString(nameColumn)
                }
            } ?: throw AssertionError("MediaStore returned no Downloads listing for $displayName")
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun <T> awaitValue(message: String, value: () -> T?): T {
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + TIMEOUT_MILLIS
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            value()?.let { return it }
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(50)
        }
        throw AssertionError("Timed out waiting for $message")
    }

    private fun await(message: String, condition: () -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + TIMEOUT_MILLIS
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (condition()) return
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(50)
        }
        throw AssertionError("Timed out waiting for $message")
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private fun countProviderQualifications(databaseFile: File): Int =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { database ->
            database.rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ProviderQualification", null).use { cursor ->
                check(cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getInt(0)
            }
        }

    private fun countTableRows(databaseFile: File, table: String): Int =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { database ->
            database.rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $table", null).use { cursor ->
                check(cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getInt(0)
            }
        }

    private fun cancelPickerWithBoundedBack(device: UiDevice, scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>) {
        repeat(MAX_PICKER_BACK_PRESSES) {
            if (device.hasObject(By.pkg(DOCUMENTS_UI))) device.pressBack()
            val stepDeadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 1_000L
            while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < stepDeadline) {
                val appForeground = device.currentPackageName == APP_PACKAGE
                var resumed = false
                scenario.onActivity { resumed = it.lifecycle.currentState == Lifecycle.State.RESUMED }
                if (appForeground && resumed) return
                if (device.hasObject(By.pkg(DOCUMENTS_UI))) break
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(50)
            }
        }
        assertTrue("Bounded Back cancellation returns to ProductActivity, not Home",
            device.wait(Until.hasObject(By.pkg(APP_PACKAGE)), TIMEOUT_MILLIS))
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + TIMEOUT_MILLIS
        while (android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            var resumed = false
            scenario.onActivity { resumed = it.lifecycle.currentState == Lifecycle.State.RESUMED }
            if (resumed) return
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(50)
        }
        throw AssertionError("ProductActivity did not resume after bounded real-picker Back cancellation")
    }

    private class Fixture(
        val context: Context,
        private val app: DocScanApplication,
        val storage: ProductStorage,
        val databaseName: String,
        val artifactDirectory: String,
        val candidateDirectory: String,
        private val priorOverride: ProductStorage?,
        private val priorProvider: (() -> ProductStorage)?,
        val suffix: String,
    ) {
        fun close() {
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = priorOverride
            app.productStorageProviderForTest = priorProvider
            runCatching { storage.close() }
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(candidateDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val DOCUMENTS_UI = "com.google.android.documentsui"
        private const val APP_PACKAGE = "app.docscan.scanner"
        private const val MAX_PICKER_BACK_PRESSES = 8
        private const val TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 30_000L
        private const val TAG = "SaveSetupInstrumentedTest"
    }
}
