package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType1Font
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File
import java.security.MessageDigest

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SavedPdfEditComposerInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun reorderProducesNewReadablePdfAndLeavesSourceUnchanged() {
        val context = androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(context)
        val source = File(context.cacheDir, "edit-source-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                listOf(300f, 400f, 500f).forEachIndexed { index, width ->
                    val page = PDPage(PDRectangle(width, 600f))
                    document.addPage(page)
                    PDPageContentStream(document, page).use { content ->
                        content.beginText()
                        content.setFont(PDType1Font.HELVETICA, 12f)
                        content.newLineAtOffset(50f, 500f)
                        content.showText("PAGE_$index")
                        content.endText()
                    }
                }
                document.save(source)
            }
            val sourceHash = sha256(source)

            val result = SavedPdfEditComposer(context).compose(
                sourceFile = source,
                expectedPageCount = 3,
                orderedSourcePageIndexes = listOf(2, 0),
                scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler(),
            )

            assertEquals(sourceHash, sha256(source))
            assertEquals(sourceHash, result.sourceSha256)
            assertNotEquals(sourceHash, result.sha256)
            assertTrue(result.file.isFile && result.sizeBytes > 0L)
            PDDocument.load(result.file).use { edited ->
                assertEquals(2, edited.numberOfPages)
                assertEquals(500f, edited.getPage(0).mediaBox.width, 0f)
                assertEquals(300f, edited.getPage(1).mediaBox.width, 0f)
                val text = PDFTextStripper().getText(edited)
                assertTrue(text.indexOf("PAGE_2") in 0 until text.indexOf("PAGE_0"))
            }
            result.file.delete()
        } finally {
            source.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsEmptyDuplicateAndOutOfRangeOrders() {
        val context = androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val source = File(context.cacheDir, "edit-invalid-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            PDDocument().use { document ->
                document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
                document.save(source)
            }
            val composer = SavedPdfEditComposer(context)
            listOf(emptyList(), listOf(0, 0), listOf(1)).forEach { order ->
                try {
                    composer.compose(source, 1, order, HeavyWorkScheduler())
                    throw AssertionError("Invalid page order was accepted: $order")
                } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
                    // Expected validation before source mutation or output publication.
                }
            }
        } finally {
            source.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        file.inputStream().buffered().use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(32 * 1024)
            while (true) {
                val read = input.read(buffer)
                if (read < 0) break
                digest.update(buffer, 0, read)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }
}

    @Test
    fun rendersOneBoundedPageAtATimeAndRejectsInvalidPageAndPdf() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val pdf = File(context.cacheDir, "preview-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        PDDocument().use { document ->
            document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle.A4))
            document.addPage(PDPage(PDRectangle(842f, 595f)))
            document.save(pdf)
        }
        try {
            val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler()
            val portrait = SavedPdfPageRenderer.renderPage(pdf, 2, 0, scheduler)
            assertEquals(2, portrait.pageCount)
            assertEquals(0, portrait.pageIndex)
            assertTrue(portrait.bitmap.width > 0 && portrait.bitmap.height > 0)
            assertTrue(maxOf(portrait.bitmap.width, portrait.bitmap.height) <= SavedPdfPageRenderer.MAX_LONG_SIDE_PX)
            portrait.bitmap.recycle()

            val landscape = SavedPdfPageRenderer.renderPage(pdf, 2, 1, scheduler)
            assertEquals(1, landscape.pageIndex)
            assertTrue(landscape.bitmap.width > landscape.bitmap.height)
            landscape.bitmap.recycle()
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                SavedPdfPageRenderer.renderPage(pdf, 2, 2, scheduler)
            }
        } finally {
            pdf.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test

        val pdf = File(context.cacheDir, "preview-corrupt-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")

        try {

    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun unsupportedPageCountsShowUnavailableWithoutOpeningPreviewOrChangingState() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val app = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "saved-preview-bounds-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "saved-preview-bounds-artifacts-$suffix"
        val candidateDirectory = "saved-preview-bounds-candidates-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory, candidateDirectory)
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        try {
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage
            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            val device = UiDevice.getInstance(instrumentation)
            var statusViewPresent = false
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                statusViewPresent = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<TextView>("docscan-status") != null
            }
            assertTrue("ProductActivity initializes its status view", statusViewPresent)
            val recentBefore = storage.recentDocuments()
            val workspaceBefore = storage.workspaceProjection()

            listOf(0L, 501L).forEach { pageCount ->
                val displayName = "unsupported-$pageCount-$suffix.pdf"
                val snapshot = RecentDocumentSnapshot(
                    recentId = "unsupported-$pageCount-$suffix",
                    exportArtifactId = ExportArtifactId.new(),
                    documentUri = "content://test-provider/$suffix/$pageCount",
                    displayName = displayName,
                    pageCount = pageCount,
                    savedWallMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                    ocrStatus = "UNKNOWN",
                )
                scenario.onActivity { activity -> activity.showSavedPdfPreview(snapshot) }
                var status = ""
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    status = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<TextView>("docscan-status")?.text?.toString().orEmpty()
                }
                assertEquals(
                    "Unsupported page count $pageCount reports the existing unavailable state",
                    context.getString(R.string.recent_document_unavailable, "Unsupported saved PDF page count"),
                    status,
                )
                assertFalse("Unsupported page count $pageCount does not open a preview dialog", device.hasObject(By.text(displayName)))
                assertEquals("Recent metadata remains unchanged", recentBefore, storage.recentDocuments())
                assertEquals("Workspace state remains unchanged", workspaceBefore, storage.workspaceProjection())
            }
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            app.productStorageOverrideForTest = null
            runCatching { storage.close() }
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
            context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve(candidateDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper
import java.io.File
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SearchablePdfFallbackRegressionInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun fallbackKeepsAtLeastEightyLinesAndDoesNotTruncateLongLines() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(600, 800, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(Color.WHITE) }
        val longLine = "LongLine-" + "0123456789".repeat(180)
        val fallback = (1..80).map { "FallbackLine-%03d".format(it) }.plus(longLine).joinToString("\n")
        val output = File(context.cacheDir, "fallback-regression-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                output,
                listOf(PdfInputPage(openBitmap = { bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, text = fallback)),
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300),
            )
            PDDocument.load(output).use { document ->
                val extracted = PDFTextStripper().getText(document)
                assertTrue("The 80th fallback line must survive PDF generation", extracted.contains("FallbackLine-080"))
                val extractedWithoutWhitespace = extracted.filterNot(Char::isWhitespace)
                val expectedWithoutWhitespace = longLine.filterNot(Char::isWhitespace)
                assertTrue(
                    "Long fallback text must retain every character across PDF line wrapping",
                    extractedWithoutWhitespace.contains(expectedWithoutWhitespace),
                )
            }
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
            output.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun blankTextOnlyPdfIsRejectedWithoutPublishingOutput() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(600, 800, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(Color.WHITE) }
        val output = File(context.cacheDir, "blank-text-only-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                    output,
                    listOf(PdfInputPage(openBitmap = { bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, text = " \n\t ")),
                    PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300, includeImage = false),
                )
            }
            assertFalse("Rejected text-only output must not leave a final PDF", output.exists())
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
            output.delete()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toRecognitionLayout
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toPlainText
import app.docscan.core.store.Baseline
import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.store.OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionGeometry
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionPayloadCodec
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognizedWord
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.TextPosition
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.rendering.PDFRenderer
import java.io.File
import java.util.Locale
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SearchablePdfWriterInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun SpanishPlainTextKeepsDiaeresisAndPunctuationAcrossCodecAndPdf() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val truth = "¿Qué año? pingüino ¡Número 4821!"
        val encoded = RecognitionPayloadCodec.encodeLayout(
            app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout(800, 1000, emptyList(), plainText = truth),
        )
        val decoded = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decodeLayout(encoded)
        assertEquals(truth, decoded.toPlainText())
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(800, 1000, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(Color.WHITE) }
        val output = File(context.cacheDir, "searchable-spanish-codec-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                output,
                listOf(PdfInputPage(
                    { bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) },
                    layout = decoded.toRecognitionLayout(),
                    text = decoded.toPlainText(),
                )),
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300, includeImage = false),
            )
            PDDocument.load(output).use { document ->
                val extracted = PDFTextStripper().getText(document)
                assertEquals(
                    SearchablePdfWriter.normalizedTextContent(truth),
                    SearchablePdfWriter.normalizedTextContent(extracted),
                )
            }
        } finally { bitmap.recycle(); output.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun positionedTextUsesSlopedHocrBaselineInPdfCoordinates() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(800, 1000, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(Color.WHITE) }
        val lineBox = NormalizedBox(0.125f, 0.1f, 0.5f, 0.15f)
        val word = OcrWord("BASE", NormalizedBox(0.125f, 0.1f, 0.25f, 0.15f), 99f)
        val line = OcrLine(lineBox, Baseline(0.1f, -10f), null, listOf(word))
        val paragraph = OcrParagraph(lineBox, listOf(line))
        val block = OcrBlock("b0", app.docscan.core.store.BlockType.TEXT, lineBox, 0, listOf(paragraph))
        val layout = RecognitionLayout(800, 1000, listOf(block))
        val output = File(context.cacheDir, "searchable-baseline-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                output,
                listOf(PdfInputPage({ bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, layout = layout)),
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300),
            )
            PDDocument.load(output).use { document ->
                var found: TextPosition? = null
                val stripper = object : PDFTextStripper() {
                    override fun writeString(text: String, textPositions: List<TextPosition>) {
                        super.writeString(text, textPositions)
                        if (found == null && text.contains("BASE")) found = textPositions.firstOrNull()
                    }
                }
                assertTrue(stripper.getText(document).contains("BASE"))
                val position = requireNotNull(found) { "PDF text position for BASE was not exposed" }
                val scale = minOf(595f / 800f, 842f / 1000f)
                val offsetY = (842f - 1000f * scale) / 2f
                val expectedBaselineY = offsetY + (1000f - 140f) * scale
                assertEquals(expectedBaselineY, position.textMatrix.translateY, 1f)
                val slope = position.textMatrix.shearY / position.textMatrix.scaleX
                assertEquals(-0.1f, slope, 0.01f)
            }
        } finally { bitmap.recycle(); output.delete() }
    }

    @Test
    fun pdfBoxWritesInvisibleSearchableMixedScriptTextAndKeepsImageVisible() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(600, 800, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        bitmap.eraseColor(Color.WHITE)
        Canvas(bitmap).drawColor(Color.WHITE)
        for (y in 20 until 60) for (x in 20 until 60) bitmap.setPixel(x, y, Color.BLACK)
        val geometry = RecognitionGeometry(
            600L, 800L, OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE,
            listOf(
                RecognizedWord("Invoice", 100L, 300L, 350L, 350L, 97.0),
                RecognizedWord("Счёт", 390L, 370L, 560L, 420L, 91.0),
            ),
        )
        val output = File(context.cacheDir, "searchable-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        val noGeometryOutput = File(context.cacheDir, "searchable-no-geometry-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        val mismatchedGeometryOutput = File(context.cacheDir, "searchable-mismatched-geometry-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            val result = SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                output,
                listOf(PdfInputPage({ bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, geometry)),
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300),
            )
            assertEquals(1, result.pageCount)
            assertTrue(result.fileSizeBytes > 0L)

            PDDocument.load(output).use { document ->
                assertEquals(1, document.numberOfPages)
                assertEquals(595f, document.getPage(0).mediaBox.width, 0.1f)
                val extractedWords = mutableListOf<Pair<String, List<TextPosition>>>()
                val stripper = object : PDFTextStripper() {
                    override fun writeString(text: String, textPositions: List<TextPosition>) {
                        super.writeString(text, textPositions)
                        if (text.isNotBlank()) extractedWords += text.trim() to textPositions.toList()
                    }
                }
                val extracted = stripper.getText(document).lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                assertTrue(extracted, extracted.contains("invoice"))
                assertTrue(extracted, extracted.contains("счёт"))

                val fitScale = minOf(595f / bitmap.width, 842f / bitmap.height)
                val expectedOffsetX = (595f - bitmap.width * fitScale) / 2f
                val expectedOffsetY = (842f - bitmap.height * fitScale) / 2f
                assertPdfWordOverlapsSourceBox(
                    extractedWords.single { it.first.contains("Invoice", ignoreCase = true) }.second,
                    expectedOffsetX + 100f * fitScale,
                    expectedOffsetY + 300f * fitScale,
                    expectedOffsetX + 350f * fitScale,
                    expectedOffsetY + 350f * fitScale,
                    "Invoice",
                )
                assertPdfWordOverlapsSourceBox(
                    extractedWords.single { it.first.contains("Счёт", ignoreCase = true) }.second,
                    expectedOffsetX + 390f * fitScale,
                    expectedOffsetY + 370f * fitScale,
                    expectedOffsetX + 560f * fitScale,
                    expectedOffsetY + 420f * fitScale,
                    "Счёт",
                )
                assertTrue("Parsed OCR words must remain in separate source regions", extractedWords.size >= 2)

                val rendered = PDFRenderer(document).renderImage(0)
                try {
                    assertEquals(Color.BLACK, rendered.getPixel(30, 60))
                    var darkPixelsInInvisibleWordArea = 0
                    for (y in 315 until 410) for (x in 90 until 360) {
                        if (Color.red(rendered.getPixel(x, y)) < 128) darkPixelsInInvisibleWordArea++
                    }
                    assertEquals("Invisible OCR text must not alter the page appearance", 0, darkPixelsInInvisibleWordArea)
                } finally {
                    rendered.recycle()
                }
            }

            // A second write to an existing output must fail closed without replacing it.
            val existingBytes = output.readBytes()
            try {
                SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                    output, listOf(PdfInputPage({ bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, geometry)),
                    PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300),
                )
                throw AssertionError("Existing output should not be overwritten")
            } catch (expected: IllegalArgumentException) {
                assertFalse(existingBytes.isEmpty())
                assertTrue(existingBytes.contentEquals(output.readBytes()))
            }

            SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                noGeometryOutput,
                listOf(PdfInputPage({ bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, null)),
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300),
            )
            PDDocument.load(noGeometryOutput).use { document ->
                assertTrue("A Page without OCR geometry must not gain searchable text", PDFTextStripper().getText(document).isBlank())
            }

            try {
                SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                    mismatchedGeometryOutput,
                    listOf(PdfInputPage({ bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, geometry.copy(sourceWidthPx = 601L))),
                    PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300),
                )
                throw AssertionError("OCR geometry from another bitmap dimension must fail closed")
            } catch (expected: IllegalArgumentException) {
                assertFalse("Mismatched OCR geometry must not publish a final PDF", mismatchedGeometryOutput.exists())
                assertFalse(
                    "Mismatched OCR geometry must not leave a temporary PDF",
                    context.cacheDir.listFiles()?.any {
                        it.name.startsWith(".${mismatchedGeometryOutput.name}.") && it.name.endsWith(".building")
                    } == true,
                )
            }
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
            output.delete()
            noGeometryOutput.delete()
            mismatchedGeometryOutput.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun assertPdfWordOverlapsSourceBox(
        positions: List<TextPosition>,
        expectedLeft: Float,
        expectedTop: Float,
        expectedRight: Float,
        expectedBottom: Float,
        word: String,
    ) {
        assertTrue("$word must have parsed glyph positions", positions.isNotEmpty())
        val actualLeft = positions.minOf { it.xDirAdj }
        val actualRight = positions.maxOf { it.xDirAdj + it.widthDirAdj }
        val actualTop = positions.minOf { it.yDirAdj - it.heightDir }
        val actualBottom = positions.maxOf { it.yDirAdj }
        assertTrue("$word starts inside/at its transformed OCR region: $actualLeft !< $expectedRight", actualLeft < expectedRight)
        assertTrue("$word ends inside/after its transformed OCR region: $actualRight !> $expectedLeft", actualRight > expectedLeft)
        assertTrue("$word glyph region should overlap transformed OCR top: $actualBottom !> $expectedTop", actualBottom > expectedTop)
        assertTrue("$word glyph region should overlap transformed OCR bottom: $actualTop !< $expectedBottom", actualTop < expectedBottom)
    }

    @Test
    fun exportWithMissingGlyphAndZeroWidthWordDoesNotCrash() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(400, 400, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        bitmap.eraseColor(Color.WHITE)
        val wordWithoutGlyph = app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrWord("∑", app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx(10, 10, 50, 40), 90f)
        val zeroWidthWord = app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrWord("Zero", app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx(50, 10, 50, 40), 90f)
        val normalWord = app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrWord("Норма", app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx(60, 10, 120, 40), 95f)
        val line = app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLine(app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx(10, 10, 120, 40), listOf(wordWithoutGlyph, zeroWidthWord, normalWord))
        val para = app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrPara(app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx(10, 10, 120, 40), listOf(line))
        val block = app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrBlock(app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx(10, 10, 120, 40), listOf(para))
        val ocrLayout = app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout(400, 400, listOf(block))
        val layout = ocrLayout.toRecognitionLayout()

        val output = File(context.cacheDir, "test-missing-glyph-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            val result = SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                output,
                listOf(PdfInputPage({ bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, null, layout)),
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300),
            )
            assertEquals(1, result.pageCount)
            assertTrue(result.fileSizeBytes > 0L)
            assertTrue(output.exists())
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
            output.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun safeTextPreservesAllSpanishCharactersExactly() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val spanishText = "¿Qué año, señor? Ñandú ÁÉÍÓÚ ü ¡Hola!"
        PDDocument().use { doc ->
            val font = com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType0Font.load(
                doc,
                context.assets.open("fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf"),
                true,
            )
            val cache = HashMap<Int, Boolean>()
            val safe = with(SearchablePdfWriter) { font.safeText(spanishText, cache) }
            assertEquals(spanishText, safe)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun pdfBoxWritesVisibleTextWithoutImageWhenIncludeImageIsFalse() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(600, 800, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        bitmap.eraseColor(Color.WHITE)
        val geometry = RecognitionGeometry(
            600L, 800L, OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE,
            listOf(
                RecognizedWord("VisibleOCR", 100L, 300L, 350L, 350L, 99.0),
            ),
        )
        val output = File(context.cacheDir, "visible-ocr-${System.nanoTime()}.pdf")
        try {
            val result = SearchablePdfWriter(context).write(
                output,
                listOf(PdfInputPage({ bitmap.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }, geometry)),
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 300, includeImage = false),
            )
            assertEquals(1, result.pageCount)
            assertTrue(result.fileSizeBytes > 0L)

            PDDocument.load(output).use { document ->
                assertEquals(1, document.numberOfPages)
                val page = document.getPage(0)
                val images = page.resources.xObjectNames.mapNotNull { name ->
                    page.resources.getXObject(name) as? com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.image.PDImageXObject
                }
                assertTrue("Page must not contain image XObjects when includeImage is false", images.isEmpty())

                val extracted = PDFTextStripper().getText(document)
                assertTrue("Extracted text must contain VisibleOCR", extracted.contains("VisibleOCR"))

                val rendered = PDFRenderer(document).renderImage(0)
                try {
                    var darkPixels = 0
                    for (y in 0 until rendered.height) {
                        for (x in 0 until rendered.width) {
                            if (Color.red(rendered.getPixel(x, y)) < 128) darkPixels++
                        }
                    }
                    assertTrue("Visible text mode must render visible dark glyph pixels on the page", darkPixels > 0)
                } finally {
                    rendered.recycle()
                }
            }
        } finally {
            bitmap.recycle()
            output.delete()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

    @Test
    fun corruptWorkspaceBlocksStartupActionsAndPreservesRowsAndArtifactBytes() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "integrity-gate-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "integrity-gate-artifacts-$suffix"
        val seedStorage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(32, 32, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
            eraseColor(0xff336699.toInt())
        }
        val imageBytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
            check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, output))
            output.toByteArray()
        }
        bitmap.recycle()
        val captured = seedStorage.importImage(imageBytes.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "gate.jpg")
        val page = seedStorage.workspaceProjection().pages.single()
        val imageFile = seedStorage.artifactPath(page.artifactRelativePath).toFile()
        val originalBytes = imageFile.readBytes()
        seedStorage.close()

        val missingImageVersionId = "missing-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val databaseFile = context.getDatabasePath(databaseName)
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READWRITE).use { db ->
            db.execSQL("PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF")
            val values = ContentValues().apply { put("current_image_version_id", missingImageVersionId) }
            assertEquals(1, db.update("Page", values, "page_id = ?", arrayOf(captured.pageId.value)))
        }

        var blockedStorage: ProductStorage? = null
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        try {
            blockedStorage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
            assertTrue(blockedStorage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertTrue(blockedStorage.workspaceIntegrityFindingsAtStartup.any {
                it.code == "CURRENT_IMAGE_VERSION_MISSING" && it.pageId == captured.pageId.value
            })
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", readArtifactState(databaseFile, captured.artifactId.value))
            assertEquals("Blocked startup must not advance the existing recovery cursor", "", readRecoveryCursor(databaseFile))
            assertTrue(imageFile.readBytes().contentEquals(originalBytes))

            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = blockedStorage
            scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            val activeScenario = scenario
            awaitCondition {
                var blocked = false
                activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    blocked = activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>("docscan-import-button")?.isEnabled == false
                }
                blocked
            }
            activeScenario.onActivity { activity ->
                listOf(
                    "docscan-capture-button",
                    "docscan-import-button",
                    "docscan-destination-button",
                    "docscan-recent-button",
                    "docscan-save-button",
                    "docscan-selection-button",
                    "docscan-recover-exports-button",
                    "docscan-resume-exports-button",
                    "docscan-delete-selected-button",
                    "docscan-clear-workspace-button",
                ).forEach { tag ->
                    assertFalse(
                        "$tag must remain disabled while startup integrity is blocked",
                        activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.view.View>(tag)?.isEnabled ?: true,
                    )
                }
                assertEquals(
                    context.getString(R.string.workspace_integrity_blocked, 1),
                    activity.window.decorView.findViewWithTag<android.widget.TextView>("docscan-status")?.text,
                )
            }

            assertEquals(missingImageVersionId, readCurrentImageVersion(databaseFile, captured.pageId.value))
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", readArtifactState(databaseFile, captured.artifactId.value))
            assertEquals("Blocked Activity must not advance the recovery cursor", "", readRecoveryCursor(databaseFile))
            assertTrue("Startup gate must leave image bytes unchanged", imageFile.readBytes().contentEquals(originalBytes))
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = null
            blockedStorage?.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun aSaturatedIntegrityInventoryFailsClosed() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "integrity-saturation-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "integrity-saturation-artifacts-$suffix"
        val seedStorage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(16, 16, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply { eraseColor(0xff112233.toInt()) }
        val imageBytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
            check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output))
            output.toByteArray()
        }
        bitmap.recycle()
        val source = seedStorage.importImage(imageBytes.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "saturation.jpg")
        val databaseFile = context.getDatabasePath(databaseName)
        seedStorage.close()

        var blockedStorage: ProductStorage? = null
        try {
            SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READWRITE).use { db ->
                db.execSQL("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
                val workspaceId = db.rawQuery("SELECT workspace_id FROM Workspace LIMIT 1", null).use { cursor ->
                    assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
                    cursor.getString(0)
                }
                val sessionId = db.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT workspace_session_id FROM WorkspaceSession WHERE workspace_id = ? AND state = 'OPEN'",
                    arrayOf(workspaceId),
                ).use { cursor ->
                    assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
                    cursor.getString(0)
                }
                val imageVersionId = db.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT current_image_version_id FROM Page WHERE page_id = ?",
                    arrayOf(source.pageId.value),
                ).use { cursor ->
                    assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
                    cursor.getString(0)
                }
                db.beginTransaction()
                try {
                    repeat(501) { index ->
                        val values = ContentValues().apply {
                            put("page_id", "saturated-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
                            put("workspace_id", workspaceId)
                            put("workspace_session_id", sessionId)
                            put("order_index", index + 1L)
                            put("selected", 0)
                            put("content_revision", 1L)
                            put("current_image_version_id", imageVersionId)
                            put("processing_desired_state", "NONE")
                            put("tombstone", 0)
                            put("source_provenance", "INTEGRITY_GATE_TEST")
                            put("select_when_ready", 0)
                        }
                        db.insertOrThrow("Page", null, values)
                    }
                    db.setTransactionSuccessful()
                } finally {
                    db.endTransaction()
                }
            }

            blockedStorage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
            assertEquals(500, blockedStorage.workspaceIntegrityFindingsAtStartup.size)
            assertTrue(blockedStorage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertTrue(blockedStorage.workspaceIntegrityFindingsAtStartup.all {
                it.code == "CURRENT_IMAGE_VERSION_PAGE_MISMATCH"
            })
            assertEquals("Blocked startup must not advance the recovery cursor", "", readRecoveryCursor(databaseFile))
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", readArtifactState(databaseFile, source.artifactId.value))
        } finally {
            blockedStorage?.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun saturatedGlobalReferenceOwnerInventoryFailsClosedBeforeRecovery() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "reference-owner-saturation-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "reference-owner-saturation-artifacts-$suffix"

        }

        val imageFile = seedStorage.artifactPath(page.artifactRelativePath).toFile()

        seedStorage.close()

        val databaseFile = context.getDatabasePath(databaseName)
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READWRITE).use { db ->
            db.execSQL("PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF")
            db.beginTransaction()
            try {
                repeat(501) {
                    val values = ContentValues().apply {
                        put("artifact_id", imported.artifactId.value)
                        put("ref_kind", "SAVE_MANIFEST")
                        put("ref_owner_id", "missing-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
                        put("protection_class", "SAVE")
                    }
                    db.insertOrThrow("ArtifactReference", null, values)
                }
                db.setTransactionSuccessful()
            } finally {
                db.endTransaction()
            }
        }

        var blockedStorage: ProductStorage? = null
        try {
            blockedStorage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
            assertEquals(500, blockedStorage.artifactReferenceIntegrityFindingsAtStartup.size)
            assertTrue(blockedStorage.artifactReferenceIntegrityFindingsAtStartup.all {
                it.code == "SAVE_MANIFEST_OWNER_MISSING"
            })
            assertEquals(500, blockedStorage.startupIntegrityFindingCount)
            assertTrue(blockedStorage.startupIntegrityBlocked)
            assertEquals(502, readReferenceCount(databaseFile, imported.artifactId.value))
            assertEquals("Blocked startup must not advance the existing recovery cursor", "", readRecoveryCursor(databaseFile))
            assertEquals("COMMITTED", readArtifactState(databaseFile, imported.artifactId.value))
            assertTrue(imageFile.readBytes().contentEquals(originalBytes))
        } finally {
            blockedStorage?.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun readCurrentImageVersion(databaseFile: File, pageId: String): String =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            db.rawQuery("SELECT current_image_version_id FROM Page WHERE page_id = ?", arrayOf(pageId)).use { cursor ->
                assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getString(0)
            }
        }

    private fun readArtifactState(databaseFile: File, artifactId: String): String =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            db.rawQuery("SELECT state FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = ?", arrayOf(artifactId)).use { cursor ->
                assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getString(0)
            }
        }

    private fun readReferenceCount(databaseFile: File, artifactId: String): Int =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            db.rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ArtifactReference WHERE artifact_id = ?", arrayOf(artifactId)).use { cursor ->
                assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getInt(0)
            }
        }

    private fun readRecoveryCursor(databaseFile: File): String =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            db.rawQuery("SELECT cursor_payload FROM MaintenanceCursor WHERE domain = ?", arrayOf("artifact-integrity-v1")).use { cursor ->
                assertTrue("A fresh workspace initializes an empty bounded-recovery cursor", cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getString(0)
            }
        }

    private fun readWorkspaceCount(databaseFile: File): Int = readCount(databaseFile, "Workspace")

    private fun readPageCount(databaseFile: File): Int = readCount(databaseFile, "Page")

    private fun readCount(databaseFile: File, table: String): Int =
        SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY).use { db ->
            db.rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $table", null).use { cursor ->
                assertTrue(cursor.moveToFirst())
                cursor.getInt(0)
            }
        }

    private fun awaitCondition(condition: () -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 10_000L
        while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync()
            if (condition()) return
            android.os.SystemClock.sleep(50L)
        }
        assertTrue("Activity did not apply startup integrity lock", condition())
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.util.Log
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.exifinterface.media.ExifInterface
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLangMode
import com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.util.Locale
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue

/** Exercises the bundled offline model through the same production OCR adapter. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class TesseractOcrInstrumentedTest {
    @Test
    fun bundledRusEngModelRecognizesCyrillicAndLatinOnOnePage() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val fixture = Bitmap.createBitmap(1800, 520, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val canvas = Canvas(fixture)
        canvas.drawColor(Color.WHITE)
        val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            color = Color.BLACK
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
            textSize = 104f
        }
        canvas.drawText("Документ № 8472", 70f, 190f, paint)
        canvas.drawText("Invoice 8472", 70f, 390f, paint)

        val png = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-rus-eng-${System.nanoTime()}.png")
        val jpeg = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-rus-eng-${System.nanoTime()}.jpg")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(png).use { output ->
                check(fixture.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, output))
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            FileOutputStream(jpeg).use { output ->
                check(fixture.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, output))
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { adapter ->
                listOf(png, jpeg).forEach { image ->
                    val decoded = ProductImageDecoder.decode(
                        image,
                        12L * 1024L * 1024L,
                        preferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888,
                    )
                    assertEquals(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, decoded?.config)
                    decoded?.recycle()

                    val result = adapter.recognizeDetailed(image)
                    val text = result.text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).replace('ё', 'е')
                    assertTrue("Russian Cyrillic token missing from ${image.extension}: $text", text.contains("документ"))
                    assertTrue("English Latin token missing from ${image.extension}: $text", text.contains("invoice"))
                    assertTrue("Shared numeric token missing from ${image.extension}: $text", text.contains("8472"))
                    assertTrue("Recognized text preserves the two source lines: $text", result.text.contains('\n'))
                    assertEquals(1800L, result.geometry.sourceWidthPx)
                    assertEquals(520L, result.geometry.sourceHeightPx)
                    assertFalse(result.geometry.words.isEmpty())
                    assertTrue(result.geometry.words.all { word ->
                        word.leftPx >= 0 && word.topPx >= 0 && word.rightPx <= 1800 && word.bottomPx <= 520
                    })
                }
            }
        } finally {
            fixture.recycle()
            png.delete()
            jpeg.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun bundledRusEngModelProcessesSpanishWordsAndDiacritics() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val fixture = Bitmap.createBitmap(1800, 620, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val canvas = Canvas(fixture)
        canvas.drawColor(Color.WHITE)
        val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            color = Color.BLACK
            typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.SANS_SERIF, Typeface.BOLD)
            textSize = 112f
        }
        canvas.drawText("Mañana acción", 70f, 190f, paint)
        canvas.drawText("Niña café pingüino", 70f, 380f, paint)
        canvas.drawText("Número 4821", 70f, 570f, paint)

        val png = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-spanish-${System.nanoTime()}.png")
        val jpeg = File(context.cacheDir, "ocr-spanish-${System.nanoTime()}.jpg")
        try {
            FileOutputStream(png).use { output ->
                check(fixture.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, output))
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            FileOutputStream(jpeg).use { output ->
                check(fixture.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, output))
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            TesseractOcrAdapter(context).use { adapter ->
                listOf(png, jpeg).forEach { image ->
                    val detected = adapter.recognizeDetailed(image, mode = OcrLangMode.AUTO)
                    val detectedLanguage = detected.layout.quality?.language.orEmpty()
                    val detectedTokens = Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}]+")
                        .findAll(detected.text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)).map { it.value }.toSet()
                    Log.i("DocScanOcrLangProbe", "${image.extension} mode=AUTO language=$detectedLanguage " +
                        "text=${detected.text.replace('\n', '|')}")
                    assertTrue("language AUTO should select Spanish for the Spanish invoice: $detectedLanguage",
                        detectedLanguage.contains("spa", ignoreCase = true))
                    val supportedAccentTokens = listOf("mañana", "acción", "niña", "café", "número", "4821")
                    supportedAccentTokens.forEach { expected ->
                        assertTrue("language AUTO selected Spanish but lost '$expected': ${detected.text}",
                            expected in detectedTokens)
                    }
                    assertTrue("language AUTO should keep the Spanish invoice number: ${detected.text}",
                        "4821" in detectedTokens)
                    val automatic = adapter.recognizeDetailed(image, mode = OcrLangMode.ES_EN)
                    Log.i("DocScanOcrLangProbe", "${image.extension} PSM_AUTO: ${automatic.text.replace('\n', '|')}")
                    val automaticTokens = Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}]+")
                        .findAll(automatic.text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)).map { it.value }.toSet()
                    val result = adapter.recognizeDetailed(
                        image,
                        mode = OcrLangMode.ES_EN,
                        settings = OcrRunSettings(TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_SINGLE_BLOCK),
                    )
                    val tokens = Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}]+")
                        .findAll(result.text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT))
                        .map { it.value }
                        .toSet()
                    Log.i("DocScanOcrLangProbe", "${image.extension} PSM_SINGLE_BLOCK: ${result.text.replace('\n', '|')}")
                    supportedAccentTokens
                        .forEach { expected ->
                            assertTrue(
                                "PSM_AUTO dropped Spanish token '$expected' from ${image.extension}: ${automatic.text}",
                                expected in automaticTokens,
                            )
                            assertTrue(
                                "Spanish token '$expected' missing from ${image.extension}: ${result.text}",
                                expected in tokens,
                            )
                        }
                    assertEquals(1800L, result.geometry.sourceWidthPx)
                    assertEquals(620L, result.geometry.sourceHeightPx)
                    assertFalse(result.geometry.words.isEmpty())

                    val truth = "Mañana acción\nNiña café pingüino\nNúmero 4821"
                    logSpanishModelResult(image.extension, "fast-ES_EN-PSM_AUTO", truth, automatic.text)
                    logSpanishModelResult(image.extension, "fast-ES_EN-PSM_SINGLE_BLOCK", truth, result.text)
                }
            }

            val testAssets = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().context.assets
            val bestAssets = testAssets.list("tessdata-best").orEmpty().toSet()
            if (listOf("eng.traineddata", "rus.traineddata", "spa.traineddata").all(bestAssets::contains)) {
                val bestRoot = OcrQualityTestSupport.installBestModels(context)
                val hybridRoot = installFastEnglishBestSpanishModels(context)
                listOf(png, jpeg).forEach { image ->
                    for ((label, root) in listOf("best-ES_EN" to bestRoot, "fast-eng+best-spa-ES_EN" to hybridRoot)) {
                        TesseractOcrAdapter(context, modelDataRootOverride = root).use { adapter ->
                            val bestResult = adapter.recognizeDetailed(image, mode = OcrLangMode.ES_EN)
                            logSpanishModelResult(image.extension, label, "Mañana acción\nNiña café pingüino\nNúmero 4821", bestResult.text)
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Log.i("DocScanOcrLangProbe", "Spanish best/hybrid comparison skipped; run tools/prepare_ocr_benchmark_assets.py")
            }
        } finally {
            fixture.recycle()
            png.delete()
            jpeg.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun logSpanishModelResult(extension: String, model: String, truth: String, recognized: String) {
        val diaeresis = Regex("(?iu)pingüino").containsMatchIn(recognized)
        Log.i("DocScanOcrLangProbe", "$extension model=$model cer=${OcrQualityTestSupport.cer(truth, recognized)} " +
            "pingueino_with_diaeresis=$diaeresis text=${recognized.replace('\n', '|')}")
    }

    private fun installFastEnglishBestSpanishModels(context: android.content.Context): File {
        val root = File(context.cacheDir, "tessdata-fast-eng-best-spa-validation")
        val tessdata = File(root, "tessdata").apply { mkdirs() }
        context.assets.open("tesseract/tessdata/eng.traineddata").use { input ->
            File(tessdata, "eng.traineddata").outputStream().use { output -> input.copyTo(output) }
        }
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().context.assets.open("tessdata-best/spa.traineddata").use { input ->
            File(tessdata, "spa.traineddata").outputStream().use { output -> input.copyTo(output) }
        }
        return root
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.Manifest
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import app.docscan.core.model.RecognitionId
import app.docscan.core.store.OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE
import app.docscan.core.store.RecentDocumentSnapshot
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionCandidate
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionGeometry
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognizedWord
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class TryAgainImportActivityInstrumentedTest {
    @get:Rule
    val cameraPermission: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)

    @Test
    fun retryRejectsChangedSavedPdfBeforeCreatingImportState() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "try-again-integrity-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "try-again-integrity-artifacts-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        val previousStorageOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val previousStorageProvider = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null

        try {
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage

            createRecognizedPage(storage, "INTEGRITY FIRST", Color.rgb(192, 32, 32))
            createRecognizedPage(storage, "INTEGRITY SECOND", Color.rgb(32, 32, 192))
            storage.visiblePages().forEach { storage.setSelected(it.pageId, true) }
            val beforeWorkspace = storage.workspaceProjection()
            val frozen = storage.freezeSelectedPagesForSave()
            val output = storage.composeFrozenSaveOutputSet(
                frozen,
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 150),
                companionJpegQuality = 85,
            )
            val exportId = storage.commitLocalExportOutputSet(frozen, output)
            val pdf = storage.committedExportOutputs(exportId).single { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
            val sourceFile = storage.exportOutputFile(pdf)
            val originalBytes = sourceFile.readBytes()
            val originalSha256 = sha256(originalBytes)
            assertTrue("Committed source must initially match its checksum", storage.verifyExportOutput(pdf))
            val inspection = AndroidPdfImportReader(context).inspect(sourceFile)
            assertEquals("Committed source contains both pages", 2, inspection.pageCount)
            val beforeRecent = storage.recentDocuments()
            val beforeCounts = integrityTableCounts(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName))
            Log.i("TryAgainIntegrityEvidence", "scenario=baseline size=${originalBytes.size} sha256=$originalSha256 pageCount=${inspection.pageCount} tableCounts=$beforeCounts workspacePages=${beforeWorkspace.pages.map { it.pageId }} recentCount=${beforeRecent.size}")
            val recent = RecentDocumentSnapshot(
                recentId = exportId.value,
                exportArtifactId = exportId,
                documentUri = "content://test-provider/recent/$suffix",
                displayName = "retry-integrity-source.pdf",
                pageCount = 2L,
                savedWallMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                ocrStatus = "FULL",
            )

            // Change one PDF header byte without changing file size; PDFBox must still parse it.
            val tamperedBytes = originalBytes.copyOf()
            val headerMinorVersionIndex = "%PDF-1.".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII).size
            assertTrue("PDF header has a minor-version digit", tamperedBytes[headerMinorVersionIndex].toInt().toChar().isDigit())
            tamperedBytes[headerMinorVersionIndex] = if (tamperedBytes[headerMinorVersionIndex].toInt().toChar() == '7') '6'.code.toByte() else '7'.code.toByte()
            sourceFile.writeBytes(tamperedBytes)
            assertEquals("Tampering preserves committed file length", originalBytes.size, sourceFile.length().toInt())
            assertTrue("Tampered source differs from persisted checksum", !storage.verifyExportOutput(pdf))
            assertEquals("Changed header remains parseable as a two-page PDF", 2, AndroidPdfImportReader(context).inspect(sourceFile).pageCount)
            val tamperedSha256 = sha256(tamperedBytes)
            Log.i("TryAgainIntegrityEvidence", "scenario=same-size-sha-mismatch originalSize=${originalBytes.size} originalSha256=$originalSha256 mutatedSize=${tamperedBytes.size} mutatedSha256=$tamperedSha256 parsedPages=${inspection.pageCount}")

            val launchedScenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            scenario = launchedScenario
            val activity = awaitCaptureReady(launchedScenario)
            launchedScenario.onActivity { it.tryAgainWithSavedPdf(recent) }
            val expectedStatus = activity.getString(
                R.string.try_again_failed,
                "Recent saved PDF failed its local checksum check",
            )
            awaitCondition("Try again must visibly reject the mismatched local PDF checksum") {
                var visible = false
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
                    visible = (findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView, "docscan-status") as? TextView)
                        ?.text?.toString() == expectedStatus
                }
                visible
            }

            val afterSameSizeWorkspace = storage.workspaceProjection()
            val afterSameSizeRecent = storage.recentDocuments()
            val afterSameSizeCounts = integrityTableCounts(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName))
            Log.i("TryAgainIntegrityEvidence", "scenario=same-size-rejection status=$expectedStatus countsBefore=$beforeCounts countsAfter=$afterSameSizeCounts workspaceEqual=${beforeWorkspace == afterSameSizeWorkspace} recentEqual=${beforeRecent == afterSameSizeRecent} sourceSize=${sourceFile.length()} sourceSha256=${sha256(sourceFile.readBytes())}")
            assertEquals("Try again does not alter workspace Page order, Active or Selected state", beforeWorkspace, afterSameSizeWorkspace)
            assertEquals("Try again does not alter Recent metadata", beforeRecent, afterSameSizeRecent)
            assertEquals("Try again creates no import or publication records", beforeCounts, afterSameSizeCounts)
            assertEquals("Try again leaves the tampered source byte-for-byte unchanged", tamperedBytes.toList(), sourceFile.readBytes().toList())
            assertEquals("Tampered source SHA remains stable after rejection", tamperedSha256, sha256(sourceFile.readBytes()))

            // Appending one legal PDF whitespace byte exercises persisted-size mismatch separately from same-size SHA mismatch.
            val sizeMismatchBytes = originalBytes + byteArrayOf('\n'.code.toByte())
            sourceFile.writeBytes(sizeMismatchBytes)
            assertEquals("The size-mismatch mutation adds exactly one byte", originalBytes.size + 1L, sourceFile.length())
            assertTrue("Size-mismatched source fails persisted output verification", !storage.verifyExportOutput(pdf))
            val sizeMismatchInspection = AndroidPdfImportReader(context).inspect(sourceFile)
            assertEquals("Appended legal PDF whitespace keeps both pages parseable", 2, sizeMismatchInspection.pageCount)
            val sizeMismatchSha256 = sha256(sizeMismatchBytes)
            Log.i("TryAgainIntegrityEvidence", "scenario=persisted-size-mismatch originalSize=${originalBytes.size} originalSha256=$originalSha256 mutatedSize=${sizeMismatchBytes.size} mutatedSha256=$sizeMismatchSha256 parsedPages=${sizeMismatchInspection.pageCount} tableCounts=$beforeCounts workspacePages=${beforeWorkspace.pages.map { it.pageId }} recentCount=${beforeRecent.size}")

            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
                (findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView, "docscan-status") as TextView).text = "RETRY SIZE CHECK START"
            }
            launchedScenario.onActivity { it.tryAgainWithSavedPdf(recent) }
            awaitCondition("Try again must visibly reject a readable source with changed committed size") {
                var visible = false
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
                    visible = (findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView, "docscan-status") as? TextView)
                        ?.text?.toString() == expectedStatus
                }
                visible
            }
            val afterSizeWorkspace = storage.workspaceProjection()
            val afterSizeRecent = storage.recentDocuments()
            val afterSizeCounts = integrityTableCounts(context.getDatabasePath(databaseName))
            val afterSizeBytes = sourceFile.readBytes()
            Log.i("TryAgainIntegrityEvidence", "scenario=size-mismatch-rejection status=$expectedStatus countsBefore=$beforeCounts countsAfter=$afterSizeCounts workspaceEqual=${beforeWorkspace == afterSizeWorkspace} recentEqual=${beforeRecent == afterSizeRecent} sourceSize=${afterSizeBytes.size} sourceSha256=${sha256(afterSizeBytes)}")
            assertEquals("Size rejection leaves workspace Page order, Active or Selected state unchanged", beforeWorkspace, afterSizeWorkspace)
            assertEquals("Size rejection leaves Recent metadata unchanged", beforeRecent, afterSizeRecent)
            assertEquals("Size rejection creates no import or publication records", beforeCounts, afterSizeCounts)
            assertEquals("Size rejection leaves source bytes unchanged", sizeMismatchBytes.toList(), afterSizeBytes.toList())
            assertEquals("Size rejection leaves mutated source SHA unchanged", sizeMismatchSha256, sha256(afterSizeBytes))
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = previousStorageProvider
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousStorageOverride
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun retryImportsAllPagesSuppressesConcurrentDuplicateAndPreservesSource() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val application = context.applicationContext as DocScanApplication
        val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val databaseName = "try-again-$suffix.db"
        val artifactDirectory = "try-again-artifacts-$suffix"
        val storage = ProductStorage(context, databaseName, artifactDirectory)
        val previousStorageOverride = application.productStorageOverrideForTest
        val previousStorageProvider = application.productStorageProviderForTest
        var scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>? = null

        try {
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = null
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = storage

            createRecognizedPage(storage, "FIRST PAGE", Color.rgb(192, 32, 32))
            createRecognizedPage(storage, "SECOND PAGE", Color.rgb(32, 32, 192))
            storage.visiblePages().forEach { storage.setSelected(it.pageId, true) }
            val initial = storage.workspaceProjection()
            val initialPageIds = initial.pages.map { it.pageId }.toSet()
            val initialImageVersionIds = initial.pages.map { it.imageVersionId }.toSet()
            val frozen = storage.freezeSelectedPagesForSave()
            val output = storage.composeFrozenSaveOutputSet(
                frozen,
                PdfOutputSettings(595f, 842f, 0.85f, 150),
                companionJpegQuality = 85,
            )
            val exportId = storage.commitLocalExportOutputSet(frozen, output)
            val pdf = storage.committedExportOutputs(exportId).single { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
            val sourceFile = storage.exportOutputFile(pdf)
            val sourceBytes = sourceFile.readBytes()
            val sourceSha256 = sha256(sourceBytes)
            assertTrue(storage.verifyExportOutput(pdf))
            val sourceInspection = AndroidPdfImportReader(context).inspect(sourceFile)
            assertEquals("The saved retry fixture contains both source pages", 2, sourceInspection.pageCount)
            assertTrue(
                "A fully recognized saved PDF must expose a reusable text layer on every source page",
                sourceInspection.pages.all { it.hasReusableTextLayer },
            )

            val recent = RecentDocumentSnapshot(
                recentId = exportId.value,
                exportArtifactId = exportId,
                documentUri = "content://test-provider/recent/$suffix",
                displayName = "retry-source.pdf",
                pageCount = 2L,
                savedWallMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                ocrStatus = "FULL",
            )
            val launchedScenario = ActivityScenario.launch(ProductActivity::class.java)
            scenario = launchedScenario
            val activity = awaitCaptureReady(launchedScenario)

            launchedScenario.onActivity {
                it.tryAgainWithSavedPdf(recent)
                it.tryAgainWithSavedPdf(recent)
            }
            awaitPageCount(storage, initial.pages.size + 2, activity)
            awaitRetryHandlerIdle(activity)

            val firstRetry = storage.workspaceProjection().pages.filter { it.pageId !in initialPageIds }
            assertEquals("One retry imports every source PDF page", 2, firstRetry.size)
            assertTrue("Retry Pages are selected", firstRetry.all { it.selected })
            assertTrue("Retry Pages have new Page identities", firstRetry.none { it.pageId in initialPageIds })
            assertTrue("Retry Pages have new ImageVersion identities", firstRetry.none { it.imageVersionId in initialImageVersionIds })
            assertEquals(2, firstRetry.map { it.pageId }.distinct().size)
            assertEquals(2, firstRetry.map { it.imageVersionId }.distinct().size)
            assertEquals("The rapid duplicate action must not create a second page block", 4, storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size)
            assertTrue("Each retried page keeps the saved searchable text", firstRetry.all { page ->
                page.recognizedText.orEmpty().lowercase().filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() }
                    .contains("documentimportverifiedtext")
            })

            launchedScenario.onActivity { it.tryAgainWithSavedPdf(recent) }
            awaitPageCount(storage, initial.pages.size + 4, activity)
            awaitRetryHandlerIdle(activity)

            val afterSecondRetry = storage.workspaceProjection().pages
            val secondRetry = afterSecondRetry.filter { it.pageId !in initialPageIds && it.pageId !in firstRetry.map { page -> page.pageId }.toSet() }
            assertEquals("A later deliberate retry creates another full block", 2, secondRetry.size)
            assertTrue(secondRetry.all { it.selected })
            assertTrue(secondRetry.none { it.imageVersionId in initialImageVersionIds || it.imageVersionId in firstRetry.map { page -> page.imageVersionId }.toSet() })
            assertTrue("The later retry also reuses the saved searchable text", secondRetry.all { page ->
                page.recognizedText.orEmpty().lowercase().filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() }
                    .contains("documentimportverifiedtext")
            })
            assertEquals("Committed local source bytes remain unchanged", sourceSha256, sha256(sourceFile.readBytes()))
            assertEquals(sourceBytes.toList(), sourceFile.readBytes().toList())
            assertTrue(storage.verifyExportOutput(pdf))
        } finally {
            scenario?.close()
            application.productStorageProviderForTest = previousStorageProvider
            application.productStorageOverrideForTest = previousStorageOverride
            storage.close()
            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)
            File(context.noBackupFilesDir, artifactDirectory).deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun createRecognizedPage(storage: ProductStorage, label: String, color: Int) {
        val searchableText = "$label DOCUMENT IMPORT VERIFIED TEXT"
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(240, 320, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888).apply {
            eraseColor(Color.WHITE)
            Canvas(this).drawText(label, 16f, 100f, Paint().apply {
                this.color = color
                textSize = 23f
            })
        }
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->
            check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 94, output))
            output.toByteArray()
        }
        bitmap.recycle()
        val imported = storage.importImage(bytes.inputStream(), "image/jpeg", "$label.jpg")
        val page = storage.visiblePages().single { it.pageId == imported.pageId }
        storage.commitRecognition(
            RecognitionCandidate(
                recognitionId = RecognitionId.new(),
                workspaceId = storage.workspaceId,
                pageId = page.pageId,
                imageVersionId = page.imageVersionId,
                contentRevision = page.contentRevision,
                desiredOperationKey = ProductActivity.OCR_OPERATION_KEY,
                recognizedText = searchableText,
                geometry = RecognitionGeometry(
                    sourceWidthPx = 240L,
                    sourceHeightPx = 320L,
                    coordinateSpace = OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE,
                    words = listOf(RecognizedWord(searchableText, 16, 70, 220, 115, 99.0)),
                ),
            ),
        )
    }

    private fun integrityTableCounts(databaseFile: File): Map<String, Long> {
        val database = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(databaseFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY)
        return try {
            listOf("ImportSession", "Page", "ImageVersion", "ArtifactRecord", "Recognition", "ArtifactReference", "RecentDocument")
                .associateWith { table ->
                    database.rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $table", null).use { cursor ->
                        check(cursor.moveToFirst()) { "Could not count $table rows" }
                        cursor.getLong(0)
                    }
                }
        } finally {
            database.close()
        }
    }

    private fun awaitCaptureReady(scenario: ActivityScenario<ProductActivity>): ProductActivity {
        var activity: ProductActivity? = null
        awaitCondition("Activity must finish storage initialization") {
            scenario.onActivity { current -> activity = current }
            activity?.let { current ->
                findViewByTag(current.window.decorView, "docscan-capture-button")?.isEnabled == true
            } == true
        }
        return requireNotNull(activity)
    }

    private fun awaitPageCount(storage: ProductStorage, expected: Int, activity: ProductActivity) {
        val deadline = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 30_000L
        while (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size == expected) return
            SystemClock.sleep(50L)
        }
        var statusText = "<unavailable>"
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
            statusText = (findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView, "docscan-status") as? TextView)
                ?.text?.toString() ?: "<missing>"
        }
        throw AssertionError(
            "Expected workspace to contain $expected pages; found ${storage.workspaceProjection().pages.size}; status='$statusText'",
        )
    }

    private fun awaitRetryHandlerIdle(activity: ProductActivity) {
        val completedTwoPages = activity.getString(R.string.try_again_complete, 2)
        awaitCondition("Try again handler must return to its completed state") {
            var done = false
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
                val status = findViewByTag(activity.window.decorView, "docscan-status") as? TextView
                done = status?.text?.toString() == completedTwoPages
            }
            done
        }
    }

    private fun findViewByTag(root: View, tag: String): View? {
        if (root.tag == tag) return root
        if (root !is ViewGroup) return null
        for (index in 0 until root.childCount) {
            findViewByTag(root.getChildAt(index), tag)?.let { return it }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun awaitCondition(description: String, condition: () -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 30_000L
        while (SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
            if (condition()) return
            SystemClock.sleep(50L)
        }
        throw AssertionError(description)
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) }

}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/kotlin/app/docscan/android/TryAgainProcessDeathInstrumentedTest.kt
