package app.docscan.android

import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.core.Point
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import kotlin.math.*

/** Bounded line combinations without horizontal/vertical axis assumptions. */
internal object DocumentLineHypotheses {
    /** Direction-independent line-pair combinations, capped before expensive refinement. */
    fun propose(edges:Mat):List<List<Point>> {
        data class Line(val a:Double,val b:Double,val c:Double,val length:Double)
        val lines=Mat()
        try {
            Imgproc.HoughLinesP(edges,lines,1.0,Math.PI/180,35,30.0,10.0)
            val measured=(0 until min(lines.rows(),80)).mapNotNull { i ->
                val p=lines.get(i,0) ?: return@mapNotNull null
                val dx=p[2]-p[0]; val dy=p[3]-p[1]; val length=hypot(dx,dy)
                if(length<30) null else Line(-dy/length,dx/length,(dy*p[0]-dx*p[1])/length,length)
            }.sortedByDescending { it.length }
            // Retain measured lines, never an average between parallel boundaries.
            // Several Hough segments on one side must not displace the other sides.
            val segments=ArrayList<Line>()
            for(candidate in measured) {
                val duplicate=segments.any { existing ->
                    val dot=existing.a*candidate.a+existing.b*candidate.b
                    abs(dot)>0.9994 && abs(existing.c-(if(dot>=0) candidate.c else -candidate.c))<3.0
                }
                if(!duplicate) segments.add(candidate)
                if(segments.size==16) break
            }
            fun intersect(a:Line,b:Line):Point? {
                val det=a.a*b.b-b.a*a.b
                if(abs(det)<0.25) return null
                return Point((a.b*b.c-b.b*a.c)/det,(b.a*a.c-a.a*b.c)/det)
            }
            val pairs=segments.indices.flatMap { i -> (i+1 until segments.size).map { j -> i to j } }
                .filter { (i,j) ->
                    val first=segments[i]; val second=segments[j]
                    val dot=first.a*second.a+first.b*second.b
                    val sign=if(dot>=0) 1.0 else -1.0
                    val separation=abs((first.a-sign*second.a)*edges.cols()/2.0+
                        (first.b-sign*second.b)*edges.rows()/2.0+first.c-sign*second.c)
                    abs(dot)>0.85 && separation>=12.0
                }
                .sortedByDescending { (i,j) -> segments[i].length+segments[j].length }
                .take(24)
            val output=ArrayList<List<Point>>()
            for(u in pairs.indices) for(v in u+1 until pairs.size) {
                val (a,b)=pairs[u]; val (c,d)=pairs[v]
                if(setOf(a,b,c,d).size!=4) continue
                val p=listOf(intersect(segments[a],segments[c]),intersect(segments[a],segments[d]),
                    intersect(segments[b],segments[d]),intersect(segments[b],segments[c]))
                if(p.any { it==null }) continue
                val q=DocumentCropProcessor.orderCorners(p.filterNotNull().toTypedArray()) ?: continue
                if(q.any { !it.x.isFinite() || !it.y.isFinite() ||
                    it.x<0 || it.y<0 || it.x>edges.cols()-1 || it.y>edges.rows()-1 }) continue
                output.add(q)
                if(output.size==80) return output
            }
            return output
        } finally { lines.release() }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

enum class LiveDetectionStatus {
    IDLE,
    PROVISIONAL,
    CONFIRMED,
    HELD,
    EXPIRED,
    PARTIAL,
    ERROR,
}

data class LiveDetectionState(
    val generationId: Long,
    val status: LiveDetectionStatus,
    val analysisSpec: AnalysisBufferSpec?,
    val quadInBufferPixels: FloatArray?,
    val quadInNormalizedViewPort: CropQuadrilateral?,
    val rawScore: Double,
    val frameTimestampMonotonicMs: Long,
    val processedTimestampMonotonicMs: Long,
    val publicationId: Long = 0L,
    val visualDeadlineMonotonicMs: Long = frameTimestampMonotonicMs + DEFAULT_MAX_TTL_MS,
    val lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs: Long = frameTimestampMonotonicMs,
    val trackId: Long? = null,
    val isTrackedGeometry: Boolean = false,
) {
    val isUsableForAgreement: Boolean
        get() = status == LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED && quadInNormalizedViewPort != null

    /** A validated current-frame track must not pulse dark between detector frames. */
    val shouldDimOverlay: Boolean
        get() = status == LiveDetectionStatus.HELD && !isTrackedGeometry

    fun isFresh(nowMonotonicMs: Long, maxTtlMs: Long = DEFAULT_MAX_TTL_MS): Boolean {
        return nowMonotonicMs >= frameTimestampMonotonicMs &&
            nowMonotonicMs - frameTimestampMonotonicMs < maxTtlMs &&
            nowMonotonicMs < visualDeadlineMonotonicMs
    }

    override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
        if (this === other) return true
        if (javaClass != other?.javaClass) return false
        other as LiveDetectionState
        if (generationId != other.generationId) return false
        if (status != other.status) return false
        if (analysisSpec != other.analysisSpec) return false
        if (quadInBufferPixels != null) {
            if (other.quadInBufferPixels == null) return false
            if (!quadInBufferPixels.contentEquals(other.quadInBufferPixels)) return false
        } else if (other.quadInBufferPixels != null) return false
        if (quadInNormalizedViewPort != other.quadInNormalizedViewPort) return false
        if (rawScore != other.rawScore) return false
        if (frameTimestampMonotonicMs != other.frameTimestampMonotonicMs) return false
        if (processedTimestampMonotonicMs != other.processedTimestampMonotonicMs) return false
        if (publicationId != other.publicationId) return false
        if (visualDeadlineMonotonicMs != other.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs) return false
        if (lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs != other.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs) return false
        if (trackId != other.trackId || isTrackedGeometry != other.isTrackedGeometry) return false
        return true
    }

    override fun hashCode(): Int {
        var result = generationId.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + status.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + (analysisSpec?.hashCode() ?: 0)
        result = 31 * result + (quadInBufferPixels?.contentHashCode() ?: 0)
        result = 31 * result + (quadInNormalizedViewPort?.hashCode() ?: 0)
        result = 31 * result + rawScore.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + frameTimestampMonotonicMs.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + processedTimestampMonotonicMs.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + publicationId.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + visualDeadlineMonotonicMs.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs.hashCode()
        result = 31 * result + (trackId?.hashCode() ?: 0)
        result = 31 * result + isTrackedGeometry.hashCode()
        return result
    }

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_MAX_TTL_MS = 200L

        fun empty(generationId: Long = 0L) = LiveDetectionState(
            generationId = generationId,
            status = LiveDetectionStatus.IDLE,
            analysisSpec = null,
            quadInBufferPixels = null,
            quadInNormalizedViewPort = null,
            rawScore = 0.0,
            frameTimestampMonotonicMs = 0L,
            processedTimestampMonotonicMs = 0L,
        )
    }
}

/** Serializes tracking events; published arrays are defensive copies. */
class DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(
    private val maxTtlMs: Long = LiveDetectionState.DEFAULT_MAX_TTL_MS,
    private val clock: () -> Long = { android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() },
) {
    init { require(maxTtlMs > 0) }

    private val generationSequence = AtomicLong(1L)
    @Volatile private var currentGenerationId = generationSequence.get()
    private val lock = Any()
    private var publishedState = LiveDetectionState.empty(currentGenerationId)
    private var activeSpec: AnalysisBufferSpec? = null
    private var provisionalPoints: FloatArray? = null
    private var provisionalQuad: CropQuadrilateral? = null
    private var provisionalTimestampMs: Long? = null
    private var confirmedPoints: FloatArray? = null
    private var confirmedQuad: CropQuadrilateral? = null
    private var measuredConfirmedQuad: CropQuadrilateral? = null
    private var confirmedTimestampMs: Long? = null
    private var confirmedVisualTimestampMs: Long? = null
    private var confirmedScore = 0.0
    private var lastFrameTimestampMs: Long? = null
    private var publicationSequence = 0L
    private var trackSequence = 0L
    private var activeTrackId: Long? = null
    private val quadFilter=DocumentQuadFilter(DocumentQuadFilterMode.ONE_EURO)

    fun currentGeneration(): Long = currentGenerationId

    fun newGeneration(): Long = synchronized(lock) { advanceGeneration() }

    fun invalidate() = synchronized(lock) {
        advanceGeneration()
        publishedState = publishedState.copy(status = LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED)
    }

    /** Binds a frame to its geometry without allowing an in-flight old session back in. */
    fun generationForFrame(spec: AnalysisBufferSpec, expectedGeneration: Long): Long? = synchronized(lock) {
        if (expectedGeneration != currentGenerationId) return@synchronized null
        if (activeSpec != null && activeSpec != spec) advanceGeneration()
        activeSpec = spec
        currentGenerationId
    }

    fun getPublishedState(): LiveDetectionState = synchronized(lock) { publishedState.detached() }

    /** UI submission accepts only the newest publication. */
    fun isCurrent(state: LiveDetectionState): Boolean = synchronized(lock) {
        state.generationId == currentGenerationId && state.publicationId == publishedState.publicationId &&
            state.analysisSpec == publishedState.analysisSpec
    }

    fun canDisplay(state: LiveDetectionState, nowMonotonicMs: Long = clock()): Boolean = synchronized(lock) {
        isCurrent(state) && state.status in setOf(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, LiveDetectionStatus.HELD) &&
            state.quadInBufferPixels != null && state.isFresh(nowMonotonicMs, maxTtlMs)
    }

    /** Keep an already applied contour through a same-track UI handoff, within its original lease.
     * This does not authorize submitting an older publication or extending its deadline.
     */
    fun canRetainDisplayed(state: LiveDetectionState, nowMonotonicMs: Long = clock()): Boolean = synchronized(lock) {
        state.generationId == currentGenerationId && state.analysisSpec == activeSpec &&
            state.trackId != null && state.trackId == publishedState.trackId &&
            state.publicationId <= publishedState.publicationId &&
            state.status in setOf(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, LiveDetectionStatus.HELD) &&
            publishedState.status in setOf(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, LiveDetectionStatus.HELD) &&
            state.quadInBufferPixels != null && state.isFresh(nowMonotonicMs, maxTtlMs) &&
            publishedState.isFresh(nowMonotonicMs, maxTtlMs)
    }

    fun captureSnapshot(): LiveDetectionState = synchronized(lock) {
        val state = publishedState.detached()
        if (state.isUsableForAgreement && state.isFresh(clock(), maxTtlMs)) state
        else state.copy(status = LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED)
    }

    /** Explicit unavailable evidence never retains a full confirmed contour. */
    fun onFrameUnavailable(generationId: Long, timestampMs: Long,
                           status: LiveDetectionStatus): LiveDetectionState = synchronized(lock) {
        require(status == LiveDetectionStatus.PARTIAL || status == LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR)
        if (generationId != currentGenerationId || lastFrameTimestampMs?.let { timestampMs <= it } == true)
            return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        resetTracking()
        lastFrameTimestampMs = timestampMs
        publishedState = LiveDetectionState.empty(currentGenerationId).copy(status = status,
            publicationId = ++publicationSequence, processedTimestampMonotonicMs = timestampMs)
        publishedState.detached()
    }

    /** Processing/projection failed for this frame, including after its geometry was published. */
    fun onFrameError(generationId:Long,frameTimestampMs:Long):LiveDetectionState = synchronized(lock) {
        if(generationId!=currentGenerationId || lastFrameTimestampMs?.let { frameTimestampMs<it }==true)
            return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        resetTracking()
        lastFrameTimestampMs=frameTimestampMs
        publishedState=LiveDetectionState.empty(currentGenerationId).copy(status=LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR,
            publicationId=++publicationSequence,processedTimestampMonotonicMs=clock())
        publishedState.detached()
    }

    /** Flow renews visual evidence, never detector evidence or initial confirmation. */
    fun onFrameTracked(generationId: Long, timestampMs: Long, points: FloatArray,
                       spec: AnalysisBufferSpec): LiveDetectionState = synchronized(lock) {
        if (generationId != currentGenerationId || spec != activeSpec ||
            lastFrameTimestampMs?.let { timestampMs <= it } == true) return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        val detectionTimestamp = confirmedTimestampMs
        if (confirmedQuad == null || detectionTimestamp == null || timestampMs - detectionTimestamp !in 0 until 500L)
            return@synchronized onFrameMissing(generationId, timestampMs)
        val measured = try { CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferQuadToNormalizedViewPort(points, spec) }
            catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { return@synchronized onFrameMissing(generationId, timestampMs) }
        clearProvisional()
        lastFrameTimestampMs = timestampMs
        val smoothed=quadFilter.update(BoundaryQuad.from(points),timestampMs).toFloatArray()
        confirmedPoints = smoothed
        confirmedQuad = CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferQuadToNormalizedViewPort(smoothed,spec)
        measuredConfirmedQuad = measured
        confirmedVisualTimestampMs = timestampMs
        publishedState = state(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, spec, smoothed, confirmedQuad, confirmedScore,
            timestampMs, clock()).copy(visualDeadlineMonotonicMs = minOf(
                timestampMs + maxTtlMs, detectionTimestamp + 500L),
                lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs = detectionTimestamp, isTrackedGeometry = true)
        publishedState.detached()
    }

    fun onFrameDetected(
        generationId: Long,
        frameTimestampMonotonicMs: Long,
        rawBufferPoints: FloatArray,
        rawScore: Double,
        spec: AnalysisBufferSpec,
        processedTimestampMonotonicMs: Long = clock(),
    ): LiveDetectionState = synchronized(lock) {
        if (generationId != currentGenerationId) return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        // Callers may submit geometry directly (e.g. tests). Never smooth across spaces.
        if (activeSpec != null && activeSpec != spec) {
            advanceGeneration()
            activeSpec = spec
            return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        }
        activeSpec = spec
        // Reject late/duplicate events before validating their payload. A bad old result must
        // never erase a newer detection or move the frame watermark to its completion time.
        if (lastFrameTimestampMs?.let { frameTimestampMonotonicMs <= it } == true)
            return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        if (frameTimestampMonotonicMs < 0 || !rawScore.isFinite() ||
            processedTimestampMonotonicMs - frameTimestampMonotonicMs !in 0 until maxTtlMs) {
            return@synchronized onFrameMissing(currentGenerationId, frameTimestampMonotonicMs)
        }
        if (lastFrameTimestampMs?.let { frameTimestampMonotonicMs - it > maxTtlMs } == true)
            resetTracking()
        lastFrameTimestampMs = frameTimestampMonotonicMs

        val candidate = try {
            CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferQuadToNormalizedViewPort(rawBufferPoints, spec)
        } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
            return@synchronized onFrameMissing(currentGenerationId, frameTimestampMonotonicMs)
        }
        if (!isRecent(confirmedVisualTimestampMs, frameTimestampMonotonicMs) ||
            confirmedTimestampMs?.let { frameTimestampMonotonicMs-it in 0 until 500L } != true) {
            confirmedQuad = null
            confirmedPoints = null
            measuredConfirmedQuad = null
            activeTrackId = null
        }
        if (!isRecent(provisionalTimestampMs, frameTimestampMonotonicMs)) clearProvisional()

        val confirmedAgreement = measuredConfirmedQuad?.let { QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(it, candidate,
            imageAspectRatio = spec.orientedAspectRatio) }
        val provisionalAgreement = provisionalQuad?.let { QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(it, candidate,
            imageAspectRatio = spec.orientedAspectRatio) }
        val reference = when {
            confirmedAgreement?.agrees == true -> confirmedPoints
            provisionalAgreement?.agrees == true -> provisionalPoints
            else -> null
        }
        if (reference != null) {
            if(confirmedAgreement?.agrees != true) {
                // Seed only the new target; never blend it with the previous sheet.
                quadFilter.reset()
                quadFilter.update(BoundaryQuad.from(reference),provisionalTimestampMs!!)
            }
            val proposed=quadFilter.update(BoundaryQuad.from(rawBufferPoints),frameTimestampMonotonicMs).toFloatArray()
            // Reject a filter-induced non-convex shape rather than failing the camera session.
            val smoothed = try {
                CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferQuadToNormalizedViewPort(proposed, spec)
                proposed
            } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { rawBufferPoints.clone() }
            confirmedPoints = smoothed
            if (confirmedAgreement?.agrees != true) activeTrackId = ++trackSequence
            measuredConfirmedQuad = candidate
            confirmedQuad = CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferQuadToNormalizedViewPort(smoothed, spec)
            confirmedTimestampMs = frameTimestampMonotonicMs
            confirmedVisualTimestampMs = frameTimestampMonotonicMs
            confirmedScore = rawScore
            clearProvisional()
            publishedState = state(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, spec, smoothed, confirmedQuad,
                rawScore, frameTimestampMonotonicMs, processedTimestampMonotonicMs)
        } else {
            provisionalPoints = rawBufferPoints.clone()
            provisionalQuad = candidate
            provisionalTimestampMs = frameTimestampMonotonicMs
            publishedState = if (confirmedQuad != null) {
                state(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, spec, confirmedPoints, confirmedQuad, confirmedScore,
                    confirmedVisualTimestampMs!!, processedTimestampMonotonicMs).copy(
                        lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs = confirmedTimestampMs!!,
                        visualDeadlineMonotonicMs = minOf(confirmedVisualTimestampMs!! + maxTtlMs, confirmedTimestampMs!! + 500L))
            } else {
                state(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, spec, provisionalPoints, candidate, rawScore,
                    frameTimestampMonotonicMs, processedTimestampMonotonicMs)
            }
        }
        publishedState.detached()
    }

    fun onFrameMissing(generationId: Long, nowMonotonicMs: Long = clock()): LiveDetectionState = synchronized(lock) {
        if (generationId != currentGenerationId) return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        if (lastFrameTimestampMs?.let { nowMonotonicMs < it } == true)
            return@synchronized publishedState.detached()
        clearProvisional() // A missing observation breaks consecutive confirmation.
        lastFrameTimestampMs = nowMonotonicMs
        publishedState = if (confirmedQuad != null && isRecent(confirmedVisualTimestampMs, nowMonotonicMs) &&
            confirmedTimestampMs?.let { nowMonotonicMs - it in 0 until 500L } == true) {
            state(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, activeSpec, confirmedPoints, confirmedQuad, confirmedScore,
                confirmedVisualTimestampMs!!, nowMonotonicMs).copy(
                    lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs = confirmedTimestampMs!!,
                    visualDeadlineMonotonicMs = minOf(confirmedVisualTimestampMs!! + maxTtlMs, confirmedTimestampMs!! + 500L))
        } else {
            resetTracking()
            LiveDetectionState.empty(currentGenerationId).copy(status = LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED,
                processedTimestampMonotonicMs = nowMonotonicMs)
        }
        publishedState.detached()
    }

    private fun isRecent(timestamp: Long?, now: Long): Boolean =
        timestamp != null && now - timestamp in 0 until maxTtlMs

    private fun advanceGeneration(): Long {
        currentGenerationId = generationSequence.incrementAndGet()
        resetTracking()
        activeSpec = null
        publishedState = LiveDetectionState.empty(currentGenerationId)
        return currentGenerationId
    }

    private fun clearProvisional() {
        provisionalPoints = null
        provisionalQuad = null
        provisionalTimestampMs = null
    }

    private fun resetTracking() {
        quadFilter.reset()
        clearProvisional()
        confirmedPoints = null
        confirmedQuad = null
        measuredConfirmedQuad = null
        activeTrackId = null
        confirmedTimestampMs = null
        confirmedVisualTimestampMs = null
        confirmedScore = 0.0
        lastFrameTimestampMs = null
    }

    private fun state(status: LiveDetectionStatus, spec: AnalysisBufferSpec?, points: FloatArray?,
                      quad: CropQuadrilateral?, score: Double, timestamp: Long, processed: Long) =
        LiveDetectionState(currentGenerationId, status, spec, points?.clone(), quad, score, timestamp, processed,
            publicationId = ++publicationSequence,
            visualDeadlineMonotonicMs = if (timestamp > Long.MAX_VALUE - maxTtlMs) Long.MAX_VALUE else timestamp + maxTtlMs,
            trackId = activeTrackId)

    private fun LiveDetectionState.detached() = copy(quadInBufferPixels = quadInBufferPixels?.clone())

}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/DocumentOverlayView.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Path
import android.view.View

/**
 * Overlay view that draws a green polygon boundary over detected documents in the live camera preview.
 * Points are ready PreviewView screen pixels (FloatArray of 8 elements: TL.x, TL.y, TR.x, TR.y, BR.x, BR.y, BL.x, BL.y).
 */
class DocumentOverlayView(context: Context) : View(context) {

    private var points: FloatArray? = null
    private val path = Path()

    init {
        setWillNotDraw(false)
    }

    private val fillPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = 0x2422C55E // Subtle emerald green transparent fill
    }

    private val strokePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = resources.displayMetrics.density * 3.0f
        strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
        strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        color = 0xFF22C55E.toInt() // Emerald Green
    }

    private val cornerPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt()
    }

    private val cornerStrokePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = resources.displayMetrics.density * 2.0f
        color = 0xFF22C55E.toInt()
    }

    fun setPolygonPixels(newPoints: FloatArray?) {
        points = newPoints?.takeIf { it.size == 8 }?.clone()
        invalidate()
    }

    val hasPolygon: Boolean get() = points != null

    fun clear() {
        points = null
        invalidate()
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)
        val p = points ?: return
        path.reset()
        path.moveTo(p[0], p[1])
        path.lineTo(p[2], p[3])
        path.lineTo(p[4], p[5])
        path.lineTo(p[6], p[7])
        path.close()

        canvas.drawPath(path, fillPaint)
        canvas.drawPath(path, strokePaint)

        val radius = resources.displayMetrics.density * 5f
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            val px = p[i * 2]
            val py = p[i * 2 + 1]
            canvas.drawCircle(px, py, radius, cornerPaint)
            canvas.drawCircle(px, py, radius, cornerStrokePaint)
        }
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/DocumentPreviewDetector.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.android

import android.util.Log
import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.opencv.android.OpenCVLoader
import org.opencv.core.*
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import kotlin.math.*

/** Live preview detection restored from the read-only 0.4.259 backup.
 * The current JPEG processor stays separate; this object contains only the original detection path.
 */
internal object DocumentPreviewDetector {
    private const val TAG = "DocScan"
    private const val MIN_SCORE = 0.45 // Lower than this — "document not found"
    const val MIN_SCORE_DEFAULT = MIN_SCORE
    const val TRACKING_MIN_SCORE = 0.32 // Hysteresis: an already shown contour is kept by a weaker candidate

    data class Detection(
        val bufferPoints: FloatArray, // TL, TR, BR, BL in buffer pixels (8 floats: x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3)
        val imageWidth: Int,
        val imageHeight: Int,
        val score: Double,
    ) {
        fun toNormalized(): CropQuadrilateral {
            fun p(i: Int) = NormalizedCropPoint(
                (bufferPoints[i] / imageWidth).toDouble().coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
                (bufferPoints[i + 1] / imageHeight).toDouble().coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
            )
            return CropQuadrilateral(
                topLeft = p(0),
                topRight = p(2),
                bottomRight = p(4),
                bottomLeft = p(6),
            )
        }
    }

    fun detectCornersFromRgbaBuffer(
        buffer: java.nio.ByteBuffer, width: Int, height: Int, rowStride: Int, minScore: Double = MIN_SCORE,
        diag: BoundaryTelemetry.Diagnostics? = null,
    ): Detection? {
        ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val rgba = Mat(height, width, CvType.CV_8UC4, buffer, rowStride.toLong())
        return try {
            detectCornersFromRgba(rgba, minScore, diag)
        } finally {
            rgba.release()
        }
    }

    fun detectCornersFromRgba(input: Mat, minScore: Double = MIN_SCORE, diag: BoundaryTelemetry.Diagnostics? = null): Detection? {
        ensureOpenCvLoaded()
        val startedAt = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        currentDiag = diag
        if (input.empty()) return null
        val ow = input.cols()
        val oh = input.rows()
        val ds = min(1.0, 720.0 / max(ow, oh).toDouble())
        val work = Mat()
        val gray = Mat()
        val blur = Mat()
        val edgeMask = Mat()
        val paperMask = Mat()
        val tmp = Mat()
        try {
            Imgproc.resize(input, work, Size(ow * ds, oh * ds), 0.0, 0.0, Imgproc.INTER_AREA)
            Imgproc.cvtColor(work, gray, if (input.channels() == 4) Imgproc.COLOR_RGBA2GRAY else Imgproc.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
            Imgproc.GaussianBlur(gray, blur, Size(5.0, 5.0), 0.0)

            // ---- Карта A: Canny OR grad(Adaptive) ----
            val otsuLevel = Imgproc.threshold(blur, tmp, 0.0, 255.0, Imgproc.THRESH_BINARY or Imgproc.THRESH_OTSU)
            val canny = Mat()
            val low = max(20.0, otsuLevel * 0.45)
            val high = max(low + 20.0, otsuLevel * 1.20)
            Imgproc.Canny(blur, canny, low, high, 3, true)

            // Adaptive threshold большим блоком переживает неравномерное освещение
            val adapt = Mat()
            var block = (min(gray.cols(), gray.rows()) * 0.10).roundToInt()
            if (block % 2 == 0) block++
            Imgproc.adaptiveThreshold(blur, adapt, 255.0, Imgproc.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, Imgproc.THRESH_BINARY, block.coerceIn(31, 101), 7.0)
            val gradMask = Mat()
            val k5 = Imgproc.getStructuringElement(Imgproc.MORPH_RECT, Size(5.0, 5.0))
            Imgproc.morphologyEx(adapt, gradMask, Imgproc.MORPH_GRADIENT, k5)
            adapt.release()

            Core.bitwise_or(canny, gradMask, edgeMask)
            canny.release()
            gradMask.release()

            Imgproc.morphologyEx(edgeMask, edgeMask, Imgproc.MORPH_CLOSE, k5, Point(-1.0, -1.0), 2)
            k5.release()
            val k3 = Imgproc.getStructuringElement(Imgproc.MORPH_RECT, Size(3.0, 3.0))
            Imgproc.dilate(edgeMask, edgeMask, k3)
            k3.release()

            // ---- Карта B: "бумага" = светлое + малонасыщенное пятно ----
            buildPaperMask(work, paperMask)

            // ---- Сбор и скоринг кандидатов с обеих карт ----
            val frameArea = work.cols().toDouble() * work.rows()
            var best: Candidate? = null
            var bestMap = ""
            for ((mask, name) in listOf(edgeMask to "edges", paperMask to "paper")) {
                for (cand in extractCandidates(mask, gray, edgeMask, frameArea)) {
                    if (best == null || cand.score > best.score) {
                        best = cand
                        bestMap = name
                    }
                }
            }

            // ---- Фоллбек HoughLinesP при слабом скоре контуров ----
            if (best == null || best.score < minScore) {
                diag?.houghTried = true
                val hough = houghLinesFallback(edgeMask, gray, frameArea)
                if (hough != null && (best == null || hough.score > best.score)) {
                    best = hough
                    bestMap = "hough"
                }
            }

            if (best != null) {
                Log.d(TAG, "Document detected: score=%.3f map=%s".format(best.score, bestMap))
            }
            diag?.bestScore = best?.score ?: -1.0
            diag?.bestMap = bestMap
            if (best == null || best.score < minScore) { diag?.failure = if (best == null) "no_candidate" else "below_threshold"; return null }

            // ---- Субпиксельное уточнение граней через fitLine ----
            val refined = refineQuadWithFitLine(best.pts, edgeMask)

            val inv = 1.0f / ds.toFloat()
            val pts = FloatArray(8)
            refined.forEachIndexed { i, p ->
                pts[i * 2] = (p.x * inv).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, ow.toFloat() - 1f)
                pts[i * 2 + 1] = (p.y * inv).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, oh.toFloat() - 1f)
            }
            return Detection(pts, ow, oh, best.score)
        } finally {
            diag?.millis = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - startedAt
            currentDiag = null
            work.release()
            gray.release()
            blur.release()
            edgeMask.release()
            paperMask.release()
            tmp.release()
        }
    }

    internal fun ensureOpenCvLoaded() {
        if (loaded) return
        synchronized(this) {
            if (!loaded) {
                if (!OpenCVLoader.initLocal()) {
                    System.loadLibrary("opencv_java4")
                }
                loaded = true
            }
        }
    }

    // ---------------- Карта "бумаги" ----------------
    private fun buildPaperMask(src: Mat, out: Mat) {
        val rgb = Mat()
        val hsv = Mat()
        val ch = ArrayList<Mat>()
        val vMask = Mat()
        val sMask = Mat()
        val vBlur = Mat()
        try {
            if (src.channels() == 4) {
                Imgproc.cvtColor(src, rgb, Imgproc.COLOR_RGBA2RGB)
            } else {
                src.copyTo(rgb)
            }
            Imgproc.cvtColor(rgb, hsv, Imgproc.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
            Core.split(hsv, ch)
            Imgproc.GaussianBlur(ch[2], vBlur, Size(9.0, 9.0), 0.0)
            Imgproc.threshold(vBlur, vMask, 0.0, 255.0, Imgproc.THRESH_BINARY or Imgproc.THRESH_OTSU)
            Imgproc.threshold(ch[1], sMask, 70.0, 255.0, Imgproc.THRESH_BINARY_INV)
            Core.bitwise_and(vMask, sMask, out)
            val k15 = Imgproc.getStructuringElement(Imgproc.MORPH_RECT, Size(15.0, 15.0))
            val k7 = Imgproc.getStructuringElement(Imgproc.MORPH_RECT, Size(7.0, 7.0))
            Imgproc.morphologyEx(out, out, Imgproc.MORPH_CLOSE, k15)
            Imgproc.morphologyEx(out, out, Imgproc.MORPH_OPEN, k7)
            fillHoles(out)
            k15.release()
            k7.release()
        } finally {
            rgb.release()
            hsv.release()
            vMask.release()
            sMask.release()
            vBlur.release()
            ch.forEach { it.release() }
        }
    }

    private fun fillHoles(mask: Mat) {
        val contours = ArrayList<MatOfPoint>()
        val work = mask.clone()
        val hierarchy = Mat()
        try {
            Imgproc.findContours(work, contours, hierarchy, Imgproc.RETR_EXTERNAL, Imgproc.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
            Imgproc.drawContours(mask, contours, -1, Scalar(255.0), Imgproc.FILLED)
        } finally {
            work.release()
            hierarchy.release()
            contours.forEach { it.release() }
        }
    }

    // ---------------- Кандидаты ----------------
    private data class Candidate(val pts: List<Point>, val score: Double)

    /** Set only for the duration of one analysis on the analyzer thread. */
    private var currentDiag: BoundaryTelemetry.Diagnostics? = null
    private fun reject(reason: String): Double? { currentDiag?.reject(reason); return null }

    private fun extractCandidates(
        mask: Mat,
        gray: Mat,
        edgeMapRef: Mat,
        frameArea: Double,
    ): List<Candidate> {
        val work = mask.clone()
        val contours = ArrayList<MatOfPoint>()
        val hierarchy = Mat()
        val result = ArrayList<Candidate>()
        try {
            // RETR_LIST обязателен: лист может лежать ВНУТРИ внешнего контура стола
            Imgproc.findContours(work, contours, hierarchy, Imgproc.RETR_LIST, Imgproc.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
            val top = contours
                .map { it to Imgproc.contourArea(it) }
                .filter { it.second > frameArea * 0.07 && it.second < frameArea * 0.96 }
                .sortedByDescending { it.second }
                .take(10)
            if (top.isEmpty()) currentDiag?.reject("no_contour_in_range")

            for ((cnt, _) in top) {
                val hull = hullOf(cnt) ?: continue
                val peri = Imgproc.arcLength(hull, true)
                if (peri < min(gray.cols(), gray.rows()) * 0.8) {
                    hull.release()
                    currentDiag?.reject("perimeter")
                    continue
                }
                val quad = approxQuad(hull, peri) ?: minAreaRectFallback(hull)
                hull.release()
                if (quad == null) { currentDiag?.reject("not_quad"); continue }
                val ordered = orderCorners(quad) ?: continue
                val score = scoreQuad(ordered, gray, edgeMapRef, frameArea) ?: continue
                currentDiag?.let { it.candidates++ }
                result += Candidate(ordered, score)
            }
        } finally {
            work.release()
            hierarchy.release()
            contours.forEach { it.release() }
        }
        return result
    }

    /** Бинарный поиск epsilon: быстрее и стабильнее, чем фиксированный список */
    private fun approxQuad(hull: MatOfPoint2f, peri: Double): Array<Point>? {
        var lo = 0.005 * peri
        var hi = 0.08 * peri
        var found: Array<Point>? = null
        repeat(12) {
            val eps = (lo + hi) / 2.0
            val approx = MatOfPoint2f()
            try {
                Imgproc.approxPolyDP(hull, approx, eps, true)
                val n = approx.total().toInt()
                if (n == 4) {
                    found = approx.toArray()
                    lo = eps
                } else if (n > 4) {
                    lo = eps
                } else {
                    hi = eps
                }
            } finally {
                approx.release()
            }
        }
        return found
    }

    private fun minAreaRectFallback(hull: MatOfPoint2f): Array<Point>? {
        val rr = Imgproc.minAreaRect(hull)
        val rectArea = rr.size.width * rr.size.height
        if (rectArea <= 0) return null
        if (Imgproc.contourArea(hull) / rectArea < 0.85) return null
        val pts = arrayOfNulls<Point>(4)
        rr.points(pts)
        return pts.filterNotNull().toTypedArray().takeIf { it.size == 4 }
    }

    private fun hullOf(c: MatOfPoint): MatOfPoint2f? {
        val idx = MatOfInt()
        Imgproc.convexHull(c, idx)
        val src = c.toArray()
        val idxArr = idx.toArray()
        idx.release()
        if (idxArr.size < 4) return null
        return MatOfPoint2f(*Array(idxArr.size) { src[idxArr[it]] })
    }

    /** TL, TR, BR, BL — геометрический расчет, устойчивый к углам наклона */
    private fun orderCorners(p: Array<Point>): List<Point>? {
        if (p.size != 4) return null
        val tl = p.minByOrNull { it.x + it.y } ?: return null
        val br = p.maxByOrNull { it.x + it.y } ?: return null
        val tr = p.minByOrNull { it.y - it.x } ?: return null
        val bl = p.maxByOrNull { it.y - it.x } ?: return null
        val candidate = listOf(tl, tr, br, bl)
        if (candidate.distinctBy { it.x.roundToInt() to it.y.roundToInt() }.size == 4) {
            return candidate
        }
        // Fallback: Clockwise around centroid
        val cx = p.sumOf { it.x } / 4.0
        val cy = p.sumOf { it.y } / 4.0
        val clockwise = p.sortedBy { atan2(it.y - cy, it.x - cx) }
        val tlIdx = clockwise.indices.minByOrNull { clockwise[it].x + clockwise[it].y } ?: return null
        val ordered = (0 until 4).map { clockwise[(tlIdx + it) % 4] }
        if (ordered.distinctBy { it.x.roundToInt() to it.y.roundToInt() }.size != 4) return null
        return ordered
    }

    // ---------------- Скоринг ----------------
    private fun scoreQuad(
        p: List<Point>,
        gray: Mat,
        edgeMap: Mat,
        frameArea: Double,
    ): Double? {
        if (p.distinctBy { it.x.roundToInt() to it.y.roundToInt() }.size < 4) return reject("degenerate")
        if (!isConvex(p)) return reject("non_convex")
        val w = gray.cols()
        val h = gray.rows()
        val area = polygonArea(p)
        val areaRatio = area / frameArea
        if (areaRatio < 0.07 || areaRatio > 0.96) return reject("area")

        val sides = doubleArrayOf(
            dist(p[0], p[1]),
            dist(p[1], p[2]),
            dist(p[2], p[3]),
            dist(p[3], p[0]),
        )
        if (sides.any { it < min(w, h) * 0.06 }) return reject("short_side")

        val angles = DoubleArray(4) { cornerAngle(p[(it + 3) % 4], p[it], p[(it + 1) % 4]) }
        // Предел 45..135 отсекает перспективные "стрелы"
        if (angles.any { it < 45.0 || it > 135.0 }) return reject("angle")

        val width = (sides[0] + sides[2]) / 2.0
        val height = (sides[1] + sides[3]) / 2.0
        val aspect = max(width, height) / max(1.0, min(width, height))
        if (aspect > 3.3) return reject("aspect")

        // Параллельность проверяем и направлением, и длинами противоположных сторон
        val parDir = (parallelDir(p[0], p[1], p[3], p[2]) + parallelDir(p[0], p[3], p[1], p[2])) / 2.0
        val parLen = (min(sides[0], sides[2]) / max(sides[0], sides[2]) + min(sides[1], sides[3]) / max(sides[1], sides[3])) / 2.0
        if (parLen < 0.50) return reject("parallel")

        // ---- Взвешенный score ----
        val areaScore = ((areaRatio - 0.07) / 0.65).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
        val angleScore = exp(-angles.map { abs(it - 90.0) }.average() / 24.0)
        val parallelScore = (parDir + parLen) / 2.0
        val aspectScore = when {
            aspect <= 1.8 -> 1.0
            aspect <= 2.4 -> 1.0 - (aspect - 1.8) / 1.2
            else -> (0.5 - (aspect - 2.4) / 1.8).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
        }
        val edgeSupport = edgeSupportScore(p, edgeMap) // есть ли реальные края вдоль сторон
        val contrast = ringContrastScore(p, gray) // бумага отличается от фона по кольцу
        val centerScore = centerScore(p, w, h)
        val borderPenalty = borderPenalty(p, w, h) // касание краёв = признак стола

        return 0.20 * areaScore +
                0.22 * angleScore +
                0.14 * parallelScore +
                0.12 * aspectScore +
                0.12 * edgeSupport +
                0.10 * contrast +
                0.10 * centerScore -
                0.20 * borderPenalty
    }

    // --- Геометрия ---
    private fun isConvex(p: List<Point>): Boolean {
        var sign = 0
        for (i in 0..3) {
            val a = p[i]
            val b = p[(i + 1) % 4]
            val c = p[(i + 2) % 4]
            val cr = (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x)
            val s = if (cr > 0) 1 else if (cr < 0) -1 else 0
            if (s != 0) {
                if (sign == 0) sign = s else if (sign != s) return false
            }
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun polygonArea(p: List<Point>): Double {
        var s = 0.0
        for (i in 0..3) {
            val j = (i + 1) % 4
            s += p[i].x * p[j].y - p[j].x * p[i].y
        }
        return abs(s) / 2.0
    }

    private fun dist(a: Point, b: Point) = hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)

    private fun distance(first: Point, second: Point) = hypot(first.x - second.x, first.y - second.y)

    private fun cornerAngle(prev: Point, cur: Point, next: Point): Double {
        val ax = prev.x - cur.x
        val ay = prev.y - cur.y
        val bx = next.x - cur.x
        val by = next.y - cur.y
        val m = hypot(ax, ay) * hypot(bx, by)
        if (m < 1e-9) return 0.0
        return Math.toDegrees(acos(((ax * bx + ay * by) / m).coerceIn(-1.0, 1.0)))
    }

    private fun parallelDir(a1: Point, a2: Point, b1: Point, b2: Point): Double {
        var ax = a2.x - a1.x
        var ay = a2.y - a1.y
        var bx = b2.x - b1.x
        var by = b2.y - b1.y
        val am = hypot(ax, ay)
        val bm = hypot(bx, by)
        if (am < 1e-9 || bm < 1e-9) return 0.0
        ax /= am
        ay /= am
        bx /= bm
        by /= bm
        return abs(ax * bx + ay * by).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
    }

    // --- Фотометрические проверки ---
    /** Сэмплируем 40 точек на каждой стороне: есть ли реальный edge-пиксель в окрестности ±2px */
    private fun edgeSupportScore(p: List<Point>, edgeMap: Mat): Double {
        var good = 0
        var total = 0
        val cols = edgeMap.cols()
        val rows = edgeMap.rows()
        for (i in 0..3) {
            val a = p[i]
            val b = p[(i + 1) % 4]
            for (j in 0..40) {
                val t = j / 40.0
                val x = (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t).roundToInt()
                val y = (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t).roundToInt()
                if (x !in 2 until cols - 2 || y !in 2 until rows - 2) continue
                total++
                var found = false
                loop@ for (dy in -2..2) {
                    for (dx in -2..2) {
                        val pixel = edgeMap.get(y + dy, x + dx)
                        if (pixel != null && pixel[0] > 0) {
                            found = true
                            break@loop
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (found) good++
            }
        }
        return if (total == 0) 0.0 else good.toDouble() / total
    }

    /** Разница яркости внутри листа и в кольце вокруг него — сильнейший сигнал против стола */
    private fun ringContrastScore(p: List<Point>, gray: Mat): Double {
        val inner = Mat.zeros(gray.size(), CvType.CV_8UC1)
        val outer = Mat()
        val ring = Mat()
        val poly = MatOfPoint(*p.toTypedArray())
        val kernel = Imgproc.getStructuringElement(Imgproc.MORPH_RECT, Size(21.0, 21.0))
        return try {
            Imgproc.fillConvexPoly(inner, poly, Scalar(255.0))
            Imgproc.dilate(inner, outer, kernel)
            Core.subtract(outer, inner, ring)
            val meanInner = Core.mean(gray, inner).`val`[0]
            val meanRing = Core.mean(gray, ring).`val`[0]
            val diff = abs(meanInner - meanRing)
            (diff / 50.0).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
        } finally {
            inner.release()
            outer.release()
            ring.release()
            poly.release()
            kernel.release()
        }
    }

    private fun centerScore(p: List<Point>, w: Int, h: Int): Double {
        val cx = p.sumOf { it.x } / 4.0
        val cy = p.sumOf { it.y } / 4.0
        val dx = (cx - w / 2.0) / (w / 2.0)
        val dy = (cy - h / 2.0) / (h / 2.0)
        return (1.0 - sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / 1.414).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
    }

    private fun borderPenalty(p: List<Point>, w: Int, h: Int): Double {
        val m = min(w, h) * 0.025
        return p.count { it.x < m || it.y < m || it.x > w - m || it.y > h - m } / 4.0
    }

    private fun refineQuadWithFitLine(pts: List<Point>, edgeMask: Mat): List<Point> {
        if (pts.size != 4) return pts
        val cols = edgeMask.cols()
        val rows = edgeMask.rows()

        data class LineEq(val a: Double, val b: Double, val c: Double)

        val lines = mutableListOf<LineEq>()
        val byteData = ByteArray(cols * rows)
        edgeMask.get(0, 0, byteData)

        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            val p1 = pts[i]
            val p2 = pts[(i + 1) % 4]
            val dx = p2.x - p1.x
            val dy = p2.y - p1.y
            val len = hypot(dx, dy)
            if (len < 10.0) {
                val a = -dy
                val b = dx
                val c = -(a * p1.x + b * p1.y)
                lines.add(LineEq(a, b, c))
                continue
            }
            val tx = dx / len
            val ty = dy / len
            val nx = -ty
            val ny = tx

            val edgePoints = mutableListOf<Point>()
            var s = 0.05 * len
            while (s <= 0.95 * len) {
                val mx = p1.x + tx * s
                val my = p1.y + ty * s
                for (k in -5..5) {
                    val qx = (mx + nx * k).roundToInt()
                    val qy = (my + ny * k).roundToInt()
                    if (qx in 0 until cols && qy in 0 until rows) {
                        if (byteData[qy * cols + qx].toInt() != 0) {
                            edgePoints.add(Point(qx.toDouble(), qy.toDouble()))
                        }
                    }
                }
                s += 2.0
            }

            if (edgePoints.size >= 15) {
                val ptsMat = MatOfPoint2f(*edgePoints.toTypedArray())
                val lineMat = Mat()
                try {
                    Imgproc.fitLine(ptsMat, lineMat, Imgproc.DIST_L2, 0.0, 0.01, 0.01)
                    val vx = lineMat.get(0, 0)[0]
                    val vy = lineMat.get(1, 0)[0]
                    val x0 = lineMat.get(2, 0)[0]
                    val y0 = lineMat.get(3, 0)[0]
                    val a = -vy
                    val b = vx
                    val c = vy * x0 - vx * y0
                    lines.add(LineEq(a, b, c))
                } finally {
                    ptsMat.release()
                    lineMat.release()
                }
            } else {
                val a = -dy
                val b = dx
                val c = -(a * p1.x + b * p1.y)
                lines.add(LineEq(a, b, c))
            }
        }

        fun intersect(l1: LineEq, l2: LineEq): Point? {
            val det = l1.a * l2.b - l2.a * l1.b
            if (abs(det) < 1e-5) return null
            val x = (l1.b * l2.c - l2.b * l1.c) / det
            val y = (l2.a * l1.c - l1.a * l2.c) / det
            return Point(x, y)
        }

        val refined = mutableListOf<Point>()
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            val lPrev = lines[(i + 3) % 4]
            val lCur = lines[i]
            val pt = intersect(lPrev, lCur)
            if (pt == null || dist(pt, pts[i]) > max(20.0, 0.15 * dist(pts[i], pts[(i + 1) % 4]))) {
                return pts
            }
            refined.add(pt)
        }

        if (!isConvex(refined)) return pts
        return orderCorners(refined.toTypedArray()) ?: pts
    }

    private fun houghLinesFallback(edgeMask: Mat, gray: Mat, frameArea: Double): Candidate? {
        val linesMat = Mat()
        return try {
            Imgproc.HoughLinesP(edgeMask, linesMat, 1.0, Math.PI / 180.0, 35, 30.0, 10.0)
            if (linesMat.rows() < 4) return null
            val w = edgeMask.cols()
            val h = edgeMask.rows()

            data class Segment(val x1: Double, val y1: Double, val x2: Double, val y2: Double, val len: Double, val angle: Double)

            val hLines = mutableListOf<Segment>()
            val vLines = mutableListOf<Segment>()

            for (i in 0 until min(linesMat.rows(), 80)) {
                val vec = linesMat.get(i, 0) ?: continue
                val x1 = vec[0]
                val y1 = vec[1]
                val x2 = vec[2]
                val y2 = vec[3]
                val dx = x2 - x1
                val dy = y2 - y1
                val len = hypot(dx, dy)
                if (len < 25.0) continue
                val angle = abs(atan2(dy, dx) * 180.0 / Math.PI)
                if (angle < 25.0 || angle > 155.0) {
                    hLines.add(Segment(x1, y1, x2, y2, len, angle))
                } else if (angle in 65.0..115.0) {
                    vLines.add(Segment(x1, y1, x2, y2, len, angle))
                }
            }

            if (hLines.size < 2 || vLines.size < 2) return null

            val top = hLines.minByOrNull { min(it.y1, it.y2) } ?: return null
            val bottom = hLines.maxByOrNull { max(it.y1, it.y2) } ?: return null
            val left = vLines.minByOrNull { min(it.x1, it.x2) } ?: return null
            val right = vLines.maxByOrNull { max(it.x1, it.x2) } ?: return null

            fun lineIntersect(s1: Segment, s2: Segment): Point? {
                val a1 = -(s1.y2 - s1.y1)
                val b1 = s1.x2 - s1.x1
                val c1 = -(a1 * s1.x1 + b1 * s1.y1)
                val a2 = -(s2.y2 - s2.y1)
                val b2 = s2.x2 - s2.x1
                val c2 = -(a2 * s2.x1 + b2 * s2.y1)
                val det = a1 * b2 - a2 * b1
                if (abs(det) < 1e-4) return null
                val x = (b1 * c2 - b2 * c1) / det
                val y = (a2 * c1 - a1 * c2) / det
                return Point(x, y)
            }

            val pTL = lineIntersect(top, left) ?: return null
            val pTR = lineIntersect(top, right) ?: return null
            val pBR = lineIntersect(bottom, right) ?: return null
            val pBL = lineIntersect(bottom, left) ?: return null

            val rawPts = arrayOf(pTL, pTR, pBR, pBL)
            val ordered = orderCorners(rawPts) ?: return null
            if (!isConvex(ordered)) return null

            val sc = scoreQuad(ordered, gray, edgeMask, frameArea)
            if (sc != null && sc >= 0.40) Candidate(ordered, sc) else null
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            null
        } finally {
            linesMat.release()
        }
    }

    @Volatile private var loaded = false
}

package app.docscan.android

import kotlin.math.*

enum class DocumentQuadFilterMode { LEGACY_EMA, TIME_EMA, ONE_EURO }

/** Filters observed pixel coordinates; ONE_EURO is also the production live filter. No prediction. */
class DocumentQuadFilter(private val mode:DocumentQuadFilterMode) {
    private var filtered:FloatArray?=null
    private var measured:FloatArray?=null
    private var derivative=FloatArray(8)
    private var timestampMs:Long?=null
    fun reset() { filtered=null; measured=null; timestampMs=null; derivative=FloatArray(8) }
    fun update(quad:BoundaryQuad,nowMs:Long):BoundaryQuad {
        val p=quad.toFloatArray(); val old=filtered; val previous=measured; val time=timestampMs
        if(old!=null && time!=null && nowMs<=time) return BoundaryQuad.from(old)
        if(old==null || previous==null || time==null || nowMs-time>300) {
            filtered=p; measured=p.clone(); timestampMs=nowMs; derivative=FloatArray(8); return quad
        }
        val shift=(0..3).minByOrNull { offset -> (0..3).sumOf { i ->
            val j=(i+offset)%4; hypot((previous[i*2]-p[j*2]).toDouble(),(previous[i*2+1]-p[j*2+1]).toDouble()) } } ?: 0
        val current=FloatArray(8) { i -> p[((i/2+shift)%4)*2+i%2] }
        val dt=(nowMs-time)/1000.0
        fun alpha(cutoff:Double)=1.0/(1.0+1.0/(2*PI*cutoff*dt))
        val derivativeAlpha=alpha(1.0)
        for(i in current.indices) {
            val velocity=(current[i]-previous[i])/dt
            derivative[i]=(derivative[i]+derivativeAlpha*(velocity-derivative[i])).toFloat()
        }
        val diagonal=max(max(hypot((current[4]-current[0]).toDouble(),(current[5]-current[1]).toDouble()),
            hypot((current[6]-current[2]).toDouble(),(current[7]-current[3]).toDouble())),1.0)
        val speed=(0 until 4).maxOf { i ->
            hypot(derivative[i*2].toDouble(),derivative[i*2+1].toDouble())
        }/diagonal
        val displacement=current.indices.maxOf { abs(current[it]-previous[it]).toDouble() }/diagonal
        val a=when(mode) {
            DocumentQuadFilterMode.LEGACY_EMA -> when { displacement<0.015 -> 0.18; displacement<0.04 -> 0.30; else -> 0.50 }
            DocumentQuadFilterMode.TIME_EMA -> 1-exp(-dt/0.12)
            DocumentQuadFilterMode.ONE_EURO -> alpha((0.8+40.0*speed).coerceAtMost(30.0))
        }
        val proposed=FloatArray(8) { i -> (old[i]+a*(current[i]-old[i])).toFloat() }
        val valid=try { BoundaryQuad.from(proposed) } catch(_:IllegalArgumentException) { quad }
        filtered=valid.toFloatArray(); measured=current; timestampMs=nowMs
        return valid
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.util.Log
import org.opencv.core.Core
import org.opencv.core.CvType
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.core.MatOfByte
import org.opencv.core.MatOfInt
import org.opencv.core.MatOfPoint
import org.opencv.core.MatOfPoint2f
import org.opencv.core.Point
import org.opencv.core.Size
import org.opencv.dnn.Dnn
import org.opencv.dnn.Net
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import kotlin.math.max

/**
 * Document segmentation network (assets/doc_seg.onnx, MobileNetV3 LRASPP trained on synthetic + real photos,
 * see tools/ml) run through OpenCV dnn. Returns the document quadrilateral in source buffer pixels.
 * Used by the live frame and, later, by still capture, so both show the same boundary.
 */
internal class DocumentSegmenter private constructor(private val net: Net) {

    class Result(
        /** TL, TR, BR, BL in the pixels of the buffer that was passed in (8 floats). */
        val bufferPoints: FloatArray,
        /** 0..1, mean mask probability weighted by how much of the mask the main component holds. */
        val confidence: Double,
        /** Sigmoid probabilities [MODEL_SIZE x MODEL_SIZE] in the upright model frame, for photometry reuse. */
        val probabilities: FloatArray,
    )

    /** [rgba] is the analyzer buffer (RGBA, any size); [rotationDegrees] rotates it upright (0/90/180/270). */
    fun segment(rgba: Mat, rotationDegrees: Int): Result? {
        val rgb = Mat()
        val upright = Mat()
        val small = Mat()
        try {
            Imgproc.cvtColor(rgba, rgb, Imgproc.COLOR_RGBA2RGB)
            val rotateCode = when (((rotationDegrees % 360) + 360) % 360) {
                90 -> Core.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE
                180 -> Core.ROTATE_180
                270 -> Core.ROTATE_90_COUNTERCLOCKWISE
                else -> -1
            }
            if (rotateCode >= 0) Core.rotate(rgb, upright, rotateCode) else rgb.copyTo(upright)
            Imgproc.resize(upright, small, Size(MODEL_SIZE.toDouble(), MODEL_SIZE.toDouble()), 0.0, 0.0, Imgproc.INTER_AREA)
            val blob = Dnn.blobFromImage(small, 1.0 / 255.0, Size(MODEL_SIZE.toDouble(), MODEL_SIZE.toDouble()),
                org.opencv.core.Scalar(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), false, false)
            val logits: Mat
            synchronized(net) {
                net.setInput(blob)
                logits = net.forward()
            }
            blob.release()
            val prob = FloatArray(MODEL_SIZE * MODEL_SIZE)
            val flat = logits.reshape(1, 1)
            flat.get(0, 0, prob)
            logits.release()
            for (i in prob.indices) prob[i] = (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-prob[i].toDouble()))).toFloat()
            val quad = maskToQuad(prob) ?: return null
            // model frame -> upright buffer -> original buffer
            val uw = upright.cols().toFloat()
            val uh = upright.rows().toFloat()
            val pts = FloatArray(8)
            for (i in 0 until 4) {
                val ux = quad.points[i * 2] * uw / MODEL_SIZE
                val uy = quad.points[i * 2 + 1] * uh / MODEL_SIZE
                val (ox, oy) = uprightToOriginal(ux, uy, rgba.cols(), rgba.rows(), rotationDegrees)
                pts[i * 2] = ox.coerceIn(0f, rgba.cols() - 1f)
                pts[i * 2 + 1] = oy.coerceIn(0f, rgba.rows() - 1f)
            }
            return Result(pts, quad.confidence, prob)
        } finally {
            rgb.release(); upright.release(); small.release()
        }
    }

    private class Quad(val points: FloatArray, val confidence: Double)

    companion object {
        const val MODEL_SIZE = 256
        const val ASSET = "doc_seg.onnx"
        private const val MIN_AREA_FRACTION = 0.04
        private const val TAG = "DocScan"

        /** Null when the asset is absent or OpenCV dnn cannot load it; callers fall back to the classical detector. */
        fun load(context: Context): DocumentSegmenter? = try {
            DocumentPreviewDetector.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
            val bytes = context.assets.open(ASSET).use { it.readBytes() }
            val mob = MatOfByte(*bytes)
            val net = Dnn.readNetFromONNX(mob)
            mob.release()
            DocumentSegmenter(net)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Document segmenter unavailable: ${failure.message}")
            null
        }

        private fun uprightToOriginal(x: Float, y: Float, w: Int, h: Int, rotation: Int): Pair<Float, Float> =
            when (((rotation % 360) + 360) % 360) {
                90 -> Pair(y, h - 1 - x)            // upright (rotated clockwise) back to the original
                180 -> Pair(w - 1 - x, h - 1 - y)
                270 -> Pair(w - 1 - y, x)
                else -> Pair(x, y)
            }

        /** Mirrors tools/ml/quad.py. Points are in model pixels. */
        private fun maskToQuad(prob: FloatArray): Quad? {
            val size = MODEL_SIZE
            val binary = Mat(size, size, CvType.CV_8UC1)
            val bytes = ByteArray(size * size) { if (prob[it] > 0.5f) 1 else 0 }
            binary.put(0, 0, bytes)
            val labels = Mat()
            val stats = Mat()
            val centroids = Mat()
            val component = Mat()
            val contours = ArrayList<MatOfPoint>()
            val hierarchy = Mat()
            val hullIdx = MatOfInt()
            try {
                val n = Imgproc.connectedComponentsWithStats(binary, labels, stats, centroids, 8)
                if (n <= 1) return null
                var best = 1
                var bestArea = -1
                var total = 0
                for (i in 1 until n) {
                    val a = stats.get(i, Imgproc.CC_STAT_AREA)[0].toInt()
                    total += a
                    if (a > bestArea) { bestArea = a; best = i }
                }
                if (bestArea < MIN_AREA_FRACTION * size * size) return null
                Core.compare(labels, org.opencv.core.Scalar(best.toDouble()), component, Core.CMP_EQ)
                Imgproc.findContours(component, contours, hierarchy, Imgproc.RETR_EXTERNAL, Imgproc.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
                val contour = contours.maxByOrNull { Imgproc.contourArea(it) } ?: return null
                Imgproc.convexHull(contour, hullIdx)
                val src = contour.toArray()
                val hull = MatOfPoint2f(*hullIdx.toArray().map { src[it] }.toTypedArray())
                val peri = Imgproc.arcLength(hull, true)
                var lo = 0.005 * peri
                var hi = 0.1 * peri
                var found: Array<Point>? = null
                repeat(14) {
                    val eps = (lo + hi) / 2
                    val approx = MatOfPoint2f()
                    Imgproc.approxPolyDP(hull, approx, eps, true)
                    val count = approx.total().toInt()
                    if (count == 4) { found = approx.toArray(); lo = eps } else if (count > 4) lo = eps else hi = eps
                    approx.release()
                }
                val corners = found ?: run {
                    val rect = Imgproc.minAreaRect(hull)
                    val pts = arrayOfNulls<Point>(4)
                    rect.points(pts)
                    pts.filterNotNull().toTypedArray()
                }
                hull.release()
                if (corners.size != 4) return null
                val ordered = refineToMask(order(corners), component)
                var sum = 0.0
                var count = 0
                val compBytes = ByteArray(size * size)
                component.get(0, 0, compBytes)
                for (i in compBytes.indices) if (compBytes[i].toInt() != 0) { sum += prob[i]; count++ }
                val confidence = (sum / max(1, count)) * (bestArea.toDouble() / max(1, total))
                return Quad(FloatArray(8) { i -> if (i % 2 == 0) ordered[i / 2].x.toFloat() else ordered[i / 2].y.toFloat() }, confidence)
            } finally {
                binary.release(); labels.release(); stats.release(); centroids.release(); component.release()
                hierarchy.release(); hullIdx.release(); contours.forEach { it.release() }
            }
        }

        /**
         * Coordinate descent on the four corners maximising IoU with the main mask component (mirrors tools/ml/quad.py).
         * A convex hull follows every spike of the mask; the best-IoU quad does not. Works at half resolution.
         */
        private fun refineToMask(start: List<Point>, component: Mat): List<Point> {
            val half = component.rows() / 2
            val small = Mat()
            Imgproc.resize(component, small, Size(half.toDouble(), half.toDouble()), 0.0, 0.0, Imgproc.INTER_NEAREST)
            val poly = Mat(half, half, CvType.CV_8UC1)
            val inter = Mat()
            val union = Mat()
            try {
                fun iou(q: List<Point>): Double {
                    poly.setTo(org.opencv.core.Scalar(0.0))
                    val pts = MatOfPoint(*q.map { Point(Math.round(it.x * 0.5 * 16.0).toDouble(), Math.round(it.y * 0.5 * 16.0).toDouble()) }.toTypedArray())
                    Imgproc.fillPoly(poly, listOf(pts), org.opencv.core.Scalar(255.0), Imgproc.LINE_8, 4, Point(0.0, 0.0))
                    pts.release()
                    Core.bitwise_and(poly, small, inter)
                    Core.bitwise_or(poly, small, union)
                    val u = Core.countNonZero(union)
                    return if (u == 0) 0.0 else Core.countNonZero(inter).toDouble() / u
                }
                fun descend(from: List<Point>): Pair<List<Point>, Double> {
                    var q = from.map { Point(it.x, it.y) }
                    var cur = iou(q)
                    val moves = arrayOf(1 to 0, -1 to 0, 0 to 1, 0 to -1, 1 to 1, -1 to -1, 1 to -1, -1 to 1)
                    for (step in intArrayOf(8, 4, 2, 1)) {
                        var improved = true
                        var guard = 0
                        while (improved && guard++ < 40) {
                            improved = false
                            for (i in 0 until 4) for ((dx, dy) in moves) {
                                val t = q.mapIndexed { j, p -> if (j == i) Point(p.x + dx * step, p.y + dy * step) else p }
                                val v = iou(t)
                                if (v > cur + 1e-4) { q = t; cur = v; improved = true }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return q to cur
                }
                var (best, bestIou) = descend(start)
                if (bestIou < 0.92) {
                    val cnts = ArrayList<MatOfPoint>()
                    val h = Mat()
                    Imgproc.findContours(component.clone(), cnts, h, Imgproc.RETR_EXTERNAL, Imgproc.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
                    val biggest = cnts.maxByOrNull { Imgproc.contourArea(it) }
                    if (biggest != null) {
                        val rect = Imgproc.minAreaRect(MatOfPoint2f(*biggest.toArray()))
                        val rp = arrayOfNulls<Point>(4)
                        rect.points(rp)
                        val (alt, altIou) = descend(order(rp.filterNotNull().toTypedArray()))
                        if (altIou > bestIou) { best = alt; bestIou = altIou }
                    }
                    h.release(); cnts.forEach { it.release() }
                }
                return order(best.toTypedArray())
            } finally {
                small.release(); poly.release(); inter.release(); union.release()
            }
        }

        private fun order(p: Array<Point>): List<Point> {
            val tl = p.minByOrNull { it.x + it.y }!!
            val br = p.maxByOrNull { it.x + it.y }!!
            val tr = p.minByOrNull { it.y - it.x }!!
            val bl = p.maxByOrNull { it.y - it.x }!!
            return listOf(tl, tr, br, bl)
        }
    }
}
