/** Cloud work belongs to the Application; dialogs never retain a destroyed Activity. */
internal class FamilyDocsUi(activity: ProductActivity, private val service: FamilyDocsService) {
    private val activity = WeakReference(activity)
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private fun post(action: (ProductActivity) -> Unit) {
        handler.post { activity.get()?.takeUnless { it.isFinishing || it.isDestroyed }?.let(action) }
    }
    private fun notice(message: String) = post { Toast.makeText(it, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() }
    private fun detail(failure: Exception) = failure.message
        ?.takeIf { it.any { c -> c in 'А'..'я' || c == 'ё' || c == 'Ё' } }
        ?.takeUnless { it.contains("ds_") || it.contains("Bearer ") || it.contains("https://") }
        ?: "Не удалось выполнить действие Docs. Локальные PDF сохранены."

    private fun dp(a: ProductActivity, value: Int) = (value * a.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
    private fun surface(a: ProductActivity, fill: Int = WHITE, stroke: Boolean = true) = GradientDrawable().apply {
        setColor(fill)
        cornerRadius = dp(a, 10).toFloat()
        if (stroke) setStroke(dp(a, 1), BORDER)
    }
    private fun body(a: ProductActivity) = LinearLayout(a).apply {
        orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        setPadding(dp(a, 20), dp(a, 8), dp(a, 20), dp(a, 10))
        setBackgroundColor(WHITE)
    }
    private fun label(a: ProductActivity, text: String, hint: Boolean = false) = TextView(a).apply {
        this.text = text
        textSize = if (hint) 12f else 13f
        setTextColor(if (hint) MUTED else SLATE)
        setPadding(0, dp(a, if (hint) 4 else 12), 0, dp(a, 6))
    }
    private fun action(a: ProductActivity, text: String, tagName: String? = null, click: () -> Unit) = Button(a).apply {
        this.text = text
        tag = tagName
        isAllCaps = false
        textSize = 14f
        typeface = Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.NORMAL)
        minHeight = dp(a, 48)
        minimumHeight = dp(a, 48)
        minWidth = 0
        setTextColor(BLUE)
        backgroundTintList = null
        background = RippleDrawable(ColorStateList.valueOf(0x22487DB8), surface(a, SOFT), null)
        setPadding(dp(a, 12), dp(a, 6), dp(a, 12), dp(a, 6))
        setOnClickListener { click() }
    }
    private fun row(a: ProductActivity) = LinearLayout(a).apply {
        orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
    }
    private fun heading(a: ProductActivity, text: String) = label(a, text).apply {
        textSize = 18f
        typeface = Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.NORMAL)
        setPadding(dp(a, 20), dp(a, 18), dp(a, 20), dp(a, 8))
    }
    private fun show(a: ProductActivity, dialog: AlertDialog) {
        dialog.show()
        listOf(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE, AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEGATIVE, AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEUTRAL).forEach { which ->
            dialog.getButton(which)?.apply { setTextColor(BLUE); isAllCaps = false; minHeight = dp(a, 48) }
        }
    }
    private fun options(a: ProductActivity, values: List<String>) = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(a, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, values) {
        override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View = text(position, parent, false)
        override fun getDropDownView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View = text(position, parent, true)
        private fun text(position: Int, parent: ViewGroup, dropdown: Boolean) = TextView(a).apply {
            setText(getItem(position))
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(if (position == 0) MUTED else SLATE)
            minHeight = dp(a, 48)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(dp(a, 10), dp(a, 6), dp(a, 10), dp(a, 6))
            if (dropdown) setBackgroundColor(WHITE) else { maxLines = 1; ellipsize = android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END }
        }
    }
    private fun select(a: ProductActivity, values: List<String>, description: String) = Spinner(a).apply {
        adapter = options(a, values)
        contentDescription = description
        minimumHeight = dp(a, 48)
        background = surface(a)
        setPopupBackgroundDrawable(surface(a))
    }

    fun menu(storage: ProductStorage?, pendingExportId: ExportArtifactId? = null, pendingName: String? = null): Unit = service.execute {
        try {
            val identity = service.client.connected()
            val entries = service.outbox.entries().filter { identity != null && it.familyId == identity.familyId && it.memberId == identity.memberId }
            post { a ->
                val content = body(a)
                content.addView(label(a, if (identity == null) "Подключите DocScan по коду из FamilyTodoList → Docs → Сканер." else "${identity.displayName} · Ожидают: ${entries.count { !it.ready }} · Сохранены: ${entries.count { it.ready }}", hint = true))
                val dialog = a.familyDocsDialogBuilder().setCustomTitle(heading(a, "Docs · FamilyTodoList"))
                    .setView(ScrollView(a).apply { addView(content) }).setNegativeButton("Закрыть", null).create()
                fun add(text: String, tag: String, click: () -> Unit) {
                    content.addView(action(a, text, tag, click), LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { topMargin = dp(a, 8) })
                }
                add(if (identity == null) "Подключить сканер" else "Подключить другой аккаунт", "family-docs-connect") {
                    dialog.dismiss()
                    connect {
                        if (storage != null && pendingExportId != null) offerExport(storage, pendingExportId, pendingName)
                        else menu(storage)
                    }
                }
                if (identity != null) {
                    add("Сохранённые PDF → Docs", "family-docs-saved") { dialog.dismiss(); saved(storage) }
                    add("Повторить отправку очереди", "family-docs-retry") { service.retryAll(::notice) }
                    add("Отключить сканер", "family-docs-disconnect") {
                        service.execute {
                            try {
                                service.client.disconnect()
                                notice("Сканер отключён. Очередь и локальные PDF сохранены.")
                            } catch (_: Exception) {
                                notice("Сканер отключён на устройстве. Проверьте отзыв доступа в FamilyTodoList → Docs → Сканер. Очередь сохранена.")
                            }
                            post { dialog.dismiss() }
                        }
                    }
                }
                entries.filter { !it.ready }.take(20).forEach { entry ->
                    content.addView(label(a, "${entry.metadata.optString("title")} · ${if (entry.error == null) "Ожидает отправки" else "Нужно повторить"}", hint = true))
                }
                show(a, dialog)
            }
        } catch (failure: Exception) { notice(detail(failure)) }
    }

    fun connect(onConnected: () -> Unit): Unit = post { a ->
        val code = EditText(a).apply {
            hint = "familydocs:…"
            setSingleLine(true)
            inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT or InputType.TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_NO_SUGGESTIONS
            tag = "family-docs-pair-code"
            contentDescription = "Код подключения Docs"
            setTextColor(SLATE); setHintTextColor(MUTED)
            background = surface(a)
            minHeight = dp(a, 48)
            setPadding(dp(a, 10), dp(a, 8), dp(a, 10), dp(a, 8))
            importantForAutofill = View.IMPORTANT_FOR_AUTOFILL_NO
            isSaveEnabled = false
        }
        val state = label(a, "FamilyTodoList → Docs → Сканер → Создать код подключения. Одноразовый код действует 10 минут.", hint = true)
        val content = body(a).apply { addView(state); addView(code) }
        val dialog = a.familyDocsDialogBuilder().setCustomTitle(heading(a, "Подключить FamilyTodoList"))
            .setView(content).setNegativeButton("Отмена", null).setPositiveButton("Подключить", null).create()
        dialog.setOnDismissListener { code.text?.clear() }
        dialog.setOnShowListener {
            dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).setOnClickListener {
                dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).isEnabled = false
                dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEGATIVE).isEnabled = false
                dialog.setCancelable(false)
                code.isEnabled = false
                state.text = "Подключаем…"
                val ticket = code.text.toString()
                service.execute {
                    try {
                        val identity = service.client.pair(ticket)
                        post { dialog.dismiss(); onConnected() }
                        notice("Подключено: ${identity.displayName}")
                        service.retryAll(::notice)
                    } catch (failure: Exception) {
                        post {
                            if (dialog.isShowing) {
                                state.text = detail(failure)
                                dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).isEnabled = true
                                dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEGATIVE).isEnabled = true
                                dialog.setCancelable(true)
                                code.isEnabled = true
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        show(a, dialog)
    }

    private fun saved(storage: ProductStorage?) {
        if (storage == null) { notice("Хранилище ещё загружается."); return }
        service.execute {
            try {
                val available = linkedMapOf<ExportArtifactId, String>()
                storage.recentDocuments().forEach { available[it.exportArtifactId] = it.displayName }
                storage.incompleteExternalExportPackages().forEach { available.putIfAbsent(it.exportArtifactId, it.commonBasename + ".pdf") }
                post { a ->
                    if (available.isEmpty()) notice("Сначала сохраните PDF локально.") else {
                        val entries = available.entries.toList()
                        val content = body(a)
                        val dialog = a.familyDocsDialogBuilder().setCustomTitle(heading(a, "Сохранённые PDF")).setView(ScrollView(a).apply { addView(content) }).setNegativeButton("Отмена", null).create()
                        entries.forEach { entry -> content.addView(action(a, entry.value) { dialog.dismiss(); offerExport(storage, entry.key, entry.value) }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { topMargin = dp(a, 8) }) }
                        show(a, dialog)
                    }
                }
            } catch (failure: Exception) { notice(detail(failure)) }
        }
    }

    fun offerExport(storage: ProductStorage, exportId: ExportArtifactId, displayName: String? = null): Unit = service.execute {
        try {
            val identity = service.client.connected()
            if (identity == null) { menu(storage, exportId, displayName); return@execute }
            val previous = service.outbox.entries().firstOrNull { it.sourceExportId == exportId.value && it.familyId == identity.familyId && it.memberId == identity.memberId }
            if (previous != null) { if (previous.ready) notice("Этот PDF уже сохранён в Docs.") else service.retryAll(::notice); return@execute }
            val pdf = storage.committedExportOutputs(exportId).singleOrNull { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" } ?: error("Нет подтверждённого локального PDF.")
            check(storage.verifyExportOutput(pdf)) { "Локальный PDF не прошёл проверку. Отправка не начата." }
            require(pdf.sizeBytes <= FamilyDocsOutbox.MAX_PDF) { "PDF сохранён локально. Для Docs поддерживаются файлы до 10 МБ." }
            val source = storage.exportOutputFile(pdf)
            val name = displayName ?: storage.externalExportPackage(exportId)?.outputs?.firstOrNull()?.displayName ?: "Scan.pdf"
            notice("Загружаем каталог Docs…")
            val me = service.client.me(identity)
            check(me.getString("family_id") == identity.familyId && me.getJSONObject("member").getString("id") == identity.memberId) { "Подключение Docs изменилось." }
            val nodes = service.client.catalogue(identity)
            post { a ->
                form(a, identity, me.getJSONArray("members"), nodes, name) { metadata, done ->
                    service.execute {
                        try {
                            val current = service.client.connected()
                            check(current?.token == identity.token && current.familyId == identity.familyId && current.memberId == identity.memberId) { "Подключение Docs изменилось. PDF не отправлен." }
                            val entry = service.outbox.enqueue(exportId.value, source, pdf.sizeBytes, pdf.sha256, metadata, identity)
                            post { done(true, "PDF добавлен в очередь. Локальный файл сохранён.") }
                            service.upload(entry.id) { result -> result.onSuccess { notice("PDF сохранён в Docs во всех выбранных папках.") }.onFailure { notice(detail(it as? Exception ?: Exception("Сбой Docs"))) } }
                        } catch (failure: Exception) { post { done(false, detail(failure)) } }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (failure: Exception) { notice(detail(failure)) }
    }

    /** Called only after the immutable local export committed, following explicit Save. */
    fun enqueueInline(storage: ProductStorage, exportId: ExportArtifactId, draft: FamilyDocsSaveDraft) {
        try {
            val current = service.client.connected()
            check(current?.token == draft.identity.token && current.familyId == draft.identity.familyId && current.memberId == draft.identity.memberId) {
                "Подключение Docs изменилось. PDF сохранён локально; выберите его в Docs повторно."
            }
            val pdf = storage.committedExportOutputs(exportId).singleOrNull { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
                ?: error("Нет подтверждённого локального PDF.")
            check(storage.verifyExportOutput(pdf)) { "Локальный PDF не прошёл проверку. Отправка не начата." }
            val entry = service.outbox.enqueue(exportId.value, storage.exportOutputFile(pdf), pdf.sizeBytes, pdf.sha256,
                draft.metadata, draft.identity, draft.workflow)
            notice("PDF добавлен в очередь Docs.")
            service.upload(entry.id) { result ->
                result.onSuccess { notice("PDF и выбранные связи сохранены в Docs.") }
                    .onFailure { notice(detail(it as? Exception ?: Exception("Сбой Docs"))) }
            }
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            notice(detail(failure) + " Можно повторить из списка сохранённых PDF → Docs.")
        }
    }

    private fun form(a: ProductActivity, identity: FamilyDocsIdentity, members: JSONArray, nodes: JSONArray, name: String, save: (JSONObject, (Boolean, String) -> Unit) -> Unit) {
        val content = body(a)
        fun field(parent: LinearLayout, text: String, value: String = "", multiline: Boolean = false, date: Boolean = false): EditText {
            parent.addView(label(a, text))
            return EditText(a).apply {
                setText(value); contentDescription = text
                isSingleLine = !multiline
                textSize = 15f
                setTextColor(SLATE); setHintTextColor(MUTED)
                hint = if (date) "ГГГГ-ММ-ДД" else ""
                inputType = if (date) InputType.TYPE_CLASS_DATETIME or InputType.TYPE_DATETIME_VARIATION_DATE else InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT or if (multiline) InputType.TYPE_TEXT_FLAG_MULTI_LINE else 0
                filters = arrayOf(android.text.InputFilter.LengthFilter(if (multiline) 4000 else if (date) 10 else 200))
                background = surface(a)
                minHeight = dp(a, if (multiline) 68 else 48)
                setPadding(dp(a, 10), dp(a, 9), dp(a, 10), dp(a, 9))
                parent.addView(this, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))
            }
        }
        val filename = field(content, "Имя PDF", if (name.endsWith(".pdf", true)) name else "$name.pdf")
        val title = field(content, "Название документа", name.substringBeforeLast('.', name))
        content.addView(label(a, "Категории и объекты"))
        content.addView(label(a, "В каждой выбранной папке будет отдельная копия PDF.", hint = true))
        val destinations = LinearLayout(a).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
        content.addView(destinations)
        val all = (0 until nodes.length()).map { nodes.getJSONObject(it) }
        val byId = all.associateBy { it.getString("id") }
        val roots = all.filter { it.isNull("parent_id") }.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.optInt("position") }, { it.getString("title") }))
        val leaves = all.filter { node -> all.none { it.optString("parent_id") == node.getString("id") } }
        fun rootOf(node: JSONObject): String {
            var current = node
            repeat(8) { byId[current.optString("parent_id")]?.let { current = it } }
            return current.getString("id")
        }
        fun relativePath(node: JSONObject): String {
            val parts = mutableListOf(node.getString("title"))
            var parent = byId[node.optString("parent_id")]
            repeat(8) {
                val ancestor = parent
                if (ancestor != null) {
                    if (!ancestor.isNull("parent_id")) parts.add(0, ancestor.getString("title"))
                    parent = byId[ancestor.optString("parent_id")]
                }
            }
            return parts.joinToString(" · ")
        }
        class Destination(val index: Int) { var nodeId: String? = null }
        val rows = mutableListOf<Destination>()
        lateinit var addDestination: Button
        fun addRow() {
            if (rows.size >= 5) return
            val value = Destination((rows.maxOfOrNull { it.index } ?: -1) + 1)
            rows.add(value)
            val line = row(a)
            val category = select(a, listOf("Категория") + roots.map { it.getString("title") }, "Категория ${value.index + 1}").apply { tag = "family-docs-category-${value.index}" }
            val target = select(a, listOf("Объект / раздел"), "Объект или раздел ${value.index + 1}").apply { tag = "family-docs-node-${value.index}"; isEnabled = false }
            line.addView(category, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, .85f))
            line.addView(target, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1.15f).apply { marginStart = dp(a, 6) })
            val remove = action(a, "×") { rows.remove(value); destinations.removeView(line); addDestination.isEnabled = rows.size < 5 }
            remove.contentDescription = "Удалить назначение ${value.index + 1}"
            line.addView(remove, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(a, 48), dp(a, 48)).apply { marginStart = dp(a, 6) })
            var choices = emptyList<JSONObject>()
            target.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
                override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) { value.nodeId = choices.getOrNull(position - 1)?.getString("id") }
                override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) { value.nodeId = null }
            }
            category.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
                override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                    value.nodeId = null
                    val chosenRoot = roots.getOrNull(position - 1)
                    choices = if (chosenRoot == null) emptyList() else leaves.filter { rootOf(it) == chosenRoot.getString("id") }.sortedBy(::relativePath)
                    target.adapter = options(a, listOf("Объект / раздел") + choices.map(::relativePath))
                    target.isEnabled = choices.isNotEmpty()
                    target.setSelection(0)
                }
                override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) { value.nodeId = null }
            }
            destinations.addView(line, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(a, 8) })
            addDestination.isEnabled = rows.size < 5
        }
        addDestination = action(a, "＋ Ещё папка", "family-docs-add-destination") { addRow() }
        content.addView(addDestination, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))
        addRow()

        val owners = mutableListOf("" to "Общие")
        (0 until members.length()).forEach { index -> members.getJSONObject(index).let { owners += it.getString("id") to it.optString("display_name", "Участник") } }
        if (owners.none { it.first == identity.memberId }) owners += identity.memberId to identity.displayName
        content.addView(label(a, "Владелец и доступ"))
        val ownerRow = row(a)
        val owner = select(a, owners.map { it.second }, "Владелец Docs").apply { tag = "family-docs-owner" }
        ownerRow.addView(owner, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f))
        var previousOwner = 0
        val privacy = CheckBox(a).apply {
            text = "🔒 Private"
            tag = "family-docs-private"
            contentDescription = "Private. Вижу только я"
            textSize = 14f; setTextColor(SLATE)
            buttonTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(BLUE)
            minimumHeight = dp(a, 48)
            setPadding(dp(a, 8), 0, 0, 0)
            setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checked ->
                if (checked) { previousOwner = owner.selectedItemPosition; owner.setSelection(owners.indexOfFirst { it.first == identity.memberId }) }
                else owner.setSelection(previousOwner)
                owner.isEnabled = !checked
            }
        }
        ownerRow.addView(privacy, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-2, -2))
        content.addView(ownerRow)
        content.addView(label(a, "Private видите только вы, включая название и содержимое.", hint = true))
        val dateRow = row(a)
        val dateColumn = LinearLayout(a).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
        val expiryColumn = LinearLayout(a).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
        dateRow.addView(dateColumn, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f))
        dateRow.addView(expiryColumn, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f).apply { marginStart = dp(a, 10) })
        content.addView(dateRow)
        val date = field(dateColumn, "Дата документа", date = true)
        val expiry = field(expiryColumn, "Действует до", date = true)
        val note = field(content, "Примечание", multiline = true)
        val feedback = label(a, "", hint = true).apply { accessibilityLiveRegion = View.ACCESSIBILITY_LIVE_REGION_POLITE }
        content.addView(feedback)
        val dialog = a.familyDocsDialogBuilder().setCustomTitle(heading(a, "Сохранить в Docs"))
            .setView(ScrollView(a).apply { addView(content) }).setNegativeButton("Позже", null).setPositiveButton("Сохранить в Docs", null).create()
        dialog.setOnShowListener {
            dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).setOnClickListener {
                val selected = rows.mapNotNull { it.nodeId }
                if (selected.isEmpty() || selected.size != rows.size) { feedback.text = "Выберите категорию и объект или раздел для каждой папки."; return@setOnClickListener }
                if (selected.distinct().size != selected.size) { feedback.text = "Одна папка выбрана дважды. Удалите повторное назначение."; return@setOnClickListener }
                if (title.text.isBlank() || filename.text.isBlank()) { feedback.text = "Укажите название и имя PDF."; return@setOnClickListener }
                if (listOf(date.text.toString(), expiry.text.toString()).any { value -> value.isNotBlank() && runCatching { java.time.LocalDate.parse(value).year in 1900..2100 }.getOrDefault(false).not() }) { feedback.text = "Дата должна быть в формате ГГГГ-ММ-ДД."; return@setOnClickListener }
                val fileName = filename.text.toString().trim().let { if (it.endsWith(".pdf", true)) it else it.take(196) + ".pdf" }
                if (fileName.any { it == '/' || it == '\\' || it.code < 32 || it.code == 127 } || title.text.any { it.code < 32 || it.code == 127 }) { feedback.text = "Название и имя PDF содержат недопустимые символы."; return@setOnClickListener }
                val metadata = JSONObject().put("title", title.text.toString().trim()).put("original_filename", fileName).put("node_ids", JSONArray(selected))
                    .put("owner_member_id", if (privacy.isChecked) identity.memberId else owners[owner.selectedItemPosition].first.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("visibility", if (privacy.isChecked) "private" else "family").put("doc_date", date.text.toString().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                    .put("expires_at", expiry.text.toString().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: JSONObject.NULL).put("note", note.text.toString())
                dialog.setCancelable(false)
                dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).isEnabled = false
                dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEGATIVE).isEnabled = false
                feedback.text = "Сохраняем снимок в очередь…"
                save(metadata) { success, message ->
                    if (dialog.isShowing) {
                        feedback.text = message
                        if (success) dialog.dismiss() else {
                            dialog.setCancelable(true)
                            dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).isEnabled = true
                            dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEGATIVE).isEnabled = true
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        show(a, dialog)
    }

    companion object {
        private val WHITE = 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt()
        private val SLATE = 0xFF46566B.toInt()
        private val MUTED = 0xFF8A98AB.toInt()
        private val BORDER = 0xFFDCE3EB.toInt()
        private val SOFT = 0xFFF1F6FB.toInt()

    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import org.json.JSONArray

internal class FilePrefixPreferences(context: Context) {
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun getPrefixes(): List<String> {
        val rawJson = prefs.getString(KEY_PREFIXES, null) ?: return DEFAULT_PREFIXES
        return try {
            val jsonArray = JSONArray(rawJson)
            val list = mutableListOf<String>()
            for (i in 0 until jsonArray.length()) {
                val item = jsonArray.optString(i).trim()
                if (item.isNotEmpty() && !list.contains(item)) {
                    list.add(item)
                }
            }
            if (list.isEmpty()) DEFAULT_PREFIXES else list
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            DEFAULT_PREFIXES
        }
    }

    fun savePrefixes(prefixes: List<String>) {
        val cleanList = prefixes.map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.distinct()
        val jsonArray = JSONArray()
        cleanList.forEach { jsonArray.put(it) }
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_PREFIXES, jsonArray.toString()).apply()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "docscan_prefix_preferences"
        private const val KEY_PREFIXES = "saved_prefixes"
        val DEFAULT_PREFIXES = listOf("договор за газ", "договор за воду", "акт")
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import app.docscan.core.artifact.FileArtifactRepository
import app.docscan.core.artifact.DirectorySync
import app.docscan.core.ocr.scaledTo
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toOcrLayout
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toRecognitionLayout
import app.docscan.core.store.FrozenSavePage
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionGeometry
import app.docscan.core.store.SaveManifestSnapshot
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.io.MemoryUsageSetting
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.image.PDImageXObject
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType0Font
import app.docscan.android.SearchablePdfWriter.Companion.safeText
import app.docscan.android.SearchablePdfWriter.Companion.normalizedTextContent
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.rendering.PDFRenderer
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

@ConsistentCopyVisibility
data class FrozenPageOutput internal constructor(
    val imageVersionId: String,
    val orderIndex: Long,
    val jpegFile: File,
    val jpegSha256: String,
    val widthPx: Int,
    val heightPx: Int,
)

@ConsistentCopyVisibility
data class FrozenSaveOutputSet internal constructor(
    val saveManifestId: String,
    val pdfFile: File,
    val pdfSha256: String,
    val pages: List<FrozenPageOutput>,
    val warnings: List<String> = emptyList(),
)

/** Creates a locally validated candidate set from one immutable SaveManifest. */
class FrozenSaveOutputComposer(
    private val sourceRepository: FileArtifactRepository,
    private val sourcePath: (String) -> File,
    private val pdfWriter: SearchablePdfWriter,
    private val resourceLoaderContext: android.content.Context,
    private val directorySync: DirectorySync,
) {
    fun compose(
        snapshot: SaveManifestSnapshot,
        outputRoot: File,
        pdfSettings: PdfOutputSettings,
        companionJpegQuality: Int,
        includeOcr: Boolean = true,
    ): FrozenSaveOutputSet {
        require(snapshot.pages.isNotEmpty()) { "SaveManifest has no frozen pages" }
        require(companionJpegQuality in 0..100)
        require(snapshot.pages.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a.orderIndex < b.orderIndex }) {
            "Frozen pages are not in strictly increasing workspace order"
        }
        require(!outputRoot.exists() || outputRoot.isDirectory) { "Save output root is not a directory" }
        if (!outputRoot.exists()) check(outputRoot.mkdirs()) { "Save output root cannot be created" }

        val staging = File(outputRoot, ".${snapshot.saveManifestId.value}.${UUID.randomUUID()}.building")
        val finalDir = File(outputRoot, snapshot.saveManifestId.value)
        check(!finalDir.exists()) { "Output already exists for this SaveManifest" }
        check(staging.mkdir()) { "Save staging directory cannot be created" }
        try {
            val pageCandidates = mutableListOf<PageCandidate>()
            val pageOutputs = snapshot.pages.mapIndexed { index, page ->
                val source = sourcePath(page.artifactRelativePath)
                check(sourceRepository.verifyPublished(page.artifactRelativePath, page.artifactSizeBytes, page.artifactSha256)) {
                    "Frozen source artifact failed size/SHA-256 verification: ${page.artifactId.value}"
                }
                require(source.isFile) { "Frozen source artifact is missing" }
                val decoded = ProductImageDecoder.decode(source, MAX_DECODE_PIXELS)
                    ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Frozen source image cannot be decoded")
                val sourceWidth = decoded.width
                val sourceHeight = decoded.height
                val scale = minOf(1f, MAX_OUTPUT_SIDE_PX.toFloat() / maxOf(sourceWidth, sourceHeight))
                val outputWidth = maxOf(1, (sourceWidth * scale).toInt())
                val outputHeight = maxOf(1, (sourceHeight * scale).toInt())
                val bitmap = if (outputWidth == sourceWidth && outputHeight == sourceHeight) decoded
                    else Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(decoded, outputWidth, outputHeight, true).also { decoded.recycle() }
                try {
                    val jpeg = File(staging, "page-${index + 1}.jpg")
                    FileOutputStream(jpeg).use { stream ->
                        check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, companionJpegQuality, stream)) {
                            "Companion JPG encoding failed"
                        }
                        stream.fd.sync()
                    }
                    val checkBitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(jpeg.absolutePath)
                        ?: throw IllegalStateException("Companion JPG cannot be read back")
                    try {
                        check(checkBitmap.width == bitmap.width && checkBitmap.height == bitmap.height
                            && maxOf(checkBitmap.width, checkBitmap.height) <= MAX_OUTPUT_SIDE_PX
                        ) {
                            "Companion JPG dimensions differ from its bounded output image"
                        }
                    } finally {
                        checkBitmap.recycle()
                    }
                    val scaledLayout = if (includeOcr) {
                        page.recognizedLayout?.toOcrLayout()?.scaledTo(bitmap.width, bitmap.height)?.toRecognitionLayout()
                    } else null
                    val scaledGeometry = if (includeOcr && scaledLayout == null) {
                        scaleGeometry(page.recognizedGeometry, sourceWidth, sourceHeight, bitmap.width, bitmap.height)
                    } else null
                    pageCandidates += PageCandidate(
                        jpeg = jpeg,
                        recognition = scaledGeometry,
                        layout = scaledLayout,
                        text = if (includeOcr) page.recognizedText else null,
                    )
                    FrozenPageOutput(
                        imageVersionId = page.imageVersionId.value,
                        orderIndex = page.orderIndex,
                        jpegFile = File(finalDir, jpeg.name),
                        jpegSha256 = sha256(jpeg),
                        widthPx = bitmap.width,
                        heightPx = bitmap.height,
                    )
                } finally {
                    bitmap.recycle()
                }
            }
            val inputs = pageCandidates.map { candidate ->
                PdfInputPage(
                    openBitmap = {
                        ProductImageDecoder.decode(candidate.jpeg, MAX_DECODE_PIXELS)
                            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Bounded companion JPG cannot be decoded")
                    },
                    recognition = candidate.recognition,
                    layout = candidate.layout,
                    text = candidate.text,
                )
            }
            val pdfTemp = File(staging, "document.pdf")
            val writeResult = pdfWriter.write(pdfTemp, inputs, pdfSettings)
            validatePdf(pdfTemp, snapshot.pages, pageOutputs, includeOcr, pdfSettings.includeImage)
            snapshot.pages.forEach { page ->
                check(sourceRepository.verifyPublished(page.artifactRelativePath, page.artifactSizeBytes, page.artifactSha256)) {
                    "Frozen source artifact changed while composing the output set: ${page.artifactId.value}"
                }
            }
            val pdfHash = sha256(pdfTemp)
            directorySync.sync(staging.toPath())
            Files.move(staging.toPath(), finalDir.toPath(), ATOMIC_MOVE)
            directorySync.sync(outputRoot.toPath())
            return FrozenSaveOutputSet(
                saveManifestId = snapshot.saveManifestId.value,
                pdfFile = File(finalDir, pdfTemp.name),
                pdfSha256 = pdfHash,
                pages = pageOutputs,
                warnings = writeResult.warnings,
            )
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            val incomplete = if (finalDir.exists()) finalDir else staging
            try {
                deleteTree(incomplete)
            } catch (cleanupFailure: Throwable) {
                failure.addSuppressed(cleanupFailure)
            }
            try {
                directorySync.sync(outputRoot.toPath())
            } catch (syncFailure: Throwable) {
                failure.addSuppressed(syncFailure)
            }
            throw failure
        }
    }

    private fun validatePdf(
        pdfFile: File,
        pages: List<FrozenSavePage>,
        pageOutputs: List<FrozenPageOutput>,
        includeOcr: Boolean,
        includeImage: Boolean,
    ) {
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(resourceLoaderContext.applicationContext)
        PDDocument.load(pdfFile, MemoryUsageSetting.setupTempFileOnly()).use { document ->
            check(document.numberOfPages == pages.size) { "PDF page count differs from frozen SaveManifest" }
            if (includeOcr) {
                val validationFont = resourceLoaderContext.assets.open("fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf").use {
                    PDType0Font.load(document, it, false)
                }
                val cache = HashMap<Int, Boolean>()
                pages.forEachIndexed { index, page ->
                    val layoutText = page.recognizedLayout?.toPlainText()?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                    val geometryText = page.recognizedGeometry?.words?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
                        ?.joinToString(" ") { it.text }
                    val rawText = layoutText ?: geometryText ?: page.recognizedText.orEmpty()
                    val expected = normalizedTextContent(validationFont.safeText(rawText, cache).orEmpty())
                    check(includeImage || expected.isNotEmpty()) { "Text-only PDF page ${index + 1} has no supported recognized text" }
                    if (rawText.isNotBlank()) {
                        val extracted = PDFTextStripper().apply {
                            startPage = index + 1; endPage = index + 1
                        }.getText(document)
                        val matches = normalizedTextContent(extracted) == expected
                        check(includeImage || extracted.isNotBlank()) { "Text-only PDF page ${index + 1} text layer is empty" }
                        if (!matches) android.util.Log.w("FrozenSaveOutputComposer",
                            "PDF page ${index + 1} extracted text differs from supported recognized content")
                    }
                }
            }
            val renderer = PDFRenderer(document)
            pages.indices.forEach { index ->
                val rendered = renderer.renderImage(index, 0.25f)
                try {
                    check(rendered.width > 0 && rendered.height > 0) {
                        "PDF page $index did not render"
                    }
                    val page = document.getPage(index)
                    val sourceImages = page.resources.xObjectNames.mapNotNull { name ->
                        page.resources.getXObject(name) as? PDImageXObject
                    }
                    if (includeImage) {
                        check(sourceImages.size == 1
                            && sourceImages.single().width == pageOutputs[index].widthPx
                            && sourceImages.single().height == pageOutputs[index].heightPx) {
                            "PDF page $index does not contain exactly one full-resolution frozen source image"
                        }
                    } else {
                        check(sourceImages.isEmpty()) {
                            "PDF page $index contains source image when includeImage is false"
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    rendered.recycle()
                }
            }
        }
        check(pdfFile.isFile && pdfFile.length() > 0L) { "PDF is empty after read-back" }
    }

    private fun scaleGeometry(
        geometry: RecognitionGeometry?,
        sourceWidth: Int,
        sourceHeight: Int,
        outputWidth: Int,
        outputHeight: Int,
    ): RecognitionGeometry? {
        if (geometry == null) return null
        val scaleX = outputWidth.toDouble() / sourceWidth
        val scaleY = outputHeight.toDouble() / sourceHeight
        val words = geometry.words.map { word ->
            val left = (word.leftPx * scaleX).toLong().coerceIn(0L, outputWidth.toLong() - 1L)
            val top = (word.topPx * scaleY).toLong().coerceIn(0L, outputHeight.toLong() - 1L)
            val right = kotlin.math.ceil(word.rightPx * scaleX).toLong().coerceIn(left + 1L, outputWidth.toLong())
            val bottom = kotlin.math.ceil(word.bottomPx * scaleY).toLong().coerceIn(top + 1L, outputHeight.toLong())
            word.copy(leftPx = left, topPx = top, rightPx = right, bottomPx = bottom)
        }
        return geometry.copy(sourceWidthPx = outputWidth.toLong(), sourceHeightPx = outputHeight.toLong(), words = words)
    }

    private data class PageCandidate(
        val jpeg: File,
        val recognition: RecognitionGeometry?,
        val layout: app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout? = null,
        val text: String? = null,
    )

    private fun sha256(file: File): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        file.inputStream().buffered().use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE)
            while (true) {
                val read = input.read(buffer)
                if (read < 0) break
                if (read > 0) digest.update(buffer, 0, read)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }

    private fun deleteTree(file: File) {
        if (!file.exists()) return
        file.listFiles()?.forEach(::deleteTree)
        check(file.delete()) { "Cannot remove incomplete save output: ${file.name}" }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_DECODE_PIXELS = 12L * 1024L * 1024L
        const val MAX_OUTPUT_SIDE_PX = 3000
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.RenderEffect
import android.graphics.Shader
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Build
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog

/** One surface policy for every application-owned dialog; system pickers remain system-owned. */
internal class InsetDialogHost(private val background: View) {
    private val hosts = mutableListOf<View>()
    private val windows = mutableMapOf<View, android.view.Window>()
    private val dialogs = mutableSetOf<AlertDialog>()
    val foregroundView: View? get() = hosts.lastOrNull()
    fun dismissAll() { dialogs.toList().asReversed().forEach { it.dismiss() }; dialogs.clear() }
    private fun dp(value: Int) = (value * background.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

    fun builder(context: Context, light: Boolean = false): AlertDialog.Builder = object : AlertDialog.Builder(context) {
        override fun create(): AlertDialog = super.create().also { dialog ->
            dialogs += dialog
            val decor = dialog.window!!.decorView
            decor.addOnAttachStateChangeListener(object : View.OnAttachStateChangeListener {
                override fun onViewAttachedToWindow(view: View) {
                    // AlertController has installed its panels before the first posted layout.
                    view.post { if (dialog.isShowing) install(dialog, light) }
                }
                override fun onViewDetachedFromWindow(view: View) { dialogs.remove(dialog) }
            })
        }
    }

    private fun install(dialog: AlertDialog, light: Boolean) {
        val window = dialog.window ?: return
        val content = window.findViewById<ViewGroup>(android.R.id.content) ?: return
        if (content.findViewWithTag<View>(HOST_TAG) != null) return
        val panel = dialog.findViewById<ViewGroup>(androidx.appcompat.R.id.parentPanel) ?: return
        val rail = panel.findViewWithTag<View>(RAIL_TAG)
        (rail?.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(rail)
        (panel.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(panel)
        val host = FrameLayout(dialog.context).apply { tag = HOST_TAG }
        androidx.core.view.ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(host) { view, insets ->
            val bars = insets.getInsets(androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
            view.setPadding(bars.left, bars.top, bars.right, bars.bottom)
            insets
        }
        var fallback: Bitmap? = null
        var detached = false
        var fallbackView: ImageView? = null
        // Android 29/30 has no RenderEffect. A small, filtered snapshot keeps memory bounded.
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 31 && background.width > 0 && background.height > 0) {
            val sample = dp(24).coerceAtLeast(1)
            fallback = Bitmap.createBitmap(maxOf(1, background.width / sample), maxOf(1, background.height / sample), Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            Canvas(fallback).apply { scale(1f / sample, 1f / sample); background.draw(this) }
            fallbackView = ImageView(dialog.context).apply {
                scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_XY
                setImageDrawable(android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable(resources, fallback).apply { isFilterBitmap = true })
                importantForAccessibility = View.IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO
            }
            host.addView(fallbackView, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
            val sourceWindow = hosts.lastOrNull()?.let { windows[it] } ?: (background.context as? android.app.Activity)?.window
            if (sourceWindow != null) {
                val capture = Bitmap.createBitmap(fallback!!.width, fallback!!.height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                runCatching { android.view.PixelCopy.request(sourceWindow, capture, { result ->
                    if (detached || result != android.view.PixelCopy.SUCCESS) capture.recycle()
                    else {
                        val previous = fallback
                        fallback = capture
                        fallbackView?.setImageDrawable(android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable(background.resources, capture).apply { isFilterBitmap = true })
                        previous?.recycle()
                    }
                }, android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())) }.onFailure { capture.recycle() }
            }
        }
        hosts.forEach { blur(it, true) }
        hosts += host
        windows[host] = window
        blur(background, true)
        val railHeight = rail?.layoutParams?.height?.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: dp(172)
        val region = FrameLayout(dialog.context)
        val hostBottomMargin = if (rail != null) railHeight + dp(20) else dp(24)
        host.addView(region, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1).apply {
            leftMargin = dp(20); rightMargin = dp(20); topMargin = dp(24); bottomMargin = hostBottomMargin
        })
        val customPanel = panel.findViewById<ViewGroup>(androidx.appcompat.R.id.customPanel)
        if (customPanel != null) {
            customPanel.layoutParams = androidx.appcompat.widget.LinearLayoutCompat.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                0f,
            )
            val contentPanel = panel.findViewById<ViewGroup>(androidx.appcompat.R.id.contentPanel)
            val messageView = contentPanel?.findViewById<View>(android.R.id.message)
            if (messageView == null || messageView.visibility == View.GONE) {
                contentPanel?.visibility = View.GONE
            }
            val buttonPanel = panel.findViewById<ViewGroup>(androidx.appcompat.R.id.buttonPanel)
            if (buttonPanel != null) {
                val hasButtons = (0 until buttonPanel.childCount).any { buttonPanel.getChildAt(it).visibility == View.VISIBLE }
                if (!hasButtons) buttonPanel.visibility = View.GONE
            }
        }
        if (light) {
            // Apply the surface during installation, rather than racing a posted
            // repaint against the host's default dark panel.
            listOf(androidx.appcompat.R.id.topPanel, androidx.appcompat.R.id.contentPanel,
                androidx.appcompat.R.id.customPanel, androidx.appcompat.R.id.buttonPanel).forEach { id ->
                panel.findViewById<View>(id)?.setBackgroundColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
            }
            panel.findViewById<android.widget.TextView>(androidx.appcompat.R.id.alertTitle)?.setTextColor(0xFF46566B.toInt())
            listOf(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE, AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEGATIVE, AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEUTRAL).forEach { which ->
                dialog.getButton(which)?.apply { setTextColor(0xFF487DB8.toInt()); isAllCaps = false }
            }
        }
        panel.background = GradientDrawable().apply { setColor(if (light) Color.WHITE else 0xFF111316.toInt()); cornerRadius = dp(20).toFloat() }
        panel.clipToOutline = true
        panel.tag = PANEL_TAG
        region.addView(panel, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2, Gravity.CENTER))
        if (rail != null) {
            rail.background = ColorDrawable(0xff17191d.toInt())
            host.addView(rail, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, railHeight, Gravity.BOTTOM))
        }
        // Preserve framework outside-touch policy, including setCanceledOnTouchOutside(false).
        // A transparent full-window host otherwise turns margins into inside-window touches.
        host.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
            val bounds = android.graphics.Rect()
            panel.getGlobalVisibleRect(bounds)
            val insidePanel = bounds.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())
            rail?.getGlobalVisibleRect(bounds)
            val insideRail = rail != null && bounds.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())
            if (insidePanel || insideRail) false else {
                val outside = android.view.MotionEvent.obtain(event)
                outside.setLocation(-dp(64).toFloat(), -dp(64).toFloat())
                dialog.onTouchEvent(outside)
                outside.recycle()
                true
            }
        }
        content.removeAllViews()
        content.addView(host, ViewGroup.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
        window.setBackgroundDrawable(ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT))
        window.setDimAmount(.28f)
        window.setLayout(-1, -1)
        // Dismissal callbacks belong to the editor. Attachment cleanup never replaces them.
        host.addOnAttachStateChangeListener(object : View.OnAttachStateChangeListener {
            override fun onViewAttachedToWindow(view: View) = Unit
            override fun onViewDetachedFromWindow(view: View) {
                hosts.remove(host)
                windows.remove(host)
                blur(host, false)
                hosts.lastOrNull()?.let { blur(it, false) }
                if (hosts.isEmpty()) blur(background, false)
                detached = true
                fallbackView?.setImageDrawable(null)
                fallback?.recycle(); fallback = null
            }
        })
    }

    private fun blur(view: View, enabled: Boolean) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) view.setRenderEffect(
            if (enabled) RenderEffect.createBlurEffect(dp(10).toFloat(), dp(10).toFloat(), Shader.TileMode.CLAMP) else null,
        )
    }

    companion object {
        const val HOST_TAG = "docscan-inset-dialog-host"
        const val PANEL_TAG = "docscan-inset-dialog-panel"
        const val RAIL_TAG = "docscan-dialog-bottom-rail"
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

/** One queued UI task and one replaceable value, even when the main looper is blocked. */
class LatestDocumentPublication<T:Any>(
    private val post:(Runnable)->Unit,
    private val remove:(Runnable)->Unit,
    private val apply:(T)->Unit,
) : AutoCloseable {
    private val latest=AtomicReference<T?>()
    private val scheduled=AtomicBoolean()
    private val closed=AtomicBoolean()
    private val drain=object:Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            try {
                val value=latest.getAndSet(null)
                if(value!=null && !closed.get()) apply(value)
            } finally {
                scheduled.set(false)
                if(latest.get()!=null && !closed.get()) schedule()
            }
        }
    }
    fun offer(value:T) {
        if(closed.get()) return
        latest.set(value)
        if(closed.get()) { latest.set(null); return }
        schedule()
    }
    private fun schedule() {
        if(!closed.get() && scheduled.compareAndSet(false,true)) {
            post(drain)
            if(closed.get()) remove(drain)
        }
    }
    /** Invalidate pending values without disabling a resumed camera session. */
    fun clear() { latest.set(null) }
    override fun close() {
        closed.set(true); latest.set(null); remove(drain); scheduled.set(false)
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/OcrImagePreparation.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel
import app.docscan.core.whiten.PixelRows
import com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/** Photometric changes only: dimensions and pixel coordinates never change. */
enum class OcrImageProfile { ORIGINAL, LIGHTING, OTSU }

data class OcrRunSettings(
    val pageSegMode: Int = TessBaseAPI.PageSegMode.PSM_AUTO,
    val imageProfile: OcrImageProfile = OcrImageProfile.ORIGINAL,
    val autoLighting: Boolean = false,
)

object OcrImagePreparation {
    /** Sample the bright part of each region so ink does not masquerade as a shadow.
     * Thresholds are deliberately conservative; they change only the OCR copy.
     */
    fun suggestProfile(source: Bitmap): OcrImageProfile {
        val backgrounds = ArrayList<Int>(48)
        val tile = IntArray(25)
        for (row in 0 until 8) for (column in 0 until 6) {
            for (sy in 0 until 5) for (sx in 0 until 5) {
                val x = ((column + (sx + 0.5) / 5) * source.width / 6).toInt().coerceIn(0, source.width - 1)
                val y = ((row + (sy + 0.5) / 5) * source.height / 8).toInt().coerceIn(0, source.height - 1)
                val pixel = source.getPixel(x, y)
                val gray = (Color.red(pixel) * 77 + Color.green(pixel) * 150 + Color.blue(pixel) * 29) shr 8
                val alpha = Color.alpha(pixel)
                tile[sy * 5 + sx] = (gray * alpha + 255 * (255 - alpha)) / 255
            }
            tile.sort()
            if (tile[22] >= 96) backgrounds += tile[22]
        }
        if (backgrounds.size < 12) return OcrImageProfile.ORIGINAL
        backgrounds.sort()
        val low = backgrounds[backgrounds.size / 5]
        val high = backgrounds[(backgrounds.size * 9 / 10).coerceAtMost(backgrounds.lastIndex)]
        return if (high >= 185 && high - low >= 50 && low * 1.3f < high)
            OcrImageProfile.LIGHTING else OcrImageProfile.ORIGINAL
    }

    fun prepare(source: Bitmap, profile: OcrImageProfile, isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false }): Bitmap {
        if (profile == OcrImageProfile.ORIGINAL) return source
        val width = source.width
        val height = source.height
        val row = IntArray(width)
        fun luminance(pixel: Int): Int {
            val gray = (Color.red(pixel) * 77 + Color.green(pixel) * 150 + Color.blue(pixel) * 29) shr 8
            val alpha = Color.alpha(pixel)
            return (gray * alpha + 255 * (255 - alpha)) / 255
        }
        var threshold = 127
        var sampler: IlluminationModel.RowSampler? = null
        if (profile == OcrImageProfile.OTSU) {
            val histogram = LongArray(256)
            for (y in 0 until height) {
                if (isCancelled()) throw java.util.concurrent.CancellationException("OCR image preparation cancelled")
                source.getPixels(row, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
                for (x in row.indices) histogram[luminance(row[x])]++
            }
            val total = width.toLong() * height
            val sum = histogram.indices.sumOf { it * histogram[it].toDouble() }
            var left = 0L
            var leftSum = 0.0
            var best = -1.0
            for (i in histogram.indices) {
                left += histogram[i]
                leftSum += i * histogram[i].toDouble()
                val right = total - left
                if (left == 0L || right == 0L) continue
                val delta = leftSum / left - (sum - leftSum) / right
                val variance = left.toDouble() * right * delta * delta
                if (variance > best) { best = variance; threshold = i }
            }
        } else {
            // One background estimator for the whole project: the same illumination model that whitens the page.
            val rows = object : PixelRows {
                override val width = source.width
                override val height = source.height
                override fun readRow(y: Int, out: IntArray) = source.getPixels(out, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
            }
            val analysis = IlluminationModel.analyse(rows, isCancelled) ?: return source
            sampler = IlluminationModel.RowSampler(analysis, width)
        }
        val background = FloatArray(width)
        val result = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        try {
            for (y in 0 until height) {
                if (isCancelled()) throw java.util.concurrent.CancellationException("OCR image preparation cancelled")
                source.getPixels(row, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
                sampler?.linearLumaRow(y, background)
                for (x in row.indices) {
                    val gray = luminance(row[x])
                    val value = if (profile == OcrImageProfile.OTSU) {
                        if (gray > threshold) 255 else 0
                    } else {
                        val paper = IlluminationModel.encodeLinear(background[x]).coerceAtLeast(96)
                        (gray * 245f / paper).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
                    }
                    row[x] = Color.rgb(value, value, value)
                }
                result.setPixels(row, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
            }
            return result
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            result.recycle()
            throw failure
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/PageImageAdjustmentProcessor.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Matrix
import app.docscan.core.edit.PageImageEditState
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/** Applies temporary right-angle, brightness, contrast, and sharpening edits to one bounded bitmap. */
object PageImageAdjustmentProcessor {
    const val MAX_SOURCE_PIXELS = 12L * 1024L * 1024L

    /** The rendered page and, when whitening was requested and applied, what was done. */
    class Rendered(val bitmap: Bitmap, val whitening: WhiteningReport? = null)

    fun render(source: Bitmap, state: PageImageEditState): Bitmap = renderWithReport(source, state).bitmap

    fun renderWithReport(source: Bitmap, state: PageImageEditState): Rendered {
        require(!source.isRecycled) { "Source image is unavailable" }
        val inputPixels = source.width.toLong() * source.height
        require(inputPixels in 1..MAX_SOURCE_PIXELS) { "Image is outside the edit pixel bound" }

        val rotated = if (state.clockwiseTurns == 0) source else Bitmap.createBitmap(
            source,
            0,
            0,
            source.width,
            source.height,
            Matrix().apply { postRotate(state.clockwiseTurns * 90f) },
            true,
        )
        try {
            val crop = state.crop
            if (state.whitening != null) return renderWhitened(rotated, state, crop)
            if (crop != null && state.brightness == 0 && state.contrastPercent == 100 && state.sharpnessPercent == 0) {
                return Rendered(DocumentCropProcessor.rectifyManual(rotated, crop))
            }
            // Even an unchanged image gets an independent bitmap: callers own and recycle it.
            val adjustedBitmap = renderRows(rotated, state)
            if (crop == null) return Rendered(adjustedBitmap)
            return try {
                Rendered(DocumentCropProcessor.rectifyManual(adjustedBitmap, crop))
            } finally {
                adjustedBitmap.recycle()
            }
        } finally {
            if (rotated !== source) rotated.recycle()
        }
    }

    /** Crop, then whiten, then user brightness/contrast/sharpness on top, so manual edits are not undone. */
    private fun renderWhitened(rotated: Bitmap, state: PageImageEditState, crop: app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral?): Rendered {
        val cropped = if (crop != null) DocumentCropProcessor.rectifyManual(rotated, crop) else rotated
        var whitened: Bitmap? = null
        var result: Bitmap? = null
        try {
            val whitenedPair = DocumentIlluminationRestorer.whitenWithReport(cropped, requireNotNull(state.whitening))
            whitened = whitenedPair?.first
            if (whitened != null && state.whitenessPercent < 100) mixWhiteness(cropped, whitened, state.whitenessPercent)
            val base = whitened ?: cropped
            val plain = state.brightness == 0 && state.contrastPercent == 100 && state.sharpnessPercent == 0
            // The caller owns and recycles the result, never the input: an untouched input is copied by renderRows.
            result = if (plain && base !== rotated) base else renderRows(base, state)
            return Rendered(result, whitenedPair?.second)
        } finally {
            if (whitened != null && whitened !== result) whitened.recycle()
            if (cropped !== rotated && cropped !== result) cropped.recycle()
        }
    }

    /** In place: [whitened] is our own bitmap, [original] is only read. */
    private fun mixWhiteness(original: Bitmap, whitened: Bitmap, percent: Int) {
        val width = whitened.width
        val a = IntArray(width)
        val b = IntArray(width)
        for (y in 0 until whitened.height) {
            original.getPixels(a, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
            whitened.getPixels(b, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
            for (x in 0 until width) b[x] = app.docscan.core.whiten.WhitenessBlend.mix(a[x], b[x], percent)
            whitened.setPixels(b, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
        }
    }

    private fun renderRows(source: Bitmap, state: PageImageEditState): Bitmap {
        val width = source.width
        val height = source.height
        val contrast = state.contrastPercent / 100f
        val output = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        try {
            if (state.sharpnessPercent == 0) {
                val row = IntArray(width)
                for (y in 0 until height) {
                    readAdjustedRow(source, y, row, contrast, state.brightness)
                    output.setPixels(row, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
                }
            } else {
                // Keep adjusted (already rounded/clamped) source rows, never sharpened rows.
                val rows = Array(3) { IntArray(width) }
                val result = IntArray(width)
                val amount = state.sharpnessPercent / 100f
                readAdjustedRow(source, 0, rows[0], contrast, state.brightness)
                for (y in 0 until height) {
                    if (y + 1 < height) {
                        readAdjustedRow(source, y + 1, rows[(y + 1) % 3], contrast, state.brightness)
                    }
                    sharpenRow(rows, result, y, width, height, amount)
                    output.setPixels(result, 0, width, 0, y, width, 1)
                }
            }
            return output
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            output.recycle()
            throw failure
        }
    }

    private fun readAdjustedRow(source: Bitmap, y: Int, row: IntArray, contrast: Float, brightness: Int) {
        source.getPixels(row, 0, source.width, 0, y, source.width, 1)
        for (x in row.indices) {
            val pixel = row[x]
            val alpha = pixel ushr 24 and 0xff
            val red = adjust(pixel ushr 16 and 0xff, contrast, brightness)
            val green = adjust(pixel ushr 8 and 0xff, contrast, brightness)
            val blue = adjust(pixel and 0xff, contrast, brightness)
            row[x] = (alpha shl 24) or (red shl 16) or (green shl 8) or blue
        }
    }

    private fun adjust(channel: Int, contrast: Float, brightness: Int): Int =
        (((channel - 127.5f) * contrast) + 127.5f + brightness).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)

    private fun sharpenRow(
        adjustedRows: Array<IntArray>,
        output: IntArray,
        y: Int,
        width: Int,
        height: Int,
        amount: Float,
    ) {
        val centerRow = adjustedRows[y % 3]
        for (x in 0 until width) {
            val center = centerRow[x]
            var red = 0
            var green = 0
            var blue = 0
            var samples = 0
            for (dy in -1..1) for (dx in -1..1) {
                val nx = x + dx
                val ny = y + dy
                if (nx !in 0 until width || ny !in 0 until height) continue
                val neighbor = adjustedRows[ny % 3][nx]
                red += neighbor ushr 16 and 0xff
                green += neighbor ushr 8 and 0xff
                blue += neighbor and 0xff
                samples++
            }
            val centerRed = center ushr 16 and 0xff
            val centerGreen = center ushr 8 and 0xff
            val centerBlue = center and 0xff
            val outRed = (centerRed + (centerRed - red / samples) * amount).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
            val outGreen = (centerGreen + (centerGreen - green / samples) * amount).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
            val outBlue = (centerBlue + (centerBlue - blue / samples) * amount).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
            output[x] = (center ushr 24 shl 24) or (outRed shl 16) or (outGreen shl 8) or outBlue
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.HorizontalScrollView
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import java.util.concurrent.Executor

/** Lazy thumbnails, bounded to visible pages; identity is the original PDF page index. */
internal class PdfPageRail(
    context: android.content.Context,
    private val worker: Executor,
    private val render: (Int) -> Bitmap,
    private val navigate: (Int) -> Unit,
) : HorizontalScrollView(context) {
    private val strip = LinearLayout(context).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL; gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL }
    private val images = mutableMapOf<Int, ImageView>()
    private val cache = linkedMapOf<Int, Bitmap>()
    private val pending = mutableSetOf<Int>()
    private var order = emptyList<Int>()
    @Volatile private var closed = false
    private val main = android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())
    private fun dp(value: Int) = (value * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

    init { tag = InsetDialogHost.RAIL_TAG; isHorizontalScrollBarEnabled = false; addView(strip, ViewGroup.LayoutParams(-2, -1)) }

    fun update(pages: List<Int>, activePosition: Int, busy: Boolean = false) {
        if (closed) return
        if (order != pages) {
            order = pages.toList(); images.clear(); strip.removeAllViews()
            pages.forEachIndexed { position, source ->
                val cell = LinearLayout(context).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL; gravity = Gravity.CENTER; setPadding(dp(5), dp(8), dp(5), dp(8)) }
                val image = ImageView(context).apply {
                    tag = "docscan-pdf-thumbnail:$source"
                    contentDescription = context.getString(R.string.page_image_description, position + 1)
                    scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER; setPadding(dp(3), dp(3), dp(3), dp(3))
                    cache[source]?.let(::setImageBitmap)
                    setOnClickListener { if (!closed && isEnabled) navigate(order.indexOf(source)) }
                }
                images[source] = image
                cell.addView(image, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(56), dp(72)))
                cell.addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "${position + 1}"; gravity = Gravity.CENTER; setTextColor(0xffb8c4d5.toInt()); textSize = 10f }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(22)))
                strip.addView(cell, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(68), -1))
            }
        }
        order.forEachIndexed { position, source ->
            images[source]?.apply {
                isEnabled = !busy
                background = GradientDrawable().apply { setColor(0xff292d35.toInt()); setStroke(dp(if (position == activePosition) 2 else 1), if (position == activePosition) Color.WHITE else 0xff667082.toInt()) }
            }
        }
        post {
            if (!closed) {
                strip.getChildAt(activePosition)?.let { cell ->
                    if (cell.left < scrollX || cell.right > scrollX + width) scrollTo(cell.left, 0)
                }
                loadVisible()
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onScrollChanged(l: Int, t: Int, oldl: Int, oldt: Int) { super.onScrollChanged(l, t, oldl, oldt); loadVisible() }

    private fun loadVisible() {
        if (closed || width <= 0) return
        val first = maxOf(0, scrollX / dp(68) - 1)
        val last = minOf(order.lastIndex, (scrollX + width) / dp(68) + 1)
        for (position in first..last) {
            val source = order.getOrNull(position) ?: continue
            if (source in cache || !pending.add(source)) continue
            worker.execute {
                val bitmap = if (closed) null else runCatching { render(source) }.getOrNull()
                main.post {
                    pending.remove(source)
                    if (closed || source !in order) bitmap?.recycle()
                    else if (bitmap != null) {
                        cache[source] = bitmap; images[source]?.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
                        while (cache.size > 24) {
                            val evict = cache.keys.firstOrNull { key -> order.indexOf(key) !in first..last } ?: break
                            images[evict]?.setImageDrawable(null); cache.remove(evict)?.recycle()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun close() {
        closed = true
        images.values.forEach { it.setImageDrawable(null) }
        cache.values.forEach { it.recycle() }; cache.clear()
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.store.Baseline
import app.docscan.core.store.BlockType
import app.docscan.core.store.LayoutQuality
import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.TextPosition
import kotlin.math.ceil
import kotlin.math.floor
import kotlin.math.hypot

/** Captures actual PDF glyph positions in the coordinate system of PDFRenderer's cropped raster. */
internal class PdfTextLayoutExtractor private constructor(
    private val documentSource: PDDocument,
    private val pageIndex: Int,
    private val rasterWidth: Int,
    private val rasterHeight: Int,
) : PDFTextStripper() {
    private data class Point(val x: Float, val y: Float)
    private data class Glyph(val text: String, val box: NormalizedBox, val start: Point, val end: Point)
    private val page = documentSource.getPage(pageIndex)
    private val crop = page.cropBox
    private val rotation = ((page.rotation % 360) + 360) % 360
    private val displayedWidth = if (rotation == 90 || rotation == 270) crop.height else crop.width
    private val displayedHeight = if (rotation == 90 || rotation == 270) crop.width else crop.height
    private val lineWords = mutableListOf<OcrWord>()
    private val blocks = mutableListOf<OcrBlock>()
    private var firstGlyph: Glyph? = null
    private var horizontalStructure = true

    init {
        startPage = pageIndex + 1
        endPage = pageIndex + 1
        sortByPosition = true
        setShouldSeparateByBeads(false)
    }

    override fun writeString(text: String, textPositions: MutableList<TextPosition>) {
        val wordGlyphs = mutableListOf<Glyph>()
        fun flushWord() {
            if (wordGlyphs.isEmpty()) return
            val first = wordGlyphs.first()
            if (firstGlyph == null) firstGlyph = first
            val wordText = wordGlyphs.joinToString("") { it.text }
            lineWords += OcrWord(wordText, union(wordGlyphs.map { it.box }), 100f)
            wordGlyphs.clear()
        }
        for (position in textPositions) {
            if (position.unicode.isNullOrBlank()) { flushWord(); continue }
            val glyph = glyph(position) ?: continue
            wordGlyphs += glyph
        }
        flushWord()
        super.writeString(text, textPositions)
    }

    override fun writeLineSeparator() {
        flushLine()
        super.writeLineSeparator()
    }

    override fun writeParagraphEnd() {
        flushLine()
        super.writeParagraphEnd()
    }

    private fun flushLine() {
        if (lineWords.isEmpty()) return
        val box = union(lineWords.map { it.box })
        val baseline = firstGlyph?.let { glyph ->
            val dx = glyph.end.x - glyph.start.x
            val dy = glyph.end.y - glyph.start.y
            // A y(x) baseline cannot represent vertical or backwards text. Keep its true boxes,
            // but mark the page for plain-text reflow when writing a new PDF.
            if (dx <= 0.001f || kotlin.math.abs(dy) > dx * 4f) {
                horizontalStructure = false
                null
            } else {
                val slope = dy / dx
                val left = floor(box.left * rasterWidth)
                val bottom = ceil(box.bottom * rasterHeight)
                Baseline(slope, glyph.start.y - bottom - slope * (glyph.start.x - left))
            }
        }
        val line = OcrLine(box, baseline, null, lineWords.toList())
        blocks += OcrBlock("pdf-line-${blocks.size + 1}", BlockType.TEXT, box, blocks.size,
            listOf(OcrParagraph(box, listOf(line))))
        lineWords.clear()
        firstGlyph = null
    }

    private fun glyph(position: TextPosition): Glyph? {
        val matrix = position.textMatrix
        // PDFBox LegacyPDFStreamEngine has already subtracted CropBox.lowerLeft from both
        // textMatrix and endX/endY. Subtracting it again shifts non-zero CropBox pages.
        val x = matrix.translateX
        val y = matrix.translateY
        val height = position.heightDir
        val upLength = hypot(matrix.shearX, matrix.scaleY)
        if (!listOf(x, y, position.endX, position.endY, height, upLength).all { it.isFinite() }
            || height <= 0f || upLength <= 0f) return null
        val upX = matrix.shearX * height / upLength
        val upY = matrix.scaleY * height / upLength
        val points = listOf(
            rasterPoint(x, y), rasterPoint(position.endX, position.endY),
            rasterPoint(x + upX, y + upY), rasterPoint(position.endX + upX, position.endY + upY),
        )
        val left = (points.minOf { it.x } / rasterWidth).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val top = (points.minOf { it.y } / rasterHeight).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val right = (points.maxOf { it.x } / rasterWidth).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val bottom = (points.maxOf { it.y } / rasterHeight).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        if (right <= left || bottom <= top) return null
        return Glyph(position.unicode, NormalizedBox(left, top, right, bottom),
            rasterPoint(x, y), rasterPoint(position.endX, position.endY))
    }

    private fun rasterPoint(x: Float, y: Float): Point {
        val rotated = when (rotation) {
            90 -> Point(y, x)
            180 -> Point(crop.width - x, y)
            270 -> Point(crop.height - y, crop.width - x)
            else -> Point(x, crop.height - y)
        }
        return Point(rotated.x * rasterWidth / displayedWidth, rotated.y * rasterHeight / displayedHeight)
    }

    private fun union(boxes: List<NormalizedBox>): NormalizedBox = NormalizedBox(
        boxes.minOf { it.left }, boxes.minOf { it.top }, boxes.maxOf { it.right }, boxes.maxOf { it.bottom },
    )

    companion object {
        fun extract(document: PDDocument, pageIndex: Int, width: Int, height: Int): RecognitionLayout {
            require(width > 0 && height > 0)
            val extractor = PdfTextLayoutExtractor(document, pageIndex, width, height)
            val text = extractor.getText(document)
            extractor.flushLine()
            return RecognitionLayout(
                sourceWidthPx = width,
                sourceHeightPx = height,
                blocks = extractor.blocks.toList(),
                plainText = text,
                quality = LayoutQuality(100f, 0,
                    structureAvailable = extractor.blocks.isNotEmpty() && extractor.horizontalStructure,
                    engineVersion = "PDF_TEXT"),
            )
        }
    }
}
