    fun renderRecentSavedPdfPage(
        recent: app.docscan.core.store.RecentDocumentSnapshot,
        pageIndex: Int,
        scheduler: app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler,
    ): RenderedSavedPdfPage {
        require(recent.pageCount in 1L..MAX_PDF_IMPORT_PAGES.toLong())
        val pdf = committedExportOutputs(recent.exportArtifactId)
            .firstOrNull { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Recent saved PDF has no committed local source")
        check(verifyExportOutput(pdf)) { "Recent saved PDF failed its local checksum check" }
        return SavedPdfPageRenderer.renderPage(
            exportOutputFile(pdf),
            recent.pageCount.toInt(),
            pageIndex,
            scheduler,
        )
    }

    fun recentSavedPdfFile(recent: app.docscan.core.store.RecentDocumentSnapshot): File {
        require(recent.pageCount in 1L..MAX_PDF_IMPORT_PAGES.toLong())
        val pdf = committedExportOutputs(recent.exportArtifactId)
            .firstOrNull { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Recent saved PDF has no committed local source")
        check(verifyExportOutput(pdf)) { "Recent saved PDF failed its local checksum check" }
        return exportOutputFile(pdf).also { file ->
            check(file.isFile && file.length() == pdf.sizeBytes) {
                "Recent saved PDF differs from its committed size"
            }
        }
    }

    fun commitSavedPdfEditOutput(
        recent: app.docscan.core.store.RecentDocumentSnapshot,
        orderedSourcePageIndexes: List<Int>,
        output: SavedPdfEditOutput,
        externalPackage: ExternalExportPackagePlan,
    ): ExportArtifactId {
        val source = recentSavedPdfFile(recent)
        val sourcePdf = committedExportOutputs(recent.exportArtifactId)
            .singleOrNull { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Recent saved PDF must have exactly one committed PDF")
        check(sourcePdf.sha256 == output.sourceSha256 && source.length() == sourcePdf.sizeBytes) {
            "Saved PDF source changed after the edit preview"
        }
        require(output.pageCount == orderedSourcePageIndexes.size)
        require(externalPackage.outputDisplayNames.size == 1)

        val saveManifestId = SaveManifestId.new()
        store.beginSavedPdfEditManifest(
            app.docscan.core.store.SavedPdfEditManifestCommand(
                saveManifestId = saveManifestId,
                workspaceId = workspaceId,
                sourceExportArtifactId = recent.exportArtifactId,
                sourcePdfArtifactId = sourcePdf.artifactId,
                sourcePdfSha256 = sourcePdf.sha256,
                sourcePageCount = recent.pageCount,
                orderedSourcePageIndexes = orderedSourcePageIndexes,
            ),
        )
        try {
            val artifact = artifacts.publishExportFile(output.file.inputStream(), "pdf")
            check(artifact.sha256 == output.sha256 && artifact.sizeBytes == output.sizeBytes) {
                "Edited PDF differs from the validated composition"
            }
            check(artifacts.verifyPublished(artifact.relativePath, artifact.sizeBytes, artifact.sha256)) {
                "Edited PDF failed private-file read-back checksum verification"
            }
            store.recordStagedExportFile(saveManifestId, artifact)
            val durableExternalPackage = ExternalExportPackageCommand(
                destinationTreeUri = externalPackage.destinationTreeUri,
                commonBasename = externalPackage.commonBasename,
                providerQualificationId = externalPackage.providerQualificationId,
                adapterId = externalPackage.adapterId,
                providerVersion = externalPackage.providerVersion,
                osVersion = externalPackage.osVersion,
                destinationAccessClass = externalPackage.destinationAccessClass,
                outputs = listOf(
                    app.docscan.core.store.ExternalExportPackageOutputCommand(
                        artifact.artifactId,
                        externalPackage.outputDisplayNames.single(),
                        0L,
                    ),
                ),
                ocrStatus = externalPackage.ocrStatus,
            )
            val exportId = ExportArtifactId.new()
            store.commitLocalExportArtifact(
                app.docscan.core.store.CommitLocalExportCommand(
                    exportArtifactId = exportId,
                    saveManifestId = saveManifestId,
                    files = listOf(app.docscan.core.store.LocalExportFileCommand(artifact, "PDF", null)),
                    externalPackage = durableExternalPackage,
                    outputKind = "EDITED_SAVED_PDF",
                    expectedPageCount = output.pageCount.toLong(),
                ),
            )
            return exportId
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            runCatching { store.abandonIncompleteSavedPdfEditManifests(STARTUP_RECOVERY_BATCH_SIZE) }
            throw failure
        }
    }

    fun importedPdfPageIds(importSessionId: app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId) =
        store.importedPdfPageIds(importSessionId)

    fun externalExportPackage(exportArtifactId: ExportArtifactId) = store.externalExportPackage(exportArtifactId)

    fun incompleteExternalExportPackages() = store.incompleteExternalExportPackages()

    fun exportAttempt(exportAttemptId: ExportAttemptId) = store.exportAttempt(exportAttemptId)

    fun markDestinationGrantVerified(treeUri: String, wallMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()) =
        store.markDestinationGrantVerified(treeUri, wallMillis)

    fun selectedPageRecognitions(): List<app.docscan.core.store.SelectedPageRecognition> =
        store.selectedPageRecognitions(workspaceId)

    fun freezeSelectedPagesForSave(): app.docscan.core.store.SaveManifestSnapshot =
        store.freezeSelectedPagesForSave(workspaceId)

    fun cancelUnstartedSaveManifest(saveManifestId: SaveManifestId) =
        store.cancelUnstartedSaveManifest(workspaceId, saveManifestId)

    fun composeFrozenSaveOutputSet(
        snapshot: app.docscan.core.store.SaveManifestSnapshot,
        pdfSettings: PdfOutputSettings,
        companionJpegQuality: Int,
        includeOcr: Boolean = true,
    ): FrozenSaveOutputSet {
        require(snapshot.workspaceId == workspaceId) { "SaveManifest belongs to another Workspace" }
        store.beginLocalOutputComposition(snapshot)
        val candidateRoot = appContext.noBackupFilesDir.toPath().resolve(saveCandidateDirectoryName).toFile()
        return try {
            FrozenSaveOutputComposer(
                sourceRepository = artifacts,
                sourcePath = { relativePath -> artifactRoot().resolve(relativePath).toFile() },
                pdfWriter = SearchablePdfWriter(appContext),
                resourceLoaderContext = appContext,
                directorySync = directorySyncFactory(),
            ).compose(snapshot, candidateRoot, pdfSettings, companionJpegQuality, includeOcr)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            try {
                store.abortLocalOutputComposition(snapshot)
            } catch (rollbackFailure: Throwable) {
                failure.addSuppressed(rollbackFailure)
            }
            throw failure
        }
    }

    /**
     * Publishes the validated frozen output set as immutable private files, then commits all
     * ArtifactRecords/ExportArtifact/references atomically in SQLite.
     */
    fun commitLocalExportOutputSet(
        snapshot: app.docscan.core.store.SaveManifestSnapshot,
        outputSet: FrozenSaveOutputSet,
        externalPackage: ExternalExportPackagePlan? = null,
    ): ExportArtifactId {
        require(snapshot.saveManifestId.value == outputSet.saveManifestId) {
            "Output set belongs to another SaveManifest"
        }
        require(outputSet.pages.map { it.imageVersionId } == snapshot.pages.map { it.imageVersionId.value }) {
            "Output JPG order differs from the frozen SaveManifest"
        }
        val exportId = ExportArtifactId.new()
        val files = mutableListOf<LocalExportFileCommand>()
        val pdf = publishFrozenSaveOutput(
            snapshot.saveManifestId,
            0,
            outputSet.pdfFile,
            "pdf",
            outputSet.pdfSha256,
        )
        files += LocalExportFileCommand(pdf, "PDF", null)

        outputSet.pages.forEachIndexed { index, page ->
            val output = publishFrozenSaveOutput(
                snapshot.saveManifestId,
                index + 1,
                page.jpegFile,
                "jpg",
                page.jpegSha256,
            )
            files += LocalExportFileCommand(output, "JPG_PAGE", snapshot.pages[index].imageVersionId)
        }
        val durableExternalPackage = externalPackage?.let { plan ->
            require(plan.outputDisplayNames.size == files.size || plan.outputDisplayNames.size == 1) {
                "External package names do not match the committed output count"
            }
            ExternalExportPackageCommand(
                plan.destinationTreeUri,
                plan.commonBasename,
                plan.providerQualificationId,
                plan.adapterId,
                plan.providerVersion,
                plan.osVersion,
                plan.destinationAccessClass,
                files.take(plan.outputDisplayNames.size).mapIndexed { index, file ->
                    ExternalExportPackageOutputCommand(file.file.artifactId, plan.outputDisplayNames[index], index.toLong())
                },
                plan.ocrStatus,
            )
        }
        store.commitLocalExportArtifact(
            CommitLocalExportCommand(
                exportArtifactId = exportId,
                saveManifestId = snapshot.saveManifestId,
                files = files,
                externalPackage = durableExternalPackage,
            ),
        )
        return exportId
    }

    private fun publishFrozenSaveOutput(
        saveManifestId: SaveManifestId,
        outputOrdinal: Int,
        candidate: File,
        extension: String,
        expectedSha256: String,
    ): DurableExportFile {
        val artifactId = app.docscan.core.model.ArtifactId.forSaveOutput(saveManifestId, outputOrdinal)
        val intent = artifacts.describeExportFile(artifactId, extension, candidate.length(), expectedSha256)
        store.beginSaveOutputPublication(saveManifestId, outputOrdinal, intent)
        val published = artifacts.publishExportFile(candidate.inputStream(), extension, artifactId)
        require(published == intent) { "Published output differs from its durable publication intent" }
        check(artifacts.verifyPublished(published.relativePath, published.sizeBytes, published.sha256)) {
            "Published export output failed private-file read-back checksum verification"
        }
        store.completeSaveOutputPublication(saveManifestId, published)
        return published
    }

    fun deletePage(page: StoredPage): DeleteReceipt =
        store.deletePage(workspaceId, page.pageId, page.contentRevision)

    fun deletePages(pages: List<StoredPage>) = store.deletePages(
        workspaceId,
        pages.map { app.docscan.core.store.DeletePageExpectation(it.pageId, it.contentRevision) },
    )

    fun undoDelete(pageId: app.docscan.core.model.PageId) = store.undoDelete(workspaceId, pageId)

    fun undoDeleteBatch(batchId: app.docscan.core.model.DeleteBatchId) = store.undoDeleteBatch(workspaceId, batchId)

    fun close() = driver.close()

    fun artifactPath(artifact: DurableImageArtifact): Path =
        artifactRoot().resolve(artifact.relativePath)

    fun artifactPath(relativePath: String): Path =
        artifactRoot().resolve(relativePath)

    private fun artifactRoot(): Path = appContext.noBackupFilesDir.toPath().resolve(artifactDirectoryName)

    private fun validateImageArtifact(artifact: DurableImageArtifact) {
        val file = artifactPath(artifact).toFile()
        val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
        BitmapFactory.decodeFile(file.absolutePath, bounds)
        if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0 || bounds.outMimeType.isNullOrBlank()) {
            throw ImageImportInvalidSourceException("Imported file is not a supported image")
        }
        var sample = 1
        while (bounds.outWidth.toLong() / sample * (bounds.outHeight.toLong() / sample) > MAX_IMPORT_BITMAP_PIXELS) {
            sample *= 2
        }
        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(
            file.absolutePath,
            BitmapFactory.Options().apply {
                inSampleSize = sample
                inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.RGB_565
            },
        ) ?: throw ImageImportInvalidSourceException("Imported image cannot be decoded")
        bitmap.recycle()
    }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_IMPORT_BITMAP_PIXELS = 12L * 1024L * 1024L
        const val DOCUMENT_CROP_WORKING_SET_BYTES = 80L * 1024L * 1024L
        const val DOCUMENT_CROP_JPEG_QUALITY = 92
        const val MAX_PDF_IMPORT_PAGES = 500
        const val STARTUP_RECOVERY_BATCH_SIZE = 4L
        const val IMPORT_OCR_OPERATION_KEY = "OCR_RUS_ENG_TESSERACT_V1"
    }

    private class ImageImportInvalidSourceException(message: String) : IllegalArgumentException(message)

    private fun reconcileSmallArtifactBatch(): Int {
        val batch = store.recoveryArtifactBatch(STARTUP_RECOVERY_BATCH_SIZE)
        if (batch.isEmpty()) {
            store.resetRecoveryCursor()
            return 0
        }
        var quarantined = 0
        batch.forEach { artifact ->
            val valid = artifact.sha256?.let { checksum ->
                runCatching { artifacts.verifyPublished(artifact.relativePath, artifact.sizeBytes, checksum) }
                    .getOrDefault(false)
            } ?: false
            if (valid) {
                store.acknowledgeRecoveredArtifact(artifact)
            } else {
                store.quarantineRecoveredArtifact(artifact)
                quarantined += 1
            }
        }
        return quarantined
    }

    private fun recoverPendingPdfImportPublications() {
        store.pendingPdfImportPublicationIntents(STARTUP_RECOVERY_BATCH_SIZE).forEach { intent ->
            val artifactId = app.docscan.core.model.ArtifactId.parse(intent.importSessionId.value)
            val source = artifacts.publishedPdfForImport(artifactId)
            if (source == null) {
                artifacts.cleanupInterruptedPdfPublication(artifactId)
                store.abandonPdfImportPublication(intent)
                return@forEach
            }
            val inspection = try {
                AndroidPdfImportReader(appContext).inspect(artifactPath(source.relativePath).toFile())
            } catch (_: PdfImportInvalidSourceException) {
                artifacts.cleanupInterruptedPdfPublication(artifactId)
                store.abandonPdfImportPublication(intent)
                return@forEach
            }
            store.beginPdfImport(
                app.docscan.core.store.BeginPdfImportCommand(
                    intent.importSessionId,
                    intent.workspaceId,
                    source,
                    inspection.pageCount.toLong(),
                    intent.displayName,
                    inspection.title,
                ),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun recoverPendingImageImportPublications() {
        store.pendingImageImportPublicationIntents(STARTUP_RECOVERY_BATCH_SIZE).forEach { intent ->
            val extension = imageExtensionForMime(intent.mimeType)
            val legacySession = store.importSessionRecord(intent.importSessionId)
            val artifact = artifacts.publishedImageForImport(intent.artifactId, extension)
            if (artifact == null) {
                check(legacySession == null) { "Legacy image ImportSession private source is missing; preserving its records" }
                artifacts.cleanupInterruptedImagePublication(intent.artifactId, extension)
                store.abandonImageImportPublication(intent)
                return@forEach
            }
            try {
                validateImageArtifact(artifact)
            } catch (_: ImageImportInvalidSourceException) {
                check(legacySession == null) { "Legacy image ImportSession source is invalid; preserving its records" }
                artifacts.cleanupInterruptedImagePublication(intent.artifactId, extension)
                store.abandonImageImportPublication(intent)
                return@forEach
            }
            store.commitImageImportPublication(
                intent,
                ImportImageCommand(
                    importSessionId = intent.importSessionId,
                    workspaceId = intent.workspaceId,
                    pageId = intent.pageId,
                    imageVersionId = intent.imageVersionId,
                    sourceArtifact = artifact,
                    mimeType = intent.mimeType,
                    displayName = intent.displayName,
                    desiredOperationKey = IMPORT_OCR_OPERATION_KEY,
                ),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun recoverLegacyOpenImageImportSessions() {
        val alreadyPending = store.pendingImageImportPublicationIntents(STARTUP_RECOVERY_BATCH_SIZE)
            .map { it.importSessionId }.toSet()
        store.openSinglePageImportSessions(STARTUP_RECOVERY_BATCH_SIZE).forEach { session ->
            val importSessionId = app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId.parse(session.import_session_id)
            if (importSessionId in alreadyPending) return@forEach
            val sourceArtifactId = session.source_snapshot_artifact_id
                ?.let(app.docscan.core.model.ArtifactId::parse) ?: return@forEach
            val storedArtifact = store.artifactRecord(sourceArtifactId) ?: return@forEach
            if (storedArtifact.artifact_kind != "DOCUMENT_PAGE") return@forEach
            val parameters = session.frozen_operation_parameters
            val json = try {
                org.json.JSONObject(parameters)
            } catch (failure: Exception) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Legacy image ImportSession has malformed frozen parameters", failure)
            }
            val mimeType = json.optString("mimeType", "").lowercase()
            val displayName = json.optString("displayName", "")
            check(mimeType.startsWith("image/") && displayName.isNotBlank()
                && displayName == session.source_display_name
            ) { "Legacy image ImportSession context is inconsistent" }
            val extension = imageExtensionForMime(mimeType)
            val artifactId = sourceArtifactId
            check(storedArtifact.state == "COMMITTED") {
                "Legacy image ImportSession source is not a committed image artifact"
            }
            val source = artifacts.publishedImageForImport(artifactId, extension)
                ?: error("Legacy image ImportSession private source file is missing")
            check(storedArtifact.relative_storage_path == source.relativePath
                && storedArtifact.size_bytes == source.sizeBytes
                && storedArtifact.checksum == source.sha256
                && storedArtifact.artifact_format_version == source.formatVersion
            ) { "Legacy image ImportSession source checksum or path is inconsistent" }
            validateImageArtifact(source)
            val pageId = deterministicLegacyImagePageId(session.import_session_id)
            val imageVersionId = deterministicLegacyImageVersionId(session.import_session_id)
            val intent = store.prepareLegacyImageImportPublication(
                importSessionId,
                app.docscan.core.model.WorkspaceId.parse(session.workspace_id),
                displayName,
                mimeType,
                artifactId,
                pageId,
                imageVersionId,
            )
            store.commitImageImportPublication(
                intent,
                ImportImageCommand(
                    importSessionId = importSessionId,
                    workspaceId = intent.workspaceId,
                    pageId = pageId,
                    imageVersionId = imageVersionId,
                    sourceArtifact = source,
                    mimeType = mimeType,
                    displayName = displayName,
                    desiredOperationKey = IMPORT_OCR_OPERATION_KEY,
                ),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun deterministicLegacyImagePageId(sessionId: String): app.docscan.core.model.PageId =
        app.docscan.core.model.PageId.parse(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("$sessionId:0:page".toByteArray()).toString())

    private fun deterministicLegacyImageVersionId(sessionId: String): app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId =
        app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId.parse(UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("$sessionId:0:image-version".toByteArray()).toString())

    private fun imageExtensionForMime(mimeType: String): String = when (mimeType.lowercase()) {
        "image/jpeg", "image/jpg" -> "jpg"
        "image/png" -> "png"
        "image/webp" -> "webp"
        "image/heic", "image/heif" -> "heic"
        else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported image type: $mimeType")
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.atan2
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlin.math.max

data class QuadAgreementResult(
    val agrees: Boolean,
    val iou: Double,
    val relativeCornerShift: Double,
    val maxCornerDistance: Double,
    val documentDiagonal: Double,
)

object QuadGeometryUtils {

    /**
     * Canonicalizes 4 corners into standard order:
     * [0] Top-Left (minimum x + y)
     * [1] Top-Right (clockwise)
     * [2] Bottom-Right (clockwise)
     * [3] Bottom-Left (clockwise)
     */
    fun canonicalizeCorners(points: List<NormalizedCropPoint>): List<NormalizedCropPoint> {
        require(points.size == 4) { "Must have exactly 4 points to canonicalize, got ${points.size}" }
        val cx = points.sumOf { it.x } / 4.0
        val cy = points.sumOf { it.y } / 4.0
        val clockwise = points.sortedBy { atan2(it.y - cy, it.x - cx) }
        val tlIndex = clockwise.indices.minByOrNull { clockwise[it].x + clockwise[it].y } ?: 0
        return (0 until 4).map { clockwise[(tlIndex + it) % 4] }
    }

    fun canonicalize(quad: CropQuadrilateral): CropQuadrilateral {
        val c = canonicalizeCorners(quad.asList())
        return CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = c[0],
            topRight = c[1],
            bottomRight = c[2],
            bottomLeft = c[3],
        )
    }

    /**
     * Polygon area via the standard Shoelace formula.
     */
    fun polygonArea(points: List<NormalizedCropPoint>): Double {
        if (points.size < 3) return 0.0
        var sum = 0.0
        val n = points.size
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val j = (i + 1) % n
            sum += points[i].x * points[j].y - points[j].x * points[i].y
        }
        return abs(sum) / 2.0
    }

    /**
     * Exact convex polygon intersection via Sutherland-Hodgman clipping.
     */
    fun convexPolygonIntersection(
        subjectPolygon: List<NormalizedCropPoint>,
        clipPolygon: List<NormalizedCropPoint>,
    ): List<NormalizedCropPoint> {
        if (subjectPolygon.size < 3 || clipPolygon.size < 3) return emptyList()

        var outputList = subjectPolygon

        // Ensure clip polygon is oriented counter-clockwise
        val clip = ensureCounterClockwise(clipPolygon)

        for (i in clip.indices) {
            val edgeStart = clip[i]
            val edgeEnd = clip[(i + 1) % clip.size]
            val inputList = outputList
            outputList = mutableListOf()
            if (inputList.isEmpty()) break

            var prev = inputList.last()
            for (curr in inputList) {
                if (isInside(curr, edgeStart, edgeEnd)) {
                    if (isInside(prev, edgeStart, edgeEnd)) {
                        outputList.add(curr)
                    } else {
                        outputList.add(computeIntersection(prev, curr, edgeStart, edgeEnd))
                        outputList.add(curr)
                    }
                } else if (isInside(prev, edgeStart, edgeEnd)) {
                    outputList.add(computeIntersection(prev, curr, edgeStart, edgeEnd))
                }
                prev = curr
            }
        }
        return outputList
    }

    private fun isInside(p: NormalizedCropPoint, a: NormalizedCropPoint, b: NormalizedCropPoint): Boolean {
        // Cross product of (b - a) and (p - a) >= -1e-9 for counter-clockwise boundary
        val cross = (b.x - a.x) * (p.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (p.x - a.x)
        return cross >= -1e-9
    }

    private fun computeIntersection(
        p1: NormalizedCropPoint,
        p2: NormalizedCropPoint,
        cp1: NormalizedCropPoint,
        cp2: NormalizedCropPoint,
    ): NormalizedCropPoint {
        val a1 = p2.y - p1.y
        val b1 = p1.x - p2.x
        val c1 = a1 * p1.x + b1 * p1.y

        val a2 = cp2.y - cp1.y
        val b2 = cp1.x - cp2.x
        val c2 = a2 * cp1.x + b2 * cp1.y

        val det = a1 * b2 - a2 * b1
        if (abs(det) < 1e-12) return p1 // Parallel fallback

        val x = (b2 * c1 - b1 * c2) / det
        val y = (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) / det
        return NormalizedCropPoint(x, y)
    }

    private fun ensureCounterClockwise(points: List<NormalizedCropPoint>): List<NormalizedCropPoint> {
        var signedArea = 0.0
        val n = points.size
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val j = (i + 1) % n
            signedArea += points[i].x * points[j].y - points[j].x * points[i].y
        }
        return if (signedArea >= 0.0) points else points.reversed()
    }

    /**
     * Polygon Intersection-over-Union (IoU) for two quadrilaterals.
     */
    fun polygonIoU(q1: CropQuadrilateral, q2: CropQuadrilateral): Double {
        val pts1 = q1.asList()
        val pts2 = q2.asList()
        val area1 = polygonArea(pts1)
        val area2 = polygonArea(pts2)
        if (area1 <= 0.0 || area2 <= 0.0) return 0.0

        val intersectionPolygon = convexPolygonIntersection(pts1, pts2)
        val intersectionArea = polygonArea(intersectionPolygon)
        val unionArea = area1 + area2 - intersectionArea
        if (unionArea <= 1e-9) return 0.0
        return (intersectionArea / unionArea).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
    }

    /**
     * Compares live quad vs still (JPEG) quad:
     * - Accounts for cyclic shifts to avoid false mismatches
     * - Measures maximum individual corner displacement relative to document diagonal
     * - Measures Polygon IoU
     * Distances use image-height units; imageAspectRatio restores isotropic pixels
     * when input x/y have been independently normalized. IoU is affine invariant.
     * - Thresholds: maxCornerShift <= 6% of diagonal, IoU >= 0.80
     */
    fun checkAgreement(
        liveQuad: CropQuadrilateral,
        stillQuad: CropQuadrilateral,
        maxRelativeShiftTolerance: Double = 0.06,
        minIouTolerance: Double = 0.80,
        imageAspectRatio: Double = 1.0,
    ): QuadAgreementResult {
        require(imageAspectRatio.isFinite() && imageAspectRatio > 0)
        val live = canonicalizeCorners(liveQuad.asList())
        val still = canonicalizeCorners(stillQuad.asList())

        var bestShift = 0
        var minTotalDist = Double.MAX_VALUE
        var bestMaxCornerDist = Double.MAX_VALUE

        for (shift in 0 until 4) {
            var totalDist = 0.0
            var maxDist = 0.0
            for (i in 0 until 4) {
                val d = hypot((live[i].x - still[(i + shift) % 4].x) * imageAspectRatio,
                    live[i].y - still[(i + shift) % 4].y)
                totalDist += d
                if (d > maxDist) maxDist = d
            }
            if (totalDist < minTotalDist) {
                minTotalDist = totalDist
                bestShift = shift
                bestMaxCornerDist = maxDist
            }
        }

        val d1 = hypot((still[2].x - still[0].x) * imageAspectRatio, still[2].y - still[0].y)
        val d2 = hypot((still[3].x - still[1].x) * imageAspectRatio, still[3].y - still[1].y)
        val docDiagonal = max(1e-4, max(d1, d2))

        val relativeCornerShift = bestMaxCornerDist / docDiagonal
        val iou = polygonIoU(liveQuad, stillQuad)

        val agrees = (relativeCornerShift <= maxRelativeShiftTolerance) && (iou >= minIouTolerance)

        return QuadAgreementResult(
            agrees = agrees,
            iou = iou,
            relativeCornerShift = relativeCornerShift,
            maxCornerDistance = bestMaxCornerDist,
            documentDiagonal = docDiagonal,
        )
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/QuadTemporalFilter.kt

package app.docscan.android

import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlin.math.max

/**
 * Adaptive EMA with outlier gate (2-frame jump confirmation),
 * speed-dependent alpha, and hold last contour on missing frames.
 */
class QuadTemporalFilter {
    /** True while a contour is shown; read from the analyzer thread to lower the detector threshold (hysteresis). */
    @Volatile var isTracking: Boolean = false
        private set
    private var current: FloatArray? = null
    private var missingFrames = 0
    private var rejectedJump: FloatArray? = null
    private var rejectedJumpCount = 0

    /** incoming — ready PreviewView pixels (8 floats) */
    fun update(incoming: FloatArray): FloatArray {
        require(incoming.size == 8)
        val previous = current ?: run {
            current = incoming.clone()
            missingFrames = 0
            isTracking = true
            return incoming.clone()
        }
        val displacement = normalizedDisplacement(previous, incoming)
        if (displacement > 0.20f) {
            // Large jump: false candidate OR real object switch.
            // Accept only after confirmation by a second consecutive frame.
            if (rejectedJump != null && normalizedDisplacement(rejectedJump!!, incoming) < 0.06f) {
                rejectedJumpCount++
            } else {
                rejectedJump = incoming.clone()
                rejectedJumpCount = 1
            }
            if (rejectedJumpCount < 2) {
                missingFrames++
                return previous.clone()
            }
            current = incoming.clone()
            rejectedJump = null
            rejectedJumpCount = 0
            missingFrames = 0
            isTracking = true
            return incoming.clone()
        }
        rejectedJump = null
        rejectedJumpCount = 0
        missingFrames = 0

        val alpha = when {
            displacement < 0.015f -> 0.16f // almost still — strong smoothing
            displacement < 0.05f -> 0.25f
            displacement < 0.10f -> 0.38f
            else -> 0.55f // camera moving — fast response
        }
        val result = FloatArray(8)
        for (i in 0 until 8) {
            result[i] = previous[i] + alpha * (incoming[i] - previous[i])
        }
        current = result
        return result.clone()
    }

    fun onMissing(): FloatArray? {
        val previous = current ?: return null
        missingFrames++
        if (missingFrames <= HOLD_FRAMES) return previous.clone() // anti-flicker hold, ~1 s at 10 Hz analysis
        current = null
        isTracking = false
        rejectedJump = null
        rejectedJumpCount = 0
        return null
    }

    fun reset() {
        current = null
        isTracking = false
        rejectedJump = null
        rejectedJumpCount = 0
        missingFrames = 0
    }

    /** Displacement normalized by the size of the quad itself — scale-invariant */
    private fun normalizedDisplacement(a: FloatArray, b: FloatArray): Float {
        var sideSum = 0f
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            val j = (i + 1) % 4
            sideSum += hypot(a[i * 2] - a[j * 2], a[i * 2 + 1] - a[j * 2 + 1])
        }
        val charSize = max(1f, sideSum / 4f)
        var disp = 0f
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            disp += hypot(a[i * 2] - b[i * 2], a[i * 2 + 1] - b[i * 2 + 1])
        }
        return (disp / 4f) / charSize
    }

    companion object {
        const val HOLD_FRAMES = 8
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.store.BlockType
import app.docscan.core.store.LayoutQuality
import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import app.docscan.core.store.normalizeBox
import app.docscan.core.store.sanitizeOcrText
import com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI

/**
 * Native LayoutExtractor that reads Tesseract's internal hierarchical layout structure
 * (Block -> Paragraph -> Line -> Word) directly via ResultIterator.
 * Avoids any intermediate XML/HTML serialization, tag parsing, or HTML entity decoding.
 */
class ResultIteratorLayoutExtractor {

    fun extract(
        tess: TessBaseAPI,
        pageWidth: Int,
        pageHeight: Int,
        languageHints: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    ): RecognitionLayout? {
        val iterator = tess.resultIterator ?: return null
        try {
            iterator.begin()

            class WordDraft(val text: String, val box: NormalizedBox, val confidence: Float)
            class LineDraft(val box: NormalizedBox?, val words: MutableList<WordDraft> = mutableListOf())
            class ParaDraft(val box: NormalizedBox?, val lines: MutableList<LineDraft> = mutableListOf())
            class BlockDraft(val id: String, val box: NormalizedBox?, val paragraphs: MutableList<ParaDraft> = mutableListOf())

            val blocks = mutableListOf<BlockDraft>()
            var currentBlock: BlockDraft? = null
            var currentPara: ParaDraft? = null
            var currentLine: LineDraft? = null
            var blockIndex = 0

            do {
                val isNewBlock = currentBlock == null || iterator.isAtBeginningOf(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_BLOCK)
                val isNewPara = isNewBlock || currentPara == null || iterator.isAtBeginningOf(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_PARA)
                val isNewLine = isNewPara || currentLine == null || iterator.isAtBeginningOf(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_TEXTLINE)

                if (isNewBlock) {
                    blockIndex++
                    val bBoxRaw = iterator.getBoundingBox(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_BLOCK)
                    val bBox = bBoxRaw?.let {
                        normalizeBox(it[0].toLong(), it[1].toLong(), it[2].toLong(), it[3].toLong(), pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    }
                    val block = BlockDraft(id = "block_$blockIndex", box = bBox)
                    blocks.add(block)
                    currentBlock = block
                    currentPara = null
                    currentLine = null
                }

                if (isNewPara) {
                    val pBoxRaw = iterator.getBoundingBox(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_PARA)
                    val pBox = pBoxRaw?.let {
                        normalizeBox(it[0].toLong(), it[1].toLong(), it[2].toLong(), it[3].toLong(), pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    }
                    val para = ParaDraft(box = pBox)
                    currentBlock!!.paragraphs.add(para)
                    currentPara = para
                    currentLine = null
                }

                if (isNewLine) {
                    val lBoxRaw = iterator.getBoundingBox(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_TEXTLINE)
                    val lBox = lBoxRaw?.let {
                        normalizeBox(it[0].toLong(), it[1].toLong(), it[2].toLong(), it[3].toLong(), pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    }
                    val line = LineDraft(box = lBox)
                    currentPara!!.lines.add(line)
                    currentLine = line
                }

                val wordText = iterator.getUTF8Text(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_WORD)?.trim().orEmpty()
                val sanitized = sanitizeOcrText(wordText)
                if (sanitized.isNotBlank()) {
                    val wBoxRaw = iterator.getBoundingBox(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_WORD)
                    val wBox = wBoxRaw?.let {
                        normalizeBox(it[0].toLong(), it[1].toLong(), it[2].toLong(), it[3].toLong(), pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    }
                    if (wBox != null) {
                        val conf = iterator.confidence(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_WORD).coerceIn(0f, 100f)
                        currentLine!!.words.add(WordDraft(sanitized, wBox, conf))
                    }
                }
            } while (iterator.next(TessBaseAPI.PageIteratorLevel.RIL_WORD))

            val resultBlocks = mutableListOf<OcrBlock>()
            var readingOrder = 0
            for (bDraft in blocks) {
                val paragraphs = mutableListOf<OcrParagraph>()
                for (pDraft in bDraft.paragraphs) {
                    val lines = mutableListOf<OcrLine>()
                    for (lDraft in pDraft.lines) {
                        if (lDraft.words.isNotEmpty()) {
                            val lineWords = lDraft.words.map { OcrWord(it.text, it.box, it.confidence) }
                            val lineBox = lDraft.box ?: resolveBoundingBox(lineWords.map { it.box })
                            if (lineBox != null) {
                                lines.add(OcrLine(box = lineBox, baseline = null, xHeight = null, words = lineWords))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (lines.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val paraBox = pDraft.box ?: resolveBoundingBox(lines.map { it.box })
                        if (paraBox != null) {
                            paragraphs.add(OcrParagraph(box = paraBox, lines = lines))
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (paragraphs.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val blockBox = bDraft.box ?: resolveBoundingBox(paragraphs.map { it.box })
                    if (blockBox != null) {
                        resultBlocks.add(
                            OcrBlock(
                                id = bDraft.id,
                                type = BlockType.TEXT,
                                box = blockBox,
                                readingOrder = readingOrder++,
                                paragraphs = paragraphs,
                            ),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            if (resultBlocks.isEmpty()) return null

            val allWords = resultBlocks.flatMap { it.paragraphs.flatMap { it.lines.flatMap { it.words } } }
            val meanConf = if (allWords.isEmpty()) 0f else allWords.map { it.confidence }.average().toFloat()
            val lowConfCount = allWords.count { it.confidence < 60f }
            val quality = LayoutQuality(
                meanConfidence = meanConf,
                lowConfidenceWordCount = lowConfCount,
                structureAvailable = allWords.isNotEmpty(),
                language = languageHints.firstOrNull(),
            )
            return RecognitionLayout(
                sourceWidthPx = maxOf(1, pageWidth),
                sourceHeightPx = maxOf(1, pageHeight),
                blocks = resultBlocks,
                languageHints = languageHints,
                quality = quality,
                formatVersion = 2,
            )
        } finally {
            iterator.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun resolveBoundingBox(boxes: List<NormalizedBox>): NormalizedBox? {
        if (boxes.isEmpty()) return null
        val minL = boxes.minOf { it.left }.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val minT = boxes.minOf { it.top }.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val maxR = boxes.maxOf { it.right }.coerceIn(minL + 0.0001f, 1f)
        val maxB = boxes.maxOf { it.bottom }.coerceIn(minT + 0.0001f, 1f)
        return NormalizedBox(minL, minT, maxR, maxB)
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import app.docscan.core.store.DestinationGrantSnapshot

/** Owns Android URI permission I/O; StateStore calls happen only after these checks complete. */
class SafDestinationGrantManager(context: Context) {
    private val appContext = context.applicationContext

    fun persistTreeGrant(uri: Uri?, returnedFlags: Int): String {
        require(uri != null && uri.scheme == "content" && DocumentsContract.isTreeUri(uri)) {
            "Picker did not return a valid SAF tree URI"
        }
        val accessFlags = returnedFlags and (Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION)
        require(accessFlags and Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION != 0
            && accessFlags and Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION != 0
            && returnedFlags and Intent.FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION != 0
        ) { "SAF provider did not return persistable read/write access" }

        appContext.contentResolver.takePersistableUriPermission(uri, accessFlags)
        check(hasPersistedReadWriteGrant(uri)) { "SAF read/write permission did not persist" }
        return uri.toString()
    }

    /** Revalidate OS-owned authority outside SQLite; updates the verification timestamp after success. */
    fun revalidate(grant: DestinationGrantSnapshot, storage: ProductStorage): Boolean {
        val uri = runCatching { Uri.parse(grant.treeUri) }.getOrNull() ?: return false
        if (uri.scheme != "content" || !DocumentsContract.isTreeUri(uri) || !hasPersistedReadWriteGrant(uri)) {
            return false
        }
        storage.markDestinationGrantVerified(grant.treeUri, System.currentTimeMillis())
        return true
    }

    fun releasePersistedGrant(uriString: String) {
        val uri = Uri.parse(uriString)
        val existing = appContext.contentResolver.persistedUriPermissions.firstOrNull { it.uri == uri } ?: return
        val flags = (if (existing.isReadPermission) Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION else 0) or
            (if (existing.isWritePermission) Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION else 0)
        if (flags != 0) appContext.contentResolver.releasePersistableUriPermission(uri, flags)
    }

    private fun hasPersistedReadWriteGrant(uri: Uri): Boolean =
        appContext.contentResolver.persistedUriPermissions.any {
            it.uri == uri && it.isReadPermission && it.isWritePermission
        }
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/SafExportGateway.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.ContentResolver
import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import android.provider.OpenableColumns
import app.docscan.core.model.ExportAttemptId
import app.docscan.core.export.OutputNameResolver
import app.docscan.core.export.OutputNameResolution
import app.docscan.core.store.BeginExportAttemptCommand
import app.docscan.core.store.CommittedExportOutput
import app.docscan.core.store.ExportAttemptOutcome
import app.docscan.core.store.ExportAttemptSnapshot
import app.docscan.core.store.ProviderOperationObservationCommand
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

/** Performs one qualified SAF document write; every attempt is journaled before provider I/O. */
class SafExportGateway(context: Context, private val storage: ProductStorage) {
    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    private val resolver: ContentResolver = appContext.contentResolver
    private val grants = SafDestinationGrantManager(appContext)

    fun resolveOutputNames(treeUri: String, basename: String, pageCount: Int): OutputNameResolution =
        OutputNameResolver.resolve(basename, pageCount, listChildren(Uri.parse(treeUri)).map { it.displayName })

    /** Resolves a unique PDF-only name, following the editor's deterministic (1), (2) suffix rule. */
    fun resolveSinglePdfName(treeUri: String, basename: String): OutputNameResolution {
        return OutputNameResolver.resolveSinglePdfWithSuffix(
            basename,
            listChildren(Uri.parse(treeUri)).map { it.displayName },
        )
    }

    /**
     * Writes a committed output under the caller's frozen display name. Provider tuple data must
     * come from a persisted qualification record; this adapter does not qualify providers itself.
     */
    fun export(command: BeginExportAttemptCommand): Uri {
        val grant = storage.destinationGrant() ?: error("No SAF destination grant is selected")
        check(grant.treeUri == command.destinationTreeUri && grants.revalidate(grant, storage)) {
            "SAF destination grant is no longer readable and writable"
        }
        val output = storage.committedExportOutputs(command.exportArtifactId)
            .singleOrNull { it.artifactId == command.outputArtifactId }
            ?: error("Requested output is not a committed member of this export set")
        require(output.mimeType == command.mimeType) { "MIME type differs from committed output" }
        check(storage.verifyExportOutput(output)) { "Committed output failed private-file checksum verification" }
        val source = storage.exportOutputFile(output)
        check(source.isFile && source.length() == output.sizeBytes) { "Committed output is unavailable" }
        val tree = Uri.parse(command.destinationTreeUri)

        storage.beginExportAttempt(command)

        // A collision check is read-only, so a definite collision can close without side effects.
        val children = try {
            listChildren(tree)
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            storage.finishWritingExportAttempt(
                command.exportAttemptId,
                ExportAttemptOutcome.FAILED_KNOWN,
                null,
                "Destination enumeration failed before createDocument: ${failure.javaClass.simpleName}",
                true,
                observation(access = "read-only destination enumeration failed before any create/write call"),
            )
            throw failure
        }
        val nameKey = normalizedName(command.plannedDisplayName)
        val collisions = children.filter { normalizedName(it.displayName) == nameKey }
        if (collisions.isNotEmpty()) {
            storage.finishWritingExportAttempt(
                command.exportAttemptId,
                ExportAttemptOutcome.FAILED_KNOWN,
                null,
                "A destination document already has this normalized name",
                true,
                observation(
                    existence = "pre-create collision count=${collisions.size}",
                    name = "requested=${command.plannedDisplayName}; matched=${collisions.joinToString { it.displayName }}",
                    access = "tree query completed",
                ),
            )
            error("Destination already contains ${command.plannedDisplayName}")
        }

        // Once createDocument is invoked, exceptions are ambiguous: leave WritingExternal so
        // startup recovery marks UnknownOutcome and never retries the side effect blindly.
        try {
            val created = DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                resolver,
                DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)),
                command.mimeType,
                command.plannedDisplayName,
            ) ?: error("Provider returned no document URI after createDocument")
            storage.exportCreatedBeforeStreamObserverForTest?.invoke(
                command.exportAttemptId.value,
                command.exportArtifactId.value,
                command.outputArtifactId.value,
                created.toString(),
            )
            resolver.openOutputStream(created, "w")?.use { destination ->
                val firstWriteObserver = storage.exportFirstProviderWriteBoundaryObserverForTest
                val buffer = ByteArray(if (firstWriteObserver == null) 8_192 else 256)
                source.inputStream().use { input ->
                    var firstWriteObserved = false
                    while (true) {
                        val count = input.read(buffer)
                        if (count < 0) break
                        if (count == 0) continue
                        destination.write(buffer, 0, count)
                        if (!firstWriteObserved && firstWriteObserver != null) {
                            destination.flush()
                            firstWriteObserver.invoke(
                                command.exportAttemptId.value,
                                command.exportArtifactId.value,
                                command.outputArtifactId.value,
                                created.toString(),
                                count,
                                output.sizeBytes,
                                output.sha256,
                            )
                            firstWriteObserved = true
                        }
                    }
                }
            } ?: error("Provider returned no output stream")

            storage.exportStreamClosedBeforeReadBackObserverForTest?.invoke(
                command.exportAttemptId.value,
                command.exportArtifactId.value,
                command.outputArtifactId.value,
                created.toString(),
                output.sizeBytes,
                output.sha256,
            )

            val readBack = resolver.openInputStream(created)?.use(::digest)
                ?: error("Provider returned no read-back stream")
            check(readBack.sizeBytes == output.sizeBytes && readBack.sha256 == output.sha256) {
                "Provider read-back does not match committed output bytes"
            }
            val observedName = queryDisplayName(created) ?: command.plannedDisplayName
            if (normalizedName(observedName) != nameKey) {
                android.util.Log.w("SafExportGateway", "Provider assigned alternate name '$observedName' for requested '$nameKey'")
            }

            storage.exportReadBackBoundaryObserverForTest?.invoke(
                command.exportAttemptId.value,
                command.exportArtifactId.value,
                command.outputArtifactId.value,
                created.toString(),
                readBack.sha256,
            )

            storage.finishWritingExportAttempt(
                command.exportAttemptId,
                ExportAttemptOutcome.SUCCEEDED,
                created.toString(),
                null,
                false,
                observation(
                    identity = "documentUri=${created}",
                    existence = "document opened for read-back",
                    integrity = "size=${readBack.sizeBytes};sha256=${readBack.sha256}",
                    readability = "full stream read completed",
                    name = "displayName=$observedName",
                    access = "persisted tree read/write grant revalidated",
                ),
            )
            return created
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            val current = runCatching { storage.exportAttempt(command.exportAttemptId) }.getOrNull()
            if (current?.state == "WRITING_EXTERNAL") {
                runCatching {
                    storage.markWritingExportAttemptUnknown(
                        command.exportAttemptId,
                        "Provider operation became ambiguous after createDocument was invoked: ${failure.javaClass.simpleName}",
                        observation(
                            existence = "create/write may have had a side effect",
                            integrity = "read-back did not complete with matching size and SHA-256",
                            access = "outcome is unresolved; no retry performed",
                        ),
                    )
                }
            }
            throw failure
        }
    }

    /** Resolves an interrupted write only from positive read-back evidence; otherwise it stays unknown. */
    fun revalidateUnknown(exportAttemptId: ExportAttemptId): ExportAttemptSnapshot {
        val attempt = storage.exportAttempt(exportAttemptId) ?: error("Export attempt does not exist")
        check(attempt.state == "UNKNOWN_OUTCOME") { "Only UnknownOutcome attempts can be revalidated" }
        val destination = JSONObject(attempt.destinationDescriptor)
        val parameters = JSONObject(attempt.frozenProviderParameters)
        val treeUri = destination.getString("treeUri")
        val plannedName = parameters.getString("plannedDisplayName")
        val expectedSize = parameters.getLong("sizeBytes")
        val expectedHash = parameters.getString("sha256")
        val tree = Uri.parse(treeUri)
        val grant = storage.destinationGrant()
        if (grant == null || grant.treeUri != treeUri || !grants.revalidate(grant, storage)) {
            storage.revalidateUnknownExportAttempt(
                exportAttemptId, ExportAttemptOutcome.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, null, null, false,
                observation(access = "persisted destination grant unavailable during recovery"),
            )
            return storage.exportAttempt(exportAttemptId)!!
        }

        val matching = runCatching { listChildren(tree).filter { normalizedName(it.displayName) == normalizedName(plannedName) } }
            .getOrElse {
                storage.revalidateUnknownExportAttempt(
                    exportAttemptId, ExportAttemptOutcome.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, null, null, false,
                    observation(access = "provider enumeration inconclusive: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}"),
                )
                return storage.exportAttempt(exportAttemptId)!!
            }
        if (matching.size == 1) {
            val child = matching.single()
            val uri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, child.documentId)
            val readback = runCatching { resolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use(::digest) }.getOrNull()
            if (readback != null && readback.sizeBytes == expectedSize && readback.sha256 == expectedHash) {
                storage.revalidateUnknownExportAttempt(
                    exportAttemptId, ExportAttemptOutcome.SUCCEEDED, uri.toString(), null, false,
                    observation(
                        identity = "documentUri=$uri",
                        existence = "exactly one matching named document enumerated",
                        integrity = "size=${readback.sizeBytes};sha256=${readback.sha256}",
                        readability = "full stream read completed during recovery",
                        name = "displayName=${child.displayName}",
                        access = "persisted tree read/write grant revalidated",
                    ),
                )
            } else {
                storage.revalidateUnknownExportAttempt(
                    exportAttemptId, ExportAttemptOutcome.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, null, null, false,
                    observation(
                        existence = "one matching name found",
                        integrity = "read-back missing or did not match expected size/hash",
                        name = "displayName=${child.displayName}",
                        access = "grant available; document integrity unresolved",
                    ),
                )
            }
        } else {
            storage.revalidateUnknownExportAttempt(
                exportAttemptId, ExportAttemptOutcome.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, null, null, false,
                observation(
                    existence = "matching name count=${matching.size}; absence does not prove no prior side effect",
                    name = "requested=$plannedName",
                    access = "persisted tree read/write grant revalidated",
                ),
            )
        }
        return storage.exportAttempt(exportAttemptId)!!
    }

    private fun listChildren(tree: Uri): List<Child> {
        val treeId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
        val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree, treeId)
        val result = mutableListOf<Child>()
        resolver.query(childrenUri, arrayOf(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
            DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME), null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
            val idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
            val nameColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
            while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                val id = cursor.getString(idColumn) ?: continue
                val name = cursor.getString(nameColumn) ?: continue
                result += Child(id, name)
            }
        } ?: error("Provider returned no child listing")
        return result
    }

    private fun queryDisplayName(uri: Uri): String? = resolver.query(
        uri, arrayOf(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME), null, null, null,
    )?.use { cursor ->
        if (cursor.moveToFirst()) cursor.getString(cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)) else null
    }

    private fun normalizedName(value: String): String = OutputNameResolver.collisionKey(value)

    private fun digest(input: java.io.InputStream): Digest {
        val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        var size = 0L
        val buffer = ByteArray(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE)
        while (true) {
            val count = input.read(buffer)
            if (count < 0) break
            size += count
            md.update(buffer, 0, count)
        }
        return Digest(size, md.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) })
    }

    private fun observation(
        identity: String? = null,
        existence: String? = null,
        integrity: String? = null,
        readability: String? = null,
        name: String? = null,
        access: String? = null,
    ) = ProviderOperationObservationCommand(
        UUID.randomUUID().toString(), identity, existence, integrity, readability, name, access,
    )

    private data class Child(val documentId: String, val displayName: String)
    private data class Digest(val sizeBytes: Long, val sha256: String)
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.provider.DocumentsContract

/** Exact provider/build tuple used by the product's SAF destination checks. */
internal data class SafProviderIdentity(
    val providerPackage: String,
    val adapterId: String,
    val providerVersion: String,
    val osVersion: String,
    val accessClass: String,
) {
    companion object {
        fun resolve(context: Context, treeUri: String): SafProviderIdentity {
            val tree = Uri.parse(treeUri)
            require(tree.scheme == "content" && DocumentsContract.isTreeUri(tree)) {
                "Choose a valid SAF tree destination"
            }
            val documentId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
            require(documentId.startsWith("primary:")) {
                "Only shared internal storage destinations are supported"
            }
            val authority = requireNotNull(tree.authority) { "SAF tree URI has no provider authority" }
            val provider = context.packageManager.resolveContentProvider(authority, 0)
                ?: error("SAF provider package cannot be resolved")
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            val packageInfo = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(provider.packageName, 0)
            return SafProviderIdentity(
                providerPackage = provider.packageName,
                adapterId = "${ProductActivity.SAF_ADAPTER_ID}/${provider.packageName}/$authority",
                providerVersion = "${packageInfo.versionName.orEmpty()}#${packageInfo.longVersionCode}",
                osVersion = Build.FINGERPRINT,
                accessClass = ProductActivity.SAF_ACCESS_CLASS,
            )
        }
    }
}
