package app.docscan.android

import android.content.ContentResolver
import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import app.docscan.core.store.ProviderQualificationCommand
import app.docscan.core.store.ProviderQualificationSnapshot
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

internal data class SafRuntimeChild(val uri: Uri, val documentId: String, val displayName: String)

internal interface SafRuntimeProviderIo {
    fun listChildren(treeUri: Uri): List<SafRuntimeChild>
    fun createDocument(treeUri: Uri, mimeType: String, displayName: String): Uri?
    fun openOutputStream(documentUri: Uri): OutputStream?
    fun openInputStream(documentUri: Uri): InputStream?
    fun deleteDocument(documentUri: Uri): Boolean
}

internal enum class SafRuntimeCheckBoundary {
    BEFORE_ENUMERATE,
    AFTER_ENUMERATE,
    BEFORE_FIRST_CREATE,
    AFTER_FIRST_CREATE_JOURNALED,
    BEFORE_FIRST_WRITE,
    AFTER_FIRST_CLOSE,
    BEFORE_FIRST_READ_BACK,
    AFTER_FIRST_READ_BACK,
    BEFORE_DUPLICATE_CREATE,
    AFTER_DUPLICATE_CREATE_JOURNALED,
    BEFORE_DUPLICATE_READ_BACK,
    AFTER_DUPLICATE_READ_BACK,
    BEFORE_DELETE,
    AFTER_DELETE,
    BEFORE_SUCCESS_EVIDENCE_PUBLICATION,
    AFTER_SUCCESS_EVIDENCE_PUBLICATION,
    BEFORE_JOURNAL_UNLINK,
    AFTER_JOURNAL_UNLINK_BEFORE_DIRECTORY_SYNC,
    AFTER_JOURNAL_DELETE_SYNC,
    BEFORE_READY_RECORD,
}

internal fun interface SafRuntimeCheckObserver {
    fun onBoundary(boundary: SafRuntimeCheckBoundary, runId: String)

    companion object {
        val NONE = SafRuntimeCheckObserver { _, _ -> }
    }
}

/** Performs and durably records a bounded, real-provider capability check for one exact tree. */
class SafRuntimeDestinationCheck internal constructor(
    context: Context,
    private val storage: ProductStorage,
    private val providerIo: SafRuntimeProviderIo,
    private val observer: SafRuntimeCheckObserver,
) {
    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    private val evidenceDirectory = File(appContext.noBackupFilesDir, CHECK_DIRECTORY)
    private val grants = SafDestinationGrantManager(appContext)

    internal constructor(context: Context, storage: ProductStorage) : this(
        context,
        storage,
        AndroidSafRuntimeProviderIo(context.applicationContext.contentResolver),
        SafRuntimeCheckObserver.NONE,
    )

    /** Returns a supported record for this provider tuple and, for runtime evidence, this exact tree. */
    fun findReady(treeUri: String): ProviderQualificationSnapshot? {
        val identity = SafProviderIdentity.resolve(appContext, treeUri)
        val candidates = storage.providerQualificationsFor(
            identity.adapterId,
            identity.providerVersion,
            identity.osVersion,
            identity.accessClass,
        )
        return candidates.firstOrNull { isReadyRecord(it, identity, treeUri) }
    }

    /** Blocking I/O: call from a worker thread. Never records readiness unless every check and cleanup passes. */
    fun ensureReady(treeUri: String): ProviderQualificationSnapshot = synchronized(PROCESS_CHECK_LOCK) {
        ensureReadySerialized(treeUri)
    }

    private fun ensureReadySerialized(treeUri: String): ProviderQualificationSnapshot {
        check(Thread.currentThread() !== mainThread) { "SAF capability checks must run off the main thread" }
        val identity = SafProviderIdentity.resolve(appContext, treeUri)
        val grant = storage.destinationGrant() ?: error("Choose a save folder before checking it")
        check(grant.treeUri == treeUri && grants.revalidate(grant, storage)) {
            "The selected folder no longer has persisted read/write access"
        }
        findReady(treeUri)?.let { return it }
        resolvePendingChecks(treeUri, identity)

        val runId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val plannedName = "docscan-runtime-check-$runId.txt"
        var journal = CheckJournal(
            runId = runId,
            treeUri = treeUri,
            identity = identity,
            plannedName = plannedName,
            phase = "PREPARED",
            baselineIds = emptySet(),
            baselineNames = emptySet(),
            ownedUris = emptyList(),
            originalUri = null,
            duplicateUri = null,
        )
        writeJournal(journal)
        try {
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_ENUMERATE, runId)
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "BASELINE_ENUMERATION_PENDING")
            val baseline = providerIo.listChildren(Uri.parse(treeUri))
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_ENUMERATE, runId)
            check(baseline.none { it.displayName == plannedName }) {
                "A random capability-check name already exists; choose the folder again"
            }
            journal = journal.copy(
                phase = "ENUMERATED",
                baselineIds = baseline.map { it.documentId }.toSet(),
                baselineNames = baseline.map { it.displayName }.toSet(),
            )
            writeJournal(journal)

            val payload = deterministicPayload()
            val expectedHash = sha256(payload)
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_FIRST_CREATE, runId)
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "FIRST_CREATE_PENDING")
            val firstUri = try {
                providerIo.createDocument(Uri.parse(treeUri), MIME_TEXT, plannedName)
                    ?: error("Provider returned no URI for the capability-check document")
            } catch (interruption: SafRuntimeCheckInterruption) {
                journal = journal.copy(
                    phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN",
                    interruptedAt = journal.phase,
                    lastError = interruption.message,
                )
                writeJournal(journal)
                throw interruption
            } catch (createFailure: Throwable) {
                resolveCreateFailure(journal, createFailure)
                throw createFailure
            }
            journal = journal.copy(phase = "FIRST_CREATE_RETURNED", originalUri = firstUri.toString())
            writeJournal(journal)

            val firstChild = identifyOwnedChild(journal, firstUri)
            if (firstChild != null) {
                journal = journal.copy(
                    phase = "FIRST_CHILD_OWNED",
                    ownedUris = journal.ownedUris + firstUri.toString(),
                )
                writeJournal(journal)
            }
            check(firstChild != null) {
                "Provider did not return a distinct child created by this check; no write was attempted"
            }
            check(firstChild.displayName == plannedName) {
                "Provider changed the requested check-document name; no bytes were written"
            }
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_FIRST_CREATE_JOURNALED, runId)

            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_FIRST_WRITE, runId)
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "FIRST_WRITE_PENDING")
            providerIo.openOutputStream(firstUri)?.use { stream ->
                stream.write(payload)
                stream.flush()
            } ?: error("Provider returned no output stream for the capability check")
            journal = journal.copy(phase = "FIRST_CLOSED")
            writeJournal(journal)
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_FIRST_CLOSE, runId)

            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_FIRST_READ_BACK, runId)
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "FIRST_READ_BACK_PENDING")
            val firstReadBack = readBounded(firstUri)
            check(firstReadBack.size == payload.size && sha256(firstReadBack) == expectedHash) {
                "Provider read-back did not match the bounded capability-check payload"
            }
            journal = journal.copy(phase = "FIRST_READ_BACK_VERIFIED", firstSha256 = expectedHash)
            writeJournal(journal)
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_FIRST_READ_BACK, runId)

            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_DUPLICATE_CREATE, runId)
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "DUPLICATE_CREATE_PENDING")
            var definiteConflict = false
            val duplicateUri = try {
                providerIo.createDocument(Uri.parse(treeUri), MIME_TEXT, plannedName)
                    ?: throw SafRuntimeCheckUnknownOutcome("Duplicate create returned no document identity")
            } catch (unknown: SafRuntimeCheckUnknownOutcome) {
                throw unknown
            } catch (duplicateFailure: Throwable) {
                journal = durablePhase(journal, "DUPLICATE_FAILURE_ENUMERATION_PENDING")
                val afterFailure = providerIo.listChildren(Uri.parse(treeUri))
                if (afterFailure.map { it.documentId }.toSet() != journal.baselineIds + firstChild.documentId) {
                    journal = journal.copy(
                        phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN",
                        interruptedAt = "DUPLICATE_CREATE_PENDING",
                        lastError = duplicateFailure.message ?: "Duplicate create changed child identities",
                    )
                    writeJournal(journal)
                    throw SafRuntimeCheckUnknownOutcome("Duplicate create may have had an unreturned side effect", duplicateFailure)
                }
                check(isDefiniteExistingNameFailure(duplicateFailure)) {
                    "Duplicate create did not prove a no-side-effect name conflict"
                }
                definiteConflict = true
                journal = durablePhase(journal, "DUPLICATE_CONFLICT_PROVED")
                null
            }
            if (duplicateUri != null) {
                journal = journal.copy(phase = "DUPLICATE_CREATE_RETURNED", duplicateUri = duplicateUri.toString())
                writeJournal(journal)
                val duplicateChild = identifyOwnedChild(journal, duplicateUri)
                if (duplicateChild != null) {
                    journal = journal.copy(
                        phase = "DUPLICATE_CHILD_OWNED",
                        ownedUris = journal.ownedUris + duplicateUri.toString(),
                    )
                    writeJournal(journal)
                }
                check(duplicateChild != null && duplicateChild.documentId != firstChild.documentId) {
                    "Duplicate create returned an existing identity; the original was not written again"
                }
                observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_DUPLICATE_CREATE_JOURNALED, runId)
            }
            check(duplicateUri != null || definiteConflict) {
                "Duplicate create did not return a distinct identity or a definite no-side-effect name conflict"
            }

            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_DUPLICATE_READ_BACK, runId)
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "DUPLICATE_READ_BACK_PENDING")
            val originalAfterDuplicate = readBounded(firstUri)
            check(originalAfterDuplicate.size == payload.size && sha256(originalAfterDuplicate) == expectedHash) {
                "Duplicate create changed the original capability-check document"
            }
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "FINAL_ENUMERATION_PENDING")
            val finalChildren = providerIo.listChildren(Uri.parse(treeUri))
            check(finalChildren.any { it.documentId == firstChild.documentId && it.displayName == plannedName }) {
                "Final child listing did not contain the original capability-check document"
            }
            if (duplicateUri != null) {
                val duplicateId = DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(duplicateUri)
                check(finalChildren.any { it.documentId == duplicateId }) {
                    "Final child listing did not contain the distinct duplicate-create result"
                }
            } else {
                check(finalChildren.map { it.documentId }.toSet() == journal.baselineIds + firstChild.documentId) {
                    "Final child listing changed unexpectedly after a rejected duplicate create"
                }
            }
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_DUPLICATE_READ_BACK, runId)

            journal = journal.copy(phase = "CHECKS_PASSED")
            writeJournal(journal)
            cleanupOwned(journal)
            journal = journal.copy(phase = "CLEANED")
            writeJournal(journal)

            val evidence = JSONObject()
                .put("schema", EVIDENCE_SCHEMA)
                .put("runId", runId)
                .put("provenance", RUNTIME_PROVENANCE)
                .put("formalQualification", false)
                .put("treeUri", treeUri)
                .put("providerPackage", identity.providerPackage)
                .put("adapterId", identity.adapterId)
                .put("providerVersion", identity.providerVersion)
                .put("osVersion", identity.osVersion)
                .put("accessClass", identity.accessClass)
                .put("validationSuiteVersion", SUITE_VERSION)
                .put("plannedName", plannedName)
                .put("baselineChildIds", JSONArray(journal.baselineIds.sorted()))
                .put("payloadByteCount", payload.size)
                .put("payloadSha256", expectedHash)
                .put("firstDocumentId", firstChild.documentId)
                .put("firstDocumentName", firstChild.displayName)
                .put("duplicateOutcome", if (duplicateUri == null) "DEFINITE_NAME_CONFLICT" else "DISTINCT_IDENTITY")
                .put("originalHashAfterDuplicate", sha256(originalAfterDuplicate))
                .put("finalListingVerified", true)
                .put("ownedCleanupVerified", true)
                .put("capabilities", JSONObject()
                    .put("createDoesNotOverwriteExistingDocument", true)
                    .put("enumerateChildren", true)
                    .put("readBackSha256", true))
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_SUCCESS_EVIDENCE_PUBLICATION, runId)
            val evidenceFile = writeEvidence(runId, evidence)
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_SUCCESS_EVIDENCE_PUBLICATION, runId)
            val evidenceHash = sha256(evidenceFile.readBytes())
            val capabilities = JSONObject()
                .put("provenance", RUNTIME_PROVENANCE)
                .put("formalQualification", false)
                .put("treeUri", treeUri)
                .put("suiteVersion", SUITE_VERSION)
                .put("evidencePath", evidenceFile.absolutePath)
                .put("evidenceSha256", evidenceHash)
                .put("capabilities", evidence.getJSONObject("capabilities"))
            // No provider or journal I/O may fail after operational readiness is committed.
            deleteJournal(runId)
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_READY_RECORD, runId)
            val command = ProviderQualificationCommand(
                qualificationId = "runtime-$runId",
                adapterId = identity.adapterId,
                providerVersion = identity.providerVersion,
                osVersion = identity.osVersion,
                destinationAccessClass = identity.accessClass,
                validationSuiteVersion = SUITE_VERSION,
                qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload = capabilities.toString(),
            )
            return storage.recordRuntimeProviderAssessment(command)
        } catch (interruption: SafRuntimeCheckInterruption) {
            journal = journal.copy(
                phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN",
                interruptedAt = journal.phase,
                lastError = interruption.message,
            )
            writeJournal(journal)
            throw interruption
        } catch (unknown: SafRuntimeCheckUnknownOutcome) {
            journal = journal.copy(
                phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN",
                interruptedAt = journal.interruptedAt ?: journal.phase,
                lastError = unknown.message,
            )
            writeJournal(journal)
            writeFailureEvidence(journal, unknown)
            throw unknown
        } catch (caught: Throwable) {
            runCatching { safeResolveAndCleanCurrent(journal) }
                .onFailure { caught.addSuppressed(it) }
            writeFailureEvidence(journal, caught)
            throw caught
        }
    }

    private fun isReadyRecord(
        record: ProviderQualificationSnapshot,
        identity: SafProviderIdentity,
        treeUri: String,
    ): Boolean = runCatching {
        if (!hasThreeCapabilities(JSONObject(record.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload))) return false
        val payload = JSONObject(record.qualifiedCapabilitiesPayload)
        if (payload.optString("provenance") != RUNTIME_PROVENANCE) {
            return !payload.has("fixtureOnly")
                && (!payload.has("formalQualification") || payload.optBoolean("formalQualification"))
        }
        if (payload.optBoolean("formalQualification", true)) return false
        if (payload.optString("treeUri") != treeUri || payload.optString("suiteVersion") != SUITE_VERSION) return false
        if (record.validationSuiteVersion != SUITE_VERSION) return false
        val evidenceFile = evidenceFileFromPayload(payload) ?: return false
        val expectedHash = payload.optString("evidenceSha256")
        if (!expectedHash.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}")) || !evidenceFile.isFile) return false
        if (sha256(evidenceFile.readBytes()) != expectedHash) return false
        val sidecar = File(evidenceDirectory, evidenceFile.nameWithoutExtension + ".sha256")
        if (!sidecar.isFile || sidecar.readText().trim() != expectedHash) return false
        val evidence = JSONObject(evidenceFile.readText())
        evidence.optString("provenance") == RUNTIME_PROVENANCE
            && !evidence.optBoolean("formalQualification", true)
            && evidence.optString("runId").isNotBlank()
            && evidence.optString("treeUri") == treeUri
            && evidence.optString("providerPackage") == identity.providerPackage
            && evidence.optString("adapterId") == identity.adapterId
            && evidence.optString("providerVersion") == identity.providerVersion
            && evidence.optString("osVersion") == identity.osVersion
            && evidence.optString("accessClass") == identity.accessClass
            && evidence.optString("validationSuiteVersion") == SUITE_VERSION
            && hasThreeCapabilities(evidence.optJSONObject("capabilities") ?: JSONObject())
            && evidence.optBoolean("ownedCleanupVerified", false)
    }.getOrDefault(false)

    private fun resolvePendingChecks(treeUri: String, identity: SafProviderIdentity) {
        if (!evidenceDirectory.exists()) return
        val pendingFiles = evidenceDirectory.listFiles()
            ?.filter { it.isFile && it.name.startsWith("pending-") && it.name.endsWith(".json") }
            .orEmpty()
        pendingFiles.forEach { file ->
            val journal = readJournal(file)
            if (journal.treeUri != treeUri) return@forEach
            check(journal.identity == identity) {
                "A previous capability check belongs to a different provider build; choose another folder or resolve its pending document manually"
            }
            val plannedPresent = listChildren(journal, "PENDING_RESOLUTION_ENUMERATION_PENDING").any {
                it.displayName == journal.plannedName
            }
            val duplicateCreateUnresolved = journal.phase in setOf(
                "FIRST_CREATE_PENDING",
                "DUPLICATE_CREATE_PENDING",
                "DUPLICATE_FAILURE_ENUMERATION_PENDING",
            ) || (journal.phase == "PENDING_UNKNOWN" && journal.interruptedAt in setOf(
                    "FIRST_CREATE_PENDING",
                    "DUPLICATE_CREATE_PENDING",
                    "DUPLICATE_FAILURE_ENUMERATION_PENDING",
                    "DUPLICATE_CREATE_RETURNED",
                ))
            val unownedReturnedDuplicate = journal.duplicateUri != null && journal.duplicateUri !in journal.ownedUris
            if (plannedPresent && (duplicateCreateUnresolved || unownedReturnedDuplicate)
            ) {
                error("A previous capability check has an unresolved provider document; choose another folder or remove it manually")
            }
            if (journal.phase == "CLEANUP_REQUIRED" || journal.ownedUris.isNotEmpty()) {
                cleanupOwned(journal)
                deleteJournal(journal.runId)
            } else if (plannedPresent) {
                error("A previous capability check may have created a document; choose another folder or remove it manually")
            } else {
                writeFailureEvidence(journal, IOException("Interrupted before any provider child was observed"))
                deleteJournal(journal.runId)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun resolveCreateFailure(journal: CheckJournal, failure: Throwable) {
        val children = runCatching { listChildren(journal, "CREATE_FAILURE_ENUMERATION_PENDING") }.getOrElse {
            val unknown = journal.copy(
                phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN",
                interruptedAt = journal.phase,
                lastError = failure.message,
            )
            writeJournal(unknown)
            throw IOException("Provider create outcome is unknown; no retry was attempted", it)
        }
        if (children.any { it.displayName == journal.plannedName }) {
            writeJournal(journal.copy(phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN", interruptedAt = journal.phase, lastError = failure.message))
            throw IOException("Provider create outcome is unknown; choose another folder or resolve the pending document manually", failure)
        }
        writeFailureEvidence(journal, failure)
        deleteJournal(journal.runId)
    }

    private fun safeResolveAndCleanCurrent(journal: CheckJournal) {
        var current = journal
        val duplicateUri = current.duplicateUri?.let(Uri::parse)
        if (duplicateUri != null && duplicateUri.toString() !in current.ownedUris) {
            val duplicateId = runCatching { DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(duplicateUri) }.getOrNull()
            val originalId = current.originalUri?.let(Uri::parse)
                ?.let { runCatching { DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(it) }.getOrNull() }
            if (duplicateId != null && duplicateId != originalId && duplicateId !in current.baselineIds) {
                val listed = runCatching {
                    listChildren(current, "RESOLVE_DUPLICATE_RETURN_PENDING")
                        .singleOrNull { it.documentId == duplicateId }
                }.getOrElse { failure ->
                    writeJournal(current.copy(
                        phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN",
                        interruptedAt = current.phase,
                        lastError = "Could not identify returned duplicate: ${failure.message}",
                    ))
                    throw IOException("Duplicate-create identity is unresolved; no cleanup by name was attempted", failure)
                }
                if (listed != null) {
                    current = current.copy(ownedUris = current.ownedUris + duplicateUri.toString())
                    writeJournal(current)
                } else {
                    if (current.ownedUris.isNotEmpty()) cleanupOwned(current)
                    writeJournal(current.copy(
                        phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN",
                        interruptedAt = current.phase,
                        lastError = "Returned duplicate identity was not independently listed",
                    ))
                    throw IOException("Duplicate-create result is not independently identifiable; choose another folder or resolve it manually")
                }
            }
        }
        if (current.ownedUris.isNotEmpty()) {
            cleanupOwned(current)
            deleteJournal(current.runId)
            return
        }
        val children = listChildren(current, "FAILURE_RESOLUTION_ENUMERATION_PENDING")
        if (children.none { it.displayName == current.plannedName }) {
            val returned = current.originalUri?.let(Uri::parse)
            val returnedId = returned?.let { runCatching { DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(it) }.getOrNull() }
            if (returnedId != null && returnedId !in current.baselineIds
                && returnedId != DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(Uri.parse(current.treeUri))) {
                writeJournal(current.copy(phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN", interruptedAt = current.phase, lastError = "Returned URI was not independently identified as an owned child"))
                throw IOException("Provider returned an unverified new identity; no cleanup or readiness was claimed")
            }
            deleteJournal(current.runId)
        } else {
            writeJournal(current.copy(phase = "PENDING_UNKNOWN", interruptedAt = current.phase, lastError = current.lastError ?: "Unowned planned name is present"))
            throw IOException("Provider outcome is unknown; no cleanup by name was attempted")
        }
    }

    private fun identifyOwnedChild(journal: CheckJournal, uri: Uri): SafRuntimeChild? {
        val tree = Uri.parse(journal.treeUri)
        if (!isDocumentInTree(uri, tree)) return null
        val id = runCatching { DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(uri) }.getOrNull() ?: return null
        if (id == DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree) || id in journal.baselineIds) return null
        return listChildren(journal, "VERIFY_RETURNED_CHILD_PENDING").singleOrNull { it.documentId == id }
    }

    private fun cleanupOwned(initial: CheckJournal) {
        var journal = initial.copy(phase = "CLEANUP_REQUIRED")
        writeJournal(journal)
        journal.ownedUris.distinct().forEach { rawUri ->
            val uri = Uri.parse(rawUri)
            val tree = Uri.parse(journal.treeUri)
            check(isDocumentInTree(uri, tree)) {
                "Owned provider URI is outside the selected document tree; cleanup is unresolved"
            }
            val id = runCatching { DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(uri) }.getOrNull()
                ?: error("Owned provider URI is not a document URI; cleanup is unresolved")
            check(id != DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)) {
                "Refusing to delete the selected folder itself"
            }
            val listedBefore = listChildren(journal, "OWNED_CLEANUP_ENUMERATION_PENDING").any { it.documentId == id }
            if (!listedBefore) return@forEach
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_DELETE, journal.runId)
            journal = durablePhase(journal, "OWNED_DELETE_PENDING")
            check(providerIo.deleteDocument(uri)) { "Provider refused cleanup of a document created by this check" }
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_DELETE, journal.runId)
            check(listChildren(journal, "VERIFY_OWNED_DELETE_PENDING").none { it.documentId == id }) {
                "Provider cleanup did not remove the document created by this check"
            }
            journal = journal.copy(phase = "CLEANUP_REQUIRED")
            writeJournal(journal)
        }
    }

    private fun isDocumentInTree(documentUri: Uri, treeUri: Uri): Boolean =
        documentUri.scheme == "content"
            && documentUri.authority == treeUri.authority
            && DocumentsContract.isDocumentUri(appContext, documentUri)
            && runCatching {
                DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(documentUri) == DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(treeUri)
            }.getOrDefault(false)

    private fun readBounded(uri: Uri): ByteArray {
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        providerIo.openInputStream(uri)?.use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(4_096)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                if (count == 0) continue
                check(output.size() + count <= MAX_READ_BACK_BYTES) { "Provider read-back exceeded the probe bound" }
                output.write(buffer, 0, count)
            }
        } ?: error("Provider returned no read-back stream")
        return output.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun durablePhase(journal: CheckJournal, phase: String): CheckJournal =
        journal.copy(phase = phase).also(::writeJournal)

    private fun listChildren(journal: CheckJournal, phase: String): List<SafRuntimeChild> {
        durablePhase(journal, phase)
        return providerIo.listChildren(Uri.parse(journal.treeUri))
    }

    private fun writeEvidence(runId: String, evidence: JSONObject): File {
        evidenceDirectory.mkdirs()
        val evidenceFile = File(evidenceDirectory, "evidence-$runId.json")
        writeAtomic(evidenceFile, evidence.toString().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val hashFile = File(evidenceDirectory, "evidence-$runId.sha256")
        writeAtomic(hashFile, (sha256(evidenceFile.readBytes()) + "\n").toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        return evidenceFile
    }

    private fun writeFailureEvidence(journal: CheckJournal, failure: Throwable) {
        val evidence = JSONObject()
            .put("schema", EVIDENCE_SCHEMA)
            .put("runId", journal.runId)
            .put("provenance", RUNTIME_PROVENANCE)
            .put("formalQualification", false)
            .put("treeUri", journal.treeUri)
            .put("adapterId", journal.identity.adapterId)
            .put("providerVersion", journal.identity.providerVersion)
            .put("osVersion", journal.identity.osVersion)
            .put("accessClass", journal.identity.accessClass)
            .put("validationSuiteVersion", SUITE_VERSION)
            .put("phase", journal.phase)
            .put("plannedName", journal.plannedName)
            .put("ownedUris", JSONArray(journal.ownedUris))
            .put("failure", failure.javaClass.name + ": " + (failure.message ?: ""))
        runCatching { writeEvidence("failed-${journal.runId}", evidence) }
    }

    private fun writeJournal(journal: CheckJournal) {
        evidenceDirectory.mkdirs()
        val json = JSONObject()
            .put("schema", JOURNAL_SCHEMA)
            .put("runId", journal.runId)
            .put("treeUri", journal.treeUri)
            .put("providerPackage", journal.identity.providerPackage)
            .put("adapterId", journal.identity.adapterId)
            .put("providerVersion", journal.identity.providerVersion)
            .put("osVersion", journal.identity.osVersion)
            .put("accessClass", journal.identity.accessClass)
            .put("plannedName", journal.plannedName)
            .put("phase", journal.phase)
            .put("baselineIds", JSONArray(journal.baselineIds.sorted()))
            .put("baselineNames", JSONArray(journal.baselineNames.sorted()))
            .put("ownedUris", JSONArray(journal.ownedUris))
            .put("originalUri", journal.originalUri)
            .put("duplicateUri", journal.duplicateUri)
            .put("firstSha256", journal.firstSha256)
            .put("lastError", journal.lastError)
            .put("interruptedAt", journal.interruptedAt)
        writeAtomic(journalFile(journal.runId), json.toString().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
    }

    private fun readJournal(file: File): CheckJournal {
        val json = JSONObject(file.readText())
        check(json.optInt("schema") == JOURNAL_SCHEMA) { "Unrecognized pending runtime capability journal: ${file.name}" }
        return CheckJournal(
            runId = json.getString("runId"),
            treeUri = json.getString("treeUri"),
            identity = SafProviderIdentity(
                providerPackage = json.getString("providerPackage"),
                adapterId = json.getString("adapterId"),
                providerVersion = json.getString("providerVersion"),
                osVersion = json.getString("osVersion"),
                accessClass = json.getString("accessClass"),
            ),
            plannedName = json.getString("plannedName"),
            phase = json.getString("phase"),
            baselineIds = json.getJSONArray("baselineIds").toStringSet(),
            baselineNames = json.getJSONArray("baselineNames").toStringSet(),
            ownedUris = json.getJSONArray("ownedUris").toStringList(),
            originalUri = json.optString("originalUri").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
            duplicateUri = json.optString("duplicateUri").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
            firstSha256 = json.optString("firstSha256").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
            lastError = json.optString("lastError").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
            interruptedAt = json.optString("interruptedAt").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
        )
    }

    private fun writeAtomic(target: File, bytes: ByteArray) {
        target.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        val temporary = File(target.parentFile, target.name + ".tmp")
        FileOutputStream(temporary).use { stream ->
            stream.write(bytes)
            stream.flush()
            stream.fd.sync()
        }
        if (!temporary.renameTo(target)) {
            temporary.delete()
            throw IOException("Could not atomically persist ${target.name}")
        }
        AndroidDirectorySync().sync(requireNotNull(target.parentFile).toPath())
    }

    private fun deleteJournal(runId: String) {
        val file = journalFile(runId)
        if (file.exists()) {
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.BEFORE_JOURNAL_UNLINK, runId)
            if (!file.delete()) throw IOException("Could not clear the completed capability-check journal")
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_JOURNAL_UNLINK_BEFORE_DIRECTORY_SYNC, runId)
            AndroidDirectorySync().sync(evidenceDirectory.toPath())
            observer.onBoundary(SafRuntimeCheckBoundary.AFTER_JOURNAL_DELETE_SYNC, runId)
        }
    }

    private fun journalFile(runId: String) = File(evidenceDirectory, "pending-$runId.json")

    private fun evidenceFileFromPayload(payload: JSONObject): File? {
        val raw = payload.optString("evidencePath").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() } ?: return null
        val candidate = File(raw).canonicalFile
        val root = evidenceDirectory.canonicalFile
        if (candidate.parentFile != root || !candidate.name.startsWith("evidence-")) return null
        return candidate
    }

    private fun hasThreeCapabilities(payload: JSONObject): Boolean {
        val capabilities = payload.optJSONObject("capabilities") ?: payload
        return capabilities.optBoolean("createDoesNotOverwriteExistingDocument", false)
            && capabilities.optBoolean("enumerateChildren", false)
            && capabilities.optBoolean("readBackSha256", false)
    }

    private fun isDefiniteExistingNameFailure(failure: Throwable): Boolean {
        val text = generateSequence(failure) { it.cause }
            .joinToString(" ") { "${it.javaClass.simpleName} ${it.message.orEmpty()}" }
            .lowercase()
        return listOf("filealreadyexists", "eexist", "already exists", "already exist", "duplicate", "name conflict")
            .any(text::contains)
    }

    private fun deterministicPayload(): ByteArray = ByteArray(PAYLOAD_BYTES) { index ->
        ((index * 31 + index / 251 + 17) and 0xff).toByte()
    }

    private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        .digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

    private data class CheckJournal(
        val runId: String,
        val treeUri: String,
        val identity: SafProviderIdentity,
        val plannedName: String,
        val phase: String,
        val baselineIds: Set<String>,
        val baselineNames: Set<String>,
        val ownedUris: List<String>,
        val originalUri: String?,
        val duplicateUri: String?,
        val firstSha256: String? = null,
        val lastError: String? = null,
        val interruptedAt: String? = null,
    )

    private fun JSONArray.toStringList(): List<String> = (0 until length()).map { getString(it) }
    private fun JSONArray.toStringSet(): Set<String> = toStringList().toSet()

    private class AndroidSafRuntimeProviderIo(private val resolver: ContentResolver) : SafRuntimeProviderIo {
        override fun listChildren(treeUri: Uri): List<SafRuntimeChild> {
            val treeId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(treeUri)
            val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(treeUri, treeId)
            val result = mutableListOf<SafRuntimeChild>()
            resolver.query(childrenUri, arrayOf(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID,
                DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME), null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
                val idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
                val nameColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    val id = cursor.getString(idColumn) ?: continue
                    result += SafRuntimeChild(
                        DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(treeUri, id),
                        id,
                        cursor.getString(nameColumn).orEmpty(),
                    )
                }
            } ?: throw IOException("Provider did not return a child listing")
            return result
        }

        override fun createDocument(treeUri: Uri, mimeType: String, displayName: String): Uri? {
            val parent = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(
                treeUri,
                DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(treeUri),
            )
            return DocumentsContract.createDocument(resolver, parent, mimeType, displayName)
        }

        override fun openOutputStream(documentUri: Uri): OutputStream? = resolver.openOutputStream(documentUri, "w")

        override fun openInputStream(documentUri: Uri): InputStream? = resolver.openInputStream(documentUri)

        override fun deleteDocument(documentUri: Uri): Boolean = DocumentsContract.deleteDocument(resolver, documentUri)
    }

    companion object {
        internal const val CHECK_DIRECTORY = "saf-runtime-destination-checks"
        internal const val SUITE_VERSION = "RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_CHECK_V1"
        private const val RUNTIME_PROVENANCE = "RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_CHECK"
        private const val EVIDENCE_SCHEMA = 1
        private const val JOURNAL_SCHEMA = 1
        private const val MIME_TEXT = "text/plain"
        private const val PAYLOAD_BYTES = 64 * 1024
        private const val MAX_READ_BACK_BYTES = PAYLOAD_BYTES + 1
        private val mainThread = android.os.Looper.getMainLooper().thread
        private val PROCESS_CHECK_LOCK = Any()
    }
}

/** Test-only process interruption marker; deliberately bypasses normal failure cleanup. */
internal class SafRuntimeCheckInterruption(message: String) : Error(message)

/** A provider effect may have occurred without returning enough identity evidence to clean it safely. */
internal class SafRuntimeCheckUnknownOutcome(message: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : IOException(message, cause)

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.io.MemoryUsageSetting
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.rendering.PDFRenderer
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

data class SavedPdfEditOutput(
    val file: File,
    val pageCount: Int,
    val sizeBytes: Long,
    val sha256: String,
    val sourceSha256: String,
)

/** Composes a new PDF from ordered pages of a checksum-verified immutable local source. */
class SavedPdfEditComposer(context: Context) {
    private val appContext = context.applicationContext

    fun compose(
        sourceFile: File,
        expectedPageCount: Int,
        orderedSourcePageIndexes: List<Int>,
        scheduler: HeavyWorkScheduler,
    ): SavedPdfEditOutput {
        require(expectedPageCount in 1..MAX_PAGES)
        require(orderedSourcePageIndexes.isNotEmpty()) { "Cannot save an empty edited PDF" }
        require(orderedSourcePageIndexes.distinct().size == orderedSourcePageIndexes.size) {
            "Edited PDF page order contains duplicates"
        }
        require(orderedSourcePageIndexes.all { it in 0 until expectedPageCount }) {
            "Edited PDF page order refers to a missing source page"
        }
        require(sourceFile.isFile && sourceFile.length() > 0L) { "Saved PDF source is unavailable" }

        val sourceHash = sha256(sourceFile)
        val output = File(appContext.cacheDir, "saved-pdf-edit-${UUID.randomUUID()}.pdf")
        check(!output.exists()) { "Temporary edited-PDF path already exists" }
        return try {
            scheduler.withAdmission(PDF_EDIT_RESERVATION_BYTES) {
                PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(appContext)
                PDDocument.load(sourceFile, MemoryUsageSetting.setupTempFileOnly()).use { source ->
                    check(source.numberOfPages == expectedPageCount) {
                        "Saved PDF page count differs from its recent-document record"
                    }
                    val originalPages = (0 until source.numberOfPages).map(source::getPage)
                    val expectedPageText = orderedSourcePageIndexes.map { sourceIndex -> pageText(source, sourceIndex) }
                    while (source.numberOfPages > 0) source.removePage(0)
                    orderedSourcePageIndexes.forEach { sourceIndex ->
                        source.addPage(originalPages[sourceIndex])
                    }
                    source.save(output)
                    FileOutputStream(output, true).use { it.fd.sync() }
                    validateOutput(output, expectedPageText)
                }
            }
            check(sha256(sourceFile) == sourceHash) { "Original saved PDF changed during editing" }
            SavedPdfEditOutput(output, orderedSourcePageIndexes.size, output.length(), sha256(output), sourceHash)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            output.delete()
            throw failure
        }
    }

    private fun validateOutput(output: File, expectedPageText: List<String>) {
        PDDocument.load(output, MemoryUsageSetting.setupTempFileOnly()).use { result ->
            check(result.numberOfPages == expectedPageText.size) {
                "Edited PDF read-back page count differs from the edit order"
            }
            val renderer = PDFRenderer(result)
            expectedPageText.indices.forEach { index ->
                check(normalizeText(pageText(result, index)) == normalizeText(expectedPageText[index])) {
                    "Edited PDF page ${index + 1} text differs from its selected source page"
                }
                val rendered = renderer.renderImage(index, 0.125f)
                try {
                    check(rendered.width > 0 && rendered.height > 0) {
                        "Edited PDF page ${index + 1} failed render validation"
                    }
                } finally {
                    rendered.recycle()
                }
            }
        }
        check(output.isFile && output.length() > 0L) { "Edited PDF is empty after read-back" }
    }

    private fun pageText(document: PDDocument, pageIndex: Int): String = PDFTextStripper().apply {
        startPage = pageIndex + 1
        endPage = pageIndex + 1
    }.getText(document)

    private fun normalizeText(value: String): String = value.trim().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")

    private fun sha256(file: File): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        file.inputStream().buffered().use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
            while (true) {
                val read = input.read(buffer)
                if (read < 0) break
                digest.update(buffer, 0, read)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_PAGES = 500
        const val PDF_EDIT_RESERVATION_BYTES = 24L * 1024L * 1024L
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Matrix
import android.graphics.pdf.PdfRenderer
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import java.io.File
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

data class RenderedSavedPdfPage(
    val bitmap: Bitmap,
    val pageCount: Int,
    val pageIndex: Int,
)

/** Renders one page at a time from an immutable, checksum-verified local PDF output. */
object SavedPdfPageRenderer {
    const val MAX_LONG_SIDE_PX = 1600

    fun renderPage(
        file: File,
        expectedPageCount: Int,
        pageIndex: Int,
        scheduler: app.docscan.core.schedule.HeavyWorkScheduler,
    ): RenderedSavedPdfPage {
        require(expectedPageCount > 0 && pageIndex in 0 until expectedPageCount)
        ParcelFileDescriptor.open(file, ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_ONLY).use { descriptor ->
            PdfRenderer(descriptor).use { renderer ->
                check(renderer.pageCount == expectedPageCount) {
                    "Saved PDF page count differs from its confirmed export record"
                }
                renderer.openPage(pageIndex).use { page ->
                    val sourceLongSide = max(page.width, page.height)
                    val scale = (MAX_LONG_SIDE_PX.toFloat() / sourceLongSide).coerceAtMost(1f)
                    val width = (page.width * scale).roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
                    val height = (page.height * scale).roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
                    val reservation = Math.addExact(width.toLong() * height * 4L, RENDER_OVERHEAD_BYTES)
                    val bitmap = scheduler.withAdmission(reservation) {
                        val target = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                        try {
                            page.render(
                                target,
                                null,
                                Matrix().apply { setScale(width.toFloat() / page.width, height.toFloat() / page.height) },
                                PdfRenderer.Page.RENDER_MODE_FOR_DISPLAY,
                            )
                            target
                        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                            target.recycle()
                            throw failure
                        }
                    }
                    return RenderedSavedPdfPage(bitmap, renderer.pageCount, pageIndex)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private const val RENDER_OVERHEAD_BYTES = 8L * 1024L * 1024L
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/SearchablePdfWriter.kt

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toOcrLayout
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionGeometry
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.io.MemoryUsageSetting
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.common.PDRectangle
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.font.PDType0Font
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.image.JPEGFactory
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.state.RenderingMode
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.util.Matrix
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE

data class PdfOutputSettings(
    val a4ShortSidePoints: Float,
    val a4LongSidePoints: Float,
    val jpegQuality: Float,
    val jpegResolutionDpi: Int,
    val includeImage: Boolean = true,
) {
    init {
        require(a4ShortSidePoints > 0f && a4LongSidePoints >= a4ShortSidePoints)
        require(jpegQuality in 0f..1f)
        require(jpegResolutionDpi > 0)
    }
}

data class PdfInputPage(
    val openBitmap: () -> Bitmap,
    val recognition: RecognitionGeometry? = null,
    val layout: app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout? = null,
    val text: String? = null,
)

data class PdfWriteResult(val pageCount: Int, val fileSizeBytes: Long, val warnings: List<String> = emptyList())

/** PDF writer candidate. Output stays local; SAF export is owned by the later workflow. */
class SearchablePdfWriter(context: Context) {
    private val appContext = context.applicationContext

    fun write(
        destination: File,
        pages: List<PdfInputPage>,
        settings: PdfOutputSettings,
    ): PdfWriteResult {
        require(pages.isNotEmpty()) { "PDF requires at least one frozen Page" }
        require(!destination.exists()) { "PDF destination already exists" }
        val parent = destination.absoluteFile.parentFile
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("PDF destination has no parent directory")
        require(parent.isDirectory || parent.mkdirs()) { "PDF output directory cannot be created" }
        val temporary = File(parent, ".${destination.name}.${System.nanoTime()}.building")
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(appContext)
        var publicationWarnings = emptyList<String>()
        try {
            PDDocument(MemoryUsageSetting.setupTempFileOnly()).use { document ->
                val font = resolveFont(document)
                val glyphCache = HashMap<Int, Boolean>()
                val warnings = mutableListOf<String>()
                pages.forEach { source ->
                    val bitmap = source.openBitmap()
                    try {
                        addPage(document, bitmap, source.recognition, source.layout, source.text, settings, font, glyphCache, warnings)
                    } finally {
                        bitmap.recycle()
                    }
                }
                document.save(temporary)
                publicationWarnings = warnings.toList()
            }
            FileOutputStream(temporary, true).use { it.fd.sync() }
            Files.move(temporary.toPath(), destination.toPath(), ATOMIC_MOVE)
            return PdfWriteResult(pages.size, destination.length(), publicationWarnings)
        } finally {
            if (temporary.exists()) check(temporary.delete()) { "Incomplete PDF temporary file cannot be removed" }
        }
    }

    private fun addPage(
        document: PDDocument,
        bitmap: Bitmap,
        recognition: RecognitionGeometry?,
        layout: app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout?,
        textFallback: String?,
        settings: PdfOutputSettings,
        font: PDType0Font?,
        cache: HashMap<Int, Boolean>,
        warnings: MutableList<String>,
    ) {
        if (recognition != null) {
            require(recognition.sourceWidthPx == bitmap.width.toLong()
                && recognition.sourceHeightPx == bitmap.height.toLong()
                && recognition.coordinateSpace == app.docscan.core.store.OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE
                && recognition.formatVersion == 1L
            ) { "OCR geometry does not match the oriented PDF source bitmap" }
        }
        if (layout != null) require(layout.sourceWidthPx == bitmap.width && layout.sourceHeightPx == bitmap.height) {
            "OCR layout does not match the oriented PDF source bitmap"
        }
        val plainText = layout?.plainText?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: textFallback
        val layoutCandidate = layout?.takeUnless { it.quality?.structureAvailable == false }?.toOcrLayout()
            ?.takeIf { it.words.any { word -> word.text.isNotBlank() } }
        fun layoutText(value: app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout): String = value.blocks.joinToString("\n\n") { block ->
            block.paras.joinToString("\n\n") { paragraph ->
                paragraph.lines.joinToString("\n") { line -> line.words.joinToString(" ") { it.text } }
            }
        }
        // A partial positional extraction must not silently discard the remaining plain text.
        val ocrLayout = layoutCandidate?.takeIf {
            plainText.isNullOrBlank() || normalizedTextContent(layoutText(it)) == normalizedTextContent(plainText)
        }
        val legacyGeometry = recognition?.takeIf { layout == null }
        val structuredText = ocrLayout?.let(::layoutText)
            ?: legacyGeometry?.words?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.joinToString(" ") { it.text }
        val rawText = structuredText ?: plainText.orEmpty()
        val hasText = rawText.isNotBlank()
        if (settings.includeImage && hasText && ocrLayout == null && legacyGeometry?.words.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            warnings += "Page ${document.numberOfPages + 1}: text is available without reliable source positions"
        }
        require(settings.includeImage || hasText) { "Text-only PDF requires recognized text on every page" }
        check(!hasText || font != null) { "PDF text font is unavailable" }
        val supportedText = font?.safeText(rawText, cache).orEmpty()
        val expectedContent = normalizedTextContent(supportedText)
        if (hasText && normalizedTextContent(rawText) != expectedContent) {
            warnings += "Page ${document.numberOfPages + 1}: bundled font cannot represent some recognized glyphs"
        }
        check(settings.includeImage || expectedContent.isNotEmpty()) { "Recognized text has no supported PDF glyphs" }
        val pageWidth = if (bitmap.width >= bitmap.height) settings.a4LongSidePoints else settings.a4ShortSidePoints
        val pageHeight = if (bitmap.width >= bitmap.height) settings.a4ShortSidePoints else settings.a4LongSidePoints
        val scale = minOf(pageWidth / bitmap.width, pageHeight / bitmap.height)
        val imageWidth = bitmap.width * scale
        val imageHeight = bitmap.height * scale
        val offsetX = (pageWidth - imageWidth) / 2f
        val offsetY = (pageHeight - imageHeight) / 2f
        val page = PDPage(PDRectangle(pageWidth, pageHeight))
        document.addPage(page)

        PDPageContentStream(document, page).use { cs ->
            if (settings.includeImage) {
                val image = JPEGFactory.createFromImage(document, bitmap, settings.jpegQuality, settings.jpegResolutionDpi)
                cs.drawImage(image, offsetX, offsetY, imageWidth, imageHeight)
            }
            if (font != null && expectedContent.isNotEmpty()) {
                val renderingMode = if (settings.includeImage) RenderingMode.NEITHER else RenderingMode.FILL
                if (!settings.includeImage) cs.setNonStrokingColor(0f, 0f, 0f)
                val ascent = font.fontDescriptor.ascent.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it > 0f } ?: 800f
                val descent = font.fontDescriptor.descent.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it <= 0f } ?: -200f
                val metricHeight = ascent - descent
                fun writeWord(raw: String, left: Float, top: Float, right: Float, bottom: Float,
                              baselineY: Float? = null, slope: Float = 0f) {
                    val text = font.safeText(raw, cache) ?: return
                    val rawHeight = bottom - top
                    val effectiveHeight = if (rawHeight > 0f) rawHeight else 12f / scale
                    val fontSize = (effectiveHeight * scale * 1000f / metricHeight).coerceIn(4f, 72f)
                    val rawWidth = right - left
                    val targetWidth = if (rawWidth > 0f) rawWidth * scale else font.getStringWidth(text) * fontSize / 1000f
                    if (fontSize <= 0f || targetWidth <= 0f || !fontSize.isFinite()) return
                    val natural = font.getStringWidth(text) * fontSize / 1000f
                    if (natural <= 0f) return
                    val yImage = baselineY ?: (bottom + descent * fontSize / (1000f * scale))
                    val angle = kotlin.math.atan(-slope.toDouble())
                    // Horizontal scaling fits the word alone. A trailing space has no bbox width.
                    val baselineWidth = targetWidth / kotlin.math.cos(angle).toFloat()
                    cs.beginText()
                    cs.setFont(font, fontSize)
                    cs.setRenderingMode(renderingMode)
                    cs.setHorizontalScaling(baselineWidth * 100f / natural)
                    cs.setTextMatrix(Matrix.getRotateInstance(
                        angle, offsetX + left * scale, offsetY + (bitmap.height - yImage) * scale,
                    ))
                    cs.showText(text)
                    cs.endText()
                }
                if (ocrLayout != null) {
                    for (block in ocrLayout.blocks) for (paragraph in block.paras) for (line in paragraph.lines) {
                        for (word in line.words) {
                            val baseline = line.baseline?.takeIf { it.slope.isFinite() && it.intercept.isFinite() }
                            val yImage = baseline?.let {
                                line.box.b + it.intercept + it.slope * (word.box.l - line.box.l)
                            }
                            writeWord(word.text, word.box.l.toFloat(), line.box.t.toFloat(), word.box.r.toFloat(),
                                line.box.b.toFloat(), yImage, baseline?.slope ?: 0f)
                        }
                    }
                } else if (legacyGeometry?.words?.isNotEmpty() == true) {
                    for (word in legacyGeometry.words) writeWord(word.text, word.leftPx.toFloat(), word.topPx.toFloat(),
                        word.rightPx.toFloat(), word.bottomPx.toFloat())
                } else {
                    val (fontSize, lines) = fitPlainText(font, plainText.orEmpty(), pageWidth - 80f, pageHeight - 80f, cache)
                    var y = pageHeight - 40f - fontSize
                    for (lineText in lines) {
                        if (lineText.isNotEmpty()) {
                            cs.beginText()
                            cs.setFont(font, fontSize)
                            cs.setRenderingMode(renderingMode)
                            cs.setHorizontalScaling(100f)
                            cs.setTextMatrix(Matrix.getTranslateInstance(40f, y))
                            cs.showText(lineText)
                            cs.endText()
                        }
                        y -= fontSize * 1.3f
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (hasText) {
            val extracted = PDFTextStripper().apply {
                startPage = document.numberOfPages
                endPage = document.numberOfPages
            }.getText(document)
            val matches = normalizedTextContent(extracted) == expectedContent
            check(settings.includeImage || extracted.isNotBlank()) {
                "Text-only PDF page ${document.numberOfPages} text layer is empty"
            }
            if (!matches) warnings += "Page ${document.numberOfPages}: extracted PDF text differs from supported recognized content"
        }
        warnings.filter { it.startsWith("Page ${document.numberOfPages}:") }.forEach {
            android.util.Log.w("SearchablePdfWriter", it)
        }
    }

    /** Plain imported text has no geometry: wrap and fit the entire input on its source page. */
    private fun fitPlainText(
        font: PDType0Font, raw: String, width: Float, height: Float, cache: HashMap<Int, Boolean>,
    ): Pair<Float, List<String>> {
        val paragraphs = raw.lines().map { font.safeText(it, cache).orEmpty() }
        check(paragraphs.any { it.isNotBlank() }) { "Recognized text has no supported PDF glyphs" }
        fun wrap(size: Float): List<String> = buildList {
            for (paragraph in paragraphs) {
                if (paragraph.isEmpty()) { add(""); continue }
                val line = StringBuilder()
                var lineWidth = 0f
                val widths = HashMap<Int, Float>()
                // Wrap at whitespace when possible, split long unbroken strings at code points.
                for (token in paragraph.split(Regex("\\s+"))) {
                    val tokenWidth = font.getStringWidth(token) * size / 1000f
                    val spaceWidth = font.getStringWidth(" ") * size / 1000f
                    if (line.isNotEmpty() && lineWidth + spaceWidth + tokenWidth > width) {
                        add(line.toString()); line.setLength(0); lineWidth = 0f
                    }
                    if (line.isNotEmpty()) { line.append(' '); lineWidth += spaceWidth }
                    token.codePoints().forEach { cp ->
                        val charWidth = widths.getOrPut(cp) { font.getStringWidth(String(Character.toChars(cp))) * size / 1000f }
                        if (line.isNotEmpty() && lineWidth + charWidth > width) {
                            add(line.toString()); line.setLength(0); lineWidth = 0f
                        }
                        line.appendCodePoint(cp); lineWidth += charWidth
                    }
                }
                add(line.toString())
            }
        }
        var low = 0.1f
        var high = 12f
        check(wrap(low).size * low * 1.3f <= height) { "Recognized text is too large for one PDF page" }
        repeat(20) {
            val mid = (low + high) / 2f
            if (wrap(mid).size * mid * 1.3f <= height) low = mid else high = mid
        }
        return low to wrap(low)
    }

    private fun resolveFont(document: PDDocument): PDType0Font? {
        return try {
            appContext.assets.open("fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf").use { input ->
                PDType0Font.load(document, input, true)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.w("SearchablePdfWriter", "Failed to load bundled font fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf", e)
            null
        }
    }

    companion object {
        /** Compare content rather than PDFBox's inferred word and line separators. */
        internal fun normalizedTextContent(raw: String): String = buildString {
            java.text.Normalizer.normalize(raw, java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFKC).codePoints().forEach { cp ->
                if (!Character.isWhitespace(cp) && !Character.isSpaceChar(cp)) appendCodePoint(cp)
            }
        }

        fun PDType0Font.safeText(raw: String, cache: HashMap<Int, Boolean>): String? {
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            raw.codePoints().forEach { original ->
                val cp = if (Character.isWhitespace(original) || Character.isSpaceChar(original)) 32 else original
                val ok = cache.getOrPut(cp) {
                    try { encode(String(Character.toChars(cp))).isNotEmpty() } catch (_: Exception) { false }
                }
                if (ok) sb.appendCodePoint(cp)
            }
            return sb.toString().trim().ifEmpty { null }
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import app.docscan.core.semantic.DateOption
import app.docscan.core.semantic.FieldSource
import app.docscan.core.semantic.Proposal
import app.docscan.core.semantic.ProposalKind
import app.docscan.core.semantic.ProposalState
import app.docscan.core.semantic.TimeOption
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalTime
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter

/** Result of loading semantic suggestions for the pages selected for saving. */
internal sealed interface SemanticSuggestionResult {
    /** At least one selected page has no OCR layout yet. */
    data object NotRecognized : SemanticSuggestionResult
    data class Ready(val proposals: List<Proposal>) : SemanticSuggestionResult
}

/** All callbacks are delivered on the main thread; the work itself runs in the background. */
internal interface SemanticSuggestionSource {
    fun load(done: (SemanticSuggestionResult) -> Unit)
    /** Runs OCR for selected pages without a layout; reports success. */
    fun recognize(done: (Boolean) -> Unit)
    /** Image fragment around [source]; null when it cannot be produced. */
    fun crop(source: FieldSource, done: (Bitmap?) -> Unit)
}

/** Pure text formatting of suggestions (no Android classes). */
internal object SemanticSuggestionText {
    const val TITLE_LIMIT = 200
    const val RECOGNIZE_PROMPT = "Найти дату в документе"
    const val RECOGNIZE_BUTTON = "Распознать"
    const val RECOGNIZING = "Распознавание…"
    const val RECOGNIZE_FAILED = "Не удалось распознать документ."
    const val NOT_CONNECTED_HINT = "Для сохранения события нужно выбрать категорию DB и подключить FamilyTodoList."

    private val display = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd.MM.yyyy")
    private val clock = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm")

    fun displayDate(date: LocalDate): String = date.format(display)
    fun displayTime(time: LocalTime): String = time.format(clock)

    /** Format expected by the form fields (validDate: yyyy-MM-dd). */
    fun formDate(date: LocalDate): String = date.toString()
    /** Format expected by the form time field: HH:mm. */
    fun formTime(time: LocalTime): String = time.format(clock)

    fun formTitle(title: String): String = title.trim().take(TITLE_LIMIT)

    fun dateOptionText(option: DateOption): String =
        displayDate(option.date) + if (option.yearInferred) YEAR_NOT_PRINTED else ""

    fun timeOptionText(option: TimeOption): String = displayTime(option.time)

    /** "18.11.2026 14:30 · Название" or "Срок 30.11.2026 · Название"; missing parts are skipped. */
    fun line(proposal: Proposal, date: DateOption? = proposal.date, time: TimeOption? = proposal.time): String {
        val parts = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (proposal.kind == ProposalKind.TASK) {
            if (date != null) parts += "Срок " + displayDate(date.date)
        } else {
            val when_ = listOfNotNull(date?.let { displayDate(it.date) }, time?.let { displayTime(it.time) }).joinToString(" ")
            if (when_.isNotEmpty()) parts += when_
        }
        parts += proposal.title
        if (date?.yearInferred == true) parts += "год не напечатан"
        return parts.joinToString(" · ")
    }

    fun kindLabel(kind: ProposalKind): String = if (kind == ProposalKind.EVENT) "Событие" else "Задача"

    fun stateLabel(state: ProposalState): String = when (state) {
        ProposalState.FILLED -> ""
        ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY -> "Проверьте по фрагменту"
        ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE -> "Несколько подходящих вариантов"
        ProposalState.EMPTY -> "Предварительная запись: заполните дату вручную"
    }

    fun actionLabel(state: ProposalState): String = when (state) {
        ProposalState.FILLED, ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE -> "Добавить"
        ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY -> "Верно, добавить"
        ProposalState.EMPTY -> "Заполнить вручную"
    }

    /** True when the user's selections cover every required field (EVENT: date and time; TASK: date). */
    fun canApply(proposal: Proposal, pickedDate: DateOption?, pickedTime: TimeOption?): Boolean {
        if (proposal.state == ProposalState.EMPTY) return true
        val date = proposal.date ?: pickedDate
        val time = proposal.time ?: pickedTime
        return date != null && (proposal.kind == ProposalKind.TASK || time != null)
    }

    private const val YEAR_NOT_PRINTED = " · год не напечатан"
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/SheetEdgeSnapper.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.android

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.floor
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * Pulls the sides of a coarse quad (from the 256 px segmentation mask) onto the real page edge of the full image.
 * Mirrors tools/ml/edge_snap.py. Per side: strip-averaged, smoothed brightness profiles along the outward normal,
 * the strongest transition with the side's polarity near the coarse edge at each position, a robust (Tukey IRLS) line fit.
 * A side that cannot be confirmed keeps its coarse line, so the result is never worse than the input by construction
 * of the search window. Pure Kotlin: no OpenCV, unit-testable on the JVM.
 */
internal object SheetEdgeSnapper {
    const val VERSION = "sheet-edge-snap-v1"
    private const val POSITIONS = 48
    private const val STRIP = 2
    private const val MIN_STRENGTH = 6.0
    private const val MIN_SUPPORT = 0.35
    private const val INLIER_PX = 3.0
    private const val SIGMA_PROFILE = 1.6

    class Result(val quad: DoubleArray, val confirmedSides: Int)

    /** [quad] = TL, TR, BR, BL as x0,y0,...,x3,y3 in [gray] pixels. [radius] is the search window on each side of the edge. */
    fun snap(gray: ByteArray, width: Int, height: Int, quad: DoubleArray, radius: Int = 26): Result {
        require(gray.size == width * height && quad.size == 8)
        val cx = (quad[0] + quad[2] + quad[4] + quad[6]) / 4.0
        val cy = (quad[1] + quad[3] + quad[5] + quad[7]) / 4.0
        // per side: a point on the fitted line and its unit direction; null direction = not confirmed (keep coarse)
        val px = DoubleArray(4); val py = DoubleArray(4); val dx = DoubleArray(4); val dy = DoubleArray(4)
        var confirmed = 0
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            val j = (i + 1) % 4
            val ax = quad[i * 2]; val ay = quad[i * 2 + 1]; val bx = quad[j * 2]; val by = quad[j * 2 + 1]
            val len = hypot(bx - ax, by - ay).coerceAtLeast(1e-9)
            var ux = (bx - ax) / len; var uy = (by - ay) / len
            var nx = uy; var ny = -ux
            if (nx * ((ax + bx) / 2 - cx) + ny * ((ay + by) / 2 - cy) < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny }
            px[i] = ax; py[i] = ay; dx[i] = ux; dy[i] = uy
            val fit = fitSide(gray, width, height, ax, ay, bx, by, ux, uy, nx, ny, radius) ?: continue
            // line s(t) = s0 + s1 * t on a->b, offset along the outward normal
            val pax = ax + nx * fit.first; val pay = ay + ny * fit.first
            val pbx = bx + nx * (fit.first + fit.second); val pby = by + ny * (fit.first + fit.second)
            val l2 = hypot(pbx - pax, pby - pay).coerceAtLeast(1e-9)
            px[i] = pax; py[i] = pay; dx[i] = (pbx - pax) / l2; dy[i] = (pby - pay) / l2
            confirmed++
        }
        val out = DoubleArray(8)
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            val p = (i + 3) % 4
            // intersect side p (ending at corner i) with side i (starting at corner i)
            val det = dx[p] * (-dy[i]) - (-dx[i]) * dy[p]
            var ox = quad[i * 2]; var oy = quad[i * 2 + 1]
            if (abs(det) > 1e-4) {
                val rx = px[i] - px[p]; val ry = py[i] - py[p]
                val t = (rx * (-dy[i]) - (-dx[i]) * ry) / det
                val nxp = px[p] + t * dx[p]; val nyp = py[p] + t * dy[p]
                if (hypot(nxp - ox, nyp - oy) <= radius * 1.8) { ox = nxp; oy = nyp }
            }
            out[i * 2] = ox.coerceIn(0.0, width - 1.0)
            out[i * 2 + 1] = oy.coerceIn(0.0, height - 1.0)
        }
        return Result(out, confirmed)
    }

    /** Returns (s0, s1) of the fitted offset line, or null when the side has no reliable edge. */
    private fun fitSide(
        gray: ByteArray, w: Int, h: Int, ax: Double, ay: Double, bx: Double, by: Double,
        ux: Double, uy: Double, nx: Double, ny: Double, radius: Int,
    ): Pair<Double, Double>? {
        val size = 2 * radius + 1
        val profiles = Array(POSITIONS) { DoubleArray(size) }
        for (k in 0 until POSITIONS) {
            val t = 0.08 + 0.84 * k / (POSITIONS - 1)
            val bxk = ax + (bx - ax) * t; val byk = ay + (by - ay) * t
            val raw = DoubleArray(size)
            for (s in -STRIP..STRIP) {
                val sx = bxk + ux * s * 2.0; val sy = byk + uy * s * 2.0
                for (o in 0 until size) raw[o] += sample(gray, w, h, sx + nx * (o - radius), sy + ny * (o - radius))
            }
            for (o in 0 until size) raw[o] /= (2 * STRIP + 1)
            profiles[k] = smooth(raw)
        }
        val mid = radius
        val diffs = DoubleArray(POSITIONS) { k ->
            val p = profiles[k]
            (mean(p, mid - 12, mid - 4) - mean(p, mid + 4, mid + 12))
        }
        val polarity = if (median(diffs) >= 0) 1.0 else -1.0
        val ts = ArrayList<Double>(); val ss = ArrayList<Double>()
        for (k in 0 until POSITIONS) {
            val p = profiles[k]
            var best = -1; var bestScore = -1e9; var bestStrength = 0.0
            for (o in 1 until size - 1) {
                val g = (p[o - 1] - p[o + 1]) * polarity / 2.0
                val weight = 1.0 - 0.45 * abs(o - radius) / radius
                val score = g * weight
                if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = o; bestStrength = g }
            }
            if (best >= 0 && bestStrength > MIN_STRENGTH) {
                ts.add(0.08 + 0.84 * k / (POSITIONS - 1)); ss.add((best - radius).toDouble())
            }
        }
        if (ts.size < MIN_SUPPORT * POSITIONS) return null
        // IRLS line fit with Tukey weights
        var s0 = 0.0; var s1 = 0.0
        var wts = DoubleArray(ts.size) { 1.0 }
        repeat(8) {
            val fit = weightedLine(ts, ss, wts) ?: return null
            s0 = fit.first; s1 = fit.second
            val res = DoubleArray(ts.size) { ss[it] - (s0 + s1 * ts[it]) }
            val sigma = max(1.0, 1.4826 * median(DoubleArray(res.size) { abs(res[it]) }))
            wts = DoubleArray(res.size) { val u = res[it] / (4.685 * sigma); if (abs(u) < 1) (1 - u * u) * (1 - u * u) else 0.0 }
        }
        val inl = ts.indices.filter { abs(ss[it] - (s0 + s1 * ts[it])) < INLIER_PX }
        if (inl.size < MIN_SUPPORT * POSITIONS) return null
        if (inl.map { floor(ts[it] * 8).toInt() }.toSet().size < 5) return null
        return weightedLine(inl.map { ts[it] }, inl.map { ss[it] }, DoubleArray(inl.size) { 1.0 })
    }

    private fun weightedLine(t: List<Double>, s: List<Double>, w: DoubleArray): Pair<Double, Double>? {
        var sw = 0.0; var st = 0.0; var ss = 0.0; var stt = 0.0; var sts = 0.0
        for (i in t.indices) { sw += w[i]; st += w[i] * t[i]; ss += w[i] * s[i]; stt += w[i] * t[i] * t[i]; sts += w[i] * t[i] * s[i] }
        val det = sw * stt - st * st
        if (abs(det) < 1e-9 || sw < 1e-6) return null
        return Pair((ss * stt - st * sts) / det, (sw * sts - st * ss) / det)
    }

    private fun sample(gray: ByteArray, w: Int, h: Int, x: Double, y: Double): Double {
        val xc = x.coerceIn(0.0, w - 1.0); val yc = y.coerceIn(0.0, h - 1.0)
        val x0 = floor(xc).toInt(); val y0 = floor(yc).toInt()
        val x1 = min(x0 + 1, w - 1); val y1 = min(y0 + 1, h - 1)
        val fx = xc - x0; val fy = yc - y0
        fun at(px: Int, py: Int) = (gray[py * w + px].toInt() and 255).toDouble()
        return (1 - fy) * ((1 - fx) * at(x0, y0) + fx * at(x1, y0)) + fy * ((1 - fx) * at(x0, y1) + fx * at(x1, y1))
    }

    private val KERNEL: DoubleArray by lazy {
        val r = 5
        val k = DoubleArray(2 * r + 1) { exp(-((it - r) * (it - r)) / (2 * SIGMA_PROFILE * SIGMA_PROFILE)) }
        val sum = k.sum()
        DoubleArray(k.size) { k[it] / sum }
    }

    private fun smooth(p: DoubleArray): DoubleArray {
        val r = KERNEL.size / 2
        return DoubleArray(p.size) { i ->
            var acc = 0.0
            for (k in KERNEL.indices) acc += KERNEL[k] * p[(i + k - r).coerceIn(0, p.size - 1)]
            acc
        }
    }

    private fun mean(p: DoubleArray, from: Int, to: Int): Double {
        var acc = 0.0; var n = 0
        for (i in max(0, from) until min(p.size, to)) { acc += p[i]; n++ }
        return if (n == 0) 0.0 else acc / n
    }

    private fun median(v: DoubleArray): Double {
        val s = v.sortedArray()
        return if (s.isEmpty()) 0.0 else if (s.size % 2 == 1) s[s.size / 2] else (s[s.size / 2 - 1] + s[s.size / 2]) / 2
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/StillBoundaryProcessor.kt

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.opencv.android.Utils
import org.opencv.core.Mat
import org.opencv.imgproc.Imgproc
import java.io.File
import kotlin.math.abs

/** JPEG-only coarse-to-fine refinement; caller holds 32MiB admission, original is read-only. */
object StillBoundaryProcessor {
    const val WORKING_SET_BYTES=32L*1024*1024
    const val VERSION="still-sheet-edge-snap-v1"
    private const val WIDE_RADIUS=26
    private const val NARROW_RADIUS=8
    private const val MAX_AREA_CHANGE=0.25

    /**
     * The coarse quad comes from a 256 px mask, so at 1600 px it can be tens of pixels off. A wide pass pulls each side
     * onto the page edge, a narrow pass settles it; a side without a confirmed edge keeps its coarse line. A result whose
     * area differs from the coarse quad by more than a quarter is discarded.
     */
    fun refine(file:File,coarse:CropQuadrilateral):CropQuadrilateral {
        val bitmap=ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(file,2L*1024*1024,maxSide=1600)
        val rgba=Mat(); val gray=Mat()
        try {
            DocumentCropProcessor.ensureOpenCvLoaded()
            Utils.bitmapToMat(bitmap,rgba)
            Imgproc.cvtColor(rgba,gray,Imgproc.COLOR_RGBA2GRAY)
            val bytes=ByteArray(gray.cols()*gray.rows()); gray.get(0,0,bytes)
            val w=bitmap.width; val h=bitmap.height
            val start=DoubleArray(8)
            coarse.asList().forEachIndexed { i,p -> start[i*2]=p.x*(w-1); start[i*2+1]=p.y*(h-1) }
            val wide=SheetEdgeSnapper.snap(bytes,w,h,start,WIDE_RADIUS)
            val fine=SheetEdgeSnapper.snap(bytes,w,h,wide.quad,NARROW_RADIUS)
            val a0=area(start); val a1=area(fine.quad)
            val q=if(a0>0 && abs(a1/a0-1.0)<=MAX_AREA_CHANGE) fine.quad else start
            val n=(0..3).map { NormalizedCropPoint(q[it*2]/(w-1),q[it*2+1]/(h-1)) }
            return CropQuadrilateral(n[0],n[1],n[2],n[3])
        } finally { gray.release(); rgba.release(); bitmap.recycle() }
    }

    private fun area(q:DoubleArray):Double {
        var s=0.0
        for(i in 0 until 4){ val j=(i+1)%4; s+=q[i*2]*q[j*2+1]-q[j*2]*q[i*2+1] }
        return abs(s)/2.0
    }
}
