package app.docscan.android

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import app.docscan.core.ocr.LangDetect
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLangMode
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLangProfile
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrQualitySelector
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toOcrLayout
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toPlainText
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toRecognitionLayout
import app.docscan.core.store.OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionGeometry
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognizedWord
import com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/** Offline Russian + English + Spanish recognizer. Use from the single admitted OCR executor only. */
class TesseractOcrAdapter(
    context: Context,
    private val progressObserverForTest: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    private val modelDataRootOverride: File? = null,
) : DocumentRecognizer {
    // Preserve the existing trailing-lambda constructor used by capture/import clients.
    constructor(context: Context, progressObserverForTest: () -> Unit) :
        this(context, progressObserverForTest, null)

    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    private val prefs by lazy { appContext.getSharedPreferences("docscan_app_preferences", Context.MODE_PRIVATE) }
    private val dataRoot = modelDataRootOverride ?: File(appContext.filesDir, "docscan-tesseract/fast-8741641")
    private var tess = createTessInstance()
    private val cancellationRequested = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val nativeRecognitionActive = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val resultIteratorExtractor = ResultIteratorLayoutExtractor()
    @Volatile private var initialized = false
    private var unusable = false
    private var currentLang: String? = null

    private fun createTessInstance(): TessBaseAPI = TessBaseAPI(
        progressObserverForTest?.let { observer -> TessBaseAPI.ProgressNotifier { observer() } }
            ?: TessBaseAPI.ProgressNotifier { /* no-op progress notifier to ensure stop() interrupts recognition */ },
    )

    data class OcrResult(
        val text: String,
        val geometry: RecognitionGeometry,
        val layout: app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout,
    )

    private fun workingPixelLimit(): Long = minOf(MAX_BITMAP_PIXELS,
        (Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory() / 48L).coerceAtLeast(1024L * 1024L))

    fun estimateDecodedWorkingSetBytes(file: File): Long {
        require(file.isFile) { "OCR source is missing" }
        // Bitmap, Leptonica/native work buffers, optional photometric copy and model reserve.
        return NATIVE_RESERVE_BYTES + workingPixelLimit() * BYTES_PER_WORKING_PIXEL
    }

    fun recognize(file: File): String {
        return recognizeDetailed(file).text
    }

    override fun recognize(file: File, options: RecognitionOptions): app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout {
        return recognizeDetailed(file, options.isCancelled).layout
    }

    fun runOcr(
        bitmap: Bitmap,
        profile: OcrLangProfile,
        isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        settings: OcrRunSettings = OcrRunSettings(),
    ): app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout {
        throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
        return synchronized(initLock) {
            ensureInitialized()
            ensureLang(tess, dataRoot.absolutePath, profile.tess)
            applyConfig(tess, settings)
            try {
                tess.setImage(bitmap)
                throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
                nativeRecognitionActive.set(true)
                throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
                // This is the wrapper's interruptible recognition entry point. Do not replace
                // it with a standalone getUTF8Text(), which does not honor stop().
                val nativeHocr = tess.getHOCRText(0)
                throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
                val hocr = nativeHocr ?: throw IllegalStateException("OCR engine returned no result")
                var extraction = "HOCR"
                var layout = try {
                    app.docscan.core.ocr.parseHocr(hocr, bitmap.width, bitmap.height)
                } catch (failure: RuntimeException) {
                    android.util.Log.w("OCR", "hOCR structure unavailable; reading native results", failure)
                    app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout(bitmap.width, bitmap.height, emptyList())
                }
                // Compare against the engine's cached complete transcript. A nonempty but
                // partial DOM extraction is just as unsafe as an empty extraction.
                val nativeText = tess.getUTF8Text().orEmpty().lines().joinToString("\n") {
                    app.docscan.core.ocr.sanitizeOcrText(it.replace('\t', ' '))
                }.trim()
                throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
                val hocrLayout = layout
                if (layout.words.isEmpty() || (nativeText.isNotBlank() &&
                        normalizedOcrContent(layout.toPlainText()) != normalizedOcrContent(nativeText))) {
                    val nativeLayout = resultIteratorExtractor.extract(tess, bitmap.width, bitmap.height,
                        profile.tess.split('+').toSet())
                    throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
                    if (nativeLayout != null) {
                        val sourceLines = hocrLayout.blocks.flatMap { it.paras }.flatMap { it.lines }
                        val extracted = nativeLayout.toOcrLayout()
                        layout = extracted.copy(blocks = extracted.blocks.map { block -> block.copy(
                            paras = block.paras.map { paragraph -> paragraph.copy(lines = paragraph.lines.map { line ->
                                val original = sourceLines.firstOrNull { other ->
                                    kotlin.math.abs(other.box.l - line.box.l) <= 2 && kotlin.math.abs(other.box.t - line.box.t) <= 2 &&
                                        kotlin.math.abs(other.box.r - line.box.r) <= 2 && kotlin.math.abs(other.box.b - line.box.b) <= 2
                                }
                                line.copy(baseline = original?.baseline)
                            }) },
                        ) })
                        extraction = "RESULT_ITERATOR"
                    }
                    if (nativeText.isNotBlank() &&
                        normalizedOcrContent(layout.toPlainText()) != normalizedOcrContent(nativeText)) {
                        layout = layout.copy(plainText = nativeText, quality = layout.toRecognitionLayout().quality?.copy(
                            structureAvailable = false,
                        ))
                        extraction = "PLAIN_TEXT"
                    } else if (layout.words.isEmpty()) {
                        layout = layout.copy(plainText = nativeText)
                        extraction = if (nativeText.isBlank()) "EMPTY" else "PLAIN_TEXT"
                    }
                }
                val normalized = layout.copy(lang = profile.tess,
                    languageHints = profile.tess.split('+').toSet()).toRecognitionLayout()
                normalized.toOcrLayout().copy(quality = normalized.quality?.copy(
                    language = profile.tess,
                    preprocessingProfile = "${settings.imageProfile.name}:PSM${settings.pageSegMode}:$extraction",
                    engineVersion = tess.version,
                ))
            } finally {
                nativeRecognitionActive.set(false)
                tess.clear()
            }
        }
    }

    fun recognize(
        bitmap: Bitmap,
        mode: OcrLangMode = readLangMode(prefs),
        isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        settings: OcrRunSettings = OcrRunSettings(),
    ): app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout {
        val first = mode.profile ?: OcrLangProfile.RU_EN
        val r1 = runOcr(bitmap, first, isCancelled, settings)
        if (mode != OcrLangMode.AUTO) return r1
        val target = LangDetect.decide(r1.toPlainText()) ?: return r1
        if (target == first) return r1
        throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
        return try {
            val r2 = runOcr(bitmap, target, isCancelled, settings)
            throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
            OcrQualitySelector.choose(r1, r2)
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            throw cancelled
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.w("OCR", "second pass failed", e)
            r1
        }
    }

    fun recognizeDetailed(
        file: File,
        isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        mode: OcrLangMode = readLangMode(prefs),
        settings: OcrRunSettings = OcrRunSettings(autoLighting = true),
    ): OcrResult {
        cancellationRequested.set(false)
        throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
        try {
            val bitmap = ProductImageDecoder.decodePrecisely(file, workingPixelLimit())
            return bitmap.useBitmap { decoded ->
                throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
                val resolvedSettings = if (settings.autoLighting && settings.imageProfile == OcrImageProfile.ORIGINAL)
                    settings.copy(imageProfile = OcrImagePreparation.suggestProfile(decoded), autoLighting = false)
                else settings
                val prepared = OcrImagePreparation.prepare(decoded, resolvedSettings.imageProfile) {
                    cancellationRequested.get() || isCancelled()
                }
                try {
                    val ocrLayout = recognize(prepared, mode, isCancelled, resolvedSettings)
                    throwIfCancelled(isCancelled)
                    val finalLayout = ocrLayout.toRecognitionLayout()
                    OcrResult(text = finalLayout.toPlainText(), geometry = finalLayout.toLegacyGeometry(), layout = finalLayout)
                } finally { if (prepared !== decoded) prepared.recycle() }
            }
        } catch (memory: OutOfMemoryError) {
            throw IllegalStateException(appContext.getString(R.string.ocr_memory_error), memory)
        }
    }

    override fun cancelCurrentRecognition() {
        cancellationRequested.set(true)
        if (nativeRecognitionActive.get() && initialized) {
            tess.stop()
        }
    }

    override fun close() {
        synchronized(initLock) {
            if (initialized) {
                tess.recycle()
                initialized = false
                currentLang = null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun normalizedOcrContent(text: String): String =
        java.text.Normalizer.normalize(text, java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFKC).filterNot(Char::isWhitespace)

    private fun applyConfig(tess: TessBaseAPI, settings: OcrRunSettings = OcrRunSettings()) {
        tess.pageSegMode = settings.pageSegMode
        tess.setVariable("user_defined_dpi", "300")
        tess.setVariable("preserve_interword_spaces", "1")
    }

    private fun ensureLang(tessApi: TessBaseAPI, dataPath: String, lang: String) {
        if (currentLang == lang) return
        currentLang = null
        val codes = lang.split("+")
        for (code in codes) {
            val file = File(dataPath, "tessdata/$code.traineddata")
            check(file.isFile && file.length() > 0) { "Missing model file: ${file.absolutePath}" }
        }
        val success = try {
            tessApi.init(dataPath, lang)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.w("OCR", "tess.init failed for $lang, recreating instance", e)
            false
        }
        if (!success) {
            try { tess.recycle() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            tess = createTessInstance()
            check(tess.init(dataPath, lang)) { "Tesseract init failed for $lang" }
        }
        applyConfig(tess)
        currentLang = lang
    }

    private fun ensureInitialized() {
        synchronized(initLock) {
            if (initialized) return
            check(!unusable) { "Offline Russian/English/Spanish OCR is unavailable after model initialization failed" }
            if (modelDataRootOverride == null) {
                installModel("eng.traineddata", ENG_SHA256)
                installModel("rus.traineddata", RUS_SHA256)
                installModel("spa.traineddata", SPA_SHA256)
            } else check(File(dataRoot, "tessdata").isDirectory) { "OCR model directory is missing" }
            initialized = true
        }
    }

    private fun installModel(name: String, expectedSha256: String) {
        val tessdata = File(dataRoot, "tessdata")
        check(tessdata.isDirectory || tessdata.mkdirs()) { "OCR model directory cannot be created" }
        val target = File(tessdata, name)
        if (target.isFile && sha256(target) == expectedSha256) return

        val temporary = File(tessdata, "$name.installing.${Thread.currentThread().id}")
        if (temporary.exists()) temporary.delete()
        try {
            appContext.assets.open("tesseract/tessdata/$name").use { input ->
                FileOutputStream(temporary).use { output ->
                    input.copyTo(output)
                    output.fd.sync()
                }
            }
            check(sha256(temporary) == expectedSha256) { "Bundled OCR model checksum mismatch: $name" }
            check(!target.exists() || target.delete()) { "Outdated OCR model cannot be replaced: $name" }
            check(temporary.renameTo(target)) { "OCR model could not be installed: $name" }
        } finally {
            if (temporary.exists()) temporary.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        file.inputStream().buffered().use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                digest.update(buffer, 0, count)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }

    private fun throwIfCancelled(isCancelled: () -> Boolean) {
        if (cancellationRequested.get() || isCancelled()) throw CancellationException("OCR was canceled")
    }

    private inline fun <T> android.graphics.Bitmap.useBitmap(block: (android.graphics.Bitmap) -> T): T = try {
        block(this)
    } finally {
        recycle()
    }

    private companion object {
        val initLock = Any()
        const val MAX_BITMAP_PIXELS = 6L * 1024L * 1024L
        const val NATIVE_RESERVE_BYTES = 32L * 1024L * 1024L
        const val BYTES_PER_WORKING_PIXEL = 10L
        const val ENG_SHA256 = "7d4322bd2a7749724879683fc3912cb542f19906c83bcc1a52132556427170b2"
        const val RUS_SHA256 = "e16e5e036cce1d9ec2b00063cf8b54472625b9e14d893a169e2b0dedeb4df225"
        const val SPA_SHA256 = "6f2e04d02774a18f01bed44b1111f2cd7f3ba7ac9dc4373cd3f898a40ea6b464"
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/WarpGeometry.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.android

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * Output size of the perspective warp. The old rule took the longest of opposite sides for each dimension, which
 * magnifies the page toward the camera and stretches it (a tilted A4 came out at 0.76 instead of 0.707).
 * The true width/height ratio is recovered from the quad itself (Zhang & He, principal point at the image centre,
 * square pixels) and snapped to a standard paper ratio when it is close. Pixel count stays that of the old rule,
 * so memory planning is unchanged.
 */
internal object WarpGeometry {
    private val STANDARD_ASPECTS = doubleArrayOf(1 / Math.sqrt(2.0), Math.sqrt(2.0), 8.5 / 11.0, 11.0 / 8.5)
    private const val SNAP_TOLERANCE = 0.02
    private const val MAX_DISAGREEMENT = 0.35
    private const val ALMOST_PARALLEL = 1e-3
    private const val BORDER_PX = 2.0

    /** [p] = TL, TR, BR, BL as x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3 in source pixels of an image of [sourceWidth]x[sourceHeight]. */
    fun outputSize(p: DoubleArray, sourceWidth: Int, sourceHeight: Int): Pair<Int, Int> {
        val top = hypot(p[2] - p[0], p[3] - p[1])
        val bottom = hypot(p[4] - p[6], p[5] - p[7])
        val left = hypot(p[6] - p[0], p[7] - p[1])
        val right = hypot(p[4] - p[2], p[5] - p[3])
        val oldWidth = max(top, bottom)
        val oldHeight = max(left, right)
        // A corner on the image border belongs to a sheet cut off by the frame: the quad is not the page rectangle.
        val aspect = if (touchesBorder(p, sourceWidth, sourceHeight)) null
            else estimateAspect(p, sourceWidth, sourceHeight, (top + bottom) / (left + right))
        if (aspect == null) return oldWidth.roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(2) to oldHeight.roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(2)
        val area = oldWidth * oldHeight
        val width = sqrt(area * aspect)
        val height = sqrt(area / aspect)
        return width.roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(2) to height.roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(2)
    }

    private fun touchesBorder(p: DoubleArray, w: Int, h: Int): Boolean = (0 until 4).any { i ->
        p[i * 2] < BORDER_PX || p[i * 2] > w - 1 - BORDER_PX || p[i * 2 + 1] < BORDER_PX || p[i * 2 + 1] > h - 1 - BORDER_PX
    }

    /** Width/height of the real rectangle, or null when the quad has no usable perspective (keep the old rule). */
    fun estimateAspect(p: DoubleArray, sourceWidth: Int, sourceHeight: Int, meanSidesAspect: Double): Double? {
        val u0 = sourceWidth / 2.0
        val v0 = sourceHeight / 2.0
        // m1 = TL, m2 = TR, m3 = BL, m4 = BR in homogeneous, centred coordinates
        val m1 = doubleArrayOf(p[0] - u0, p[1] - v0, 1.0)
        val m2 = doubleArrayOf(p[2] - u0, p[3] - v0, 1.0)
        val m3 = doubleArrayOf(p[6] - u0, p[7] - v0, 1.0)
        val m4 = doubleArrayOf(p[4] - u0, p[5] - v0, 1.0)
        val den2 = dot(cross(m2, m4), m3)
        val den3 = dot(cross(m3, m4), m2)
        val scale = max(sourceWidth, sourceHeight).toDouble()
        // near-parallelogram quads (no perspective): the formula is ill-conditioned, keep the plain rule
        if (abs(den2) < ALMOST_PARALLEL * scale * scale || abs(den3) < ALMOST_PARALLEL * scale * scale) return null
        val k2 = dot(cross(m1, m4), m3) / den2
        val k3 = dot(cross(m1, m4), m2) / den3
        val n2 = doubleArrayOf(k2 * m2[0] - m1[0], k2 * m2[1] - m1[1], k2 * m2[2] - m1[2])
        val n3 = doubleArrayOf(k3 * m3[0] - m1[0], k3 * m3[1] - m1[1], k3 * m3[2] - m1[2])
        if (abs(n2[2]) < 1e-9 || abs(n3[2]) < 1e-9) return null
        val f2 = -(n2[0] * n3[0] + n2[1] * n3[1]) / (n2[2] * n3[2])
        if (!(f2 > 0.0) || f2.isNaN() || f2.isInfinite()) return null
        val width = hypot(n2[0], hypot(n2[1], n2[2] * sqrt(f2)))
        val height = hypot(n3[0], hypot(n3[1], n3[2] * sqrt(f2)))
        // above: |A^-1 n| with A = diag(f, f, 1) -> (n.x/f, n.y/f, n.z); scaled by f: (n.x, n.y, n.z*f)
        if (height <= 0.0) return null
        val aspect = width / height
        if (aspect.isNaN() || aspect < 0.2 || aspect > 5.0) return null
        if (abs(aspect / meanSidesAspect - 1.0) > MAX_DISAGREEMENT) return null
        for (standard in STANDARD_ASPECTS) if (abs(aspect / standard - 1.0) <= SNAP_TOLERANCE) return standard
        return aspect
    }

    private fun cross(a: DoubleArray, b: DoubleArray) = doubleArrayOf(
        a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0])

    private fun dot(a: DoubleArray, b: DoubleArray) = a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.GestureDetector
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.CheckBox
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.DiffUtil
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import app.docscan.core.store.StoredPage
import java.util.UUID

/** Stable-identity camera rail with drag & drop reordering, double-tap viewer open, and responsive buttons. */
internal class WorkspaceHomeAdapter(
    private val activity: ProductActivity,
    private val loader: WorkspaceThumbnailLoader,
    private val enabled: () -> Boolean,
    private val onPageClick: (StoredPage) -> Unit,
    private val onSelectionChanged: (StoredPage, Boolean) -> Unit,
    private val onPageActive: ((StoredPage) -> Unit)? = null,
    private val onDeletePage: ((StoredPage) -> Unit)? = null,
    private val onToggleAllSelection: (() -> Unit)? = null,
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<WorkspaceHomeAdapter.Holder>() {
    internal data class Item(val page: StoredPage, val index: Int, val active: Boolean)

    private val items = mutableListOf<Item>()

    init { setHasStableIds(true) }

    override fun getItemId(position: Int): Long =
        if (items.isEmpty()) -1L - position else stableIdFor(items[position].page.pageId)

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = if (items.isEmpty()) PLACEHOLDER_COUNT else items.size

    override fun getItemViewType(position: Int): Int =
        if (items.isEmpty()) VIEW_TYPE_PLACEHOLDER else VIEW_TYPE_PAGE

    internal fun getItem(position: Int): Item? = items.getOrNull(position)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): Holder = Holder(activity).also { holder ->
        holder.thumbnail.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.dpForThumbnail(72), activity.dpForThumbnail(92))
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: Holder, position: Int) {
        if (items.isEmpty()) {
            bindPlaceholder(holder)
        } else {
            bind(holder, items[position])
        }
    }

    override fun onViewAttachedToWindow(holder: Holder) {
        super.onViewAttachedToWindow(holder)
        holder.boundItem?.let { bindThumbnail(holder, it) }
    }

    override fun onViewDetachedFromWindow(holder: Holder) {
        loader.unbind(holder.thumbnail)
        super.onViewDetachedFromWindow(holder)
    }

    override fun onViewRecycled(holder: Holder) {
        loader.unbind(holder.thumbnail)
        holder.boundItem = null
        super.onViewRecycled(holder)
    }

    private fun bindPlaceholder(holder: Holder) {
        holder.boundItem = null
        loader.unbind(holder.thumbnail)
        holder.itemView.isEnabled = false
        holder.itemView.isClickable = false
        holder.thumbnail.isEnabled = false
        holder.thumbnail.isClickable = false
        holder.thumbnail.setImageDrawable(null)
        holder.thumbnail.tag = null
        holder.thumbnail.contentDescription = null
        holder.thumbnail.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(0x0CFFFFFF.toInt())
            cornerRadius = activity.dpForThumbnail(8).toFloat()
            setStroke(activity.dpForThumbnail(1), 0x22FFFFFF.toInt())
        }
        holder.selection.tag = null
        holder.selection.contentDescription = null
        holder.selection.setOnCheckedChangeListener(null)
        holder.selection.isChecked = false
        holder.selection.isEnabled = false
        holder.selection.alpha = 0.25f
        holder.selection.buttonTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(0x44FFFFFF.toInt())
        holder.pageNumber.text = ""
        holder.pageNumber.isEnabled = false
        holder.pageNumber.isClickable = false
    }

    private fun bind(holder: Holder, item: Item) {
        val isItemEnabled = enabled()
        holder.boundItem = item
        holder.itemView.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
        holder.itemView.isClickable = true
        holder.thumbnail.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
        holder.thumbnail.isClickable = true
        holder.thumbnail.tag = HOME_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX + item.page.pageId.value
        holder.thumbnail.contentDescription = activity.getString(
            if (item.active) R.string.active_page else R.string.page_image_description,
            item.index + 1,
        )
        holder.thumbnail.background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(0xff303030.toInt())
            setStroke(activity.dpForThumbnail(if (item.active) 3 else 1), if (item.active) Color.WHITE else 0xff777777.toInt())
        }

        holder.pageNumber.text = "${item.index + 1}"
        holder.pageNumber.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
        holder.pageNumber.isClickable = true
        holder.selection.tag = HOME_SELECTION_TAG_PREFIX + item.page.pageId.value
        holder.selection.contentDescription = activity.getString(R.string.include_page_in_save, item.index + 1)
        holder.selection.buttonTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.WHITE)
        holder.selection.minimumWidth = activity.dpForThumbnail(32)
        holder.selection.minimumHeight = activity.dpForThumbnail(32)
        holder.selection.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
        holder.selection.alpha = 1.0f
        holder.selection.setOnCheckedChangeListener(null)
        holder.selection.isChecked = item.page.selected
        holder.selection.setOnCheckedChangeListener { checkbox, checked ->
            if (!enabled()) {
                checkbox.isChecked = item.page.selected
                return@setOnCheckedChangeListener
            }
            val pos = holder.bindingAdapterPosition
            if (pos != RecyclerView.NO_POSITION && pos in items.indices) {
                val page = items[pos].page
                if (page.selected != checked) {
                    onSelectionChanged(page, checked)
                }
            }
        }
        if (holder.itemView.isAttachedToWindow) bindThumbnail(holder, item)
    }

    private fun bindThumbnail(holder: Holder, item: Item) {
        if (item.page.artifactState != "COMMITTED") {
            loader.unbind(holder.thumbnail)
            return
        }
        val file = activity.thumbnailFile(item.page)
        loader.bind(
            holder.thumbnail,
            WorkspaceThumbnailLoader.Key(
                pageId = item.page.pageId,
                imageVersionId = item.page.imageVersionId,
                sourceSizeBytes = file.length(),
                targetWidthPx = activity.dpForThumbnail(72) * 2,
                targetHeightPx = activity.dpForThumbnail(92) * 2,
            ),
            file,
        )
    }

    internal fun submitPages(pages: List<StoredPage>, activePageId: PageId?) {
        val wasEmpty = items.isEmpty()
        val willBeEmpty = pages.isEmpty()
        val newItems = pages.mapIndexed { index, page -> Item(page, index, page.pageId == activePageId) }
        if (wasEmpty || willBeEmpty) {
            items.clear()
            items.addAll(newItems)
            notifyDataSetChanged()
            return
        }
        val diffResult = DiffUtil.calculateDiff(object : DiffUtil.Callback() {
            override fun getOldListSize(): Int = items.size
            override fun getNewListSize(): Int = newItems.size
            override fun areItemsTheSame(oldPos: Int, newPos: Int): Boolean = items[oldPos].page.pageId == newItems[newPos].page.pageId
            override fun areContentsTheSame(oldPos: Int, newPos: Int): Boolean = items[oldPos] == newItems[newPos]
        })
        items.clear()
        items.addAll(newItems)
        diffResult.dispatchUpdatesTo(this)
    }

    internal fun currentPages(): List<StoredPage> = items.map { it.page }

    internal fun moveItem(fromPosition: Int, toPosition: Int): Boolean {
        if (fromPosition !in items.indices || toPosition !in items.indices || fromPosition == toPosition) return false
        val item = items.removeAt(fromPosition)
        items.add(toPosition, item)
        notifyItemMoved(fromPosition, toPosition)
        return true
    }

    /** Rebind attached checkboxes after the workspace busy state changes without a page diff. */
    internal fun refreshBoundItems() {
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    internal inner class Holder(activity: ProductActivity) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(
        LinearLayout(activity).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(activity.dpForThumbnail(4), 0, activity.dpForThumbnail(4), 0)
        },
    ) {
        val thumbnail = ImageView(activity).apply {
            scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER
            setPadding(activity.dpForThumbnail(3), activity.dpForThumbnail(3), activity.dpForThumbnail(3), activity.dpForThumbnail(3))
        }
        val selection = CheckBox(activity).apply {
            buttonTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.WHITE)
        }
        val pageNumber = TextView(activity).apply {
            textSize = 12f
            typeface = android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
            setTextColor(0xFFE2E8F0.toInt())
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            tag = "docscan-thumbnail-page-number"
            setOnClickListener { handlePageTap(this@Holder, this) }
        }
        var boundItem: Item? = null

        init {
            val isItemEnabled = enabled()
            itemView.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
            thumbnail.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
            selection.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
            pageNumber.isEnabled = isItemEnabled
            val bottomRow = LinearLayout(activity).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                addView(selection, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.dpForThumbnail(36), activity.dpForThumbnail(32)))
                addView(pageNumber, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.dpForThumbnail(36), activity.dpForThumbnail(32)))
            }
            (itemView as LinearLayout).apply {
                addView(thumbnail)
                addView(bottomRow, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.dpForThumbnail(72), activity.dpForThumbnail(32)).apply {
                    topMargin = activity.dpForThumbnail(2)
                })
                layoutParams = RecyclerView.LayoutParams(activity.dpForThumbnail(84), ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
            }
            thumbnail.setOnClickListener { handlePageTap(this, thumbnail) }
            itemView.setOnClickListener { handlePageTap(this, itemView) }
        }
    }

    private val handler = android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var pendingSingleTapRunnable: Runnable? = null
    private var lastClickTime = 0L
    private var lastClickPageId: PageId? = null
    private val DOUBLE_TAP_TIMEOUT_MS = 280L

    override fun onDetachedFromRecyclerView(recyclerView: RecyclerView) {
        super.onDetachedFromRecyclerView(recyclerView)
        pendingSingleTapRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        pendingSingleTapRunnable = null
    }

    private fun handlePageTap(holder: Holder, view: View) {
        if (!enabled()) return
        val pos = holder.bindingAdapterPosition
        if (pos == RecyclerView.NO_POSITION || pos !in items.indices) return
        val item = items[pos]
        val page = item.page
        val now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
        val isDoubleTap = page.pageId == lastClickPageId && (now - lastClickTime) < DOUBLE_TAP_TIMEOUT_MS

        if (isDoubleTap) {
            // Cancel pending single-tap runnable to prevent opening the viewer
            pendingSingleTapRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
            pendingSingleTapRunnable = null
            lastClickTime = 0L
            lastClickPageId = null

            activity.uiHapticFeedback(view)
            onToggleAllSelection?.invoke()
        } else {
            lastClickTime = now
            lastClickPageId = page.pageId

            val isAlreadyActive = item.active
            if (isAlreadyActive) {
                // Post single tap with delay so double-tap can cancel it
                pendingSingleTapRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
                val runnable = Runnable {
                    pendingSingleTapRunnable = null
                    activity.uiHapticFeedback(view)
                    onPageClick(page)
                }
                pendingSingleTapRunnable = runnable
                handler.postDelayed(runnable, DOUBLE_TAP_TIMEOUT_MS)
            } else {
                activity.uiHapticFeedback(view)
                onPageActive?.invoke(page)
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val PLACEHOLDER_COUNT = 4
        private const val VIEW_TYPE_PAGE = 0
        private const val VIEW_TYPE_PLACEHOLDER = 1
        const val HOME_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX = "docscan-home-page:"
        const val HOME_SELECTION_TAG_PREFIX = "docscan-home-selection:"

        internal fun stableIdFor(pageId: PageId): Long = runCatching {
            UUID.fromString(pageId.value).mostSignificantBits
        }.getOrElse { pageId.value.hashCode().toLong() }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.DiffUtil
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.ListAdapter
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import app.docscan.core.store.StoredPage
import app.docscan.core.store.WorkspaceProjection

/** Lazily creates only attached detailed workspace rows and preserves Page identity across updates. */
internal class WorkspacePageAdapter(
    private val loader: WorkspaceThumbnailLoader,
    private val createRow: (WorkspaceProjection, Int) -> View,
    private val bindRowThumbnail: (View, WorkspaceProjection, Int) -> Unit,
) : ListAdapter<WorkspacePageAdapter.Item, WorkspacePageAdapter.Holder>(DIFF) {
    internal data class Item(
        val projection: WorkspaceProjection,
        val page: StoredPage,
        val index: Int,
    ) {
        val active: Boolean get() = projection.activePageId == page.pageId
    }

    init { setHasStableIds(true) }

    override fun getItemId(position: Int): Long = WorkspaceHomeAdapter.stableIdFor(getItem(position).page.pageId)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): Holder = Holder(FrameLayout(parent.context))

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: Holder, position: Int) {
        val item = getItem(position)
        clearThumbnails(holder.container)
        holder.item = item
        holder.container.removeAllViews()
        holder.container.addView(createRow(item.projection, item.index), ViewGroup.LayoutParams(-1, -2))
        if (holder.itemView.isAttachedToWindow) {
            bindRowThumbnail(holder.itemView, item.projection, item.index)
        }
    }

    override fun onViewAttachedToWindow(holder: Holder) {
        super.onViewAttachedToWindow(holder)
        holder.item?.let { bindRowThumbnail(holder.itemView, it.projection, it.index) }
    }

    override fun onViewDetachedFromWindow(holder: Holder) {
        clearThumbnails(holder.itemView)
        super.onViewDetachedFromWindow(holder)
    }

    override fun onViewRecycled(holder: Holder) {
        clearThumbnails(holder.itemView)
        holder.container.removeAllViews()
        holder.item = null
        super.onViewRecycled(holder)
    }

    fun submitProjection(projection: WorkspaceProjection) {
        submitList(projection.pages.mapIndexed { index, page -> Item(projection, page, index) })
    }

    /** Recreate attached command rows after a transient workspace busy-state transition. */
    fun refreshBoundItems() {
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    private fun clearThumbnails(view: View) {
        if (view is ImageView && view.tag is String && (view.tag as String).startsWith(ProductActivity.WORKSPACE_PAGE_THUMBNAIL_TAG_PREFIX)) {
            loader.unbind(view)
        } else if (view is ViewGroup) {
            for (index in 0 until view.childCount) clearThumbnails(view.getChildAt(index))
        }
    }

    internal class Holder(val container: FrameLayout) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(container) {
        var item: Item? = null
    }

    companion object {
        private val DIFF = object : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Item>() {
            override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Item, newItem: Item): Boolean = oldItem.page.pageId == newItem.page.pageId
            override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Item, newItem: Item): Boolean =
                oldItem.page == newItem.page && oldItem.index == newItem.index && oldItem.active == newItem.active &&
                    oldItem.projection.orderRevision == newItem.projection.orderRevision
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/android/WorkspaceThumbnailLoader.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.android

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.widget.ImageView
import app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import java.io.File
import java.util.IdentityHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.Executor
import java.util.concurrent.Semaphore
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/** A sampled, byte-bounded thumbnail cache shared by workspace views in one Activity. */
internal class WorkspaceThumbnailLoader(
    private val worker: Executor,
    private val mainPoster: (Runnable) -> Unit = { Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post(it) },
    val maxCacheBytes: Long = DEFAULT_CACHE_BYTES,
    private val decode: (File, Int, Int) -> Bitmap? = { file, width, height ->
        ProductImageDecoder.decode(
            file = file,
            maxPixels = width.toLong() * height,
            maxWidth = width,
            maxHeight = height,
        )
    },
) {
    internal data class Key(
        val pageId: PageId,
        val imageVersionId: ImageVersionId,
        val sourceSizeBytes: Long,
        val targetWidthPx: Int,
        val targetHeightPx: Int,
    )

    private data class Binding(val key: Key, val file: File, val token: Long)
    private class Job(val cancelled: AtomicBoolean = AtomicBoolean(false))
    private val cache = LinkedHashMap<Key, Bitmap>(16, 0.75f, true)
    private val bindings = IdentityHashMap<ImageView, Binding>()
    private val inFlight = mutableMapOf<Key, Job>()
    private val failedKeys = mutableSetOf<Key>()
    private val workSlots = Semaphore(MAX_PENDING)
    private var nextToken = 1L
    private var closed = false
    private var cacheBytesValue = 0L
    private var decodeCountValue = 0

    val cachedBytes: Long get() = cacheBytesValue
    val pendingCount: Int get() = inFlight.values.count { !it.cancelled.get() }
    val waitingCount: Int get() = waitingBindings().size
    val decodeCount: Int get() = decodeCountValue
    val boundTargetCount: Int get() = bindings.size

    /** Bind or replace the target's current request. Call on the main thread. */
    fun bind(target: ImageView, key: Key, file: File) {
        if (bindings[target]?.key == key) return
        unbind(target)
        if (closed) return
        val binding = Binding(key, file, nextToken++)
        bindings[target] = binding
        target.setImageDrawable(ColorDrawable(PLACEHOLDER_COLOR))
        cache[key]?.let { bitmap ->
            target.setImageDrawable(BitmapDrawable(target.resources, bitmap))
            return
        }
        scheduleWaitingRequests()
    }

    /** Promote live bound targets only; the binding map is the bounded waiter set. */
    private fun scheduleWaitingRequests() {
        if (closed) return
        waitingBindings().forEach { binding ->
            if (!workSlots.tryAcquire()) return
            val stillBound = bindings.values.any { it.key == binding.key }
            if (!stillBound || cache.containsKey(binding.key) || inFlight.containsKey(binding.key) || binding.key in failedKeys) {
                workSlots.release()
                return@forEach
            }
            startJob(binding)
        }
    }

    private fun waitingBindings(): List<Binding> = bindings.values
        .sortedBy { it.token }
        .distinctBy { it.key }
        .filter { it.key !in cache && it.key !in inFlight && it.key !in failedKeys }

    private fun startJob(binding: Binding) {
        val key = binding.key
        val job = Job()
        inFlight[key] = job
        try {
            worker.execute {
                val bitmap = if (job.cancelled.get()) null else try {
                    decode(binding.file, key.targetWidthPx, key.targetHeightPx)
                } catch (_: Exception) { null } catch (_: OutOfMemoryError) { null }
                try {
                    mainPoster {
                        try {
                            if (inFlight[key] === job) inFlight.remove(key)
                            if (closed || job.cancelled.get()) {
                                bitmap?.recycleIfSafe()
                                return@mainPoster
                            }
                            val validTargets = bindings.entries
                                .filter { it.value.key == key }
                                .map { it.key to it.value }
                            if (validTargets.isEmpty()) {
                                bitmap?.recycleIfSafe()
                                return@mainPoster
                            }
                            if (bitmap == null) {
                                // Do not retry a failed decode in a promotion loop. This marker
                                // lives only as long as a target for the key remains bound.
                                failedKeys.add(key)
                                return@mainPoster
                            }
                            decodeCountValue += 1
                            val bytes = bitmap.allocationByteCount.toLong()
                            if (bytes <= maxCacheBytes) {
                                cache[key] = bitmap
                                cacheBytesValue += bytes
                                trimCache()
                            }
                            validTargets.forEach { (view, expected) ->
                                if (bindings[view] == expected) {
                                    view.setImageDrawable(BitmapDrawable(view.resources, bitmap))
                                }
                            }
                        } finally {
                            workSlots.release()
                            scheduleWaitingRequests()
                        }
                    }
                } catch (_: RuntimeException) {
                    bitmap?.recycleIfSafe()
                    workSlots.release()
                }
            }
        } catch (_: RuntimeException) {
            if (inFlight[key] === job) inFlight.remove(key)
            job.cancelled.set(true)
            failedKeys.add(key)
            workSlots.release()
        }
    }

    /** Clear a target's image and invalidate any result still in flight for it. */
    fun unbind(target: ImageView) {
        val old = bindings.remove(target)
        target.setImageDrawable(null)
        old?.let(::cancelIfUnused)
    }

    /** Drop retained cache references and bindings while keeping the loader usable. */
    fun clear() {
        bindings.keys.toList().forEach { it.setImageDrawable(null) }
        bindings.clear()
        inFlight.values.forEach { it.cancelled.set(true) }
        failedKeys.clear()
        cache.values.forEach { it.recycleIfSafe() }
        cache.clear()
        cacheBytesValue = 0L
    }

    /** Terminal lifecycle release; late worker results are discarded and recycled. */
    fun close() {
        if (closed) return
        clear()
        closed = true
    }

    private fun trimCache() {
        val iterator = cache.entries.iterator()
        while (cacheBytesValue > maxCacheBytes && iterator.hasNext()) {
            val entry = iterator.next()
            cacheBytesValue -= entry.value.allocationByteCount.toLong()
            iterator.remove()
            // Bound views keep their own reference until recycled/rebound; never recycle a shared bitmap here.
        }
    }

    private fun cancelIfUnused(binding: Binding) {
        if (bindings.values.any { it.key == binding.key }) return
        inFlight[binding.key]?.cancelled?.set(true)
        failedKeys.remove(binding.key)
    }

    private fun Bitmap.recycleIfSafe() {
        if (!isRecycled) recycle()
    }

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_CACHE_BYTES = 8L * 1024L * 1024L
        private const val MAX_PENDING = 16
        private const val PLACEHOLDER_COLOR = 0xff424242.toInt()
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.abs

class CameraGeometryTransformTest {

    @Test
    fun `dm01 control example - buffer 1280x960 with cropRect 160,0,1120,960 maps 320,240 to 1 div 6, 1 div 4`() {
        val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 1280,
            bufferHeight = 960,
            cropRect = BufferRect(left = 160, top = 0, right = 1120, bottom = 960),
            rotationDegrees = 0,
        )

        val normalized = CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferPointToNormalizedViewPort(320.0, 240.0, spec)

        val expectedX = 1.0 / 6.0
        val expectedY = 1.0 / 4.0
        assertEquals("Normalized X should be 1/6", expectedX, normalized.x, 1e-6)
        assertEquals("Normalized Y should be 1/4", expectedY, normalized.y, 1e-6)

        // Check inverse mapping
        val (backX, backY) = CameraGeometryTransform.normalizedViewPortToAnalysisBufferPoint(normalized, spec)
        assertEquals("Inverted buffer X should match original pixel", 320.0, backX, 1e-5)
        assertEquals("Inverted buffer Y should match original pixel", 240.0, backY, 1e-5)
    }

    @Test
    fun `rotations 0 90 180 270 bidirectional round-trip accuracy within 1e-5 normalized and 1 pixel`() {
        val bufferWidth = 1920
        val bufferHeight = 1080
        val cropRect = BufferRect(left = 240, top = 60, right = 1680, bottom = 1020)

        val testPoints = listOf(
            240.0 to 60.0,
            1680.0 to 60.0,
            1680.0 to 1020.0,
            240.0 to 1020.0,
            960.0 to 540.0,
            500.0 to 300.0,
            1200.0 to 800.0,
        )

        for (rotation in listOf(0, 90, 180, 270)) {
            val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
                bufferWidth = bufferWidth,
                bufferHeight = bufferHeight,
                cropRect = cropRect,
                rotationDegrees = rotation,
            )

            for ((px, py) in testPoints) {
                val norm = CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferPointToNormalizedViewPort(px, py, spec)
                assertTrue("Normalized x must be in [0, 1] for rotation $rotation", norm.x in -1e-6..1.0 + 1e-6)
                assertTrue("Normalized y must be in [0, 1] for rotation $rotation", norm.y in -1e-6..1.0 + 1e-6)

                val (rx, ry) = CameraGeometryTransform.normalizedViewPortToAnalysisBufferPoint(norm, spec)
                val errX = abs(rx - px)
                val errY = abs(ry - py)
                assertTrue("Error in X for rotation $rotation must be < 1 px (was $errX)", errX <= 1.0)
                assertTrue("Error in Y for rotation $rotation must be < 1 px (was $errY)", errY <= 1.0)
                assertTrue("Error in X for rotation $rotation must be < 1e-5", errX < 1e-4)
                assertTrue("Error in Y for rotation $rotation must be < 1e-5", errY < 1e-4)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `jpeg coordinate mapping with 90 degree portrait orientation and different resolutions`() {
        // Analysis buffer in landscape (1280x960), cropped to 720x960 (3:4 portrait), rotated 90 deg -> 960x720 (4:3)
        // or cropped to 960x720, rotated 90 deg -> 720x960 (3:4 portrait)
        val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 1280,
            bufferHeight = 960,
            cropRect = BufferRect(left = 160, top = 0, right = 1120, bottom = 960), // 960x960 (1:1)
            rotationDegrees = 90,
        )
        val jpegSpec = JpegGeometrySpec(orientedWidth = 3000, orientedHeight = 3000) // 1:1

        assertTrue(CameraGeometryTransform.isGeometryCompatible(spec, jpegSpec))

        // Center of cropRect (left=160, width=960 -> center=640; top=0, height=960 -> center=480)
        val norm = CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferPointToNormalizedViewPort(640.0, 480.0, spec)
        assertEquals(0.5, norm.x, 1e-5)
        assertEquals(0.5, norm.y, 1e-5)

        val (jpegX, jpegY) = CameraGeometryTransform.normalizedViewPortToJpegPixel(norm, jpegSpec)
        assertEquals(1500.0, jpegX, 1.0)
        assertEquals(1500.0, jpegY, 1.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun `incompatible aspect ratio is detected to disable stale live quad fallback`() {
        // ViewPort is 16:9 portrait (oriented: 9:16 = 0.5625)
        val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 1920,
            bufferHeight = 1080,
            cropRect = BufferRect(left = 0, top = 0, right = 1920, bottom = 1080),
            rotationDegrees = 90, // oriented: 1080 x 1920
        )
        // Saved JPEG is 4:3 portrait: 3000 x 4000 (aspect 0.75)
        val jpegSpec = JpegGeometrySpec(orientedWidth = 3000, orientedHeight = 4000)

        assertFalse("Aspect ratios 9:16 and 3:4 must be flagged as incompatible",
            CameraGeometryTransform.isGeometryCompatible(spec, jpegSpec))
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelectionTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelectionTest {
    @Test
    fun `alternating near equal scores keep selecting the measured outer edge around a printed frame`() {
        val outer = quad(100.0, 100.0, 900.0, 900.0)
        val printedFrame = quad(108.0, 108.0, 892.0, 892.0)
        val outerCandidate = candidate(outer, 0.91)
        val printCandidate = candidate(printedFrame, 0.93)

        val first = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(
            listOf(printCandidate, outerCandidate), outer, 1000, 1000))
        val second = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(
            listOf(candidate(outer, 0.93), candidate(printedFrame, 0.91)), outer, 1000, 1000))

        assertEquals("A small score reversal must not switch to the nested printed edge", outerCandidate.quad, first.quad)
        assertEquals(outer, second.quad)
    }

    @Test
    fun `closest eligible candidate wins and returns its fresh measured coordinates`() {
        val previous = quad(100.0, 100.0, 900.0, 900.0)
        val nearest = candidate(shift(previous, 2.0, 0.0), 0.86)
        val middle = candidate(shift(previous, 8.0, 0.0), 0.89)
        val best = candidate(shift(previous, 14.0, 0.0), 0.92)

        val selected = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(
            listOf(best, middle, nearest), previous, 1000, 1000))

        assertEquals(nearest, selected)
        assertEquals("The result must be the current measurement, not the stored reference", nearest.quad, selected.quad)
        assertNotEquals(previous, selected.quad)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a clearly stronger candidate wins despite being farther from the previous edge`() {
        val previous = quad(100.0, 100.0, 900.0, 900.0)
        val close = candidate(shift(previous, 2.0, 0.0), 0.82)
        val stronger = candidate(shift(previous, 70.0, 0.0), 0.91)

        val selected = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(
            listOf(close, stronger), previous, 1000, 1000))

        assertEquals(stronger, selected)
    }

    @Test
    fun `without a previous edge the best candidate wins and empty candidates return null`() {
        val lower = candidate(quad(100.0, 100.0, 900.0, 900.0), 0.7)
        val best = candidate(quad(140.0, 140.0, 860.0, 860.0), 0.9)

        assertEquals(best, DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(listOf(lower, best), null, 1000, 1000))
        assertNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(emptyList(), lower.quad, 1000, 1000))
    }

    @Test
    fun `portrait geometry uses pixel aspect and accepts cyclic corner order while returning shifted measurement`() {
        val previous = quad(40.0, 100.0, 360.0, 900.0)
        val closeShifted = cyclic(shift(previous, 15.0, 0.0))
        val farther = shift(previous, 25.0, 0.0)
        val closeCandidate = candidate(closeShifted, 0.85)
        val higherScoreFarther = candidate(farther, 0.92)

        val selected = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(
            listOf(higherScoreFarther, closeCandidate), previous, 400, 1000))

        assertEquals(closeCandidate, selected)
        assertEquals("Cyclic order and portrait scaling must preserve the measured contour", closeShifted, selected.quad)
        assertNotEquals(previous, selected.quad)
    }

    @Test
    fun `coherent camera translation keeps the whole page ahead of a higher scoring print frame`() {
        val previous = quad(100.0, 100.0, 600.0, 650.0)
        val paper = candidate(shift(previous, 20.0, 0.0), 0.80)
        val print = candidate(quad(140.0, 120.0, 600.0, 630.0), 0.82)

        val selected = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(
            listOf(print, paper), previous, 720, 720))

        assertEquals("The page moved as one shape; its inset printed edge is a different boundary", paper, selected)
    }

    @Test
    fun `camera zoom and small rotation preserve the transformed page over its nested print frame`() {
        val previous = quad(100.0, 100.0, 600.0, 650.0)
        val paper = candidate(transform(previous, 1.03, 2.0, 10.0, -5.0), 0.80)
        val printFrame = transform(quad(120.0, 120.0, 580.0, 630.0), 1.03, 2.0, 10.0, -5.0)
        val print = candidate(printFrame, 0.82)

        val selected = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.choose(
            listOf(print, paper), previous, 720, 720))

        assertEquals("A coherent camera transform changes all page corners together", paper, selected)
    }

    private fun candidate(quad: BoundaryQuad, score: Double) =
        DocumentBoundaryCandidateSelection.Candidate(quad, score)

    private fun quad(left: Double, top: Double, right: Double, bottom: Double) = BoundaryQuad(
        BoundaryPoint(left, top), BoundaryPoint(right, top),
        BoundaryPoint(right, bottom), BoundaryPoint(left, bottom),
    )

    private fun shift(quad: BoundaryQuad, dx: Double, dy: Double) = BoundaryQuad(
        quad.a.copy(x = quad.a.x + dx, y = quad.a.y + dy),
        quad.b.copy(x = quad.b.x + dx, y = quad.b.y + dy),
        quad.c.copy(x = quad.c.x + dx, y = quad.c.y + dy),
        quad.d.copy(x = quad.d.x + dx, y = quad.d.y + dy),
    )

    private fun cyclic(quad: BoundaryQuad) = BoundaryQuad(quad.b, quad.c, quad.d, quad.a)

    private fun transform(quad: BoundaryQuad, scale: Double, degrees: Double, dx: Double, dy: Double): BoundaryQuad {
        val centerX = 350.0
        val centerY = 375.0
        val radians = Math.toRadians(degrees)
        val cos = kotlin.math.cos(radians)
        val sin = kotlin.math.sin(radians)
        fun point(p: BoundaryPoint): BoundaryPoint {
            val x = p.x - centerX
            val y = p.y - centerY
            return BoundaryPoint(
                centerX + scale * (x * cos - y * sin) + dx,
                centerY + scale * (x * sin + y * cos) + dy,
            )
        }
        val points = quad.points.map(::point)
        return BoundaryQuad(points[0], points[1], points[2], points[3])
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentBoundaryColorEvidenceTest {
    @Test
    fun observedChromaticContextCanConfirmSideWithoutLuminanceCutoff() {
        val side = side(availableContextContrast = 0.0, colorSupportedSamples = 30, colorOccupiedBins = 6)

        assertTrue(side.hasObservedTransition)
    }

    @Test
    fun chromaticFallbackRequiresThirtySupportedSamplesAndSixBins() {
        assertFalse(side(colorSupportedSamples = 29, colorOccupiedBins = 6).hasObservedTransition)
        assertFalse(side(colorSupportedSamples = 30, colorOccupiedBins = 5).hasObservedTransition)
    }

    @Test
    fun strongLuminancePathStillConfirmsWithoutChromaticEvidence() {
        assertTrue(side(availableContextContrast = 0.12).hasObservedTransition)
        assertFalse(side(availableContextContrast = 0.119).hasObservedTransition)
    }

    @Test
    fun fourSideAssessmentRequiresSupportAndTransitionOnEverySide() {
        val accepted = DocumentBoundaryEvidenceSampler.Assessment(
            sides = List(4) { side(colorSupportedSamples = 30, colorOccupiedBins = 6) },
            interiorPaper = 1.0,
        )
        assertTrue(accepted.hasFourObservedSides)

        val oneSideWithoutColor = accepted.sides.toMutableList().apply {
            this[2] = side(colorSupportedSamples = 29, colorOccupiedBins = 6)
        }
        assertFalse(accepted.copy(sides = oneSideWithoutColor).hasFourObservedSides)

        val oneSideWithoutEdgeSupport = accepted.sides.toMutableList().apply {
            this[1] = side(coverage = 0.34, colorSupportedSamples = 40, colorOccupiedBins = 8)
        }
        assertFalse(accepted.copy(sides = oneSideWithoutEdgeSupport).hasFourObservedSides)

        val oneSideWithoutSpatialSpread = accepted.sides.toMutableList().apply {
            this[3] = side(occupiedBins = 3, colorSupportedSamples = 40, colorOccupiedBins = 8)
        }
        assertFalse(accepted.copy(sides = oneSideWithoutSpatialSpread).hasFourObservedSides)
    }

    private fun side(
        coverage: Double = 1.0,
        occupiedBins: Int = 8,
        availableContextContrast: Double = 0.0,
        colorSupportedSamples: Int = 0,
        colorOccupiedBins: Int = 0,
    ) = DocumentBoundaryEvidenceSampler.Side(
        coverage = coverage,
        occupiedBins = occupiedBins,
        contrast = 0.0,
        paperTransition = 0.0,
        availableContextContrast = availableContextContrast,
        chromaticTransition = 1.0,
        colorSupportedSamples = colorSupportedSamples,
        colorOccupiedBins = colorOccupiedBins,
    )
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentBoundaryContinuityTest {
    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
        bufferWidth = 1280,
        bufferHeight = 960,
        cropRect = BufferRect(160, 0, 1120, 960),
        rotationDegrees = 0,
    )
    private val quad = floatArrayOf(240f, 120f, 1000f, 120f, 1000f, 840f, 240f, 840f)
    private val nearQuad = floatArrayOf(242f, 121f, 998f, 121f, 998f, 839f, 242f, 839f)
    private val farQuad = floatArrayOf(480f, 260f, 800f, 260f, 800f, 640f, 480f, 640f)

    @Test
    fun `tracked frames every 33ms preserve confirmation past 200ms and matching detector keeps the track`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })
        val originalTrackId = confirmed.trackId

        var tracked = confirmed
        for (timestamp in 1_083L..1_281L step 33L) {
            now = timestamp
            tracked = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, timestamp, quad, spec)
            assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, tracked.status)
            assertTrue(tracked.isTrackedGeometry)
        }
        assertTrue(tracked.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs + 200L < tracked.frameTimestampMonotonicMs)

        now = 1_282L
        val resumed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_282L, nearQuad, 0.92, spec, 1_290L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, resumed.status)
        assertEquals(originalTrackId, resumed.trackId)
    }

    @Test
    fun `fresh flow cannot confirm a provisional detector candidate`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val first = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, first.status)

        now = 1_033L
        val flow = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_033L, nearQuad, spec)
        assertFalse(flow.status == LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED)
        assertFalse(flow.isUsableForAgreement)

        now = 1_050L
        val nextDetector = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_050L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_060L)
        assertEquals("A tracked frame breaks the detector confirmation streak", LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, nextDetector.status)
    }

    @Test
    fun `without fresh visual support a detector candidate after 200ms needs two frames`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })

        now = 1_250L
        val firstAfterGap = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_250L, nearQuad, 0.91, spec, 1_260L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, firstAfterGap.status)
        assertNotEquals(confirmed.trackId, firstAfterGap.trackId)

        now = 1_251L
        val secondAfterGap = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_251L, nearQuad, 0.91, spec, 1_261L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, secondAfterGap.status)
        assertNotEquals(confirmed.trackId, secondAfterGap.trackId)
    }

    @Test
    fun `flow renews visual freshness but never extends the detector 500ms semantic deadline`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })

        var tracked = LiveDetectionState.empty(generation)
        for (timestamp in 1_083L..1_545L step 33L) {
            now = timestamp
            tracked = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, timestamp, quad, spec)
        }
        assertEquals(1_550L, tracked.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(tracked, 1_549L))

        now = 1_550L
        val atSemanticLimit = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_550L, quad, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, atSemanticLimit.status)
        assertNull(atSemanticLimit.quadInBufferPixels)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a refreshed flow publication cannot extend an already displayed contours original UI deadline`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val applied = confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })
        assertEquals(1_250L, applied.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs)

        now = 1_200L
        val tracked = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_200L, quad, spec)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_249L))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_250L))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(applied, 1_249L))
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(tracked, 1_249L))
        assertEquals(1_250L, applied.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs)
    }

    @Test
    fun `partial error and generation invalidation clear continuity immediately`() {
        listOf(LiveDetectionStatus.PARTIAL, LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR).forEach { status ->
            var now = 1_000L
            val coordinator = coordinator { now }
            val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
            val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })
            now = 1_051L
            val unavailable = coordinator.onFrameUnavailable(generation, 1_051L, status)
            assertEquals(status, unavailable.status)
            assertNull(unavailable.quadInBufferPixels)
            assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(confirmed, 1_051L))
        }

        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })
        val newGeneration = coordinator.newGeneration()
        val staleTrack = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_100L, quad, spec)
        assertEquals(newGeneration, staleTrack.generationId)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(confirmed, 1_100L))
        assertNull(coordinator.getPublishedState().quadInBufferPixels)
    }

    @Test
    fun `overlay dims static held state but not confirmed or validated tracked held state`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })
        assertFalse(confirmed.shouldDimOverlay)

        now = 1_100L
        val staticHeld = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_100L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, staticHeld.status)
        assertFalse(staticHeld.isTrackedGeometry)
        assertTrue(staticHeld.shouldDimOverlay)

        now = 1_133L
        val trackedHeld = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_133L, nearQuad, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, trackedHeld.status)
        assertTrue(trackedHeld.isTrackedGeometry)
        assertFalse(trackedHeld.shouldDimOverlay)
    }

    @Test
    fun `snapshot does not treat a tracked held state as detector confirmation`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })

        now = 1_083L
        val tracked = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_083L, quad, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, tracked.status)
        assertFalse(tracked.isUsableForAgreement)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, coordinator.captureSnapshot().status)
    }

    @Test
    fun `missing frames retain the latest fresh flow only until detection plus 500ms`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = coordinator { now }
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation, now = { now = it })
        assertEquals(1_050L, confirmed.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs)

        var tracked = LiveDetectionState.empty(generation)
        for (timestamp in 1_083L..1_545L step 33L) {
            now = timestamp
            tracked = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, timestamp, quad, spec)
        }
        now = 1_549L
        val heldBeforeLimit = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_549L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, heldBeforeLimit.status)
        assertEquals(tracked.trackId, heldBeforeLimit.trackId)
        assertTrue(heldBeforeLimit.shouldDimOverlay)

        now = 1_550L
        val expiredAtLimit = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_550L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, expiredAtLimit.status)
        assertNull(expiredAtLimit.quadInBufferPixels)
        assertNull(expiredAtLimit.trackId)
    }

    private fun coordinator(clock: () -> Long) = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 200L, clock = clock)

    private fun confirm(
        coordinator: DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator,
        generation: Long,
        now: (Long) -> Unit,
    ): LiveDetectionState {
        now(1_000L)
        val provisional = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, provisional.status)
        now(1_050L)
        val confirmed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_050L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_060L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmed.status)
        return confirmed
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentBoundaryCoordinatorV281Test {
    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
        bufferWidth = 1280,
        bufferHeight = 960,
        cropRect = BufferRect(160, 0, 1120, 960),
        rotationDegrees = 0,
    )
    private val quad = floatArrayOf(240f, 120f, 1000f, 120f, 1000f, 840f, 240f, 840f)
    private val nearQuad = floatArrayOf(242f, 121f, 998f, 121f, 998f, 839f, 242f, 839f)

    @Test
    fun `optical flow can retain a confirmed candidate but cannot confirm the first detector observation`() {
        var processingClock = 10_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 1_000L, clock = { processingClock })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        val firstDetection = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_012L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, firstDetection.status)
        val unconfirmedFlow = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_050L, nearQuad, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, unconfirmedFlow.status)
        assertFalse(unconfirmedFlow.isUsableForAgreement)

        val freshFirst = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_100L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_115L)
        assertEquals("Flow between observations must break rather than complete detector confirmation", LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, freshFirst.status)
        val confirmed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_150L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_164L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmed.status)
        assertEquals(1_150L, confirmed.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs)
    }

    @Test
    fun `tracked visual timestamps renew only display freshness and stop at original detection plus 500ms`() {
        var processingClock = 5_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 1_000L, clock = { processingClock })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        val detection = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_100L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_117L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, detection.status)

        processingClock = 5_123L
        val tracked = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_200L, nearQuad, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, tracked.status)
        assertTrue(tracked.isTrackedGeometry)
        assertEquals(1_200L, tracked.frameTimestampMonotonicMs)
        assertEquals("Flow must not rewrite detector evidence", 1_100L, tracked.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs)
        assertEquals("Processing time remains a separate semantic timestamp", 5_123L, tracked.processedTimestampMonotonicMs)
        assertEquals("Visual deadline is capped by original detection + 500ms", 1_600L, tracked.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(tracked, 1_599L))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(tracked, 1_600L))

        processingClock = 5_200L
        val lastAllowed = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_599L, nearQuad, spec)
        assertEquals(1_100L, lastAllowed.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs)
        assertEquals(1_600L, lastAllowed.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(lastAllowed, 1_600L))

        val atDetectionLimit = coordinator.onFrameTracked(generation, 1_600L, nearQuad, spec)
        assertEquals("Tracking at the exact 500ms evidence boundary expires", LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, atDetectionLimit.status)
        assertNull(atDetectionLimit.quadInBufferPixels)
    }

    @Test
    fun `partial and error detector outcomes clear confirmed live geometry`() {
        var processingClock = 2_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 1_000L, clock = { processingClock })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        val confirmed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_100L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_115L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmed.status)

        processingClock = 2_120L
        val partial = coordinator.onFrameUnavailable(generation, 1_200L, LiveDetectionStatus.PARTIAL)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PARTIAL, partial.status)
        assertNull(partial.quadInBufferPixels)
        assertNull(partial.quadInNormalizedViewPort)
        assertFalse(coordinator.isCurrent(confirmed))

        processingClock = 2_220L
        val error = coordinator.onFrameUnavailable(generation, 1_300L, LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR, error.status)
        assertNull(error.quadInBufferPixels)
        assertNull(error.quadInNormalizedViewPort)
    }

    @Test
    fun `callbacks from an earlier generation cannot restore a confirmed publication`() {
        var processingClock = 3_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 1_000L, clock = { processingClock })
        val oldGeneration = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, 1_000L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        val oldPublication = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, 1_100L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_115L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, oldPublication.status)

        val newGeneration = coordinator.newGeneration()
        assertTrue(newGeneration > oldGeneration)
        val staleTracked = coordinator.onFrameTracked(oldGeneration, 1_200L, quad, spec)
        val staleUnavailable = coordinator.onFrameUnavailable(oldGeneration, 1_300L, LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR)
        assertEquals(newGeneration, staleTracked.generationId)
        assertEquals(newGeneration, staleUnavailable.generationId)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.IDLE, coordinator.getPublishedState().status)
        assertNull(coordinator.getPublishedState().quadInBufferPixels)
        assertFalse(coordinator.isCurrent(oldPublication))
    }
}
