package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentBoundaryGeometryTest {
    @Test
    fun `EXIF orientations map all continuous image corners and round trip`() {
        val width = 640.0
        val height = 480.0
        val corners = listOf(
            BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(width, 0.0),
            BoundaryPoint(width, height), BoundaryPoint(0.0, height),
        )
        val expected = mapOf(
            1 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(width, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(width, height), BoundaryPoint(0.0, height)),
            2 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(width, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(0.0, height), BoundaryPoint(width, height)),
            3 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(width, height), BoundaryPoint(0.0, height), BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(width, 0.0)),
            4 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(0.0, height), BoundaryPoint(width, height), BoundaryPoint(width, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0)),
            5 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(0.0, width), BoundaryPoint(height, width), BoundaryPoint(height, 0.0)),
            6 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(height, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(height, width), BoundaryPoint(0.0, width), BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0)),
            7 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(height, width), BoundaryPoint(height, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(0.0, width)),
            8 to listOf(BoundaryPoint(0.0, width), BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(height, 0.0), BoundaryPoint(height, width)),
        )

        for (orientation in 1..8) {
            val transform = BoundaryImageTransform.exif(orientation, width.toInt(), height.toInt())
            corners.zip(expected.getValue(orientation)).forEach { (source, destination) ->
                assertEquals("EXIF $orientation maps $source x", destination.x, transform.map(source).x, 1e-9)
                assertEquals("EXIF $orientation maps $source y", destination.y, transform.map(source).y, 1e-9)
                val roundTrip = transform.inverse().map(destination)
                assertEquals("EXIF $orientation inverse x", source.x, roundTrip.x, 1e-9)
                assertEquals("EXIF $orientation inverse y", source.y, roundTrip.y, 1e-9)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `letterbox removes asymmetric padding on inverse without clamping`() {
        val transform = BoundaryImageTransform.letterbox(200, 100, 100, 100)
        assertEquals(BoundaryPoint(0.0, 25.0), transform.map(BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0)))
        assertEquals(BoundaryPoint(100.0, 75.0), transform.map(BoundaryPoint(200.0, 100.0)))
        val original = BoundaryPoint(37.25, 68.5)
        val mapped = transform.map(original)
        assertEquals(original.x, transform.inverse().map(mapped).x, 1e-9)
        assertEquals(original.y, transform.inverse().map(mapped).y, 1e-9)
        assertTrue("Transform leaves source points outside target bounds unclamped", transform.map(BoundaryPoint(220.0, 50.0)).x > 100.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun `pixel-centre resize follows OpenCV half-pixel convention and round trips`() {
        val transform = BoundaryImageTransform.resizeCentres(640, 480, 320, 240)
        val centre = BoundaryPoint(319.5, 239.5)
        val mapped = transform.map(centre)
        assertEquals(159.5, mapped.x, 1e-9)
        assertEquals(119.5, mapped.y, 1e-9)
        val roundTrip = transform.inverse().map(mapped)
        assertEquals(centre.x, roundTrip.x, 1e-9)
        assertEquals(centre.y, roundTrip.y, 1e-9)
        assertEquals(-0.25, transform.map(BoundaryPoint(0.0, 0.0)).x, 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun `quad validation accepts cyclic and reversed winding but rejects malformed and crossed points`() {
        val points = floatArrayOf(20f, 10f, 80f, 10f, 80f, 70f, 20f, 70f)
        val canonical = BoundaryQuad.from(points)
        val cyclic = BoundaryQuad.from(floatArrayOf(80f, 10f, 80f, 70f, 20f, 70f, 20f, 10f))
        val reversed = BoundaryQuad.from(floatArrayOf(20f, 10f, 20f, 70f, 80f, 70f, 80f, 10f))
        assertEquals(canonical.points.toSet(), cyclic.points.toSet())
        assertEquals(canonical.points.toSet(), reversed.points.toSet())
        assertTrue(runCatching { BoundaryQuad.from(floatArrayOf(1f, 2f, 3f)) }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            BoundaryQuad.from(floatArrayOf(Float.NaN, 0f, 10f, 0f, 10f, 10f, 0f, 10f))
        }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching {
            BoundaryQuad.from(floatArrayOf(0f, 0f, 10f, 10f, 0f, 10f, 10f, 0f))
        }.isFailure)
    }

    @Test
    fun `camera mapping rejects crossed raw corner order and uses pixel-centre crop limits`() {
        val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(100, 80, BufferRect(10, 5, 90, 75), 0)
        val crossed = floatArrayOf(20f, 10f, 80f, 60f, 80f, 10f, 20f, 60f)
        assertTrue("Raw self-crossing order must not be silently canonicalized", runCatching {
            CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferQuadToNormalizedViewPort(crossed, spec)
        }.isFailure)

        val rightEdge = quad(20.0, 10.0, 90.0, 60.0)
        val rect = BufferRect(10, 5, 90, 75)
        assertFalse("CropRect right/bottom are exclusive pixel-centre limits", rightEdge.inside(rect))
        assertTrue(quad(20.0, 10.0, 89.0, 74.0).inside(rect))
    }

    @Test
    fun `outside or explicitly hidden hypothesis cannot suppress an inside page candidate`() {
        val viewport = BufferRect(0, 0, 1000, 800)
        val inside = hypothesis(
            quad(180.0, 100.0, 820.0, 700.0), source = "inside-perspective", visibility = BoundaryVisibility.FULL,
        )
        val outside = hypothesis(
            quad(-100.0, -80.0, 1100.0, 880.0), source = "outside-simple-page", visibility = BoundaryVisibility.OUT_OF_FRAME,
        )
        val unknownButInside = hypothesis(
            quad(210.0, 130.0, 790.0, 670.0), source = "inside-color-page", visibility = BoundaryVisibility.UNKNOWN,
        )
        val result = boundaryResult(listOf(outside, inside, unknownButInside))

        assertEquals(listOf(inside, unknownButInside), DocumentBoundarySelection.visible(result, viewport))
        assertTrue(inside.quad.inside(viewport))
        assertTrue(unknownButInside.quad.inside(viewport))
    }

    private fun hypothesis(
        quad: BoundaryQuad,
        source: String,
        visibility: BoundaryVisibility,
    ) = DocumentHypothesis(0, quad, 0.8, visibility = visibility, source = source)

    private fun boundaryResult(candidates: List<DocumentHypothesis>) = DocumentBoundaryResult(
        identity = BoundaryFrameId(1L, 1L, 1L), detectorId = "test", configVersion = "test-v1",
        outcome = BoundaryOutcome.FOUND, candidates = candidates, detectorStartedNs = 0L, detectorFinishedNs = 1L,
    )

    private fun quad(left: Double, top: Double, right: Double, bottom: Double) = BoundaryQuad(
        BoundaryPoint(left, top), BoundaryPoint(right, top), BoundaryPoint(right, bottom), BoundaryPoint(left, bottom),
    )
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentBoundaryGradientPeakTest {
    @Test
    fun nearestWeakExternalPeakBeatsStrongerInternalPrintAtLiveRadius() {
        assertNearestSeedPeak(radius = 3, innerOffset = 2)
    }

    @Test
    fun nearestWeakExternalPeakBeatsStrongerInternalPrintAtStillRadius() {
        assertNearestSeedPeak(radius = 10, innerOffset = 7)
    }

    @Test
    fun lightPaperTwoPixelBlackPrintAtLiveSearchRadiusKeepsExternalBoundary() {
        assertIntensityStepAnchoring(radius = 3, printStart = 2, outside = 210, paper = 230, print = 20)
    }

    @Test
    fun lightPaperTwoPixelBlackPrintAtStillSearchRadiusKeepsExternalBoundary() {
        assertIntensityStepAnchoring(radius = 10, printStart = 7, outside = 210, paper = 230, print = 20)
    }

    @Test
    fun darkPaperTwoPixelBrightPrintAtLiveSearchRadiusKeepsExternalBoundary() {
        assertIntensityStepAnchoring(radius = 3, printStart = 2, outside = 40, paper = 20, print = 230)
    }

    @Test
    fun darkPaperTwoPixelBrightPrintAtStillSearchRadiusKeepsExternalBoundary() {
        assertIntensityStepAnchoring(radius = 10, printStart = 7, outside = 40, paper = 20, print = 230)
    }

    @Test
    fun sameLuminanceRgbSeedSelectsBlueChannelAndKeepsColorBoundary() {
        val outside = intArrayOf(40, 60, 50)
        val paper = intArrayOf(40, 40, 150)
        val print = intArrayOf(40, 40, 20)
        val gray = DoubleArray(11) { 53.0 }.apply {
            this[5 + 2] = 38.0
            this[5 + 3] = 38.0
        }
        val rgb = Array(11) { outside }.apply {
            this[5] = paper
            this[6] = paper
            this[7] = print
            this[8] = print
            this[9] = paper
        }

        val graySeedStrength = kotlin.math.abs(gray[6] - gray[4])
        var selectedChannel = -1
        var anchorStrength = graySeedStrength
        for (component in 0..2) {
            val strength = kotlin.math.abs(rgb[6][component] - rgb[4][component]).toDouble()
            if (strength > 11.0 && strength > anchorStrength) {
                selectedChannel = component
                anchorStrength = strength
            }
        }
        val blueGradients = DoubleArray(9) { index ->
            (rgb[index + 2][selectedChannel] - rgb[index][selectedChannel]).toDouble()
        }

        assertEquals(0.0, graySeedStrength, 0.0)
        assertEquals(2, selectedChannel)
        assertEquals(-0.5, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(blueGradients, 3, subpixel = true)), 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun isolatedShiftedEdgeIsReturnedAtSubpixelPosition() {
        val gradients = profile(radius = 4, peaks = mapOf(-2 to 8.0, -1 to 24.0, 0 to 8.0))

        assertEquals(-1.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, 4, subpixel = false)), 0.0)
        assertEquals(-1.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, 4, subpixel = true)), 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun flatTopWiderThanTwoSamplesKeepsNearestSeedIndexWhenSeedIsInside() {
        val gradients = profile(radius = 5, peaks = mapOf(-2 to 24.0, -1 to 24.0, 0 to 24.0, 1 to 24.0))

        assertEquals(0.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, 5, subpixel = false)), 0.0)
        assertEquals(0.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, 5, subpixel = true)), 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun flatTopWiderThanTwoSamplesUsesNearestEdgeWhenSeedIsOutside() {
        val gradients = profile(radius = 5, peaks = mapOf(1 to 24.0, 2 to 24.0, 3 to 24.0))

        assertEquals(1.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, 5, subpixel = false)), 0.0)
        assertEquals(1.5, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, 5, subpixel = true)), 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun noGradientAndUnboundedRampAreRejected() {
        assertNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(DoubleArray(11), radius = 4, subpixel = true))

        val ramp = DoubleArray(11) { it.toDouble() * 5.0 }
        assertNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(ramp, radius = 4, subpixel = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun nanSamplesDoNotCreateAnEdgeOrHideAnotherFinitePeak() {
        val onlyNanPeak = profile(radius = 4, peaks = mapOf(-1 to 24.0)).apply {
            this[4] = Double.NaN // A required neighbor of the candidate at offset -1.
        }
        assertNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(onlyNanPeak, 4, subpixel = true))

        val withFinitePeak = profile(radius = 4, peaks = mapOf(-1 to 24.0, 2 to 20.0)).apply {
            this[4] = Double.NaN
        }
        assertEquals(2.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(withFinitePeak, 4, subpixel = false)), 0.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun boundedPeaksAtBothSearchLimitsAreAcceptedButGuardSamplesAreNotSearched() {
        val leftLimit = profile(radius = 3, peaks = mapOf(-3 to 18.0))
        val rightLimit = profile(radius = 3, peaks = mapOf(3 to 18.0))
        assertEquals(-3.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(leftLimit, 3, subpixel = false)), 0.0)
        assertEquals(3.0, requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(rightLimit, 3, subpixel = false)), 0.0)

        val guardOnly = DoubleArray(9)
        guardOnly[0] = 40.0
        guardOnly[8] = 40.0
        assertNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(guardOnly, 3, subpixel = false))
    }

    private fun assertNearestSeedPeak(radius: Int, innerOffset: Int) {
        val gradients = profile(
            radius = radius,
            peaks = mapOf(0 to 16.0, innerOffset to 48.0),
        )

        assertEquals(
            "The weak external boundary at the seed should beat a stronger inner print edge",
            0.0,
            requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, radius, subpixel = false)),
            0.0,
        )
    }

    private fun assertIntensityStepAnchoring(
        radius: Int,
        printStart: Int,
        outside: Int,
        paper: Int,
        print: Int,
    ) {
        val gradients = centralDifferenceProfile(
            radius = radius,
            printStart = printStart,
            outside = outside,
            paper = paper,
            print = print,
        )
        val refinedOffset = requireNotNull(DocumentBoundaryGradientPeak.nearest(gradients, radius, subpixel = true))
        val baselineOffset = (-(radius)..radius)
            .filter { gradients[radius + 1 + it].isFinite() && kotlin.math.abs(gradients[radius + 1 + it]) > 11.0 }
            .maxBy { offset -> kotlin.math.abs(gradients[radius + 1 + offset]) - kotlin.math.abs(offset) * 0.5 }

        // The new polarity anchor stays at the weak paper/background boundary (central difference
        // straddles it, so its subpixel location may be half a pixel outward). The old absolute
        // magnitude-minus-distance rule locks onto the much stronger inner print stroke.
        assertEquals(printStart - 1, baselineOffset)
        assertTrue(
            "Refinement moved away from the external transition: $refinedOffset",
            kotlin.math.abs(refinedOffset + 0.5) <= 0.5,
        )
    }

    private fun centralDifferenceProfile(
        radius: Int,
        printStart: Int,
        outside: Int,
        paper: Int,
        print: Int,
    ): DoubleArray {
        fun intensity(x: Int): Int = when {
            x < 0 -> outside
            x in printStart..(printStart + 1) -> print
            else -> paper
        }
        return DoubleArray(radius * 2 + 3) { index ->
            val offset = index - (radius + 1)
            (intensity(offset + 1) - intensity(offset - 1)).toDouble()
        }
    }

    private fun profile(radius: Int, peaks: Map<Int, Double>): DoubleArray {
        val values = DoubleArray(radius * 2 + 3)
        val origin = radius + 1
        peaks.forEach { (offset, value) ->
            require(offset in -radius..radius)
            values[origin + offset] = value
        }
        return values
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/DocumentBoundaryHandoffTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentBoundaryHandoffTest {
    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
        bufferWidth = 1280,
        bufferHeight = 960,
        cropRect = BufferRect(160, 0, 1120, 960),
        rotationDegrees = 0,
    )
    private val quad = floatArrayOf(240f, 120f, 1000f, 120f, 1000f, 840f, 240f, 840f)
    private val nearQuad = floatArrayOf(242f, 121f, 998f, 121f, 998f, 839f, 242f, 839f)
    private val differentQuad = floatArrayOf(480f, 260f, 800f, 260f, 800f, 640f, 480f, 640f)

    @Test
    fun `same track can hand off an applied contour while its original 200ms lease is fresh`() {
        val coordinator = coordinator()
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val applied = confirm(coordinator, generation)
        val newer = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_100L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_110L)

        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, newer.status)
        assertEquals(applied.trackId, newer.trackId)
        assertFalse("An old publication cannot be submitted as current", coordinator.isCurrent(applied))
        assertFalse("canDisplay accepts only the newest publication", coordinator.canDisplay(applied, 1_249L))
        assertTrue("The already applied contour may survive the same-track handoff", coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_249L))
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(newer, 1_249L))

        assertFalse("The applied contour expires at its original 200ms deadline", coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_250L))
        assertTrue("The newer publication has its own fresh lease", coordinator.canDisplay(newer, 1_250L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `a held isolated miss loses confirmation after the 200ms measurement lease`() {
        val coordinator = coordinator()
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation)

        val held = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_100L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, held.status)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(confirmed, 1_100L))

        val firstAfterLease = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_250L, nearQuad, 0.92, spec, 1_260L)
        assertEquals("At exactly 200ms a matching candidate starts a new confirmation streak",
            LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, firstAfterLease.status)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(confirmed, 1_250L))

        val secondAfterLease = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_251L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_261L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, secondAfterLease.status)
        assertNotEquals(confirmed.trackId, secondAfterLease.trackId)
    }

    @Test
    fun `a mismatched candidate cannot restore the old track after an isolated miss`() {
        val coordinator = coordinator()
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val confirmed = confirm(coordinator, generation)
        coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_100L)

        val mismatch = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_250L, differentQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_260L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, mismatch.status)
        assertNotEquals(confirmed.trackId, mismatch.trackId)
        assertFalse("The old contour's visual lease is expired", coordinator.canDisplay(mismatch, 1_250L))

        val secondNewSheetObservation = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_251L, differentQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_261L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, secondNewSheetObservation.status)
        assertNotEquals(confirmed.trackId, secondNewSheetObservation.trackId)
    }

    @Test
    fun `held same track is retainable until a new track is confirmed`() {
        val coordinator = coordinator()
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val applied = confirm(coordinator, generation)

        val held = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_100L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, held.status)
        assertEquals(applied.trackId, held.trackId)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_100L))

        val firstDifferentObservation = coordinator.onFrameDetected(
            generation, 1_110L, differentQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_120L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, firstDifferentObservation.status)
        val newTrack = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_120L, differentQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_130L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, newTrack.status)
        assertNotEquals(applied.trackId, newTrack.trackId)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_120L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `new generation invalidates an old applied contour`() {
        val coordinator = coordinator()
        val oldGeneration = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val applied = confirm(coordinator, oldGeneration)

        val newGeneration = coordinator.newGeneration()
        assertTrue(newGeneration > oldGeneration)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_100L))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(applied, 1_100L))

        val geometryCoordinator = coordinator()
        val oldGeometryGeneration = geometryCoordinator.currentGeneration()
        val oldGeometryPublication = confirm(geometryCoordinator, oldGeometryGeneration)
        val changedSpec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 1920,
            bufferHeight = 1080,
            cropRect = BufferRect(240, 0, 1680, 1080),
            rotationDegrees = 90,
        )
        val changedGeometryGeneration = requireNotNull(
            geometryCoordinator.generationForFrame(changedSpec, oldGeometryGeneration))

        assertTrue(changedGeometryGeneration > oldGeometryGeneration)
        assertFalse(geometryCoordinator.canRetainDisplayed(oldGeometryPublication, 1_100L))
        assertFalse(geometryCoordinator.canDisplay(oldGeometryPublication, 1_100L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `partial and error publications invalidate an old applied contour`() {
        listOf(LiveDetectionStatus.PARTIAL, LiveDetectionStatus.ERROR).forEach { status ->
            val coordinator = coordinator()
            val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
            val applied = confirm(coordinator, generation)
            val unavailable = coordinator.onFrameUnavailable(generation, 1_051L, status)

            assertEquals(status, unavailable.status)
            assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_100L))
            assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(applied, 1_100L))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `expired publication invalidates an old applied contour`() {
        val coordinator = coordinator()
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val applied = confirm(coordinator, generation)

        val expired = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_250L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, expired.status)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_249L))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(applied, 1_249L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `stale submission remains forbidden while the applied contour is retained`() {
        val coordinator = coordinator()
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val applied = confirm(coordinator, generation)
        val latest = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_100L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_110L)

        assertTrue(coordinator.canRetainDisplayed(applied, 1_200L))
        assertFalse(coordinator.isCurrent(applied))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(applied, 1_200L))
        assertTrue(coordinator.isCurrent(latest))
    }

    private fun coordinator() = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 200L, clock = { 10_000L })

    private fun confirm(coordinator: DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator, generation: Long): LiveDetectionState {
        val first = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, quad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, first.status)
        val confirmed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_050L, nearQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_060L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmed.status)
        assertNotNull(confirmed.trackId)
        return confirmed
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentCapturePolicyTest {

    private val generation = 7L
    private val shutterTimeMs = 1_000L
    private val analysisSpec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
        bufferWidth = 800,
        bufferHeight = 800,
        cropRect = BufferRect(80, 80, 720, 720),
        rotationDegrees = 0,
    )
    private val compatibleJpeg = JpegGeometrySpec(orientedWidth = 3000, orientedHeight = 3000)
    private val document = quad(0.10, 0.10, 0.90, 0.90)

    @Test
    fun `good still boundary rectifies when live boundary is absent`() {
        assertDecision(DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, stillQuad = document, live = null)
    }

    @Test
    fun `good still boundary rectifies when live frame is held stale or from another generation`() {
        assertDecision(DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, document, live(status = LiveDetectionStatus.HELD))
        assertDecision(DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, document, live(timestampMs = shutterTimeMs - 301L))
        assertDecision(DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, document, live(generationId = generation + 1L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `good still boundary rectifies when analysis and jpeg geometry are incompatible`() {
        val incompatibleAnalysis = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 800,
            bufferHeight = 600,
            cropRect = BufferRect(80, 60, 720, 540),
            rotationDegrees = 0,
        )
        val incompatibleLive = live(spec = incompatibleAnalysis)

        assertDecision(DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, document, incompatibleLive)
    }

    @Test
    fun `missing still boundary never borrows a live boundary`() {
        assertDecision(DocumentCaptureDecision.NO_STILL_BOUNDARY, stillQuad = null, live = live())
    }

    @Test
    fun `matching live and still boundaries allow rectification`() {
        assertDecision(DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, document, live())
    }

    @Test
    fun `one bad live corner vetoes automatic rectification when spatial and temporal match are verified`() {
        val oneBadCorner = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.48, 0.12),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.10),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.90),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.10, 0.90),
        )

        assertDecision(
            DocumentCaptureDecision.BOUNDARIES_DISAGREE,
            document,
            live(quad = oneBadCorner),
            compatibility = LiveStillCompatibility(
                sameFieldOfViewVerified = true,
                exposureTimestampMonotonicMs = shutterTimeMs,
            ),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `bad live boundary does not veto a good still when correspondence is unproven`() {
        val oneBadCorner = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.48, 0.12),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.10),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.90),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.10, 0.90),
        )

        assertDecision(
            DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL,
            document,
            live(quad = oneBadCorner),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `bad live boundary does not veto when exposure is unknown stale or field of view is unverified`() {
        val oneBadCorner = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.48, 0.12),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.10),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.90),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.10, 0.90),
        )
        val badLive = live(quad = oneBadCorner)

        for (compatibility in listOf(
            LiveStillCompatibility(true, null),
            LiveStillCompatibility(true, shutterTimeMs - 301L),
            LiveStillCompatibility(false, shutterTimeMs),
        )) {
            assertEquals(
                DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL,
                DocumentCapturePolicy.decide(document, badLive, compatibleJpeg, generation, shutterTimeMs, compatibility),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun assertDecision(
        expected: DocumentCaptureDecision,
        stillQuad: CropQuadrilateral?,
        live: LiveDetectionState?,
        compatibility: LiveStillCompatibility? = null,
    ) {
        assertEquals(
            expected,
            DocumentCapturePolicy.decide(
                stillQuad = stillQuad,
                live = live,
                jpeg = compatibleJpeg,
                generationAtShutter = generation,
                shutterTimestampMs = shutterTimeMs,
                compatibility = compatibility,
            ),
        )
    }

    private fun live(
        status: LiveDetectionStatus = LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED,
        quad: CropQuadrilateral = document,
        generationId: Long = generation,
        timestampMs: Long = shutterTimeMs - 100L,
        spec: AnalysisBufferSpec = analysisSpec,
    ) = LiveDetectionState(
        generationId = generationId,
        status = status,
        analysisSpec = spec,
        quadInBufferPixels = floatArrayOf(160f, 160f, 640f, 160f, 640f, 640f, 160f, 640f),
        quadInNormalizedViewPort = quad,
        rawScore = 0.9,
        frameTimestampMonotonicMs = timestampMs,
        processedTimestampMonotonicMs = timestampMs,
    )

    private fun quad(left: Double, top: Double, right: Double, bottom: Double) = CropQuadrilateral(
        topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(left, top),
        topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(right, top),
        bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(right, bottom),
        bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(left, bottom),
    )
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min

class DocumentCropLongReceiptTest {

    @Test
    fun canonicalizeCorners_supportsExtremeReceiptAspectRatios() {
        // Receipt with 1:12 aspect ratio: narrow width (0.07), long height (0.84)
        val pTL = NormalizedCropPoint(0.45, 0.05)
        val pTR = NormalizedCropPoint(0.52, 0.05)
        val pBR = NormalizedCropPoint(0.52, 0.89)
        val pBL = NormalizedCropPoint(0.45, 0.89)

        val shuffled = listOf(pTR, pBL, pBR, pTL)
        val canonical = QuadGeometryUtils.canonicalizeCorners(shuffled)

        assertEquals("TL", pTL, canonical[0])
        assertEquals("TR", pTR, canonical[1])
        assertEquals("BR", pBR, canonical[2])
        assertEquals("BL", pBL, canonical[3])
    }

    @Test
    fun checkAgreement_acceptsStableLongReceipts() {
        // 1:8 receipt
        val receiptLive = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.40, 0.10),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.50, 0.10),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.50, 0.90),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.40, 0.90),
        )

        // Still capture with slight 1% sensor jitter
        val receiptStill = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.402, 0.101),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.501, 0.099),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.499, 0.899),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.399, 0.902),
        )

        val check = QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(
            receiptLive,
            receiptStill,
            maxRelativeShiftTolerance = 0.05,
            minIouTolerance = 0.85,
        )

        assertTrue("Agreement must hold for stable long receipt", check.agrees)
        assertTrue("IoU should be high (> 0.90)", check.iou > 0.90)
    }

    @Test
    fun checkAgreement_rejectsShiftedLongReceipt() {
        // 1:10 receipt
        val receiptLive = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.40, 0.05),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.48, 0.05),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.48, 0.85),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.40, 0.85),
        )

        // Document shifted laterally by 10%
        val receiptMoved = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.50, 0.05),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.58, 0.05),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.58, 0.85),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.50, 0.85),
        )

        val check = QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(
            receiptLive,
            receiptMoved,
            maxRelativeShiftTolerance = 0.05,
            minIouTolerance = 0.85,
        )

        assertFalse("Agreement must be rejected when receipt shifted laterally", check.agrees)
    }

    @Test
    fun cameraGeometryTransform_mapsLongReceiptAccurately() {
        // 1280x960 buffer, cropRect [160, 0, 1120, 960], rotation 90
        val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 1280,
            bufferHeight = 960,
            cropRect = BufferRect(160, 0, 1120, 960),
            rotationDegrees = 90,
        )

        // Narrow receipt in viewport coordinates: x in [0.45, 0.55], y in [0.1, 0.9] (1:8 ratio)
        val qVp = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.45, 0.10),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.55, 0.10),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.55, 0.90),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.45, 0.90),
        )

        // Convert corners from viewport to buffer and back
        for (corner in qVp.asList()) {
            val (bx, by) = CameraGeometryTransform.normalizedViewPortToAnalysisBufferPoint(corner, spec)
            val mappedBack = CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferPointToNormalizedViewPort(bx, by, spec)
            assertEquals(corner.x, mappedBack.x, 1e-6)
            assertEquals(corner.y, mappedBack.y, 1e-6)
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentCropMemoryCalculatorTest {

    @Test
    fun estimateWarpWorkingSetBytes_doesNotOverflow32BitInt() {
        val largePixelCount = 50_000_000L // 50 MP
        val estimatedBytes = DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.estimateWarpWorkingSetBytes(largePixelCount)
        // 50M * 16 + 4MB = 800MB + 4MB = 804MB (well above Int.MAX_VALUE if it were in bits or multi-stage arithmetic)
        assertTrue(estimatedBytes > 0L)
        assertEquals(largePixelCount * 16L + 4L * 1024L * 1024L, estimatedBytes)

        val extremePixelCount = 500_000_000L // 500 MP
        val extremeBytes = DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.estimateWarpWorkingSetBytes(extremePixelCount)
        assertTrue("Estimated bytes must be positive and > Int.MAX_VALUE", extremeBytes > Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong())
    }

    @Test
    fun calculateBoundedPixels_capsWhenSourceExceedsBudget() {
        val width = 4000
        val height = 3000 // 12 MP
        val budgetBytes = 96L * 1024L * 1024L // 96 MiB

        val bounded = DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.calculateBoundedPixels(
            sourceWidth = width,
            sourceHeight = height,
            maxBudgetBytes = budgetBytes,
            maxSourcePixelsLimit = 20_000_000L,
        )

        val expectedCap = (budgetBytes - 4L * 1024L * 1024L) / 16L
        assertEquals(expectedCap, bounded)
        assertTrue(bounded < width.toLong() * height.toLong())
    }

    @Test
    fun calculateBoundedPixels_smallBudgetNeverExceedsItsEstimate() {
        val budgetBytes = 8L * 1024L * 1024L
        val bounded = DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.calculateBoundedPixels(
            sourceWidth = 4000,
            sourceHeight = 3000,
            maxBudgetBytes = budgetBytes,
        )

        assertTrue("Bounded pixels must fit inside the 8 MiB budget", bounded <= 262_144L)
        assertTrue(
            "The working-set estimate must fit the requested budget",
            DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.estimateWarpWorkingSetBytes(bounded) <= budgetBytes,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun calculateBoundedPixels_rejectsBudgetBelowReservePlusOnePixel() {
        val minimumPossibleBudget = 4L * 1024L * 1024L + 16L
        val insufficientBudget = minimumPossibleBudget - 1L

        val result = runCatching {
            DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.calculateBoundedPixels(
                sourceWidth = 4000,
                sourceHeight = 3000,
                maxBudgetBytes = insufficientBudget,
            )
        }

        assertTrue("Insufficient budget must be rejected before allocation", result.isFailure)
    }

    @Test
    fun planWarp_accountsForPerspectiveOutputLargerThanDecodedSource() {
        val sourceWidth = 1000
        val sourceHeight = 800
        val quad = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.0, 0.5),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 0.0),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.5, 1.0),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.0, 1.0),
        )

        val plan = DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.planWarp(
            sourceWidth = sourceWidth,
            sourceHeight = sourceHeight,
            quad = quad,
        )
        val decodedPixels = plan.decodedWidth.toLong() * plan.decodedHeight
        val outputPixels = plan.outputWidth.toLong() * plan.outputHeight

        assertTrue("Fixture must exercise an output larger than its source", outputPixels > decodedPixels)
        assertTrue(plan.workingSetBytes <= DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.DEFAULT_MAX_BUDGET_BYTES)
        assertEquals(
            plan.workingSetBytes,
            DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.estimateWarpWorkingSetBytes(decodedPixels, outputPixels),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun planWarp_keepsOrdinaryPageWithinDefaultBudget() {
        val plan = DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.planWarp(
            sourceWidth = 4000,
            sourceHeight = 3000,
            quad = CropQuadrilateral(
                topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.05, 0.04),
                topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 0.04),
                bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 0.96),
                bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.05, 0.96),
            ),
        )

        assertTrue(plan.workingSetBytes <= DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.DEFAULT_MAX_BUDGET_BYTES)
        assertTrue(plan.decodedWidth.toLong() * plan.decodedHeight <= 12_000_000L)
    }

    @Test
    fun planWarp_rejectsBudgetTooSmallForReserveAndOnePixel() {
        val result = runCatching {
            DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.planWarp(
                sourceWidth = 1000,
                sourceHeight = 800,
                quad = CropQuadrilateral(
                    topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.05, 0.05),
                    topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 0.05),
                    bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 0.95),
                    bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.05, 0.95),
                ),
                maxBudgetBytes = 4L * 1024L * 1024L + 15L,
            )
        }

        assertTrue("An impossible warp plan must be rejected before allocation", result.isFailure)
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException::class)
    fun planWarp_rejectsOnePixelThinSource() {
        DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.planWarp(
            sourceWidth = 1,
            sourceHeight = 1000,
            quad = CropQuadrilateral(
                topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.0, 0.0),
                topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 0.0),
                bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 1.0),
                bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.0, 1.0),
            ),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun estimateWarpWorkingSetBytes_rejectsArithmeticOverflow() {
        val result = runCatching {
            DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.estimateWarpWorkingSetBytes(Long.MAX_VALUE)
        }

        assertTrue(
            "Overflow must be rejected or saturated instead of wrapping to a small estimate",
            result.isFailure || result.getOrNull() == Long.MAX_VALUE,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun calculateBoundedPixels_preservesSourceWhenWithinBudget() {
        val width = 1000
        val height = 800 // 0.8 MP
        val budgetBytes = 96L * 1024L * 1024L

        val bounded = DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.calculateBoundedPixels(
            sourceWidth = width,
            sourceHeight = height,
            maxBudgetBytes = budgetBytes,
        )

        assertEquals(800_000L, bounded)
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException::class)
    fun calculateBoundedPixels_rejectsZeroWidth() {
        DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.calculateBoundedPixels(0, 1000)
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException::class)
    fun calculateBoundedPixels_rejectsNegativeHeight() {
        DocumentCropMemoryCalculator.calculateBoundedPixels(1000, -5)
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentCropPlanTest {

    private val sampleQuad = CropQuadrilateral(
        topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1),
        topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.1),
        bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.9),
        bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.9),
    )

    @Test
    fun plan_preservesInputMetadata() {
        val pageId = PageId.new()
        val versionId = ImageVersionId.new()
        val plan = DocumentCropPlan(
            pageId = pageId,
            initialImageVersionId = versionId,
            initialContentRevision = 3L,
            cropQuad = sampleQuad,
            orientedWidth = 2000,
            orientedHeight = 3000,
            artifactRelativePath = "pages/page1.jpg",
            algorithmVersion = "DOC_CROP_V2",
        )

        assertEquals(pageId, plan.pageId)
        assertEquals(versionId, plan.initialImageVersionId)
        assertEquals(3L, plan.initialContentRevision)
        assertEquals(sampleQuad, plan.cropQuad)
        assertEquals(2000, plan.orientedWidth)
        assertEquals(3000, plan.orientedHeight)
        assertEquals("pages/page1.jpg", plan.artifactRelativePath)
        assertEquals("DOC_CROP_V2", plan.algorithmVersion)
    }

    @Test
    fun isStale_detectsVersionOrRevisionChange() {
        val pageId = PageId.new()
        val versionId = ImageVersionId.new()
        val plan = DocumentCropPlan(
            pageId = pageId,
            initialImageVersionId = versionId,
            initialContentRevision = 1L,
            cropQuad = sampleQuad,
            orientedWidth = 1000,
            orientedHeight = 1500,
            artifactRelativePath = "p.jpg",
        )

        // Same version and revision -> not stale
        assertFalse(plan.initialImageVersionId != versionId || plan.initialContentRevision != 1L)

        // Revision changed (e.g. rotated or edited) -> stale
        val modifiedRevision = 2L
        assertTrue(plan.initialImageVersionId != versionId || plan.initialContentRevision != modifiedRevision)

        // Version changed -> stale
        val modifiedVersion = ImageVersionId.new()
        assertTrue(plan.initialImageVersionId != modifiedVersion || plan.initialContentRevision != 1L)
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException::class)
    fun plan_rejectsNonPositiveDimensions() {
        DocumentCropPlan(
            pageId = PageId.new(),
            initialImageVersionId = ImageVersionId.new(),
            initialContentRevision = 1L,
            cropQuad = sampleQuad,
            orientedWidth = 0,
            orientedHeight = 1000,
            artifactRelativePath = "p.jpg",
        )
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentFrameTimingTest {

    @Test
    fun `ut12 unknown sensor clock does not produce a sensor capture age`() {
        val timing = DocumentFrameTiming(
            sensorTimestampNs = 1_000_000L,
            receivedTimestampNs = 1_100_000L,
            sensorClock = DocumentSensorClock.UNKNOWN,
        )

        assertNull(timing.sensorAgeNs(nowElapsedRealtimeNs = 1_200_000L))
        assertEquals(100_000L, timing.processingAgeNs(nowElapsedRealtimeNs = 1_200_000L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `realtime sensor clock permits age calculation and rejects future timestamps`() {
        val timing = DocumentFrameTiming(
            sensorTimestampNs = 1_000_000L,
            receivedTimestampNs = 1_100_000L,
            sensorClock = DocumentSensorClock.REALTIME,
        )

        assertEquals(200_000L, timing.sensorAgeNs(nowElapsedRealtimeNs = 1_200_000L))
        assertNull(timing.sensorAgeNs(nowElapsedRealtimeNs = 900_000L))
        assertNull(timing.processingAgeNs(nowElapsedRealtimeNs = 1_000_000L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `prepared timestamp is optional and cannot precede receipt`() {
        assertNull(DocumentFrameTiming(sensorTimestampNs = null, receivedTimestampNs = 10L).preparedTimestampNs)
        assertEquals(15L, DocumentFrameTiming(
            sensorTimestampNs = null,
            receivedTimestampNs = 10L,
            preparedTimestampNs = 15L,
        ).preparedTimestampNs)

        val failure = runCatching {
            DocumentFrameTiming(sensorTimestampNs = null, receivedTimestampNs = 10L, preparedTimestampNs = 9L)
        }.exceptionOrNull()
        assertTrue("Prepared time cannot precede frame receipt", failure is IllegalArgumentException)
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinatorTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinatorTest {

    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
        bufferWidth = 1280,
        bufferHeight = 960,
        cropRect = BufferRect(left = 160, top = 0, right = 1120, bottom = 960),
        rotationDegrees = 0,
    )

    private val candidatePoints1 = floatArrayOf(
        200f, 100f,  // TL
        1000f, 100f, // TR
        1000f, 900f, // BR
        200f, 900f,  // BL
    )

    private val candidatePointsClose = floatArrayOf(
        202f, 101f,
        998f, 102f,
        1001f, 898f,
        199f, 901f,
    )

    private val candidatePointsJump = floatArrayOf(
        500f, 400f,
        800f, 400f,
        800f, 700f,
        500f, 700f,
    )

    @Test
    fun `t04 - initial single frame or false jump is provisional and not confirmed`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        // First frame
        val state1 = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        assertEquals("Single frame must be PROVISIONAL", LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, state1.status)
        assertFalse("Single frame must not be usable for agreement", state1.isUsableForAgreement)

        // Second frame: false jump
        currentTime += 100L
        val stateJump = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsJump, 0.80, spec)
        assertEquals("Jumped frame must remain PROVISIONAL", LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, stateJump.status)
        assertFalse("Jumped frame must not be usable for agreement", stateJump.isUsableForAgreement)
    }

    @Test
    fun `t05 - two consecutive consistent frames confirm the detection`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)

        currentTime += 100L
        val state2 = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertEquals("Two consistent frames must be CONFIRMED", LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, state2.status)
        assertTrue("Confirmed detection must be usable for agreement", state2.isUsableForAgreement)
    }

    @Test
    fun `t06 - misses within ttl become held, and after ttl become expired`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        // Establish confirmed state
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        currentTime += 100L
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)

        // Miss at +100ms (within 300ms TTL)
        currentTime += 100L
        val heldState = coordinator.onFrameMissing(gen, currentTime)
        assertEquals("Miss within TTL must be HELD", LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, heldState.status)
        assertFalse("Held contour must not be usable for agreement", heldState.isUsableForAgreement)

        // Miss at +350ms (exceeding TTL)
        currentTime += 250L
        val expiredState = coordinator.onFrameMissing(gen, currentTime)
        assertEquals("Miss beyond TTL must be EXPIRED", LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, expiredState.status)
        assertFalse(expiredState.isUsableForAgreement)
    }

    @Test
    fun `t07 - mode invalidation and old generation callbacks are ignored`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val oldGen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        currentTime += 100L
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, coordinator.getPublishedState().status)

        // Mode toggled off or activity paused -> invalidate
        coordinator.invalidate()
        val newGen = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        assertNotEquals("Generation must increment on invalidate", oldGen, newGen)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, coordinator.getPublishedState().status)

        // Late callback from old generation arrives on background thread
        currentTime += 50L
        val staleFirst = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.90, spec)
        currentTime += 100L
        val staleSecond = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.90, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, staleFirst.status)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, staleSecond.status)
        assertEquals("Late callback from old generation must be ignored", LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, coordinator.getPublishedState().status)

        // The caller must use the fresh generation for frames after toggling back on.
        val firstFresh = coordinator.onFrameDetected(newGen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        currentTime += 100L
        val secondFresh = coordinator.onFrameDetected(newGen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, firstFresh.status)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, secondFresh.status)
        assertEquals(newGen, secondFresh.generationId)
    }

    @Test
    fun `t05 - jump to a new document is confirmed by two stable frames`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        currentTime += 100L
        assertEquals(
            LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED,
            coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec).status,
        )

        currentTime += 100L
        val firstB = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsJump, 0.80, spec)
        assertEquals("A single jump may hold A during its TTL", LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, firstB.status)

        currentTime += 100L
        val confirmedB = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsJump, 0.80, spec)

        assertEquals("Two stable B observations must replace A", LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmedB.status)
        assertTrue(confirmedB.isUsableForAgreement)
        assertEquals(
            CameraGeometryTransform.analysisBufferQuadToNormalizedViewPort(candidatePointsJump, spec),
            confirmedB.quadInNormalizedViewPort,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `provisional candidate separated by more than ttl is not confirmed`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        currentTime += 301L
        val lateSecond = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)

        assertNotEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, lateSecond.status)
    }

    @Test
    fun `confirmed state expires after a gap and next frame starts a new candidate`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        currentTime += 100L
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)

        currentTime += 301L
        val expired = coordinator.onFrameMissing(gen, currentTime)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, expired.status)
        assertFalse(expired.isUsableForAgreement)

        currentTime += 1L
        val firstAfterGap = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, firstAfterGap.status)
        currentTime += 100L
        val secondAfterGap = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, secondAfterGap.status)
    }

    @Test
    fun `missing frame breaks provisional confirmation streak`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        val firstCandidate = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, firstCandidate.status)

        currentTime += 100L
        coordinator.onFrameMissing(gen, currentTime)
        currentTime += 100L
        val afterGap = coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)

        assertEquals("A missing observation must break the two-frame streak", LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, afterGap.status)
    }

    @Test
    fun `geometry change starts a fresh generation and rejects old geometry callbacks`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val oldGeneration = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val initialFrameGeneration = requireNotNull(coordinator.generationForFrame(spec, oldGeneration))
        assertEquals(oldGeneration, initialFrameGeneration)
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(initialFrameGeneration, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)

        val changedSpec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 1920,
            bufferHeight = 1080,
            cropRect = BufferRect(left = 240, top = 0, right = 1680, bottom = 1080),
            rotationDegrees = 90,
        )
        val newGeneration = requireNotNull(coordinator.generationForFrame(changedSpec, oldGeneration))
        assertNotEquals(oldGeneration, newGeneration)
        currentTime += 100L
        val stale = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.IDLE, stale.status)
        assertEquals(newGeneration, stale.generationId)

        val pointsInChangedGeometry = floatArrayOf(
            400f, 100f,
            1500f, 100f,
            1500f, 900f,
            400f, 900f,
        )
        val firstNewGeometry = coordinator.onFrameDetected(newGeneration, currentTime, pointsInChangedGeometry, 0.85, changedSpec)
        currentTime += 100L
        val secondNewGeometry = coordinator.onFrameDetected(newGeneration, currentTime, pointsInChangedGeometry.clone(), 0.87, changedSpec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, firstNewGeometry.status)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, secondNewGeometry.status)
        assertEquals(changedSpec, secondNewGeometry.analysisSpec)
    }

    @Test
    fun `captureSnapshot captures frozen immutable copy and rejects expired state`() {
        var currentTime = 1000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { currentTime })
        val gen = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        currentTime += 80L
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsClose, 0.85, spec)

        val snapshot = coordinator.captureSnapshot()
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, snapshot.status)
        assertTrue(snapshot.isUsableForAgreement)

        val publishedFirstX = coordinator.getPublishedState().quadInBufferPixels!![0]
        snapshot.quadInBufferPixels!![0] = -100f
        assertEquals(
            "Snapshot mutation must not mutate published state",
            publishedFirstX,
            coordinator.getPublishedState().quadInBufferPixels!![0],
            0f,
        )

        // Later frames in background thread do not affect captured snapshot
        currentTime += 80L
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(gen, currentTime, candidatePointsJump, 0.70, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, snapshot.status)

        // Expired snapshot
        currentTime += 500L
        val expiredSnapshot = coordinator.captureSnapshot()
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, expiredSnapshot.status)
        assertFalse(expiredSnapshot.isUsableForAgreement)
    }

    @Test
    fun `ut11 malformed duplicate or out of order frame cannot erase a newer publication`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { now })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)

        now = 1_100L
        val newest = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, newest.status)
        val beforeLateResult = coordinator.getPublishedState()

        // Timestamp 1,050 is older than the newest 1,100 frame, and the payload is malformed.
        val lateMalformed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(
            generationId = generation,
            frameTimestampMonotonicMs = 1_050L,
            rawBufferPoints = floatArrayOf(1f, 2f),
            rawScore = Double.NaN,
            spec = spec,
            processedTimestampMonotonicMs = 1_120L,
        )

        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, coordinator.getPublishedState().status)
        assertEquals(beforeLateResult.publicationId, coordinator.getPublishedState().publicationId)
        assertEquals(beforeLateResult, coordinator.getPublishedState())
        assertEquals(beforeLateResult, lateMalformed)
        assertTrue(coordinator.isCurrent(newest))
    }

    @Test
    fun `ut13 default visual lease expires exactly at 200 milliseconds without a new callback`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { now })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)

        now = 1_050L
        val confirmed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertEquals(1_250L, confirmed.visualDeadlineMonotonicMs)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionState.DEFAULT_MAX_TTL_MS, 200L)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(confirmed, nowMonotonicMs = 1_249L))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(confirmed, nowMonotonicMs = 1_250L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `ut14 delayed UI lease from an older publication cannot display after a newer one`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { now })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)

        now = 1_050L
        val olderPublication = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(olderPublication, nowMonotonicMs = now))

        now = 1_100L
        val newerPublication = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, candidatePointsClose, 0.88, spec)
        assertNotEquals(olderPublication.publicationId, newerPublication.publicationId)
        assertFalse(coordinator.isCurrent(olderPublication))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(olderPublication, nowMonotonicMs = now))
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(newerPublication, nowMonotonicMs = now))
    }

    @Test
    fun `ut15 invalidation keeps a confirmed old publication from being displayed after mode returns`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { now })
        val oldGeneration = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, now, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        now = 1_050L
        val oldPublication = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, now, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(oldPublication, now))

        coordinator.invalidate()
        val newGeneration = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        assertFalse(coordinator.isCurrent(oldPublication))
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(oldPublication, now))

        now = 1_100L
        val newFirst = coordinator.onFrameDetected(newGeneration, now, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, newFirst.status)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(oldPublication, now))
    }

    @Test
    fun `ut16 geometry change rejects old space publication and old callbacks`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { now })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val oldGeneration = requireNotNull(coordinator.generationForFrame(spec, generation))
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, now, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec)
        now = 1_050L
        val oldPublication = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, now, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(oldPublication, now))

        val changedSpec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
            bufferWidth = 1920,
            bufferHeight = 1080,
            cropRect = BufferRect(left = 240, top = 0, right = 1680, bottom = 1080),
            rotationDegrees = 90,
        )
        val changedGeneration = requireNotNull(coordinator.generationForFrame(changedSpec, oldGeneration))
        assertNotEquals(oldGeneration, changedGeneration)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(oldPublication, now))
        val stale = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, now + 10L, candidatePoints1, 0.9, spec)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.IDLE, stale.status)
        assertFalse(coordinator.isCurrent(oldPublication))
    }

    @Test
    fun `ut17 detector result processed at the ttl boundary is discarded instead of promoted`() {
        val now = 1_200L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { now })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, candidatePoints1, 0.85, spec,
            processedTimestampMonotonicMs = 1_000L)

        val late = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_001L, candidatePointsClose, 0.87, spec,
            processedTimestampMonotonicMs = 1_201L)

        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, late.status)
        assertFalse(late.isUsableForAgreement)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(late, nowMonotonicMs = now))
        assertEquals(generation, late.generationId)
    }

    @Test
    fun `ut20 input and returned coordinate arrays cannot mutate published state`() {
        var now = 1_000L
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(clock = { now })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        val submitted = candidatePoints1.clone()
        val originalFirstX = submitted[0]

        val returned = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, now, submitted, 0.85, spec)
        submitted[0] = -500f
        returned.quadInBufferPixels!![0] = -600f

        val published = coordinator.getPublishedState()
        assertEquals(originalFirstX, published.quadInBufferPixels!![0], 0f)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, published.status)
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentPreviewBaselineTest {
    private val spec = AnalysisBufferSpec(
        bufferWidth = 1280,
        bufferHeight = 960,
        cropRect = BufferRect(160, 0, 1120, 960),
        rotationDegrees = 0,
    )
    private val firstQuad = floatArrayOf(240f, 120f, 1000f, 120f, 1000f, 840f, 240f, 840f)
    private val nextQuad = floatArrayOf(242f, 121f, 998f, 121f, 998f, 839f, 242f, 839f)

    @Test
    fun `two compatible detector frames confirm with a 250ms processed age and missing expires at 300ms`() {
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { 1_500L })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()

        val first = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, firstQuad, 0.9, spec,
            processedTimestampMonotonicMs = 1_250L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.PROVISIONAL, first.status)
        val confirmed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_250L, nextQuad, 0.9, spec,
            processedTimestampMonotonicMs = 1_500L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmed.status)
        assertEquals(1_250L, confirmed.lastDetectionTimestampMonotonicMs)

        val beforeDeadline = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_549L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.HELD, beforeDeadline.status)
        assertTrue(beforeDeadline.quadInBufferPixels != null)
        assertTrue(coordinator.canDisplay(beforeDeadline, 1_549L))

        val atDeadline = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_550L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, atDeadline.status)
        assertNull(atDeadline.quadInBufferPixels)
        assertFalse(coordinator.canDisplay(atDeadline, 1_550L))
    }

    @Test
    fun `old generation callbacks cannot restore a preview boundary`() {
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { 1_500L })
        val oldGeneration = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, 1_000L, firstQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        val confirmed = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, 1_050L, nextQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_060L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.CONFIRMED, confirmed.status)

        val newGeneration = coordinator.newGeneration()
        val stale = coordinator.onFrameDetected(oldGeneration, 1_100L, firstQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_110L)
        assertEquals(newGeneration, stale.generationId)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.IDLE, stale.status)
        assertNull(stale.quadInBufferPixels)
        assertNull(coordinator.getPublishedState().quadInBufferPixels)
    }

    @Test
    fun `still crop decision can succeed while the live preview boundary has expired`() {
        val coordinator = DocumentLiveDetectionCoordinator(maxTtlMs = 300L, clock = { 1_550L })
        val generation = coordinator.currentGeneration()
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_000L, firstQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_010L)
        coordinator.onFrameDetected(generation, 1_050L, nextQuad, 0.9, spec, 1_060L)
        val expiredPreview = coordinator.onFrameMissing(generation, 1_350L)
        assertEquals(LiveDetectionStatus.EXPIRED, expiredPreview.status)
        assertNull(expiredPreview.quadInBufferPixels)

        val stillCrop = CropQuadrilateral(
            NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1),
            NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.1),
            NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.9),
            NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.9),
        )
        val decision = DocumentCapturePolicy.decide(
            stillQuad = stillCrop,
            live = expiredPreview,
            jpeg = JpegGeometrySpec(orientedWidth = 3000, orientedHeight = 2250),
            generationAtShutter = generation,
            shutterTimestampMs = 1_350L,
        )
        assertEquals(DocumentCaptureDecision.RECTIFY_STILL, decision)
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DocumentQuadFilterTest {
    @Test
    fun `time EMA aligns cyclic corner numbering before filtering motion`() {
        val filter = DocumentQuadFilter(DocumentQuadFilterMode.TIME_EMA)
        val first = quad(20f, 30f, 180f, 160f)
        val translated = quad(40f, 40f, 200f, 170f)
        filter.update(first, 1_000L)

        // Same polygon with a different cyclic start; this must not collapse opposite corners.
        val cyclicTranslation = BoundaryQuad.from(floatArrayOf(200f, 40f, 200f, 170f, 40f, 170f, 40f, 40f))
        val filtered = filter.update(cyclicTranslation, 1_100L)

        assertTrue(filtered.points.zip(translated.points).all { (actual, expected) ->
            kotlin.math.abs(actual.x - expected.x) < 15.0 && kotlin.math.abs(actual.y - expected.y) < 15.0
        })
        assertTrue("The filter must return a valid convex quad", filtered.inside(BufferRect(0, 0, 240, 220)))
    }

    @Test
    fun `reset and discontinuous time restart from the current measurement`() {
        val filter = DocumentQuadFilter(DocumentQuadFilterMode.ONE_EURO)
        val first = quad(20f, 30f, 180f, 160f)
        val moved = quad(40f, 40f, 200f, 170f)
        filter.update(first, 100L)
        val smoothed = filter.update(moved, 200L)
        assertTrue(smoothed.a.x > first.a.x && smoothed.a.x < moved.a.x)

        val afterGap = quad(60f, 50f, 220f, 180f)
        assertEquals(afterGap, filter.update(afterGap, 501L))
        filter.reset()
        assertEquals(first, filter.update(first, 10_000L))
    }

    private fun quad(left: Float, top: Float, right: Float, bottom: Float) = BoundaryQuad(
        BoundaryPoint(left.toDouble(), top.toDouble()), BoundaryPoint(right.toDouble(), top.toDouble()),
        BoundaryPoint(right.toDouble(), bottom.toDouble()), BoundaryPoint(left.toDouble(), bottom.toDouble()),
    )
}

FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/LatestDocumentPublicationTest.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.ArrayDeque

class LatestDocumentPublicationTest {
    private class QueueHarness {
        val queue = ArrayDeque<Runnable>()
        val removed = mutableListOf<Runnable>()
        fun post(task: Runnable) { queue.addLast(task) }
        fun remove(task: Runnable) { removed += task; queue.remove(task) }
        fun runNext() { queue.removeFirst().run() }
    }

    @Test
    fun `many offers while main is blocked retain one queued task and apply only newest value`() {
        val harness = QueueHarness()
        val applied = mutableListOf<Int>()
        val publication = LatestDocumentPublication<Int>(harness::post, harness::remove, applied::add)

        repeat(20_000) { publication.offer(it) }

        assertEquals("Pending work is bounded to a single main-loop task", 1, harness.queue.size)
        assertTrue(applied.isEmpty())
        harness.runNext()
        assertEquals(listOf(19_999), applied)
        assertTrue(harness.queue.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun `an offer during apply is drained in a second task without losing the newer value`() {
        val harness = QueueHarness()
        val applied = mutableListOf<Int>()
        lateinit var publication: LatestDocumentPublication<Int>
        publication = LatestDocumentPublication(harness::post, harness::remove) { value ->
            applied += value
            if (value == 1) publication.offer(2)
        }

        publication.offer(1)
        harness.runNext()
        assertEquals(listOf(1), applied)
        assertEquals(1, harness.queue.size)
        harness.runNext()
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2), applied)
        assertTrue(harness.queue.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun `clear discards pending value but keeps publisher reusable`() {
        val harness = QueueHarness()
        val applied = mutableListOf<Int>()
        val publication = LatestDocumentPublication<Int>(harness::post, harness::remove, applied::add)

        publication.offer(1)
        publication.clear()
        harness.runNext()
        assertTrue(applied.isEmpty())

        publication.offer(2)
        assertEquals(1, harness.queue.size)
        harness.runNext()
        assertEquals(listOf(2), applied)
    }

    @Test
    fun `close removes queued runnable and later offers can never publish`() {
        val harness = QueueHarness()
        val applied = mutableListOf<Int>()
        val publication = LatestDocumentPublication<Int>(harness::post, harness::remove, applied::add)

        publication.offer(1)
        val alreadyPosted = harness.queue.single()
        publication.close()
        assertTrue(harness.queue.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(harness.removed.contains(alreadyPosted))

        // A looper may already have dequeued a Runnable when removeCallbacks is called.
        alreadyPosted.run()
        publication.offer(2)
        assertTrue(applied.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(harness.queue.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(harness.removed.isEmpty())
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class PrefixApplicatorTest {

    @Test
    fun `applyPrefix prepends prefix when no old prefix was present`() {
        val result = PrefixApplicator.applyPrefix("2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", "", "договор за газ")
        assertEquals("договор за газ 2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", result)
    }

    @Test
    fun `applyPrefix replaces old prefix cleanly`() {
        val result = PrefixApplicator.applyPrefix("договор за газ 2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", "договор за газ", "договор за воду")
        assertEquals("договор за воду 2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", result)
    }

    @Test
    fun `applyPrefix strips old prefix when new prefix is blank`() {
        val result = PrefixApplicator.applyPrefix("договор за газ 2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", "договор за газ", "")
        assertEquals("2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", result)
    }

    @Test
    fun `removePrefix strips prefix with space`() {
        val result = PrefixApplicator.removePrefix("договор за газ 2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", "договор за газ")
        assertEquals("2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", result)
    }

    @Test
    fun `removePrefix returns unchanged string if prefix not matching`() {
        val result = PrefixApplicator.removePrefix("2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", "договор за газ")
        assertEquals("2026-10-17 17-05.pdf", result)
    }

    @Test
    fun `applyPrefix works when user appended extra text after the date`() {
        val result = PrefixApplicator.applyPrefix("договор за газ 2026-10-17 17-05 квартира 5.pdf", "договор за газ", "акт")
        assertEquals("акт 2026-10-17 17-05 квартира 5.pdf", result)
    }
}
