FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/QuadGeometryUtilsTest.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.edit.CropQuadrilateral
import app.docscan.core.edit.NormalizedCropPoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class QuadGeometryUtilsTest {

    @Test
    fun `canonicalizeCorners correctly orders cyclically shifted or shuffled corners`() {
        val pTL = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1)
        val pTR = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.1)
        val pBR = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.9)
        val pBL = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.9)

        // Test shuffled permutations
        val permutations = listOf(
            listOf(pTL, pTR, pBR, pBL),
            listOf(pTR, pBR, pBL, pTL),
            listOf(pBR, pBL, pTL, pTR),
            listOf(pBL, pTL, pTR, pBR),
            listOf(pTL, pBL, pBR, pTR),
        )

        for (perm in permutations) {
            val ordered = QuadGeometryUtils.canonicalizeCorners(perm)
            assertEquals("TL should be pTL", pTL, ordered[0])
            assertEquals("TR should be pTR", pTR, ordered[1])
            assertEquals("BR should be pBR", pBR, ordered[2])
            assertEquals("BL should be pBL", pBL, ordered[3])
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `polygonIoU matches expected values for identical, shifted, and disjoint quadrilaterals`() {
        val q1 = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.1),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.9),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.9),
        )

        // Identical quad -> IoU = 1.0
        val iouSame = QuadGeometryUtils.polygonIoU(q1, q1)
        assertEquals(1.0, iouSame, 1e-4)

        // Disjoint quad
        val qDisjoint = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 0.95),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 0.95),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 1.0),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 1.0),
        )
        val iouDisjoint = QuadGeometryUtils.polygonIoU(q1, qDisjoint)
        assertEquals(0.0, iouDisjoint, 1e-4)

        // Overlapping quads:
        // q1 is [0.1..0.7] x [0.1..0.7] -> width 0.6, height 0.6 -> Area1 = 0.36
        // qOverlap is [0.4..1.0] x [0.1..0.7] -> width 0.6, height 0.6 -> Area2 = 0.36
        // Overlap region: [0.4..0.7] x [0.1..0.7] -> width 0.3, height 0.6 -> InterArea = 0.18
        // UnionArea = 0.36 + 0.36 - 0.18 = 0.54
        // IoU = 0.18 / 0.54 = 1/3 ~ 0.3333
        val qBase = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.7, 0.1),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.7, 0.7),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.7),
        )
        val qOverlap = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.4, 0.1),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 0.1),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0, 0.7),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.4, 0.7),
        )
        val iouOverlap = QuadGeometryUtils.polygonIoU(qBase, qOverlap)
        assertEquals(1.0 / 3.0, iouOverlap, 1e-3)
    }

    @Test
    fun `checkAgreement passes for close quads and fails for substantial disagreement or single bad corner`() {
        val live = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.10, 0.10),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.10),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.90),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.10, 0.90),
        )

        // Very close quad (within 1% diagonal shift) -> should agree
        val close = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.105, 0.102),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.898, 0.104),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.903, 0.897),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.098, 0.902),
        )
        val resClose = QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(live, close)
        assertTrue("Close quads must agree", resClose.agrees)
        assertTrue("IoU must be high (>0.90)", resClose.iou > 0.90)
        assertTrue("Relative corner shift must be <= 0.06", resClose.relativeCornerShift <= 0.06)

        // Substantial disagreement (one bad corner shifted by 15% of diagonal)
        // Diagonal is hypot(0.8, 0.8) = 1.131. 15% is ~0.17
        val oneBadCorner = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.28, 0.28), // Shifted by 0.25 (diagonal ratio ~0.22)
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.10),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.90, 0.90),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.10, 0.90),
        )
        val resBad = QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(live, oneBadCorner)
        assertFalse("Single bad corner (>6% diagonal) must reject agreement", resBad.agrees)

        // Low IoU (< 0.80)
        val shifted = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.25, 0.25),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 0.25),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.95, 0.95),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.25, 0.95),
        )
        val resShifted = QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(live, shifted)
        assertFalse("Significantly shifted quad must reject agreement", resShifted.agrees)
    }

    @Test
    fun `checkAgreement measures equal pixel translations isotropically in portrait viewport`() {
        val live = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.20, 0.20),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.80, 0.20),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.80, 0.80),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.20, 0.80),
        )
        // For a 100x200 viewport, 5px means 0.05 normalized X or 0.025 normalized Y.
        val shiftedX = live.translate(dx = 5.0 / 100.0, dy = 0.0)
        val shiftedY = live.translate(dx = 0.0, dy = 5.0 / 200.0)

        val horizontal = QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(
            live,
            shiftedX,
            maxRelativeShiftTolerance = 1.0,
            minIouTolerance = 0.0,
            imageAspectRatio = 100.0 / 200.0,
        )
        val vertical = QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(
            live,
            shiftedY,
            maxRelativeShiftTolerance = 1.0,
            minIouTolerance = 0.0,
            imageAspectRatio = 100.0 / 200.0,
        )

        assertEquals(horizontal.maxCornerDistance, vertical.maxCornerDistance, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(horizontal.documentDiagonal, vertical.documentDiagonal, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(horizontal.relativeCornerShift, vertical.relativeCornerShift, 1e-12)
        assertTrue(horizontal.agrees)
        assertTrue(vertical.agrees)
    }

    @Test
    fun `checkAgreement rejects nonfinite or nonpositive image aspect ratio`() {
        val quad = CropQuadrilateral(
            topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.1),
            topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.1),
            bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(0.9, 0.9),
            bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(0.1, 0.9),
        )
        for (aspect in listOf(0.0, -1.0, Double.NaN, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY)) {
            try {
                QuadGeometryUtils.checkAgreement(quad, quad, imageAspectRatio = aspect)
                throw AssertionError("Expected invalid aspect ratio $aspect to be rejected")
            } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
                // Invalid geometry scale must fail closed.
            }
        }
    }

    private fun CropQuadrilateral.translate(dx: Double, dy: Double) = CropQuadrilateral(
        topLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(topLeft.x + dx, topLeft.y + dy),
        topRight = NormalizedCropPoint(topRight.x + dx, topRight.y + dy),
        bottomRight = NormalizedCropPoint(bottomRight.x + dx, bottomRight.y + dy),
        bottomLeft = NormalizedCropPoint(bottomLeft.x + dx, bottomLeft.y + dy),
    )
}

FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/QuadTemporalFilterTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class QuadTemporalFilterTest {
    private val initial = floatArrayOf(100f, 100f, 200f, 100f, 200f, 200f, 100f, 200f)

    @Test
    fun `first quad is returned immediately and filter keeps defensive copies`() {
        val filter = QuadTemporalFilter()
        val input = initial.clone()

        val first = filter.update(input)
        assertArrayEquals(input, first, 0f)
        assertNotSame("Returned coordinates are a copy of the input", input, first)

        first[0] = -1f
        input[1] = -2f
        val held = filter.onMissing()
        assertArrayEquals("Stored geometry is unaffected by caller mutations", initial, held, 0f)
        assertNotSame(first, held)

        held!![0] = -3f
        assertArrayEquals("Each missing result is also a defensive copy", initial, filter.onMissing(), 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun `hold frames retain the last contour and the next one clears it`() {
        val filter = QuadTemporalFilter()
        filter.update(initial)

        repeat(QuadTemporalFilter.HOLD_FRAMES) {
            assertArrayEquals(initial, filter.onMissing(), 0f)
        }
        assertNull(filter.onMissing())
        assertNull(filter.onMissing())
        assertFalse(filter.isTracking)
    }

    @Test
    fun `large jump is held once and accepted only after a second consistent measurement`() {
        val filter = QuadTemporalFilter()
        filter.update(initial)
        val firstJump = shifted(initial, dx = 60f)
        val confirmingJump = shifted(initial, dx = 62f)

        assertArrayEquals("The first large jump holds the prior contour", initial, filter.update(firstJump), 0f)
        assertArrayEquals("A second nearby jump is accepted without blending with the old sheet",
            confirmingJump, filter.update(confirmingJump), 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun `reset clears current contour and a pending rejected jump`() {
        val filter = QuadTemporalFilter()
        filter.update(initial)
        val pendingJump = shifted(initial, dx = 60f)
        assertArrayEquals(initial, filter.update(pendingJump), 0f)

        filter.reset()
        assertNull(filter.onMissing())
        assertArrayEquals("The next quad after reset becomes the new immediate baseline",
            pendingJump, filter.update(pendingJump), 0f)
    }

    private fun shifted(quad: FloatArray, dx: Float): FloatArray = FloatArray(quad.size) { index ->
        quad[index] + if (index % 2 == 0) dx else 0f
    }
}

package app.docscan.android

import app.docscan.core.semantic.DateOption
import app.docscan.core.semantic.EventStatus
import app.docscan.core.semantic.Proposal
import app.docscan.core.semantic.ProposalKind
import app.docscan.core.semantic.ProposalState
import app.docscan.core.semantic.TimeOption
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalTime
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SemanticSuggestionTextTest {
    private fun date(y: Int, m: Int, d: Int, inferred: Boolean = false) = DateOption(LocalDate.of(y, m, d), inferred, emptyList())
    private fun time(h: Int, m: Int) = TimeOption(LocalTime.of(h, m), emptyList())
    private fun proposal(
        kind: ProposalKind = ProposalKind.EVENT,
        state: ProposalState = ProposalState.FILLED,
        date: DateOption? = null,
        time: TimeOption? = null,
        dateOptions: List<DateOption> = emptyList(),
        timeOptions: List<TimeOption> = emptyList(),
    ) = Proposal(kind, state, EventStatus.CONFIRMED, "Приём у врача", date, dateOptions, time, timeOptions)

    @Test fun eventLine() {
        assertEquals("18.11.2026 14:30 · Приём у врача", SemanticSuggestionText.line(proposal(date = date(2026, 11, 18), time = time(14, 30))))
    }

    @Test fun inferredYearIsMarked() {
        assertEquals(
            "18.11.2026 14:30 · Приём у врача · год не напечатан",
            SemanticSuggestionText.line(proposal(date = date(2026, 11, 18, true), time = time(14, 30))),
        )
        assertEquals("18.11.2026 · год не напечатан", SemanticSuggestionText.dateOptionText(date(2026, 11, 18, true)))
        assertEquals("18.11.2026", SemanticSuggestionText.dateOptionText(date(2026, 11, 18)))
    }

    @Test fun taskLine() {
        assertEquals("Срок 30.11.2026 · Приём у врача", SemanticSuggestionText.line(proposal(ProposalKind.TASK, date = date(2026, 11, 30))))
    }

    @Test fun stateLabelsAreDistinct() {
        val labels = ProposalState.values().map { SemanticSuggestionText.stateLabel(it) }
        assertEquals("", SemanticSuggestionText.stateLabel(ProposalState.FILLED))
        assertEquals("Проверьте по фрагменту", SemanticSuggestionText.stateLabel(ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY))
        assertEquals("Несколько подходящих вариантов", SemanticSuggestionText.stateLabel(ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE))
        assertEquals("Предварительная запись: заполните дату вручную", SemanticSuggestionText.stateLabel(ProposalState.EMPTY))
        assertEquals(labels.size, labels.toSet().size)
    }

    @Test fun actionLabels() {
        assertEquals("Добавить", SemanticSuggestionText.actionLabel(ProposalState.FILLED))
        assertEquals("Верно, добавить", SemanticSuggestionText.actionLabel(ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY))
        assertEquals("Заполнить вручную", SemanticSuggestionText.actionLabel(ProposalState.EMPTY))
        assertEquals("Добавить", SemanticSuggestionText.actionLabel(ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE))
    }

    @Test fun formFormats() {
        assertEquals("2026-11-18", SemanticSuggestionText.formDate(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 18)))
        assertEquals("09:05", SemanticSuggestionText.formTime(LocalTime.of(9, 5)))
        assertTrue(Regex("\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}").matches(SemanticSuggestionText.formDate(LocalDate.of(2026, 1, 2))))
        assertTrue(Regex("([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]").matches(SemanticSuggestionText.formTime(LocalTime.of(0, 0))))
    }

    @Test fun titleIsTrimmedToFormLimit() {
        assertEquals(200, SemanticSuggestionText.formTitle("а".repeat(500)).length)
        assertEquals("x", SemanticSuggestionText.formTitle("  x "))
    }

    @Test fun choiceNeverPickedForUser() {
        val needs = proposal(state = ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, dateOptions = listOf(date(2026, 11, 18)), timeOptions = listOf(time(9, 0)))
        assertFalse(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(needs, null, null))
        assertFalse(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(needs, needs.dateOptions[0], null))
        assertFalse(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(needs, null, needs.timeOptions[0]))
        assertTrue(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(needs, needs.dateOptions[0], needs.timeOptions[0]))
    }

    @Test fun eventWithKnownDateNeedsOnlyTime() {
        val p = proposal(state = ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, date = date(2026, 11, 18), timeOptions = listOf(time(9, 0), time(10, 0)))
        assertFalse(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(p, null, null))
        assertTrue(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(p, null, p.timeOptions[1]))
    }

    @Test fun taskNeedsOnlyDate() {
        val p = proposal(ProposalKind.TASK, ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, dateOptions = listOf(date(2026, 11, 30), date(2027, 11, 30, true)))
        assertFalse(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(p, null, null))
        assertTrue(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(p, p.dateOptions[1], null))
    }

    @Test fun emptyAlwaysApplicableAndFilledToo() {
        assertTrue(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(proposal(state = ProposalState.EMPTY), null, null))
        assertTrue(SemanticSuggestionText.canApply(proposal(date = date(2026, 11, 18), time = time(14, 30)), null, null))
    }

    @Test fun lineWithPickedValues() {
        val p = proposal(state = ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, dateOptions = listOf(date(2026, 11, 18)), timeOptions = listOf(time(9, 0)))
        assertEquals("18.11.2026 09:00 · Приём у врача", SemanticSuggestionText.line(p, p.dateOptions[0], p.timeOptions[0]))
        assertEquals("Приём у врача", SemanticSuggestionText.line(p))
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/SheetEdgeSnapperTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.hypot

class SheetEdgeSnapperTest {
    private val w = 600
    private val h = 800

    /** Bright page (quad) on a darker, noisy background, edges slightly blurred. */
    private fun scene(quad: DoubleArray, page: Int = 215, bg: Int = 60): ByteArray {
        val img = ByteArray(w * h)
        val rnd = java.util.Random(3)
        fun inside(x: Double, y: Double): Boolean {
            var sign = 0
            for (i in 0 until 4) {
                val j = (i + 1) % 4
                val cr = (quad[j * 2] - quad[i * 2]) * (y - quad[i * 2 + 1]) - (quad[j * 2 + 1] - quad[i * 2 + 1]) * (x - quad[i * 2])
                val s = if (cr >= 0) 1 else -1
                if (sign == 0) sign = s else if (s != sign) return false
            }
            return true
        }
        val raw = DoubleArray(w * h) { i ->
            val x = (i % w).toDouble(); val y = (i / w).toDouble()
            (if (inside(x, y)) page else bg) + rnd.nextGaussian() * 4
        }
        for (y in 1 until h - 1) for (x in 1 until w - 1) {
            var acc = 0.0
            for (dy in -1..1) for (dx in -1..1) acc += raw[(y + dy) * w + x + dx]
            img[y * w + x] = (acc / 9).coerceIn(0.0, 255.0).toInt().toByte()
        }
        return img
    }

    private fun maxError(a: DoubleArray, b: DoubleArray) = (0 until 4).maxOf { hypot(a[it * 2] - b[it * 2], a[it * 2 + 1] - b[it * 2 + 1]) }

    @Test
    fun `coarse quad off by fifteen pixels snaps onto the page edge`() {
        val truth = doubleArrayOf(120.0, 140.0, 480.0, 120.0, 500.0, 680.0, 100.0, 700.0)
        val coarse = doubleArrayOf(105.0, 152.0, 494.0, 108.0, 512.0, 694.0, 88.0, 712.0)
        val result = SheetEdgeSnapper.snap(scene(truth), w, h, coarse)
        assertEquals(4, result.confirmedSides)
        assertTrue("error ${maxError(result.quad, truth)}", maxError(result.quad, truth) < 2.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun `dark page on a bright background is handled by polarity`() {
        val truth = doubleArrayOf(120.0, 140.0, 480.0, 120.0, 500.0, 680.0, 100.0, 700.0)
        val coarse = doubleArrayOf(110.0, 148.0, 490.0, 112.0, 508.0, 690.0, 92.0, 708.0)
        val result = SheetEdgeSnapper.snap(scene(truth, page = 50, bg = 200), w, h, coarse)
        assertTrue(maxError(result.quad, truth) < 2.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun `featureless image keeps the coarse quad`() {
        val flat = ByteArray(w * h) { 128.toByte() }
        val coarse = doubleArrayOf(120.0, 140.0, 480.0, 120.0, 500.0, 680.0, 100.0, 700.0)
        val result = SheetEdgeSnapper.snap(flat, w, h, coarse)
        assertEquals(0, result.confirmedSides)
        assertEquals(0.0, maxError(result.quad, coarse), 1e-6)
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/android/WarpGeometryTest.kt

package app.docscan.android

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin

class WarpGeometryTest {
    private val width = 3000
    private val height = 4000

    /** Pinhole projection of a w x h rectangle rotated by [tiltX]/[tiltY] radians, focal length [f] pixels, 400 mm away. */
    private fun project(w: Double, h: Double, tiltX: Double, tiltY: Double, f: Double = 3000.0): DoubleArray {
        val corners = listOf(-w / 2 to -h / 2, w / 2 to -h / 2, w / 2 to h / 2, -w / 2 to h / 2)
        val out = DoubleArray(8)
        corners.forEachIndexed { i, (x, y) ->
            val y1 = y * cos(tiltX)
            val z1 = y * sin(tiltX)
            val x2 = x * cos(tiltY) + z1 * sin(tiltY)
            val z2 = -x * sin(tiltY) + z1 * cos(tiltY)
            val depth = 400.0 + z2
            out[i * 2] = width / 2.0 + f * x2 / depth
            out[i * 2 + 1] = height / 2.0 + f * y1 / depth
        }
        return out
    }

    private fun ratio(size: Pair<Int, Int>) = size.first.toDouble() / size.second

    @Test
    fun `tilted A4 is restored to A4 where the old rule stretched it`() {
        val quad = project(210.0, 297.0, tiltX = 0.45, tiltY = 0.12)
        val old = maxOf(
            Math.hypot(quad[2] - quad[0], quad[3] - quad[1]), Math.hypot(quad[4] - quad[6], quad[5] - quad[7])
        ) / maxOf(
            Math.hypot(quad[6] - quad[0], quad[7] - quad[1]), Math.hypot(quad[4] - quad[2], quad[5] - quad[3])
        )
        assertEquals("old max-sides rule stretches the page", true, old > 0.74)
        assertEquals(210.0 / 297.0, ratio(WarpGeometry.outputSize(quad, width, height)), 0.004)
    }

    @Test
    fun `non standard page keeps its measured ratio`() {
        val quad = project(100.0, 240.0, tiltX = 0.4, tiltY = -0.15)
        assertEquals(100.0 / 240.0, ratio(WarpGeometry.outputSize(quad, width, height)), 0.012)
    }

    @Test
    fun `quad without perspective keeps the plain side lengths`() {
        val quad = doubleArrayOf(100.0, 100.0, 700.0, 100.0, 700.0, 1000.0, 100.0, 1000.0)
        assertEquals(600 to 900, WarpGeometry.outputSize(quad, width, height))
        assertNull(WarpGeometry.estimateAspect(quad, width, height, 600.0 / 900.0))
    }

    @Test
    fun `pixel count stays that of the old rule`() {
        val quad = project(210.0, 297.0, tiltX = 0.45, tiltY = 0.12)
        val size = WarpGeometry.outputSize(quad, width, height)
        val oldW = maxOf(Math.hypot(quad[2] - quad[0], quad[3] - quad[1]), Math.hypot(quad[4] - quad[6], quad[5] - quad[7]))
        val oldH = maxOf(Math.hypot(quad[6] - quad[0], quad[7] - quad[1]), Math.hypot(quad[4] - quad[2], quad[5] - quad[3]))
        assertEquals(oldW * oldH, size.first.toDouble() * size.second, oldW * oldH * 0.01)
    }

    @Test
    fun `sheet cut off by the image border keeps the plain side lengths`() {
        val quad = project(210.0, 297.0, tiltX = 0.45, tiltY = 0.12)
        quad[7] = (height - 1).toDouble(); quad[5] = (height - 1).toDouble()
        val top = Math.hypot(quad[2] - quad[0], quad[3] - quad[1]); val bottom = Math.hypot(quad[4] - quad[6], quad[5] - quad[7])
        val left = Math.hypot(quad[6] - quad[0], quad[7] - quad[1]); val right = Math.hypot(quad[4] - quad[2], quad[5] - quad[3])
        assertEquals(Math.round(maxOf(top, bottom)).toInt() to Math.round(maxOf(left, right)).toInt(),
            WarpGeometry.outputSize(quad, width, height).let { it.first to it.second }, )
    }
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/artifact/FileArtifactRepository.kt

package app.docscan.core.artifact

import app.docscan.core.model.ArtifactId
import app.docscan.core.store.DurableImageArtifact
import app.docscan.core.store.DurableExportFile
import java.io.InputStream
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.CREATE
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.READ
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.WRITE
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock

fun interface DirectorySync {
    /** Must return only after the directory entry is durable for the supported crash boundary. */
    fun sync(directory: Path)
}

fun interface AtomicArtifactPublisher {
    /** Creates the final name atomically and must fail if it already exists. */
    fun publish(temporary: Path, target: Path)
}

fun interface ArtifactStagingSync {
    /** Forces completed staging-file bytes before the repository can publish a final name. */
    fun force(channel: FileChannel)
}

fun interface ArtifactStagingWriteCheckpoint {
    /** Runs immediately before the next private staging-file write. */
    fun beforeWrite(channel: FileChannel, bytesAlreadyWritten: Long)
}

fun interface ArtifactStagingOutputFlush {
    /** Flushes completed output before the staging file is forced or published. */
    fun flush(output: java.io.OutputStream, channel: FileChannel, bytesWritten: Long)
}

object NioAtomicArtifactPublisher : AtomicArtifactPublisher {
    override fun publish(temporary: Path, target: Path) {
        Files.createLink(target, temporary)
        Files.delete(temporary)
    }
}

/** JVM implementation for host tests. Android must provide its own qualified DirectorySync. */
object NioDirectorySync : DirectorySync {
    override fun sync(directory: Path) {
        FileChannel.open(directory, READ).use { channel -> channel.force(true) }
    }
}

/**
 * Publishes image bytes into private immutable object storage.
 * Metadata registration is deliberately a separate StateStore transaction.
 */
class FileArtifactRepository(
    private val privateRoot: Path,
    private val directorySync: DirectorySync,
    private val producerEpoch: String,
    private val atomicPublisher: AtomicArtifactPublisher = NioAtomicArtifactPublisher,
    private val stagingSync: ArtifactStagingSync = ArtifactStagingSync { channel -> channel.force(true) },
    private val stagingWriteCheckpoint: ArtifactStagingWriteCheckpoint = ArtifactStagingWriteCheckpoint { _, _ -> },
    private val stagingOutputFlush: ArtifactStagingOutputFlush = ArtifactStagingOutputFlush { output, _, _ -> output.flush() },
) {
    init {
        require(producerEpoch.isNotBlank())
    }

    fun publishJpeg(source: InputStream, artifactId: ArtifactId = ArtifactId.new()): DurableImageArtifact {
        return publishImage(source, "jpg", artifactId)
    }

    fun publishImage(
        source: InputStream,
        extension: String,
        artifactId: ArtifactId = ArtifactId.new(),
    ): DurableImageArtifact {
        require(extension in SUPPORTED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS) { "Unsupported image extension" }
        val metadata = publishBytes(source, extension, artifactId)
        return DurableImageArtifact(
            artifactId = metadata.artifactId,
            relativePath = metadata.relativePath,
            sizeBytes = metadata.sizeBytes,
            sha256 = metadata.sha256,
            formatVersion = metadata.formatVersion,
            producerEpoch = metadata.producerEpoch,
        )
    }

    /** Reuses a deterministic image object after a crash only when the bytes are identical. */
    fun publishOrVerifyImage(
        source: InputStream,
        extension: String,
        artifactId: ArtifactId,
    ): DurableImageArtifact {
        require(extension in SUPPORTED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS) { "Unsupported image extension" }
        val metadata = publishBytes(source, extension, artifactId, allowIdenticalExisting = true)
        return DurableImageArtifact(
            artifactId = metadata.artifactId,
            relativePath = metadata.relativePath,
            sizeBytes = metadata.sizeBytes,
            sha256 = metadata.sha256,
            formatVersion = metadata.formatVersion,
            producerEpoch = metadata.producerEpoch,
        )
    }

    fun publishExportFile(
        source: InputStream,
        extension: String,
        artifactId: ArtifactId = ArtifactId.new(),
    ): DurableExportFile {
        require(extension in SUPPORTED_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS) { "Unsupported export file extension" }
        val metadata = publishBytes(source, extension, artifactId)
        return DurableExportFile(
            artifactId = metadata.artifactId,
            relativePath = metadata.relativePath,
            sizeBytes = metadata.sizeBytes,
            sha256 = metadata.sha256,
            formatVersion = metadata.formatVersion,
            producerEpoch = metadata.producerEpoch,
        )
    }

    /** Describes an immutable export target before creating any file-system object. */
    fun describeExportFile(
        artifactId: ArtifactId,
        extension: String,
        sizeBytes: Long,
        sha256: String,
    ): DurableExportFile {
        require(extension in SUPPORTED_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS)
        require(sizeBytes > 0L && sha256.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}")))
        return DurableExportFile(
            artifactId = artifactId,
            relativePath = expectedExportFileRelativePath(artifactId, extension),
            sizeBytes = sizeBytes,
            sha256 = sha256,
            formatVersion = 1L,
            producerEpoch = producerEpoch,
        )
    }

    fun expectedExportFileRelativePath(artifactId: ArtifactId, extension: String): String {
        require(extension in SUPPORTED_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS)
        return "objects/${artifactId.value.take(2)}/${artifactId.value}.$extension"
    }

    fun expectedImageFileRelativePath(artifactId: ArtifactId, extension: String): String {
        require(extension in SUPPORTED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS)
        return "objects/${artifactId.value.take(2)}/${artifactId.value}.$extension"
    }

    /** Reads metadata for the exact deterministic private PDF source path owned by an import intent. */
    fun publishedPdfForImport(artifactId: ArtifactId): DurableExportFile? {
        val relativePath = expectedExportFileRelativePath(artifactId, "pdf")
        val target = resolvePrivateObject(relativePath) ?: return null
        if (!Files.exists(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return null
        check(Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Private PDF source path is not a regular file" }
        val size = Files.size(target)
        check(size > 0L) { "Private PDF source is empty" }
        return DurableExportFile(
            artifactId = artifactId,
            relativePath = relativePath,
            sizeBytes = size,
            sha256 = sha256(target),
            formatVersion = 1L,
            producerEpoch = producerEpoch,
        )
    }

    /** Reads metadata only for the deterministic private image path owned by an image-import intent. */
    fun publishedImageForImport(artifactId: ArtifactId, extension: String): DurableImageArtifact? {
        val relativePath = expectedImageFileRelativePath(artifactId, extension)
        val target = resolvePrivateObject(relativePath) ?: return null
        if (!Files.exists(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return null
        check(Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Private image source path is not a regular file" }
        val size = Files.size(target)
        check(size > 0L) { "Private image source is empty" }
        return DurableImageArtifact(
            artifactId = artifactId,
            relativePath = relativePath,
            sizeBytes = size,
            sha256 = sha256(target),
            formatVersion = 1L,
            producerEpoch = producerEpoch,
        )
    }

    /** Removes only an import-intent-owned final PDF and ID-prefixed staging files. */
    fun cleanupInterruptedPdfPublication(artifactId: ArtifactId) {
        val root = ensurePrivateRoot()
        val relativePath = expectedExportFileRelativePath(artifactId, "pdf")
        val target = resolvePrivateObject(relativePath)
        if (target != null && Files.exists(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            rejectSymbolicLinks(root, target)
            check(Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Interrupted PDF target is not a regular file" }
            check(Files.deleteIfExists(target)) { "Cannot remove interrupted PDF target" }
            syncDirectoryChain(root, target.parent)
        }

        val staging = root.resolve("staging").normalize()
        ensureContained(root, staging)
        if (!Files.exists(staging, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return
        rejectSymbolicLinks(root, staging)
        check(Files.isDirectory(staging, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Artifact staging path is not a directory" }
        val pattern = Regex("^${Regex.escape(artifactId.value)}-[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}\\.tmp$")
        val temporaries = Files.newDirectoryStream(staging).use { entries ->
            entries.filter { pattern.matches(it.fileName.toString()) }.toList()
        }
        temporaries.forEach { temporary ->
            rejectSymbolicLinks(root, temporary)
            check(Files.isRegularFile(temporary, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Artifact temporary path is not a regular file" }
            check(Files.deleteIfExists(temporary)) { "Cannot remove interrupted PDF temporary" }
        }
        if (temporaries.isNotEmpty()) directorySync.sync(staging)
    }

    /** Removes only an image-import-intent-owned final image and ID-prefixed staging files. */
    fun cleanupInterruptedImagePublication(artifactId: ArtifactId, extension: String) {
        val root = ensurePrivateRoot()
        val target = resolvePrivateObject(expectedImageFileRelativePath(artifactId, extension))
        if (target != null && Files.exists(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            rejectSymbolicLinks(root, target)
            check(Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Interrupted image target is not a regular file" }
            check(Files.deleteIfExists(target)) { "Cannot remove interrupted image target" }
            syncDirectoryChain(root, target.parent)
        }
        val staging = root.resolve("staging").normalize()
        ensureContained(root, staging)
        if (!Files.exists(staging, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return
        rejectSymbolicLinks(root, staging)
        check(Files.isDirectory(staging, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Artifact staging path is not a directory" }
        val escapedId = Regex.escape(artifactId.value)
        val pattern = Regex("^$escapedId-[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}\\.tmp$")
        val temporaries = Files.newDirectoryStream(staging).use { entries ->
            entries.filter { pattern.matches(it.fileName.toString()) }.toList()
        }
        temporaries.forEach { temporary ->
            rejectSymbolicLinks(root, temporary)
            check(Files.isRegularFile(temporary, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Artifact temporary path is not a regular file" }
            check(Files.deleteIfExists(temporary)) { "Cannot remove interrupted image temporary" }
        }
        if (temporaries.isNotEmpty()) directorySync.sync(staging)
    }

    /** Removes a publication intent's exact target and ID-prefixed write temps, idempotently. */
    fun cleanupInterruptedExportPublication(
        artifactId: ArtifactId,
        extension: String,
        relativePath: String,
        sizeBytes: Long,
        sha256: String,
    ) {
        require(relativePath == expectedExportFileRelativePath(artifactId, extension)) {
            "Publication intent path does not match its deterministic ArtifactId"
        }
        when (inspect(relativePath, sizeBytes, sha256)) {
            ArtifactFileObservation.VERIFIED_PRESENT -> check(
                deleteVerified(relativePath, sizeBytes, sha256) != VerifiedDeleteResult.INVALID,
            ) { "Interrupted export object changed while deleting" }
            ArtifactFileObservation.MISSING -> Unit
            ArtifactFileObservation.INVALID -> error("Interrupted export object failed private path/content validation")
        }

        val root = ensurePrivateRoot()
        val staging = root.resolve("staging").normalize()
        ensureContained(root, staging)
        if (!Files.exists(staging, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return
        rejectSymbolicLinks(root, staging)
        check(Files.isDirectory(staging, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Artifact staging path is not a directory" }
        val escapedId = Regex.escape(artifactId.value)
        val temporaryPattern = Regex("^$escapedId-[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}\\.tmp$")
        val temporaries = Files.newDirectoryStream(staging).use { entries ->
            entries.filter { temporaryPattern.matches(it.fileName.toString()) }.toList()
        }
        temporaries.forEach { temporary ->
            rejectSymbolicLinks(root, temporary)
            check(Files.isRegularFile(temporary, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { "Artifact temporary path is not a regular file" }
            check(Files.deleteIfExists(temporary)) { "Cannot remove interrupted artifact temporary" }
        }
        if (temporaries.isNotEmpty()) directorySync.sync(staging)
    }

    /** Reuses a deterministic publication only when a repeated workflow presents byte-identical input. */
    fun publishOrVerifyExportFile(
        source: InputStream,
        extension: String,
        artifactId: ArtifactId,
    ): DurableExportFile {
        require(extension in SUPPORTED_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS) { "Unsupported export file extension" }
        val metadata = publishBytes(source, extension, artifactId, allowIdenticalExisting = true)
        return DurableExportFile(
            artifactId = metadata.artifactId,
            relativePath = metadata.relativePath,
            sizeBytes = metadata.sizeBytes,
            sha256 = metadata.sha256,
            formatVersion = metadata.formatVersion,
            producerEpoch = metadata.producerEpoch,
        )
    }

    private fun publishBytes(
        source: InputStream,
        extension: String,
        artifactId: ArtifactId,
        allowIdenticalExisting: Boolean = false,
    ): FileMetadata {
        val root = ensurePrivateRoot()
        val id = artifactId.value
        val stagingDir = root.resolve("staging").normalize()
        val objectDir = root.resolve("objects").resolve(id.take(2)).normalize()
        ensureContained(root, stagingDir)
        ensureContained(root, objectDir)
        Files.createDirectories(stagingDir)
        Files.createDirectories(objectDir)
        rejectSymbolicLinks(root, stagingDir)
        rejectSymbolicLinks(root, objectDir)

        val temporary = stagingDir.resolve("$id-${UUID.randomUUID()}.tmp")
        val target = objectDir.resolve("$id.$extension")
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        var byteCount = 0L

        try {
            FileChannel.open(temporary, WRITE, CREATE_NEW).use { channel ->
                val output = java.nio.channels.Channels.newOutputStream(channel)
                val buffer = ByteArray(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE)
                while (true) {
                    val count = source.read(buffer)
                    if (count < 0) break
                    if (count == 0) continue
                    stagingWriteCheckpoint.beforeWrite(channel, byteCount)
                    output.write(buffer, 0, count)
                    digest.update(buffer, 0, count)
                    byteCount += count
                }
                stagingOutputFlush.flush(output, channel, byteCount)
                stagingSync.force(channel)
            }
            require(byteCount > 0L) { "Cannot publish an empty artifact" }
            if (Files.exists(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                if (!allowIdenticalExisting || Files.isSymbolicLink(target)
                    || !Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)
                    || Files.size(target) != byteCount
                ) throw IllegalStateException("Immutable artifact path already exists")
                val incomingSha256 = digest.digest().toHex()
                if (sha256(target) != incomingSha256) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("Repeated import request supplied different source bytes")
                }
                Files.deleteIfExists(temporary)
                directorySync.sync(stagingDir)
                directorySync.sync(objectDir)
                return FileMetadata(
                    artifactId,
                    root.relativize(target).toString().replace('\\', '/'),
                    byteCount,
                    incomingSha256,
                    1L,
                    producerEpoch,
                )
            }

            try {
                atomicPublisher.publish(temporary, target)
            } catch (failure: java.nio.file.FileAlreadyExistsException) {
                if (!allowIdenticalExisting || Files.isSymbolicLink(target)
                    || !Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)
                    || Files.size(target) != byteCount
                    || sha256(target) != digest.digest().toHex()
                ) throw failure
                Files.deleteIfExists(temporary)
                syncDirectoryChain(root, stagingDir)
                syncDirectoryChain(root, objectDir)
                return FileMetadata(
                    artifactId,
                    root.relativize(target).toString().replace('\\', '/'),
                    byteCount,
                    sha256(target),
                    1L,
                    producerEpoch,
                )
            }
            syncDirectoryChain(root, stagingDir)
            syncDirectoryChain(root, objectDir)

            return FileMetadata(
                artifactId = artifactId,
                relativePath = root.relativize(target).toString().replace('\\', '/'),
                sizeBytes = byteCount,
                sha256 = digest.digest().toHex(),
                formatVersion = 1L,
                producerEpoch = producerEpoch,
            )
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            try {
                Files.deleteIfExists(temporary)
            } catch (cleanupFailure: Throwable) {
                failure.addSuppressed(cleanupFailure)
            }
            throw failure
        }
    }

    /** Bounded one-object check. Caller must perform filesystem I/O outside database transactions. */
    fun verifyPublished(relativePath: String, expectedSize: Long, expectedSha256: String): Boolean {
        if (expectedSize <= 0L || !expectedSha256.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}"))) return false
        val root = ensurePrivateRoot()
        val relative = Path.of(relativePath)
        if (relative.isAbsolute || relative.any { it.toString() == ".." || it.toString().isBlank() }) return false
        val target = root.resolve(relative).normalize()
        ensureContained(root, target)
        rejectSymbolicLinks(root, target)
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.size(target) != expectedSize) return false
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        Files.newInputStream(target, READ).use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                if (count > 0) digest.update(buffer, 0, count)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().toHex() == expectedSha256
    }

    /** Deletes exactly one checksum-verified private object and syncs its directory entries. */
    fun deleteVerified(relativePath: String, expectedSize: Long, expectedSha256: String): VerifiedDeleteResult {
        val target = resolvePrivateObject(relativePath) ?: return VerifiedDeleteResult.INVALID
        if (!Files.exists(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return VerifiedDeleteResult.MISSING
        if (!verifyPublished(relativePath, expectedSize, expectedSha256)) return VerifiedDeleteResult.INVALID
        // Recheck the final component immediately before unlinking; artifact storage is app-private.
        rejectSymbolicLinks(ensurePrivateRoot(), target)
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return VerifiedDeleteResult.INVALID
        if (!Files.deleteIfExists(target)) return VerifiedDeleteResult.MISSING
        syncDirectoryChain(ensurePrivateRoot(), target.parent)
        return VerifiedDeleteResult.DELETED
    }

    /**
     * Excludes cleanup workers sharing this private artifact root, including workers in other
     * processes. The OS releases the file lock if a process dies; the in-process lock prevents
     * overlapping Java file locks from throwing instead of waiting.
     */
    fun <T> withExclusiveCleanupLock(block: () -> T): T {
        PROCESS_CLEANUP_LOCK.lock()
        try {
            val root = ensurePrivateRoot()
            val lockPath = root.resolve(CLEANUP_LOCK_FILE)
            FileChannel.open(lockPath, CREATE, WRITE, NOFOLLOW_LINKS).use { channel ->
                channel.lock().use { return block() }
            }
        } finally {
            PROCESS_CLEANUP_LOCK.unlock()
        }
    }

    fun inspect(relativePath: String, expectedSize: Long, expectedSha256: String?): ArtifactFileObservation {
        val target = try { resolvePrivateObject(relativePath) } catch (_: SecurityException) { null }
            ?: return ArtifactFileObservation.INVALID
        if (!Files.exists(target, NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return ArtifactFileObservation.MISSING
        if (expectedSha256 == null || !verifyPublished(relativePath, expectedSize, expectedSha256)) {
            return ArtifactFileObservation.INVALID
        }
        return ArtifactFileObservation.VERIFIED_PRESENT
    }

    private fun resolvePrivateObject(relativePath: String): Path? {
        val root = ensurePrivateRoot()
        val relative = Path.of(relativePath)
        if (relative.isAbsolute || relative.any { it.toString() == ".." || it.toString().isBlank() }) return null
        val target = root.resolve(relative).normalize()
        ensureContained(root, target)
        rejectSymbolicLinks(root, target)
        return target
    }

    private fun ensurePrivateRoot(): Path {
        Files.createDirectories(privateRoot)
        val root = privateRoot.toRealPath()
        if (Files.isSymbolicLink(privateRoot)) throw SecurityException("Artifact root cannot be a symlink")
        return root
    }

    private fun ensureContained(root: Path, candidate: Path) {
        if (!candidate.startsWith(root) || candidate == root) {
            throw SecurityException("Artifact path escapes private storage")
        }
    }

    private fun rejectSymbolicLinks(root: Path, target: Path) {
        var current = root
        for (part in root.relativize(target)) {
            current = current.resolve(part)
            if (Files.isSymbolicLink(current)) throw SecurityException("Artifact path contains a symlink")
        }
    }

    private fun syncDirectoryChain(root: Path, directory: Path) {
        var current: Path? = directory
        while (current != null && current.startsWith(root)) {
            directorySync.sync(current)
            if (current == root) break
            current = current.parent
        }
        directorySync.sync(root)
    }

    private fun ByteArray.toHex(): String = joinToString("") { byte -> "%02x".format(byte) }

    private fun sha256(path: Path): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        Files.newInputStream(path, READ).use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                if (count == 0) continue
                digest.update(buffer, 0, count)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().toHex()
    }

    private companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = 64 * 1024
        const val CLEANUP_LOCK_FILE = ".cleanup-arbiter.lock"
        val PROCESS_CLEANUP_LOCK = ReentrantLock(true)
        val SUPPORTED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = setOf("jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "heic")
        val SUPPORTED_EXPORT_EXTENSIONS = setOf("pdf", "jpg")
    }

    private data class FileMetadata(
        val artifactId: ArtifactId,
        val relativePath: String,
        val sizeBytes: Long,
        val sha256: String,
        val formatVersion: Long,
        val producerEpoch: String,
    )
}

enum class VerifiedDeleteResult { DELETED, MISSING, INVALID }
enum class ArtifactFileObservation { VERIFIED_PRESENT, MISSING, INVALID }

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/cleanup/CleanupArbiter.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.cleanup

import app.docscan.core.artifact.ArtifactFileObservation
import app.docscan.core.artifact.FileArtifactRepository
import app.docscan.core.artifact.VerifiedDeleteResult
import app.docscan.core.store.ArtifactDeletionClaim
import app.docscan.core.store.StateStore

/** Serializes cleanup through durable reference checks, claim tokens and verified file deletion. */
class CleanupArbiter(
    private val store: StateStore,
    private val artifacts: FileArtifactRepository,
) {
    /** Reconciles existing claims first, then processes at most [limit] new artifacts. */
    fun runBatch(limit: Long = DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE): CleanupBatchResult {
        require(limit in 1L..MAX_BATCH_SIZE)
        return artifacts.withExclusiveCleanupLock {
            val recovered = recoverInterruptedDeletionsLocked(limit)
            val claims = store.claimUnreferencedArtifacts(limit)
            var deleted = 0
            var quarantined = 0
            claims.forEach { claim ->
                when (artifacts.deleteVerified(claim.relativePath, claim.sizeBytes, claim.sha256.orEmpty())) {
                    VerifiedDeleteResult.DELETED, VerifiedDeleteResult.MISSING -> {
                        store.finalizeArtifactDeletion(claim)
                        deleted++
                    }
                    VerifiedDeleteResult.INVALID -> {
                        store.quarantineClaimedArtifact(claim)
                        quarantined++
                    }
                }
            }
            CleanupBatchResult(recovered, claims.size, deleted, quarantined)
        }
    }

    /**
     * A valid file means the prior worker died before unlink; retry may be scheduled later.
     * A missing file means unlink completed; corrupt/unsafe paths are quarantined without unlink.
     */
    fun recoverInterruptedDeletions(limit: Long = DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE): Int {
        require(limit in 1L..MAX_BATCH_SIZE)
        return artifacts.withExclusiveCleanupLock { recoverInterruptedDeletionsLocked(limit) }
    }

    private fun recoverInterruptedDeletionsLocked(limit: Long): Int {
        val claims: List<ArtifactDeletionClaim> = store.claimedArtifactDeletions(limit)
        claims.forEach { claim ->
            when (artifacts.inspect(claim.relativePath, claim.sizeBytes, claim.sha256)) {
                ArtifactFileObservation.VERIFIED_PRESENT -> store.releaseArtifactDeletionClaim(claim)
                ArtifactFileObservation.MISSING -> store.finalizeArtifactDeletion(claim)
                ArtifactFileObservation.INVALID -> store.quarantineClaimedArtifact(claim)
            }
        }
        return claims.size
    }

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE = 32L
        const val MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 100L
    }
}

data class CleanupBatchResult(
    val recoveredClaims: Int,
    val claimedArtifacts: Int,
    val deletedArtifacts: Int,
    val quarantinedArtifacts: Int,
)

package app.docscan.core.edit

/** Ordered normalized image-space corners: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. */
data class NormalizedCropPoint(val x: Double, val y: Double) {
    init {
        require(x.isFinite() && y.isFinite())
        require(x in 0.0..1.0 && y in 0.0..1.0)
    }
}

data class CropQuadrilateral(
    val topLeft: NormalizedCropPoint,
    val topRight: NormalizedCropPoint,
    val bottomRight: NormalizedCropPoint,
    val bottomLeft: NormalizedCropPoint,
) {
    init {
        val points = listOf(topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft)
        val turns = points.indices.map { index ->
            val a = points[index]
            val b = points[(index + 1) % points.size]
            val c = points[(index + 2) % points.size]
            (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x)
        }
        require(turns.all { it > MIN_CROSS } || turns.all { it < -MIN_CROSS }) {
            "Crop corners must form a non-degenerate convex quadrilateral"
        }
        val areaTwice = points.indices.sumOf { index ->
            val current = points[index]
            val next = points[(index + 1) % points.size]
            current.x * next.y - next.x * current.y
        }
        require(kotlin.math.abs(areaTwice) > MIN_AREA_TWICE) {
            "Crop area must be greater than zero"
        }
    }

    fun asList(): List<NormalizedCropPoint> = listOf(topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft)

    /** Moves one of the 4 edges by the given normalized delta (dx, dy), clamping to bounds and preserving convexity. */
    fun withMovedEdge(edgeIndex: Int, dx: Double, dy: Double): CropQuadrilateral {
        require(edgeIndex in 0..3) { "edgeIndex must be in 0..3, was $edgeIndex" }
        if (!dx.isFinite() || !dy.isFinite() || (dx == 0.0 && dy == 0.0)) return this

        val points = asList()
        val idx1 = edgeIndex
        val idx2 = (edgeIndex + 1) % 4
        val p1 = points[idx1]
        val p2 = points[idx2]

        val minDx = maxOf(-p1.x, -p2.x)
        val maxDx = minOf(1.0 - p1.x, 1.0 - p2.x)
        val clampedDx = dx.coerceIn(minDx, maxDx)

        val minDy = maxOf(-p1.y, -p2.y)
        val maxDy = minOf(1.0 - p1.y, 1.0 - p2.y)
        val clampedDy = dy.coerceIn(minDy, maxDy)

        if (clampedDx == 0.0 && clampedDy == 0.0) return this

        val initialTurnsPositive = run {
            val a = points[0]
            val b = points[1]
            val c = points[2]
            (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x) > 0
        }

        fun tryConstruct(stepDx: Double, stepDy: Double): CropQuadrilateral? {
            return runCatching {
                val newP1 = NormalizedCropPoint(
                    (p1.x + stepDx).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
                    (p1.y + stepDy).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
                )
                val newP2 = NormalizedCropPoint(
                    (p2.x + stepDx).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
                    (p2.y + stepDy).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
                )
                val updated = points.toMutableList()
                updated[idx1] = newP1
                updated[idx2] = newP2
                val candTurnsPositive = run {
                    val a = updated[0]
                    val b = updated[1]
                    val c = updated[2]
                    (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - b.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - b.x) > 0
                }
                require(candTurnsPositive == initialTurnsPositive)
                CropQuadrilateral(updated[0], updated[1], updated[2], updated[3])
            }.getOrNull()
        }

        val full = tryConstruct(clampedDx, clampedDy)
        if (full != null) return full

        var low = 0.0
        var high = 1.0
        var best: CropQuadrilateral = this
        repeat(8) {
            val mid = (low + high) / 2.0
            val candidate = tryConstruct(clampedDx * mid, clampedDy * mid)
            if (candidate != null) {
                best = candidate
                low = mid
            } else {
                high = mid
            }
        }
        return best
    }

    /** Keeps the selected source region aligned when the page is rotated clockwise. */
    fun rotatedClockwise(turns: Int): CropQuadrilateral {
        require(turns in 0..3)
        var points = asList()
        repeat(turns) {
            fun map(point: NormalizedCropPoint) = NormalizedCropPoint(1.0 - point.y, point.x)
            points = listOf(map(points[3]), map(points[0]), map(points[1]), map(points[2]))
        }
        return CropQuadrilateral(points[0], points[1], points[2], points[3])
    }

    private companion object {
        const val MIN_CROSS = 1e-6
        const val MIN_AREA_TWICE = 1e-6
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.edit

/** Volatile, multi-operation image edit state; pixels are rendered from the immutable source. */
data class PageImageEditState(
    val clockwiseTurns: Int = 0,
    val brightness: Int = 0,
    val contrastPercent: Int = 100,
    val sharpnessPercent: Int = 0,
    val crop: CropQuadrilateral? = null,
    /** Null leaves illumination alone; any mode whitens the current artifact (idempotent, so safe on a whitened page). */
    val whitening: app.docscan.core.whiten.WhiteningMode? = null,
    /** How far towards the whitened result the page goes: 0 keeps the image, 100 is the full effect. */
    val whitenessPercent: Int = 100,
) {
    init {
        require(clockwiseTurns in 0..3)
        require(brightness in -100..100)
        require(contrastPercent in 0..200)
        require(sharpnessPercent in 0..200)
        require(whitenessPercent in 0..100)
    }
}

class PageImageEditDraft {
    private val undoStates = mutableListOf<PageImageEditState>()
    private var savedState = PageImageEditState()
    private var previewOrigin: PageImageEditState? = null

    var state: PageImageEditState = savedState
        private set

    val isDirty: Boolean get() = state != savedState || undoStates.isNotEmpty()
    val canUndo: Boolean get() = undoStates.isNotEmpty()

    fun preview(next: PageImageEditState) {
        if (previewOrigin == null) previewOrigin = state
        state = next
    }

    fun commitPreview() {
        val origin = previewOrigin ?: return
        if (state != origin) undoStates += origin
        previewOrigin = null
    }

    fun apply(next: PageImageEditState) {
        commitPreview()
        if (next == state) return
        undoStates += state
        state = next
    }

    fun undo() {
        check(canUndo) { "There is no image edit to undo" }
        previewOrigin = null
        state = undoStates.removeAt(undoStates.lastIndex)
        if (state == savedState) undoStates.clear()
    }

    fun markSaved() {
        commitPreview()
        savedState = state
        undoStates.clear()
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.edit

/** Volatile right-angle rotation state with reverse-order Undo and a clean zero-turn state. */
class RightAngleRotationDraft {
    private val previousTurns = mutableListOf<Int>()

    var clockwiseTurns: Int = 0
        private set

    val isDirty: Boolean get() = clockwiseTurns != 0
    val canUndo: Boolean get() = previousTurns.isNotEmpty()

    fun rotateClockwise() {
        val next = (clockwiseTurns + 1) % 4
        if (next == 0) {
            clockwiseTurns = 0
            previousTurns.clear()
        } else {
            previousTurns += clockwiseTurns
            clockwiseTurns = next
        }
    }

    fun undo() {
        check(canUndo) { "There is no rotation to undo" }
        clockwiseTurns = previousTurns.removeAt(previousTurns.lastIndex)
        if (clockwiseTurns == 0) previousTurns.clear()
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.export

import java.text.Normalizer
import java.time.LocalDateTime
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.Locale

/** Builds the editable default basename from current-page OCR and a stable local timestamp. */
object OutputBasenameSuggester {
    private val timestampFormatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH-mm", Locale.ROOT)

    fun suggest(recognizedTextInPageOrder: Iterable<String?>, localTime: LocalDateTime): String {
        val semanticPrefix = recognizedTextInPageOrder.asSequence()
            .filterNotNull()
            .flatMap { it.lineSequence() }
            .map(::safeMeaningfulLine)
            .firstOrNull { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?.let(::firstCodePoints40)
            ?: "Scan"
        return "$semanticPrefix ${localTime.format(timestampFormatter)}"
    }

    private fun safeMeaningfulLine(line: String): String {
        val safe = Normalizer.normalize(line, Normalizer.Form.NFKC)
            .filterNot { character ->
            val category = Character.getType(character)
            character == '/' || character == '\\' || character == ':' || character == '*' || character == '?'
                || character == '"' || character == '<' || character == '>' || character == '|'
                || Character.isISOControl(character)
                || category == Character.FORMAT.toInt()
                || category == Character.LINE_SEPARATOR.toInt()
                || category == Character.PARAGRAPH_SEPARATOR.toInt()
            }
            .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
            .trim(' ', '.', '¿', '¡')
        return if (safe.any(Character::isLetterOrDigit)) safe else ""
    }

    private fun firstCodePoints40(value: String): String {
        val result = StringBuilder()
        val points = value.codePoints().iterator()
        var count = 0
        while (points.hasNext() && count < MAX_SEMANTIC_CODE_POINTS) {
            result.appendCodePoint(points.nextInt())
            count++
        }
        return result.toString()
    }

    private const val MAX_SEMANTIC_CODE_POINTS = 40
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/export/OutputNameResolver.kt

package app.docscan.core.export

import java.text.Normalizer
import java.util.Locale

data class ExportOutputNames(
    val basename: String,
    val pdfName: String,
    val pageJpegNames: List<String>,
)

sealed interface OutputNameResolution {
    data class Resolved(val names: ExportOutputNames) : OutputNameResolution
    data class Invalid(val reason: String) : OutputNameResolution
    data class Collision(val conflictingNames: List<String>) : OutputNameResolution
}

/** Resolves UFS single/multi-page output names and chooses a free basename suffix without overwriting. */
object OutputNameResolver {
    /** Used by saved-PDF editing when only a PDF name is published. */
    fun resolveSinglePdfWithSuffix(
        requestedBasename: String,
        existingNames: Collection<String>,
    ): OutputNameResolution {
        val initial = resolve(requestedBasename, 1, emptyList())
        if (initial !is OutputNameResolution.Resolved) return initial
        val keys = existingNames.mapTo(HashSet()) { collisionKey(it) }
        for (suffix in 0..keys.size) {
            val basename = if (suffix == 0) initial.names.basename else "${initial.names.basename} ($suffix)"
            val candidate = namesFor(basename, 1)
            if (collisionKey(candidate.pdfName) !in keys) return OutputNameResolution.Resolved(candidate)
        }
        return OutputNameResolution.Collision(listOf("$requestedBasename.pdf"))
    }

    fun resolve(
        requestedBasename: String,
        pageCount: Int,
        existingNames: Collection<String>,
    ): OutputNameResolution {
        if (pageCount <= 0) return OutputNameResolution.Invalid("At least one frozen page is required")
        var basename = Normalizer.normalize(requestedBasename.trim(), Normalizer.Form.NFC)
        if (basename.endsWith(".pdf", ignoreCase = true)) {
            basename = basename.dropLast(4).trim()
        }
        if (basename.isBlank() || basename == "." || basename == "..") {
            return OutputNameResolution.Invalid("Enter a non-empty base filename")
        }
        if (basename.any {
                val category = Character.getType(it)
                it == '/' || it == '\\' || Character.isISOControl(it)
                    || category == Character.FORMAT.toInt()
                    || category == Character.LINE_SEPARATOR.toInt()
                    || category == Character.PARAGRAPH_SEPARATOR.toInt()
            }
        ) {
            return OutputNameResolution.Invalid("Base filename cannot contain path separators or control characters")
        }

        val existingKeys = existingNames.mapTo(HashSet()) { collisionKey(it) }
        var lastCollisions = emptyList<String>()
        // At most |existingKeys| suffix candidates can be blocked: each blocked set
        // consumes at least one distinct existing filename. The next candidate is free.
        for (suffix in 0..existingKeys.size) {
            val candidateBase = if (suffix == 0) basename else "$basename ($suffix)"
            val candidate = namesFor(candidateBase, pageCount)
            lastCollisions = (listOf(candidate.pdfName) + candidate.pageJpegNames)
                .filter { collisionKey(it) in existingKeys }
            if (lastCollisions.isEmpty()) return OutputNameResolution.Resolved(candidate)
        }
        return OutputNameResolution.Collision(lastCollisions)
    }

    private fun namesFor(basename: String, pageCount: Int): ExportOutputNames {
        val digits = maxOf(2, pageCount.toString().length)
        return ExportOutputNames(
            basename = basename,
            pdfName = "$basename.pdf",
            pageJpegNames = if (pageCount == 1) listOf("$basename.jpg") else {
                (1..pageCount).map { index ->
                    "$basename — ${index.toString().padStart(digits, '0')}.jpg"
                }
            },
        )
    }

    /** Shared by name planning and SAF pre-create/recovery checks. */
    fun collisionKey(name: String): String =
        Normalizer.normalize(name.trim().trimEnd('.'), Normalizer.Form.NFKC).lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/ocr/HocrParser.kt

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import app.docscan.core.store.Baseline
import org.jsoup.Jsoup
import org.jsoup.parser.Parser

private val BBOX = Regex("""bbox (-?\d+) (-?\d+) (-?\d+) (-?\d+)""")
private val WCONF = Regex("""x_wconf (\d+)""")
private val BASELINE = Regex("""baseline\s+(-?[\d.]+)\s+(-?[\d.]+)""")
private const val CONTAINER_SEL = ".ocr_carea, .ocr_header, .ocr_footer, .ocr_caption, .ocr_textfloat"

private fun org.jsoup.nodes.Element.box(w: Int, h: Int): Bx? {
    val g = BBOX.find(attr("title"))?.groupValues ?: return null
    return clampBox(g[1].toInt(), g[2].toInt(), g[3].toInt(), g[4].toInt(), w, h)
}

fun parseHocr(hocr: String, w: Int, h: Int): OcrLayout {
    if (hocr.isBlank()) return OcrLayout(maxOf(1, w), maxOf(1, h), emptyList())
    val doc = Jsoup.parse(hocr, "", Parser.xmlParser())
    val pageElem = doc.selectFirst(".ocr_page")
    val pageBbox = pageElem?.let { BBOX.find(it.attr("title"))?.groupValues }
    val pageW = if (w > 1) w else (pageBbox?.get(3)?.toIntOrNull() ?: maxOf(1, w))
    val pageH = if (h > 1) h else (pageBbox?.get(4)?.toIntOrNull() ?: maxOf(1, h))

    fun isContainer(element: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): Boolean =
        element.hasClass("ocr_carea") || element.hasClass("ocr_header") ||
            element.hasClass("ocr_footer") || element.hasClass("ocr_caption") ||
            element.hasClass("ocr_textfloat")

    fun nearestContainer(element: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): org.jsoup.nodes.Element? {
        var ancestor = element.parent()
        while (ancestor != null) {
            if (isContainer(ancestor)) return ancestor
            ancestor = ancestor.parent()
        }
        return null
    }

    fun nearestLine(element: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): org.jsoup.nodes.Element? {
        var ancestor = element.parent()
        while (ancestor != null) {
            if (ancestor.hasClass("ocr_line")) return ancestor
            ancestor = ancestor.parent()
        }
        return null
    }

    fun isNonText(element: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): Boolean {
        var ancestor: org.jsoup.nodes.Element? = element
        while (ancestor != null) {
            if (ancestor.hasClass("ocr_photo") || ancestor.hasClass("ocr_separator")) return true
            ancestor = ancestor.parent()
        }
        return false
    }

    fun parseLine(l: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): OcrLine? {
        val lb = l.box(pageW, pageH) ?: return null
        val lineContainer = if (isContainer(l)) l else nearestContainer(l)
        val words = l.select(".ocrx_word").filter { word ->
            !isNonText(word) && nearestContainer(word) === lineContainer &&
                nearestLine(word) == (if (l.hasClass("ocr_line")) l else null)
        }.mapNotNull { e ->
            val text = sanitizeOcrText(e.text())
            val wb = e.box(pageW, pageH)
            if (text.isEmpty() || wb == null) null
            else OcrWord(text, wb, WCONF.find(e.attr("title"))?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toFloatOrNull() ?: 0f)
        }
        val baseMatch = BASELINE.find(l.attr("title"))
        val baseline = if (baseMatch != null) {
            val slope = baseMatch.groupValues[1].toFloatOrNull() ?: 0f
            val intercept = baseMatch.groupValues[2].toFloatOrNull() ?: 0f
            Baseline(slope, intercept)
        } else null
        return if (words.isEmpty()) null else OcrLine(lb, words, baseline)
    }

    val containers = doc.select(CONTAINER_SEL)

    fun ownedBy(element: org.jsoup.nodes.Element, container: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): Boolean =
        nearestContainer(element) === container

    fun nearestParagraph(element: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): org.jsoup.nodes.Element? {
        var ancestor = element.parent()
        while (ancestor != null) {
            if (ancestor.hasClass("ocr_par")) return ancestor
            ancestor = ancestor.parent()
        }
        return null
    }

    fun lineElements(area: org.jsoup.nodes.Element): List<org.jsoup.nodes.Element> {
        val lines = area.select(".ocr_line")
            // Element.selectFirst includes the element itself when it matches.
            // Only discard a line when it contains a distinct nested line.
            .filter { line -> line.select(".ocr_line").none { it !== line } && !isNonText(line) }
            .toMutableList()

        // Some hOCR producers put words directly in semantic containers instead of
        // wrapping them in an .ocr_line. Treat those containers as one line only
        // when they have no actual line descendants.
        if (area.select(".ocr_line").none { it !== area } && area.children().any { it.hasClass("ocrx_word") }) {
            lines += area
        }
        return lines
    }

    data class LineEntry(
        val container: org.jsoup.nodes.Element,
        val paragraph: org.jsoup.nodes.Element?,
        val source: org.jsoup.nodes.Element,
        val line: OcrLine,
    )

    val domOrder = doc.select("*").withIndex().associate { (index, element) -> element to index }
    val lineEntries = containers.flatMap { area ->
        val paragraphs = area.select(".ocr_par").filter { paragraph -> ownedBy(paragraph, area) }
        val candidates = if (paragraphs.isNotEmpty()) {
            paragraphs.flatMap { paragraph ->
                lineElements(paragraph)
                    .filter { line -> ownedBy(line, area) && (line === paragraph || nearestParagraph(line) === paragraph) }
                    .mapNotNull { line -> parseLine(line)?.let { LineEntry(area, paragraph, line, it) } }
            }
        } else {
            lineElements(area)
                .filter { line -> line === area || ownedBy(line, area) }
                .mapNotNull { line -> parseLine(line)?.let { LineEntry(area, null, line, it) } }
        }
        candidates
    }.sortedBy { entry -> domOrder[entry.source] ?: Int.MAX_VALUE }

    val chunks = mutableListOf<MutableList<LineEntry>>()
    lineEntries.forEach { entry ->
        val current = chunks.lastOrNull()
        if (current == null || current.last().container !== entry.container) {
            chunks += mutableListOf(entry)
        } else {
            current += entry
        }
    }

    val blocks = chunks.mapNotNull { chunk ->
        val area = chunk.first().container
        val ab = area.box(pageW, pageH) ?: return@mapNotNull null
        val paraChunks = mutableListOf<MutableList<LineEntry>>()
        chunk.forEach { entry ->
            val current = paraChunks.lastOrNull()
            if (current == null || current.last().paragraph !== entry.paragraph) {
                paraChunks += mutableListOf(entry)
            } else {
                current += entry
            }
        }
        val paras = paraChunks.mapNotNull { paraChunk ->
            val paragraph = paraChunk.first().paragraph
            val pb = paragraph?.box(pageW, pageH) ?: ab
            OcrPara(pb, paraChunk.map { it.line })
        }
        val type = when {
            area.hasClass("ocr_header") -> "HEADER"
            area.hasClass("ocr_footer") -> "FOOTER"
            area.hasClass("ocr_caption") -> "CAPTION"
            area.hasClass("ocr_title") -> "TITLE"
            area.selectFirst("h1, h2, h3, .ocr_title") != null -> "TITLE"
            area.hasClass("ocr_carea") && area.selectFirst(".ocr_par") != null -> "PARAGRAPH"
            else -> "TEXT"
        }
        val id = area.id().ifBlank { null }
        OcrBlock(ab, paras, type, id)
    }
    return OcrLayout(pageW, pageH, blocks)
}

object HocrParser {
    fun parse(
        hocr: String,
        fallbackWidthPx: Int = 0,
        fallbackHeightPx: Int = 0,
        languageHints: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    ): app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout {
        return parseHocr(hocr, fallbackWidthPx, fallbackHeightPx).toRecognitionLayout()
    }

    fun parse(
        hocr: String,
        fallbackWidthPx: Long,
        fallbackHeightPx: Long,
    ): app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout {
        return parse(hocr, fallbackWidthPx.toInt(), fallbackHeightPx.toInt())
    }
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/ocr/LangDetect.kt

package app.docscan.core.ocr

object LangDetect {
    private const val MIN_LETTERS = 40          // подобрать по тестам
    private const val MIN_ES_HITS = 5.0         // подобрать по тестам
    private const val ES_OVER_EN = 1.5          // подобрать по тестам
    private const val CYR_SHARE_MIXED = 0.25    // подобрать по тестам
    private const val DIACRITICS = "ñáéíóúü¿¡"

    private val ES = setOf(
        "el", "la", "los", "las", "de", "del", "que", "y", "en", "un", "una",
        "por", "para", "con", "es", "se", "su", "sus", "al", "lo", "como", "más", "pero", "ya", "este",
        "esta", "entre", "cuando", "muy", "sin", "sobre", "también", "hasta", "hay", "donde", "desde",
        "todo", "nos", "durante", "sí", "porque", "son", "fue", "ser"
    )
    private val EN = setOf(
        "the", "and", "of", "to", "in", "is", "that", "for", "it", "with", "as",
        "was", "on", "are", "be", "by", "this", "at", "from", "or", "an", "have", "not", "but", "which",
        "you", "all", "we", "will", "can", "has", "their", "been"
    )
    // Typical Spanish document words remain useful when a RU/EN first pass loses accents.
    // Two distinct cues are required; a name or a borrowed word alone is not enough.
    private val ES_DOCUMENT = setOf(
        "factura", "importe", "cantidad", "fecha", "numero", "documento", "direccion",
        "pagina", "recibo", "telefono", "accion", "solicitud", "apellido", "apellidos",
        "domicilio", "nacimiento",
    )
    private val WORD = Regex("\\p{L}+")

    fun decide(text: String): OcrLangProfile? {
        val lower = text.lowercase()
        var letters = 0
        var cyr = 0
        var dia = 0
        for (ch in lower) {
            if (ch.isLetter()) {
                letters++
                if (ch in '\u0400'..'\u04FF') cyr++
            }
            if (ch in DIACRITICS) dia++
        }
        val words = WORD.findAll(lower).map { it.value }.toList()
        val enHits = words.count { it in EN }
        val documentCues = words.map { word ->
            java.text.Normalizer.normalize(word, java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFD)
                .filter { Character.getType(it) != Character.NON_SPACING_MARK.toInt() }
        }.filter { it in ES_DOCUMENT }.toSet()
        if (letters >= 8 && documentCues.size >= 2 && enHits < 2) {
            return if (cyr.toDouble() / letters >= CYR_SHARE_MIXED)
                OcrLangProfile.RU_ES_EN else OcrLangProfile.ES_EN
        }
        if (letters < MIN_LETTERS) {
            // Short receipts/titles do not provide enough stop words. ñ and inverted
            // punctuation are stronger evidence among the supported RU/EN/ES languages.
            if (letters < 3 || lower.none { it == 'ñ' || it == '¿' || it == '¡' }) return null
            return if (cyr.toDouble() / letters >= CYR_SHARE_MIXED)
                OcrLangProfile.RU_ES_EN else OcrLangProfile.ES_EN
        }
        var es = 0.5 * dia
        var en = 0.0
        for (m in WORD.findAll(lower)) {
            if (m.value in ES) es += 1.0
            if (m.value in EN) en += 1.0
        }
        // Titles and receipts can be long yet contain no grammatical stop words.
        // Require repeated distinctive evidence; one "señor" in English is insufficient.
        val distinctive = lower.count { it == 'ñ' || it == '¿' || it == '¡' }
        val strongSpanish = distinctive >= 2 && dia >= 3 && en < 2.0
        if (!strongSpanish && (es < MIN_ES_HITS || es < ES_OVER_EN * (en + 1))) return null   // не испанский
        return if (cyr.toDouble() / letters >= CYR_SHARE_MIXED) {
            OcrLangProfile.RU_ES_EN
        } else {
            OcrLangProfile.ES_EN
        }
    }
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/ocr/LayoutExtractor.kt
