package app.docscan.core.ocr

import app.docscan.core.store.Baseline
import app.docscan.core.store.BlockType
import app.docscan.core.store.LayoutQuality
import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import app.docscan.core.store.normalizeBox
import app.docscan.core.store.sanitizeOcrText
import org.jsoup.Jsoup
import org.jsoup.nodes.Element

interface LayoutExtractor {
    fun extract(
        hocr: String,
        fallbackWidthPx: Int = 0,
        fallbackHeightPx: Int = 0,
        languageHints: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    ): RecognitionLayout
}

class HocrLayoutExtractor : LayoutExtractor {
    override fun extract(
        hocr: String,
        fallbackWidthPx: Int,
        fallbackHeightPx: Int,
        languageHints: Set<String>,
    ): RecognitionLayout {
        if (hocr.isBlank()) {
            return RecognitionLayout(
                sourceWidthPx = maxOf(0, fallbackWidthPx),
                sourceHeightPx = maxOf(0, fallbackHeightPx),
                blocks = emptyList(),
                languageHints = languageHints,
                quality = LayoutQuality(
                    meanConfidence = 0f,
                    lowConfidenceWordCount = 0,
                    structureAvailable = false,
                    language = languageHints.firstOrNull(),
                ),
            )
        }

        val doc = Jsoup.parse(hocr)
        val pageElem = doc.selectFirst(".ocr_page")

        var pageWidth = fallbackWidthPx
        var pageHeight = fallbackHeightPx
        if (pageElem != null) {
            val pageBbox = parsePixelBbox(pageElem.attr("title"))
            if (pageBbox != null && pageBbox.right > pageBbox.left && pageBbox.bottom > pageBbox.top) {
                pageWidth = pageBbox.right.toInt()
                pageHeight = pageBbox.bottom.toInt()
            }
        }
        pageWidth = maxOf(1, pageWidth)
        pageHeight = maxOf(1, pageHeight)

        val root = pageElem ?: doc.body()
        val containers = root.select(".ocr_carea, .ocr_header, .ocr_footer, .ocr_caption")

        val blocks = mutableListOf<OcrBlock>()
        var readingOrder = 0

        if (containers.isNotEmpty()) {
            containers.forEachIndexed { cIndex, container ->
                val pars = container.select(".ocr_par")
                val paragraphs = mutableListOf<OcrParagraph>()
                if (pars.isNotEmpty()) {
                    pars.forEach { par ->
                        val lines = parseLines(par, pageWidth, pageHeight)
                        if (lines.isNotEmpty()) {
                            val parBox = resolveNormalizedBox(
                                parsePixelBbox(par.attr("title")),
                                lines.map { it.box },
                                pageWidth,
                                pageHeight,
                            )
                            if (parBox != null) {
                                paragraphs += OcrParagraph(parBox, lines)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    val lines = parseLines(container, pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    if (lines.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val parBox = resolveNormalizedBox(
                            parsePixelBbox(container.attr("title")),
                            lines.map { it.box },
                            pageWidth,
                            pageHeight,
                        )
                        if (parBox != null) {
                            paragraphs += OcrParagraph(parBox, lines)
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (paragraphs.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val blockBox = resolveNormalizedBox(
                        parsePixelBbox(container.attr("title")),
                        paragraphs.map { it.box },
                        pageWidth,
                        pageHeight,
                    )
                    if (blockBox != null) {
                        val blockId = container.id().ifBlank { "block_${cIndex + 1}" }
                        val type = determineBlockType(container, null)
                        blocks += OcrBlock(
                            id = blockId,
                            type = type,
                            box = blockBox,
                            readingOrder = readingOrder++,
                            paragraphs = paragraphs,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            val pars = root.select(".ocr_par")
            if (pars.isNotEmpty()) {
                val paragraphs = mutableListOf<OcrParagraph>()
                pars.forEach { par ->
                    val lines = parseLines(par, pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    if (lines.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val parBox = resolveNormalizedBox(
                            parsePixelBbox(par.attr("title")),
                            lines.map { it.box },
                            pageWidth,
                            pageHeight,
                        )
                        if (parBox != null) {
                            paragraphs += OcrParagraph(parBox, lines)
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (paragraphs.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val blockBox = resolveNormalizedBox(null, paragraphs.map { it.box }, pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    if (blockBox != null) {
                        blocks += OcrBlock(
                            id = "block_1",
                            type = BlockType.TEXT,
                            box = blockBox,
                            readingOrder = readingOrder++,
                            paragraphs = paragraphs,
                        )
                    }
                }
            } else {
                val lines = parseLines(root, pageWidth, pageHeight)
                if (lines.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val box = resolveNormalizedBox(null, lines.map { it.box }, pageWidth, pageHeight)
                    if (box != null) {
                        val paragraph = OcrParagraph(box, lines)
                        blocks += OcrBlock(
                            id = "block_1",
                            type = BlockType.TEXT,
                            box = box,
                            readingOrder = readingOrder++,
                            paragraphs = listOf(paragraph),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        val allWords = blocks.flatMap { it.paragraphs.flatMap { it.lines.flatMap { it.words } } }
        val meanConf = if (allWords.isEmpty()) 0f else (allWords.map { it.confidence.toDouble() }.average()).toFloat()
        val lowConfCount = allWords.count { it.confidence < 60f }
        val quality = LayoutQuality(
            meanConfidence = meanConf,
            lowConfidenceWordCount = lowConfCount,
            structureAvailable = allWords.isNotEmpty(),
            language = languageHints.firstOrNull(),
        )

        return RecognitionLayout(
            sourceWidthPx = pageWidth,
            sourceHeightPx = pageHeight,
            blocks = blocks,
            languageHints = languageHints,
            quality = quality,
            formatVersion = 2,
        )
    }

    private fun parseLines(container: Element, pageWidth: Int, pageHeight: Int): List<OcrLine> {
        val lineElems = container.select(".ocr_line")
        if (lineElems.isEmpty()) {
            val words = parseWords(container, pageWidth, pageHeight)
            if (words.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
            val box = resolveNormalizedBox(null, words.map { it.box }, pageWidth, pageHeight) ?: return emptyList()
            return listOf(OcrLine(box, null, null, words))
        }

        val result = mutableListOf<OcrLine>()
        lineElems.forEach { lineElem ->
            val words = parseWords(lineElem, pageWidth, pageHeight)
            if (words.isNotEmpty()) {
                val rawTitle = lineElem.attr("title")
                val box = resolveNormalizedBox(parsePixelBbox(rawTitle), words.map { it.box }, pageWidth, pageHeight)
                if (box != null) {
                    val baseline = parseBaseline(rawTitle)
                    val xHeight = parseXHeight(rawTitle)
                    result += OcrLine(box, baseline, xHeight, words)
                }
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun parseWords(container: Element, pageWidth: Int, pageHeight: Int): List<OcrWord> {
        val wordElems = container.select(".ocrx_word, .ocr_word")
        val result = mutableListOf<OcrWord>()
        wordElems.forEach { wordElem ->
            val sanitized = sanitizeOcrText(wordElem.text())
            if (sanitized.isEmpty()) return@forEach
            val title = wordElem.attr("title")
            val rawBbox = parsePixelBbox(title) ?: return@forEach
            val normalizedBox = normalizeBox(
                leftPx = rawBbox.left,
                topPx = rawBbox.top,
                rightPx = rawBbox.right,
                bottomPx = rawBbox.bottom,
                widthPx = pageWidth,
                heightPx = pageHeight,
            ) ?: return@forEach

            val confidence = CONFIDENCE_REGEX.find(title)?.groupValues?.get(1)
                ?.toFloatOrNull()?.coerceIn(0f, 100f) ?: 0f

            result += OcrWord(sanitized, normalizedBox, confidence)
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun parsePixelBbox(title: String): PixelBbox? {
        val match = BBOX_REGEX.find(title) ?: return null
        val values = match.groupValues.drop(1).mapNotNull(String::toLongOrNull)
        if (values.size != 4) return null
        val left = values[0]
        val top = values[1]
        val right = values[2]
        val bottom = values[3]
        if (left < 0L || top < 0L || right <= left || bottom <= top) return null
        return PixelBbox(left, top, right, bottom)
    }

    private fun parseBaseline(title: String): Baseline? {
        val match = BASELINE_REGEX.find(title) ?: return null
        val slope = match.groupValues[1].toFloatOrNull() ?: return null
        val intercept = match.groupValues[2].toFloatOrNull() ?: return null
        return Baseline(slope, intercept)
    }

    private fun parseXHeight(title: String): Float? {
        val match = X_SIZE_REGEX.find(title) ?: return null
        return match.groupValues[1].toFloatOrNull()
    }

    private fun resolveNormalizedBox(
        declared: PixelBbox?,
        childrenBoxes: List<NormalizedBox>,
        pageWidth: Int,
        pageHeight: Int,
    ): NormalizedBox? {
        if (declared != null) {
            val normalized = normalizeBox(declared.left, declared.top, declared.right, declared.bottom, pageWidth, pageHeight)
            if (normalized != null) return normalized
        }
        if (childrenBoxes.isEmpty()) return null
        val minLeft = childrenBoxes.minOf { it.left }.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val minTop = childrenBoxes.minOf { it.top }.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val maxRight = childrenBoxes.maxOf { it.right }.coerceIn(minLeft + 0.0001f, 1f)
        val maxBottom = childrenBoxes.maxOf { it.bottom }.coerceIn(minTop + 0.0001f, 1f)
        return NormalizedBox(minLeft, minTop, maxRight, maxBottom)
    }

    private fun determineBlockType(element: Element, parent: Element?): BlockType {
        val combined = (element.className() + " " + element.id() + " " + (parent?.className().orEmpty()) + " " + (parent?.id().orEmpty())).lowercase()
        return when {
            combined.contains("header") -> BlockType.HEADER
            combined.contains("footer") -> BlockType.FOOTER
            combined.contains("caption") -> BlockType.CAPTION
            combined.contains("title") || combined.contains("heading") -> BlockType.TITLE
            combined.contains("table") -> BlockType.TABLE
            combined.contains("list") -> BlockType.LIST
            combined.contains("figure") -> BlockType.FIGURE
            combined.contains("par") || combined.contains("carea") -> BlockType.PARAGRAPH
            else -> BlockType.TEXT
        }
    }

    private data class PixelBbox(val left: Long, val top: Long, val right: Long, val bottom: Long)

    private companion object {
        val BBOX_REGEX = Regex("""\bbbox\s+(-?\d+)\s+(-?\d+)\s+(-?\d+)\s+(-?\d+)""")
        val BASELINE_REGEX = Regex("""\bbaseline\s+([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)""")
        val X_SIZE_REGEX = Regex("""\bx_size\s+([-\d.]+)""")
        val CONFIDENCE_REGEX = Regex("""\bx_wconf\s+([-\d.]+)""")
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import app.docscan.core.store.Baseline
import app.docscan.core.store.LayoutQuality

data class OcrWord(val text: String, val box: Bx, val conf: Float)
data class OcrLine(val box: Bx, val words: List<OcrWord>, val baseline: Baseline? = null)
data class OcrPara(val box: Bx, val lines: List<OcrLine>)
data class OcrBlock(
    val box: Bx,
    val paras: List<OcrPara>,
    val type: String? = null,
    val id: String? = null,
)
data class OcrLayout(
    val sourceW: Int,
    val sourceH: Int,
    val blocks: List<OcrBlock>,
    val lang: String? = null,
    val plainText: String? = null,
    val quality: LayoutQuality? = null,
    val languageHints: Set<String> = emptySet(),
) {
    val words: List<OcrWord>
        get() = blocks.flatMap { b -> b.paras.flatMap { p -> p.lines.flatMap { it.words } } }
}

fun OcrLayout.toPlainText(): String {
    if (!plainText.isNullOrBlank()) return plainText
    if (words.isEmpty()) return plainText.orEmpty()
    return blocks.joinToString("\n\n") { b ->
        b.paras.joinToString("\n\n") { p ->
            p.lines.joinToString("\n") { l -> l.words.joinToString(" ") { it.text } }
        }
    }
}

fun OcrLayout.toRecognitionLayout(): app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout {
    val w = maxOf(1, sourceW)
    val h = maxOf(1, sourceH)
    val recBlocks = blocks.mapIndexed { bIdx, b ->
        val bLeft = (b.box.l.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val bTop = (b.box.t.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val bRight = (b.box.r.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(bLeft, 1f)
        val bBottom = (b.box.b.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(bTop, 1f)
        val blockType = when (b.type) {
            "HEADER" -> app.docscan.core.store.BlockType.HEADER
            "FOOTER" -> app.docscan.core.store.BlockType.FOOTER
            "CAPTION" -> app.docscan.core.store.BlockType.CAPTION
            "TITLE" -> app.docscan.core.store.BlockType.TITLE
            "PARAGRAPH" -> app.docscan.core.store.BlockType.PARAGRAPH
            else -> app.docscan.core.store.BlockType.TEXT
        }
        val paras = b.paras.map { p ->
            val pLeft = (p.box.l.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            val pTop = (p.box.t.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            val pRight = (p.box.r.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(pLeft, 1f)
            val pBottom = (p.box.b.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(pTop, 1f)
            val lines = p.lines.map { l ->
                val lLeft = (l.box.l.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                val lTop = (l.box.t.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                val lRight = (l.box.r.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(lLeft, 1f)
                val lBottom = (l.box.b.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(lTop, 1f)
                val words = l.words.map { word ->
                    val wLeft = (word.box.l.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    val wTop = (word.box.t.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    val wRight = (word.box.r.toFloat() / w).coerceIn(wLeft, 1f)
                    val wBottom = (word.box.b.toFloat() / h).coerceIn(wTop, 1f)
                    app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord(
                        text = word.text,
                        box = app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox(wLeft, wTop, wRight, wBottom),
                        confidence = word.conf,
                    )
                }
                app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine(
                    box = app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox(lLeft, lTop, lRight, lBottom),
                    baseline = l.baseline,
                    xHeight = null,
                    words = words,
                )
            }
            app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph(
                box = app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox(pLeft, pTop, pRight, pBottom),
                lines = lines,
            )
        }
        app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock(
            id = b.id ?: "block_${bIdx + 1}",
            type = blockType,
            box = app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox(bLeft, bTop, bRight, bBottom),
            readingOrder = bIdx,
            paragraphs = paras,
        )
    }
    val allWords = words
    val computedQuality = LayoutQuality(
        meanConfidence = if (allWords.isEmpty()) 0f else allWords.map { it.conf }.average().toFloat(),
        lowConfidenceWordCount = allWords.count { it.conf < 60f },
        structureAvailable = allWords.isNotEmpty(),
        language = lang,
    )
    return app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout(
        sourceWidthPx = w,
        sourceHeightPx = h,
        blocks = recBlocks,
        languageHints = languageHints,
        quality = quality ?: computedQuality,
        formatVersion = 2,
        plainText = plainText,
    )
}

fun app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout.toOcrLayout(): OcrLayout {
    val w = sourceWidthPx
    val h = sourceHeightPx
    fun nb(box: app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox): Bx {
        val l = (box.left * w).toInt().coerceIn(0, maxOf(0, w - 1))
        val t = (box.top * h).toInt().coerceIn(0, maxOf(0, h - 1))
        val r = kotlin.math.ceil(box.right * w).toInt().coerceIn(l + 1, maxOf(l + 1, w))
        val b = kotlin.math.ceil(box.bottom * h).toInt().coerceIn(t + 1, maxOf(t + 1, h))
        return Bx(l, t, r, b)
    }
    val ocrBlocks = blocks.sortedBy { it.readingOrder }.map { b ->
        val paras = b.paragraphs.map { p ->
            val lines = p.lines.map { l ->
                val words = l.words.map { w ->
                    OcrWord(w.text, nb(w.box), w.confidence)
                }
                OcrLine(nb(l.box), words, l.baseline)
            }
            OcrPara(nb(p.box), lines)
        }
        OcrBlock(nb(b.box), paras, b.type.name, b.id)
    }
    return OcrLayout(
        sourceW = w,
        sourceH = h,
        blocks = ocrBlocks,
        lang = quality?.language ?: languageHints.firstOrNull(),
        plainText = plainText,
        quality = quality,
        languageHints = languageHints,
    )
}

fun OcrLayout.scaledTo(w: Int, h: Int): OcrLayout? {
    if (sourceW <= 0 || sourceH <= 0 || w <= 0 || h <= 0) return null
    val diff = kotlin.math.abs((sourceW.toDouble() / sourceH) / (w.toDouble() / h) - 1.0)
    if (diff > 0.01) return null              // другое изображение
    val fx = w.toDouble() / sourceW; val fy = h.toDouble() / sourceH
    fun s(b: Bx) = clampBox((b.l * fx).toInt(), (b.t * fy).toInt(), (b.r * fx).toInt(), (b.b * fy).toInt(), w, h)
        ?: Bx(0, 0, maxOf(1, w), maxOf(1, h))
    return OcrLayout(
        sourceW = w,
        sourceH = h,
        blocks = blocks.map { bl ->
            OcrBlock(
                box = s(bl.box),
                paras = bl.paras.map { p ->
                    OcrPara(
                        box = s(p.box),
                        lines = p.lines.map { l ->
                            OcrLine(
                                box = s(l.box),
                                words = l.words.map { it.copy(box = s(it.box)) },
                                baseline = l.baseline?.let { baseline ->
                                    Baseline(
                                        slope = (baseline.slope * fy / fx).toFloat(),
                                        intercept = (baseline.intercept * fy).toFloat(),
                                    )
                                },
                            )
                        },
                    )
                },
                type = bl.type,
                id = bl.id,
            )
        },
        lang = lang,
        plainText = plainText,
        quality = quality,
        languageHints = languageHints,
    )
}

package app.docscan.core.ocr

/** Chooses the OCR pass with the best character coverage while guarding text already recognized. */
object OcrQualitySelector {
    fun choose(first: OcrLayout, second: OcrLayout): OcrLayout {
        val firstText = first.toPlainText()
        val secondText = second.toPlainText()
        val firstChars = firstText.count(Char::isLetterOrDigit)
        val secondChars = secondText.count(Char::isLetterOrDigit)
        if (firstChars == 0 && secondChars == 0) return first
        if (firstChars > 0 && confidence(second) + 0.10f < confidence(first)) return first
        // Keep already credible identifiers/amounts unless the replacement also contains them.
        // Low-confidence numbers may be corrected, so this is not a blanket digit lock.
        val credibleNumbers = first.words.filter { it.conf >= 70f }
            .flatMap { NUMBER.findAll(it.text).map { match -> match.value }.toList() }
        val secondNumbers = NUMBER.findAll(secondText).map { it.value }.toList()
        if (credibleNumbers.any { number -> secondNumbers.none { it.contains(number) } }) return first

        val maxChars = maxOf(firstChars, secondChars).coerceAtLeast(1)
        fun contentScore(text: String, count: Int): Float {
            val coverage = count.toFloat() / maxChars
            val retained = if (firstChars == 0) 1f else characterOverlap(firstText, text).toFloat() / firstChars
            return 0.65f * coverage + 0.35f * retained.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        }

        val firstContent = contentScore(firstText, firstChars)
        val secondContent = contentScore(secondText, secondChars)
        if (secondContent > firstContent + CONTENT_TIE_EPSILON) return second
        if (firstContent > secondContent + CONTENT_TIE_EPSILON) return first

        val firstSecondary = 0.8f * confidence(first) + 0.2f * languageAgreement(first, second)
        val secondSecondary = 0.8f * confidence(second) + 0.2f * languageAgreement(second, first)
        return if (secondSecondary > firstSecondary + SCORE_TIE_EPSILON) second else first
    }

    private fun characterOverlap(first: String, second: String): Int {
        val firstCounts = characterCounts(first)
        val secondCounts = characterCounts(second)
        return firstCounts.entries.sumOf { (character, count) -> minOf(count, secondCounts[character] ?: 0) }
    }

    private fun characterCounts(text: String): Map<Char, Int> = buildMap {
        // Diacritic corrections must not look like dropped content (nina -> niña).
        java.text.Normalizer.normalize(text, java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFD).forEach { character ->
            if (character.isLetterOrDigit()) {
                val normalized = character.lowercaseChar()
                put(normalized, (get(normalized) ?: 0) + 1)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun confidence(layout: OcrLayout): Float {
        val confidences = layout.words.map { it.conf }.filter { it.isFinite() }
        val value = if (confidences.isNotEmpty()) confidences.average().toFloat()
        else layout.quality?.meanConfidence ?: 0f
        return value.coerceIn(0f, 100f) / 100f
    }

    private fun languageAgreement(candidate: OcrLayout, other: OcrLayout): Float {
        val supported = languageTags(candidate.lang, candidate.quality?.language)
        val expected = LangDetect.decide(other.toPlainText())?.tess?.let { languageTags(it) }
        if (!expected.isNullOrEmpty()) return if (supported.containsAll(expected)) 1f else 0f
        val hints = (candidate.languageHints + other.languageHints).flatMap { languageTags(it) }.toSet()
        if (supported.isEmpty() || hints.isEmpty()) return 0.5f
        return if (supported.any { it in hints }) 1f else 0f
    }

    private fun languageTags(vararg values: String?): Set<String> = values
        .filterNotNull()
        .flatMap { it.split('+', ',', ';') }
        .map { it.trim().lowercase().substringBefore('-') }
        .filter(String::isNotBlank)
        .toSet()

    private val NUMBER = Regex("\\d+(?:[.,:/-]\\d+)*")
    private const val CONTENT_TIE_EPSILON = 0.015f
    private const val SCORE_TIE_EPSILON = 0.01f
}

package app.docscan.core.ocr

private val INVISIBLE = Regex("[\\u200B-\\u200D\\u2060\\uFEFF\\u00AD\\p{Cntrl}]")
fun sanitizeOcrText(s: String): String = s.replace(INVISIBLE, "").trim()

data class Bx(val l: Int, val t: Int, val r: Int, val b: Int)

fun clampBox(l: Int, t: Int, r: Int, b: Int, w: Int, h: Int): Bx? {
    if (w <= 1 || h <= 1) return null
    val cl = l.coerceIn(0, w - 1)
    val ct = t.coerceIn(0, h - 1)
    val cr = r.coerceIn(cl + 1, w)
    val cb = b.coerceIn(ct + 1, h)
    return Bx(cl, ct, cr, cb)
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/ocr/OcrTaskQueue.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService
import java.util.concurrent.Future
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

/** Keeps at most one current OCR request per key and lets a newer request replace it. */
class OcrTaskQueue<K : Any>(
    private val executor: ExecutorService,
    private val stopActiveTask: (K) -> Unit,
    private val nanoTime: () -> Long = System::nanoTime,
) {
    private class Job(val requestKey: String?) {
        val cancelled = AtomicBoolean(false)
        @Volatile var future: Future<*>? = null
    }

    private val jobs = ConcurrentHashMap<K, Job>()
    private val active = AtomicReference<Pair<K, Job>?>(null)
    private val lock = Any()

    /**
     * Returns true when a task was submitted. An equal non-null request key is deduplicated while
     * its request is pending or running, unless [replaceExisting] is true.
     */
    fun enqueue(
        key: K,
        replaceExisting: Boolean = false,
        requestKey: String? = null,
        task: (isCancelled: () -> Boolean) -> Unit,
    ): Boolean = synchronized(lock) {
        val existing = jobs[key]
        if (existing != null && !replaceExisting && !existing.cancelled.get()) {
            if (requestKey != null && existing.requestKey == requestKey && existing.future?.isDone != true) return@synchronized false
            if (requestKey == null && existing.future?.isDone != true) return@synchronized false
        }

        // Stop/cancel the old request before submitting its replacement. With the single-thread
        // executor this ensures the native stop hook cannot catch the replacement's recognition.
        if (existing != null) cancelLocked(key, existing)
        val job = Job(requestKey)
        jobs[key] = job
        try {
            job.future = executor.submit {
                val activeEntry = key to job
                val started = synchronized(lock) {
                    if (job.cancelled.get()) false else {
                        active.set(activeEntry)
                        true
                    }
                }
                try {
                    if (started && !job.cancelled.get()) task { job.cancelled.get() }
                } finally {
                    // Serialize active-job retirement with cancelLocked so stopActiveTask cannot
                    // observe one job and accidentally stop the next recognition.
                    synchronized(lock) { active.compareAndSet(activeEntry, null) }
                }
            }
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            jobs.remove(key, job)
            throw failure
        }
        true
    }

    fun cancel(keys: Collection<K>) {
        keys.forEach { key ->
            synchronized(lock) { jobs[key]?.let { cancelLocked(key, it) } }
        }
    }

    fun await(keys: Collection<K>, timeoutMs: Long = 60_000L) {
        require(timeoutMs >= 0) { "timeoutMs must be non-negative" }
        val timeoutNanos = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeoutMs)
        val startedAt = nanoTime()

        for (key in keys) {
            while (true) {
                val job = synchronized(lock) { jobs[key] } ?: break
                val future = job.future ?: continue
                try {
                    val elapsed = nanoTime() - startedAt
                    val remaining = if (elapsed < 0L || timeoutNanos < elapsed) 0L else timeoutNanos - elapsed
                    if (remaining <= 0L && !future.isDone) throw TimeoutException("Timed out waiting for OCR page $key")
                    future.get(maxOf(0L, remaining), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)
                } catch (error: ExecutionException) {
                    if (isCurrent(key, job)) throw (error.cause ?: error)
                } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                    if (isCurrent(key, job)) throw error
                } catch (error: TimeoutException) {
                    if (isCurrent(key, job)) throw error
                }

                if (isCurrent(key, job)) {
                    if (job.cancelled.get()) throw CancellationException("OCR page $key was cancelled")
                    break
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isCurrent(key: K, job: Job): Boolean = synchronized(lock) { jobs[key] === job }

    private fun cancelLocked(key: K, job: Job) {
        job.cancelled.set(true)
        val activeEntry = active.get()
        if (activeEntry?.first == key && activeEntry.second === job) {
            stopActiveTask(key)
        } else {
            job.future?.cancel(false)
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.recent

/** Volatile page-order draft for editing a saved PDF without changing its source. */
class SavedPdfEditSession(pageCount: Int) {
    init {
        require(pageCount > 0) { "A saved PDF edit session requires at least one page" }
    }

    private val originalOrder = (0 until pageCount).toList()
    private val mutableOrder = originalOrder.toMutableList()
    private val undoStack = ArrayDeque<Change>()

    val pageCount: Int get() = mutableOrder.size
    val canSave: Boolean get() = mutableOrder.isNotEmpty()
    val canUndo: Boolean get() = undoStack.isNotEmpty()
    val isDirty: Boolean get() = mutableOrder != originalOrder
    val pageOrder: List<Int> get() = mutableOrder.toList()

    /** Removes the page at [position] and returns the new selected position, or -1 if empty. */
    fun removeAt(position: Int): Int {
        require(position in mutableOrder.indices)
        val removedPage = mutableOrder.removeAt(position)
        undoStack.addLast(Change.Removed(removedPage, position))
        return if (mutableOrder.isEmpty()) -1 else minOf(position, mutableOrder.lastIndex)
    }

    /** Moves a page by current list positions; no-op moves do not create undo entries. */
    fun move(fromPosition: Int, toPosition: Int) {
        require(fromPosition in mutableOrder.indices)
        require(toPosition in mutableOrder.indices)
        if (fromPosition == toPosition) return
        val page = mutableOrder.removeAt(fromPosition)
        mutableOrder.add(toPosition, page)
        undoStack.addLast(Change.Moved(fromPosition, toPosition))
    }

    fun undo(): Boolean {
        val change = undoStack.removeLastOrNull() ?: return false
        when (change) {
            is Change.Removed -> mutableOrder.add(change.position, change.page)
            is Change.Moved -> {
                val page = mutableOrder.removeAt(change.toPosition)
                mutableOrder.add(change.fromPosition, page)
            }
        }
        return true
    }

    private sealed interface Change {
        data class Removed(val page: Int, val position: Int) : Change
        data class Moved(val fromPosition: Int, val toPosition: Int) : Change
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.schedule

/** Runtime admission for non-interactive image work. Capture must not use this gate. */
class HeavyWorkScheduler(
    private val maxConcurrentJobs: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS,
    val decodedByteBudget: Long = DEFAULT_DECODED_BYTE_BUDGET,
) {
    private val lock = Any()
    private var runningJobs = 0
    private var reservedBytes = 0L

    init {
        require(maxConcurrentJobs > 0)
        require(decodedByteBudget > 0L)
    }

    fun <T> withAdmission(decodedBytes: Long, work: () -> T): T {
        require(decodedBytes in 1..decodedByteBudget) {
            "Heavy job estimate $decodedBytes exceeds the decoded-image budget $decodedByteBudget"
        }
        synchronized(lock) {
            while (runningJobs >= maxConcurrentJobs || reservedBytes > decodedByteBudget - decodedBytes) {
                @Suppress("PLATFORM_CLASS_MAPPED_TO_KOTLIN")
                (lock as java.lang.Object).wait()
            }
            runningJobs += 1
            reservedBytes += decodedBytes
        }
        try {
            return work()
        } finally {
            synchronized(lock) {
                runningJobs -= 1
                reservedBytes -= decodedBytes
                @Suppress("PLATFORM_CLASS_MAPPED_TO_KOTLIN")
                (lock as java.lang.Object).notifyAll()
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS = 1
        const val DEFAULT_DECODED_BYTE_BUDGET = 96L * 1024L * 1024L
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import kotlin.math.abs

/** Year inference by docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.4. */
class AnchorYearResolver : YearResolver {

    override fun resolve(value: DateValue, documentDate: LocalDate?, scanDate: LocalDate): YearResolution {
        value.year?.let { year ->
            val date = build(year, value) ?: return YearResolution.Invalid
            return YearResolution.Resolved(date, inferred = false)
        }
        val anchor = documentDate ?: scanDate
        // 29 February in a non-leap anchor year: the neighbouring years are tried by the same rules.
        val baseYears = if (build(anchor.year, value) != null) listOf(anchor.year)
        else listOf(anchor.year - 1, anchor.year + 1)
        val shifted = baseYears.mapNotNull { shiftTowardAnchor(value, it, anchor) }
        val date = shifted.minByOrNull { abs(ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(anchor, it)) } ?: return YearResolution.Invalid
        if (!date.isBefore(anchor)) return YearResolution.Resolved(date, inferred = true)
        val options = listOfNotNull(date, build(date.year + 1, value))
        return if (options.isEmpty()) YearResolution.Invalid else YearResolution.Choice(options)
    }

    private fun shiftTowardAnchor(value: DateValue, year: Int, anchor: LocalDate): LocalDate? {
        val date = build(year, value) ?: return null
        val distance = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(anchor, date)
        if (abs(distance) <= SHIFT_THRESHOLD_DAYS) return date
        return build(if (distance > 0) year - 1 else year + 1, value)
    }

    private fun build(year: Int, value: DateValue): LocalDate? {
        if (year !in MIN_YEAR..MAX_YEAR) return null
        return try { LocalDate.of(year, value.month, value.day) } catch (_: java.time.DateTimeException) { null }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val SHIFT_THRESHOLD_DAYS = 183L
        const val MIN_YEAR = 1900
        const val MAX_YEAR = 2100
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/KeywordPageEventRules.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import java.text.Normalizer

/**
 * Keyword rules of docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.5 and §4.6: candidate roles, event status and
 * assembly of events on one page. The rules never pick a candidate "by default": no keyword or two equally
 * close keywords of different roles give [CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER]; unclear dates become options.
 */
class KeywordPageEventRules : PageEventRules {

    override fun analyze(page: CanonicalPage, candidates: List<Candidate>): PageAnalysis {
        val language = page.language ?: return PageAnalysis(page, candidates, emptyMap(), emptyList())
        return Run(page, candidates, lexicon(language)).analyze()
    }

    private enum class MarkerGroup { CANCEL, TENTATIVE, RESCHEDULE }

    private class RoleHit(val role: CandidateRole, val range: TextRange)
    private class MarkerHit(val group: MarkerGroup, val range: TextRange)

    private class Lexicon(
        val roleKeywords: Map<CandidateRole, List<Regex>>,
        /** Birth markers printed after the date ("г. р."). */
        val birthSuffix: List<Regex>,
        val markers: Map<MarkerGroup, List<Regex>>,
        val weakIssueBeforeDate: Regex?,
        val oldLead: Regex,
        val newLead: Regex,
        val newMarkerLead: Regex,
    )

    private class Run(
        val page: CanonicalPage,
        val candidates: List<Candidate>,
        val lex: Lexicon,
    ) {
        val norm = normalize(page.text)
        val dates = candidates.filter { it.value is DateValue }.sortedBy { it.range.start }
        val times = candidates.filter { it.value is TimeValue }.sortedBy { it.range.start }
        val byId = candidates.associateBy { it.id }
        val lineIndexOf = HashMap<Int, Int>()
        val sentencesByLine = HashMap<Int, List<TextRange>>()
        val roleHits = mutableListOf<RoleHit>()
        val suffixHits = mutableListOf<TextRange>()
        val markerHits = mutableListOf<MarkerHit>()
        val roles = HashMap<Int, CandidateRole>()

        fun lineIndex(c: Candidate): Int? = lineIndexOf.getOrPut(c.id) {
            page.lines.indexOfFirst { it.range.contains(c.range) }
        }.takeIf { it >= 0 }

        fun analyze(): PageAnalysis {
            for ((role, regexes) in lex.roleKeywords) for (r in regexes) for (m in r.findAll(norm)) {
                roleHits += RoleHit(role, TextRange(m.range.first, m.range.last + 1))
            }
            for (r in lex.birthSuffix) for (m in r.findAll(norm)) suffixHits += TextRange(m.range.first, m.range.last + 1)
            for ((group, regexes) in lex.markers) for (r in regexes) for (m in r.findAll(norm)) {
                markerHits += MarkerHit(group, TextRange(m.range.first, m.range.last + 1))
            }
            // Hits must stay inside one line.
            roleHits.removeAll { h -> page.lines.none { it.range.contains(h.range) } }
            markerHits.removeAll { h -> page.lines.none { it.range.contains(h.range) } }

            for (d in dates) roles[d.id] = baseRole(d)
            val baseRoles = HashMap(roles)

            val groups = mutableListOf<EventDraft>()
            val handled = HashSet<Int>()

            // Reschedule sentences.
            val doneSentences = HashSet<TextRange>()
            for (hit in markerHits.filter { it.group == MarkerGroup.RESCHEDULE }.sortedBy { it.range.start }) {
                val sentence = sentenceAt(hit.range.start) ?: continue
                if (!doneSentences.add(sentence)) continue
                val set = dates.filter {
                    sentence.contains(TextRange(it.range.start, it.range.start)) &&
                        baseRoles[it.id] != CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE && baseRoles[it.id] != CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE
                }
                if (set.isEmpty()) continue
                if (set.none { baseRoles[it.id] == CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START || baseRoles[it.id] == CandidateRole.DUE_DATE }) continue
                handled += set.map { it.id }
                val kind = if (set.all { baseRoles[it.id] == CandidateRole.DUE_DATE }) EventKind.DEADLINE else EventKind.APPOINTMENT
                val leads = set.associateWith { leadOf(it, sentence) }
                var resolved = HashMap<Int, CandidateRole?>()
                for (d in set) resolved[d.id] = leads[d]
                if (set.size == 2) {
                    val a = set[0]; val b = set[1]
                    if (resolved[a.id] != null && resolved[b.id] == null) resolved[b.id] = complement(resolved[a.id])
                    else if (resolved[b.id] != null && resolved[a.id] == null) resolved[a.id] = complement(resolved[b.id])
                }
                for (d in set) resolved[d.id]?.let { roles[d.id] = it }
                val newDates = set.filter { resolved[it.id] == CandidateRole.NEW_START }
                val allAssigned = set.all { resolved[it.id] != null }
                if (allAssigned && newDates.isNotEmpty()) {
                    groups += EventDraft(kind, newDates)
                } else if (set.size >= 2) {
                    val options = set.filter { resolved[it.id] != CandidateRole.OLD_START }
                    groups += EventDraft(kind, options)
                }
                // One date without a lead-in (or only an old date): no event, nothing is chosen.
            }

            // Plain groups by line.
            for ((role, kind) in listOf(
                CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START to EventKind.APPOINTMENT,
                CandidateRole.DUE_DATE to EventKind.DEADLINE,
            )) {
                val plain = dates.filter { it.id !in handled && roles[it.id] == role }
                for ((_, group) in plain.groupBy { lineIndex(it) ?: -1 }) groups += EventDraft(kind, group)
            }
            groups.sortBy { it.dates.first().range.start }

            val eventDateStarts = groups.flatMap { g -> g.dates.map { it.range.start } }
            val orphanCancel = markerHits.any { h ->
                h.group == MarkerGroup.CANCEL && sentenceAt(h.range.start)?.let { s ->
                    eventDateStarts.none { s.contains(TextRange(it, it)) }
                } ?: true
            }

            val events = groups.map { buildEvent(it, orphanCancel) }
            return PageAnalysis(page, candidates, roles.toMap(), events)
        }

        class EventDraft(val kind: EventKind, val dates: List<Candidate>)

        fun complement(role: CandidateRole?) = when (role) {
            CandidateRole.OLD_START -> CandidateRole.NEW_START
            CandidateRole.NEW_START -> CandidateRole.OLD_START
            else -> null
        }

        fun buildEvent(draft: EventDraft, orphanCancel: Boolean): PageEvent {
            val first = draft.dates.first()
            val li = lineIndex(first) ?: 0
            val anchor = page.lines.getOrNull(li)?.range ?: first.range
            val dateId = if (draft.dates.size == 1) first.id else null
            val dateOptions = if (draft.dates.size == 1) emptyList() else draft.dates.map { it.id }
            var timeId: Int? = null
            var timeOptions = emptyList<Int>()
            if (draft.kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT) {
                val found = timesFor(draft.dates, li)
                if (found.size == 1) timeId = found[0].id else if (found.size > 1) timeOptions = found.map { it.id }
            }
            val sentences = draft.dates.mapNotNull { sentenceAt(it.range.start) }.distinct()
            val hits = markerHits.filter { h -> sentences.any { it.contains(h.range) } }.map { it.group }.toSet()
            val status = when {
                MarkerGroup.CANCEL in hits -> EventStatus.CANCELLED
                orphanCancel -> EventStatus.UNKNOWN
                MarkerGroup.TENTATIVE in hits -> EventStatus.TENTATIVE
                MarkerGroup.RESCHEDULE in hits -> EventStatus.RESCHEDULED
                else -> EventStatus.CONFIRMED
            }
            return PageEvent(draft.kind, status, dateId, dateOptions, timeId, timeOptions, anchor)
        }

        // ---- roles ----

        fun baseRole(d: Candidate): CandidateRole {
            val li = lineIndex(d) ?: return CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER
            val line = page.lines[li].range
            val left = roleHits.filter { line.contains(it.range) && it.range.endExclusive <= d.range.start }
            val cell = cellOf(line, d.range)
            val scoped = left.filter { it.range.start >= cell.start }.ifEmpty { left }
            // (role, distance)
            val found = mutableListOf<Pair<CandidateRole, Int>>()
            scoped.forEach { found += it.role to (d.range.start - it.range.endExclusive) }
            for (s in suffixHits) {
                if (s.start >= d.range.endExclusive && line.contains(s) &&
                    norm.substring(d.range.endExclusive, s.start).isBlank()
                ) found += CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE to (s.start - d.range.endExclusive)
            }
            val strong: CandidateRole? = if (found.isEmpty()) null else {
                val best = found.minOf { it.second }
                val roles = found.filter { it.second == best }.map { it.first }.toSet()
                if (roles.size == 1) roles.first() else return CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER
            }
            val weakIssue = lex.weakIssueBeforeDate?.containsMatchIn(norm.substring(line.start, d.range.start)) == true
            return when {
                weakIssue && strong == null -> CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE
                weakIssue && strong != CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE -> CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER
                else -> strong ?: CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER
            }
        }

        fun cellOf(line: TextRange, at: TextRange): TextRange {
            val sep = CanonicalPage.CELL_SEPARATOR
            var start = line.start
            while (true) {
                val idx = page.text.indexOf(sep, start)
                if (idx < 0 || idx + sep.length > line.endExclusive) return TextRange(start, line.endExclusive)
                if (at.start < idx) return TextRange(start, idx)
                start = idx + sep.length
                if (at.start < start) return TextRange(idx, start)
            }
        }

        fun leadOf(d: Candidate, sentence: TextRange): CandidateRole? {
            val left = norm.substring(sentence.start, d.range.start)
            val trimmed = left.trimEnd { it.isWhitespace() || it == ':' || it == ',' }
            val isNew = lex.newLead.containsMatchIn(trimmed) || lex.newMarkerLead.containsMatchIn(left)
            val isOld = lex.oldLead.containsMatchIn(trimmed)
            return when {
                isNew && isOld -> null
                isNew -> CandidateRole.NEW_START
                isOld -> CandidateRole.OLD_START
                else -> null
            }
        }

        // ---- sentences ----

        fun sentenceAt(pos: Int): TextRange? {
            val li = page.lines.indexOfFirst { pos >= it.range.start && pos <= it.range.endExclusive }
            if (li < 0) return null
            val sentences = sentencesByLine.getOrPut(li) { splitSentences(page.text, page.lines[li].range) }
            return sentences.firstOrNull { pos >= it.start && pos < it.endExclusive } ?: sentences.lastOrNull()
        }

        fun splitSentences(text: String, line: TextRange): List<TextRange> {
            val out = mutableListOf<TextRange>()
            var start = line.start
            val end = line.endExclusive
            for (i in line.start until end) {
                val c = text[i]
                if (c != '.' && c != '!' && c != '?' && c != ';') continue
                var boundary = false
                val next = i + 1
                if (next >= end) boundary = true
                else if (text[next].isWhitespace()) {
                    if (c == '.') {
                        val abbreviation = i > line.start && text[i - 1].isLetter() &&
                            (i - 1 == line.start || !text[i - 2].isLetter())
                        var j = next
                        while (j < end && text[j].isWhitespace()) j++
                        boundary = !abbreviation && (j >= end || text[j].isUpperCase())
                    } else boundary = true
                }
                if (boundary) { out += TextRange(start, next); start = next }
            }
            if (start < end) out += TextRange(start, end)
            if (out.isEmpty()) out += line
            return out
        }

        // ---- times ----

        fun timesIn(lineIdx: Int): List<Candidate> {
            val line = page.lines.getOrNull(lineIdx)?.range ?: return emptyList()
            val inLine = times.filter { line.contains(it.range) }
            val dropped = HashSet<Int>()
            for (i in inLine.indices) {
                val t = inLine[i]
                if (CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START in t.flags && i + 1 < inLine.size) {
                    val gap = norm.substring(t.range.endExclusive, inLine[i + 1].range.start).trim()
                    if (RANGE_CONNECTOR.matches(gap)) dropped += inLine[i + 1].id
                }
            }
            return inLine.filter { it.id !in dropped }
        }

        fun timesFor(group: List<Candidate>, lineIdx: Int): List<Candidate> {
            val inLine = timesIn(lineIdx)
            val line = page.lines[lineIdx].range
            val lineDates = dates.filter { line.contains(it.range) }
            var chosen: List<Candidate> = inLine
            if (group.size == 1 && lineDates.size > 1) {
                val d = group[0]
                val nextStart = lineDates.firstOrNull { it.range.start >= d.range.endExclusive }?.range?.start ?: Int.MAX_VALUE
                val prevEnd = lineDates.lastOrNull { it.range.endExclusive <= d.range.start }?.range?.endExclusive ?: -1
                val following = inLine.filter { it.range.start >= d.range.endExclusive && it.range.start < nextStart }
                chosen = following.ifEmpty { inLine.filter { it.range.start >= prevEnd && it.range.endExclusive <= d.range.start } }
            }
            if (chosen.isEmpty() && lineIdx + 1 < page.lines.size) {
                val next = page.lines[lineIdx + 1].range
                if (dates.none { next.contains(it.range) }) chosen = timesIn(lineIdx + 1)
            }
            return chosen
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        val RANGE_CONNECTOR = Regex("(до|a|al|hasta|-|–|—)")
        const val B1 = "(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])"
        const val B2 = "(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}])"

        /** Length-preserving: lower case, no diacritics (й -> и, ё -> е, á -> a), no-break space -> space. */
        fun normalize(s: String): String {
            val sb = StringBuilder(s.length)
            for (ch in s) {
                if (ch == ' ') { sb.append(' '); continue }
                val low = Character.toLowerCase(ch)
                val d = Normalizer.normalize(low.toString(), Normalizer.Form.NFD)
                sb.append(if (d.length > 1 && d.drop(1).all { Character.getType(it) == Character.NON_SPACING_MARK.toInt() }) d[0] else low)
            }
            return sb.toString()
        }

        fun phrase(p: String): Regex =
            Regex(B1 + normalize(p).split(' ').joinToString("[ \\t]+") { Regex.escape(it) } + B2)

        fun phrases(vararg p: String): List<Regex> = p.map { phrase(it) }

        fun lexicon(language: SemanticLanguage): Lexicon = when (language) {
            SemanticLanguage.RU -> RU
            SemanticLanguage.ES -> ES
        }

        val RU = Lexicon(
            roleKeywords = mapOf(
                CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START to phrases(
                    "приём", "приёма", "приёму", "приёме", "приёмом", "явка", "явки", "явиться",
                    "запись на", "записаны на", "записан на", "записана на", "состоится",
                ),
                CandidateRole.DUE_DATE to phrases(
                    "оплатить до", "оплата до", "оплатите до", "срок", "срока", "сроки", "не позднее", "не позже",
                ),
                CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE to phrases("выдан", "выдана", "выдано", "выданы", "дата выдачи"),
                CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE to phrases("дата рождения", "года рождения", "родился", "родилась"),
            ),
            birthSuffix = phrases("г. р.", "г.р."),
            markers = mapOf(
                MarkerGroup.CANCEL to phrases(
                    "отменён", "отменена", "отменено", "отменены", "отмена", "отменяется", "отменяются",
                    "аннулирован", "аннулирована", "аннулировано", "не состоится",
                    "не подтверждён", "не подтверждена", "не подтверждено",
                    "не записан", "не записана", "не записаны", "без записи", "запись не требуется",
                ),
                MarkerGroup.TENTATIVE to phrases(
                    "предварительно", "предварительная запись", "ожидает подтверждения", "лист ожидания", "при условии",
                ),
                MarkerGroup.RESCHEDULE to phrases(
                    "перенесён", "перенесена", "перенесено", "перенесены", "перенос", "переносится",
                    "новая дата", "новую дату", "новой даты",
                ),
            ),
            weakIssueBeforeDate = Regex("$B1" + "от[ \\t]*$"),
            oldLead = Regex("$B1(с|со|вместо)$"),
            newLead = Regex("$B1(на)$"),
            newMarkerLead = Regex("(новая дата|новую дату|новой даты)[^\\d]{0,30}$"),
        )

        val ES = Lexicon(
            roleKeywords = mapOf(
                CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START to phrases(
                    "cita", "citas", "consulta", "hora de la cita", "se le cita", "tendrá lugar",
                ),
                CandidateRole.DUE_DATE to phrases(
                    "fecha límite", "vencimiento", "pagar antes del", "pagar antes de", "plazo hasta",
                ),
                CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE to phrases(
                    "fecha de expedición", "fecha de emisión", "expedido el", "expedida el",
                ),
                CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE to phrases("fecha de nacimiento", "nacido el", "nacida el"),
            ),
            birthSuffix = emptyList(),
            markers = mapOf(
                MarkerGroup.CANCEL to phrases(
                    "cancelada", "cancelado", "canceladas", "cancelados", "cancelación", "anulada", "anulado",
                    "suspendida", "suspendido", "no se celebrará", "queda sin efecto",
                    "no confirmada", "no confirmado", "sin cita", "no requiere cita",
                ),
                MarkerGroup.TENTATIVE to phrases(
                    "provisional", "pendiente de confirmación", "lista de espera", "sujeto a", "sujeta a",
                ),
                MarkerGroup.RESCHEDULE to phrases(
                    "aplazada", "aplazado", "pospuesta", "pospuesto", "reprogramada", "reprogramado",
                    "se traslada", "nueva fecha", "cambio de cita",
                ),
            ),
            weakIssueBeforeDate = null,
            oldLead = Regex("$B1(del|en lugar del|en lugar de)$"),
            newLead = Regex("$B1(al)$"),
            newMarkerLead = Regex("(nueva fecha)[^\\d]{0,30}$"),
        )
    }

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.tan

/**
 * Builds the canonical text from OCR lines (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.1).
 * OCR lines of different blocks lying on one visual row (tilt up to ±3°) become cells of one line.
 * [RecognitionLayout.plainText] is never used.
 */
class LayoutCanonicalTextBuilder(private val languageDetector: LanguageDetector) : CanonicalTextBuilder {

    private class Cell(val line: OcrLine, val words: List<OcrWord>, val order: Int) {
        val centerX = (line.box.left + line.box.right) / 2f
        val centerY = (line.box.top + line.box.bottom) / 2f
    }

    override fun build(pageIndex: Int, layout: RecognitionLayout): CanonicalPage {
        val cells = ArrayList<Cell>()
        for (block in layout.blocks.sortedBy { it.readingOrder }) {
            for (line in block.lines) {
                val words = line.words.filter { it.text.isNotEmpty() }
                if (words.isNotEmpty()) cells += Cell(line, words, cells.size)
            }
        }
        val width = if (layout.sourceWidthPx > 0) layout.sourceWidthPx.toFloat() else 1f
        val height = if (layout.sourceHeightPx > 0) layout.sourceHeightPx.toFloat() else 1f

        val parent = IntArray(cells.size) { it }
        fun find(x: Int): Int {
            var r = x
            while (parent[r] != r) r = parent[r]
            var c = x
            while (parent[c] != r) { val n = parent[c]; parent[c] = r; c = n }
            return r
        }
        for (i in cells.indices) for (j in i + 1 until cells.size) {
            if (sameVisualRow(cells[i], cells[j], width, height)) parent[find(j)] = find(i)
        }
        val groups = cells.indices.groupBy { find(it) }.values
            .map { idx -> idx.map { cells[it] }.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.line.box.left }, { it.order })) }
            .sortedWith(compareBy({ g -> g.map { it.centerY }.average() }, { g -> g.first().line.box.left }))

        val text = StringBuilder()
        val lines = ArrayList<CanonicalLine>()
        val words = ArrayList<CanonicalWord>()
        for ((rowIndex, row) in groups.withIndex()) {
            if (rowIndex > 0) text.append('\n')
            val rowStart = text.length
            for ((cellIndex, cell) in row.withIndex()) {
                if (cellIndex > 0) text.append(CanonicalPage.CELL_SEPARATOR)
                for ((wordIndex, word) in cell.words.withIndex()) {
                    if (wordIndex > 0) text.append(' ')
                    val start = text.length
                    text.append(word.text)
                    words += CanonicalWord(TextRange(start, text.length), word.box, word.confidence)
                }
            }
            lines += CanonicalLine(TextRange(rowStart, text.length))
        }
        val result = text.toString()
        return CanonicalPage(pageIndex, result, lines, words, languageDetector.detect(result))
    }

    private fun sameVisualRow(a: Cell, b: Cell, width: Float, height: Float): Boolean {
        val ha = a.line.box.height * height
        val hb = b.line.box.height * height
        val minH = min(ha, hb)
        if (minH <= 0f) return false
        val dx = (b.centerX - a.centerX) * width
        val slopes = listOfNotNull(a.line.baseline?.slope, b.line.baseline?.slope)
        val slope = if (slopes.isEmpty()) 0f else slopes.average().toFloat()
        val dy = (b.centerY - a.centerY) * height - slope * dx
        val allowed = TAN_MAX_TILT * abs(dx)
        val offset = max(0f, abs(dy) - allowed)
        val overlap = min(ha / 2f, offset + hb / 2f) - max(-ha / 2f, offset - hb / 2f)
        return overlap >= MIN_OVERLAP * minH
    }

    private companion object {
        val TAN_MAX_TILT = tan(Math.toRadians(3.0)).toFloat()
        const val MIN_OVERLAP = 0.5f
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox

/** Binds grammar matches to the page: box, minimal word confidence and flags (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.3). */
class PageCandidateExtractor : CandidateExtractor {
    override fun extract(page: CanonicalPage, grammar: DateTimeGrammar): List<Candidate> {
        val out = ArrayList<Candidate>()
        for (match in grammar.find(page.text)) {
            val range = match.range
            if (range.endExclusive > page.text.length || range.length == 0) continue
            val raw = range.substring(page.text)
            if ('\n' in raw) continue
            val covered = page.words.filter { it.range.overlaps(range) }
            val box = if (covered.isEmpty()) null else NormalizedBox(
                left = covered.minOf { it.box.left },
                top = covered.minOf { it.box.top },
                right = covered.maxOf { it.box.right },
                bottom = covered.maxOf { it.box.bottom },
            )
            out += Candidate(
                id = out.size,
                pageIndex = page.pageIndex,
                range = range,
                raw = raw,
                value = match.value,
                box = box,
                minConfidence = covered.minOfOrNull { it.confidence } ?: 1.0f,
                flags = match.flags,
            )
        }
        return out
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import java.time.DateTimeException
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalTime

/** Validation, year resolution, cross-page merge and policy (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.4, §4.7, §4.8). */
class RuleDocumentAssembler(private val yearResolver: YearResolver) : DocumentAssembler {

    private class Draft(
        val pageIndex: Int,
        val anchorStart: Int,
        val kind: EventKind,
        val status: EventStatus,
        val title: String,
        val dates: List<DateOption>,
        val dateChosen: Boolean,
        val times: List<TimeOption>,
        val timeChosen: Boolean,
    ) {
        val needsChoice: Boolean get() = !dateChosen || (kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT && !timeChosen)
        val selectedDate: DateOption? get() = if (dateChosen) dates.single() else null
        val selectedTime: TimeOption? get() = if (timeChosen) times.single() else null
        val lowQuality: Boolean
            get() = selectedDate?.sources?.any { it.needsCropConfirmation } == true ||
                selectedTime?.sources?.any { it.needsCropConfirmation } == true
        val key: Key?
            get() {
                val date = selectedDate?.date ?: return null
                return when (kind) {
                    EventKind.APPOINTMENT -> selectedTime?.let { Key(kind, date, it.time) }
                    EventKind.DEADLINE -> Key(kind, date, null)
                }
            }
    }

    private data class Key(val kind: EventKind, val date: LocalDate, val time: LocalTime?)

    private class Document(val documentDate: LocalDate?, val birthDates: Set<LocalDate>, val scanDate: LocalDate) {
        val anchor: LocalDate get() = documentDate ?: scanDate
    }

    override fun assemble(
        pages: List<PageAnalysis>,
        titles: (PageAnalysis, PageEvent) -> String,
        scanDate: LocalDate,
    ): List<Proposal> {
        val document = Document(findDocumentDate(pages, scanDate), findBirthDates(pages), scanDate)
        val drafts = ArrayList<Draft>()
        for (analysis in pages) {
            for (event in analysis.events) {
                if (event.status == EventStatus.MENTIONED) continue
                buildDraft(analysis, event, document, titles)?.let { drafts.add(it) }
            }
        }
        drafts.sortWith(compareBy({ it.pageIndex }, { it.anchorStart }))

        val killed = drafts.filter { it.status == EventStatus.CANCELLED || it.status == EventStatus.UNKNOWN }
            .mapNotNull { it.key }.toSet()
        val alive = drafts.filter {
            it.status != EventStatus.CANCELLED && it.status != EventStatus.UNKNOWN && it.key !in killed
        }

        val result = ArrayList<Proposal>()
        val merged = HashSet<Key>()
        for (draft in alive) {
            val key = draft.key
            if (key == null) { result.add(toProposal(listOf(draft))); continue }
            if (!merged.add(key)) continue
            result.add(toProposal(alive.filter { it.key == key }))
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun toProposal(group: List<Draft>): Proposal {
        val first = group.first()
        val kind = if (first.kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT) ProposalKind.EVENT else ProposalKind.TASK
        if (group.any { it.status == EventStatus.TENTATIVE }) {
            return Proposal(kind, ProposalState.EMPTY, EventStatus.TENTATIVE, first.title, null, emptyList(), null, emptyList())
        }
        val status = if (group.any { it.status == EventStatus.RESCHEDULED }) EventStatus.RESCHEDULED else EventStatus.CONFIRMED
        if (first.needsChoice) {
            return Proposal(
                kind, ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, status, first.title,
                null, if (first.dateChosen) emptyList() else first.dates,
                null, if (first.timeChosen) emptyList() else first.times,
            ).let { p ->
                // A chosen field of a NEEDS_CHOICE proposal stays prefilled.
                p.copy(date = first.selectedDate, time = first.selectedTime)
            }
        }
        val date = first.selectedDate?.let { DateOption(it.date, it.yearInferred, group.flatMap { g -> g.selectedDate!!.sources }.distinct()) }
        val time = first.selectedTime?.let { TimeOption(it.time, group.flatMap { g -> g.selectedTime!!.sources }.distinct()) }
        val state = if (group.any { it.lowQuality }) ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY else ProposalState.FILLED
        return Proposal(kind, state, status, first.title, date, emptyList(), time, emptyList())
    }

    private fun buildDraft(
        analysis: PageAnalysis,
        event: PageEvent,
        document: Document,
        titles: (PageAnalysis, PageEvent) -> String,
    ): Draft? {
        val dateIds = if (event.dateCandidateId != null) listOf(event.dateCandidateId) else event.dateOptions
        if (dateIds.isEmpty()) return null
        val dateChosenByEvent = event.dateCandidateId != null
        val dateCandidates = dateIds.map { id -> analysis.candidates.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return null }
        if (dateCandidates.any { it.value !is DateValue }) return null

        var dateChoice = !dateChosenByEvent
        val dateOptions = ArrayList<DateOption>()
        for (candidate in dateCandidates) {
            if (!rawMatches(analysis.page, candidate)) continue
            val resolution = yearResolver.resolve(candidate.value as DateValue, document.documentDate, document.scanDate)
            val (dates, inferred) = when (resolution) {
                is YearResolution.Resolved -> {
                    listOf(resolution.date) to resolution.inferred
                }
                is YearResolution.Choice -> { dateChoice = true; resolution.options to true }
                YearResolution.Invalid -> continue
            }
            for (date in dates) {
                if (!dateAllowed(date, event.kind, document)) continue
                val source = source(candidate)
                val existing = dateOptions.indexOfFirst { it.date == date }
                if (existing >= 0) {
                    dateOptions[existing] = dateOptions[existing].copy(sources = (dateOptions[existing].sources + source).distinct())
                } else dateOptions.add(DateOption(date, inferred, listOf(source)))
            }
        }
        if (dateOptions.isEmpty()) return null
        if (dateChosenByEvent && !dateChoice && dateOptions.size != 1) return null

        var times: List<TimeOption> = emptyList()
        var timeChoice = false
        if (event.kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT) {
            val timeIds = if (event.timeCandidateId != null) listOf(event.timeCandidateId) else event.timeOptions
            if (timeIds.isEmpty()) return null
            timeChoice = event.timeCandidateId == null
            val timeCandidates = timeIds.map { id -> analysis.candidates.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: return null }
            if (timeCandidates.any { it.value !is TimeValue }) return null
            val list = ArrayList<TimeOption>()
            for (candidate in timeCandidates) {
                if (!rawMatches(analysis.page, candidate)) continue
                val value = candidate.value as TimeValue
                val time = LocalTime.of(value.hour, value.minute)
                val source = source(candidate)
                val existing = list.indexOfFirst { it.time == time }
                if (existing >= 0) list[existing] = list[existing].copy(sources = (list[existing].sources + source).distinct())
                else list.add(TimeOption(time, listOf(source)))
            }
            if (list.isEmpty()) return null
            times = list
        }

        return Draft(
            pageIndex = analysis.page.pageIndex,
            anchorStart = event.anchorLine.start,
            kind = event.kind,
            status = event.status,
            title = titles(analysis, event),
            dates = dateOptions,
            dateChosen = !dateChoice,
            times = times,
            timeChosen = event.kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT && !timeChoice,
        )
    }

    private fun dateAllowed(date: LocalDate, kind: EventKind, document: Document): Boolean {
        if (date.year !in 1900..2100) return false
        document.documentDate?.let { if (date.isBefore(it)) return false }
        if (date in document.birthDates) return false
        val horizon = if (kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT) 730L else 1825L
        return !date.isBefore(document.scanDate.minusDays(30)) && !date.isAfter(document.anchor.plusDays(horizon))
    }

    private fun rawMatches(page: CanonicalPage, candidate: Candidate): Boolean {
        val range = candidate.range
        if (range.endExclusive > page.text.length) return false
        return range.substring(page.text) == candidate.raw
    }

    private fun source(c: Candidate) = FieldSource(c.pageIndex, c.range, c.box, c.raw, c.needsCropConfirmation)

    private fun printedDate(analysis: PageAnalysis, candidate: Candidate): LocalDate? {
        val value = candidate.value as? DateValue ?: return null
        val year = value.year ?: return null
        if (year !in 1900..2100 || !rawMatches(analysis.page, candidate)) return null
        return try { LocalDate.of(year, value.month, value.day) } catch (_: DateTimeException) { null }
    }

    private fun datesWithRole(pages: List<PageAnalysis>, role: CandidateRole): List<LocalDate> =
        pages.flatMap { a ->
            a.candidates.filter { a.roles[it.id] == role }.mapNotNull { printedDate(a, it) }
        }

    private fun findDocumentDate(pages: List<PageAnalysis>, scanDate: LocalDate): LocalDate? =
        datesWithRole(pages, CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE).filter { !it.isAfter(scanDate) }.maxOrNull()

    private fun findBirthDates(pages: List<PageAnalysis>): Set<LocalDate> =
        datesWithRole(pages, CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE).toSet()
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/RussianDateTimeGrammar.kt
