package app.docscan.core.semantic

import java.time.YearMonth
import java.util.regex.Matcher
import java.util.regex.Pattern

/**
 * Russian dates and times (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.3). Works on the original text: ranges are UTF-16 offsets
 * of the input, nothing is normalised before matching. Never guesses: impossible values, phone numbers, amounts,
 * document numbers and ambiguous fragments produce no match.
 *
 * Range conventions (fixed by RussianDateTimeGrammarTest):
 * - a date range covers day, month and the year with its marker ("г.", "года"), without weekday and without
 *   the sentence period after a full word ("18 ноября 2026 года" + "." -> period excluded; "нояб." and "г." keep
 *   their abbreviation period);
 * - a time range covers the time expression only, without the preposition ("в", "к", "с"...); the unit words
 *   required by the form ("14 ч 30 мин.", "9 часов") are part of it;
 * - for "с 9 до 14" only the start time is returned; the end time is swallowed and never returned.
 */
class RussianDateTimeGrammar : DateTimeGrammar {
    override val language: SemanticLanguage = SemanticLanguage.RU

    override fun find(text: String): List<GrammarMatch> {
        if (text.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val found = ArrayList<Found>()
        findMonthNameDates(text, found)
        findNumericDates(text, found)
        findTimes(text, found)
        found.sortWith(compareBy<Found> { it.consumed.start }.thenByDescending { it.consumed.length })
        val result = ArrayList<GrammarMatch>()
        var lastEnd = 0
        for (candidate in found) {
            if (candidate.consumed.start < lastEnd) continue
            result += candidate.match
            lastEnd = candidate.consumed.endExclusive
        }
        return result
    }

    /** [consumed] may be wider than the match: the end of a time range is swallowed but not returned. */
    private class Found(val match: GrammarMatch, val consumed: TextRange)

    private class Num(val value: Int, val substituted: Boolean)

    private enum class Kind { UNITS, COLON, DOT, HOUR_UNIT, BARE }

    private class Atom(val start: Int, val end: Int, val hour: Int, val minute: Int, val kind: Kind, val substituted: Boolean) {
        val hasMinutes: Boolean get() = kind == Kind.UNITS || kind == Kind.COLON || kind == Kind.DOT
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- dates

    private fun findMonthNameDates(text: String, out: MutableList<Found>) {
        val m = MONTH_DATE.matcher(text)
        while (m.find()) {
            val day = num(m.group(1)) ?: continue
            val word = (m.group(2) ?: m.group(3)).lowercase()
            val month = monthOf(word)
            var substituted = day.substituted
            var end = maxOf(m.end(2), m.end(3), m.end(4))
            var year: Int? = null
            val yearGroup = m.group(5)
            if (yearGroup != null) {
                val parsed = num(yearGroup)
                if (parsed != null && parsed.value in YEAR_RANGE) {
                    year = parsed.value
                    substituted = substituted || parsed.substituted
                    end = m.end()
                }
            }
            if (day.value !in 1..daysIn(month, year)) continue
            val flags = if (substituted) setOf(CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION) else emptySet()
            val range = TextRange(m.start(), end)
            out += Found(GrammarMatch(range, DateValue(day.value, month, year), flags), range)
        }
    }

    private fun findNumericDates(text: String, out: MutableList<Found>) {
        val m = NUMERIC_DATE.matcher(text)
        while (m.find()) {
            val separator = m.group(2)[0]
            val day = num(m.group(1)) ?: continue
            val month = num(m.group(3)) ?: continue
            val yearNum = num(m.group(4)) ?: continue
            val twoDigitYear = m.group(4).length == 2
            if (twoDigitYear && separator != '.') continue
            val year = if (twoDigitYear) 2000 + yearNum.value else yearNum.value
            if (month.value !in 1..12 || year !in YEAR_RANGE) continue
            if (day.value !in 1..daysIn(month.value, year)) continue
            val start = m.start()
            if (isDocumentNumberPrefix(text, start)) continue
            if (separator == '-') {
                // 10-12-2014 inside "8-10-12-2014" is a phone-like chain, not a date.
                if (start > 0 && text[start - 1] in "-+(") continue
                if (m.end() < text.length && text[m.end()] == '-') continue
            }
            val substituted = day.substituted || month.substituted || yearNum.substituted
            val flags = if (substituted) setOf(CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION) else emptySet()
            val range = TextRange(start, m.end())
            out += Found(GrammarMatch(range, DateValue(day.value, month.value, year), flags), range)
        }
    }

    private fun isDocumentNumberPrefix(text: String, start: Int): Boolean {
        var i = start - 1
        while (i >= 0 && text[i].isWhitespace()) i--
        return i >= 0 && (text[i] == '№' || text[i] == '#')
    }

    private fun daysIn(month: Int, year: Int?): Int = YearMonth.of(year ?: 2000, month).lengthOfMonth()

    private fun monthOf(word: String): Int = when {
        word.startsWith("янв") -> 1
        word.startsWith("фев") -> 2
        word.startsWith("мар") -> 3
        word.startsWith("апр") -> 4
        word.startsWith("мая") -> 5
        word.startsWith("июн") -> 6
        word.startsWith("июл") -> 7
        word.startsWith("авг") -> 8
        word.startsWith("сен") -> 9
        word.startsWith("окт") -> 10
        word.startsWith("ноя") -> 11
        else -> 12
    }

    private fun num(group: String): Num? {
        val result = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(group, SemanticLanguage.RU) ?: return null
        return Num(result.digits.toInt(), result.substituted)
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- times

    private fun findTimes(text: String, out: MutableList<Found>) {
        val noon = NOON.matcher(text)
        while (noon.find()) {
            val range = TextRange(noon.start(1), noon.end(1))
            out += Found(GrammarMatch(range, TimeValue(12, 0)), range)
        }
        for (i in text.indices) {
            val c = text[i]
            if (isLookAlikeOrDigit(c) && leftOk(text, i)) {
                val atom = parseAtom(text, i, inRange = false)
                if (atom != null) {
                    out += atomFound(atom, emptySet(), atom.end)
                    if (atom.kind == Kind.COLON || atom.kind == Kind.DOT) {
                        val rangeEnd = tryRange(text, atom, dashOnly = true)
                        if (rangeEnd != null) out += atomFound(atom, setOf(CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START), rangeEnd)
                    }
                }
            }
            if ((c == 'с' || c == 'С') && wordStart(text, i) && i + 1 < text.length && isSpace(text[i + 1])) {
                var j = i + 1
                while (j < text.length && isSpace(text[j])) j++
                val atom = parseAtom(text, j, inRange = true) ?: continue
                val rangeEnd = tryRange(text, atom, dashOnly = false) ?: continue
                out += atomFound(atom, setOf(CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START), rangeEnd)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun atomFound(atom: Atom, rangeFlags: Set<CandidateFlag>, consumedEnd: Int): Found {
        val flags = if (atom.substituted) rangeFlags + CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION else rangeFlags
        val range = TextRange(atom.start, atom.end)
        return Found(GrammarMatch(range, TimeValue(atom.hour, atom.minute), flags), TextRange(atom.start, consumedEnd))
    }

    /** Returns the end of the swallowed range end time, or null when [start] is not the start of a printed range. */
    private fun tryRange(text: String, start: Atom, dashOnly: Boolean): Int? {
        val connector = CONNECTOR.matcher(text)
        connector.region(start.end, text.length)
        connector.useTransparentBounds(true)
        connector.useAnchoringBounds(false)
        if (!connector.lookingAt()) return null
        val word = connector.group(1)?.lowercase()
        val viaUntil = word == "до"
        if (dashOnly && word != null) return null
        if (!viaUntil && !start.hasMinutes) return null
        val end = parseAtom(text, connector.end(), inRange = true) ?: return null
        if (!viaUntil && !end.hasMinutes) return null
        if (end.kind == Kind.BARE && AFTER_BARE_END.matcher(text).region(end.end, text.length).let { it.useTransparentBounds(true); it.lookingAt() }) return null
        return end.end
    }

    private fun parseAtom(text: String, pos: Int, inRange: Boolean): Atom? {
        val prep = inRange || prepCue(text, pos)
        lookingAt(UNITS, text, pos)?.let { m -> return build(pos, m.end(), m.group(1), m.group(2), Kind.UNITS) }
        lookingAt(COLON, text, pos)?.let { m ->
            if (m.group(1).length == 1 && !(prep || timeWordCue(text, pos))) return null
            return build(pos, m.end(), m.group(1), m.group(2), Kind.COLON)
        }
        lookingAt(DOT, text, pos)?.let { m ->
            val explicit = timeWordCue(text, pos) || lookingAt(UNIT_AFTER, text, m.end()) != null
            if (!(prep || explicit)) return null
            val minute = num(m.group(2)) ?: return null
            // "в 14.10" can be 14 October: without "время"/"ч" the dotted form is ambiguous when minutes look like a month.
            if (!explicit && minute.value in 1..12) return null
            return build(pos, m.end(), m.group(1), m.group(2), Kind.DOT)
        }
        lookingAt(HOUR_UNIT, text, pos)?.let { m ->
            if (!prep) return null
            return build(pos, m.end(), m.group(1), null, Kind.HOUR_UNIT)
        }
        if (inRange) {
            lookingAt(BARE, text, pos)?.let { m -> return build(pos, m.end(), m.group(1), null, Kind.BARE) }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun build(start: Int, end: Int, hourGroup: String, minuteGroup: String?, kind: Kind): Atom? {
        val hour = num(hourGroup) ?: return null
        val minute = if (minuteGroup == null) Num(0, false) else num(minuteGroup) ?: return null
        if (hour.value !in 0..23 || minute.value !in 0..59) return null
        return Atom(start, end, hour.value, minute.value, kind, hour.substituted || minute.substituted)
    }

    private fun lookingAt(pattern: Pattern, text: String, pos: Int): Matcher? {
        val m = pattern.matcher(text)
        m.region(pos, text.length)
        m.useTransparentBounds(true)
        m.useAnchoringBounds(false)
        return if (m.lookingAt()) m else null
    }

    private fun prepCue(text: String, pos: Int): Boolean =
        PREP_CUE.matcher(text.substring(maxOf(0, pos - 14), pos)).find()

    private fun timeWordCue(text: String, pos: Int): Boolean =
        TIME_WORD_CUE.matcher(text.substring(maxOf(0, pos - 24), pos)).find()

    private fun isLookAlikeOrDigit(c: Char): Boolean = c in '0'..'9' || DigitConfusion.isLookAlike(c, SemanticLanguage.RU)

    private fun isSpace(c: Char): Boolean = c.isWhitespace() || c == ' ' || c == ' '

    private fun wordStart(text: String, i: Int): Boolean = i == 0 || !text[i - 1].isLetterOrDigit()

    /** Not inside a longer token and not the tail of "123.45" / "495:12" style chains. */
    private fun leftOk(text: String, i: Int): Boolean {
        if (i == 0) return true
        if (text[i - 1].isLetterOrDigit()) return false
        if (i >= 2 && text[i - 1] in ".,:/" && text[i - 2] in '0'..'9') return false
        return true
    }

    private companion object {
        val YEAR_RANGE = 1900..2100

        /** One digit or one look-alike character; real digits are required later by DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup. */
        val G: String = "(?-i:[" + (0..0xFFFF).map { it.toChar() }
            .filter { it in '0'..'9' || DigitConfusion.isLookAlike(it, SemanticLanguage.RU) }
            .joinToString("") { "\\u%04x".format(it.code) } + "])"
        const val S = "[\\s\\u00a0\\u202f]"
        const val W = "[\\p{L}\\p{N}]"
        const val FLAGS = "(?iu)"

        const val FULL_MONTH = "января|февраля|марта|апреля|мая|июня|июля|августа|сентября|октября|ноября|декабря"
        const val ABBR_MONTH = "янв|февр|фев|мар|апр|июн|июл|авг|сент|сен|окт|нояб|ноя|дек"
        val ABBREVIATIONS = ABBR_MONTH.split('|').toSet()

        /** Year marker: "г." keeps its abbreviation period, full words do not take the sentence period. */
        const val YEAR_MARKER = "(?:(?:года|году|год)(?!$W)|г(?!$W)\\.?+)"
        const val YEAR_TAIL = "(?:$S*$YEAR_MARKER|(?!$W)(?![.:/]\\d))"
        const val LEFT = "(?<!$W)(?<![0-9][.,:/])"

        val MONTH_DATE: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "$FLAGS$LEFT($G{1,2})$S+(?:($FULL_MONTH)(?!$W)|($ABBR_MONTH)(?!$W)(\\.)?)(?:$S+($G{4})$YEAR_TAIL)?",
        )
        val NUMERIC_DATE: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "$FLAGS$LEFT($G{1,2})([./-])($G{1,2})\\2($G{4}|$G{2})$YEAR_TAIL",
        )

        const val HOUR_WORD = "(?:часов|часа|часам|час|ч)(?!\\p{L})"
        val UNITS: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "$FLAGS($G{1,2})$S*$HOUR_WORD\\.?+$S*($G{2})$S*мин(?:ут(?:а|ы|у|ам)?)?(?!\\p{L})\\.?+",
        )
        val COLON: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS($G{1,2}):($G{2})(?!$W)(?![.:/]\\d)")
        val DOT: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "$FLAGS($G{1,2})\\.($G{2})(?!$W)(?![.,:/]\\d)(?!$S*(?:руб|₽|коп|%|р(?!\\p{L})))",
        )
        val HOUR_UNIT: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS($G{1,2})$S*$HOUR_WORD\\.?+(?!$S*[0-9])")
        val BARE: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS($G{1,2})(?!$W)(?![.,:/]\\d)")
        val UNIT_AFTER: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS$S*(?:часов|часа|час|ч)(?!$W)")
        val NOON: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS(?<!$W)в$S+(полдень)(?!$W)")
        val CONNECTOR: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS(?:$S+(до|по)$S+|$S*[-\\u2013\\u2014]$S*)")
        val PREP_CUE: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS(?:\\A|[^\\p{L}\\p{N}])(?:в|к|до|с|около|после|ровно)$S{1,3}\\z")
        val TIME_WORD_CUE: Pattern = Pattern.compile("$FLAGS(?:\\A|[^\\p{L}])(?:времени|время)$S*[:\\-\\u2013\\u2014]?$S*\\z")
        /** A bare range end followed by these is a day, an age, a class or a quantity, not an hour. */
        val AFTER_BARE_END: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "$FLAGS$S*(?:%|числ|лет|год|руб|₽|кг|шт|мес|дн|нед|кл|чел|янв|фев|мар|апр|ма[яй]|июн|июл|авг|сен|окт|ноя|дек)",
        )
    }
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/ScriptLanguageDetector.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.semantic

/**
 * Detects the page language by its letter script (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.2).
 *
 * Letters are counted only from the Cyrillic block (U+0400..U+04FF) and the Latin alphabet
 * (A-Z, a-z, Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A/B letters). Digits, punctuation and spaces are ignored.
 */
class ScriptLanguageDetector : LanguageDetector {

    override fun detect(text: String): SemanticLanguage? {
        var cyrillic = 0
        var latin = 0
        for (char in text) {
            when {
                char in CYRILLIC -> cyrillic++
                isLatinLetter(char) -> latin++
            }
        }
        val letters = cyrillic + latin
        if (letters < MIN_LETTERS) return null
        // Share >= 0.6 written as integer arithmetic: cyrillic / letters >= 3 / 5.
        if (cyrillic * 5 >= letters * 3) return SemanticLanguage.RU
        if (latin * 5 >= letters * 3) {
            return if (hasSpanishMarks(text)) SemanticLanguage.ES else null
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun hasSpanishMarks(text: String): Boolean {
        if (text.any { it in SPANISH_DIACRITICS }) return true
        val serviceWords = WORD.findAll(text).count { it.value.lowercase() in SPANISH_SERVICE_WORDS }
        return serviceWords >= MIN_SERVICE_WORDS
    }

    private fun isLatinLetter(char: Char): Boolean =
        char in 'A'..'Z' || char in 'a'..'z' ||
            (char in 'À'..'ɏ' && char != '×' && char != '÷')

    private companion object {
        val CYRILLIC = 'Ѐ'..'ӿ'
        const val MIN_LETTERS = 20
        const val MIN_SERVICE_WORDS = 3
        const val SPANISH_DIACRITICS = "ñÑáéíóúü¿¡"
        val SPANISH_SERVICE_WORDS = setOf(
            "de", "el", "la", "las", "los", "del", "para", "que", "en", "con", "por", "una", "su",
        )
        val WORD = Regex("\\p{L}+")
    }
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/SemanticContracts.kt

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalTime

/** Rule set version of the semantic layer; bump on any behavioural change of rules or grammars. */
const val SEMANTIC_RULE_SET_VERSION = "1.0.0"

/** Word confidence below this value always requires showing the image crop (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.9). */
const val LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.8f

enum class SemanticLanguage { RU, ES }

/** Half-open range in UTF-16 code units of [CanonicalPage.text]. */
data class TextRange(val start: Int, val endExclusive: Int) {
    init { require(start in 0..endExclusive) { "Invalid range $start..$endExclusive" } }
    val length: Int get() = endExclusive - start
    fun overlaps(other: TextRange): Boolean = start < other.endExclusive && other.start < endExclusive
    fun contains(other: TextRange): Boolean = start <= other.start && other.endExclusive <= endExclusive
    fun substring(text: String): String = text.substring(start, endExclusive)
}

/** One OCR word placed in the canonical text. */
data class CanonicalWord(val range: TextRange, val box: NormalizedBox, val confidence: Float)

/**
 * One visual row of the page. Cells that came from different OCR blocks are joined with [CELL_SEPARATOR];
 * [range] excludes the trailing line break.
 */
data class CanonicalLine(val range: TextRange)

/**
 * Immutable canonical text of one page. Lines are joined with '\n', words inside a cell with one space,
 * cells of one visual row with [CELL_SEPARATOR]. Word text is copied from OCR unchanged.
 */
data class CanonicalPage(
    val pageIndex: Int,
    val text: String,
    val lines: List<CanonicalLine>,
    val words: List<CanonicalWord>,
    val language: SemanticLanguage?,
) {
    fun lineOf(range: TextRange): CanonicalLine? = lines.firstOrNull { it.range.contains(range) }
    companion object { const val CELL_SEPARATOR = " | " }
}

fun interface CanonicalTextBuilder {
    fun build(pageIndex: Int, layout: RecognitionLayout): CanonicalPage
}

fun interface LanguageDetector {
    /** Returns null when the text is neither Russian nor Spanish: the layer stays silent. */
    fun detect(text: String): SemanticLanguage?
}

sealed interface CandidateValue

/** [year] is null when no year is printed next to the date. */
data class DateValue(val day: Int, val month: Int, val year: Int?) : CandidateValue {
    init { require(month in 1..12 && day in 1..31) { "Invalid date $day.$month" } }
}

data class TimeValue(val hour: Int, val minute: Int) : CandidateValue {
    init { require(hour in 0..23 && minute in 0..59) { "Invalid time $hour:$minute" } }
}

enum class CandidateFlag {
    /** A look-alike character was replaced by a digit inside this candidate. */
    HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION,
    /** Start of a printed time range ("de 9 a 14 h", "с 9 до 14"). */
    TIME_RANGE_START,
}

/** What a grammar found in plain text. Grammars know nothing about layout. */
data class GrammarMatch(val range: TextRange, val value: CandidateValue, val flags: Set<CandidateFlag> = emptySet())

interface DateTimeGrammar {
    val language: SemanticLanguage
    /** Non-overlapping matches ordered by range start. Never guesses: an ambiguous fragment yields no match. */
    fun find(text: String): List<GrammarMatch>
}

/** A grammar match bound to the page: the only source of date and time values in the layer. */
data class Candidate(
    val id: Int,
    val pageIndex: Int,
    val range: TextRange,
    val raw: String,
    val value: CandidateValue,
    val box: NormalizedBox?,
    val minConfidence: Float,
    val flags: Set<CandidateFlag>,
) {
    /** The value must not be filled in without the user checking the image crop. */
    val needsCropConfirmation: Boolean
        get() = CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION in flags || minConfidence < LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
}

fun interface CandidateExtractor {
    /** Ids are unique within the page and start at 0. */
    fun extract(page: CanonicalPage, grammar: DateTimeGrammar): List<Candidate>
}

enum class EventStatus { CONFIRMED, RESCHEDULED, TENTATIVE, CANCELLED, MENTIONED, UNKNOWN }

enum class CandidateRole { APPOINTMENT_START, OLD_START, NEW_START, DUE_DATE, ISSUE_DATE, BIRTH_DATE, OTHER, NO_ANSWER }

enum class EventKind { APPOINTMENT, DEADLINE }

/**
 * One event found on a page.
 * [dateCandidateId] is null when several dates are equally plausible; then [dateOptions] lists them.
 * [timeCandidateId] is null for a deadline or when the time is ambiguous ([timeOptions] non-empty).
 */
data class PageEvent(
    val kind: EventKind,
    val status: EventStatus,
    val dateCandidateId: Int?,
    val dateOptions: List<Int>,
    val timeCandidateId: Int?,
    val timeOptions: List<Int>,
    /** Line that anchors the event (keyword line); used for the title. */
    val anchorLine: TextRange,
)

data class PageAnalysis(
    val page: CanonicalPage,
    val candidates: List<Candidate>,
    val roles: Map<Int, CandidateRole>,
    val events: List<PageEvent>,
)

fun interface PageEventRules {
    /** Assigns roles and status, pairs dates with times. Requires [CanonicalPage.language] to be non-null. */
    fun analyze(page: CanonicalPage, candidates: List<Candidate>): PageAnalysis
}

fun interface TitleBuilder {
    /** Title built from document words by a template, 1..500 characters, no free text. */
    fun build(page: CanonicalPage, event: PageEvent, candidates: List<Candidate>): String
}

/** Result of docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.4. */
sealed interface YearResolution {
    /** [inferred] is false only when the year is printed next to the date. */
    data class Resolved(val date: LocalDate, val inferred: Boolean) : YearResolution
    /** The date falls before the anchor date: the user chooses. */
    data class Choice(val options: List<LocalDate>) : YearResolution
    /** The date does not exist in any plausible year (e.g. 31.02). */
    data object Invalid : YearResolution
}

fun interface YearResolver {
    fun resolve(value: DateValue, documentDate: LocalDate?, scanDate: LocalDate): YearResolution
}

enum class ProposalKind { EVENT, TASK }

enum class ProposalState {
    /** All required fields passed the checks. */
    FILLED,
    /** Several plausible dates, times or years: the user picks. */
    NEEDS_CHOICE,
    /** A required field needs confirmation against the image crop. */
    LOW_QUALITY,
    /** Tentative event or unclear marker scope: nothing is prefilled. */
    EMPTY,
}

/** Where a field value came from; one entry per page that mentions it. */
data class FieldSource(
    val pageIndex: Int,
    val range: TextRange,
    val box: NormalizedBox?,
    val raw: String,
    val needsCropConfirmation: Boolean,
)

data class DateOption(val date: LocalDate, val yearInferred: Boolean, val sources: List<FieldSource>)
data class TimeOption(val time: LocalTime, val sources: List<FieldSource>)

/**
 * A suggestion for the FamilyTodoList save form. Nothing is created without the user's tap.
 * [date]/[time] are non-null only when the value may be prefilled; otherwise the options lists are used.
 */
data class Proposal(
    val kind: ProposalKind,
    val state: ProposalState,
    val status: EventStatus,
    val title: String,
    val date: DateOption?,
    val dateOptions: List<DateOption>,
    val time: TimeOption?,
    val timeOptions: List<TimeOption>,
)

fun interface DocumentAssembler {
    /** Validation, year resolution, cross-page aggregation and policy (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.4, §4.7, §4.8). */
    fun assemble(pages: List<PageAnalysis>, titles: (PageAnalysis, PageEvent) -> String, scanDate: LocalDate): List<Proposal>
}

/**
 * Look-alike character to digit replacement, allowed only inside a numeric candidate
 * (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.3). Never replaces a digit with another digit.
 */
object DigitConfusion {
    private val common = mapOf('O' to '0', 'o' to '0', 'l' to '1', 'I' to '1', '|' to '1', 'S' to '5', 's' to '5', 'b' to '6', 'B' to '8')
    private val russianOnly = mapOf(
        'О' to '0', 'о' to '0', 'З' to '3', 'з' to '3', 'Б' to '6', 'б' to '6', 'Ь' to '6',
        'В' to '8', 'І' to '1', 'і' to '1', 'Ч' to '4',
    )

    data class Result(val digits: String, val substituted: Boolean)

    fun isLookAlike(char: Char, language: SemanticLanguage): Boolean =
        char in common || (language == SemanticLanguage.RU && char in russianOnly)

    /**
     * Converts one numeric group to digits. Returns null when the group is empty, contains a character that is
     * neither a digit nor a look-alike for [language], or has no real digit at all.
     */
    fun normalizeGroup(group: String, language: SemanticLanguage): Result? {
        if (group.isEmpty() || group.none { it in '0'..'9' }) return null
        val out = StringBuilder(group.length)
        var substituted = false
        for (char in group) {
            if (char in '0'..'9') { out.append(char); continue }
            val digit = common[char] ?: if (language == SemanticLanguage.RU) russianOnly[char] else null
            out.append(digit ?: return null)
            substituted = true
        }
        return Result(out.toString(), substituted)
    }
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/SemanticEngine.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import java.time.LocalDate

/**
 * The whole semantic layer over OCR (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md): pages selected for saving in,
 * suggestions for the FamilyTodoList save form out. Pure and deterministic; makes no network calls.
 */
class SemanticEngine(
    private val textBuilder: CanonicalTextBuilder,
    private val extractor: CandidateExtractor,
    private val grammars: Map<SemanticLanguage, DateTimeGrammar>,
    private val rules: PageEventRules,
    private val titleBuilder: TitleBuilder,
    private val assembler: DocumentAssembler,
) {
    /**
     * [layouts] are the OCR results of the selected pages in document order; a null entry is a page
     * without OCR and is skipped. Pages that are neither Russian nor Spanish yield nothing.
     */
    fun analyze(layouts: List<RecognitionLayout?>, scanDate: LocalDate): List<Proposal> {
        val pages = layouts.mapIndexedNotNull { index, layout ->
            if (layout == null) return@mapIndexedNotNull null
            val page = textBuilder.build(index, layout.withoutBrokenWords())
            val grammar = page.language?.let(grammars::get) ?: return@mapIndexedNotNull null
            rules.analyze(page, extractor.extract(page, grammar))
        }
        if (pages.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return assembler.assemble(pages, { analysis, event -> titleBuilder.build(analysis.page, event, analysis.candidates) }, scanDate)
    }

    companion object {
        fun default(): SemanticEngine = SemanticEngine(
            textBuilder = LayoutCanonicalTextBuilder(ScriptLanguageDetector()),
            extractor = PageCandidateExtractor(),
            grammars = listOf(RussianDateTimeGrammar(), SpanishDateTimeGrammar()).associateBy { it.language },
            rules = KeywordPageEventRules(),
            titleBuilder = TemplateTitleBuilder(),
            assembler = RuleDocumentAssembler(AnchorYearResolver()),
        )

        /** A word with a line break inside would break the "one line = one range" invariant of the canonical text. */
        private fun RecognitionLayout.withoutBrokenWords(): RecognitionLayout = copy(
            blocks = blocks.map { block ->
                block.copy(paragraphs = block.paragraphs.map { paragraph ->
                    paragraph.copy(lines = paragraph.lines.map { line ->
                        line.copy(words = line.words.filter { word -> word.text.none { it == '\n' || it == '\r' } })
                    })
                })
            },
        )
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/SpanishDateTimeGrammar.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import java.text.Normalizer
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.Month
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.regex.Matcher
import java.util.regex.Pattern

/**
 * Spanish dates and times (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.3).
 *
 * Works on the original text; ranges are UTF-16 offsets into it. Never guesses: impossible values,
 * numbers that only look like dates (phones, amounts, ids) and ambiguous fragments produce no match.
 *
 * Range decisions (pinned by tests):
 * - a date covers day..month or day..year, without weekday, without "de" before the day and without a trailing dot;
 * - a time covers the digits and an attached "h/hs/hrs/horas" or "a.m./p.m." suffix; "a las" is never covered;
 * - "a mediodía" is covered as "mediodía";
 * - a printed range ("de 9 a 14 h", "9:00-14:00") returns only the start time, covering the start token only.
 */
class SpanishDateTimeGrammar : DateTimeGrammar {
    override val language: SemanticLanguage = SemanticLanguage.ES

    override fun find(text: String): List<GrammarMatch> {
        if (text.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val all = ArrayList<Cand>()
        findNamedMonthDates(text, all)
        findNumericDates(text, all)
        findTimeRanges(text, all)
        findTimes(text, all)
        findNoon(text, all)
        all.sortWith(compareBy<Cand>({ it.cover.start }, { -it.cover.length }))
        val result = ArrayList<GrammarMatch>()
        var lastEnd = 0
        for (cand in all) {
            if (cand.cover.start < lastEnd) continue
            lastEnd = cand.cover.endExclusive
            val value = cand.value ?: continue
            result += GrammarMatch(cand.range, value, cand.flags)
        }
        return result
    }

    /** [value] == null marks a blocker: an ambiguous fragment that must also hide the times inside it. */
    private class Cand(val range: TextRange, val cover: TextRange, val value: CandidateValue?, val flags: Set<CandidateFlag>)

    private class TimeTok(
        val start: Int,
        val end: Int,
        val value: TimeValue,
        val substituted: Boolean,
        val minuteSep: Char?,
        val meridiem: Boolean,
        val hourSuffix: String?,
    ) {
        val hasMinutes: Boolean get() = minuteSep != null
    }

    // ---------- named-month dates ----------

    private fun findNamedMonthDates(text: String, out: MutableList<Cand>) {
        val m = NAMED_DATE.matcher(text)
        var from = 0
        while (from <= text.length && m.find(from)) {
            val start = m.start()
            from = start + 1
            val cand = namedDate(text, m) ?: continue
            out += cand
            from = m.end()
        }
    }

    private fun namedDate(text: String, m: Matcher): Cand? {
        val dayRaw = m.group("d")
        // "1o de mayo" is an ordinal typed with a letter, not 10: ambiguous.
        if (dayRaw.length == 2 && dayRaw[0] in '0'..'9' && dayRaw[1] == 'o') return null
        val month = MONTHS[foldWord(m.group("mon"))] ?: return null
        val day = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(dayRaw, SemanticLanguage.ES) ?: return null
        var substituted = day.substituted
        var year: Int? = null
        if (m.group("y") != null) {
            val y = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(m.group("y"), SemanticLanguage.ES) ?: return null
            substituted = substituted || y.substituted
            year = y.digits.toInt()
            if (year !in YEAR_MIN..YEAR_MAX) return null
        }
        val value = buildDate(day.digits.toInt(), month, year) ?: return null
        val end = if (year != null) m.end("y") else m.end("mon")
        // A number that follows the month but is not a valid year ("de noviembre 20267") makes the date ambiguous.
        if (year == null && STRAY_NUMBER.matcher(text).region(end, text.length).also { it.useTransparentBounds(true) }.lookingAt()) {
            return null
        }
        if (!edgeOk(text, m.start(), end)) return null
        val range = TextRange(m.start(), end)
        return Cand(range, range, value, flagsOf(substituted))
    }

    // ---------- numeric dates ----------

    private fun findNumericDates(text: String, out: MutableList<Cand>) {
        val m = NUMERIC_DATE.matcher(text)
        var from = 0
        while (from <= text.length && m.find(from)) {
            val start = m.start()
            from = start + 1
            val cand = numericDate(text, m) ?: continue
            out += cand
            from = m.end()
        }
    }

    private fun numericDate(text: String, m: Matcher): Cand? {
        val d = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(m.group("d"), SemanticLanguage.ES) ?: return null
        val mo = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(m.group("m"), SemanticLanguage.ES) ?: return null
        val y = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(m.group("y"), SemanticLanguage.ES) ?: return null
        // A two-digit year is accepted only in the dd/mm/yy form: "12-10-20" and "10.12.30" are usually numbers.
        if (y.digits.length == 2 && '/' !in text.substring(m.start(), m.end())) return null
        val year = if (y.digits.length == 2) 2000 + y.digits.toInt() else y.digits.toInt()
        if (year !in YEAR_MIN..YEAR_MAX) return null
        val value = buildDate(d.digits.toInt(), mo.digits.toInt(), year) ?: return null
        if (!edgeOk(text, m.start(), m.end())) return null
        val range = TextRange(m.start(), m.end())
        return Cand(range, range, value, flagsOf(d.substituted || mo.substituted || y.substituted))
    }

    private fun buildDate(day: Int, month: Int, year: Int?): DateValue? {
        if (month !in 1..12 || day !in 1..31) return null
        val maxDay = if (year != null) {
            LocalDate.of(year, month, 1).lengthOfMonth()
        } else {
            Month.of(month).maxLength()
        }
        if (day > maxDay) return null
        return DateValue(day, month, year)
    }

    // ---------- times ----------

    private fun findTimes(text: String, out: MutableList<Cand>) {
        val m = TIME.matcher(text)
        var from = 0
        while (from <= text.length && m.find(from)) {
            val start = m.start()
            from = start + 1
            val tok = toTok(m) ?: continue
            if (!edgeOk(text, tok.start, tok.end)) continue
            if (AMBIGUOUS_TAIL.matcher(text).region(tok.end, text.length).also { it.useTransparentBounds(true) }.lookingAt()) continue
            if (!isTimeContext(text, tok)) continue
            out += Cand(TextRange(tok.start, tok.end), TextRange(tok.start, tok.end), tok.value, flagsOf(tok.substituted))
            from = tok.end
        }
    }

    private fun isTimeContext(text: String, tok: TimeTok): Boolean {
        if (tok.meridiem) return true
        if (tok.hasMinutes && tok.minuteSep == ':') return true
        val prefixed = matchesBefore(PREFIX, text, tok.start)
        if (tok.hasMinutes) return tok.hourSuffix != null || prefixed
        if (prefixed) return true
        val suffix = tok.hourSuffix?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return false
        if (suffix == "horas") return false
        return !matchesBefore(DURATION_WORD, text, tok.start)
    }

    private fun matchesBefore(pattern: Pattern, text: String, position: Int): Boolean {
        val from = maxOf(0, position - 24)
        val matcher = pattern.matcher(text).region(from, position)
        matcher.useTransparentBounds(true)
        return matcher.find()
    }

    private fun findTimeRanges(text: String, out: MutableList<Cand>) {
        val head = RANGE_HEAD.matcher(text)
        var from = 0
        while (from <= text.length && head.find(from)) {
            from = head.start() + 1
            val tok1 = parseTokAt(text, head.end()) ?: continue
            val mid = MID.matcher(text).region(tok1.end, text.length)
            mid.useTransparentBounds(true)
            if (!mid.lookingAt()) continue
            val tok2 = parseTokAt(text, mid.end()) ?: continue
            val cover = TextRange(tok1.start, tok2.end)
            val marker2 = tok2.meridiem || tok2.hourSuffix != null || tok2.minuteSep == ':' || tok1.minuteSep == ':'
            if (!marker2) continue
            if (!edgeOk(text, cover.start, cover.endExclusive)) continue
            val tail = AMBIGUOUS_TAIL.matcher(text).region(tok2.end, text.length)
            tail.useTransparentBounds(true)
            val ambiguous = tok1.meridiem != tok2.meridiem || tail.lookingAt()
            if (ambiguous) {
                out += Cand(cover, cover, null, emptySet())
            } else {
                out += rangeCand(tok1, cover)
            }
        }
        val colon = TIME.matcher(text)
        from = 0
        while (from <= text.length && colon.find(from)) {
            from = colon.start() + 1
            val tok1 = toTok(colon) ?: continue
            if (tok1.minuteSep != ':') continue
            val hyphen = HYPHEN.matcher(text).region(tok1.end, text.length)
            hyphen.useTransparentBounds(true)
            if (!hyphen.lookingAt()) continue
            val tok2 = parseTokAt(text, hyphen.end()) ?: continue
            if (tok2.minuteSep != ':' || tok1.meridiem != tok2.meridiem) continue
            val cover = TextRange(tok1.start, tok2.end)
            if (!edgeOk(text, cover.start, cover.endExclusive)) continue
            val tail = AMBIGUOUS_TAIL.matcher(text).region(tok2.end, text.length)
            tail.useTransparentBounds(true)
            if (tail.lookingAt()) continue
            out += rangeCand(tok1, cover)
            from = tok2.end
        }
    }

    private fun rangeCand(start: TimeTok, cover: TextRange): Cand = Cand(
        TextRange(start.start, start.end),
        cover,
        start.value,
        buildSet {
            add(CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START)
            if (start.substituted) add(CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION)
        },
    )

    private fun parseTokAt(text: String, position: Int): TimeTok? {
        val m = TIME.matcher(text).region(position, text.length)
        m.useTransparentBounds(true)
        m.useAnchoringBounds(false)
        if (!m.lookingAt()) return null
        return toTok(m)
    }

    private fun toTok(m: Matcher): TimeTok? {
        val hour = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(m.group("h"), SemanticLanguage.ES) ?: return null
        var substituted = hour.substituted
        var hourValue = hour.digits.toInt()
        var minuteValue = 0
        var sep: Char? = null
        val minuteRaw = m.group("m")
        if (minuteRaw != null) {
            val minute = DigitConfusion.normalizeGroup(minuteRaw, SemanticLanguage.ES) ?: return null
            substituted = substituted || minute.substituted
            minuteValue = minute.digits.toInt()
            sep = m.group("sep")[0]
        }
        val mer = m.group("mer")
        if (mer != null) {
            if (hourValue !in 1..12) return null
            val pm = mer[0] == 'p' || mer[0] == 'P'
            hourValue = hourValue % 12 + if (pm) 12 else 0
        }
        if (hourValue !in 0..23 || minuteValue !in 0..59) return null
        return TimeTok(m.start(), m.end(), TimeValue(hourValue, minuteValue), substituted, sep, mer != null, m.group("hs"))
    }

    private fun findNoon(text: String, out: MutableList<Cand>) {
        val m = NOON.matcher(text)
        var from = 0
        while (from <= text.length && m.find(from)) {
            from = m.start() + 1
            val start = m.start("w")
            val end = m.end("w")
            if (!edgeOk(text, m.start(), end)) continue
            val range = TextRange(start, end)
            out += Cand(range, range, TimeValue(12, 0), emptySet())
            from = end
        }
    }

    // ---------- shared ----------

    private fun flagsOf(substituted: Boolean): Set<CandidateFlag> =
        if (substituted) setOf(CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION) else emptySet()

    /** The candidate must not be a fragment of a longer word or number. */
    private fun edgeOk(text: String, start: Int, end: Int): Boolean {
        if (start > 0) {
            val c = text[start - 1]
            if (c.isLetterOrDigit()) return false
            if (c in NUMBER_JOINERS && start >= 2 && text[start - 2].isDigit()) return false
        }
        if (end < text.length) {
            val c = text[end]
            if (c.isLetterOrDigit()) return false
            if (c in NUMBER_JOINERS && end + 1 < text.length && text[end + 1].isDigit()) return false
            if (c == '-' && end + 1 < text.length && text[end + 1].isDigit()) {
                // "12-05-2026-001" is a document number; "9:00-14:00" and "18/11/2026-20/11/2026" are ranges.
                val tail = DATE_TAIL.matcher(text).region(end + 1, text.length)
                if (!tail.lookingAt()) return false
            }
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun foldWord(word: String): String =
        Normalizer.normalize(word, Normalizer.Form.NFD).filter { Character.getType(it) != Character.NON_SPACING_MARK.toInt() }
            .lowercase(Locale.ROOT)

    private companion object {
        const val YEAR_MIN = 1900
        const val YEAR_MAX = 2099
        const val G = "[0-9OolI|SsbB]"
        const val SP = "[ \u00A0\t]"
        const val NUMBER_JOINERS = ".,/:"

        val MONTHS: Map<String, Int> = buildMap {
            val full = listOf(
                "enero", "febrero", "marzo", "abril", "mayo", "junio",
                "julio", "agosto", "septiembre", "octubre", "noviembre", "diciembre",
            )
            full.forEachIndexed { i, name -> put(name, i + 1) }
            put("setiembre", 9)
            listOf("ene", "feb", "mar", "abr", "may", "jun", "jul", "ago", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dic")
                .forEachIndexed { i, name -> put(name, i + 1) }
            put("sept", 9)
            put("set", 9)
        }

        val NAMED_DATE: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "(?iu)(?<d>${G}{1,2})(?:\\.?[º°])?${SP}+(?:de${SP}+)?(?<mon>[\\p{L}\\p{M}]{3,12})(?![\\p{L}\\p{M}])" +
                "(?:\\.?${SP}+(?:del?${SP}+)?(?<y>${G}{4})(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}]))?",
        )

        val STRAY_NUMBER: Pattern = Pattern.compile("\\.?${SP}+(?:del?${SP}+)?(?=${G}*[0-9])${G}{3,}")

        val NUMERIC_DATE: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "(?<d>${G}{1,2})(?<s>[/.\\-])(?<m>${G}{1,2})\\k<s>(?<y>${G}{4}|${G}{2})",
        )

        val TIME: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "(?iu)(?<h>${G}{1,2})(?:(?<sep>[:.])(?<m>${G}{2}))?" +
                "(?:${SP}*(?:(?<mer>[ap]\\.${SP}?m\\.?|[ap]m)|(?<hs>horas|hrs|hs|h))(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}]))?",
        )

        val PREFIX: Pattern = Pattern.compile("(?iu)(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])(?:a|desde|hasta|para)${SP}+las?${SP}+\\z")

        val DURATION_WORD: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "(?iu)(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])(?:duraci[oó]n:?|estimad[oa]s?:?|durante|cada|unas|unos|aprox\\.?|aproximadamente|cerca de|m[aá]s de|menos de|" +
                "dentro de|m[ií]nimo|m[aá]ximo|por|en|hasta)${SP}+\\z",
        )

        val AMBIGUOUS_TAIL: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "(?iu)${SP}+(?:y${SP}+(?:media|cuarto)|menos|(?:de|por|en)${SP}+la${SP}+(?:ma[ñn]ana|tarde|noche|madrugada))(?![\\p{L}])",
        )

        val RANGE_HEAD: Pattern = Pattern.compile("(?iu)(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])de${SP}+(?:las?${SP}+)?(?=${G})")
        val MID: Pattern = Pattern.compile("(?iu)${SP}+a${SP}+(?:las?${SP}+)?")
        val HYPHEN: Pattern = Pattern.compile("${SP}*[\\-\u2013]${SP}*")
        val DATE_TAIL: Pattern = Pattern.compile("\\d{1,2}[/.:\\-]\\d")

        val NOON: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
            "(?iu)(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])(?:a|al)${SP}+(?<w>mediod(?:[i\u00ED]|i\u0301)a)(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}])",
        )
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.semantic

/**
 * Builds an event title from the words of the anchor line (docs/SEMANTIC_LAYER_SPEC.md §4.9).
 * Only document words are used; the only fixed words are the fallback titles.
 */
class TemplateTitleBuilder : TitleBuilder {

    override fun build(page: CanonicalPage, event: PageEvent, candidates: List<Candidate>): String {
        val anchor = event.anchorLine
        val line = anchor.substring(page.text)
        val cuts = candidates
            .map { it.range }
            .filter { anchor.contains(it) && it.length > 0 }
            .sortedBy { it.start }
        val cleaned = clean(cutCandidates(line, anchor.start, cuts))
        if (cleaned.length < MIN_TITLE_LENGTH) return fallback(page.language, event.kind)
        return truncate(cleaned)
    }

    /** Replaces every candidate range inside the line with [SENTINEL]. */
    private fun cutCandidates(line: String, lineStart: Int, cuts: List<TextRange>): String {
        val out = StringBuilder(line.length)
        var cursor = 0
        for (cut in cuts) {
            val start = cut.start - lineStart
            val end = cut.endExclusive - lineStart
            if (start < cursor) {
                cursor = maxOf(cursor, end)
                continue
            }
            out.append(line, cursor, start)
            out.append(SENTINEL)
            cursor = end
        }
        out.append(line, cursor, line.length)
        return out.toString()
    }

    private fun clean(raw: String): String {
        val padded = raw
            .replace(CanonicalPage.CELL_SEPARATOR, ", ")
            .replace(SENTINEL.toString(), " $SENTINEL ")
        val tokens = padded.split(WHITESPACE).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.toMutableList()

        // Drop service words at the edges of the title and next to cut-out fragments; repeat until stable,
        // because removing one word can expose the next one.
        var changed = true
        while (changed) {
            changed = false
            var i = 0
            while (i < tokens.size) {
                val token = tokens[i]
                if (token != SENTINEL_TOKEN && isServiceWord(token) &&
                    (i == tokens.lastIndex || (i > 0 && tokens[i - 1] == SENTINEL_TOKEN) || tokens[i + 1] == SENTINEL_TOKEN)
                ) {
                    tokens.removeAt(i)
                    changed = true
                } else {
                    i++
                }
            }
        }

        return tokens
            .filter { it != SENTINEL_TOKEN }
            .joinToString(" ")
            .replace(WHITESPACE, " ")
            .replace(SPACE_BEFORE_PUNCTUATION, "$1")
            .trim { it.isWhitespace() || it in EDGE_PUNCTUATION }
    }

    private fun isServiceWord(token: String): Boolean =
        token.trim { it in EDGE_PUNCTUATION }.lowercase() in SERVICE_WORDS

    private fun truncate(title: String): String {
        if (title.length <= MAX_TITLE_LENGTH) return title
        var end = MAX_TITLE_LENGTH
        // Do not split a surrogate pair.
        if (Character.isHighSurrogate(title[end - 1])) end--
        return title.substring(0, end).trimEnd { it.isWhitespace() || it in EDGE_PUNCTUATION }
    }

    private fun fallback(language: SemanticLanguage?, kind: EventKind): String = when (language) {
        SemanticLanguage.RU -> if (kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT) "Приём" else "Срок"
        SemanticLanguage.ES -> if (kind == EventKind.APPOINTMENT) "Cita" else "Plazo"
        null -> "Событие"
    }

    private companion object {
        const val SENTINEL = '\u0001'
        const val SENTINEL_TOKEN = "\u0001"
        const val MIN_TITLE_LENGTH = 3
        const val MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 500
        const val EDGE_PUNCTUATION = ".,:;-–"
        val WHITESPACE = Regex("\\s+")
        val SPACE_BEFORE_PUNCTUATION = Regex("\\s+([,.:;])")

        val SERVICE_WORDS = setOf(
            // Russian
            "в", "на", "к", "до", "с", "г", "года", "ч", "час", "мин",
            // Spanish
            "a", "las", "la", "el", "día", "de", "del", "h", "horas", "hora",
        )
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.store

/** Reversible text-layer reuse heuristic from ENG-PDF-IMPORT-01; FACT-07 still gates acceptance. */
object PdfTextLayerPolicy {
    const val MIN_NON_WHITESPACE_CHARACTERS = 20
    const val MIN_LATIN_CYRILLIC_ALNUM_PERCENT = 70

    fun isReusable(text: String): Boolean {
        val visible = text.filterNot(Char::isWhitespace)
        if (visible.length < MIN_NON_WHITESPACE_CHARACTERS) return false
        val supported = visible.count(::isLatinCyrillicLetterOrDigit)
        return supported * 100 >= visible.length * MIN_LATIN_CYRILLIC_ALNUM_PERCENT
    }

    private fun isLatinCyrillicLetterOrDigit(char: Char): Boolean =
        char in '0'..'9'
            || char in 'A'..'Z'
            || char in 'a'..'z'
            || char in '\u0400'..'\u052F'
            || char in '\u1C80'..'\u1C8A'
            || char in '\uA640'..'\uA69F'
}

package app.docscan.core.store

data class RecognitionLayout(
    val sourceWidthPx: Int,
    val sourceHeightPx: Int,
    val blocks: List<OcrBlock>,
    val languageHints: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val quality: LayoutQuality? = null,
    val formatVersion: Int = 2,
    val plainText: String? = null,
) {
    fun toLegacyGeometry(): RecognitionGeometry {
        val allWords = blocks
            .sortedBy { it.readingOrder }
            .flatMap { it.paragraphs.flatMap { par -> par.lines.flatMap { line -> line.words } } }
            .map { word ->
                val leftPx = (word.box.left * sourceWidthPx).toLong().coerceIn(0L, maxOf(0L, sourceWidthPx.toLong() - 1L))
                val topPx = (word.box.top * sourceHeightPx).toLong().coerceIn(0L, maxOf(0L, sourceHeightPx.toLong() - 1L))
                val rightPx = kotlin.math.ceil(word.box.right * sourceWidthPx).toLong().coerceIn(leftPx + 1L, maxOf(leftPx + 1L, sourceWidthPx.toLong()))
                val bottomPx = kotlin.math.ceil(word.box.bottom * sourceHeightPx).toLong().coerceIn(topPx + 1L, maxOf(topPx + 1L, sourceHeightPx.toLong()))
                RecognizedWord(
                    text = word.text,
                    leftPx = leftPx,
                    topPx = topPx,
                    rightPx = rightPx,
                    bottomPx = bottomPx,
                    confidence = word.confidence.toDouble(),
                )
            }
        return RecognitionGeometry(
            sourceWidthPx = sourceWidthPx.toLong(),
            sourceHeightPx = sourceHeightPx.toLong(),
            coordinateSpace = OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE,
            words = allWords,
            formatVersion = 1L,
        )
    }

    fun toPlainText(): String {
        if (!plainText.isNullOrBlank()) return plainText
        val structuralText = blocks
            .sortedBy { it.readingOrder }
            .mapNotNull { block ->
                val blockText = block.paragraphs
                    .mapNotNull { paragraph ->
                        val parText = paragraph.lines
                            .map { line -> line.words.joinToString(" ") { it.text } }
                            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
                            .joinToString("\n")
                        if (parText.isBlank()) null else parText
                    }
                    .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
                    .joinToString("\n\n")
                if (blockText.isBlank()) null else blockText
            }
            .joinToString("\n\n")
        val hasWords = blocks.any { block ->
            block.paragraphs.any { paragraph -> paragraph.lines.any { it.words.isNotEmpty() } }
        }
        return if (hasWords) structuralText else plainText.orEmpty()
    }
}

data class OcrBlock(
    val id: String,
    val type: BlockType,
    val box: NormalizedBox,
    val readingOrder: Int,
    val paragraphs: List<OcrParagraph>,
) {
    val lines: List<OcrLine> get() = paragraphs.flatMap { it.lines }
}

data class OcrParagraph(
    val box: NormalizedBox,
    val lines: List<OcrLine>,
)

data class OcrLine(
    val box: NormalizedBox,
    val baseline: Baseline?,
    val xHeight: Float?,
    val words: List<OcrWord>,
)

data class OcrWord(
    val text: String,
    val box: NormalizedBox,
    val confidence: Float,
)

data class NormalizedBox(
    val left: Float,
    val top: Float,
    val right: Float,
    val bottom: Float,
) {
    init {
        require(left in 0f..1f && top in 0f..1f && right in 0f..1f && bottom in 0f..1f) {
            "Normalized box coordinates must be in [0, 1]: $this"
        }
        require(right >= left && bottom >= top) {
            "Normalized box inverted: right ($right) < left ($left) or bottom ($bottom) < top ($top)"
        }
    }

    val width: Float get() = (right - left).coerceAtLeast(0f)
    val height: Float get() = (bottom - top).coerceAtLeast(0f)
}

data class Baseline(
    val slope: Float = 0f,
    val intercept: Float = 0f,
)

data class LayoutQuality(
    val meanConfidence: Float,
    val lowConfidenceWordCount: Int,
    val structureAvailable: Boolean,
    val language: String? = null,
    val preprocessingProfile: String = "DEFAULT",
    val engineVersion: String = "UNKNOWN",
)

enum class BlockType {
    TEXT,
    TITLE,
    PARAGRAPH,
    LIST,
    TABLE,
    HEADER,
    FOOTER,
    CAPTION,
    FIGURE,
    UNKNOWN,
}

fun normalizeBox(
    leftPx: Long,
    topPx: Long,
    rightPx: Long,
    bottomPx: Long,
    widthPx: Int,
    heightPx: Int,
): NormalizedBox? {
    if (widthPx <= 0 || heightPx <= 0) return null
    val l = leftPx.coerceIn(0L, widthPx.toLong())
    val t = topPx.coerceIn(0L, heightPx.toLong())
    val r = rightPx.coerceIn(0L, widthPx.toLong())
    val b = bottomPx.coerceIn(0L, heightPx.toLong())
    if (r <= l || b <= t) return null
    val left = (l.toFloat() / widthPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val top = (t.toFloat() / heightPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val right = (r.toFloat() / widthPx).coerceIn(left, 1f)
    val bottom = (b.toFloat() / heightPx).coerceIn(top, 1f)
    if (right <= left || bottom <= top) return null
    return NormalizedBox(left, top, right, bottom)
}

fun sanitizeOcrText(raw: String): String = app.docscan.core.ocr.sanitizeOcrText(raw)

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/store/RecognitionPayloadCodec.kt

package app.docscan.core.store

import app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrBlock as CoreOcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLine as CoreOcrLine
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrPara as CoreOcrPara
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrWord as CoreOcrWord
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toOcrLayout
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toPlainText
import app.docscan.core.ocr.toRecognitionLayout
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.Base64

data class DecodedRecognitionPayload(
    val text: String,
    val geometry: RecognitionGeometry?,
    val layout: RecognitionLayout? = null,
    val ocrLayout: OcrLayout? = null,
)

/** Backward-compatible envelope stored in the existing Recognition.payload column. */
object RecognitionPayloadCodec {
    private const val MAGIC_V1 = "DOCSCAN-OCR-GEOMETRY/1"
    private const val MAGIC_V2 = "DOCSCAN-OCR-LAYOUT/2"
    private const val HEAD2 = "DOCSCAN-OCR-LAYOUT/2\n"
    private val encoder = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding()
    private val decoder = Base64.getUrlDecoder()

    private fun bx(b: Bx) = JSONArray().put(b.l).put(b.t).put(b.r).put(b.b)
    private fun unbx(a: JSONArray) = Bx(a.getInt(0), a.getInt(1), a.getInt(2), a.getInt(3))

    fun encodeLayout(l: OcrLayout): String {
        val blocks = JSONArray()
        for (b in l.blocks) {
            val paras = JSONArray()
            for (p in b.paras) {
                val lines = JSONArray()
                for (ln in p.lines) {
                    val ws = JSONArray()
                    for (w in ln.words) ws.put(JSONArray()
                        .put(w.text).put(w.box.l).put(w.box.t).put(w.box.r).put(w.box.b).put(w.conf.toDouble()))
                    val lineObj = JSONObject().put("b", bx(ln.box)).put("w", ws)
                    ln.baseline?.let { lineObj.put("baseline", JSONArray().put(it.slope.toDouble()).put(it.intercept.toDouble())) }
                    lines.put(lineObj)
                }
                paras.put(JSONObject().put("b", bx(p.box)).put("l", lines))
            }
            val blockObj = JSONObject().put("b", bx(b.box)).put("p", paras)
            if (b.type != null) blockObj.put("t", b.type)
            if (b.id != null) blockObj.put("id", b.id)
            blocks.put(blockObj)
        }
        val obj = JSONObject().put("w", l.sourceW).put("h", l.sourceH).put("blocks", blocks)
        obj.put("lang", l.lang ?: "")
        obj.put("plainText", l.plainText ?: JSONObject.NULL)
        obj.put("languageHints", JSONArray().apply { l.languageHints.sorted().forEach(::put) })
        l.quality?.let { quality ->
            obj.put("quality", JSONObject()
                .put("meanConfidence", quality.meanConfidence.toDouble())
                .put("lowConfidenceWordCount", quality.lowConfidenceWordCount)
                .put("structureAvailable", quality.structureAvailable)
                .put("language", quality.language ?: JSONObject.NULL)
                .put("preprocessingProfile", quality.preprocessingProfile)
                .put("engineVersion", quality.engineVersion))
        }
        return HEAD2 + obj.toString()
    }

    fun decodeLayout(payload: String): OcrLayout {
        val o = JSONObject(payload.removePrefix(HEAD2))
        val blocks = (0 until o.getJSONArray("blocks").length()).map { i ->
            val b = o.getJSONArray("blocks").getJSONObject(i)
            val pa = b.getJSONArray("p")
            val bType = b.optString("t", "").ifEmpty { null }
            val bId = b.optString("id", "").ifEmpty { null }
            CoreOcrBlock(
                box = unbx(b.getJSONArray("b")),
                paras = (0 until pa.length()).map { j ->
                    val p = pa.getJSONObject(j); val la = p.getJSONArray("l")
                    CoreOcrPara(unbx(p.getJSONArray("b")), (0 until la.length()).map { k ->
                        val l = la.getJSONObject(k); val wa = l.getJSONArray("w")
                        val baselineArray = l.optJSONArray("baseline")
                        val baseline = if (baselineArray != null && baselineArray.length() >= 2) {
                            Baseline(baselineArray.getDouble(0).toFloat(), baselineArray.getDouble(1).toFloat())
                        } else null
                        CoreOcrLine(unbx(l.getJSONArray("b")), (0 until wa.length()).map { m ->
                            val w = wa.getJSONArray(m)
                            CoreOcrWord(w.getString(0), Bx(w.getInt(1), w.getInt(2), w.getInt(3), w.getInt(4)), w.getDouble(5).toFloat())
                        }, baseline)
                    })
                },
                type = bType,
                id = bId,
            )
        }
        val lang = o.optString("lang", "").ifEmpty { null }
        val plainText = if (!o.has("plainText") || o.isNull("plainText")) null else o.getString("plainText")
        val hintsArray = o.optJSONArray("languageHints")
        val languageHints = if (hintsArray == null) emptySet() else
            (0 until hintsArray.length()).mapNotNull { hintsArray.optString(it).takeIf(String::isNotBlank) }.toSet()
        val qualityObj = o.optJSONObject("quality")
        val quality = qualityObj?.let { value ->
            LayoutQuality(
                meanConfidence = value.optDouble("meanConfidence", 0.0).toFloat(),
                lowConfidenceWordCount = value.optInt("lowConfidenceWordCount", 0),
                structureAvailable = value.optBoolean("structureAvailable", false),
                language = if (!value.has("language") || value.isNull("language")) null else value.optString("language"),
                preprocessingProfile = value.optString("preprocessingProfile", "DEFAULT"),
                engineVersion = value.optString("engineVersion", "UNKNOWN"),
            )
        }
        return OcrLayout(o.getInt("w"), o.getInt("h"), blocks, lang, plainText, quality, languageHints)
    }

    fun encode(text: String, layout: RecognitionLayout): String {
        val ocrLayout = layout.toOcrLayout()
        val textless = ocrLayout.words.isEmpty() && ocrLayout.plainText.isNullOrEmpty()
        return encodeLayout(if (textless) ocrLayout.copy(plainText = text) else ocrLayout)
    }

    fun encode(text: String, geometry: RecognitionGeometry): String {
        validate(geometry)
        val lines = mutableListOf(
            MAGIC_V1,
            text.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).encodeBase64(),
            listOf(
                geometry.sourceWidthPx,
                geometry.sourceHeightPx,
                geometry.coordinateSpace,
                geometry.formatVersion,
                geometry.words.size,
            ).joinToString("|"),
        )
        geometry.words.forEach { word ->
            lines += listOf(
                word.text.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).encodeBase64(),
                word.leftPx,
                word.topPx,
                word.rightPx,
                word.bottomPx,
                word.confidence,
            ).joinToString("|")
        }
        return lines.joinToString("\n")
    }

    /** Decodes V2 layout, V1 geometry, or plain legacy UTF-8 text. */
    fun decode(payload: String): DecodedRecognitionPayload {
        return when {
            payload.startsWith(HEAD2) -> {
                val body = payload.removePrefix(HEAD2).trimStart()
                if (body.startsWith("{")) {
                    val ocrLayout = decodeLayout(payload)
                    val recLayout = ocrLayout.toRecognitionLayout()
                    DecodedRecognitionPayload(
                        text = ocrLayout.toPlainText(),
                        geometry = recLayout.toLegacyGeometry(),
                        layout = recLayout,
                        ocrLayout = ocrLayout,
                    )
                } else {
                    decodeV2(payload)
                }
            }
            payload.startsWith("$MAGIC_V1\n") -> decodeV1(payload)
            else -> DecodedRecognitionPayload(payload, null, null, null)
        }
    }

    private fun decodeV2(payload: String): DecodedRecognitionPayload {
        val lines = payload.split('\n')
        require(lines.size >= 3 && lines[0] == MAGIC_V2) { "OCR layout envelope is truncated" }
        val text = lines[1].decodeBase64().toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        val header = lines[2].split('|')

        val width: Int
        val height: Int
        val version: Int
        val blockCount: Int
        val languageHints = mutableSetOf<String>()

        if (header.isNotEmpty() && header[0] == "H") {
            require(header.size >= 5) { "OCR layout header is malformed" }
            width = header[1].toInt()
            height = header[2].toInt()
            version = header[3].toInt()
            blockCount = header[4].toInt()
            if (header.size > 5 && header[5].isNotBlank()) {
                languageHints.addAll(header[5].split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() })
            }
        } else {
            require(header.size == 4) { "OCR layout header is malformed" }
            width = header[0].toInt()
            height = header[1].toInt()
            version = header[2].toInt()
            blockCount = header[3].toInt()
        }
        require(version == 2 && blockCount >= 0) { "OCR layout header parameters are invalid" }

        var lineIndex = 3
        var quality: LayoutQuality? = null
        if (lineIndex < lines.size && lines[lineIndex].startsWith("Q|")) {
            val qFields = lines[lineIndex++].split('|')
            if (qFields.size >= 7) {
                quality = LayoutQuality(
                    meanConfidence = qFields[1].toFloatOrNull() ?: 0f,
                    lowConfidenceWordCount = qFields[2].toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                    structureAvailable = qFields[3] == "1" || qFields[3].equals("true", ignoreCase = true),
                    language = qFields[4].ifBlank { null },
                    preprocessingProfile = qFields[5],
                    engineVersion = qFields[6],
                )
            }
        }

        val blocks = mutableListOf<OcrBlock>()
        for (b in 0 until blockCount) {
            require(lineIndex < lines.size) { "OCR layout envelope truncated at block $b" }
            val blockFields = lines[lineIndex++].split('|')
            require(blockFields.isNotEmpty() && blockFields[0] == "B") { "OCR layout block record is malformed" }

            val blockId: String
            val blockType: BlockType
            val blockBox: NormalizedBox
            val readingOrder: Int
            val childCount: Int

            if (blockFields.size == 9) {
                blockId = blockFields[1].decodeBase64().toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                blockType = try { BlockType.valueOf(blockFields[2]) } catch (_: Exception) { BlockType.UNKNOWN }
                blockBox = safeNormalizedBox(
                    blockFields[3].toFloat(),
                    blockFields[4].toFloat(),
                    blockFields[5].toFloat(),
                    blockFields[6].toFloat(),
                )
                readingOrder = blockFields[7].toInt()
                childCount = blockFields[8].toInt()
            } else if (blockFields.size == 8) {
                // Legacy V2 block line without Base64 id
                blockId = "block_${b + 1}"
                blockType = try { BlockType.valueOf(blockFields[1]) } catch (_: Exception) { BlockType.UNKNOWN }
                val l = blockFields[2].toFloat()
                val t = blockFields[3].toFloat()
                val r = blockFields[4].toFloat()
                val btm = blockFields[5].toFloat()
                blockBox = if (l <= 1f && t <= 1f && r <= 1f && btm <= 1f) {
                    safeNormalizedBox(l, t, r, btm)
                } else {
                    normalizeBox(l.toLong(), t.toLong(), r.toLong(), btm.toLong(), width, height)
                        ?: safeNormalizedBox(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f)
                }
                readingOrder = blockFields[6].toInt()
                childCount = blockFields[7].toInt()
            } else {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("OCR layout block record is malformed")
            }

            val paragraphs = mutableListOf<OcrParagraph>()
            // Check if next lines are paragraphs (P) or lines (L)
            if (lineIndex < lines.size && lines[lineIndex].startsWith("P|")) {
                for (p in 0 until childCount) {
                    require(lineIndex < lines.size) { "OCR layout envelope truncated at paragraph $p" }
                    val pFields = lines[lineIndex++].split('|')
                    require(pFields.size == 6 && pFields[0] == "P") { "OCR layout paragraph record is malformed" }
                    val parBox = safeNormalizedBox(
                        pFields[1].toFloat(),
                        pFields[2].toFloat(),
                        pFields[3].toFloat(),
                        pFields[4].toFloat(),
                    )
                    val lineCount = pFields[5].toInt()
                    val parLines = decodeLines(lines, lineIndex, lineCount, width, height)
                    lineIndex += countLinesOffset(lines, lineIndex, lineCount)
                    paragraphs += OcrParagraph(parBox, parLines)
                }
            } else {
                // Lines directly under block
                val blockLines = decodeLines(lines, lineIndex, childCount, width, height)
                lineIndex += countLinesOffset(lines, lineIndex, childCount)
                paragraphs += OcrParagraph(blockBox, blockLines)
            }

            blocks += OcrBlock(
                id = blockId,
                type = blockType,
                box = blockBox,
                readingOrder = readingOrder,
                paragraphs = paragraphs,
            )
        }
        require(lineIndex == lines.size) { "OCR layout envelope has unexpected trailing lines" }

        val layout = RecognitionLayout(
            sourceWidthPx = width,
            sourceHeightPx = height,
            blocks = blocks,
            languageHints = languageHints,
            quality = quality,
            formatVersion = version,
            plainText = text,
        )
        validate(layout)
        val ocrLayout = layout.toOcrLayout()
        return DecodedRecognitionPayload(text, layout.toLegacyGeometry(), layout, ocrLayout)
    }

    private fun decodeLines(
        lines: List<String>,
        startIndex: Int,
        lineCount: Int,
        width: Int,
        height: Int,
    ): List<OcrLine> {
        var idx = startIndex
        val result = mutableListOf<OcrLine>()
        for (l in 0 until lineCount) {
            require(idx < lines.size) { "OCR layout envelope truncated at line $l" }
            val lineFields = lines[idx++].split('|')
            require(lineFields.isNotEmpty() && lineFields[0] == "L") { "OCR layout line record is malformed" }

            val lineBox: NormalizedBox
            val baseline: Baseline?
            val xHeight: Float?
            val wordCount: Int

            if (lineFields.size == 11) {
                lineBox = safeNormalizedBox(
                    lineFields[1].toFloat(),
                    lineFields[2].toFloat(),
                    lineFields[3].toFloat(),
                    lineFields[4].toFloat(),
                )
                val hasBaseline = lineFields[5].toInt() == 1
                baseline = if (hasBaseline) Baseline(lineFields[6].toFloat(), lineFields[7].toFloat()) else null
                val hasXHeight = lineFields[8].toInt() == 1
                xHeight = if (hasXHeight) lineFields[9].toFloat() else null
                wordCount = lineFields[10].toInt()
            } else if (lineFields.size == 9) {
                // Older line format
                val lVal = lineFields[1].toFloat()
                val tVal = lineFields[2].toFloat()
                val rVal = lineFields[3].toFloat()
                val bVal = lineFields[4].toFloat()
                lineBox = if (lVal <= 1f && tVal <= 1f && rVal <= 1f && bVal <= 1f) {
                    safeNormalizedBox(lVal, tVal, rVal, bVal)
                } else {
                    normalizeBox(lVal.toLong(), tVal.toLong(), rVal.toLong(), bVal.toLong(), width, height)
                        ?: safeNormalizedBox(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f)
                }
                val hasBaseline = lineFields[5].toInt() == 1
                baseline = if (hasBaseline) Baseline(lineFields[6].toFloat(), lineFields[7].toFloat()) else null
                xHeight = null
                wordCount = lineFields[8].toInt()
            } else {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("OCR layout line record is malformed: ${lineFields.size} fields")
            }

            val words = mutableListOf<OcrWord>()
            for (w in 0 until wordCount) {
                require(idx < lines.size) { "OCR layout envelope truncated at word $w" }
                val wordFields = lines[idx++].split('|')
                require(wordFields.size == 7 && wordFields[0] == "W") { "OCR layout word record is malformed" }
                val wordText = wordFields[1].decodeBase64().toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                val wl = wordFields[2].toFloat()
                val wt = wordFields[3].toFloat()
                val wr = wordFields[4].toFloat()
                val wb = wordFields[5].toFloat()
                val wordBox = if (wl <= 1f && wt <= 1f && wr <= 1f && wb <= 1f) {
                    safeNormalizedBox(wl, wt, wr, wb)
                } else {
                    normalizeBox(wl.toLong(), wt.toLong(), wr.toLong(), wb.toLong(), width, height)
                        ?: safeNormalizedBox(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f)
                }
                val confidence = wordFields[6].toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 100f)
                words += OcrWord(wordText, wordBox, confidence)
            }
            result += OcrLine(lineBox, baseline, xHeight, words)
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun countLinesOffset(lines: List<String>, startIndex: Int, lineCount: Int): Int {
        var idx = startIndex
        for (l in 0 until lineCount) {
            val lineFields = lines[idx++].split('|')
            val wordCount = lineFields.last().toInt()
            idx += wordCount
        }
        return idx - startIndex
    }

    private fun decodeV1(payload: String): DecodedRecognitionPayload {
        val lines = payload.split('\n')
        require(lines.size >= 3 && lines[0] == MAGIC_V1) { "OCR geometry envelope is truncated" }
        val header = lines[2].split('|')
        require(header.size == 5) { "OCR geometry header is malformed" }
        val width = header[0].toLong()
        val height = header[1].toLong()
        val coordinateSpace = header[2]
        val version = header[3].toLong()
        val wordCount = header[4].toInt()
        require(wordCount >= 0 && lines.size == 3 + wordCount) { "OCR geometry word count is malformed" }
        val words = lines.drop(3).map { line ->
            val fields = line.split('|')
            require(fields.size == 6) { "OCR word record is malformed" }
            RecognizedWord(
                text = fields[0].decodeBase64().toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                leftPx = fields[1].toLong(),
                topPx = fields[2].toLong(),
                rightPx = fields[3].toLong(),
                bottomPx = fields[4].toLong(),
                confidence = fields[5].toDouble(),
            )
        }
        val geometry = RecognitionGeometry(width, height, coordinateSpace, words, version)
        validate(geometry)
        val text = lines[1].decodeBase64().toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        return DecodedRecognitionPayload(text, geometry, null)
    }

    private fun validate(layout: RecognitionLayout) {
        require(layout.sourceWidthPx > 0 && layout.sourceHeightPx > 0) { "OCR source dimensions must be positive" }
        require(layout.formatVersion == 2) { "Unsupported layout format version: ${layout.formatVersion}" }
        layout.blocks.forEach { block ->
            require(block.readingOrder >= 0) { "Block reading order must be non-negative" }
            block.paragraphs.forEach { par ->
                par.lines.forEach { line ->
                    line.words.forEach { word ->
                        require(word.text.isNotBlank()) { "Word text must not be blank" }
                        require(word.confidence.isFinite() && word.confidence in 0f..100f) { "Word confidence invalid" }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validate(geometry: RecognitionGeometry) {
        require(geometry.sourceWidthPx > 0L && geometry.sourceHeightPx > 0L)
        require(geometry.coordinateSpace == OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE && geometry.formatVersion == 1L)
        geometry.words.forEach { word ->
            require(word.text.isNotBlank())
            require(word.leftPx >= 0L && word.topPx >= 0L)
            require(word.rightPx > word.leftPx && word.bottomPx > word.topPx)
            require(word.rightPx <= geometry.sourceWidthPx && word.bottomPx <= geometry.sourceHeightPx)
            require(word.confidence.isFinite() && word.confidence in 0.0..100.0)
        }
    }

    private fun safeNormalizedBox(l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float): NormalizedBox {
        val left = l.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val top = t.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val right = r.coerceIn(left, 1f)
        val bottom = b.coerceIn(top, 1f)
        return NormalizedBox(left, top, right, bottom)
    }

    private fun ByteArray.encodeBase64(): String = encoder.encodeToString(this)

    private fun String.decodeBase64(): ByteArray = decoder.decode(this)
}



================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.store

import app.docscan.core.db.DocScanDatabase
import app.docscan.core.model.ArtifactId
import app.docscan.core.model.DeleteBatchId
import app.docscan.core.model.ExportArtifactId
import app.docscan.core.model.ExportAttemptId
import app.docscan.core.model.ImageVersionId
import app.docscan.core.model.ImportSessionId
import app.docscan.core.model.PageId
import app.docscan.core.model.RecognitionId
import app.docscan.core.model.SaveManifestId
import app.docscan.core.model.WorkspaceId
import app.docscan.core.model.WorkspaceSessionId
import app.docscan.core.time.Clock
import app.docscan.core.time.TimeReading

/** Product metadata authority. Android/provider I/O must happen before these transactions. */
class StateStore(
    private val database: DocScanDatabase,
    private val clock: Clock,
) {
    private val queries get() = database.schemaQueries

    private fun String.jsonEscape(): String = buildString(length) {
        this@jsonEscape.forEach { char ->
            when (char) {
                '\\' -> append("\\\\")
                '"' -> append("\\\"")
                '\n' -> append("\\n")
                '\r' -> append("\\r")
                '\t' -> append("\\t")
                else -> if (char.code < 0x20) append("\\u%04x".format(char.code)) else append(char)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun expectedExportPath(artifactId: ArtifactId, extension: String): String =
        "objects/${artifactId.value.take(2)}/${artifactId.value}.$extension"

    fun firstWorkspaceId(): WorkspaceId? =
        queries.firstWorkspace().executeAsOneOrNull()?.workspace_id?.let(WorkspaceId::parse)

    fun workspaceBootstrapState(): WorkspaceBootstrapState = when (queries.workspaceBootstrapState().executeAsOne()) {
        "EMPTY" -> WorkspaceBootstrapState.EMPTY
        "EXISTING" -> WorkspaceBootstrapState.EXISTING
        "ORPHANED" -> WorkspaceBootstrapState.ORPHANED
        else -> throw StoreInvariantViolation("Unknown workspace bootstrap state")
    }

    /** Persists a URI only after Android has durably taken its persistable tree grant. */
    fun recordDestinationGrant(treeUri: String, wallMillis: Long) {
        val grant = DestinationGrantSnapshot(treeUri, wallMillis, wallMillis)
        database.transaction {
            queries.deleteDestinationGrant()
            queries.insertDestinationGrant(grant.treeUri, grant.grantedWallMillis, grant.lastVerifiedWallMillis)
        }
    }

    fun destinationGrant(): DestinationGrantSnapshot? = queries.activeDestinationGrant().executeAsOneOrNull()?.let {
        DestinationGrantSnapshot(it.tree_uri, it.granted_wall, it.last_verified_wall)
    }

    /** Updated only after caller revalidates the OS grant outside this transaction. */
    fun markDestinationGrantVerified(treeUri: String, wallMillis: Long) {
        require(treeUri.startsWith("content://") && wallMillis >= 0L)
        database.transaction {
            val current = queries.activeDestinationGrant().executeAsOneOrNull()
