                    ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Existing PDF import has no source snapshot")
                val source = queries.artifactById(sourceId).executeAsOneOrNull()
                    ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Existing PDF import source record is missing")
                if (source.artifact_id != command.sourceArtifact.artifactId.value
                    || source.artifact_kind != "IMPORT_PDF_SOURCE"
                    || source.state != "COMMITTED"
                    || source.checksum != command.sourceArtifact.sha256
                    || source.size_bytes != command.sourceArtifact.sizeBytes
                    || source.relative_storage_path != command.sourceArtifact.relativePath
                    || source.artifact_format_version != command.sourceArtifact.formatVersion
                ) throw StoreConflict("Repeated request supplied different PDF bytes")
                val pending = queries.pdfImportPublicationIntentById(command.importSessionId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
                if (pending != null) {
                    if (pending.workspace_id != command.workspaceId.value
                        || pending.source_display_name != command.displayName
                    ) throw StoreConflict("PDF publication intent conflicts with its existing session")
                    queries.deletePdfImportPublicationIntent(command.importSessionId.value, command.workspaceId.value)
                }
                return@transactionWithResult command.importSessionId
            }
            val pending = queries.pdfImportPublicationIntentById(command.importSessionId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
            if (pending != null && (pending.workspace_id != command.workspaceId.value
                    || pending.source_display_name != command.displayName)
            ) throw StoreConflict("PDF publication intent differs from the completed source snapshot")
            val file = command.sourceArtifact
            queries.insertStagedArtifact(
                artifact_id = file.artifactId.value,
                relative_storage_path = file.relativePath,
                artifact_kind = "IMPORT_PDF_SOURCE",
                size_bytes = file.sizeBytes,
                checksum = file.sha256,
                artifact_format_version = file.formatVersion,
                creation_revision = 1L,
                producer_epoch = file.producerEpoch,
            )
            if (queries.commitArtifact(file.artifactId.value).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreInvariantViolation("Private PDF import source could not be committed")
            }
            queries.insertImportSession(
                import_session_id = command.importSessionId.value,
                workspace_id = workspace.workspace_id,
                frozen_operation_parameters = "{\"mimeType\":\"application/pdf\",\"pdfTitle\":\"${(command.documentTitle ?: "").jsonEscape()}\",\"renderDpi\":200,\"maxLongSidePx\":3000,\"textReusePolicy\":\"ENG-PDF-IMPORT-01\"}",
                source_snapshot_artifact_id = file.artifactId.value,
                source_page_count = command.sourcePageCount,
                source_display_name = command.displayName,
            )
            addArtifactReferenceChecked(
                artifact_id = file.artifactId.value,
                ref_kind = "IMPORT_SESSION",
                ref_owner_id = command.importSessionId.value,
                protection_class = "RECOVERY",
            )
            queries.updateWorkspaceActivity(
                last_user_activity_wall = time.wallTimeMillis,
                last_user_activity_monotonic = time.monotonicTimeNanos,
                monotonic_epoch_token = time.monotonicEpochToken,
                workspace_id = workspace.workspace_id,
            )
            if (pending != null && queries.deletePdfImportPublicationIntent(
                    command.importSessionId.value,
                    command.workspaceId.value,
                ).value != 1L
            ) throw StoreConflict("PDF publication intent changed while registering the import session")
            command.importSessionId
        }
    }

    fun pdfImportSnapshot(importSessionId: ImportSessionId): PdfImportSourceSnapshot? {
        val session = queries.importSessionById(importSessionId.value).executeAsOneOrNull() ?: return null
        if (session.state != "OPEN" || session.source_page_count == null) return null
        val sourceId = session.source_snapshot_artifact_id ?: return null
        val source = queries.artifactById(sourceId).executeAsOneOrNull() ?: return null
        if (source.artifact_kind != "IMPORT_PDF_SOURCE" || source.state != "COMMITTED") return null
        return PdfImportSourceSnapshot(
            ImportSessionId.parse(session.import_session_id),
            WorkspaceId.parse(session.workspace_id),
            ArtifactId.parse(source.artifact_id),
            source.relative_storage_path,
            source.size_bytes,
            source.checksum ?: return null,
            source.artifact_format_version,
            source.producer_epoch ?: return null,
            session.source_page_count,
            session.source_display_name,
            session.last_error,
            queries.importedPdfPageIndices(importSessionId.value).executeAsList().toSet(),
        )
    }

    fun incompletePdfImportSessions(): List<PdfImportSourceSnapshot> =
        queries.openPdfImportSessionIds().executeAsList().mapNotNull {
            pdfImportSnapshot(ImportSessionId.parse(it))
        }

    fun importedPdfPageIds(importSessionId: ImportSessionId): List<PageId> =
        queries.importedPdfPageIds(importSessionId.value).executeAsList().map(PageId::parse)

    fun pdfImportSessionState(importSessionId: ImportSessionId): String? =
        queries.importSessionById(importSessionId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()?.state

    fun markPdfImportSourceUnavailable(importSessionId: ImportSessionId) {
        database.transaction {
            if (queries.markImportSourceUnavailable(importSessionId.value).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreConflict("PDF ImportSession is no longer open")
            }
        }
    }

    fun recordPdfImportFailure(importSessionId: ImportSessionId, message: String) {
        val diagnostic = message.trim().take(1_000).ifBlank { "PDF import failed" }
        database.transaction {
            if (queries.recordPdfImportFailure(diagnostic, importSessionId.value).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreConflict("PDF ImportSession is no longer open")
            }
        }
    }

    /** Materializes one source image and completes its ImportSession in one transaction. */
    fun commitImportedImage(command: ImportImageCommand): CapturedPage = database.transactionWithResult {
        val session = queries.importSessionById(command.importSessionId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("ImportSession is missing")
        if (session.workspace_id != command.workspaceId.value || session.state != "OPEN") {
            throw StoreConflict("ImportSession is not open in this workspace")
        }
        if (queries.pageByImportTuple(command.importSessionId.value, 0L).executeAsOneOrNull() != null) {
            throw StoreConflict("Source image was already materialized")
        }
        val artifact = queries.artifactById(command.sourceArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Import snapshot artifact record is missing")
        if (artifact.artifact_id != session.source_snapshot_artifact_id || artifact.state != "COMMITTED") {
            throw StoreInvariantViolation("ImportSession snapshot is not committed")
        }
        val openWorkspaceSession = queries.openSessionForWorkspace(command.workspaceId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Workspace has no open session")
        val orderIndex = queries.nextVisibleOrder(command.workspaceId.value).executeAsOne()
        queries.insertImageVersion(
            image_version_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
            page_id = command.pageId.value,
            artifact_id = artifact.artifact_id,
            parent_version_id = null,
            coordinate_space = "SOURCE_ENCODED_IMAGE_COORDINATES_V1",
            transform_provenance = "import-original-v1",
            artifact_format_version = artifact.artifact_format_version,
        )
        queries.insertImportedPage(
            page_id = command.pageId.value,
            workspace_id = command.workspaceId.value,
            workspace_session_id = openWorkspaceSession.workspace_session_id,
            order_index = orderIndex,
            current_image_version_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
            processing_desired_state = command.desiredOperationKey,
            import_session_id = command.importSessionId.value,
            source_page_index = 0L,
            source_provenance = "${command.mimeType}:${command.displayName}",
        )
        addArtifactReferenceChecked(
            artifact_id = artifact.artifact_id,
            ref_kind = "IMAGE_VERSION",
            ref_owner_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
            protection_class = "AUTHORITATIVE",
        )
        if (queries.completeImportSession(command.importSessionId.value).value != 1L) {
            throw StoreConflict("ImportSession changed while materializing source image")
        }
        if (queries.removeImportSnapshotReference(artifact.artifact_id, command.importSessionId.value).value != 1L) {
            throw StoreInvariantViolation("Import snapshot protection reference is missing")
        }
        queries.advanceOrderRevision(command.workspaceId.value)
        queries.setActivePage(command.pageId.value, command.workspaceId.value)
        CapturedPage(
            pageId = command.pageId,
            imageVersionId = command.imageVersionId,
            artifactId = ArtifactId.parse(artifact.artifact_id),
            orderIndex = orderIndex,
        )
    }

    /** Commits one rendered PDF page idempotently while retaining the private source until all pages exist. */
    fun commitPdfImportPage(
        command: CommitPdfImportPageCommand,
        beforeTransactionCommitForTest: ((CommitPdfImportPageCommand) -> Unit)? = null,
    ): CapturedPage = database.transactionWithResult {
        val session = queries.importSessionById(command.importSessionId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("PDF ImportSession is missing")
        if (session.workspace_id != command.workspaceId.value || session.state != "OPEN") {
            throw StoreConflict("PDF ImportSession is not open in this workspace")
        }
        if (command.sourcePageIndex >= (session.source_page_count ?: 0L)) {
            throw StoreInvariantViolation("PDF source page index is outside the inspected document")
        }
        val existingPage = queries.pageByImportTuple(command.importSessionId.value, command.sourcePageIndex).executeAsOneOrNull()
        if (existingPage != null) {
            val version = queries.imageVersionById(existingPage.current_image_version_id).executeAsOne()
            return@transactionWithResult CapturedPage(
                PageId.parse(existingPage.page_id),
                ImageVersionId.parse(existingPage.current_image_version_id),
                ArtifactId.parse(version.artifact_id),
                existingPage.order_index,
            )
        }
        val sourceArtifactId = session.source_snapshot_artifact_id
            ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("PDF ImportSession has no source snapshot")
        val sourceArtifact = queries.artifactById(sourceArtifactId).executeAsOne()
        if (sourceArtifact.artifact_kind != "IMPORT_PDF_SOURCE" || sourceArtifact.state != "COMMITTED") {
            throw StoreInvariantViolation("PDF source snapshot is not committed")
        }
        if (queries.pageById(command.pageId.value).executeAsOneOrNull() != null
            || queries.imageVersionById(command.imageVersionId.value).executeAsOneOrNull() != null
        ) throw StoreConflict("Imported Page or ImageVersion ID already exists")
        val file = command.imageArtifact
        val staged = queries.artifactById(file.artifactId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Rendered PDF page artifact was not staged")
        if (staged.state != "STAGED_DURABLE"
            || staged.artifact_kind != "DOCUMENT_PAGE"
            || staged.relative_storage_path != file.relativePath
            || staged.size_bytes != file.sizeBytes
            || staged.checksum != file.sha256
            || staged.artifact_format_version != file.formatVersion
            || staged.producer_epoch != file.producerEpoch
        ) throw StoreInvariantViolation("Rendered PDF page differs from its staged durable artifact")
        if (queries.commitArtifact(file.artifactId.value).value != 1L) {
            throw StoreInvariantViolation("Rendered PDF page image could not be committed")
        }
        val openWorkspaceSession = queries.openSessionForWorkspace(command.workspaceId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Workspace has no open session")
        val orderIndex = queries.nextVisibleOrder(command.workspaceId.value).executeAsOne()
        queries.insertImageVersion(
            image_version_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
            page_id = command.pageId.value,
            artifact_id = file.artifactId.value,
            parent_version_id = null,
            coordinate_space = "PDF_RENDERED_PAGE_PIXELS_TOP_LEFT",
            transform_provenance = "pdf-import-render-v1",
            artifact_format_version = file.formatVersion,
        )
        queries.insertImportedPage(
            page_id = command.pageId.value,
            workspace_id = command.workspaceId.value,
            workspace_session_id = openWorkspaceSession.workspace_session_id,
            order_index = orderIndex,
            current_image_version_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
            processing_desired_state = command.desiredOperationKey,
            import_session_id = command.importSessionId.value,
            source_page_index = command.sourcePageIndex,
            source_provenance = "application/pdf:${command.sourceDisplayName}",
        )
        addArtifactReferenceChecked(
            artifact_id = file.artifactId.value,
            ref_kind = "IMAGE_VERSION",
            ref_owner_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
            protection_class = "AUTHORITATIVE",
        )
        if (command.recognizedText != null) {
            val recognitionId = command.recognitionId ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("PDF text recognition has no ID")
            queries.insertRecognition(
                recognition_id = recognitionId.value,
                page_id = command.pageId.value,
                image_version_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
                payload = command.recognizedLayout?.let { RecognitionPayloadCodec.encode(command.recognizedText, it) }
                    ?: command.recognizedText,
            )
            if (queries.commitCurrentRecognition(
                    current_recognition_id = recognitionId.value,
                    page_id = command.pageId.value,
                    workspace_id = command.workspaceId.value,
                    current_image_version_id = command.imageVersionId.value,
                    content_revision = 1L,
                    processing_desired_state = command.desiredOperationKey,
                ).value != 1L
            ) throw StoreInvariantViolation("PDF text layer could not be attached to its imported page")
        }
        queries.advanceOrderRevision(command.workspaceId.value)
        queries.setActivePage(command.pageId.value, command.workspaceId.value)
        queries.clearPdfImportFailure(command.importSessionId.value)
        if (queries.completePdfImportSession(command.importSessionId.value, command.importSessionId.value).value == 1L) {
            if (queries.removeImportSnapshotReference(sourceArtifactId, command.importSessionId.value).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreInvariantViolation("Completed PDF import lost its source recovery reference")
            }
        }
        // A no-op-by-default instrumentation seam: this callback runs after the page SQL mutations,
        // while the enclosing SQLite transaction is still open and before SQLDelight commits it.
        beforeTransactionCommitForTest?.invoke(command)
        CapturedPage(command.pageId, command.imageVersionId, file.artifactId, orderIndex)
    }

    fun recoveryArtifactBatch(limit: Long): List<RecoveryArtifact> {
        require(limit in 1L..100L)
        val cursor = queries.recoveryCursorByDomain(RECOVERY_CURSOR_DOMAIN).executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?.cursor_payload?.toLongOrNull()?.coerceAtLeast(0L) ?: 0L
        return queries.recoveryArtifactBatch(cursor, limit).executeAsList().map {
            RecoveryArtifact(
                recoverySequence = it.recovery_sequence,
                artifactId = ArtifactId.parse(it.artifact_id),
                relativePath = it.relative_storage_path,
                sizeBytes = it.size_bytes,
                sha256 = it.checksum,
                state = it.state,
            )
        }
    }

    /** Retain originals throughout Delete Undo, including a successful Save's Delete receipt. */
    private fun releaseExpiredCameraSources(limit: Long) {
        val time = clock.read()
        queries.tombstonedCameraSourcePages(limit).executeAsList().forEach { page ->
            val undo = queries.deleteUndoByPage(page.page_id, page.workspace_id).executeAsOneOrNull()
            val openSession = queries.openSessionForWorkspace(page.workspace_id).executeAsOneOrNull()
            val permanentlyUnavailable = undo == null ||
                openSession?.workspace_session_id != undo.undo_workspace_session_id
            // A backwards/uncertain clock can become valid again; do not destroy recovery bytes for it.
            val definitelyExpired = undo != null && time.wallTimeMillis >= undo.deleted_wall &&
                (if (time.monotonicEpochToken == undo.monotonic_epoch_token) {
                    time.monotonicTimeNanos > undo.undo_until_monotonic
                } else time.wallTimeMillis > undo.undo_until_wall)
            if (permanentlyUnavailable || definitelyExpired) queries.deleteCameraSourceReference(page.page_id)
        }
    }

    /** Atomically claims only committed, currently unreferenced private artifacts. */
    fun claimUnreferencedArtifacts(limit: Long): List<ArtifactDeletionClaim> {
        require(limit in 1L..100L)
        return database.transactionWithResult {
            releaseExpiredCameraSources(limit)
            queries.unreferencedArtifacts(limit).executeAsList().mapNotNull { artifact ->
                val token = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                if (queries.claimArtifactForDeletion(token, artifact.artifact_id).value != 1L) return@mapNotNull null
                ArtifactDeletionClaim(
                    artifactId = ArtifactId.parse(artifact.artifact_id),
                    claimToken = token,
                    relativePath = artifact.relative_storage_path,
                    sizeBytes = artifact.size_bytes,
                    sha256 = artifact.checksum,
                )
            }
        }
    }

    /** Lists interrupted physical deletions so CleanupArbiter can converge after process death. */
    fun claimedArtifactDeletions(limit: Long): List<ArtifactDeletionClaim> {
        require(limit in 1L..100L)
        return queries.gcClaimedArtifacts(limit).executeAsList().mapNotNull { artifact ->
            ArtifactDeletionClaim(
                artifactId = ArtifactId.parse(artifact.artifact_id),
                claimToken = artifact.gc_claim_token,
                relativePath = artifact.relative_storage_path,
                sizeBytes = artifact.size_bytes,
                sha256 = artifact.checksum,
            )
        }
    }

    fun finalizeArtifactDeletion(claim: ArtifactDeletionClaim) {
        database.transaction {
            if (queries.finalizeArtifactDeletion(claim.artifactId.value, claim.claimToken).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreConflict("Artifact deletion claim is stale or gained a protection reference")
            }
        }
    }

    fun releaseArtifactDeletionClaim(claim: ArtifactDeletionClaim) {
        database.transaction {
            if (queries.releaseArtifactDeletionClaim(claim.artifactId.value, claim.claimToken).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreConflict("Artifact deletion claim is stale")
            }
        }
    }

    fun quarantineClaimedArtifact(claim: ArtifactDeletionClaim) {
        database.transaction {
            if (queries.quarantineClaimedArtifact(claim.artifactId.value, claim.claimToken).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreConflict("Artifact deletion claim is stale")
            }
        }
    }

    fun acknowledgeRecoveredArtifact(artifact: RecoveryArtifact) {
        database.transaction {
            val current = queries.artifactById(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
                ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Recovery artifact disappeared")
            if (current.state !in setOf("STAGED_DURABLE", "COMMITTED")) {
                throw StoreConflict("Recovery artifact state changed")
            }
            queries.writeRecoveryCursor(RECOVERY_CURSOR_DOMAIN, artifact.recoverySequence.toString())
        }
    }

    fun quarantineRecoveredArtifact(artifact: RecoveryArtifact) {
        database.transaction {
            val current = queries.artifactById(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
                ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Recovery artifact disappeared")
            if (current.state != "QUARANTINED" && queries.quarantineArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreConflict("Recovery artifact state changed while quarantining")
            }
            queries.writeRecoveryCursor(RECOVERY_CURSOR_DOMAIN, artifact.recoverySequence.toString())
        }
    }

    fun resetRecoveryCursor() {
        database.transaction { queries.writeRecoveryCursor(RECOVERY_CURSOR_DOMAIN, "") }
    }

    fun reorderPages(workspaceId: WorkspaceId, expectedOrderRevision: Long, orderedPageIds: List<app.docscan.core.model.PageId>) {
        require(expectedOrderRevision >= 0L)
        val time = clock.read()
        database.transaction {
            val workspace = queries.workspaceById(workspaceId.value).executeAsOneOrNull()
                ?: throw StoreInvariantViolation("Workspace is missing")
            if (workspace.order_revision != expectedOrderRevision) {
                throw StoreConflict("Workspace order changed since reorder started")
            }
            val visible = queries.visiblePages(workspaceId.value).executeAsList()
            val currentIds = visible.map { it.page_id }.toSet()
            val requestedIds = orderedPageIds.map { it.value }
            if (requestedIds.size != currentIds.size || requestedIds.toSet() != currentIds) {
                throw StoreInvariantViolation("Reorder must contain each visible Page exactly once")
            }
            val offset = (visible.maxOfOrNull { it.order_index } ?: -1L) + visible.size + 1L
            visible.forEachIndexed { index, page ->
                queries.setPageOrder(offset + index, page.page_id, workspaceId.value)
            }
            orderedPageIds.forEachIndexed { index, pageId ->
                queries.setPageOrder(index.toLong(), pageId.value, workspaceId.value)
            }
            if (queries.advanceOrderRevisionIfExpected(workspaceId.value, expectedOrderRevision).value != 1L) {
                throw StoreConflict("Workspace order changed while reordering")
            }
            queries.updateWorkspaceActivity(
                last_user_activity_wall = time.wallTimeMillis,
                last_user_activity_monotonic = time.monotonicTimeNanos,
                monotonic_epoch_token = time.monotonicEpochToken,
                workspace_id = workspaceId.value,
            )
        }
    }

    fun openSessionId(workspaceId: WorkspaceId): WorkspaceSessionId? =
        queries.openSessionForWorkspace(workspaceId.value)
            .executeAsOneOrNull()
            ?.workspace_session_id
            ?.let(WorkspaceSessionId::parse)

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_WORKSPACE_INTEGRITY_FINDINGS = 500L
        const val MAX_ARTIFACT_REFERENCE_FINDINGS = 500L
        const val RECOVERY_CURSOR_DOMAIN = "artifact-integrity-v1"
        const val DELETE_UNDO_WINDOW_MILLIS = 8_000L
        const val DELETE_UNDO_WINDOW_NANOS = 8_000_000_000L
        const val RECENT_DOCUMENT_WINDOW_MILLIS = 24L * 60L * 60L * 1_000L
    }
}

@ConsistentCopyVisibility
data class DurableImageArtifact internal constructor(
    val artifactId: ArtifactId,
    val relativePath: String,
    val sizeBytes: Long,
    val sha256: String,
    val formatVersion: Long,
    val producerEpoch: String,
) {
    init {
        require(relativePath.isNotBlank() && !relativePath.startsWith('/'))
        require(relativePath.split('/').none { it == ".." || it.isBlank() })
        require(sizeBytes > 0L)
        require(sha256.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}")))
        require(formatVersion > 0L)
        require(producerEpoch.isNotBlank())
    }
}

        require(sizeBytes > 0L)
        require(sha256.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}")))

data class CommitLocalExportCommand(
    val exportArtifactId: app.docscan.core.model.ExportArtifactId,
    val saveManifestId: SaveManifestId,
    val files: List<LocalExportFileCommand>,
    val externalPackage: ExternalExportPackageCommand? = null,
    val artifactFormatVersion: Long = 1L,
    val structuralValidationVersion: Long = 1L,
    val outputKind: String = "PDF_WITH_JPG_PAGE_SET",
    val expectedPageCount: Long? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(outputKind in setOf("PDF_WITH_JPG_PAGE_SET", "EDITED_SAVED_PDF"))
        if (outputKind == "PDF_WITH_JPG_PAGE_SET") {
            require(files.isNotEmpty() && files.count { it.fileKind == "PDF" } == 1)
            require(files.first().fileKind == "PDF" && files.drop(1).all { it.fileKind == "JPG_PAGE" })
            require(expectedPageCount == null)
        } else {
            require(files.size == 1 && files.single().fileKind == "PDF")
            require(expectedPageCount != null && expectedPageCount > 0L)
        }
        require(files.all { it.file.sizeBytes > 0L })
        require(files.map { it.file.artifactId }.distinct().size == files.size)
        require(artifactFormatVersion > 0L && structuralValidationVersion > 0L)
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.time

import java.util.UUID

data class TimeReading(
    val wallTimeMillis: Long,
    val monotonicTimeNanos: Long,
    val monotonicEpochToken: String,
) {
    init {
        require(wallTimeMillis >= 0L)
        require(monotonicTimeNanos >= 0L)
        require(monotonicEpochToken.isNotBlank())
    }
}

fun interface Clock {
    fun read(): TimeReading
}

class SystemClock : Clock {
    private val epochToken = UUID.randomUUID().toString()

    override fun read(): TimeReading = TimeReading(
        wallTimeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        monotonicTimeNanos = System.nanoTime().coerceAtLeast(0L),
        monotonicEpochToken = epochToken,
    )
}

class FakeClock(initial: TimeReading) : Clock {
    private var current = initial

    @Synchronized
    override fun read(): TimeReading = current

    @Synchronized
    fun set(reading: TimeReading) {
        current = reading
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/whiten/DocumentInkTone.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.whiten

import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/** Softly deepens neutral shadows after document capture, leaving paper and saturated ink alone. */
object DocumentInkTone {
    fun apply(pixel: Int): Int {
        val r = pixel shr 16 and 255
        val g = pixel shr 8 and 255
        val b = pixel and 255
        val highest = max(r, max(g, b))
        val lowest = min(r, min(g, b))
        val neutral = (1f - (highest - lowest) / 32f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val shadow = ((200f - highest) / 110f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val factor = 1f - 0.38f * neutral * shadow
        fun channel(value: Int) = (value * factor).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255)
        return (pixel and -0x1000000) or (channel(r) shl 16) or (channel(g) shl 8) or channel(b)
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/whiten/DocumentTextSharpener.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.whiten

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/** Bounded, noise-thresholded luminance edge enhancement for document captures. */
object DocumentTextSharpener {
    fun sharpenRow(previous: IntArray, current: IntArray, next: IntArray, output: IntArray) {
        val width = current.size
        require(previous.size == width && next.size == width && output.size == width)
        fun luma(p: Int): Int = (77 * (p ushr 16 and 255) + 150 * (p ushr 8 and 255) + 29 * (p and 255)) shr 8
        for (x in 0 until width) {
            val p = current[x]
            val r = p ushr 16 and 255; val g = p ushr 8 and 255; val b = p and 255
            // Leave coloured marks alone. A small dead zone suppresses paper and sensor noise.
            if (max(r, max(g, b)) - min(r, min(g, b)) >= 32) { output[x] = p; continue }
            val center = luma(p)
            val mean = (luma(previous[x]) + luma(next[x]) + luma(current[max(0, x - 1)]) + luma(current[min(width - 1, x + 1)])) / 4f
            val edge = center - mean
            val delta = if (abs(edge) <= 4f) 0 else ((abs(edge) - 4f) * 0.65f * if (edge < 0) -1 else 1).roundToInt().coerceIn(-14, 14)
            fun channel(v: Int) = (v + delta).coerceIn(0, 255)
            output[x] = (p and -0x1000000) or (channel(r) shl 16) or (channel(g) shl 8) or channel(b)
        }
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/whiten/IlluminationModel.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.whiten

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/**
 * The one background-illumination estimator of the project (WP-INV-5): whitening (`WhiteningEngine`) and the OCR
 * LIGHTING profile both read their background from here.
 *
 * Estimation runs on a copy with a long side of about [ANALYSIS_SIDE] pixels: 85-90th percentile per overlapping
 * tile without glare, dark objects refilled from neighbours, smoothed tiles, then a luminance map at analysis
 * resolution refined by greyscale closing so hard shadow edges stay where they are.
 */
object IlluminationModel {
    const val ANALYSIS_SIDE = 512

    /** Analysis of one image: the map plus the integer shrink factor that maps image pixels to analysis pixels. */
    class Analysis internal constructor(internal val map: BackgroundMap, val cell: Int)

    fun analyse(source: PixelRows, isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false }): Analysis? {
        val cell = max(1, (max(source.width, source.height) + ANALYSIS_SIDE - 1) / ANALYSIS_SIDE)
        val map = estimate(downscale(source, cell, isCancelled)) ?: return null
        return Analysis(map, cell)
    }

    /** Fills linear-light luminance of the background for image row [y]; [out] has one value per image column. */
    class RowSampler(private val analysis: Analysis, private val width: Int) {
        private val map = analysis.map
        private val columnIndex = IntArray(width)
        private val columnFraction = FloatArray(width)
        private val verticalRow = FloatArray(map.smallWidth)

        init {
            for (x in 0 until width) {
                val sx = ((x + 0.5f) / analysis.cell - 0.5f).coerceIn(0f, (map.smallWidth - 1).toFloat())
                val i = min(sx.toInt(), max(map.smallWidth - 2, 0))
                columnIndex[x] = i; columnFraction[x] = if (map.smallWidth == 1) 0f else sx - i
            }
        }

        fun linearLumaRow(y: Int, out: FloatArray) {
            val sw = map.smallWidth
            val sy = ((y + 0.5f) / analysis.cell - 0.5f).coerceIn(0f, (map.smallHeight - 1).toFloat())
            val iy = min(sy.toInt(), max(map.smallHeight - 2, 0))
            val fy = if (map.smallHeight == 1) 0f else sy - iy
            val iy1 = min(iy + 1, map.smallHeight - 1)
            for (i in 0 until sw) {
                val a = (iy * sw + i) * 3; val b = (iy1 * sw + i) * 3
                verticalRow[i] = (0.2126f * map.fine[a] + 0.7152f * map.fine[a + 1] + 0.0722f * map.fine[a + 2]) * (1 - fy) +
                    (0.2126f * map.fine[b] + 0.7152f * map.fine[b + 1] + 0.0722f * map.fine[b + 2]) * fy
            }
            for (x in 0 until width) {
                val i = columnIndex[x]; val f = columnFraction[x]
                out[x] = verticalRow[i] * (1 - f) + verticalRow[min(i + 1, sw - 1)] * f
            }
        }
    }

    /** sRGB code (0..255) of a linear-light value. */
    fun encodeLinear(linear: Float): Int =
        fromLinear[(linear.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * FROM_LINEAR_SIZE + 0.5f).toInt()].toInt() and 0xFF

    internal const val TILE = 16
    internal const val STRIDE = 8
    internal val toLinear = FloatArray(256) { i ->
        val c = i / 255f
        if (c <= 0.04045f) c / 12.92f else ((c + 0.055f) / 1.055f).pow(2.4f)
    }
    internal const val FROM_LINEAR_SIZE = 4096
    internal val fromLinear = ByteArray(FROM_LINEAR_SIZE + 1) { i ->
        val l = i / FROM_LINEAR_SIZE.toFloat()
        val c = if (l <= 0.0031308f) l * 12.92f else 1.055f * l.pow(1f / 2.4f) - 0.055f
        (c * 255f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 255).toByte()
    }


    internal class Small(val width: Int, val height: Int, val pixels: IntArray)

    internal fun downscale(source: PixelRows, cell: Int, isCancelled: () -> Boolean): Small {
        val sw = (source.width + cell - 1) / cell
        val sh = (source.height + cell - 1) / cell
        val sum = FloatArray(sw * sh * 3)
        val count = IntArray(sw * sh)
        val row = IntArray(source.width)
        for (y in 0 until source.height) {
            if (isCancelled()) throw java.util.concurrent.CancellationException("Whitening cancelled")
            source.readRow(y, row)
            val base = (y / cell) * sw
            var cellX = 0
            var inCell = 0
            for (x in 0 until source.width) {
                val p = row[x]
                val alpha = (p ushr 24) and 0xFF
                val i = base + cellX
                // Transparent pixels count as white paper.
                if (alpha == 255) {
                    sum[i * 3] += (p shr 16 and 0xFF).toFloat(); sum[i * 3 + 1] += (p shr 8 and 0xFF).toFloat(); sum[i * 3 + 2] += (p and 0xFF).toFloat()
                } else {
                    sum[i * 3] += ((p shr 16 and 0xFF) * alpha + 255 * (255 - alpha)) / 255f
                    sum[i * 3 + 1] += ((p shr 8 and 0xFF) * alpha + 255 * (255 - alpha)) / 255f
                    sum[i * 3 + 2] += ((p and 0xFF) * alpha + 255 * (255 - alpha)) / 255f
                }
                count[i]++
                if (++inCell == cell) { inCell = 0; cellX++ }
            }
        }
        val pixels = IntArray(sw * sh) { i ->
            val n = max(count[i], 1)
            (0xFF shl 24) or ((sum[i * 3] / n).roundToInt() shl 16) or
                ((sum[i * 3 + 1] / n).roundToInt() shl 8) or (sum[i * 3 + 2] / n).roundToInt()
        }
        return Small(sw, sh, pixels)
    }

    class BackgroundMap(
        val tilesX: Int,
        val tilesY: Int,
        /** Linear RGB background per tile centre, interleaved. */
        val linear: FloatArray,
        val validShare: Float,
        val localShare: Float,
        val chroma: Float,
        val medianLuma: Float,
        /** Share of pixels within a few percent of their tile's paper level: ~0.8-0.95 for a page, ~0.35 for a wooden floor. */
        val flatShare: Float,
        val smallWidth: Int,
        val smallHeight: Int,
        /** Linear RGB background at analysis-pixel resolution: closing keeps hard shadow edges where tiles would erode them. */
        val fine: FloatArray,
    )

    internal fun luma(r: Int, g: Int, b: Int) = (r * 77 + g * 150 + b * 29) shr 8

    internal fun estimate(small: Small): BackgroundMap? {
        val tilesX = max(1, (small.width - TILE) / STRIDE + 1)
        val tilesY = max(1, (small.height - TILE) / STRIDE + 1)
        val count = tilesX * tilesY
        val rgb = FloatArray(count * 3)
        val p90 = IntArray(count)
        val valid = BooleanArray(count)
        val ys = IntArray(TILE * TILE)
        var flatHits = 0L
        var flatTotal = 0L
        val sel = IntArray(TILE * TILE)
        for (ty in 0 until tilesY) for (tx in 0 until tilesX) {
            val x0 = min(tx * STRIDE, max(0, small.width - TILE)); val y0 = min(ty * STRIDE, max(0, small.height - TILE))
            var n = 0
            var glare = 0
            var total = 0
            for (y in y0 until min(y0 + TILE, small.height)) for (x in x0 until min(x0 + TILE, small.width)) {
                val p = small.pixels[y * small.width + x]
                val r = p shr 16 and 0xFF; val g = p shr 8 and 0xFF; val b = p and 0xFF
                total++
                val yy = luma(r, g, b)
                // Near-clipped, nearly colourless pixels are glare: they say nothing about the paper.
                if (yy >= 252 && max(r, max(g, b)) - min(r, min(g, b)) < 8) { glare++; continue }
                ys[n] = yy; sel[n] = p; n++
            }
            val i = ty * tilesX + tx
            if (n < total * 0.4f || n < 8) continue
            val sorted = ys.copyOf(n).also { it.sort() }
            val top = sorted[min(n - 1, (n * 0.9f).toInt())]
            p90[i] = top
            for (k in 0 until n) if (abs(ys[k] - top) <= FLAT_TOLERANCE * top) flatHits++
            flatTotal += n
            var sr = 0f; var sg = 0f; var sb = 0f; var m = 0
            for (k in 0 until n) {
                if (ys[k] >= top * 0.94f && ys[k] <= top) {
                    val p = sel[k]
                    sr += toLinear[p shr 16 and 0xFF]; sg += toLinear[p shr 8 and 0xFF]; sb += toLinear[p and 0xFF]; m++
                }
            }
            if (m == 0) continue
            rgb[i * 3] = sr / m; rgb[i * 3 + 1] = sg / m; rgb[i * 3 + 2] = sb / m
            valid[i] = true
        }
        val tops = (0 until count).filter { valid[it] }.map { p90[it] }.sorted()
        if (tops.size < max(4, count / 10)) return null
        val reference = tops[(tops.size * 0.7f).toInt().coerceAtMost(tops.lastIndex)]
        // Tiles far darker than the page are dark objects (photo, stamp), not shadow: refill them from neighbours.
        for (i in 0 until count) if (valid[i] && p90[i] < reference * 0.3f) valid[i] = false
        val validCount = valid.count { it }
        if (validCount < max(4, count / 10)) return null
        val lumas = (0 until count).filter { valid[it] }
            .map { 0.2126f * rgb[it * 3] + 0.7152f * rgb[it * 3 + 1] + 0.0722f * rgb[it * 3 + 2] }.sorted()
        fun pct(q: Float) = lumas[(lumas.size * q).toInt().coerceAtMost(lumas.lastIndex)]
        val median = pct(0.5f)
        val nonUniformity = if (median > 1e-4f) (pct(0.9f) - pct(0.1f)) / median else 0f
        val refChroma = run {
            val idx = (0 until count).filter { valid[it] }
            var mx = 0f; var mn = 0f
            idx.forEach { mx += max(rgb[it * 3], max(rgb[it * 3 + 1], rgb[it * 3 + 2])); mn += min(rgb[it * 3], min(rgb[it * 3 + 1], rgb[it * 3 + 2])) }
            if (mx > 0f) (mx - mn) / mx else 0f
        }
        val invalidTile = BooleanArray(count) { !valid[it] }
        fill(rgb, valid, tilesX, tilesY)
        smooth(rgb, tilesX, tilesY, 1)
        // Chromaticity is smoothed harder than luminance, otherwise coloured fringes appear along shadow edges.
        val ratio = FloatArray(count * 3)
        val bgLuma = FloatArray(count) { 0.2126f * rgb[it * 3] + 0.7152f * rgb[it * 3 + 1] + 0.0722f * rgb[it * 3 + 2] }
        for (i in 0 until count) for (c in 0..2) ratio[i * 3 + c] = rgb[i * 3 + c] / max(bgLuma[i], 1e-4f)
        smooth(ratio, tilesX, tilesY, 2)
        for (i in 0 until count) for (c in 0..2) rgb[i * 3 + c] = max(ratio[i * 3 + c] * bgLuma[i], 1e-3f)
        val localShare = ((nonUniformity - 0.02f) / 0.06f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val fine = buildFine(small, tilesX, tilesY, rgb, invalidTile)
        return BackgroundMap(tilesX, tilesY, rgb, validCount / count.toFloat(), localShare, refChroma, median, if (flatTotal > 0) flatHits / flatTotal.toFloat() else 0f, small.width, small.height, fine)
    }

    private fun sampleTiles(rgb: FloatArray, tilesX: Int, tilesY: Int, sx: Float, sy: Float, out: FloatArray) {
        val gx = ((sx - TILE / 2f + 0.5f) / STRIDE).coerceIn(0f, (tilesX - 1).toFloat())
        val gy = ((sy - TILE / 2f + 0.5f) / STRIDE).coerceIn(0f, (tilesY - 1).toFloat())
        val ix = min(gx.toInt(), max(tilesX - 2, 0)); val iy = min(gy.toInt(), max(tilesY - 2, 0))
        val fx = if (tilesX == 1) 0f else gx - ix; val fy = if (tilesY == 1) 0f else gy - iy
        val ix1 = min(ix + 1, tilesX - 1); val iy1 = min(iy + 1, tilesY - 1)
        for (c in 0..2) {
            val top = rgb[(iy * tilesX + ix) * 3 + c] * (1 - fx) + rgb[(iy * tilesX + ix1) * 3 + c] * fx
            val bottom = rgb[(iy1 * tilesX + ix) * 3 + c] * (1 - fx) + rgb[(iy1 * tilesX + ix1) * 3 + c] * fx
            out[c] = top * (1 - fy) + bottom * fy
        }
    }

    private const val CLOSING_RADIUS = 3
    private const val FLAT_TOLERANCE = 0.06f

    /**
     * Greyscale closing (dilate then erode) of the luminance removes strokes narrower than the window while keeping a
     * hard shadow edge exactly where it is; tile percentiles alone erode such an edge by about half a tile. Chromaticity
     * stays on the heavily smoothed tile map, and tiles flagged as dark objects keep the tile value.
     */
    private fun buildFine(small: Small, tilesX: Int, tilesY: Int, tile: FloatArray, invalidTile: BooleanArray): FloatArray {
        val w = small.width; val h = small.height; val n = w * h
        val sampled = FloatArray(3)
        val tileRgb = FloatArray(n * 3)
        val tileLuma = FloatArray(n)
        val base = FloatArray(n)
        for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) {
            val i = y * w + x
            sampleTiles(tile, tilesX, tilesY, x.toFloat(), y.toFloat(), sampled)
            for (c in 0..2) tileRgb[i * 3 + c] = sampled[c]
            val tl = 0.2126f * sampled[0] + 0.7152f * sampled[1] + 0.0722f * sampled[2]
            tileLuma[i] = tl
            val p = small.pixels[i]
            val r = p shr 16 and 0xFF; val g = p shr 8 and 0xFF; val b = p and 0xFF
            val glare = luma(r, g, b) >= 252 && max(r, max(g, b)) - min(r, min(g, b)) < 8
            base[i] = if (glare) tl else 0.2126f * toLinear[r] + 0.7152f * toLinear[g] + 0.0722f * toLinear[b]
        }
        val work = FloatArray(n)
        boxBlur(base, work, w, h)
        val dilated = FloatArray(n)
        separableExtremum(work, dilated, w, h, CLOSING_RADIUS, true)
        separableExtremum(dilated, work, w, h, CLOSING_RADIUS, false)
        boxBlur(work, dilated, w, h)
        val fine = FloatArray(n * 3)
        for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) {
            val i = y * w + x
            val tx = (((x - TILE / 2f + 0.5f) / STRIDE) + 0.5f).toInt().coerceIn(0, tilesX - 1)
            val ty = (((y - TILE / 2f + 0.5f) / STRIDE) + 0.5f).toInt().coerceIn(0, tilesY - 1)
            val tl = max(tileLuma[i], 1e-4f)
            val level = if (invalidTile[ty * tilesX + tx]) tl else min(max(dilated[i], 1e-3f), tl * 1.2f)
            for (c in 0..2) fine[i * 3 + c] = max(tileRgb[i * 3 + c] / tl * level, 1e-3f)
        }
        return fine
    }

    private fun boxBlur(src: FloatArray, dst: FloatArray, w: Int, h: Int) {
        for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) {
            var sum = 0f; var n = 0
            for (dy in -1..1) for (dx in -1..1) {
                val nx = x + dx; val ny = y + dy
                if (nx !in 0 until w || ny !in 0 until h) continue
                sum += src[ny * w + nx]; n++
            }
            dst[y * w + x] = sum / n
        }
    }

    private fun separableExtremum(src: FloatArray, dst: FloatArray, w: Int, h: Int, radius: Int, maximum: Boolean) {
        val tmp = FloatArray(src.size)
        for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) {
            var v = src[y * w + x]
            for (d in -radius..radius) {
                val nx = (x + d).coerceIn(0, w - 1); val o = src[y * w + nx]
                if (if (maximum) o > v else o < v) v = o
            }
            tmp[y * w + x] = v
        }
        for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) {
            var v = tmp[y * w + x]
            for (d in -radius..radius) {
                val ny = (y + d).coerceIn(0, h - 1); val o = tmp[ny * w + x]
                if (if (maximum) o > v else o < v) v = o
            }
            dst[y * w + x] = v
        }
    }

    private fun fill(values: FloatArray, valid: BooleanArray, w: Int, h: Int) {
        val known = valid.copyOf()
        var changed = true
        var guard = w + h
        while (changed && guard-- > 0) {
            changed = false
            val newly = ArrayList<Int>()
            val acc = ArrayList<FloatArray>()
            for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) {
                val i = y * w + x
                if (known[i]) continue
                var n = 0
                val s = FloatArray(3)
                for (dy in -1..1) for (dx in -1..1) {
                    val nx = x + dx; val ny = y + dy
                    if (nx !in 0 until w || ny !in 0 until h) continue
                    val j = ny * w + nx
                    if (!known[j]) continue
                    n++; s[0] += values[j * 3]; s[1] += values[j * 3 + 1]; s[2] += values[j * 3 + 2]
                }
                if (n > 0) { newly += i; acc += floatArrayOf(s[0] / n, s[1] / n, s[2] / n) }
            }
            for (k in newly.indices) {
                val i = newly[k]
                values[i * 3] = acc[k][0]; values[i * 3 + 1] = acc[k][1]; values[i * 3 + 2] = acc[k][2]
                known[i] = true; changed = true
            }
        }
    }

    private fun smooth(values: FloatArray, w: Int, h: Int, passes: Int) {
        repeat(passes) {
            val copy = values.copyOf()
            for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) for (c in 0..2) {
                var s = 0f; var n = 0
                for (dy in -1..1) for (dx in -1..1) {
                    val nx = x + dx; val ny = y + dy
                    if (nx !in 0 until w || ny !in 0 until h) continue
                    s += copy[(ny * w + nx) * 3 + c]; n++
                }
                values[(y * w + x) * 3 + c] = s / n
            }
        }
    }

}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/whiten/WhitenessBlend.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.whiten

/** The "Белизна" slider: linear mix, in sRGB code values, of the original pixel and its whitened version. */
object WhitenessBlend {
    /** ARGB in, ARGB out; alpha comes from [original]. [percent] 0 returns the original, 100 the whitened pixel. */
    fun mix(original: Int, whitened: Int, percent: Int): Int {
        require(percent in 0..100)
        if (percent == 100) return (original and (0xFF shl 24)) or (whitened and 0xFFFFFF)
        if (percent == 0) return original
        fun channel(shift: Int): Int {
            val a = original shr shift and 0xFF
            val b = whitened shr shift and 0xFF
            return (a * (100 - percent) + b * percent + 50) / 100
        }
        return (original and (0xFF shl 24)) or (channel(16) shl 16) or (channel(8) shl 8) or channel(0)
    }
}

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/whiten/WhiteningEngine.kt

package app.docscan.core.whiten

import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.BackgroundMap
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.FROM_LINEAR_SIZE
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.STRIDE
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.Small
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.TILE
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.downscale
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.estimate
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.fromLinear
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.luma
import app.docscan.core.whiten.IlluminationModel.toLinear
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

const val WHITEN_ALGORITHM_VERSION = "whiten-1"

/** User-visible whitening profiles. AUTO resolves to NATURAL, or keeps the paper tint on strongly coloured/dark paper. */
enum class WhiteningMode { AUTO, NATURAL, CLEAN, BLACK_WHITE }

/** Row-wise ARGB access so the engine never needs a full-size copy of the page. */
interface PixelRows {
    val width: Int
    val height: Int
    fun readRow(y: Int, out: IntArray)
}

/** Side product of planning; BEFORE/AFTER are measured on the analysis copy, not on the full image. */
data class WhiteningMetrics(
    val backgroundMedianBefore: Int,
    val backgroundMedianAfter: Int,
    val backgroundStdBefore: Float,
    val backgroundStdAfter: Float,
    val glareFraction: Float,
    val relativeContrastBefore: Float,
    val relativeContrastAfter: Float,
    val nonUniformity: Float,
)

enum class WhiteningRefusal { NO_PAPER_FOUND, NOT_PAPER, CONTRAST_LOST, BACKGROUND_WORSE }

sealed interface WhiteningOutcome {
    data class Ready(val plan: WhiteningPlan) : WhiteningOutcome
    data class Refused(val reason: WhiteningRefusal, val metrics: WhiteningMetrics?) : WhiteningOutcome
}

/**
 * Background-illumination model and whitening, `whiten-1`.
 *
 * The background map is estimated on a copy with a long side of about [ANALYSIS_SIDE] pixels and applied row by
 * row, so no full-size float buffer exists. Division happens in linear light, per channel; correction strength
 * grows with measured background non-uniformity, there is no separate "flat page" branch. Every numeric constant
 * is a starting hypothesis to be calibrated on the physical corpus.
 */
object WhiteningEngine {
    const val NATURAL_WHITE = 248
    const val CLEAN_WHITE = 252
    const val GAIN_CAP = 4f

    /** Below this share of flat pixels the image is not a sheet of paper (pages measure 0.77+, a wooden floor 0.33-0.40). */
    const val MIN_FLAT_SHARE = 0.5f
    private const val DENOISE_GAIN = 1.5f
    private const val DENOISE_RADIUS = 3
    private const val DENOISE_ROWS = 3
    private const val DENOISE_RANGE = 12f
    private val DENOISE_KERNEL = FloatArray(256) { d -> exp(-(d / DENOISE_RANGE) * (d / DENOISE_RANGE)) }

    /** Linear-light chroma above which paper is treated as deliberately coloured; ordinary warm lamp light stays below. */
    const val TINT_KEEP_CHROMA = 0.6f

    fun plan(source: PixelRows, mode: WhiteningMode, isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false }): WhiteningOutcome {
        require(source.width > 0 && source.height > 0)
        val cell = max(1, (max(source.width, source.height) + IlluminationModel.ANALYSIS_SIDE - 1) / IlluminationModel.ANALYSIS_SIDE)
        val small = downscale(source, cell, isCancelled)
        val map = estimate(small) ?: return WhiteningOutcome.Refused(WhiteningRefusal.NO_PAPER_FOUND, null)
        // A textured surface (wooden floor, fabric) is not paper: whitening would wash it out into a grey-white smear.
        if (map.flatShare < MIN_FLAT_SHARE) return WhiteningOutcome.Refused(WhiteningRefusal.NOT_PAPER, null)
        val resolved = resolve(mode, map)
        var last: WhiteningMetrics? = null
        var reason = WhiteningRefusal.CONTRAST_LOST
        // Full local correction first; on a failed self-check fall back to the global white point only.
        for (local in listOf(map.localShare, 0f)) {
            val candidate = WhiteningPlan(map, resolved, local, source.width, cell)
            val metrics = measure(small, map, candidate)
            last = metrics
            val contrastKept = metrics.relativeContrastBefore < 0.15f ||
                metrics.relativeContrastAfter >= 0.9f * metrics.relativeContrastBefore
            // Relative spread: lifting a dim page legitimately raises absolute noise, but never the noise-to-level ratio.
            val relativeBefore = metrics.backgroundStdBefore / max(metrics.backgroundMedianBefore, 1)
            val relativeAfter = metrics.backgroundStdAfter / max(metrics.backgroundMedianAfter, 1)
            val backgroundOk = relativeAfter <= relativeBefore * 1.05f + 0.005f
            if (contrastKept && backgroundOk) return WhiteningOutcome.Ready(candidate.also { it.metrics = metrics })
            reason = if (!contrastKept) WhiteningRefusal.CONTRAST_LOST else WhiteningRefusal.BACKGROUND_WORSE
            if (local == 0f) break
        }
        return WhiteningOutcome.Refused(reason, last)
    }

    private fun resolve(mode: WhiteningMode, map: BackgroundMap): WhiteningMode {
        if (mode != WhiteningMode.AUTO) return mode
        // Strongly coloured or dark paper keeps its tint: bleaching it would invent a document that was never there.
        return if (map.chroma > TINT_KEEP_CHROMA || map.medianLuma < 0.08f) WhiteningMode.AUTO else WhiteningMode.NATURAL
    }

    internal fun measure(small: Small, map: BackgroundMap, plan: WhiteningPlan): WhiteningMetrics {
        val n = small.width * small.height
        val before = IntArray(n) { luma(small.pixels[it] shr 16 and 0xFF, small.pixels[it] shr 8 and 0xFF, small.pixels[it] and 0xFF) }
        val transformer = plan.rowTransformer(small.width, 1)
        val row = IntArray(small.width)
        val after = IntArray(n)
        for (y in 0 until small.height) {
            System.arraycopy(small.pixels, y * small.width, row, 0, small.width)
            transformer.transformRow(row, y)
            for (x in 0 until small.width) {
                val p = row[x]
                after[y * small.width + x] = luma(p shr 16 and 0xFF, p shr 8 and 0xFF, p and 0xFF)
            }
        }
        // Paper = pixels close to the local background level of the *source*; ink and objects are excluded.
        val paperIdx = ArrayList<Int>()
        var glare = 0
        val localLuma = plan.localBackgroundLuma(small.width, small.height)
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            if (before[i] >= 252) glare++
            if (before[i] >= 0.85f * localLuma[i] && before[i] < 252) paperIdx += i
        }
        if (paperIdx.isEmpty()) return WhiteningMetrics(0, 0, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f, map.localShare)
        fun stats(src: IntArray): Pair<Int, Float> {
            val values = IntArray(paperIdx.size) { src[paperIdx[it]] }.also { it.sort() }
            val median = values[values.size / 2]
            var s = 0.0
            values.forEach { s += (it - median).toDouble() * (it - median) }
            return median to kotlin.math.sqrt(s / values.size).toFloat()
        }
        // Stroke contrast: depth of ink below its *local* paper level, before vs after, on the same ink pixels.
        val inkIdx = (0 until n).filter { before[it] < 0.75f * localLuma[it] && localLuma[it] > 0 }
        fun inkContrast(src: IntArray, level: (Int) -> Float): Float =
            if (inkIdx.isEmpty()) 0f else inkIdx.sumOf { (1f - src[it] / max(level(it), 1f)).toDouble() }.toFloat() / inkIdx.size
        val (bm, bs) = stats(before)
        val (am, asd) = stats(after)
        return WhiteningMetrics(
            bm, am, bs, asd, glare / n.toFloat(),
            inkContrast(before) { localLuma[it].toFloat() }, inkContrast(after) { am.toFloat() }, map.localShare,
        )
    }

    /** Immutable result of planning; [rowTransformer] is cheap and may be created once per image width. */
    class WhiteningPlan internal constructor(
        private val map: BackgroundMap,
        val resolvedMode: WhiteningMode,
        private val localShare: Float,
        private val width: Int,
        private val cell: Int,
    ) {
        var metrics: WhiteningMetrics? = null
            internal set
        val appliedLocalShare: Float get() = localShare
        val algorithmVersion: String get() = WHITEN_ALGORITHM_VERSION

        private val targetLuma = when (resolvedMode) {
            WhiteningMode.CLEAN, WhiteningMode.BLACK_WHITE -> CLEAN_WHITE
            else -> NATURAL_WHITE
        }
        private val keepTint = resolvedMode == WhiteningMode.AUTO

        /**
         * Strong amplification (a dim page) multiplies sensor noise, so background-like pixels are smoothed along the
         * row. Ink is never touched: the range kernel only joins pixels within a few levels of each other.
         */
        internal val denoise: Boolean = run {
            val lumaMedian = 0.2126f * globalBgOf(0) + 0.7152f * globalBgOf(1) + 0.0722f * globalBgOf(2)
            if (1f / max(lumaMedian, 1e-3f) >= DENOISE_GAIN) return@run true
            var strong = 0
            val n = map.smallWidth * map.smallHeight
            for (i in 0 until n) {
                val l = 0.2126f * map.fine[i * 3] + 0.7152f * map.fine[i * 3 + 1] + 0.0722f * map.fine[i * 3 + 2]
                if (1f / max(l, 1e-3f) >= DENOISE_GAIN * 1.25f) strong++
            }
            strong >= n * 0.15f
        }
        private val grey = resolvedMode == WhiteningMode.BLACK_WHITE
        private val clean = resolvedMode == WhiteningMode.CLEAN || grey

        private fun globalBgOf(c: Int): Float {
            val v = FloatArray(map.tilesX * map.tilesY) { map.linear[it * 3 + c] }.also { it.sort() }
            return v[v.size / 2]
        }

        private val globalBg: FloatArray = FloatArray(3).also { g ->
            for (c in 0..2) {
                val v = FloatArray(map.tilesX * map.tilesY) { map.linear[it * 3 + c] }.also { it.sort() }
                g[c] = v[v.size / 2]
            }
        }

        internal fun localBackgroundLuma(w: Int, h: Int): IntArray {
            val t = rowTransformer(w, 1)
            val out = IntArray(w * h)
            val bg = FloatArray(3)
            for (y in 0 until h) for (x in 0 until w) {
                t.backgroundAt(x, y, bg)
                val l = 0.2126f * bg[0] + 0.7152f * bg[1] + 0.0722f * bg[2]
                out[y * w + x] = fromLinear[(l.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * FROM_LINEAR_SIZE).roundToInt()].toInt() and 0xFF
            }
            return out
        }

        fun rowTransformer(rowWidth: Int = width, cellSize: Int = cell): RowTransformer = RowTransformer(rowWidth, cellSize)

        inner class RowTransformer(private val rowWidth: Int, private val cellSize: Int) {
            private val gx0 = IntArray(rowWidth)
            private val gxf = FloatArray(rowWidth)
            private val bg = FloatArray(3)
            private val targetLinear = toLinear[targetLuma]
            private val gainBase = FloatArray(3)
            private val ratio = FloatArray(3)

            init {
                for (x in 0 until rowWidth) {
                    val sx = ((x + 0.5f) / cellSize - 0.5f).coerceIn(0f, (map.smallWidth - 1).toFloat())
                    val i = min(sx.toInt(), max(map.smallWidth - 2, 0))
                    gx0[x] = i; gxf[x] = if (map.smallWidth == 1) 0f else sx - i
                }
                for (c in 0..2) gainBase[c] = 1f / max(if (keepTint) max(globalBg[0], max(globalBg[1], globalBg[2])) else globalBg[c], 1e-3f)
            }

            internal fun backgroundAt(x: Int, y: Int, out: FloatArray) {
                val sy = ((y + 0.5f) / cellSize - 0.5f).coerceIn(0f, (map.smallHeight - 1).toFloat())
                val iy = min(sy.toInt(), max(map.smallHeight - 2, 0)); val fy = if (map.smallHeight == 1) 0f else sy - iy
                val iy1 = min(iy + 1, map.smallHeight - 1)
                val ix = gx0[x]; val fx = gxf[x]; val ix1 = min(ix + 1, map.smallWidth - 1)
                val w = map.smallWidth
                for (c in 0..2) {
                    val top = map.fine[(iy * w + ix) * 3 + c] * (1 - fx) + map.fine[(iy * w + ix1) * 3 + c] * fx
                    val bottom = map.fine[(iy1 * w + ix) * 3 + c] * (1 - fx) + map.fine[(iy1 * w + ix1) * 3 + c] * fx
                    out[c] = top * (1 - fy) + bottom * fy
                }
            }

            private val vRow = FloatArray(map.smallWidth * 3)
            private val referenceChannel = FloatArray(3) { c ->
                if (keepTint) max(globalBg[0], max(globalBg[1], globalBg[2])) else globalBg[c]
            }
            private val capChannel = FloatArray(3) { GAIN_CAP * gainBase[it] }

            fun transformRow(row: IntArray, y: Int) {
                // Vertical interpolation of the fine map once per row, horizontal one per pixel.
                val sw = map.smallWidth
                val sy = ((y + 0.5f) / cellSize - 0.5f).coerceIn(0f, (map.smallHeight - 1).toFloat())
                val iy = min(sy.toInt(), max(map.smallHeight - 2, 0))
                val fy = if (map.smallHeight == 1) 0f else sy - iy
                val iy1 = min(iy + 1, map.smallHeight - 1)
                val upper = iy * sw * 3; val lower = iy1 * sw * 3
                for (i in 0 until sw * 3) vRow[i] = map.fine[upper + i] * (1 - fy) + map.fine[lower + i] * fy
                val share = localShare
                for (x in 0 until rowWidth) {
                    val ix = gx0[x] * 3; val fx = gxf[x]; val ix1 = min(gx0[x] + 1, sw - 1) * 3
                    var b0 = vRow[ix] * (1 - fx) + vRow[ix1] * fx
                    var b1 = vRow[ix + 1] * (1 - fx) + vRow[ix1 + 1] * fx
                    var b2 = vRow[ix + 2] * (1 - fx) + vRow[ix1 + 2] * fx
                    if (keepTint) { val m = max(b0, max(b1, b2)); b0 = m; b1 = m; b2 = m }
                    val p = row[x]
                    // Blend between the global white point and the local map by the measured non-uniformity;
                    // the gain relative to the global reference is capped so deep-shadow noise is not amplified.
                    val r0 = toLinear[p shr 16 and 0xFF] * min(1f / max(referenceChannel[0] + (b0 - referenceChannel[0]) * share, 1e-3f), capChannel[0])
                    val r1 = toLinear[p shr 8 and 0xFF] * min(1f / max(referenceChannel[1] + (b1 - referenceChannel[1]) * share, 1e-3f), capChannel[1])
                    val r2 = toLinear[p and 0xFF] * min(1f / max(referenceChannel[2] + (b2 - referenceChannel[2]) * share, 1e-3f), capChannel[2])
                    val greyRatio = 0.2126f * r0 + 0.7152f * r1 + 0.0722f * r2
                    row[x] = (p and (0xFF shl 24)) or
                        (encode(if (grey) greyRatio else r0) shl 16) or
                        (encode(if (grey) greyRatio else r1) shl 8) or
                        encode(if (grey) greyRatio else r2)
                }
                if (denoise) smoothRow(row, y)
            }

            private fun encode(ratio: Float): Int {
                val r = if (clean) snapPaper(ratio) else ratio
                val lin = shoulder(r) * targetLinear
                return fromLinear[(lin.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * FROM_LINEAR_SIZE + 0.5f).toInt()].toInt() and 0xFF
            }

            private val lumaRow = IntArray(rowWidth)
            private val srcRow = IntArray(rowWidth)
            private val previousRows = Array(DENOISE_ROWS - 1) { IntArray(rowWidth) }
            private val previousLuma = Array(DENOISE_ROWS - 1) { IntArray(rowWidth) }
            private var lastSmoothedRow = -2

            /**
             * Range-weighted mean over this row and the previous rows (rows are fed top to bottom): flat paper grain
             * averages out, while anything that differs by more than a few levels (ink) keeps its own value.
             */
            private fun smoothRow(row: IntArray, y: Int) {
                for (x in 0 until rowWidth) {
                    val p = row[x]
                    lumaRow[x] = luma(p shr 16 and 0xFF, p shr 8 and 0xFF, p and 0xFF)
                }
                System.arraycopy(row, 0, srcRow, 0, rowWidth)
                if (y != lastSmoothedRow + 1) {
                    // First row of a pass (or a jump): fill the history with the current row.
                    for (k in previousRows.indices) { System.arraycopy(srcRow, 0, previousRows[k], 0, rowWidth); System.arraycopy(lumaRow, 0, previousLuma[k], 0, rowWidth) }
                }
                for (x in 0 until rowWidth) {
                    var wSum = 0f; var r = 0f; var g = 0f; var b = 0f
                    val centre = lumaRow[x]
                    for (k in 0 until DENOISE_ROWS) {
                        val rows = if (k == 0) srcRow else previousRows[k - 1]
                        val lumas = if (k == 0) lumaRow else previousLuma[k - 1]
                        for (d in -DENOISE_RADIUS..DENOISE_RADIUS) {
                            val nx = (x + d).coerceIn(0, rowWidth - 1)
                            val w = DENOISE_KERNEL[abs(lumas[nx] - centre)]
                            val p = rows[nx]
                            wSum += w; r += w * (p shr 16 and 0xFF); g += w * (p shr 8 and 0xFF); b += w * (p and 0xFF)
                        }
                    }
                    row[x] = (srcRow[x] and (0xFF shl 24)) or ((r / wSum).roundToInt() shl 16) or ((g / wSum).roundToInt() shl 8) or (b / wSum).roundToInt()
                }
                // Shift the history: newest pre-smooth row becomes previous row 1.
                for (k in previousRows.size - 1 downTo 1) {
                    System.arraycopy(previousRows[k - 1], 0, previousRows[k], 0, rowWidth); System.arraycopy(previousLuma[k - 1], 0, previousLuma[k], 0, rowWidth)
                }
                System.arraycopy(srcRow, 0, previousRows[0], 0, rowWidth); System.arraycopy(lumaRow, 0, previousLuma[0], 0, rowWidth)
                lastSmoothedRow = y
            }
        }

        private companion object {
            /** Identity up to the paper level, then a soft knee towards the headroom above the target white. */
            fun shoulder(r: Float): Float = if (r <= 1f) r else 1f + (1f - exp(-(r - 1f) * 3f)) * 0.03f

            /** Clean: values within a few percent of paper become exactly paper; strokes (< ~0.8) are untouched. */
            fun snapPaper(r: Float): Float {
                if (r >= 0.97f) return max(r, 1f)
                if (r <= 0.90f) return r
                val t = (r - 0.90f) / 0.07f
                val s = t * t * (3f - 2f * t)
                return r + (1f - r) * s
            }
        }
    }
}

typealias WhiteningPlan = WhiteningEngine.WhiteningPlan

FILE: core/src/main/kotlin/app/docscan/core/whiten/WhiteningQuality.kt

package app.docscan.core.whiten

enum class PageQualityFlag { UNEVEN_BACKGROUND, DIM_SOURCE, GLARE, LOW_STROKE_CONTRAST }

/**
 * Informational reading of [WhiteningMetrics] for the page quality check (BR-003-04, DR-05).
 *
 * The thresholds are PROPOSALS (DR-37 in the owner decision sheet) and are not approved: nothing sets a
 * "low quality" status from them, they are logged and shown to the user as a hint only.
 */
data class WhiteningAssessment(val metrics: WhiteningMetrics, val flags: Set<PageQualityFlag>) {
    val isClean: Boolean get() = flags.isEmpty()
}

object WhiteningQuality {
    /** Paper spread above this after whitening (luma levels) means a shadow survived. */
    const val PROPOSED_MAX_BACKGROUND_STD_AFTER = 4f

    /** Median paper luma below this before whitening means a very dim capture: noise was amplified. */
    const val PROPOSED_MIN_SOURCE_BACKGROUND = 110

    /** Share of near-clipped pixels above this means glare covers a visible part of the sheet. */
    const val PROPOSED_MAX_GLARE_FRACTION = 0.02f

    /** Depth of ink below paper (0..1) below this means faint or washed-out content. */
    const val PROPOSED_MIN_STROKE_CONTRAST = 0.35f

    fun assess(metrics: WhiteningMetrics): WhiteningAssessment {
        val flags = linkedSetOf<PageQualityFlag>()
        if (metrics.backgroundStdAfter > PROPOSED_MAX_BACKGROUND_STD_AFTER) flags += PageQualityFlag.UNEVEN_BACKGROUND
        if (metrics.backgroundMedianBefore in 1 until PROPOSED_MIN_SOURCE_BACKGROUND) flags += PageQualityFlag.DIM_SOURCE
        if (metrics.glareFraction > PROPOSED_MAX_GLARE_FRACTION) flags += PageQualityFlag.GLARE
        if (metrics.relativeContrastBefore > 0f && metrics.relativeContrastAfter < PROPOSED_MIN_STROKE_CONTRAST) flags += PageQualityFlag.LOW_STROKE_CONTRAST
        return WhiteningAssessment(metrics, flags)
    }
}

CREATE TABLE ExternalExportPackage (
  export_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES ExportArtifact(export_artifact_id),
  destination_tree_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  common_basename TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_qualification_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ProviderQualification(qualification_id),
  adapter_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  os_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  destination_access_class TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('READY', 'WRITING_EXTERNAL', 'UNKNOWN_OUTCOME', 'PARTIAL', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED_KNOWN')),
  last_error TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE ExternalExportPackageOutput (
  export_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ExternalExportPackage(export_artifact_id),
  output_artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ArtifactRecord(artifact_id),
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (export_artifact_id, output_artifact_id),
  UNIQUE (export_artifact_id, display_name),
  UNIQUE (export_artifact_id, ordinal)
);

================================================================================
FILE: core/src/main/sqldelight/app/docscan/core/db/Schema.sq
