package app.docscan.core.ocr

import app.docscan.core.store.BlockType
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class HocrParserTest {

    @Test
    fun parsesTwoColumnDocumentInNaturalReadingOrder() {
        val hocr = """
            <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
            <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN"
                "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd">
            <html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xml:lang="en" lang="en">
             <head><title></title></head>
             <body>
              <div class='ocr_page' id='page_1' title='image "doc.png"; bbox 0 0 2000 1000; ppageno 0'>
               <!-- Column 1: Left column -->
               <div class='ocr_carea' id='block_1_1' title='bbox 100 100 900 800'>
                <p class='ocr_par' id='par_1_1' title='bbox 100 100 900 400'>
                 <span class='ocr_line' id='line_1_1' title='bbox 100 100 900 200; baseline 0 -10'>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_1' title='bbox 100 100 400 200; x_wconf 95'>Колонка</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_2' title='bbox 450 100 600 200; x_wconf 92'>1</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_3' title='bbox 650 100 900 200; x_wconf 90'>строка</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_4' title='bbox 910 100 950 200; x_wconf 91'>1</span>
                 </span>
                 <span class='ocr_line' id='line_1_2' title='bbox 100 250 900 350; baseline 0 -8'>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_5' title='bbox 100 250 400 350; x_wconf 88'>Колонка</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_6' title='bbox 450 250 600 350; x_wconf 94'>1</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_7' title='bbox 650 250 900 350; x_wconf 89'>строка</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_8' title='bbox 910 250 950 350; x_wconf 90'>2</span>
                 </span>
                </p>
               </div>
               <!-- Column 2: Right column -->
               <div class='ocr_carea' id='block_1_2' title='bbox 1100 100 1900 800'>
                <p class='ocr_par' id='par_1_2' title='bbox 1100 100 1900 400'>
                 <span class='ocr_line' id='line_1_3' title='bbox 1100 100 1900 200; baseline 0 -12'>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_9' title='bbox 1100 100 1400 200; x_wconf 96'>Колонка</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_10' title='bbox 1450 100 1600 200; x_wconf 93'>2</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_11' title='bbox 1650 100 1900 200; x_wconf 91'>строка</span>
                  <span class='ocrx_word' id='word_1_12' title='bbox 1910 100 1950 200; x_wconf 92'>1</span>
                 </span>
                </p>
               </div>
              </div>
             </body>
            </html>
        """.trimIndent()

        val layout = HocrParser.parse(hocr)
        assertEquals(2000, layout.sourceWidthPx)
        assertEquals(1000, layout.sourceHeightPx)
        assertEquals(2, layout.blocks.size)

        val block1 = layout.blocks[0]
        val block2 = layout.blocks[1]
        assertEquals(0, block1.readingOrder)
        assertEquals(1, block2.readingOrder)
        assertEquals(2, block1.lines.size)
        assertEquals(1, block2.lines.size)

        // Baseline verification
        assertNotNull(block1.lines[0].baseline)
        assertEquals(0f, block1.lines[0].baseline?.slope)
        assertEquals(-10f, block1.lines[0].baseline?.intercept)

        // Verify plain text has Column 1 first, then Column 2 (not interleaved!)
        val plainText = layout.toPlainText()
        val expected = "Колонка 1 строка 1\nКолонка 1 строка 2\n\nКолонка 2 строка 1"
        assertEquals(expected, plainText)

        // Verify legacy geometry projection
        val geometry = layout.toLegacyGeometry()
        assertEquals(2000L, geometry.sourceWidthPx)
        assertEquals(1000L, geometry.sourceHeightPx)
        assertEquals(12, geometry.words.size)
        assertEquals("Колонка", geometry.words.first().text)
        assertEquals("1", geometry.words.last().text)
    }

    @Test
    fun parsesSemanticBlockTypesAndHtmlEntities() {
        val hocr = """
            <div class='ocr_page' title='bbox 0 0 1000 800'>
             <div class='ocr_header' id='hdr_1' title='bbox 50 20 950 80'>
              <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 50 20 950 80'>
               <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 50 20 300 80; x_wconf 98'>HEADER &amp; TITLE</span>
              </span>
             </div>
             <div class='ocr_carea' id='carea_1' title='bbox 50 100 950 600'>
              <p class='ocr_par' title='bbox 50 100 950 600'>
               <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 50 100 950 200'>
                <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 50 100 400 200; x_wconf 90'>Tom &quot;Cat&quot;</span>
               </span>
              </p>
             </div>
             <div class='ocr_footer' id='ftr_1' title='bbox 50 700 950 780'>
              <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 50 700 950 780'>
               <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 50 700 300 780; x_wconf 85'>Footer 1</span>
              </span>
             </div>
            </div>
        """.trimIndent()

        val layout = HocrParser.parse(hocr)
        assertEquals(3, layout.blocks.size)
        assertEquals(BlockType.HEADER, layout.blocks[0].type)
        assertEquals(BlockType.PARAGRAPH, layout.blocks[1].type)
        assertEquals(BlockType.FOOTER, layout.blocks[2].type)

        assertEquals("HEADER & TITLE", layout.blocks[0].lines[0].words[0].text)
        assertEquals("Tom \"Cat\"", layout.blocks[1].lines[0].words[0].text)
    }

    @Test
    fun nestedHeaderLinesAreEmittedOnceInDocumentOrder() {
        val hocr = """
            <div class='ocr_page' title='bbox 0 0 400 300'>
             <div class='ocr_carea' id='body' title='bbox 10 10 390 290'>
              <p class='ocr_par' id='body_par' title='bbox 10 10 390 290'>
               <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 10 10 390 50'>
                <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 10 100 50'>Before</span>
               </span>
               <div class='ocr_header' id='nested_header' title='bbox 10 60 390 100'>
                <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 10 60 390 100'>
                 <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 60 200 100'>INVOICE</span>
                </span>
               </div>
               <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 10 110 390 150'>
                <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 110 100 150'>After</span>
               </span>
              </p>
             </div>
            </div>
        """.trimIndent()

        val layout = HocrParser.parse(hocr)

        assertEquals(3, layout.blocks.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(BlockType.PARAGRAPH, BlockType.HEADER, BlockType.PARAGRAPH), layout.blocks.map { it.type })
        assertEquals(listOf("Before", "INVOICE", "After"), layout.blocks.flatMap { block ->
            block.lines.flatMap { line -> line.words.map { it.text } }
        })
        assertEquals("Before\n\nINVOICE\n\nAfter", layout.toPlainText())
    }

    @Test
    fun parsesStandaloneSemanticTextAndIgnoresPhotoAndSeparatorContent() {
        val hocr = """
            <div class='ocr_page' title='bbox 0 0 400 300'>
             <div class='ocr_header' id='header' title='bbox 10 10 390 50'>
              <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 10 150 50'>Header</span>
             </div>
             <div class='ocr_caption' id='caption' title='bbox 10 60 390 100'>
              <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 60 150 100'>Caption</span>
             </div>
             <div class='ocr_footer' id='footer' title='bbox 10 110 390 150'>
              <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 110 150 150'>Footer</span>
             </div>
             <div class='ocr_carea' id='body' title='bbox 10 160 390 290'>
              <p class='ocr_par' title='bbox 10 160 390 290'>
               <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 10 160 390 200'>
                <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 160 100 200'>Body</span>
               </span>
               <div class='ocr_photo' title='bbox 10 205 200 250'>
                <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 10 205 200 250'>
                 <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 205 200 250'>PhotoText</span>
                </span>
               </div>
               <div class='ocr_separator' title='bbox 10 255 390 260'>
                <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 10 255 390 260'>
                 <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 10 255 390 260'>SeparatorText</span>
                </span>
               </div>
              </p>
             </div>
            </div>
        """.trimIndent()

        val layout = HocrParser.parse(hocr)

        assertEquals(4, layout.blocks.size)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(BlockType.HEADER, BlockType.CAPTION, BlockType.FOOTER, BlockType.PARAGRAPH),
            layout.blocks.map { it.type },
        )
        assertEquals("Header\n\nCaption\n\nFooter\n\nBody", layout.toPlainText())
    }

    @Test
    fun handlesEmptyAndMalformedHocrGracefully() {
        val emptyLayout = HocrParser.parse("", fallbackWidthPx = 800, fallbackHeightPx = 600)
        assertEquals(800, emptyLayout.sourceWidthPx)
        assertEquals(600, emptyLayout.sourceHeightPx)
        assertTrue(emptyLayout.blocks.isEmpty())
        assertEquals("", emptyLayout.toPlainText())

        val malformedHocr = "<html><body><div>Just some raw text without hocr markup</div></body></html>"
        val malformedLayout = HocrParser.parse(malformedHocr, 100, 200)
        assertEquals(100, malformedLayout.sourceWidthPx)
        assertEquals(200, malformedLayout.sourceHeightPx)
        assertTrue(malformedLayout.blocks.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun testParseHocrSnippetFromPlan() {
        val hocr = """
            <div class='ocr_page' title='bbox 0 0 1000 1400'>
             <div class='ocr_carea' title='bbox 100 100 900 200'><p class='ocr_par' title='bbox 100 100 900 200'>
              <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 100 100 900 150'>
               <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 100 100 300 150; x_wconf 95'>Привет</span>
               <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 320 100 500 150; x_wconf 93'>мир</span></span>
              <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 100 160 900 200'>
               <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 100 160 400 200; x_wconf 90'>Вторая</span></span>
             </p></div>
             <div class='ocr_carea' title='bbox 100 300 900 350'><p class='ocr_par' title='bbox 100 300 900 350'>
              <span class='ocr_line' title='bbox 100 300 900 350'>
               <span class='ocrx_word' title='bbox 100 300 400 350; x_wconf 90'>Другой</span></span>
             </p></div></div>

        assertEquals("Привет мир\nВторая\n\nДругой", layout.toPlainText())
    }

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class LangDetectTest {
    @Test
    fun spanishParagraphDetectsEsEn() {
        val text = "El contrato de arrendamiento se firmó en la ciudad y las partes acordaron que el pago se hará por mes, con el fin de cumplir lo que se dijo en el documento"
        val result = LangDetect.decide(text)
        assertEquals(OcrLangProfile.ES_EN, result)
    }

    @Test
    fun englishParagraphReturnsNull() {
        val text = "The agreement was signed in the city and the parties agreed that the payment will be made by month in order to fulfill what was stated in the document"
        val result = LangDetect.decide(text)
        assertNull(result)
    }

        val text = "Договор аренды был подписан в городе и стороны согласились, что оплата будет производиться ежемесячно для выполнения условий документа"
        val result = LangDetect.decide(text)
        assertNull(result)
    }

    @Test
    fun mixedRussianAndSpanishReturnsRuEsEn() {
        val spanish = "El contrato de arrendamiento se firmó en la ciudad y las partes acordaron que el pago se hará por mes, con el fin de cumplir lo que se dijo en el documento. "
        val russian = "Договор аренды был подписан в городе и стороны согласились, что оплата будет производиться ежемесячно для выполнения условий документа."

        val result = LangDetect.decide(text)
        assertEquals(OcrLangProfile.RU_ES_EN, result)
    }

    }

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import app.docscan.core.store.BlockType
import app.docscan.core.store.Baseline
import app.docscan.core.store.LayoutQuality
import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock as RecognitionBlock
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine as RecognitionLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord as RecognitionWord
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionPayloadCodec
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class OcrLayoutConversionTest {
    @Test
    fun conversionsComputeAndPreserveConfidenceLanguageAndPlainText() {
        val words = listOf(
            OcrWord("Invoice", Bx(10, 10, 80, 30), 59f),
            OcrWord("42", Bx(85, 10, 105, 30), 90f),
        )
        val line = OcrLine(Bx(10, 10, 105, 30), words)
        val paragraph = OcrPara(line.box, listOf(line))
        val block = OcrBlock(line.box, listOf(paragraph))
        val extracted = OcrLayout(200, 100, listOf(block), lang = "eng", languageHints = setOf("eng", "spa"))

        val recognition = extracted.toRecognitionLayout()
        assertEquals(74.5f, recognition.quality?.meanConfidence ?: 0f, 0.001f)
        assertEquals(1, recognition.quality?.lowConfidenceWordCount)
        assertTrue(recognition.quality?.structureAvailable == true)
        assertEquals("eng", recognition.quality?.language)
        assertEquals(setOf("eng", "spa"), recognition.languageHints)
        assertEquals("Invoice 42", recognition.toPlainText())

        val restored = recognition.toOcrLayout()
        assertEquals(recognition.quality, restored.quality)
        assertEquals(recognition.languageHints, restored.languageHints)
        assertEquals("eng", restored.lang)
        assertEquals("Invoice 42", restored.toPlainText())
    }

    @Test
    fun providedQualityIsNotReplacedAndTextOnlyLayoutsKeepTheirText() {
        val suppliedQuality = LayoutQuality(
            meanConfidence = 31f,
            lowConfidenceWordCount = 7,
            structureAvailable = false,
            language = "spa",
            preprocessingProfile = "ADAPTIVE",
            engineVersion = "TESSERACT_5.5.1",
        )
        val recognition = RecognitionLayout(
            sourceWidthPx = 100,
            sourceHeightPx = 100,
            blocks = emptyList(),
            languageHints = setOf("spa", "eng"),
            quality = suppliedQuality,
            plainText = "Texto recognizado 2026",
        )

        val ocr = recognition.toOcrLayout()
        assertEquals("Texto recognizado 2026", ocr.toPlainText())
        assertEquals(suppliedQuality, ocr.quality)
        assertEquals(setOf("spa", "eng"), ocr.languageHints)
        assertEquals("Texto recognizado 2026", ocr.toRecognitionLayout().toPlainText())
        assertFalse(ocr.toRecognitionLayout().quality?.structureAvailable ?: true)

        val encoded = RecognitionPayloadCodec.encode("Fallback transcript", RecognitionLayout(100, 100, emptyList()))
        val decoded = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decode(encoded)
        assertEquals("Fallback transcript", decoded.text)
        assertEquals("Fallback transcript", decoded.layout?.plainText)
        assertEquals("Fallback transcript", decoded.ocrLayout?.toPlainText())
    }

    @Test
    fun scaledLayoutPreservesPlainTextQualityAndTransformsBaseline() {
        val quality = LayoutQuality(88f, 2, true, language = "eng", engineVersion = "UNKNOWN")
        val baseline = Baseline(slope = 0.5f, intercept = 4f)
        val line = OcrLine(
            Bx(10, 20, 50, 40),
            listOf(OcrWord("Text", Bx(10, 20, 40, 40), 88f)),
            baseline,
        )
        val original = OcrLayout(
            sourceW = 100,
            sourceH = 100,
            blocks = listOf(OcrBlock(Bx(10, 20, 50, 40), listOf(OcrPara(Bx(10, 20, 50, 40), listOf(line))))),
            lang = "eng",
            plainText = "Text fallback",
            quality = quality,
            languageHints = setOf("eng"),
        )

        val scaled = original.scaledTo(101, 100)

        assertEquals("Text fallback", scaled?.plainText)
        assertEquals(quality, scaled?.quality)
        assertEquals(setOf("eng"), scaled?.languageHints)
        assertEquals("eng", scaled?.lang)
        val scaledBaseline = scaled!!.blocks.single().paras.single().lines.single().baseline!!
        assertEquals(0.5f / 1.01f, scaledBaseline.slope, 0.0001f)
        assertEquals(4f, scaledBaseline.intercept, 0.0001f)
    }

    @Test
    fun textOnlyRecognitionLayoutPlainTextFallsBackWhenThereAreNoWords() {
        val emptyBlock = RecognitionBlock(
            id = "empty",
            type = BlockType.PARAGRAPH,
            box = NormalizedBox(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f),
            readingOrder = 0,
            paragraphs = listOf(
                OcrParagraph(
                    box = NormalizedBox(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f),
                    lines = listOf(RecognitionLine(
                        box = NormalizedBox(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f),
                        baseline = null,
                        xHeight = null,
                        words = emptyList(),
                    )),
                ),
            ),
        )
        val layout = RecognitionLayout(10, 10, listOf(emptyBlock), plainText = "No words, retained transcript")

        assertEquals("No words, retained transcript", layout.toPlainText())
        assertNull(layout.quality)
    }

    @Test
    fun completePdfTranscriptRemainsAuthoritativeWhenSomeGlyphBoxesAreAvailable() {
        val box = NormalizedBox(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.5f, 0.2f)
        val partialBlock = RecognitionBlock(
            id = "pdf-line-1",
            type = BlockType.TEXT,
            box = box,
            readingOrder = 0,
            paragraphs = listOf(OcrParagraph(box, listOf(RecognitionLine(
                box = box,
                baseline = null,
                xHeight = null,
                words = listOf(RecognitionWord("Coordinates", box, 100f)),
            )))),
        )
        val fullTranscript = "Coordinates for part of line\nAnd remaining PDF text without boxes"
        val recognition = RecognitionLayout(1000, 1400, listOf(partialBlock), plainText = fullTranscript)

        assertEquals(fullTranscript, recognition.toPlainText())
        assertEquals(fullTranscript, recognition.toOcrLayout().toPlainText())
        assertEquals(fullTranscript, recognition.toOcrLayout().toRecognitionLayout().toPlainText())
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class OcrQualitySelectorTest {
    @Test
    fun favorsAdditionalLettersAndDigitsWhenFirstPassTextIsRetained() {
        val first = layout("INVOICE 123", confidence = 72f)
        val second = layout("INVOICE 1234", confidence = 68f)

        assertEquals(second, OcrQualitySelector.choose(first, second))
    }

    @Test
    fun preservesBroadCharacterCoverageInsteadOfChoosingShorterHighConfidenceText() {
        val first = layout("INVOICE 12345", confidence = 61f)
        val second = layout("INVC 123", confidence = 99f)

        assertEquals(first, OcrQualitySelector.choose(first, second))
    }

    @Test
    fun usesConfidenceAndLanguageCompatibilityWhenCharacterCoverageIsEqual() {
        val expected = layout("Texto 42", confidence = 70f, language = "eng", hints = setOf("eng", "spa"))
        val mismatching = layout("Texto 42", confidence = 70f, language = "deu", hints = setOf("eng", "spa"))

        assertEquals(expected, OcrQualitySelector.choose(expected, mismatching))
        val higherConfidence = layout("Texto 42", confidence = 92f, language = "eng", hints = setOf("eng", "spa"))
        assertEquals(higherConfidence, OcrQualitySelector.choose(expected, higherConfidence))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyPassesKeepFirstAndSelectedPassRetainsAllOfItsWords() {
        val emptyFirst = OcrLayout(100, 100, emptyList())
        val emptySecond = OcrLayout(100, 100, emptyList(), plainText = "")
        assertEquals(emptyFirst, OcrQualitySelector.choose(emptyFirst, emptySecond))

        val first = layout("weak", confidence = 42f)
        val selected = layout("weak strong", confidence = 88f)
        val chosen = OcrQualitySelector.choose(first, selected)
        assertEquals(selected, chosen)
        assertEquals(listOf("weak", "strong"), chosen.words.map { it.text })
    }

    @Test
    fun shortSpanishDiacriticsAreDetectedButNumbersAreNotLanguageEvidence() {
        assertEquals(OcrLangProfile.ES_EN, LangDetect.decide("Niña café"))
        assertNull(LangDetect.decide("INV-2026 12345 90.25"))
    }

    @Test
    fun spanishDocumentWordsRouteAccentlessAutoOutputToSpanish() {
        assertEquals(
            OcrLangProfile.ES_EN,
            LangDetect.decide("Manana accion Nina café pinguino Numero 4821"),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun oneSpanishDocumentWordDoesNotRerouteOrdinaryEnglish() {
        assertNull(LangDetect.decide("The invoice is ready for factura number 4821"))
    }

    @Test
    fun credibleNumberIsPreservedWhenTheOtherPassChangesIt() {
        val first = layout("Total 42", confidence = 86f)
        val second = layout("Total 43", confidence = 93f)
        assertEquals(first, OcrQualitySelector.choose(first, second))
    }

    @Test
    fun lowConfidenceNumberCanBeCorrectedWhenSecondPassRecoversMoreContent() {
        val first = layout("Total 45", confidence = 45f)
        val second = layout("Total 90 Amount 4.50", confidence = 78f)
        assertEquals(second, OcrQualitySelector.choose(first, second))
    }

    @Test
    fun correctedDiacriticsKeepCharacterCoverageAndSpanishLanguageEvidence() {
        val first = layout("Nina cafe", confidence = 74f, language = "eng", hints = setOf("eng", "spa"))
        val corrected = layout("Niña café", confidence = 74f, language = "spa", hints = setOf("spa", "eng"))
        assertEquals(corrected, OcrQualitySelector.choose(first, corrected))
    }

    private fun layout(text: String, confidence: Float, language: String = "eng", hints: Set<String> = setOf("eng")): OcrLayout {
        val words = text.split(' ').filter(String::isNotBlank).mapIndexed { index, token ->
            OcrWord(token, Bx(index * 20, 10, index * 20 + 18, 30), confidence)
        }
        val line = OcrLine(Bx(0, 10, maxOf(1, words.size * 20), 30), words)
        val paragraph = OcrPara(line.box, listOf(line))
        val block = OcrBlock(line.box, listOf(paragraph))
        return OcrLayout(200, 100, listOf(block), lang = language, languageHints = hints)
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class OcrSanitizeTest {

    @Test
    fun testSanitizeOcrText() {
        assertEquals("ab", sanitizeOcrText("a\u200Bb"))
        assertEquals("", sanitizeOcrText("\u200B"))
        assertEquals("слово", sanitizeOcrText(" слово "))
    }

    @Test
    fun testClampBox() {
        // рамка с right = w + 1 даёт right = w
        val b1 = clampBox(10, 10, 101, 50, 100, 100)
        assertEquals(Bx(10, 10, 100, 50), b1)

        // рамка нулевой ширины l=5, r=5 даёт ширину 1
        val b2 = clampBox(5, 10, 5, 20, 100, 100)
        assertEquals(Bx(5, 10, 6, 20), b2)
        assertEquals(1, b2!!.r - b2.l)

        // w <= 1 or h <= 1 returns null
        assertNull(clampBox(0, 0, 10, 10, 1, 100))
        assertNull(clampBox(0, 0, 10, 10, 100, 1))
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/ocr/OcrTaskQueueTest.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.ocr

import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFailsWith
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class OcrTaskQueueTest {
    @Test
    fun `same request is deduplicated and newer request replaces running work`() {
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val releaseOld = CountDownLatch(1)
        val oldStarted = CountDownLatch(1)
        val newTaskRan = CountDownLatch(1)
        val stopped = AtomicInteger()
        try {
            val queue = OcrTaskQueue<String>(executor, stopActiveTask = {
                stopped.incrementAndGet()
                releaseOld.countDown()
            })
            assertTrue(queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "1:1:eng") { cancelled ->
                oldStarted.countDown()
                while (!cancelled()) releaseOld.await(10, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
            })
            assertTrue(oldStarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "The previous recognition must be active before replacement")
            assertFalse(queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "1:1:eng") { error("duplicate ran") })
            assertTrue(queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "1:1:rus") { newTaskRan.countDown() })

            assertTrue(newTaskRan.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            queue.await(listOf("page"), 2_000)
            assertEquals(1, stopped.get())
        } finally {
            releaseOld.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `replacement is not submitted until active native cancellation finishes`() {
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val caller = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val oldStarted = CountDownLatch(1)
        val stopEntered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val releaseStop = CountDownLatch(1)
        val replacementStarted = CountDownLatch(1)
        try {
            val queue = OcrTaskQueue<String>(executor, stopActiveTask = {
                stopEntered.countDown()
                releaseStop.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            })
            queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "old") { cancelled ->
                oldStarted.countDown()
                while (!cancelled()) Thread.yield()
            }
            assertTrue(oldStarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))

            val replacement = caller.submit<Boolean> {
                queue.enqueue("page", replaceExisting = true, requestKey = "new") {
                    replacementStarted.countDown()
                }
            }
            assertTrue(stopEntered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertFalse(
                replacementStarted.await(100, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS),
                "Replacement must remain queued until native stop returns",
            )
            releaseStop.countDown()

            assertTrue(replacement.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(replacementStarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            queue.await(listOf("page"), 2_000)
        } finally {
            releaseStop.countDown()
            caller.shutdownNow()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `replacement of pending work cancels only the old future`() {
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val releaseBlocker = CountDownLatch(1)
        val latestRan = CountDownLatch(1)
        val oldPendingRan = AtomicInteger()
        try {
            val queue = OcrTaskQueue<String>(executor, stopActiveTask = {})
            queue.enqueue("blocker") { releaseBlocker.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }
            queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "old") { oldPendingRan.incrementAndGet() }
            queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "new") { latestRan.countDown() }
            releaseBlocker.countDown()

            assertTrue(latestRan.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            queue.await(listOf("blocker", "page"), 2_000)
            assertEquals(0, oldPendingRan.get())
        } finally {
            releaseBlocker.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `await follows replacement and reports task failures`() {
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val releaseOld = CountDownLatch(1)
        val latestStarted = CountDownLatch(1)
        val releaseLatest = CountDownLatch(1)
        try {
            val queue = OcrTaskQueue<String>(executor, stopActiveTask = { releaseOld.countDown() })
            queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "old") { cancelled ->
                while (!cancelled()) releaseOld.await(10, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
            }

            val waiter = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
            try {
                val awaiting = waiter.submit { queue.await(listOf("page"), 2_000) }
                queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "latest") {
                    latestStarted.countDown()
                    releaseLatest.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                }
                assertTrue(latestStarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                assertFalse(awaiting.isDone)
                releaseLatest.countDown()
                awaiting.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            } finally {
                releaseLatest.countDown()
                waiter.shutdownNow()
            }

            queue.enqueue("failed", replaceExisting = true) { throw IllegalStateException("recognition failed") }
            assertFailsWith<IllegalStateException> { queue.await(listOf("failed"), 2_000) }
        } finally {
            releaseOld.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `await reports timeout and explicit cancellation`() {
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        try {
            val queue = OcrTaskQueue<String>(executor, stopActiveTask = { release.countDown() })
            queue.enqueue("page") { release.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }
            assertFailsWith<TimeoutException> { queue.await(listOf("page"), 1) }

            queue.cancel(listOf("page"))
            assertFailsWith<CancellationException> { queue.await(listOf("page"), 2_000) }
        } finally {
            release.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `completed failed request with same key can be retried`() {
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val retryRan = CountDownLatch(1)
        try {
            val queue = OcrTaskQueue<String>(executor, stopActiveTask = {})
            queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "1:2:eng") { throw IllegalStateException("first attempt failed") }
            assertFailsWith<IllegalStateException> { queue.await(listOf("page"), 2_000) }

            assertTrue(queue.enqueue("page", requestKey = "1:2:eng") { retryRan.countDown() })
            assertTrue(retryRan.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            queue.await(listOf("page"), 2_000)
        } finally {
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.recent

import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFailsWith
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class SavedPdfEditSessionTest {
    @Test
    fun reorderAndUndoReturnToCleanSourceOrder() {
        val session = SavedPdfEditSession(4)

        session.move(0, 2)

        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2, 0, 3), session.pageOrder)
        assertTrue(session.isDirty)
        assertTrue(session.undo())
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1, 2, 3), session.pageOrder)
        assertFalse(session.isDirty)
        assertFalse(session.canUndo)
    }

    @Test
    fun deleteAllDisablesSaveAndUndoRestoresPagesInOrder() {
        val session = SavedPdfEditSession(2)

        assertEquals(0, session.removeAt(0))
        assertEquals(-1, session.removeAt(0))
        assertFalse(session.canSave)
        assertTrue(session.isDirty)

        assertTrue(session.undo())
        assertEquals(listOf(1), session.pageOrder)
        assertTrue(session.canSave)
        assertTrue(session.undo())
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1), session.pageOrder)
        assertFalse(session.isDirty)
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidIndexesFailWithoutChangingTheDraft() {
        val session = SavedPdfEditSession(1)

        assertFailsWith<IllegalArgumentException> { SavedPdfEditSession(0) }
        assertFailsWith<IllegalArgumentException> { session.removeAt(1) }
        assertFailsWith<IllegalArgumentException> { session.move(0, 1) }
        assertEquals(listOf(0), session.pageOrder)
        assertFalse(session.isDirty)
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/schedule/HeavyWorkSchedulerTest.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.schedule

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class HeavyWorkSchedulerTest {
    @Test
    fun concurrentCallersNeverExceedSingleJobOrDecodedBudget() {
        val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler(maxConcurrentJobs = 1, decodedByteBudget = 100L)
        val pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8)
        val ready = CountDownLatch(8)
        val start = CountDownLatch(1)
        val finished = CountDownLatch(8)
        val active = AtomicInteger()
        val peak = AtomicInteger()

        repeat(8) {
            pool.execute {
                ready.countDown()
                start.await()
                scheduler.withAdmission(80L) {
                    val now = active.incrementAndGet()
                    peak.updateAndGet { current -> maxOf(current, now) }
                    Thread.sleep(10L)
                    active.decrementAndGet()
                }
                finished.countDown()
            }
        }
        assertTrue(ready.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        start.countDown()
        assertTrue(finished.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        pool.shutdownNow()
        assertEquals(1, peak.get())
    }

    @Test
    fun oversizedEstimateIsRejectedBeforeWorkStarts() {
        val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler(decodedByteBudget = 96L)
        var ran = false

        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            scheduler.withAdmission(97L) { ran = true }
        }

        assertEquals(false, ran)
    }

    @Test
    fun thrownWorkReleasesAdmissionForNextJob() {
        val scheduler = HeavyWorkScheduler(decodedByteBudget = 96L)

        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            scheduler.withAdmission(96L) { error("decode failed") }
        }
        assertEquals("ok", scheduler.withAdmission(96L) { "ok" })
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/AnchorYearResolverTest.kt

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import java.time.LocalDate
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertIs

class AnchorYearResolverTest {
    private val resolver = AnchorYearResolver()
    private val scan = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 13)

    private fun resolve(day: Int, month: Int, year: Int?, doc: LocalDate? = null, scanDate: LocalDate = scan) =
        resolver.resolve(DateValue(day, month, year), doc, scanDate)

    @Test fun printedYearIsUsed() {
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Resolved(LocalDate.of(2027, 3, 5), false), resolve(5, 3, 2027))
    }

    @Test fun printedYearOutOfRangeIsInvalid() {
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Invalid, resolve(5, 3, 1899))
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Invalid, resolve(5, 3, 2101))
    }

    @Test fun printedNonexistentDateIsInvalid() {
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Invalid, resolve(31, 2, 2026))
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Invalid, resolve(29, 2, 2027))
    }

    @Test fun nonexistentDateWithoutYearIsInvalid() {
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Invalid, resolve(31, 2, null))
    }

    @Test fun yearInferredFromDocumentDate() {
        val doc = LocalDate.of(2026, 3, 1)
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Resolved(LocalDate.of(2026, 4, 10), true), resolve(10, 4, null, doc))
    }

    @Test fun yearInferredFromScanDate() {
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Resolved(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 20), true), resolve(20, 12, null))
    }

    @Test fun decemberToJanuaryShiftsYear() {
        val doc = LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 15)
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Resolved(LocalDate.of(2027, 1, 10), true), resolve(10, 1, null, doc))
    }

    @Test fun januaryToDecemberShiftsYearBack() {
        val doc = LocalDate.of(2027, 1, 5)
        val result = resolve(28, 12, null, doc)
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Choice(listOf(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 28), LocalDate.of(2027, 12, 28))), result)
    }

    @Test fun dateBeforeAnchorGivesChoice() {
        val result = resolve(1, 11, null)
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Choice(listOf(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 1), LocalDate.of(2027, 11, 1))), result)
    }

    @Test fun dateEqualToAnchorIsResolved() {
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Resolved(scan, true), resolve(13, 11, null))
    }

    @Test fun leapDayInLeapAnchorYear() {
        val result = resolve(29, 2, null, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2028, 1, 10))
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Resolved(LocalDate.of(2028, 2, 29), true), result)
    }

    @Test fun leapDayInNonLeapAnchorYearUsesNeighbour() {
        // anchor 2027-12-20: 29.02.2027 does not exist, 2028 is leap and within 183 days.
        val result = resolve(29, 2, null, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2027, 12, 20))
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Resolved(LocalDate.of(2028, 2, 29), true), result)
    }

    @Test fun leapDayTooFarFromAnyLeapYearIsInvalid() {
        // anchor 2027-06-15: neighbours 2028-02-29 (259 days) and 2026 (non leap).
        assertEquals(YearResolution.Invalid, resolve(29, 2, null, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2027, 6, 15)))
    }

    @Test fun choiceDropsNonexistentLeapOption() {
        // anchor 2028-03-10: 29.02.2028 is before anchor, 29.02.2029 does not exist.
        val result = resolve(29, 2, null, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2028, 3, 10))
        assertIs<YearResolution.Choice>(result)
        assertEquals(listOf(LocalDate.of(2028, 2, 29)), result.options)
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class KeywordPageEventRulesTest {
    private val rules = KeywordPageEventRules()

    private class Builder(val lang: SemanticLanguage?, val text: String) {
        val candidates = mutableListOf<Candidate>()
        val page: CanonicalPage
        init {
            val lines = mutableListOf<CanonicalLine>()
            var pos = 0
            for (line in text.split('\n')) {
                lines += CanonicalLine(TextRange(pos, pos + line.length))
                pos += line.length + 1
            }
            page = CanonicalPage(0, text, lines, emptyList(), lang)
        }

        private fun add(raw: String, value: CandidateValue, nth: Int, flags: Set<CandidateFlag>): Int {
            var idx = -1
            repeat(nth + 1) { idx = text.indexOf(raw, idx + 1) }
            require(idx >= 0) { "'$raw' not found" }
            val id = candidates.size
            candidates += Candidate(id, 0, TextRange(idx, idx + raw.length), raw, value, null, 1f, flags)
            return id
        }

        fun date(raw: String, d: Int, m: Int, y: Int? = null, nth: Int = 0) = add(raw, DateValue(d, m, y), nth, emptySet())
        fun time(raw: String, h: Int, min: Int, nth: Int = 0, flags: Set<CandidateFlag> = emptySet()) =
            add(raw, TimeValue(h, min), nth, flags)

        fun analyze(rules: PageEventRules) = rules.analyze(page, candidates)
    }

    private fun ru(text: String) = Builder(SemanticLanguage.RU, text)
    private fun es(text: String) = Builder(SemanticLanguage.ES, text)

    // ---------- Russian ----------

    @Test fun ruAppointmentWithTime() {
        val b = ru("Приём назначен на 05.03.2026 в 10:30")
        val d = b.date("05.03.2026", 5, 3, 2026); val t = b.time("10:30", 10, 30)
        val a = b.analyze(rules)
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START, a.roles[d])
        assertEquals(null, a.roles[t])
        val e = a.events.single()
        assertEquals(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, e.kind)
        assertEquals(EventStatus.CONFIRMED, e.status)
        assertEquals(d, e.dateCandidateId); assertEquals(t, e.timeCandidateId)
    }

    @Test fun ruBirthIssueAppointment() {
        val b = ru("Дата рождения: 01.02.1980\nВыдан 10.10.2020\nПриём 05.03.2026 в 09:00")
        val birth = b.date("01.02.1980", 1, 2, 1980); val issue = b.date("10.10.2020", 10, 10, 2020)
        val appt = b.date("05.03.2026", 5, 3, 2026); val t = b.time("09:00", 9, 0)
        val a = b.analyze(rules)
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE, a.roles[birth])
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE, a.roles[issue])
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START, a.roles[appt])
        val e = a.events.single()
        assertEquals(appt, e.dateCandidateId); assertEquals(t, e.timeCandidateId)
    }

    @Test fun ruBirthSuffixAndOtIssue() {
        val b = ru("Иванов, 01.02.1980 г. р.\nСправка от 03.04.2021")
        val birth = b.date("01.02.1980", 1, 2, 1980); val issue = b.date("03.04.2021", 3, 4, 2021)
        val a = b.analyze(rules)
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE, a.roles[birth])
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE, a.roles[issue])
        assertTrue(a.events.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun ruCancelled() {
        val b = ru("Приём 05.03.2026 в 10:00 отменён")
        b.date("05.03.2026", 5, 3, 2026); b.time("10:00", 10, 0)

    }

    }

        b.date("05.03.2026", 5, 3, 2026); b.time("10:00", 10, 0)
        assertEquals(EventStatus.TENTATIVE, b.analyze(rules).events.single().status)
    }

    @Test fun ruTentativeBeatsRescheduledButCancelBeatsAll() {

        assertEquals(EventStatus.TENTATIVE, b.analyze(rules).events.single().status)
        val c = ru("Приём перенесён на 06.03.2026, предварительно, отменён")

    }

    }

    @Test fun esDueDate() {
        val b = es("Fecha límite de pago: 15/03/2026")
        val d = b.date("15/03/2026", 15, 3, 2026)
        val e = b.analyze(rules).events.single()
        assertEquals(EventKind.DEADLINE, e.kind); assertEquals(d, e.dateCandidateId)
    }

    @Test fun esCancelMarkerOnSeparateLine() {
        val b = es("Cita 05/03/2026 10:00\nQueda sin efecto")
        b.date("05/03/2026", 5, 3, 2026); b.time("10:00", 10, 0)
        assertEquals(EventStatus.UNKNOWN, b.analyze(rules).events.single().status)
    }

    @Test fun esNoKeywords() {
        val b = es("Reunión 05/03/2026 10:00")
        val d = b.date("05/03/2026", 5, 3, 2026); b.time("10:00", 10, 0)
        val a = b.analyze(rules)
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER, a.roles[d]); assertTrue(a.events.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun esTwoTimesAndNextLineAndCells() {
        val two = es("Cita 05/03/2026 a las 10:00 o 14:00")
        two.date("05/03/2026", 5, 3, 2026); val t1 = two.time("10:00", 10, 0); val t2 = two.time("14:00", 14, 0)
        assertEquals(listOf(t1, t2), two.analyze(rules).events.single().timeOptions)

        val next = es("Cita 05/03/2026\nHora: 10:00")
        next.date("05/03/2026", 5, 3, 2026); val t = next.time("10:00", 10, 0)
        assertEquals(t, next.analyze(rules).events.single().timeCandidateId)

        val cells = es("Fecha de nacimiento | 01/02/1980 | Cita | 05/03/2026 | 10:00")
        val birth = cells.date("01/02/1980", 1, 2, 1980); val appt = cells.date("05/03/2026", 5, 3, 2026)
        val ct = cells.time("10:00", 10, 0)
        val a = cells.analyze(rules)
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE, a.roles[birth]); assertEquals(CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START, a.roles[appt])
        assertEquals(ct, a.events.single().timeCandidateId)
    }

    @Test fun esWordBoundaries() {
        val b = es("Citado 05/03/2026\nConsultar 06/03/2026\nCita 07/03/2026")
        val d1 = b.date("05/03/2026", 5, 3, 2026); val d2 = b.date("06/03/2026", 6, 3, 2026)
        val d3 = b.date("07/03/2026", 7, 3, 2026)
        val a = b.analyze(rules)
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER, a.roles[d1])
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.NO_ANSWER, a.roles[d2])
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START, a.roles[d3])
        assertEquals(d3, a.events.single().dateCandidateId)
    }

    @Test fun equalDistanceDifferentRolesIsNoAnswer() {
        val b = ru("Срок приёма 05.03.2026")
        val d = b.date("05.03.2026", 5, 3, 2026)
        // "приёма" is nearest: single role. Add a case with two roles at the same distance via overlap.
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.APPOINTMENT_START, b.analyze(rules).roles[d])
        val c = ru("Дата рождения Выдан 05.03.2026")
        val d2 = c.date("05.03.2026", 5, 3, 2026)
        assertEquals(CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE, c.analyze(rules).roles[d2])
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/LayoutCanonicalTextBuilderTest.kt

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.Baseline
import app.docscan.core.store.BlockType
import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class LayoutCanonicalTextBuilderTest {
    private val builder = LayoutCanonicalTextBuilder { SemanticLanguage.RU }

    private fun box(l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float) = NormalizedBox(l, t, r, b)

    private fun word(text: String, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, c: Float = 0.9f) =
        OcrWord(text, box(l, t, r, b), c)

    private fun line(vararg words: OcrWord, baseline: Baseline? = null): OcrLine {
        val b = box(words.minOf { it.box.left }, words.minOf { it.box.top }, words.maxOf { it.box.right }, words.maxOf { it.box.bottom })
        return OcrLine(b, baseline, null, words.toList())
    }

    private fun block(order: Int, vararg lines: OcrLine): OcrBlock {
        val b = box(lines.minOf { it.box.left }, lines.minOf { it.box.top }, lines.maxOf { it.box.right }, lines.maxOf { it.box.bottom })
        return OcrBlock("b$order", BlockType.TEXT, b, order, listOf(OcrParagraph(b, lines.toList())))
    }

    private fun layout(vararg blocks: OcrBlock) = RecognitionLayout(1000, 1000, blocks.toList())

    private fun assertInvariant(page: CanonicalPage, expected: List<String>) {
        assertEquals(expected, page.words.map { it.range.substring(page.text) })
        page.lines.forEach { assertTrue('\n' !in it.range.substring(page.text)) }
    }

    @Test fun emptyLayout() {
        val page = builder.build(3, layout())
        assertEquals("", page.text)
        assertTrue(page.lines.isEmpty() && page.words.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(3, page.pageIndex)
    }

    @Test fun blankWordsSkipped() {
        val page = builder.build(0, layout(block(0, line(word("a", 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.15f), word("", 0.3f, 0.1f, 0.4f, 0.15f), word("b", 0.5f, 0.1f, 0.6f, 0.15f)))))
        assertEquals("a b", page.text)
        assertInvariant(page, listOf("a", "b"))
    }

    @Test fun twoColumnsJoinedBySeparator() {
        val left = block(0, line(word("Дата", 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.14f), word("приёма", 0.22f, 0.1f, 0.35f, 0.14f)))
        val right = block(1, line(word("14:30", 0.6f, 0.1f, 0.7f, 0.14f)))
        val page = builder.build(0, layout(right, left))
        assertEquals("Дата приёма | 14:30", page.text)
        assertEquals(1, page.lines.size)
        assertInvariant(page, listOf("Дата", "приёма", "14:30"))
    }

    @Test fun differentHeightsNotJoined() {
        val a = block(0, line(word("one", 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.14f)))
        val b = block(1, line(word("two", 0.6f, 0.3f, 0.7f, 0.34f)))
        val page = builder.build(0, layout(a, b))
        assertEquals("one\ntwo", page.text)
        assertEquals(2, page.lines.size)
    }

    @Test fun tiltTwoDegreesJoins() {
        // 0.5 page width apart, 2 degrees: ~17.5 px shift, line height 20 px.
        val a = block(0, line(word("left", 0.1f, 0.100f, 0.2f, 0.120f)))
        val b = block(1, line(word("right", 0.6f, 0.118f, 0.7f, 0.138f)))
        val page = builder.build(0, layout(a, b))
        assertEquals("left | right", page.text)
    }

    @Test fun tiltUsesBaselineSlope() {
        val s = 0.1f // steeper than 3 degrees, declared by the baseline
        val a = block(0, line(word("left", 0.1f, 0.100f, 0.2f, 0.120f), baseline = Baseline(s, 0f)))
        val b = block(1, line(word("right", 0.6f, 0.150f, 0.7f, 0.170f), baseline = Baseline(s, 0f)))
        assertEquals("left | right", builder.build(0, layout(a, b)).text)
        val flat = block(0, line(word("left", 0.1f, 0.100f, 0.2f, 0.120f)))
        val c = block(1, line(word("right", 0.6f, 0.150f, 0.7f, 0.170f)))
        assertEquals("left\nright", builder.build(0, layout(flat, c)).text)
    }

    @Test fun emojiAndSurrogatePairs() {
        val page = builder.build(0, layout(block(0,
            line(word("😀📅", 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.14f), word("18.11", 0.22f, 0.1f, 0.3f, 0.14f)),
            line(word("𝒳y", 0.1f, 0.3f, 0.2f, 0.34f)))))
        assertEquals("😀📅 18.11\n𝒳y", page.text)
        assertEquals(TextRange(0, 4), page.words[0].range)
        assertEquals(TextRange(5, 10), page.words[1].range)
        assertInvariant(page, listOf("😀📅", "18.11", "𝒳y"))
    }

    @Test fun cyrillicWithDiacritics() {
        val page = builder.build(0, layout(block(0, line(word("ёлка́", 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.14f), word("Ñandú", 0.3f, 0.1f, 0.4f, 0.14f)))))
        assertEquals("ёлка́ Ñandú", page.text)
        assertInvariant(page, listOf("ёлка́", "Ñandú"))
    }

    @Test fun languageFromDetector() {
        val b = LayoutCanonicalTextBuilder { null }
        assertNull(b.build(0, layout(block(0, line(word("x", 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.14f))))).language)
        assertEquals(SemanticLanguage.RU, builder.build(0, layout()).language)
    }

    @Test fun rowsOrderedTopToBottomAndCarryConfidence() {
        val low = block(0, line(word("bottom", 0.1f, 0.5f, 0.2f, 0.54f, 0.3f)))
        val top = block(1, line(word("top", 0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.14f)))
        val page = builder.build(0, layout(low, top))
        assertEquals("top\nbottom", page.text)
        assertEquals(0.3f, page.words[1].confidence)
        assertEquals(TextRange(4, 10), page.lines[1].range)
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNull

class PageCandidateExtractorTest {
    private fun w(start: Int, end: Int, l: Float, r: Float, c: Float, t: Float = 0.1f, b: Float = 0.2f) =
        CanonicalWord(TextRange(start, end), NormalizedBox(l, t, r, b), c)

    // "cita 18.11 14:30\nfin"
    private val text = "cita 18.11 14:30\nfin"
    private val page = CanonicalPage(
        2, text, listOf(CanonicalLine(TextRange(0, 16)), CanonicalLine(TextRange(17, 20))),
        listOf(w(0, 4, 0.0f, 0.1f, 0.9f), w(5, 10, 0.2f, 0.3f, 0.95f, 0.1f, 0.2f), w(11, 16, 0.4f, 0.5f, 0.6f, 0.12f, 0.25f), w(17, 20, 0.0f, 0.1f, 0.9f, 0.5f, 0.6f)),
        SemanticLanguage.ES,
    )

    private fun grammar(vararg matches: GrammarMatch) = object : DateTimeGrammar {
        override val language = SemanticLanguage.ES
        override fun find(text: String) = matches.toList()
    }

    private val date = DateValue(18, 11, null)

    @Test fun boxConfidenceAndFlags() {
        val flags = setOf(CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION)
        val result = PageCandidateExtractor().extract(page, grammar(GrammarMatch(TextRange(5, 16), date, flags)))
        val c = result.single()
        assertEquals(0, c.id)
        assertEquals(2, c.pageIndex)
        assertEquals("18.11 14:30", c.raw)
        assertEquals(NormalizedBox(0.2f, 0.1f, 0.5f, 0.25f), c.box)
        assertEquals(0.6f, c.minConfidence)
        assertEquals(flags, c.flags)
        assertEquals(true, c.needsCropConfirmation)
    }

    @Test fun partialWordOverlapCounts() {
        val c = PageCandidateExtractor().extract(page, grammar(GrammarMatch(TextRange(6, 8), date))).single()
        assertEquals(NormalizedBox(0.2f, 0.1f, 0.3f, 0.2f), c.box)
        assertEquals(0.95f, c.minConfidence)
    }

    @Test fun noWordsGivesNullBoxAndFullConfidence() {
        val bare = page.copy(words = emptyList())
        val c = PageCandidateExtractor().extract(bare, grammar(GrammarMatch(TextRange(5, 10), date))).single()
        assertNull(c.box)
        assertEquals(1.0f, c.minConfidence)
    }

    @Test fun invalidRangesDropped() {
        val result = PageCandidateExtractor().extract(
            page,
            grammar(
                GrammarMatch(TextRange(5, 10), date),
                GrammarMatch(TextRange(14, 19), date),   // crosses '\n'
                GrammarMatch(TextRange(18, 25), date),   // outside the text
                GrammarMatch(TextRange(11, 16), TimeValue(14, 30)),
            ),
        )
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1), result.map { it.id })
        assertEquals(listOf("18.11", "14:30"), result.map { it.raw })
    }

    @Test fun emptyWhenNoMatches() {
        assertEquals(emptyList(), PageCandidateExtractor().extract(page, grammar()))
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/RuleDocumentAssemblerTest.kt

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalTime
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class RuleDocumentAssemblerTest {
    private val assembler = RuleDocumentAssembler(AnchorYearResolver())
    private val scan = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 13)
    private val titles: (PageAnalysis, PageEvent) -> String = { a, e -> "t${a.page.pageIndex}-${e.anchorLine.start}" }

    private class Builder(val pageIndex: Int, val text: String) {
        val candidates = ArrayList<Candidate>()
        val roles = HashMap<Int, CandidateRole>()
        val events = ArrayList<PageEvent>()

        fun date(raw: String, day: Int, month: Int, year: Int?, role: CandidateRole = CandidateRole.OTHER,
                 conf: Float = 0.95f, flags: Set<CandidateFlag> = emptySet()): Int =
            add(raw, DateValue(day, month, year), role, conf, flags)

        fun time(raw: String, h: Int, m: Int, conf: Float = 0.95f, flags: Set<CandidateFlag> = emptySet()): Int =
            add(raw, TimeValue(h, m), CandidateRole.OTHER, conf, flags)

        private fun add(raw: String, v: CandidateValue, role: CandidateRole, conf: Float, flags: Set<CandidateFlag>): Int {
            val start = text.indexOf(raw)
            require(start >= 0) { "'$raw' not in '$text'" }
            val id = candidates.size
            candidates.add(Candidate(id, pageIndex, TextRange(start, start + raw.length), raw, v,
                NormalizedBox(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.2f, 0.2f), conf, flags))
            roles[id] = role
            return id
        }

        fun event(kind: EventKind, status: EventStatus = EventStatus.CONFIRMED, date: Int? = null, dateOptions: List<Int> = emptyList(),
                  time: Int? = null, timeOptions: List<Int> = emptyList(), anchor: Int = 0) {
            events.add(PageEvent(kind, status, date, dateOptions, time, timeOptions, TextRange(anchor, anchor + 1)))
        }

        fun build() = PageAnalysis(
            CanonicalPage(pageIndex, text, listOf(CanonicalLine(TextRange(0, text.length))), emptyList(), SemanticLanguage.RU),
            candidates, roles, events,
        )
    }

    private fun page(text: String = "Приём 20.12.2026 в 10:30 справка 01.12.2026 рождения 05.05.1980 21.12.2026 11:00", index: Int = 0,
                     block: Builder.() -> Unit): PageAnalysis = Builder(index, text).apply(block).build()

    private fun run(vararg pages: PageAnalysis, scanDate: LocalDate = scan) = assembler.assemble(pages.toList(), titles, scanDate)

    private fun appointment(b: Builder, status: EventStatus = EventStatus.CONFIRMED, anchor: Int = 0,
                            date: String = "20.12.2026", time: String = "10:30") {
        val (d, m, y) = date.split(".").map { it.toInt() }
        val (h, mi) = time.split(":").map { it.toInt() }
        b.event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, status, date = b.date(date, d, m, y), time = b.time(time, h, mi), anchor = anchor)
    }

    @Test fun printedYearFilled() {
        val result = run(page { appointment(this) })
        assertEquals(1, result.size)
        val p = result.single()
        assertEquals(ProposalKind.EVENT, p.kind)
        assertEquals(ProposalState.FILLED, p.state)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 20), p.date!!.date)
        assertEquals(false, p.date!!.yearInferred)
        assertEquals(LocalTime.of(10, 30), p.time!!.time)
        assertEquals("t0-0", p.title)
    }

    @Test fun yearInferredFromDocumentDate() {
        val a = page("Дата 01.12.2026 приём 20.12 в 10:30") {
            date("01.12.2026", 1, 12, 2026, CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("20.12", 20, 12, null), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        val p = run(a).single()
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 20), p.date!!.date)
        assertEquals(true, p.date!!.yearInferred)
    }

    @Test fun yearInferredFromScanDate() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.12 в 10:30") {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("20.12", 20, 12, null), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 20), run(a).single().date!!.date)
    }

    @Test fun decemberToJanuary() {
        val a = page("Дата 15.12.2026 приём 10.01 в 10:30") {
            date("15.12.2026", 15, 12, 2026, CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("10.01", 10, 1, null), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        val p = run(a, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 15)).single()
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2027, 1, 10), p.date!!.date)
        assertEquals(ProposalState.FILLED, p.state)
    }

    @Test fun dateBeforeAnchorGivesChoice() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.11 в 10:30") {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("20.11", 20, 11, null), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        val p = run(a, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 25)).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, p.state)
        assertNull(p.date)
        assertEquals(listOf(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 20), LocalDate.of(2027, 11, 20)), p.dateOptions.map { it.date })
        assertEquals(LocalTime.of(10, 30), p.time!!.time)
    }

    @Test fun leapDay() {
        val a = page("Приём 29.02 в 10:30") {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("29.02", 29, 2, null), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        val p = run(a, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2028, 1, 10)).single()
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2028, 2, 29), p.date!!.date)
    }

    @Test fun invalidDateDropped() {
        val a = page("Приём 31.02 в 10:30") {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("31.02", 31, 2, null), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        assertTrue(run(a).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun plantedCandidateIdsDropEvents() {
        val a0 = page { appointment(this) }
        val base = a0.events.single()
        val unknownIds = (100..114).toList()
        val wrongType = listOf(
            base.copy(dateCandidateId = base.timeCandidateId),   // time used as date
            base.copy(timeCandidateId = base.dateCandidateId),   // date used as time
        )
        val events = ArrayList<PageEvent>()
        for (id in unknownIds) {
            events.add(base.copy(dateCandidateId = id))
            events.add(base.copy(timeCandidateId = id + 1000))
        }
        events.addAll(wrongType)
        for (n in 0 until 9) {
            events.add(base.copy(dateCandidateId = null, dateOptions = listOf(base.dateCandidateId!!, 500 + n)))
            events.add(base.copy(timeCandidateId = null, timeOptions = listOf(base.timeCandidateId!!, 600 + n)))
        }
        assertEquals(50, events.size)
        var dropped = 0
        for (e in events) {
            if (run(a0.copy(events = listOf(e))).isEmpty()) dropped++
        }
        assertEquals(50, dropped)
    }

    @Test fun rawMismatchDropsEvent() {
        val a = page { appointment(this) }
        val bad = a.candidates.map { if (it.value is DateValue) it.copy(raw = "20.12.2027") else it }
        assertTrue(run(a.copy(candidates = bad)).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun rawMismatchRemovesOneOption() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.12.2026 или 21.12.2026 в 10:30") {
            val d1 = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026)
            val d2 = date("21.12.2026", 21, 12, 2026)
            val t = time("10:30", 10, 30)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, dateOptions = listOf(d1, d2), time = t)
        }
        val broken = a.candidates.map { if (it.id == 1) it.copy(raw = "22.12.2026") else it }
        val p = run(a.copy(candidates = broken)).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, p.state)
        assertEquals(listOf(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 20)), p.dateOptions.map { it.date })
        assertNull(p.date)
    }

    @Test fun dateBeforeDocumentDateDropped() {
        val a = page("Дата 10.12.2026 приём 05.12.2026 в 10:30") {
            date("10.12.2026", 10, 12, 2026, CandidateRole.ISSUE_DATE)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("05.12.2026", 5, 12, 2026), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        assertTrue(run(a, scanDate = LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 11)).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun birthDateDropped() {
        val a = page("Рожд 20.12.2026 приём 20.12.2026 в 10:30") {
            date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026, CandidateRole.BIRTH_DATE)
            val d = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = d, time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        // Both candidates share the first occurrence range; second one gets same raw, still matches text.
        assertTrue(run(a).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun outsideWindowDropped() {
        val far = page("Приём 20.12.2029 в 10:30") {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("20.12.2029", 20, 12, 2029), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        assertTrue(run(far).isEmpty())
        val past = page("Приём 01.01.2026 в 10:30") {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("01.01.2026", 1, 1, 2026), time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        assertTrue(run(past).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun deadlineWindowIsWiderThanEvent() {
        val a = page("Срок до 20.12.2029") {
            event(EventKind.DEADLINE, date = date("20.12.2029", 20, 12, 2029))
        }
        val p = run(a).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalKind.TASK, p.kind)
        assertEquals(ProposalState.FILLED, p.state)
        assertNull(p.time)
    }

    @Test fun cancelledGivesNothing() {
        assertTrue(run(page { appointment(this, EventStatus.CANCELLED) }).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun tentativeGivesEmptyProposal() {
        val p = run(page { appointment(this, EventStatus.TENTATIVE) }).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.EMPTY, p.state)
        assertNull(p.date); assertNull(p.time)
        assertTrue(p.dateOptions.isEmpty() && p.timeOptions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun appointmentWithoutTimeGivesNothing() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.12.2026") {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026))
        }
        assertTrue(run(a).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun twoTimeOptionsNeedChoice() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.12.2026 10:30 или 11:30") {
            val d = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = d, timeOptions = listOf(time("10:30", 10, 30), time("11:30", 11, 30)))
        }
        val p = run(a).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, p.state)
        assertNull(p.time)
        assertEquals(2, p.timeOptions.size)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 20), p.date!!.date)
    }

    @Test fun singleRemainingOptionIsNotAutoSelected() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.12.2026 10:30 или 11:30") {
            val d = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = d, timeOptions = listOf(time("10:30", 10, 30), time("11:30", 11, 30)))
        }
        val broken = a.candidates.map { if (it.id == 2) it.copy(raw = "99:99") else it }
        val p = run(a.copy(candidates = broken)).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.NEEDS_CHOICE, p.state)
        assertNull(p.time)
        assertEquals(listOf(LocalTime.of(10, 30)), p.timeOptions.map { it.time })
    }

    @Test fun homoglyphGivesLowQuality() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.12.2026 в 1O:30") {
            val d = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = d, time = time("1O:30", 10, 30, flags = setOf(CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION)))
        }
        val p = run(a).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY, p.state)
        assertEquals(LocalTime.of(10, 30), p.time!!.time)
        assertTrue(p.time!!.sources.single().needsCropConfirmation)
    }

    @Test fun lowConfidenceGivesLowQuality() {
        val a = page("Приём 20.12.2026 в 10:30") {
            val d = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026, conf = 0.5f)
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = d, time = time("10:30", 10, 30))
        }
        assertEquals(ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY, run(a).single().state)
    }

    @Test fun mergeSameEventFromTwoPages() {
        val p0 = page("Приём 20.12.2026 в 10:30", 0) { appointment(this) }
        val p1 = page("Напоминание: 20.12.2026 в 10:30", 1) {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, date = date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026), time = time("10:30", 10, 30, conf = 0.4f))
        }
        val r = run(p0, p1)
        assertEquals(1, r.size)
        val p = r.single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY, p.state)
        assertEquals(2, p.date!!.sources.size)
        assertEquals(2, p.time!!.sources.size)
        assertEquals("t0-0", p.title)
    }

    @Test fun cancelOnSecondPageRemovesFirst() {
        val p0 = page("Приём 20.12.2026 в 10:30", 0) { appointment(this) }
        val p1 = page("Приём отменён 20.12.2026 в 10:30", 1) {
            event(EventKind.APPOINTMENT, EventStatus.CANCELLED, date("20.12.2026", 20, 12, 2026), emptyList(), time("10:30", 10, 30), emptyList())
        }
        assertTrue(run(p0, p1).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun differentDatesGiveTwoProposals() {
        val p0 = page("Приём 20.12.2026 в 10:30", 0) { appointment(this) }
        val p1 = page("Приём 21.12.2026 в 10:30", 1) { appointment(this, date = "21.12.2026") }
        val r = run(p0, p1)
        assertEquals(2, r.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 20), LocalDate.of(2026, 12, 21)), r.map { it.date!!.date })
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/RussianDateTimeGrammarTest.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.random.Random
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class RussianDateTimeGrammarTest {
    private val grammar = RussianDateTimeGrammar()

    private class Row(val line: Int, val phrase: String, val expected: String)

    private fun rows(): List<Row> {
        val stream = checkNotNull(javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/semantic/ru_datetime_phrases.tsv")) { "TSV resource not found" }
        val lines = stream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).readLines()
        return lines.mapIndexedNotNull { index, line ->
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) return@mapIndexedNotNull null
            val tab = line.indexOf('\t')
            require(tab >= 0) { "Line ${index + 1}: no TAB" }
            Row(index + 1, line.substring(0, tab), line.substring(tab + 1))
        }
    }

    /** Expected-side notation: D:dd.mm.yyyy|-, T:hh:mm, '!' homoglyph, '~' range start; joined by ';'. */
    private fun describe(match: GrammarMatch): String {
        val value = when (val v = match.value) {
            is DateValue -> "D:%02d.%02d.%s".format(v.day, v.month, v.year?.let { "%04d".format(it) } ?: "-")
            is TimeValue -> "T:%02d:%02d".format(v.hour, v.minute)
        }
        val homoglyph = if (CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION in match.flags) "!" else ""
        val range = if (CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START in match.flags) "~" else ""
        return value + homoglyph + range
    }

    private fun describe(text: String): String = grammar.find(text).joinToString(";") { describe(it) }

    private fun checkInvariants(text: String, matches: List<GrammarMatch>) {
        var lastEnd = 0
        for (match in matches) {
            assertTrue(match.range.start >= lastEnd, "overlap or order in '$text': $matches")
            assertTrue(match.range.endExclusive <= text.length, "range outside '$text'")
            assertTrue(match.range.length > 0, "empty range in '$text'")
            val piece = match.range.substring(text)
            assertTrue(piece == piece.trim(), "range of '$text' has whitespace at its border: '$piece'")
            lastEnd = match.range.endExclusive
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun phraseTableMatchesExpectedValues() {
        val failures = ArrayList<String>()
        for (row in rows()) {
            val matches = grammar.find(row.phrase)
            val actual = matches.joinToString(";") { describe(it) }
            if (actual != row.expected) failures += "line ${row.line}: '${row.phrase}' expected '${row.expected}' actual '$actual'"
            runCatching { checkInvariants(row.phrase, matches) }.onFailure { failures += "line ${row.line}: ${it.message}" }
        }
        assertTrue(failures.isEmpty(), "Failed rows (${failures.size}):\n" + failures.joinToString("\n"))
    }

    @Test
    fun phraseTableIsLargeEnoughAndCoversRequiredGroups() {
        val rows = rows()
        assertTrue(rows.size >= 300, "phrases: ${rows.size}")
        assertTrue(rows.count { it.expected.isEmpty() } >= 60, "negative rows")
        assertTrue(rows.count { it.expected.contains('!') } >= 30, "homoglyph rows")
        val monthForms = listOf(
            "января", "февраля", "марта", "апреля", "мая", "июня", "июля", "августа", "сентября", "октября", "ноября", "декабря",
            "янв", "февр", "фев", "мар", "апр", "июн", "июл", "авг", "сент", "сен", "окт", "нояб", "ноя", "дек",
        )
        for (form in monthForms) {
            assertTrue(rows.any { it.expected.startsWith("D:") && it.phrase.lowercase().contains(" $form") }, "month form not covered: $form")
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rangesAreFixedForDates() {
        fun covered(text: String): List<String> = grammar.find(text).map { it.range.substring(text) }
        assertEquals(listOf("18 ноября 2026 г."), covered("Явка 18 ноября 2026 г."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 ноября 2026 года"), covered("Явка 18 ноября 2026 года."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 ноября"), covered("Явка 18 ноября."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 нояб."), covered("вт, 18 нояб."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 нояб. 2026"), covered("18 нояб. 2026"))
        assertEquals(listOf("18.11.2026"), covered("до 18.11.2026."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18.11.2026 г."), covered("до 18.11.2026 г."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18.11.26"), covered("(18.11.26)"))
    }

    @Test
    fun rangesAreFixedForTimes() {
        fun covered(text: String): List<String> = grammar.find(text).map { it.range.substring(text) }
        assertEquals(listOf("14:30"), covered("Явка в 14:30."))
        assertEquals(listOf("14.30"), covered("в 14.30"))
        assertEquals(listOf("14 ч 30 мин."), covered("в 14 ч 30 мин."))
        assertEquals(listOf("9 часов"), covered("в 9 часов утра"))
        assertEquals(listOf("полдень"), covered("в полдень"))
        assertEquals(listOf("9"), covered("с 9 до 14"))
        assertEquals(listOf("9:00"), covered("с 9:00 до 14:00"))
        assertEquals(listOf("09:00"), covered("Пн-пт 09:00-18:00"))
    }

    @Test
    fun dateAndTimeNextToEachOtherAreTwoMatches() {
        val text = "18 ноября в 14:30"
        val matches = grammar.find(text)
        assertEquals(2, matches.size)
        assertEquals(DateValue(18, 11, null), matches[0].value)
        assertEquals(TimeValue(14, 30), matches[1].value)
        assertTrue(!matches[0].range.overlaps(matches[1].range))
    }

    @Test
    fun rangeEndTimeIsNeverReturned() {
        val matches = grammar.find("с 9:00 до 14:00")
        assertEquals(1, matches.size)
        assertEquals(TimeValue(9, 0), matches[0].value)
        assertEquals(setOf(CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START), matches[0].flags)
    }

    @Test
    fun rangesUseOffsetsOfTheOriginalString() {
        val prefixes = listOf("", "  ", "\u00a0\u200b", "\uD83D\uDE00 ", "Ё\u0301 ", "line1\nline2\n", "а | б | ")
        val phrases = listOf("18 ноября 2026 г.", "вт, 18 нояб.", "в 14:30", "14 ч 30 мин", "с 9 до 14", "18.11.2О26")
        for (prefix in prefixes) {
            for (phrase in phrases) {
                val plain = grammar.find(phrase)
                val shifted = grammar.find(prefix + phrase + " хвост")
                assertEquals(plain.size, shifted.size, "'$prefix' + '$phrase'")
                for ((a, b) in plain.zip(shifted)) {
                    assertEquals(a.value, b.value)
                    assertEquals(a.flags, b.flags)
                    assertEquals(a.range.start + prefix.length, b.range.start)
                    assertEquals(a.range.endExclusive + prefix.length, b.range.endExclusive)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun nonBreakingSpaceWorksAsSpace() {
        assertEquals("D:18.11.2026", describe("18\u00a0ноября\u00a02026\u00a0г."))
        assertEquals("T:14:30", describe("в\u00a014.30"))
    }

    @Test
    fun plainDigitsNeverGetHomoglyphFlag() {
        for (text in listOf("18.11.2026", "в 14:30", "14 ч 30 мин", "18 ноября 2026 г.", "18/11/2026", "с 9 до 14")) {
            assertTrue(grammar.find(text).none { CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION in it.flags }, text)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun everySubstitutionSetsTheFlagAndDigitOnlyGroupsKeepTheirValue() {
        assertEquals("T:10:30!", describe("1\u041e:3\u041e"))
        assertEquals("T:14:30!", describe("14:\u04170"))
        assertEquals("D:18.11.2026!", describe("18.11.2\u041e26"))
        // A group without a single real digit is not a candidate at all.
        assertEquals("", describe("\u041e\u041e:\u041e\u041e"))
        assertEquals("", describe("в 1\u041e:\u0417\u041e"))
    }

    @Test
    fun ambiguousFragmentsGiveNoMatch() {
        for (text in listOf("18.11", "14.30", "в 14.10", "до 18.11", "1:50", "в 9 часов 30", "10-12-14", "12/03/24", "№ 12.03.2026")) {
            assertEquals("", describe(text), text)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun resultIsSortedAndNonOverlappingOnRandomInput() {
        val alphabet = "0123456789 .:/-,вксдоч ноября г\nOОlSЗ|№%ч мин час"
        val random = Random(20261113)
        repeat(4000) {
            val length = random.nextInt(0, 40)
            val text = buildString { repeat(length) { append(alphabet[random.nextInt(alphabet.length)]) } }
            val matches = grammar.find(text)
            checkInvariants(text, matches)
            for (match in matches) assertNotNull(match.value)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun languageIsRussian() {
        assertEquals(SemanticLanguage.RU, grammar.language)
    }
}

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class ScriptLanguageDetectorTest {
    private val detector = ScriptLanguageDetector()

    @Test
    fun russianParagraphIsRu() {
        val text = "Уважаемый клиент, напоминаем, что приём состоится 18 ноября 2026 года в 14:30. " +
            "Просим прийти за пятнадцать минут до назначенного времени и иметь при себе документ."
        assertEquals(SemanticLanguage.RU, detector.detect(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun spanishParagraphWithDiacriticsIsEs() {
        val text = "Le recordamos que la cita con el especialista tendrá lugar el 18 de noviembre de 2026 " +
            "a las 14:30 h en la clínica de la calle Mayor."
        assertEquals(SemanticLanguage.ES, detector.detect(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun spanishWithoutDiacriticsButWithServiceWordsIsEs() {
        val text = "Recordatorio: cita para la revision de las pruebas del laboratorio con el doctor, " +
            "en la consulta, por la tarde. Traiga el documento."
        assertEquals(SemanticLanguage.ES, detector.detect(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun englishParagraphIsNull() {
        val text = "Please bring your passport and insurance card to the clinic before the visit. " +
            "The doctor will review the results with you during the appointment and answer questions."
        assertNull(detector.detect(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyStringIsNull() {
        assertNull(detector.detect(""))
    }

    @Test
    fun shortDateAndTimeIsNull() {
        assertNull(detector.detect("18.11.2026 14:30"))
    }

    @Test
    fun digitsOnlyIsNull() {
        assertNull(detector.detect("0123456789 9876543210 1122334455"))
    }

    @Test
    fun fiftyFiftyMixIsNull() {
        val text = "Привет hello мир world Привет hello мир world"
        assertNull(detector.detect(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun russianTextWithLatinNamesIsRu() {
        val text = "Пожалуйста, подтвердите запись на приём к врачу Ivan Petrov в клинике на Тверской улице, " +
            "ул. Тверская, 12. Оплата через Sber Pay при визите не требуется, принесите полис ОМС и паспорт. " +
            "Вопросы можно задать в чате Telegram."
        assertEquals(SemanticLanguage.RU, detector.detect(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun delInsideModeloIsNotServiceWord() {
        // "modelo" contains "del" and "el" as substrings only; with no Spanish marks and fewer than
        // three whole service words the English-looking text must stay null.
        val text = "The modelo model modelo of the device is shown here for review and testing with the new modelo version."
        assertNull(detector.detect(text))
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/SemanticEngineTest.kt
