package app.docscan.core.semantic

import app.docscan.core.store.BlockType
import app.docscan.core.store.NormalizedBox
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrParagraph
import app.docscan.core.store.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.store.RecognitionLayout
import org.junit.Test
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalTime
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/** End-to-end checks of the whole layer on pages built the way OCR delivers them. */
class SemanticEngineTest {
    private val engine = SemanticEngine.default()
    private val scan = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 13)

    /** One text line per row; every word gets its own box, [lowConfidence] words get confidence 0.5. */
    private fun page(vararg lines: String, lowConfidence: Set<String> = emptySet()): RecognitionLayout {
        val ocrLines = lines.mapIndexed { row, text ->
            val top = 0.05f + row * 0.04f
            val tokens = text.split(' ').filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            val words = tokens.mapIndexed { column, token ->
                val left = 0.05f + column * (0.9f / tokens.size)
                OcrWord(token, NormalizedBox(left, top, left + 0.9f / tokens.size * 0.9f, top + 0.03f), if (token in lowConfidence) 0.5f else 0.95f)
            }
            OcrLine(NormalizedBox(0.05f, top, 0.95f, top + 0.03f), null, null, words)
        }
        val box = NormalizedBox(0.05f, 0.05f, 0.95f, 0.95f)
        return RecognitionLayout(1000, 1400, listOf(OcrBlock("b0", BlockType.TEXT, box, 0, listOf(OcrParagraph(box, ocrLines)))))
    }

    private val ruHeader = arrayOf(
        "Городская поликлиника номер пять города Москвы",
        "Талон на приём к врачу выдан пациенту по записи через регистратуру",
    )
    private val esHeader = arrayOf(
        "Centro de Salud de la Comunidad de Madrid",
        "Justificante de cita previa para el paciente en la consulta de atención primaria",
    )

    @Test
    fun russianAppointmentIsFilled() {
        val result = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Приём терапевта 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30, каб. 305")), scan)
        val proposal = result.single()
        assertEquals(ProposalKind.EVENT, proposal.kind)
        assertEquals(ProposalState.FILLED, proposal.state)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 18), proposal.date!!.date)
        assertFalse(proposal.date!!.yearInferred)
        assertEquals(LocalTime.of(14, 30), proposal.time!!.time)
        assertTrue(proposal.title.startsWith("Приём терапевта"), proposal.title)
        assertNotNull(proposal.date!!.sources.single().box)
    }

    @Test
    fun spanishAppointmentIsFilled() {
        val result = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*esHeader, "Cita con el médico de familia el 18 de noviembre de 2026 a las 14:30")), scan)
        val proposal = result.single()
        assertEquals(ProposalKind.EVENT, proposal.kind)
        assertEquals(ProposalState.FILLED, proposal.state)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 18), proposal.date!!.date)
        assertEquals(LocalTime.of(14, 30), proposal.time!!.time)
        assertEquals("Cita con el médico de familia", proposal.title)
    }

    @Test
    fun yearIsInferredAndMarked() {
        val proposal = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Приём 20 ноября в 10:30")), scan).single()
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 20), proposal.date!!.date)
        assertTrue(proposal.date!!.yearInferred)
        assertEquals(ProposalState.FILLED, proposal.state)
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelledAppointmentGivesNothing() {
        assertTrue(engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Приём 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30 отменён")), scan).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(engine.analyze(listOf(page(*esHeader, "La cita del 18 de noviembre de 2026 a las 14:30 ha sido cancelada")), scan).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun rescheduledAppointmentUsesOnlyTheNewDate() {
        val ru = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Приём перенесён с 18 ноября 2026 г. на 20 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30")), scan)
        assertEquals(listOf(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 20)), ru.mapNotNull { it.date?.date })
        assertTrue(ru.none { p -> p.dateOptions.any { it.date == LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 18) } && p.date != null })
        assertEquals(EventStatus.RESCHEDULED, ru.single().status)
    }

    @Test
    fun deadlineBecomesTask() {
        val ru = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Оплатить до 30 ноября 2026 г.")), scan).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalKind.TASK, ru.kind)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 30), ru.date!!.date)
        assertNull(ru.time)
        val es = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*esHeader, "Fecha límite de pago: 30 de noviembre de 2026")), scan).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalKind.TASK, es.kind)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 30), es.date!!.date)
    }

    @Test
    fun lookAlikeCharacterIsNeverFilledSilently() {
        val proposal = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Приём 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:З0")), scan).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY, proposal.state)
        assertEquals(LocalTime.of(14, 30), proposal.time!!.time)
        assertTrue(proposal.time!!.sources.single().needsCropConfirmation)
    }

    @Test
    fun lowConfidenceWordRequiresCrop() {
        val proposal = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Приём 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30", lowConfidence = setOf("14:30"))), scan).single()
        assertEquals(ProposalState.LOW_QUALITY, proposal.state)
    }

    @Test
    fun otherDatesNeverBecomeEvents() {
        val result = engine.analyze(
            listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Дата рождения 12.05.1982", "Направление выдано 10.11.2026", "Иванов Иван Иванович 15.11.2026 10:00")),
            scan,
        )
        assertTrue(result.isEmpty(), result.toString())
    }

    @Test
    fun birthAndIssueDatesDoNotDisturbTheAppointment() {
        val proposal = engine.analyze(
            listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Дата рождения 12.05.1982", "Дата выдачи 10.11.2026", "Явка 18.11.2026 в 09:15")),
            scan,
        ).single()
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 18), proposal.date!!.date)
        assertEquals(LocalTime.of(9, 15), proposal.time!!.time)
    }

    @Test
    fun sameEventOnTwoPagesGivesOneProposal() {
        val line = "Приём терапевта 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30"
        val proposal = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*ruHeader, line), page(*ruHeader, line)), scan).single()
        assertEquals(setOf(0, 1), proposal.date!!.sources.map { it.pageIndex }.toSet())
    }

    @Test
    fun cancellationOnAnotherPageRemovesTheEvent() {
        val result = engine.analyze(
            listOf(page(*ruHeader, "Приём терапевта 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30"), page(*ruHeader, "Приём 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30 отменён")),
            scan,
        )
        assertTrue(result.isEmpty(), result.toString())
    }

    @Test
    fun mixedLanguageDocumentIsHandledPerPage() {
        val result = engine.analyze(
            listOf(
                page(*ruHeader, "Приём терапевта 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30"),
                page(*esHeader, "Cita con el pediatra el 20 de noviembre de 2026 a las 09:00"),
            ),
            scan,
        )
        assertEquals(listOf(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 18), LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 20)), result.map { it.date!!.date })
    }

    @Test
    fun unsupportedLanguageAndMissingOcrStaySilent() {
        val english = page(
            "City Medical Centre appointment confirmation letter for the patient",
            "Your appointment is on 18 November 2026 at 14:30 with the family doctor",
        )
        assertTrue(engine.analyze(listOf(english, null), scan).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(engine.analyze(emptyList(), scan).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun durationIsNotTakenForTheTime() {
        val result = engine.analyze(listOf(page(*esHeader, "Cita 18/11/2026, duración: 2 h")), scan)
        assertTrue(result.none { it.time != null }, result.toString())
    }

    @Test
    fun everyFilledValueIsBackedByTheDocumentText() {
        val layout = page(*ruHeader, "Приём терапевта 18 ноября 2026 г. в 14:30")
        val text = LayoutCanonicalTextBuilder(ScriptLanguageDetector()).build(0, layout).text
        val proposal = engine.analyze(listOf(layout), scan).single()
        (proposal.date!!.sources + proposal.time!!.sources).forEach { source ->
            assertEquals(source.raw, source.range.substring(text))
        }
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/SpanishDateTimeGrammarTest.kt
================================================================================

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import java.util.Random
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlin.test.fail

class SpanishDateTimeGrammarTest {
    private val grammar = SpanishDateTimeGrammar()

    private data class Expected(val value: CandidateValue, val flags: Set<CandidateFlag>)

    private fun parseExpected(raw: String): List<Expected> {
        if (raw.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return raw.split(';').map { item ->
            var body = item
            val flags = mutableSetOf<CandidateFlag>()
            while (body.endsWith("!") || body.endsWith("~")) {
                flags += if (body.last() == '!') CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION else CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START
                body = body.dropLast(1)
            }
            val value: CandidateValue = when {
                body.startsWith("D:") -> {
                    val (d, m, y) = body.removePrefix("D:").split('.')
                    DateValue(d.toInt(), m.toInt(), if (y == "-") null else y.toInt())
                }
                body.startsWith("T:") -> {
                    val (h, m) = body.removePrefix("T:").split(':')
                    TimeValue(h.toInt(), m.toInt())
                }
                else -> error("Bad expected item '$item'")
            }
            Expected(value, flags)
        }
    }

    private fun checkInvariants(text: String, matches: List<GrammarMatch>): String? {
        var previousEnd = 0
        for (match in matches) {
            if (match.range.start < previousEnd) return "overlap or wrong order at ${match.range}"
            if (match.range.endExclusive > text.length || match.range.length == 0) return "range ${match.range} outside text"
            previousEnd = match.range.endExclusive
        }
        return null
    }

    @Test
    fun languageIsSpanish() {
        assertEquals(SemanticLanguage.ES, grammar.language)
    }

    @Test
    fun phraseTableIsCheckedLineByLine() {
        val stream = javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/semantic/es_datetime_phrases.tsv") ?: fail("TSV resource is missing")
        val lines = stream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).readLines()
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        var phrases = 0
        var negatives = 0
        var homoglyphs = 0
        lines.forEachIndexed { index, line ->
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) return@forEachIndexed
            val parts = line.split('\t', limit = 2)
            if (parts.size != 2) {
                failures += "line ${index + 1}: no TAB separator: '$line'"
                return@forEachIndexed
            }
            val phrase = parts[0]
            val expected = parseExpected(parts[1])
            phrases++
            if (expected.isEmpty()) negatives++
            if (expected.any { CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION in it.flags }) homoglyphs++
            val actual = grammar.find(phrase)
            checkInvariants(phrase, actual)?.let { failures += "line ${index + 1} '$phrase': $it" }
            val actualDescription = actual.map { Expected(it.value, it.flags) }
            if (actualDescription != expected) {
                failures += "line ${index + 1} '$phrase': expected $expected but got $actualDescription"
            }
        }
        assertTrue(phrases >= 300, "need at least 300 phrases, have $phrases")
        assertTrue(negatives >= 60, "need at least 60 negatives, have $negatives")
        assertTrue(homoglyphs >= 30, "need at least 30 homoglyph phrases, have $homoglyphs")
        if (failures.isNotEmpty()) fail("${failures.size} failures of $phrases phrases:\n" + failures.joinToString("\n"))
    }

    private fun covered(text: String): List<String> = grammar.find(text).map { it.range.substring(text) }

    @Test
    fun rangesAreExactBoundaries() {
        assertEquals(listOf("18 de noviembre de 2026", "14:30 h"), covered("Cita el 18 de noviembre de 2026 a las 14:30 h."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 de noviembre", "14:30"), covered("martes, 18 de noviembre a las 14:30."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 nov"), covered("mar. 18 nov"))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 nov. 2026"), covered("18 nov. 2026."))
        assertEquals(listOf("18 nov"), covered("el 18 nov."))
        assertEquals(listOf("1º de mayo"), covered("1º de mayo"))
        assertEquals(listOf("18/11/2026"), covered("(18/11/2026)."))
    }

    @Test
    fun hourSuffixIsAlwaysCoveredAndALasNever() {
        assertEquals(listOf("14:30h"), covered("a las 14:30h"))
        assertEquals(listOf("14.30 horas"), covered("a las 14.30 horas"))
        assertEquals(listOf("9 horas"), covered("a las 9 horas"))
        assertEquals(listOf("9"), covered("a las 9"))
        assertEquals(listOf("14 h"), covered("14 h"))
        assertEquals(listOf("9:30 a.m."), covered("9:30 a.m."))
        assertEquals(listOf("4:30 p. m."), covered("4:30 p. m."))
        assertEquals(listOf("14:30"), covered("14:30 horario"))
    }

    @Test
    fun timeRangeReturnsOnlyTheStartAndSwallowsTheEnd() {
        val text = "Horario de 9 a 14 h"
        val matches = grammar.find(text)
        assertEquals(1, matches.size)
        assertEquals("9", matches[0].range.substring(text))
        assertEquals(TimeValue(9, 0), matches[0].value)
        assertEquals(setOf(CandidateFlag.TIME_RANGE_START), matches[0].flags)
        val colon = grammar.find("de 9:00 a 14:00")
        assertEquals(1, colon.size)
        assertEquals(TimeValue(9, 0), colon[0].value)
    }

    @Test
    fun midday() {
        val text = "Cita a mediodía"
        val match = grammar.find(text).single()
        assertEquals(TimeValue(12, 0), match.value)
        assertEquals("mediodía", match.range.substring(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun dateAndTimeNextToEachOtherAreTwoMatches() {
        val text = "18 de noviembre a las 14:30"
        val matches = grammar.find(text)
        assertEquals(2, matches.size)
        assertEquals(DateValue(18, 11, null), matches[0].value)
        assertEquals(TimeValue(14, 30), matches[1].value)
        assertTrue(matches[0].range.endExclusive <= matches[1].range.start)
    }

    @Test
    fun offsetsStayInOriginalTextUnits() {
        val prefix = "🙂 Cita en Almería\n"
        val text = prefix + "mié. 18 NOV 2026 a las 14:30 h"
        val matches = grammar.find(text)
        assertEquals(2, matches.size)
        assertEquals("18 NOV 2026", matches[0].range.substring(text))
        assertEquals(prefix.length + "mié. ".length, matches[0].range.start)
        assertEquals("14:30 h", matches[1].range.substring(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun matchesDoNotCrossLineBreaks() {
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("18 de\nnoviembre"))
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("14:\n30"))
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("18/\n11/2026"))
        assertEquals(2, grammar.find("18/11/2026\n14:30").size)
    }

    @Test
    fun homoglyphFlagOnlyWhenSubstituted() {
        assertEquals(emptySet(), grammar.find("10:30").single().flags)
        assertEquals(setOf(CandidateFlag.HOMOGLYPH_SUBSTITUTION), grammar.find("1O:3O").single().flags)
        assertEquals(TimeValue(10, 30), grammar.find("1O:3O").single().value)
        assertEquals(DateValue(18, 11, 2026), grammar.find("18/11/2O26").single().value)
    }

    @Test
    fun groupsWithoutRealDigitAreNotCandidates() {
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("lO:OO"))
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("ll/ll/2026"))
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("lo de mayo"))
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("a las lO"))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyAndBlankTextGiveNothing() {
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find(""))
        assertEquals(emptyList(), grammar.find("   \n\t "))
    }

    @Test
    fun repeatedCallsGiveTheSameResult() {
        val text = "Cita 18/11/2026 a las 14:30 y de 9 a 14 h el 3 de mayo"
        assertEquals(grammar.find(text), grammar.find(text))
    }

    @Test
    fun randomTextKeepsInvariants() {
        val alphabet = "0123456789OolIsSbB| :./-,\n hHaApPmMdeynovbrlzº"
        val pieces = listOf("de ", "a las ", "nov", "mar. ", " h", "a.m.", "18", "11", "2026", "14:30", " de ", "mediodía", "2O26")
        val random = Random(20261113)
        repeat(4000) {
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            repeat(random.nextInt(14)) {
                if (random.nextInt(3) == 0) sb.append(pieces[random.nextInt(pieces.size)]) else sb.append(alphabet[random.nextInt(alphabet.length)])
            }
            val text = sb.toString()
            val matches = grammar.find(text)
            checkInvariants(text, matches)?.let { fail("'$text': $it") }
        }
    }
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/semantic/TemplateTitleBuilderTest.kt

package app.docscan.core.semantic

import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class TemplateTitleBuilderTest {

    private val builder = TemplateTitleBuilder()

    @Test
    fun ru_appointment_drops_dates_time_and_dangling_preposition() {
        val text = "Приём терапевта 18 ноября в 14:30, каб. 305"
        val title = titleOf(
            text,
            SemanticLanguage.RU,
            candidates = listOf(
                dateCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "18 ноября")),
                timeCandidate(2, rangeOf(text, "14:30")),
            ),
        )
        assertEquals("Приём терапевта, каб. 305", title)
    }

    @Test
    fun es_appointment_drops_dates_time_and_articles() {
        val text = "Cita con el médico de familia el 18 de noviembre a las 14:30"
        val title = titleOf(
            text,
            SemanticLanguage.ES,
            candidates = listOf(
                dateCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "18 de noviembre")),
                timeCandidate(2, rangeOf(text, "14:30")),
            ),
        )
        assertEquals("Cita con el médico de familia", title)
    }

    @Test
    fun ru_line_with_only_date_and_time_uses_fallback() {
        val text = "18 ноября в 14:30"
        val candidates = listOf(
            dateCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "18 ноября")),
            timeCandidate(2, rangeOf(text, "14:30")),
        )
        assertEquals("Приём", titleOf(text, SemanticLanguage.RU, candidates, EventKind.APPOINTMENT))
        assertEquals("Срок", titleOf(text, SemanticLanguage.RU, candidates, EventKind.DEADLINE))
    }

    @Test
    fun ru_deadline_with_only_date_uses_fallback() {
        val text = "до 18 ноября"
        val candidates = listOf(dateCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "18 ноября")))
        assertEquals("Срок", titleOf(text, SemanticLanguage.RU, candidates, EventKind.DEADLINE))
    }

    @Test
    fun es_line_with_only_date_and_time_uses_fallback() {
        val text = "18 de noviembre a las 14:30"
        val candidates = listOf(
            dateCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "18 de noviembre")),
            timeCandidate(2, rangeOf(text, "14:30")),
        )
        assertEquals("Cita", titleOf(text, SemanticLanguage.ES, candidates, EventKind.APPOINTMENT))
        assertEquals("Plazo", titleOf(text, SemanticLanguage.ES, candidates, EventKind.DEADLINE))
    }

    @Test
    fun cells_separated_by_pipe_become_comma_list() {
        val text = "Кабинет 305 | Приём терапевта | 18 ноября в 14:30"
        val title = titleOf(
            text,
            SemanticLanguage.RU,
            candidates = listOf(
                dateCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "18 ноября")),
                timeCandidate(2, rangeOf(text, "14:30")),
            ),
        )
        assertEquals("Кабинет 305, Приём терапевта", title)
    }

    @Test
    fun long_line_is_truncated_to_500_characters() {
        val text = "Приём " + "а".repeat(600)
        val title = titleOf(text, SemanticLanguage.RU)
        assertEquals(500, title.length)
        assertTrue(title.startsWith("Приём аа"))
    }

    @Test
    fun truncation_does_not_split_surrogate_pair() {
        val text = "Приём " + "а".repeat(493) + "😀" + "хвост"
        val title = titleOf(text, SemanticLanguage.RU)
        assertTrue(title.length <= 500)
        assertTrue(!Character.isHighSurrogate(title.last()))
    }

    @Test
    fun null_language_uses_neutral_fallback() {
        val text = "18 ноября в 14:30"
        val candidates = listOf(
            dateCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "18 ноября")),
            timeCandidate(2, rangeOf(text, "14:30")),
        )
        assertEquals("Событие", titleOf(text, null, candidates, EventKind.APPOINTMENT))
        assertEquals("Событие", titleOf(text, null, candidates, EventKind.DEADLINE))
    }

    @Test
    fun candidate_from_another_line_is_not_cut() {
        val text = "Приём в 14:30\n14:30 каб. 305"
        val lines = listOf(
            CanonicalLine(TextRange(0, 13)),
            CanonicalLine(TextRange(14, text.length)),
        )
        val title = titleOf(
            text,
            SemanticLanguage.RU,
            candidates = listOf(timeCandidate(1, rangeOf(text, "14:30", from = 14))),
            anchor = TextRange(0, 13),
            lines = lines,
        )
        assertEquals("Приём в 14:30", title)
    }

    private fun titleOf(
        text: String,
        language: SemanticLanguage?,
        candidates: List<Candidate> = emptyList(),
        kind: EventKind = EventKind.APPOINTMENT,
        anchor: TextRange = TextRange(0, text.length),
        lines: List<CanonicalLine> = listOf(CanonicalLine(TextRange(0, text.length))),
    ): String {
        val page = CanonicalPage(
            pageIndex = 0,
            text = text,
            lines = lines,
            words = emptyList(),
            language = language,
        )
        val event = PageEvent(
            kind = kind,
            status = EventStatus.CONFIRMED,
            dateCandidateId = null,
            dateOptions = emptyList(),
            timeCandidateId = null,
            timeOptions = emptyList(),
            anchorLine = anchor,
        )
        return builder.build(page, event, candidates)
    }

    private fun rangeOf(text: String, fragment: String, from: Int = 0): TextRange {
        val start = text.indexOf(fragment, from)
        require(start >= 0) { "'$fragment' not found in '$text'" }
        return TextRange(start, start + fragment.length)
    }

    private fun dateCandidate(id: Int, range: TextRange) = Candidate(
        id = id,
        pageIndex = 0,
        range = range,
        raw = "",
        value = DateValue(day = 18, month = 11, year = 2026),
        box = null,
        minConfidence = 0.95f,
        flags = emptySet(),
    )

    private fun timeCandidate(id: Int, range: TextRange) = Candidate(
        id = id,
        pageIndex = 0,
        range = range,
        raw = "",
        value = TimeValue(hour = 14, minute = 30),
        box = null,
        minConfidence = 0.95f,
        flags = emptySet(),
    )
}

FILE: core/src/test/kotlin/app/docscan/core/store/RecognitionPayloadCodecTest.kt

package app.docscan.core.store

import app.docscan.core.ocr.Bx
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrBlock
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLine
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrPara
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrWord
import app.docscan.core.ocr.OcrLayout
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class RecognitionPayloadCodecTest {

    @Test
    fun testLayoutRoundTrip() {
        val word1 = OcrWord("Привет", Bx(10, 20, 100, 50), 95f)
        val word2 = OcrWord("мир", Bx(110, 20, 200, 50), 90f)
        val line1 = OcrLine(Bx(10, 20, 200, 50), listOf(word1, word2), Baseline(0.25f, -3.5f))
        val para1 = OcrPara(Bx(10, 20, 200, 50), listOf(line1))
        val block1 = OcrBlock(Bx(10, 20, 200, 50), listOf(para1))
        val quality = LayoutQuality(92.5f, 1, true, "spa", "ADAPTIVE", "TESSERACT_5.5.1")
        val layout = OcrLayout(
            sourceW = 800,
            sourceH = 600,
            blocks = listOf(block1),
            lang = "spa+eng",
            plainText = "Preserved transcript",
            quality = quality,
            languageHints = setOf("spa", "eng"),
        )

        val encoded = RecognitionPayloadCodec.encodeLayout(layout)
        val decoded = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decodeLayout(encoded)

        assertEquals(layout, decoded)

        // With lang
        val layoutWithLang = layout.copy(lang = "spa+eng")
        val encodedWithLang = RecognitionPayloadCodec.encodeLayout(layoutWithLang)
        val decodedWithLang = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decodeLayout(encodedWithLang)
        assertEquals(layoutWithLang, decodedWithLang)

        // Legacy /2 without lang field
        val legacyV2WithoutLang = "DOCSCAN-OCR-LAYOUT/2\n{\"w\":800,\"h\":600,\"blocks\":[]}"
        val decodedLegacyV2 = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decodeLayout(legacyV2WithoutLang)
        assertEquals(800, decodedLegacyV2.sourceW)
        assertEquals(600, decodedLegacyV2.sourceH)
        assertNull(decodedLegacyV2.lang)
        assertNull(decodedLegacyV2.plainText)
        assertNull(decodedLegacyV2.quality)
        assertEquals(emptySet<String>(), decodedLegacyV2.languageHints)
    }

    @Test
    fun jsonV2RoundTripPreservesBaselineQualityPlainTextAndLanguageHints() {
        val original = OcrLayout(
            sourceW = 400,
            sourceH = 300,
            blocks = listOf(
                OcrBlock(
                    Bx(1, 2, 100, 40),
                    listOf(OcrPara(
                        Bx(1, 2, 100, 40),
                        listOf(OcrLine(
                            Bx(1, 2, 100, 40),
                            listOf(OcrWord("Line", Bx(1, 2, 50, 40), 76f)),
                            Baseline(-0.5f, 8f),
                        )),
                    )),
                    type = "PARAGRAPH",
                    id = "block-A",
                ),
            ),
            lang = "eng",
            plainText = "Line fallback",
            quality = LayoutQuality(76f, 1, true, "eng", "DEFAULT", "UNKNOWN"),
            languageHints = setOf("eng", "spa"),
        )

        val decoded = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decodeLayout(RecognitionPayloadCodec.encodeLayout(original))

        assertEquals(original, decoded)
    }

    @Test
    fun testDecodeLegacyFormats() {
        // Plain text
        val plainText = "Simple plain text"
        val decodedPlain = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decode(plainText)
        assertEquals("Simple plain text", decodedPlain.text)
        assertNull(decodedPlain.geometry)
        assertNull(decodedPlain.layout)

        // Geometry /1 format
        val word = RecognizedWord("Тест", 10, 10, 50, 30, 99.0)
        val geometry = RecognitionGeometry(
            sourceWidthPx = 100,
            sourceHeightPx = 100,
            coordinateSpace = OCR_WORD_COORDINATE_SPACE,
            words = listOf(word),
            formatVersion = 1L,
        )
        val encodedV1 = RecognitionPayloadCodec.encode("Тест", geometry)
        val decodedV1 = RecognitionPayloadCodec.decode(encodedV1)
        assertEquals("Тест", decodedV1.text)
        assertNotNull(decodedV1.geometry)
        assertEquals(1, decodedV1.geometry!!.words.size)
        assertEquals("Тест", decodedV1.geometry!!.words[0].text)
        assertNull(decodedV1.layout) // /1 does not create blocks/lines
    }
}

                    null,
                    """SELECT order_revision, active_page_id, last_user_activity_wall,
                        last_user_activity_monotonic, monotonic_epoch_token, retention_time_uncertain
                        FROM Workspace WHERE workspace_id = 'migration-sentinel'""",
                    { cursor ->
                        if (!cursor.next().value) return@executeQuery QueryResult.Value(null)
                        QueryResult.Value(
                            listOf(
                                cursor.getLong(0),
                                cursor.getString(1),
                                cursor.getLong(2),
                                cursor.getLong(3),
                                cursor.getString(4),
                                cursor.getLong(5),
                            ),
                        )
                    },
                    0,
                    null,
                ).value
                assertEquals("Workspace state after v$sourceVersion→v12", listOf(7L, "page-sentinel", 1234L, 5678L, "epoch-v1", 0L), workspace)

                val page = driver.executeQuery(
                    null,
                    """SELECT order_index, selected, content_revision, current_image_version_id,
                        current_recognition_id, tombstone, source_provenance FROM Page WHERE page_id = 'page-sentinel'""",
                    { cursor ->
                        if (!cursor.next().value) return@executeQuery QueryResult.Value(null)
                        QueryResult.Value(
                            listOf(
                                cursor.getLong(0), cursor.getLong(1), cursor.getLong(2),
                                cursor.getString(3), cursor.getString(4), cursor.getLong(5), cursor.getString(6),
                            ),
                        )
                    },
                    0,
                    null,
                ).value
                assertEquals("Page state after v$sourceVersion→v12", listOf(3L, 1L, 2L, "image-version-sentinel", "recognition-sentinel", 0L, "CAMERA"), page)

                val recognition = driver.executeQuery(
                    null,
                    "SELECT page_id, image_version_id, payload FROM Recognition WHERE recognition_id = 'recognition-sentinel'",
                    { cursor ->
                        if (!cursor.next().value) return@executeQuery QueryResult.Value(null)
                        QueryResult.Value(listOf(cursor.getString(0), cursor.getString(1), cursor.getString(2)))
                    },
                    0,
                    null,
                ).value
                assertEquals("Recognition after v$sourceVersion→v12", listOf("page-sentinel", "image-version-sentinel", "{\"text\":\"Invoice 42\"}"), recognition)

                val imageVersion = driver.executeQuery(
                    null,
                    "SELECT page_id, artifact_id, coordinate_space, transform_provenance, artifact_format_version FROM ImageVersion WHERE image_version_id = 'image-version-sentinel'",
                    { cursor ->
                        if (!cursor.next().value) return@executeQuery QueryResult.Value(null)
                        QueryResult.Value(listOf(cursor.getString(0), cursor.getString(1), cursor.getString(2), cursor.getString(3), cursor.getLong(4)))
                    },
                    0,
                    null,
                ).value
                assertEquals("ImageVersion after v$sourceVersion→v12", listOf("page-sentinel", "artifact-sentinel", "PIXEL", "{\"operation\":\"capture\"}", 1L), imageVersion)

                val artifact = driver.executeQuery(
                    null,
                    "SELECT relative_storage_path, artifact_kind, size_bytes, checksum, state, storage_state FROM ArtifactRecord WHERE artifact_id = 'artifact-sentinel'",
                    { cursor ->
                        if (!cursor.next().value) return@executeQuery QueryResult.Value(null)
                        QueryResult.Value(listOf(cursor.getString(0), cursor.getString(1), cursor.getLong(2), cursor.getString(3), cursor.getString(4), cursor.getString(5)))
                    },
                    0,
                    null,
                ).value
                assertEquals("Artifact after v$sourceVersion→v12", listOf("pages/source.jpg", "IMAGE", 4L, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", "COMMITTED", "PRESENT"), artifact)

                val reference = driver.executeQuery(
                    null,
                    "SELECT ref_kind, ref_owner_id, protection_class FROM ArtifactReference WHERE artifact_id = 'artifact-sentinel'",
                    { cursor ->
                        if (!cursor.next().value) return@executeQuery QueryResult.Value(null)
                        QueryResult.Value(listOf(cursor.getString(0), cursor.getString(1), cursor.getString(2)))
                    },
                    0,
                    null,
                ).value
                assertEquals("ArtifactReference after v$sourceVersion→v12", listOf("IMAGE_VERSION", "image-version-sentinel", "AUTHORITATIVE"), reference)

                for (table in listOf(
                    "SaveOutputPublicationIntent",
                    "PdfImportPublicationIntent",
                    "ImageImportPublicationIntent",
                    "SavedPdfEditComposition",
                    "PublicExportPublication",
                )) {
                    val tableCount = driver.executeQuery(
                        null,
                        "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='$table'",
                        { cursor -> cursor.next(); QueryResult.Value(cursor.getLong(0)) },
                        0,
                        null,
                    ).value
                    assertEquals("$table exists after v$sourceVersion→v12", 1L, tableCount)
                }
            } finally {
                driver.close()
                Files.deleteIfExists(temporaryDatabase)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun versionTwelveToThirteenCreatesPublicExportPublicationTable() {
        val driver = JdbcSqliteDriver(
            JdbcSqliteDriver.IN_MEMORY,
            Properties().apply { setProperty("foreign_keys", "false") },
        )
        try {
            DocScanDatabase.Schema.create(driver)
            driver.execute(null, "DROP TABLE PublicExportPublication", 0, null)
            driver.execute(null, "ALTER TABLE ExternalExportPackage DROP COLUMN include_jpg", 0, null)

            DocScanDatabase.Schema.migrate(driver, 12L, 13L)

            val tableCount = driver.executeQuery(
                null,
                "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='PublicExportPublication'",
                { cursor -> cursor.next(); QueryResult.Value(cursor.getLong(0)) },
                0,
                null,
            ).value
            assertEquals(1L, tableCount)

            val includeJpgColumn = driver.executeQuery(
                null,
                "PRAGMA table_info(ExternalExportPackage)",
                { cursor ->
                    while (cursor.next().value) {
                        if (cursor.getString(1) == "include_jpg") {
                            return@executeQuery QueryResult.Value(
                                Triple(cursor.getLong(3), cursor.getString(4), cursor.getLong(5)),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    QueryResult.Value(null)
                },
                0,
                null,
            ).value
            assertEquals(Triple(1L, "1", 0L), includeJpgColumn)
        } finally {
            driver.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun versionEightToNinePreservesUserSelectionAndInitializesNoPendingAutoSelect() {
        val driver = JdbcSqliteDriver(
            JdbcSqliteDriver.IN_MEMORY,
            Properties().apply { setProperty("foreign_keys", "false") },
        )
        try {
            DocScanDatabase.Schema.create(driver)
            // Reconstruct the v8 Page shape before seeding historical selection values.
            driver.execute(null, "ALTER TABLE Page DROP COLUMN select_when_ready", 0, null)
            driver.execute(
                null,
                """INSERT INTO Page(page_id, workspace_id, workspace_session_id, order_index, selected,
                    content_revision, current_image_version_id, processing_desired_state, tombstone, source_provenance)
                    VALUES ('unselected', 'w', 's', 0, 0, 1, 'iv0', 'OCR_V1', 0, 'CAMERA')""",
                0,
                null,
            )
            driver.execute(
                null,
                """INSERT INTO Page(page_id, workspace_id, workspace_session_id, order_index, selected,
                    content_revision, current_image_version_id, processing_desired_state, tombstone, source_provenance)
                    VALUES ('selected', 'w', 's', 1, 1, 1, 'iv1', 'OCR_V1', 0, 'IMPORT')""",
                0,
                null,
            )

            DocScanDatabase.Schema.migrate(driver, 8L, 9L)

            val database = DocScanDatabase(driver)
            assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.pageById("unselected").executeAsOne().selected)
            assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.pageById("selected").executeAsOne().selected)
            assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.pageById("unselected").executeAsOne().select_when_ready)
            assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.pageById("selected").executeAsOne().select_when_ready)
        } finally {
            driver.close()
        }
    }

class StateStoreTest {
    private lateinit var driver: JdbcSqliteDriver
    private lateinit var database: DocScanDatabase
    private var workspaceId: WorkspaceId = WorkspaceId.new()
    private lateinit var store: StateStore
    private lateinit var fakeClock: FakeClock

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        driver = JdbcSqliteDriver(
            JdbcSqliteDriver.IN_MEMORY,
            Properties().apply { setProperty("foreign_keys", "true") },
        )
        DocScanDatabase.Schema.create(driver)
        database = DocScanDatabase(driver)
        workspaceId = WorkspaceId.new()
        fakeClock = FakeClock(TimeReading(1_000L, 2_000L, "test-epoch"))
        store = StateStore(database, fakeClock)
        store.createInitialWorkspace(workspaceId, WorkspaceSessionId.new())
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        driver.close()
    }

    @Test
    fun captureAtomicallyCommitsPageImageVersionAndProtectiveReference() {
        val artifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(artifact)
        val command = captureCommand(artifact)

        val captured = store.commitCapture(command)

        assertEquals(command.pageId, captured.pageId)
        assertEquals(0L, captured.orderIndex)
        assertEquals(1L, store.visiblePageCount(workspaceId))
        assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.workspaceById(workspaceId.value).executeAsOne().order_revision)
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
        assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())
    }

    @Test
    fun cameraOriginalSurvivesEditsAndIsReplacedOnlyByRetake() {
        val image = durableArtifact()
        val original = durableArtifact()
        listOf(image, original).forEach(store::recordStagedDurableArtifact)
        val capture = captureCommand(image).copy(captureSource = original)
        store.commitCapture(capture)
        assertEquals(original, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))
        assertTrue(store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(store.claimUnreferencedArtifacts(100L).isEmpty())

        val edited = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(edited)
        val editedVersion = ImageVersionId.new()
        store.replacePageImage(ReplacePageImageCommand(workspaceId, capture.pageId, capture.imageVersionId,
            1L, editedVersion, edited, "pixels", "edit", "OCR_LATIN_V1"))
        assertEquals(original, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))
        store.undoPageImage(workspaceId, capture.pageId, editedVersion, 2L)
        assertEquals(original, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))

        val retaken = durableArtifact()
        val newOriginal = durableArtifact()
        val retakenVersion = ImageVersionId.new()
        listOf(retaken, newOriginal).forEach(store::recordStagedDurableArtifact)
        store.replacePageImage(ReplacePageImageCommand(workspaceId, capture.pageId, capture.imageVersionId,
            3L, retakenVersion, retaken, "pixels", "retake", "OCR_LATIN_V1", newOriginal))
        assertEquals(newOriginal, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))
        assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(original.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())
        assertFalse(store.claimUnreferencedArtifacts(100L).any { it.artifactId == original.artifactId })
        store.undoPageImage(workspaceId, capture.pageId, retakenVersion, 4L)
        assertEquals(original, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))
        assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(original.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())
        assertTrue(store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidCameraSourceRollsBackWholeCaptureAndDoesNotCreateFakeOriginalForLegacyCapture() {
        val image = durableArtifact()
        val original = durableArtifact()
        listOf(image, original).forEach(store::recordStagedDurableArtifact)
        val capture = captureCommand(image)
        assertThrows(StoreInvariantViolation::class.java) {
            store.commitCapture(capture.copy(captureSource = original.copy(sha256 = "f".repeat(64))))
        }
        assertEquals(0L, store.visiblePageCount(workspaceId))
        assertEquals("STAGED_DURABLE", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(image.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
        store.commitCapture(capture)
        assertEquals(null, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))
    }

    @Test
    fun cameraOriginalIsProtectedForDeleteUndoThenReleasedWhenUndoExpires() {
        val image = durableArtifact()
        val original = durableArtifact()
        listOf(image, original).forEach(store::recordStagedDurableArtifact)
        val capture = captureCommand(image).copy(captureSource = original)
        store.commitCapture(capture)
        store.deletePage(workspaceId, capture.pageId, 1L)
        assertTrue(store.claimUnreferencedArtifacts(100L).none { it.artifactId == original.artifactId })
        fakeClock.set(TimeReading(500L, 1_000L, "test-epoch"))
        assertTrue(store.claimUnreferencedArtifacts(100L).none { it.artifactId == original.artifactId })
        fakeClock.set(TimeReading(1_000L, 2_000L, "test-epoch"))
        store.undoDelete(workspaceId, capture.pageId)
        assertEquals(original, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))
        store.deletePage(workspaceId, capture.pageId, 3L)
        fakeClock.set(TimeReading(100_000L, 100_000_000_000L, "test-epoch"))
        assertTrue(store.claimUnreferencedArtifacts(100L).any { it.artifactId == original.artifactId })
        assertEquals(null, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))
    }

    @Test

        store.commitCapture(capture)
        assertEquals(image, store.cameraSource(capture.pageId))

        val codes = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).map { it.code }
        assertTrue(codes.contains("CAPTURE_SOURCE_OWNER_MISSING"))
    }

    @Test
    fun selectAllAndClearSelectionAffectVisiblePagesAtomicallyWithoutChangingActivePage() {

        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(firstArtifact)
        val first = captureCommand(firstArtifact)
        store.commitCapture(first)
        val secondArtifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(secondArtifact)
        val second = captureCommand(secondArtifact)
        store.commitCapture(second)

        store.setAllVisiblePagesSelected(workspaceId, selected = true)

        assertEquals(listOf(true, true), store.visiblePages(workspaceId).map { it.selected })
        assertEquals(second.pageId.value, database.schemaQueries.workspaceById(workspaceId.value)
            .executeAsOne().active_page_id)

        store.setAllVisiblePagesSelected(workspaceId, selected = false)

        assertEquals(listOf(false, false), store.visiblePages(workspaceId).map { it.selected })

            .executeAsOne().active_page_id)
    }

    @Test
    fun artifactReferenceOwnerAuditFindsCorruptionAcrossKnownKindsWithoutRepairingRows() {
        val artifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(artifact)
        val capture = captureCommand(artifact)
        store.commitCapture(capture)
        val wrongArtifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(wrongArtifact)
        database.schemaQueries.insertSaveManifest(
            "existing-save-manifest", workspaceId.value, 1L,
            "{\"pages\":[{\"artifactId\":\"${artifact.artifactId.value}\"}]}",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertExportArtifact(
            "existing-export-artifact", "existing-save-manifest", "PDF",
            "{\"files\":[{\"artifactId\":\"${wrongArtifact.artifactId.value}\"}]}", 1L, 1L,
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertExportAttempt(
            "existing-export-attempt", "existing-export-artifact", wrongArtifact.artifactId.value,
            1L, "destination", "parameters",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertImportSession(
            "existing-import-session", workspaceId.value, "parameters", wrongArtifact.artifactId.value,
            null, "source.pdf",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "SAVE_MANIFEST", "existing-save-manifest", "SAVE",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            wrongArtifact.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ARTIFACT", "existing-export-artifact", "EXPORT",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            wrongArtifact.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ATTEMPT", "existing-export-attempt", "RECOVERY",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            wrongArtifact.artifactId.value, "IMPORT_SESSION", "existing-import-session", "RECOVERY",
        )
        assertEquals(emptyList<ArtifactReferenceIntegrityFinding>(), store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L))
        database.schemaQueries.insertSaveManifest(
            "missing-source-reference-manifest", workspaceId.value, 1L,
            "{\"pages\":[{\"artifactId\":\"${artifact.artifactId.value}\"}]}",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertExportArtifact(
            "missing-output-reference-export", "existing-save-manifest", "PDF",
            "{\"files\":[{\"artifactId\":\"${artifact.artifactId.value}\"}]}", 1L, 1L,
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            wrongArtifact.artifactId.value, "SAVE_MANIFEST", "existing-save-manifest", "SAVE",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ARTIFACT", "existing-export-artifact", "EXPORT",
        )

        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            wrongArtifact.artifactId.value, "IMAGE_VERSION", capture.imageVersionId.value, "AUTHORITATIVE",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "IMAGE_VERSION", "missing-image-version", "AUTHORITATIVE",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "SAVE_MANIFEST", "missing-save-manifest", "SAVE",
        )
        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ArtifactReference SET protection_class = 'EXPORT' WHERE artifact_id = '${artifact.artifactId.value}' AND ref_kind = 'SAVE_MANIFEST' AND ref_owner_id = 'existing-save-manifest'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ARTIFACT", "missing-export-artifact", "EXPORT",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ATTEMPT", "missing-export-attempt", "RECOVERY",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "IMPORT_SESSION", "missing-import-session", "RECOVERY",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            artifact.artifactId.value, "FUTURE_KIND", "future-owner", "RECOVERY",
        )

        val referencesBefore = database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
        val allReferencesBefore = referencesBefore + database.schemaQueries
            .referenceCountForArtifact(wrongArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
        val findings = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_ARTIFACT_NOT_IN_PAYLOAD",
                "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_OWNER_MISSING",
                "EXPORT_ARTIFACT_REFERENCE_MISSING",
                "EXPORT_ATTEMPT_OWNER_MISSING",
                "IMAGE_VERSION_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH",
                "IMAGE_VERSION_OWNER_MISSING",
                "IMPORT_SESSION_OWNER_MISSING",
                "SAVE_MANIFEST_ARTIFACT_NOT_IN_FROZEN_PAYLOAD",
                "SAVE_MANIFEST_OWNER_MISSING",
                "SAVE_MANIFEST_PROTECTION_MISMATCH",
                "SAVE_MANIFEST_REFERENCE_MISSING",
                "UNKNOWN_REFERENCE_KIND",
            ),
            findings.map { it.code },
        )
        assertEquals(findings, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L))
        assertEquals(findings.first(), store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(1L).single())
        assertEquals(artifact.artifactId, findings.first().artifactId)
        assertEquals("EXPORT_ARTIFACT", findings.first().refKind)
        assertEquals("existing-export-artifact", findings.first().refOwnerId)
        assertEquals(referencesBefore, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())
        assertEquals(
            allReferencesBefore,
            database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
                + database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(wrongArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne(),
        )
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
        assertEquals(capture.imageVersionId.value, database.schemaQueries.pageById(capture.pageId.value)
            .executeAsOne().current_image_version_id)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(0L) }
    }

    @Test
    fun artifactReferenceAuditChecksExternalPackageOutputMembershipBothWaysWithoutMutation() {
        val member = durableArtifact()
        val nonMember = durableArtifact()
        listOf(member, nonMember).forEach { artifact ->
            store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(artifact)
            assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.commitArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).value)
        }
        val exportId = "external-package-membership-export"
        val saveId = "external-package-membership-save"
        database.schemaQueries.insertSaveManifest(saveId, workspaceId.value, 1L, "{}")
        database.schemaQueries.insertExportArtifact(
            exportId,
            saveId,
            "PDF_AND_JPG",
            "{\"formatVersion\":1,\"files\":[{\"kind\":\"PDF\",\"artifactId\":\"${member.artifactId.value}\"}]}",
            1L,
            1L,
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(member.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ARTIFACT", exportId, "EXPORT")
        database.schemaQueries.insertProviderQualification(
            "external-package-membership-qualification", "test-adapter", "1", "test-os", "tree",
            "suite-1", "{}",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertExternalExportPackage(
            exportId, "content://tree", "Scan", "external-package-membership-qualification",
            "test-adapter", "1", "test-os", "tree", "NONE",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertExternalExportPackageOutput(
            exportId, member.artifactId.value, "Scan.pdf", 0L,
        )

        assertEquals(emptyList<ArtifactReferenceIntegrityFinding>(), store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L))

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "DELETE FROM ExternalExportPackageOutput WHERE export_artifact_id = '$exportId'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertExternalExportPackageOutput(
            exportId, nonMember.artifactId.value, "Scan.pdf", 0L,
        )
        val referencesBefore = listOf(member, nonMember).sumOf {
            database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(it.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
        }
        val findings = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                "EXTERNAL_PACKAGE_OUTPUT_MAPPING_MISSING",
                "EXTERNAL_PACKAGE_OUTPUT_NOT_IN_EXPORT_PAYLOAD",
            ),
            findings.map { it.code },
        )
        assertEquals(member.artifactId, findings[0].artifactId)
        assertEquals(nonMember.artifactId, findings[1].artifactId)
        assertEquals(listOf(exportId, exportId), findings.map { it.refOwnerId })
        assertEquals(findings, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L))
        assertEquals(
            referencesBefore,
            listOf(member, nonMember).sumOf {
                database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(it.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
            },
        )
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(member.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(nonMember.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
    }

    @Test

        val source = committedExportPackageFixture()

        database.schemaQueries.insertRecentDocument(

        )

            workspaceId = workspaceId,
            sourceExportArtifactId = source.export.exportArtifactId,
            sourcePdfArtifactId = sourcePdf.artifactId,
            sourcePdfSha256 = sourcePdf.sha256,
            sourcePageCount = 1L,
            orderedSourcePageIndexes = listOf(0),
        )
        store.beginSavedPdfEditManifest(edit)
        assertEquals(
            baseline.filterNot { it.refKind == "RECENT_DOCUMENT" },
            store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filterNot {
                it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION" || it.refKind == "RECENT_DOCUMENT"
            },
        )

        val composition = database.schemaQueries.savedPdfEditCompositionByManifest(manifestId.value).executeAsOne()
        val manifestBefore = database.schemaQueries.saveManifestById(manifestId.value).executeAsOne().toString()
        val sourceReferenceCount = database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(sourcePdf.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "DELETE FROM ArtifactReference WHERE artifact_id = '${sourcePdf.artifactId.value}' " +
                "AND ref_kind = 'SAVE_MANIFEST' AND ref_owner_id = '${manifestId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        val missingSourceReference = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L)
        assertEquals(
            1,
            missingSourceReference.count {
                it.code == "SAVE_MANIFEST_REFERENCE_MISSING" && it.refOwnerId == manifestId.value &&
                    it.artifactId == sourcePdf.artifactId
            },
        )
        assertEquals(missingSourceReference, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L))
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            sourcePdf.artifactId.value,
            "SAVE_MANIFEST",
            manifestId.value,
            "SAVE",
        )
        assertEquals(
            baseline.filterNot { it.refKind == "RECENT_DOCUMENT" },
            store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filterNot {
                it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION" || it.refKind == "RECENT_DOCUMENT"
            },
        )

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE SavedPdfEditComposition SET source_page_count = 2 WHERE save_manifest_id = '${manifestId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        val mismatch = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filter {
            it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION"
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH"), mismatch.map { it.code })
        assertEquals(sourcePdf.artifactId, mismatch.single().artifactId)
        assertEquals(manifestId.value, mismatch.single().refOwnerId)
        assertEquals(
            mismatch,
            store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filter {
                it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION"
            },
        )
        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE SavedPdfEditComposition SET source_page_count = 1 WHERE save_manifest_id = '${manifestId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "DELETE FROM SavedPdfEditComposition WHERE save_manifest_id = '${manifestId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        val missing = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filter {
            it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION"
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION_MISSING"), missing.map { it.code })
        assertEquals(sourcePdf.artifactId, missing.single().artifactId)
        assertEquals(
            missing,
            store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filter {
                it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION"
            },
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertSavedPdfEditComposition(
            composition.save_manifest_id,
            composition.source_export_artifact_id,
            composition.source_pdf_artifact_id,
            composition.source_pdf_sha256,
            composition.source_page_count,
            composition.output_page_order,
        )

        val otherSaveManifestId = SaveManifestId.new()
        val otherExportArtifactId = ExportArtifactId.new()
        database.schemaQueries.insertSaveManifest(otherSaveManifestId.value, workspaceId.value, 1L, "{}")
        database.schemaQueries.insertExportArtifact(
            otherExportArtifactId.value,
            otherSaveManifestId.value,
            "PDF_WITH_JPG_PAGE_SET",
            "{\"formatVersion\":1,\"files\":[]}",
            1L,
            1L,
        )
        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE SavedPdfEditComposition SET source_export_artifact_id = '${otherExportArtifactId.value}' " +
                "WHERE save_manifest_id = '${manifestId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        val nonMember = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filter {
            it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION"
        }
        assertEquals(
            listOf("SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH", "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_SOURCE_NOT_IN_EXPORT"),
            nonMember.map { it.code },
        )
        assertTrue(nonMember.all { it.artifactId == sourcePdf.artifactId && it.refOwnerId == manifestId.value })
        assertEquals(
            nonMember,
            store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L).filter {
                it.refKind == "SAVED_PDF_EDIT_COMPOSITION"
            },
        )

        val manifestAfter = database.schemaQueries.saveManifestById(manifestId.value).executeAsOne()
        assertEquals(manifestBefore, manifestAfter.toString())
        assertEquals(
            sourceReferenceCount,
            database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(sourcePdf.artifactId.value).executeAsOne(),
        )
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(sourcePdf.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
    }

    @Test
    fun exportAttemptObservationAuditFindsBrokenLinksWithoutMutation() {
        val fixture = committedExportFixture()
        val provider = qualifiedProvider()
        val outputs = store.committedExportOutputs(fixture.exportArtifactId)
        val firstCommand = beginAttempt(fixture, provider).copy(
            outputArtifactId = outputs[0].artifactId,
            plannedDisplayName = "audit-first.pdf",
            mimeType = "application/pdf",
        )
        val secondCommand = beginAttempt(fixture, provider).copy(
            exportAttemptId = ExportAttemptId.new(),
            outputArtifactId = outputs[1].artifactId,
            plannedDisplayName = "audit-second.jpg",
            mimeType = "image/jpeg",
        )
        listOf(
            firstCommand to observation("audit-observation-first", "first"),
            secondCommand to observation("audit-observation-second", "second"),
        ).forEach { (command, providerObservation) ->
            store.beginExportAttempt(command)
            store.finishWritingExportAttempt(
                command.exportAttemptId,
                ExportAttemptOutcome.SUCCEEDED,
                "provider:${command.exportAttemptId.value}",
                null,
                false,
                providerObservation,
            )
        }
        val relevantKinds = setOf("EXPORT_ATTEMPT_OBSERVATION", "PROVIDER_OPERATION_OBSERVATION")
        val baseline = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind in relevantKinds }
        assertEquals(emptyList<ArtifactReferenceIntegrityFinding>(), baseline)

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ExportAttempt SET operation_observation_id = 'missing-observation' " +
                "WHERE export_attempt_id = '${firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        val missingAttemptBefore = database.schemaQueries.exportAttemptById(firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value)
            .executeAsOne().toString()
        val firstObservationBefore = database.schemaQueries.providerOperationObservationById("audit-observation-first")
            .executeAsOne().toString()
        val missing = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind in relevantKinds }
        assertEquals(
            listOf("EXPORT_ATTEMPT_OBSERVATION_MISSING", "PROVIDER_OBSERVATION_BACKLINK_MISSING"),
            missing.map { it.code },
        )
        assertEquals(missing, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind in relevantKinds })
        assertEquals(missingAttemptBefore, database.schemaQueries.exportAttemptById(firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value)
            .executeAsOne().toString())
        assertEquals(firstObservationBefore, database.schemaQueries.providerOperationObservationById("audit-observation-first")
            .executeAsOne().toString())
        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ExportAttempt SET operation_observation_id = 'audit-observation-first' " +
                "WHERE export_attempt_id = '${firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ExportAttempt SET operation_observation_id = 'audit-observation-second' " +
                "WHERE export_attempt_id = '${firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        val mismatch = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind in relevantKinds }
        assertEquals(
            listOf("EXPORT_ATTEMPT_OBSERVATION_OWNER_MISMATCH", "PROVIDER_OBSERVATION_BACKLINK_MISSING"),
            mismatch.map { it.code },
        )
        assertEquals(mismatch, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind in relevantKinds })
        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ExportAttempt SET operation_observation_id = 'audit-observation-first' " +
                "WHERE export_attempt_id = '${firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value}'",
            0,
            null,
        )

        database.schemaQueries.insertProviderOperationObservation(
            "audit-observation-orphan",
            firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value,
            "orphan",
            null,
            null,
            null,
            null,
            null,
        )
        val orphanBefore = database.schemaQueries.providerOperationObservationById("audit-observation-orphan")
            .executeAsOne().toString()
        val orphan = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind in relevantKinds }
        assertEquals(listOf("PROVIDER_OBSERVATION_BACKLINK_MISSING"), orphan.map { it.code })
        assertEquals(firstCommand.exportAttemptId.value, orphan.single().refOwnerId)
        assertEquals(orphan, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind in relevantKinds })
        assertEquals(orphanBefore, database.schemaQueries.providerOperationObservationById("audit-observation-orphan")
            .executeAsOne().toString())
    }

    @Test
    fun externalPackageQualificationTupleAuditFindsEveryMismatchWithoutMutation() {
        val fixture = committedExportPackageFixture()
        val exportId = fixture.export.exportArtifactId.value
        val packageBefore = database.schemaQueries.externalExportPackageById(exportId).executeAsOne()
        val qualificationBefore = database.schemaQueries.providerQualificationById(
            packageBefore.provider_qualification_id,
        ).executeAsOne()
        val pdfOutput = store.committedExportOutputs(fixture.export.exportArtifactId)
            .single { it.mimeType == "application/pdf" }
        val relevantKind = "EXTERNAL_PACKAGE_QUALIFICATION"
        assertTrue(store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).none { it.refKind == relevantKind })

        val mismatches = listOf(
            "adapter_id" to "different-adapter",
            "provider_version" to "different-provider-version",
            "os_version" to "different-os-version",
            "destination_access_class" to "different-access-class",
        )
        mismatches.forEachIndexed { index, (column, changedValue) ->
            driver.execute(
                null,
                "UPDATE ExternalExportPackage SET $column = '$changedValue' WHERE export_artifact_id = '$exportId'",
                0,
                null,
            )
            val corruptRow = database.schemaQueries.externalExportPackageById(exportId).executeAsOne().toString()
            val findings = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter {
                it.refKind == relevantKind
            }
            assertEquals(listOf("EXTERNAL_PACKAGE_QUALIFICATION_TUPLE_MISMATCH"), findings.map { it.code })
            assertEquals(pdfOutput.artifactId, findings.single().artifactId)
            assertEquals(exportId, findings.single().refOwnerId)
            assertEquals(
                findings,
                store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter { it.refKind == relevantKind },
            )
            assertEquals(corruptRow, database.schemaQueries.externalExportPackageById(exportId).executeAsOne().toString())
            assertEquals(
                qualificationBefore,
                database.schemaQueries.providerQualificationById(packageBefore.provider_qualification_id).executeAsOne(),
            )
            val originalValue = when (column) {
                "adapter_id" -> packageBefore.adapter_id
                "provider_version" -> packageBefore.provider_version
                "os_version" -> packageBefore.os_version
                else -> packageBefore.destination_access_class
            }
            driver.execute(
                null,
                "UPDATE ExternalExportPackage SET $column = '$originalValue' WHERE export_artifact_id = '$exportId'",
                0,
                null,
            )
            if (index < mismatches.lastIndex) {
                assertTrue(store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).none { it.refKind == relevantKind })
            }
        }
        assertEquals(packageBefore, database.schemaQueries.externalExportPackageById(exportId).executeAsOne())
    }

    @Test
    fun recentDocumentAuditChecksConfirmedPdfProjectionWithoutMutation() {
        val fixture = committedExportPackageFixture()
        val outputs = store.committedExportOutputs(fixture.export.exportArtifactId)
        outputs.forEachIndexed { index, output ->
            val command = beginAttempt(fixture.export, fixture.provider).copy(
                exportAttemptId = ExportAttemptId.new(),
                outputArtifactId = output.artifactId,
                plannedDisplayName = if (index == 0) "Scan.pdf" else "Scan-001.jpg",
                mimeType = if (index == 0) "application/pdf" else "image/jpeg",
            )
            store.beginExportAttempt(command)
            store.finishWritingExportAttempt(
                command.exportAttemptId,
                ExportAttemptOutcome.SUCCEEDED,
                "content://test.provider/${command.exportAttemptId.value}",
                null,
                false,
                observation("recent-audit-${command.exportAttemptId.value}", "fully read back"),
            )
        }
        val recent = store.recentDocuments(1_000L).single()
        val exportId = fixture.export.exportArtifactId.value
        val pdfOutput = outputs.first()
        val relevantKind = "RECENT_DOCUMENT"
        assertTrue(store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).none { it.refKind == relevantKind })

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ExternalExportPackage SET state = 'PARTIAL' WHERE export_artifact_id = '$exportId'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        val packageFinding = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter {
            it.refKind == relevantKind
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("RECENT_DOCUMENT_PACKAGE_NOT_CONFIRMED"), packageFinding.map { it.code })
        assertEquals(pdfOutput.artifactId, packageFinding.single().artifactId)
        assertEquals(packageFinding, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter {
            it.refKind == relevantKind
        })
        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ExternalExportPackage SET state = 'SUCCEEDED' WHERE export_artifact_id = '$exportId'",
            0,
            null,
        )

        val corruptions = listOf(
            Triple("document_uri", "content://tampered", "RECENT_DOCUMENT_URI_MISMATCH"),
            Triple("display_name", "Other.pdf", "RECENT_DOCUMENT_DISPLAY_NAME_MISMATCH"),
            Triple("page_count", "2", "RECENT_DOCUMENT_PAGE_COUNT_MISMATCH"),
            Triple("ocr_status", "NONE", "RECENT_DOCUMENT_OCR_STATUS_MISMATCH"),
        )
        corruptions.forEach { (column, changedValue, expectedCode) ->
            driver.execute(
                null,
                "UPDATE RecentDocument SET $column = '$changedValue' WHERE export_artifact_id = '$exportId'",
                0,
                null,
            )
            val recentBeforeRead = database.schemaQueries.recentDocumentByExport(exportId).executeAsOne().toString()
            val findings = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter {
                it.refKind == relevantKind
            }
            assertEquals(listOf(expectedCode), findings.map { it.code })
            assertEquals(pdfOutput.artifactId, findings.single().artifactId)
            assertEquals(exportId, findings.single().refOwnerId)
            assertEquals(findings, store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).filter {
                it.refKind == relevantKind
            })
            assertEquals(
                recentBeforeRead,
                database.schemaQueries.recentDocumentByExport(exportId).executeAsOne().toString(),
            )
            val restoreValue = when (column) {
                "document_uri" -> recent.documentUri
                "display_name" -> recent.displayName
                "page_count" -> recent.pageCount.toString()
                else -> recent.ocrStatus
            }
            driver.execute(
                null,
                "UPDATE RecentDocument SET $column = '$restoreValue' WHERE export_artifact_id = '$exportId'",
                0,
                null,
            )
        }
        assertTrue(store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(100L).none { it.refKind == relevantKind })
    }

    @Test
    fun artifactReferenceClosureFindsMissingCurrentImportAndActiveExportEdges() {
        val pageArtifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(pageArtifact)
        val capture = captureCommand(pageArtifact)
        store.commitCapture(capture)

        val replacementArtifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(replacementArtifact)
        val replacementVersion = ImageVersionId.new()
        assertEquals(
            2L,
            store.replacePageImage(
                ReplacePageImageCommand(
                    workspaceId = workspaceId,
                    pageId = capture.pageId,
                    expectedImageVersionId = capture.imageVersionId,
                    expectedContentRevision = 1L,
                    newImageVersionId = replacementVersion,
                    artifact = replacementArtifact,
                    coordinateSpace = "source-pixel-v1",
                    transformProvenance = "test-replacement",
                    processingDesiredState = "NONE",
                ),
            ),
        )

        val workflowArtifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(workflowArtifact)
        assertEquals(1L, database.schemaQueries.commitArtifact(workflowArtifact.artifactId.value).value)
        database.schemaQueries.insertImportSession(
            "open-import-session", workspaceId.value, "parameters", workflowArtifact.artifactId.value,
            null, "source.pdf",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertSaveManifest("closure-save-manifest", workspaceId.value, 1L, "{}")
        database.schemaQueries.insertExportArtifact(
            "closure-export-artifact", "closure-save-manifest", "PDF",
            "{\"files\":[{\"artifactId\":\"${workflowArtifact.artifactId.value}\"}]}", 1L, 1L,
        )
        database.schemaQueries.insertExportAttempt(
            "active-export-attempt", "closure-export-artifact", workflowArtifact.artifactId.value,
            1L, "destination", "parameters",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            workflowArtifact.artifactId.value, "IMPORT_SESSION", "open-import-session", "RECOVERY",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            workflowArtifact.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ARTIFACT", "closure-export-artifact", "EXPORT",
        )
        database.schemaQueries.addArtifactReference(
            workflowArtifact.artifactId.value, "EXPORT_ATTEMPT", "active-export-attempt", "RECOVERY",
        )
        assertEquals(emptyList<ArtifactReferenceIntegrityFinding>(), store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L))

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "DELETE FROM ArtifactReference WHERE ref_kind = 'IMAGE_VERSION' AND ref_owner_id IN ('${capture.imageVersionId.value}', '${replacementVersion.value}')",
            0,
            null,
        )
        driver.execute(
            null,
            "DELETE FROM ArtifactReference WHERE ref_kind = 'IMPORT_SESSION' AND ref_owner_id = 'open-import-session'",
            0,
            null,
        )
        database.schemaQueries.deleteExportAttemptArtifactReferences("active-export-attempt")

        val allReferencesBefore = listOf(pageArtifact, replacementArtifact, workflowArtifact).sumOf {
            database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(it.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
        }
        val findings = store.artifactReferenceOwnerIntegrityFindings(20L)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                "CURRENT_IMAGE_VERSION_REFERENCE_MISSING",
                "EXPORT_ATTEMPT_REFERENCE_MISSING",
                "IMPORT_SESSION_REFERENCE_MISSING",
                "UNDO_IMAGE_VERSION_REFERENCE_MISSING",
            ),
            findings.map { it.code },
        )
        assertEquals(replacementVersion.value, findings[0].refOwnerId)
        assertEquals("active-export-attempt", findings[1].refOwnerId)
        assertEquals("open-import-session", findings[2].refOwnerId)
        assertEquals(capture.imageVersionId.value, findings[3].refOwnerId)
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(pageArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(workflowArtifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
        assertEquals(
            allReferencesBefore,
            listOf(pageArtifact, replacementArtifact, workflowArtifact).sumOf {
                database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(it.artifactId.value).executeAsOne()
            },
        )
        assertEquals(replacementVersion.value, database.schemaQueries.pageById(capture.pageId.value)
            .executeAsOne().current_image_version_id)
    }

    @Test
    fun workspaceIntegrityDiagnosticsFindCurrentOwnerAndProtectionFailuresWithoutRepairingThem() {
        val artifact = durableArtifact()
        store.recordStagedDurableArtifact(artifact)
        val capture = captureCommand(artifact)
        store.commitCapture(capture)

        driver.execute(
            null,
            "UPDATE ImageVersion SET page_id = 'wrong-owner' WHERE image_version_id = '${capture.imageVersionId.value}'",

        )

        assertEquals(
            setOf(
                "CURRENT_IMAGE_VERSION_PAGE_MISMATCH",
                "CURRENT_IMAGE_VERSION_REFERENCE_MISSING",
                "ACTIVE_PAGE_NOT_VISIBLE",
            ),
            findings.map { it.code }.toSet(),
        )

            .all { it.pageId == capture.pageId.value })

        assertEquals(0L, database.schemaQueries.referenceCountForArtifact(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne())

            .executeAsOne().current_image_version_id)
        assertEquals("COMMITTED", database.schemaQueries.artifactById(artifact.artifactId.value).executeAsOne().state)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            store.workspaceImageReferenceIntegrityFindings(workspaceId, 0L)
        }
    }
